    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ir" "circuit" "missing IR" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (schema (hash-ref ir "schema" "")))
      (if (and (string? schema)
               (not (equal? schema ""))
               (not (equal? schema daed:ir-schema-id)))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "schema" "circuit"
                                    "unexpected schema id" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let ((cs (daed:ir-comps ir)))
        (if (null? cs)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                      "no components" "")
                          acc))
          0)
        (let loop ((xs cs))
          (if (null? xs)
            0
            (begin
              (let ((c (car xs)))
                (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
                      (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
                      (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" -1)))
                      (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" -1)))
                      (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" #f))))
                  (if (or (not (string? nm)) (equal? nm ""))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-name" "circuit"
                                                "component missing name" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (string? nm) (daed:mem-name? nm seen))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                                "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (string? nm)
                    (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                    0)
                  (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                                "unknown component type" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (or (= n1 0) (= n2 0)
                          (and (equal? ty "Q")
                               (= (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" -1)) 0)))
                    (set! has-gnd #t)
                    0)
                  (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q"))
                           (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "bad-is" nm
                                                "Is should be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I"))
                           (not (number? val)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "source value missing" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))

                                                "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "I") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "i-open" nm
                                                "current source terminals coincide" "")
                                    acc))

                                    acc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr xs)))))
        (if (not has-gnd)

                          acc))

; ── Circuit validation (plus connectivity) ──

(define (daed:ckt-node-list ckt)
  (let ((acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        acc
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c)))
              (if (and (number? n1) (not (daed:mem-num? n1 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n1 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (number? n2) (not (daed:mem-num? n2 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n2 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                       (number? n3) (not (= n3 0))
                       (not (daed:mem-num? n3 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n3 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                       (number? (daed:comp-n4 c))
                       (not (= (daed:comp-n4 c) 0))
                       (not (daed:mem-num? (daed:comp-n4 c) acc)))
                (set! acc (cons (daed:comp-n4 c) acc))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Undirected adjacency as list of (node . neighbors)
(define (daed:adj-get adj node)
  (let loop ((xs adj))
    (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (if (equal? (car (car xs)) node)
        (cdr (car xs))
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:adj-add adj a b)
  (if (= a b)
    adj
    (let ((na (cons b (daed:adj-get adj a)))
          (nb (cons a (daed:adj-get adj b)))
          (out '())
          (seen-a #f)
          (seen-b #f))
      (let loop ((xs adj))
        (if (null? xs)
          (begin
            (if (not seen-a) (set! out (cons (cons a na) out)) 0)
            (if (not seen-b) (set! out (cons (cons b nb) out)) 0)
            out)
          (begin
            (let ((k (car (car xs))))
              (if (equal? k a)
                (begin (set! seen-a #t) (set! out (cons (cons a na) out)))
                (if (equal? k b)
                  (begin (set! seen-b #t) (set! out (cons (cons b nb) out)))
                  (set! out (cons (car xs) out)))))
            (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (daed:ckt-adj ckt)
  (let ((adj '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        adj
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n1 c) (daed:comp-n2 c)))
            (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
              (begin
                (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n1 c) (daed:comp-n3 c)))
                (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n3 c))))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:reachable-from adj start)
  (let ((seen (list start))
        (stack (list start)))
    (while (lambda () (not (null? stack)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((n (car stack)))
          (set! stack (cdr stack))
          (let loop ((ns (daed:adj-get adj n)))
            (if (null? ns)
              0
              (begin
                (if (not (daed:mem-num? (car ns) seen))
                  (begin
                    (set! seen (cons (car ns) seen))
                    (set! stack (cons (car ns) stack)))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr ns))))))))
    seen))

(define (daed:validate-ckt ckt)
  (if (not ckt)
    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ckt" "circuit" "missing circuit" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                    "no components" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "topology" "circuit"
                                    "topology-ok? failed" "fix-value")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let loop ((xs cs))
        (if (null? xs)
          0
          (begin
            (let ((c (car xs)))
              (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                    (nm (daed:comp-name c))
                    (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                    (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                    (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (daed:mem-name? nm seen)
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                              "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                              "unknown component type" "")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (if (or (equal? n1 0) (equal? n2 0)
                        (and (equal? ty "Q") (equal? (daed:comp-n3 c) 0)))
                  (set! has-gnd #t)
                  0)
                (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                              "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "v-short" nm
                                              "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                  acc))
                  0)))
            (loop (cdr xs)))))
      (if (not has-gnd)
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "no-gnd" "circuit"
                                    "no terminal on node 0 (GND)" "ensure-gnd")
                        acc))
        0)
      (if has-gnd
        (let ((nodes (daed:ckt-node-list ckt))
              (reach (daed:reachable-from (daed:ckt-adj ckt) 0)))
          (let loop ((ns nodes))
            (if (null? ns)
              0
              (begin
                (if (not (daed:mem-num? (car ns) reach))

                                              "node not connected to GND"
                                              "ensure-gnd")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr ns))))))
        0)
      (reverse acc))))

; lib/validate.aura — Static topology / semantic checks (issue #6 / #9)
;
; (require "validate" all:)
;
; Pure Aura. Issues are hashes the repair agent can consume:
;   severity  "error" | "warn"
;   code      machine id
;   loc       component name or "circuit"
;   msg       human text
;   fix       suggested operator name (or "")

(export daed:validate-version
        daed:issue
        daed:issue-error?
        daed:issues-errors
        daed:issues-error-count
        daed:validate-ir
        daed:validate-ckt)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "ir" all:)
(require "mutate-circuit" all:)

(define daed:validate-version 1)

(define (daed:issue sev code loc msg fix)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "severity" sev)
    (hash-set! h "code" code)
    (hash-set! h "loc" loc)
    (hash-set! h "msg" msg)
    (hash-set! h "fix" fix)
    h))

(define (daed:issue-error? iss)
  (equal? (hash-ref iss "severity" "") "error"))

(define (daed:issues-error-count issues)
  (let ((n 0))
    (let loop ((xs issues))
      (if (null? xs)
        n
        (begin
          (if (daed:issue-error? (car xs))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            0)
          (loop (cdr xs)))))))

(define (daed:issues-errors issues)
  (let ((acc '()))
    (let loop ((xs issues))
      (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (begin
          (if (daed:issue-error? (car xs))
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            0)
          (loop (cdr xs)))))))

(define (daed:mem-name? name xs)
  (let loop ((ys xs))
    (if (null? ys)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car ys) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr ys))))))

(define (daed:mem-num? n xs)
  (let loop ((ys xs))
    (if (null? ys)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car ys) n)
        #t
        (loop (cdr ys))))))

(define (daed:type-ok? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")
      (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I") (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q")
      (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "G") (equal? ty "F") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:passive? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")))

; ── IR validation ──

(define (daed:validate-ir ir)
  (if (not ir)
    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ir" "circuit" "missing IR" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (schema (hash-ref ir "schema" "")))
      (if (and (string? schema)
               (not (equal? schema ""))
               (not (equal? schema daed:ir-schema-id)))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "schema" "circuit"
                                    "unexpected schema id" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let ((cs (daed:ir-comps ir)))
        (if (null? cs)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                      "no components" "")
                          acc))
          0)
        (let loop ((xs cs))
          (if (null? xs)
            0
            (begin
              (let ((c (car xs)))
                (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
                      (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
                      (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" -1)))
                      (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" -1)))
                      (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" #f))))
                  (if (or (not (string? nm)) (equal? nm ""))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-name" "circuit"
                                                "component missing name" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (string? nm) (daed:mem-name? nm seen))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                                "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (string? nm)
                    (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                    0)
                  (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                                "unknown component type" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (or (= n1 0) (= n2 0)
                          (and (equal? ty "Q")
                               (= (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" -1)) 0)))
                    (set! has-gnd #t)
                    0)
                  (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q"))
                           (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "bad-is" nm
                                                "Is should be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I"))
                           (not (number? val)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "source value missing" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "v-short" nm
                                                "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "I") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "i-open" nm
                                                "current source terminals coincide" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "D") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "d-short" nm
                                                "diode terminals coincide" "flip-d")
                                    acc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr xs)))))
        (if (not has-gnd)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "no-gnd" "circuit"
                                      "no terminal on node 0 (GND)" "ensure-gnd")
                          acc))
          0))
      (reverse acc))))

; ── Circuit validation (plus connectivity) ──

(define (daed:ckt-node-list ckt)
  (let ((acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        acc
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c)))
              (if (and (number? n1) (not (daed:mem-num? n1 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n1 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (number? n2) (not (daed:mem-num? n2 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n2 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                       (number? n3) (not (= n3 0))
                       (not (daed:mem-num? n3 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n3 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                       (number? (daed:comp-n4 c))
                       (not (= (daed:comp-n4 c) 0))
                       (not (daed:mem-num? (daed:comp-n4 c) acc)))
                (set! acc (cons (daed:comp-n4 c) acc))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Undirected adjacency as list of (node . neighbors)
(define (daed:adj-get adj node)
  (let loop ((xs adj))
    (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (if (equal? (car (car xs)) node)
        (cdr (car xs))
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:adj-add adj a b)
  (if (= a b)
    adj
    (let ((na (cons b (daed:adj-get adj a)))
          (nb (cons a (daed:adj-get adj b)))
          (out '())
          (seen-a #f)
          (seen-b #f))
      (let loop ((xs adj))
        (if (null? xs)
          (begin
            (if (not seen-a) (set! out (cons (cons a na) out)) 0)
            (if (not seen-b) (set! out (cons (cons b nb) out)) 0)
            out)
          (begin
            (let ((k (car (car xs))))
              (if (equal? k a)
                (begin (set! seen-a #t) (set! out (cons (cons a na) out)))
                (if (equal? k b)
                  (begin (set! seen-b #t) (set! out (cons (cons b nb) out)))
                  (set! out (cons (car xs) out)))))
            (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (daed:ckt-adj ckt)
  (let ((adj '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        adj
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n1 c) (daed:comp-n2 c)))
            (if (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
              (begin
                (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n1 c) (daed:comp-n3 c)))
                (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n3 c))))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:reachable-from adj start)
  (let ((seen (list start))
        (stack (list start)))
    (while (lambda () (not (null? stack)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((n (car stack)))
          (set! stack (cdr stack))
          (let loop ((ns (daed:adj-get adj n)))
            (if (null? ns)
              0
              (begin
                (if (not (daed:mem-num? (car ns) seen))
                  (begin
                    (set! seen (cons (car ns) seen))
                    (set! stack (cons (car ns) stack)))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr ns))))))))
    seen))

(define (daed:validate-ckt ckt)
  (if (not ckt)
    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ckt" "circuit" "missing circuit" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                    "no components" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "topology" "circuit"
                                    "topology-ok? failed" "fix-value")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let loop ((xs cs))
        (if (null? xs)
          0
          (begin
            (let ((c (car xs)))
              (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                    (nm (daed:comp-name c))
                    (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                    (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                    (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (daed:mem-name? nm seen)
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                              "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                              "unknown component type" "")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (if (or (equal? n1 0) (equal? n2 0)
                        (and (equal? ty "Q") (equal? (daed:comp-n3 c) 0)))
                  (set! has-gnd #t)
                  0)
                (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                              "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "v-short" nm
                                              "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                  acc))
                  0)))
            (loop (cdr xs)))))
      (if (not has-gnd)
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "no-gnd" "circuit"
                                    "no terminal on node 0 (GND)" "ensure-gnd")
                        acc))
        0)
      (if has-gnd
        (let ((nodes (daed:ckt-node-list ckt))
              (reach (daed:reachable-from (daed:ckt-adj ckt) 0)))
          (let loop ((ns nodes))
            (if (null? ns)
              0
              (begin
                (if (not (daed:mem-num? (car ns) reach))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "floating" "circuit"
                                              "node not connected to GND"
                                              "ensure-gnd")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr ns))))))
        0)
      (reverse acc))))

input.source:
; lib/validate.aura — Static topology / semantic checks (issue #6 / #9)
;
; (require "validate" all:)
;
; Pure Aura. Issues are hashes the repair agent can consume:
;   severity  "error" | "warn"
;   code      machine id
;   loc       component name or "circuit"
;   msg       human text
;   fix       suggested operator name (or "")

(export daed:validate-version
        daed:issue
        daed:issue-error?
        daed:issues-errors
        daed:issues-error-count
        daed:validate-ir
        daed:validate-ckt)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "ir" all:)
(require "mutate-circuit" all:)

(define daed:validate-version 1)

(define (daed:issue sev code loc msg fix)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "severity" sev)
    (hash-set! h "code" code)
    (hash-set! h "loc" loc)
    (hash-set! h "msg" msg)
    (hash-set! h "fix" fix)
    h))

(define (daed:issue-error? iss)
  (equal? (hash-ref iss "severity" "") "error"))

(define (daed:issues-error-count issues)
  (let ((n 0))
    (let loop ((xs issues))
      (if (null? xs)
        n
        (begin
          (if (daed:issue-error? (car xs))
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            0)
          (loop (cdr xs)))))))

(define (daed:issues-errors issues)
  (let ((acc '()))
    (let loop ((xs issues))
      (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (begin
          (if (daed:issue-error? (car xs))
            (set! acc (cons (car xs) acc))
            0)
          (loop (cdr xs)))))))

(define (daed:mem-name? name xs)
  (let loop ((ys xs))
    (if (null? ys)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car ys) name)
        #t
        (loop (cdr ys))))))

(define (daed:mem-num? n xs)
  (let loop ((ys xs))
    (if (null? ys)
      #f
      (if (equal? (car ys) n)
        #t
        (loop (cdr ys))))))

(define (daed:type-ok? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")
      (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I") (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q")
      (equal? ty "M")
      (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "G") (equal? ty "F") (equal? ty "H")))

(define (daed:passive? ty)
  (or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "C") (equal? ty "L")))

; ── IR validation ──

(define (daed:validate-ir ir)
  (if (not ir)
    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ir" "circuit" "missing IR" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (schema (hash-ref ir "schema" "")))
      (if (and (string? schema)
               (not (equal? schema ""))
               (not (equal? schema daed:ir-schema-id)))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "schema" "circuit"
                                    "unexpected schema id" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let ((cs (daed:ir-comps ir)))
        (if (null? cs)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                      "no components" "")
                          acc))
          0)
        (let loop ((xs cs))
          (if (null? xs)
            0
            (begin
              (let ((c (car xs)))
                (let ((ty (hash-ref c "type" ""))
                      (nm (hash-ref c "name" ""))
                      (n1 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n1" -1)))
                      (n2 (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n2" -1)))
                      (val (daed:parse-value (hash-ref c "value" #f))))
                  (if (or (not (string? nm)) (equal? nm ""))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-name" "circuit"
                                                "component missing name" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (string? nm) (daed:mem-name? nm seen))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                                "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (string? nm)
                    (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                    0)
                  (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                                "unknown component type" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (or (= n1 0) (= n2 0)
                          (and (or (equal? ty "Q") (equal? ty "M"))
                               (= (daed:node-id (hash-ref c "n3" -1)) 0)))
                    (set! has-gnd #t)
                    0)
                  (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "D") (equal? ty "Q"))
                           (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "bad-is" nm
                                                "Is should be > 0" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (or (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I"))
                           (not (number? val)))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                                "source value missing" "fix-value")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "v-short" nm
                                                "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "I") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "warn" "i-open" nm
                                                "current source terminals coincide" "")
                                    acc))
                    0)
                  (if (and (equal? ty "D") (= n1 n2))
                    (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "d-short" nm
                                                "diode terminals coincide" "flip-d")
                                    acc))
                    0)))
              (loop (cdr xs)))))
        (if (not has-gnd)
          (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "no-gnd" "circuit"
                                      "no terminal on node 0 (GND)" "ensure-gnd")
                          acc))
          0))
      (reverse acc))))

; ── Circuit validation (plus connectivity) ──

(define (daed:ckt-node-list ckt)
  (let ((acc '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        acc
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                  (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                  (n3 (daed:comp-n3 c)))
              (if (and (number? n1) (not (daed:mem-num? n1 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n1 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (number? n2) (not (daed:mem-num? n2 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n2 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "M")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                       (number? n3) (not (= n3 0))
                       (not (daed:mem-num? n3 acc)))
                (set! acc (cons n3 acc))
                0)
              (if (and (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "E")
                           (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "G"))
                       (number? (daed:comp-n4 c))
                       (not (= (daed:comp-n4 c) 0))
                       (not (daed:mem-num? (daed:comp-n4 c) acc)))
                (set! acc (cons (daed:comp-n4 c) acc))
                0)))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; Undirected adjacency as list of (node . neighbors)
(define (daed:adj-get adj node)
  (let loop ((xs adj))
    (if (null? xs)
      '()
      (if (equal? (car (car xs)) node)
        (cdr (car xs))
        (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (daed:adj-add adj a b)
  (if (= a b)
    adj
    (let ((na (cons b (daed:adj-get adj a)))
          (nb (cons a (daed:adj-get adj b)))
          (out '())
          (seen-a #f)
          (seen-b #f))
      (let loop ((xs adj))
        (if (null? xs)
          (begin
            (if (not seen-a) (set! out (cons (cons a na) out)) 0)
            (if (not seen-b) (set! out (cons (cons b nb) out)) 0)
            out)
          (begin
            (let ((k (car (car xs))))
              (if (equal? k a)
                (begin (set! seen-a #t) (set! out (cons (cons a na) out)))
                (if (equal? k b)
                  (begin (set! seen-b #t) (set! out (cons (cons b nb) out)))
                  (set! out (cons (car xs) out)))))
            (loop (cdr xs))))))))

(define (daed:ckt-adj ckt)
  (let ((adj '()))
    (let loop ((cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        adj
        (begin
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n1 c) (daed:comp-n2 c)))
            (if (or (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "Q")
                    (equal? (daed:comp-type c) "M"))
              (begin
                (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n1 c) (daed:comp-n3 c)))
                (set! adj (daed:adj-add adj (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n3 c))))
              0))
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:reachable-from adj start)
  (let ((seen (list start))
        (stack (list start)))
    (while (lambda () (not (null? stack)))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((n (car stack)))
          (set! stack (cdr stack))
          (let loop ((ns (daed:adj-get adj n)))
            (if (null? ns)
              0
              (begin
                (if (not (daed:mem-num? (car ns) seen))
                  (begin
                    (set! seen (cons (car ns) seen))
                    (set! stack (cons (car ns) stack)))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr ns))))))))
    seen))

(define (daed:validate-ckt ckt)
  (if (not ckt)
    (list (daed:issue "error" "no-ckt" "circuit" "missing circuit" ""))
    (let ((acc '())
          (seen '())
          (has-gnd #f)
          (cs (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
      (if (null? cs)
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "empty" "circuit"
                                    "no components" "")
                        acc))
        0)
      (if (not (daed:topology-ok? ckt))
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "topology" "circuit"
                                    "topology-ok? failed" "fix-value")
                        acc))
        0)
      (let loop ((xs cs))
        (if (null? xs)
          0
          (begin
            (let ((c (car xs)))
              (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                    (nm (daed:comp-name c))
                    (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                    (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                    (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                (if (daed:mem-name? nm seen)
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "dup-name" nm
                                              "duplicate component name" "rename")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (set! seen (cons nm seen))
                (if (not (daed:type-ok? ty))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-type" nm
                                              "unknown component type" "")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (if (or (equal? n1 0) (equal? n2 0)
                        (and (or (equal? ty "Q") (equal? ty "M"))
                             (equal? (daed:comp-n3 c) 0)))
                  (set! has-gnd #t)
                  0)
                (if (and (daed:passive? ty) (or (not (number? val)) (<= val 0.0)))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "bad-value" nm
                                              "R/C/L must be > 0" "fix-value")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (if (and (equal? ty "V") (= n1 n2))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "v-short" nm
                                              "voltage source is shorted" "unshort-v")
                                  acc))
                  0)))
            (loop (cdr xs)))))
      (if (not has-gnd)
        (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "no-gnd" "circuit"
                                    "no terminal on node 0 (GND)" "ensure-gnd")
                        acc))
        0)
      (if has-gnd
        (let ((nodes (daed:ckt-node-list ckt))
              (reach (daed:reachable-from (daed:ckt-adj ckt) 0)))
          (let loop ((ns nodes))
            (if (null? ns)
              0
              (begin
                (if (not (daed:mem-num? (car ns) reach))
                  (set! acc (cons (daed:issue "error" "floating" "circuit"
                                              "node not connected to GND"
                                              "ensure-gnd")
                                  acc))
                  0)
                (loop (cdr ns))))))
        0)
      (reverse acc))))

; lib/native.aura — C++ dense-solve escape (issue #28 / M5)
;
; (require "native" all:)
;
; Hephaestus-pattern rebind: logical kernel daed:dense-solve! is
; "pure" (default) or "native". Native path is c-load + copy-in/out
; Opaque buffers (issue #32). Each native call is a metered escape.
; Failure of bind or solve leaves the Aura matrix untouched.

(export daed:native-version
        daed:native-ready?
        daed:native-lib
        daed:solve-backend
        daed:solve-rebind!
        daed:solve-rebind-ok?
        daed:solve-rebind-reason
        daed:solve-rebind-prev
        daed:dense-solve-native!
        daed:native-set-fail!
        daed:native-calls
        daed:native-on-escape!
        daed:solve-backend-set!)

; No require: FFI primitives are host-core. Escape hook set by the facade.

(define daed:native-version 1)

(define *daed-solve-backend* "pure")
(define *daed-native-lib* #f)
(define *daed-native-solve* #f)
(define *daed-native-ver* #f)
(define *daed-native-fail* #f)
(define *daed-native-tried* #f)
(define *daed-native-calls* 0)
(define *daed-native-escape-hook* #f)

(define (daed:native-calls)
  *daed-native-calls*)

(define (daed:native-on-escape! fn)
  (set! *daed-native-escape-hook* fn)
  #t)

(define (daed:native-escape! tag)
  (set! *daed-native-calls* (+ 1 *daed-native-calls*))
  (if *daed-native-escape-hook*
    (*daed-native-escape-hook* tag)
    #t))

(define (daed:solve-backend)
  *daed-solve-backend*)

(define (daed:solve-backend-set! k)
  (set! *daed-solve-backend* (if (string? k) k "pure"))
  *daed-solve-backend*)

(define (daed:native-lib)
  *daed-native-lib*)

(define (daed:native-try-path path)
  (let ((hid (try (c-load path) (catch (e) -2)))
        (disp #f)
        (v -1))
    (if (not (number? hid))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! disp (try (c-func hid "daed_dispatch"
                                "(Int Int Int Int) -> Int")
                        (catch (e) #f)))
        (if (or (not disp) (number? disp))
          #f
          (begin
            (set! v (try (disp 0 0 0 0) (catch (e) -1)))
            (if (= v 1)
              (begin
                (set! *daed-native-lib* hid)
                (set! *daed-native-solve* disp)
                disp)
              #f)))))))

(define (daed:native-bind!)
  (if *daed-native-tried*
    *daed-native-solve*
    (begin
      (set! *daed-native-tried* #t)
      (if (daed:native-try-path "native/libdaed_solve.so")
        *daed-native-solve*
        (daed:native-try-path "native/libdaed_solve.dylib")))))

(define (daed:native-ready?)
  (if *daed-native-solve*
    #t
    (if (daed:native-bind!)
      #t
      #f)))

(define (daed:f64-off i)
  (inexact->exact (* i 8)))

(define (daed:pack-f64! buf vec n)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (c-struct-set! buf (daed:f64-off i) (vector-ref vec i))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    buf))

(define (daed:unpack-f64! buf vec n)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (vector-set! vec i (c-struct-ref buf (daed:f64-off i) 1))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    vec))

(define (daed:native-set-fail! on)
  (if (not (daed:native-ready?))
    #f
    (begin
      (*daed-native-solve* 1 (if on 1 0) 0 0)
      #t)))

; Copy A,b → Opaque, call C++, copy b back on rc=0.
(define (daed:dense-solve-native! A b n)
  (if (not (daed:native-ready?))
    #f
    (if (or (not (number? n)) (<= n 0))
      #f
      (let ((nn (inexact->exact n))
            (Ab #f)
            (bb #f)

(define (daed:native-escape! tag)
  (set! *daed-native-calls* (+ 1 *daed-native-calls*))
  (if *daed-native-escape-hook*
    (*daed-native-escape-hook* tag)
    #t))

(define (daed:solve-backend)
  *daed-solve-backend*)

(define (daed:solve-backend-set! k)

  *daed-solve-backend*)

(define (daed:native-lib)
  *daed-native-lib*)

(define (daed:native-try-path path)
  (let ((ld (daed:load-kernels path))

  (hash-ref r "reason" ""))

(define (daed:solve-rebind-prev r)

; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + .op entry (Phase 1)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Host residual: naive (/ a b) can return 0 for legitimate small float
; operands after intermediate arithmetic (see notes/host-residuals.md).
; All critical divisions go through daed:safe-div.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:safe-div
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)

(define daed:solve-version 1)

; Scale numerator/denominator so |den*scale| >= 1 before dividing.
; Works around host float-div footgun on small post-arithmetic values.
(define (daed:safe-div num den)
  (if (or (not (number? num)) (not (number? den)))
    0.0
    (if (< (abs den) 0.000000000001)
      0.0
      (let ((scale 1.0))
        (while (lambda ()
                 (and (< (* (abs den) scale) 1.0)
                      (< scale 1000000000000.0)))
          (lambda ()
            (set! scale (* scale 1024.0))))
        (/ (* num scale) (* den scale))))))

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best 0.000000000001)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (daed:safe-div (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) 0.000000000001)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (daed:safe-div s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
      (let ((N (car sys))
            (A (car (cdr sys)))
            (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
            (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
        (let ((res (hash)))
          (hash-set! res "n" N)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (if (<= N 0)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
              (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
              res)
            (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
              (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
              (hash-set! res "x" b)
              (let ((volts (hash)))
                (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
                (if ok
                  (let ((k 1))
                    (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
                      (lambda ()
                        (hash-set! volts
                                   (number->string k)
                                   (daed:vec-ref b (- k 1)))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))
                  0)
                (hash-set! res "volts" volts)
                res))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + .op entry (Phase 1)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)

; 2 = post-#2940/#2941 cleanup (native / + sci literals; no safe-div)
(define daed:solve-version 2)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
      (let ((N (car sys))
            (A (car (cdr sys)))
            (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
            (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
        (let ((res (hash)))
          (hash-set! res "n" N)
          (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
          (if (<= N 0)
            (begin
              (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
              (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
              (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
              res)
            (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
              (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
              (hash-set! res "x" b)
              (let ((volts (hash)))
                (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
                (if ok
                  (let ((k 1))
                    (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
                      (lambda ()
                        (hash-set! volts
                                   (number->string k)
                                   (daed:vec-ref b (- k 1)))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))
                  0)
                (hash-set! res "volts" volts)
                res))))))))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

target.name: daed:simulate-op
target.body:
(lambda (ckt) (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

input.source:
; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 3 = Phase 5 Newton-Raphson for D/Q
(define daed:solve-version 3)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                      (i 0))
                  (while (lambda () (< i N))
                    (lambda ()
                      (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                      (set! i (+ i 1))))
                  (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                    (begin
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "singular"))
                    (begin
                      (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                      (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                        (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                        (if (< (vector-length x) N)
                          (let ((nx (make-vector N 0.0))
                                (k 0)
                                (m (vector-length x)))
                            (while (lambda () (< k m))
                              (lambda ()
                                (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
                                (set! k (+ k 1))))
                            (set! x nx))
                          0)
                        (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                        (if (or (< resid daed:nr-atol) (< dxn daed:nr-vtol))
                          (begin
                            (set! ok #t)
                            (set! going #f)
                            (set! reason "converged"))
                          0)))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (let ((nr (daed:newton-solve
                (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
                (make-vector N 0.0))))
      (hash-set! nr "volts"
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                             (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
          (hash)))
      nr)))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

target.name: daed:simulate-op-lin
target.body:
(lambda (comps) (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))

          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)

            res))))))

input.source:
; lib/solve.aura — Dense linear solve + Newton-Raphson .op (Phase 1 / 5)
;
; (require "solve" all:)
;
; Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting on dense MNA.
; Nonlinear circuits use NR (Jacobian + residual) on the same GE kernel.
; Linear circuits keep the one-shot path (bit-stable vs Phase 1 probes).
; Pure Aura; no FFI (escape count 0 on this path).
;
; Post aura#2940: plain (/) is correct on small post-arithmetic floats.
; Post aura#2941: scientific literals (1e-12) are accepted.

(export daed:solve-version
        daed:dense-solve!
        daed:newton-solve
        daed:simulate-op
        daed:op-ok?
        daed:op-x
        daed:op-n
        daed:op-n-v
        daed:op-voltages
        daed:op-iters
        daed:op-residual
        daed:nr-maxiter
        daed:nr-atol
        daed:nr-vtol
        daed:nr-dvmax)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)
(require "devices" all:)

; 3 = Phase 5 Newton-Raphson for D/Q
(define daed:solve-version 3)

(define daed:nr-maxiter 50)
(define daed:nr-atol 1e-8)
(define daed:nr-vtol 1e-6)
(define daed:nr-dvmax 0.5)

; Pivot / singularity floor for dense GE
(define daed:ge-eps 1e-12)

; Swap rows r1 and r2 in n×n matrix A and rhs b.
(define (daed:swap-rows! A b n r1 r2)
  (if (= r1 r2)
    #t
    (begin
      (let ((j 0))
        (while (lambda () (< j n))
          (lambda ()
            (let ((tmp (daed:mat-ref A n r1 j)))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r1 j (daed:mat-ref A n r2 j))
              (daed:mat-set! A n r2 j tmp))
            (set! j (+ j 1)))))
      (let ((tb (daed:vec-ref b r1)))
        (daed:vec-set! b r1 (daed:vec-ref b r2))
        (daed:vec-set! b r2 tb))
      #t)))

; In-place dense GE + back-sub. Returns #t on success, #f if singular.
; Solution overwrites b.
(define (daed:dense-solve! A b n)
  (let ((ok #t)
        (col 0))
    (while (lambda () (and ok (< col n)))
      (lambda ()
        ; partial pivot
        (let ((piv col)
              (best (abs (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
              (r (+ col 1)))
          (while (lambda () (< r n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((av (abs (daed:mat-ref A n r col))))
                (if (> av best)
                  (begin (set! best av) (set! piv r))
                  0))
              (set! r (+ r 1))))
          (if (< best daed:ge-eps)
            (set! ok #f)
            (begin
              (daed:swap-rows! A b n col piv)
              ; eliminate below
              (let ((i (+ col 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< i n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n col col)))
                      (let ((factor (/ (daed:mat-ref A n i col) diag)))
                        (daed:mat-set! A n i col 0.0)
                        (let ((j (+ col 1)))
                          (while (lambda () (< j n))
                            (lambda ()
                              (daed:mat-set! A n i j
                                (- (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                   (* factor (daed:mat-ref A n col j))))
                              (set! j (+ j 1)))))
                        (daed:vec-set! b i
                          (- (daed:vec-ref b i)
                             (* factor (daed:vec-ref b col))))))
                    (set! i (+ i 1))))))))
        (set! col (+ col 1))))
    (if (not ok)
      #f
      (begin
        ; back substitution
        (let ((i (- n 1)))
          (while (lambda () (and ok (>= i 0)))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((s (daed:vec-ref b i))
                    (j (+ i 1)))
                (while (lambda () (< j n))
                  (lambda ()
                    (set! s (- s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
                                    (daed:vec-ref b j))))
                    (set! j (+ j 1))))
                (let ((diag (daed:mat-ref A n i i)))
                  (if (< (abs diag) daed:ge-eps)
                    (set! ok #f)
                    (daed:vec-set! b i (/ s diag)))))
              (set! i (- i 1)))))
        ok))))

; Pack node voltages from x into a "volts" hash.
(define (daed:volts-from-x x n-v)
  (let ((volts (hash)))
    (hash-set! volts "0" 0.0)
    (let ((k 1))
      (while (lambda () (<= k n-v))
        (lambda ()
          (hash-set! volts
                     (number->string k)
                     (daed:x-v x k))
          (set! k (+ k 1)))))
    volts))

; Newton-Raphson on a stamp thunk: (stamp-fn x x-old) → (list N J F n-v)
; Returns hash: ok, x, n, n_v, iters, residual, reason
(define (daed:newton-solve stamp-fn x0)
  (let ((res (hash))
        (x (if x0 (daed:copy-vec x0) (make-vector 0 0.0)))
        (x-old #f)
        (ok #f)
        (iters 0)
        (resid 1e300)
        (reason "init")
        (going #t))
    (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
    (while (lambda () (and going (< iters daed:nr-maxiter)))
      (lambda ()
        (set! iters (+ iters 1))
        (let ((sys (stamp-fn x x-old)))
          (let ((N (car sys))
                (J (car (cdr sys)))
                (F (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
                (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
            (hash-set! res "n" N)
            (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
            (if (<= N 0)
              (begin
                (set! going #f)
                (set! reason "empty"))
              (begin
                (set! resid (daed:vec-norm-inf F N))
                (let ((rhs (make-vector N 0.0))
                      (i 0))
                  (while (lambda () (< i N))
                    (lambda ()
                      (daed:vec-set! rhs i (* -1.0 (daed:vec-ref F i)))
                      (set! i (+ i 1))))
                  (if (not (daed:dense-solve! J rhs N))
                    (begin
                      (set! going #f)
                      (set! reason "singular"))
                    (begin
                      (daed:limit-dx! rhs n-v daed:nr-dvmax)
                      (let ((dxn (daed:vec-norm-inf rhs n-v)))
                        (set! x-old (daed:copy-vec x))
                        (if (< (vector-length x) N)
                          (let ((nx (make-vector N 0.0))
                                (k 0)
                                (m (vector-length x)))
                            (while (lambda () (< k m))
                              (lambda ()
                                (vector-set! nx k (vector-ref x k))
                                (set! k (+ k 1))))
                            (set! x nx))
                          0)
                        (daed:vec-add-scaled! x rhs N 1.0)
                        (if (or (< resid daed:nr-atol) (< dxn daed:nr-vtol))
                          (begin
                            (set! ok #t)
                            (set! going #f)
                            (set! reason "converged"))
                          0)))))))))))
    (if (and (not ok) (< resid (* 10.0 daed:nr-atol)))
      (begin
        (set! ok #t)
        (set! reason "relaxed"))
      0)
    (if (and (not ok) (equal? reason "init"))
      (set! reason "maxiter")
      0)
    (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
    (hash-set! res "x" x)
    (hash-set! res "iters" iters)
    (hash-set! res "residual" resid)
    (hash-set! res "reason" reason)
    (hash-set! res "nr" #t)
    res))

; Result hash:
;   ok     → boolean
;   n      → system size
;   n_v    → number of voltage unknowns
;   x      → solution vector (node voltages then branch currents)
;   volts  → hash "1"→v1, "2"→v2, … (string keys for node ids); "0"→0.0
;   iters / residual / nr  → Newton stats (linear path: iters=1, nr=#f)
(define (daed:simulate-op ckt)
  (let ((comps (daed:ckt-comps ckt)))
    (if (daed:has-nonlinear? comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
      (daed:simulate-op-lin comps))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-lin comps)
  (let ((sys (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car sys))
          (A (car (cdr sys)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr sys))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr sys))))))
      (let ((res (hash)))
        (hash-set! res "n" N)
        (hash-set! res "n_v" n-v)
        (hash-set! res "iters" 1)
        (hash-set! res "residual" 0.0)
        (hash-set! res "nr" #f)
        (hash-set! res "reason" "linear")
        (if (<= N 0)
          (begin
            (hash-set! res "ok" #f)
            (hash-set! res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
            (hash-set! res "volts" (hash))
            res)
          (let ((ok (daed:dense-solve! A b N)))
            (hash-set! res "ok" ok)
            (hash-set! res "x" b)
            (hash-set! res "volts" (if ok (daed:volts-from-x b n-v) (hash)))
            res))))))

(define (daed:simulate-op-nr comps)
  (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (let ((nr (daed:newton-solve
                (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
                (make-vector N 0.0))))
      (hash-set! nr "volts"
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                             (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
          (hash)))
      nr)))

(define (daed:op-ok? res)
  (hash-ref res "ok" #f))

(define (daed:op-x res)
  (hash-ref res "x" (make-vector 0 0.0)))

(define (daed:op-n res)
  (hash-ref res "n" 0))

(define (daed:op-n-v res)
  (hash-ref res "n_v" 0))

(define (daed:op-voltages res)
  (hash-ref res "volts" (hash)))

(define (daed:op-iters res)
  (hash-ref res "iters" 0))

(define (daed:op-residual res)
  (hash-ref res "residual" 0.0))

target.name: daed:simulate-op-nr
target.body:
(lambda (comps) (let ((N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (let ((nr (daed:newton-solve
                (lambda (x xo) (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x xo))
                (make-vector N 0.0))))
      (hash-set! nr "volts"
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (daed:volts-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                             (hash-ref nr "n_v" 0))
          (hash)))
      (hash-set! nr "ibranch"
        (if (hash-ref nr "ok" #f)
          (daed:ibranch-from-x (hash-ref nr "x" (make-vector 0 0.0))
                               comps #t)
          (hash)))
      nr)))
