input.source:
; lib/stamp.aura — Modified Nodal Analysis stamping (Phase 1–2)
;
; (require "stamp" all:)
;
; DC (.op): R, V, I; C open; L short (0 V branch).
; TRAN: same + Backward-Euler companion models for C and L.
; Matrix A is row-major flat vector length N*N; b length N.
; Unknowns: [v_1 … v_m | i_branch…]  (node 0 = GND).

(export daed:stamp-version
        daed:mna-size
        daed:mna-size-tran
        daed:stamp-system
        daed:stamp-system-tran
        daed:mat-ref
        daed:mat-set!
        daed:mat-add!
        daed:vec-ref
        daed:vec-set!
        daed:vec-add!
        daed:stamp-G!
        daed:stamp-I!)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:stamp-version 2)

; DC system size: node voltages + V sources + L (treated as 0 V).
(define (daed:mna-size comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-type comps "V")
     (daed:count-type comps "L")))

; TRAN system size: node voltages + V sources only (C/L are companion G).
(define (daed:mna-size-tran comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-type comps "V")))

(define (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
  (vector-ref A (+ (* i n) j)))

(define (daed:mat-set! A n i j val)
  (vector-set! A (+ (* i n) j) val))

(define (daed:mat-add! A n i j delta)
  (daed:mat-set! A n i j (+ (daed:mat-ref A n i j) delta)))

(define (daed:vec-ref b i)
  (vector-ref b i))

(define (daed:vec-set! b i val)
  (vector-set! b i val))

(define (daed:vec-add! b i delta)
  (vector-set! b i (+ (vector-ref b i) delta)))

; Conductance stamp between n1–n2 (G > 0).
(define (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 G)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i1 G)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i2 G)
      0)
    (if (and (>= i1 0) (>= i2 0))
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i2 (* -1.0 G))
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i1 (* -1.0 G)))
      0)
    #t))

; Resistor: G = 1/R
(define (daed:stamp-R! A n n1 n2 r)
  (if (or (not (number? r)) (<= r 0.0))
    #f
    (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 (/ 1.0 r))))

; Independent current source: current leaves n1 into n2 (n1 → n2).
; KCL: -I at n1, +I at n2 on RHS (sum leaving = 0 form with A v = b).
(define (daed:stamp-I! b n n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 I)
      0)
    #t))

; Independent voltage source n1(+)–n2(-) = val; vs-idx is branch unknown.
(define (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 val vs-idx)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 vs-idx 1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i1 1.0))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 vs-idx -1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i2 -1.0))
      0)
    (daed:vec-add! b vs-idx val)
    #t))

; Inject branch current contribution on RHS: +Ieq at n1, -Ieq at n2
; (for capacitor companion Geq*v_old).
(define (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 Ieq)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 Ieq)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 (* -1.0 Ieq))
      0)
    #t))

; ── DC stamp ──
; C open (skip). L short as 0 V voltage branch.
(define (daed:stamp-system comps)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (n-L (daed:count-type comps "L")))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs n-L)))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        (daed:comp-value c)
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       ; DC short: 0 V between terminals
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        0.0
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       ; DC open
                       0)
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

; ── TRAN stamp (Backward Euler companions) ──
; state: hash with "v" (vector by node id) and "iL" (hash name → current)
(define (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs)))
      (if (or (<= N 0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                        (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N n1 n2 val))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N n1 n2 val vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N n1 n2 val))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                         (let ((Geq (/ val h))
                               (vold (- (daed:node-voltage vprev n1)
                                        (daed:node-voltage vprev n2))))
                           (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                           (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 (* Geq vold)))
                         0))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                         (let ((Geq (/ h val))
                               (iold (hash-ref iL (daed:comp-name c) 0.0)))
                           (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                           ; b: -iold at n1, +iold at n2
                           (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
                                 (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
                             (if (>= i1 0)
                               (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 iold))
                               0)
                             (if (>= i2 0)
                               (daed:vec-add! b i2 iold)
                               0)))
                         0))
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

target.name: daed:mna-size
target.body:

; lib/stamp.aura — Modified Nodal Analysis stamping (Phase 1–2)
;
; (require "stamp" all:)
;
; DC (.op): R, V, I; C open; L short (0 V branch).
; TRAN: same + Backward-Euler companion models for C and L.
; Matrix A is row-major flat vector length N*N; b length N.
; Unknowns: [v_1 … v_m | i_branch…]  (node 0 = GND).

(export daed:stamp-version
        daed:mna-size
        daed:mna-size-tran
        daed:stamp-system
        daed:stamp-system-tran
        daed:mat-ref
        daed:mat-set!
        daed:mat-add!
        daed:vec-ref
        daed:vec-set!
        daed:vec-add!
        daed:stamp-G!
        daed:stamp-I!)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:stamp-version 2)

; DC system size: node voltages + V sources + L (treated as 0 V).
(define (daed:mna-size comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-type comps "V")
     (daed:count-type comps "L")))

; TRAN system size: node voltages + V sources only (C/L are companion G).
(define (daed:mna-size-tran comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-type comps "V")))

(define (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
  (vector-ref A (+ (* i n) j)))

(define (daed:mat-set! A n i j val)
  (vector-set! A (+ (* i n) j) val))

(define (daed:mat-add! A n i j delta)
  (daed:mat-set! A n i j (+ (daed:mat-ref A n i j) delta)))

(define (daed:vec-ref b i)
  (vector-ref b i))

(define (daed:vec-set! b i val)
  (vector-set! b i val))

(define (daed:vec-add! b i delta)
  (vector-set! b i (+ (vector-ref b i) delta)))

; Conductance stamp between n1–n2 (G > 0).
(define (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 G)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i1 G)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i2 G)
      0)
    (if (and (>= i1 0) (>= i2 0))
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i2 (* -1.0 G))
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i1 (* -1.0 G)))
      0)
    #t))

; Resistor: G = 1/R
(define (daed:stamp-R! A n n1 n2 r)
  (if (or (not (number? r)) (<= r 0.0))
    #f
    (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 (/ 1.0 r))))

; Independent current source: current leaves n1 into n2 (n1 → n2).
; KCL: -I at n1, +I at n2 on RHS (sum leaving = 0 form with A v = b).
(define (daed:stamp-I! b n n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 I)
      0)
    #t))

; Independent voltage source n1(+)–n2(-) = val; vs-idx is branch unknown.
(define (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 val vs-idx)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 vs-idx 1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i1 1.0))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 vs-idx -1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i2 -1.0))
      0)
    (daed:vec-add! b vs-idx val)
    #t))

; Inject branch current contribution on RHS: +Ieq at n1, -Ieq at n2
; (for capacitor companion Geq*v_old).
(define (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 Ieq)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 Ieq)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 (* -1.0 Ieq))
      0)
    #t))

; ── DC stamp ──
; C open (skip). L short as 0 V voltage branch.
(define (daed:stamp-system comps)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (n-L (daed:count-type comps "L")))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs n-L)))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        (daed:comp-value c)
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       ; DC short: 0 V between terminals
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        0.0
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       ; DC open
                       0)
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

; ── TRAN stamp (Backward Euler companions) ──
; state: hash with "v" (vector by node id) and "iL" (hash name → current)
(define (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs)))
      (if (or (<= N 0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                        (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N n1 n2 val))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N n1 n2 val vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N n1 n2 val))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                         (let ((Geq (/ val h))
                               (vold (- (daed:node-voltage vprev n1)
                                        (daed:node-voltage vprev n2))))
                           (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                           (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 (* Geq vold)))
                         0))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                         (let ((Geq (/ h val))
                               (iold (hash-ref iL (daed:comp-name c) 0.0)))
                           (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                           ; b: -iold at n1, +iold at n2
                           (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
                                 (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
                             (if (>= i1 0)
                               (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 iold))
                               0)
                             (if (>= i2 0)
                               (daed:vec-add! b i2 iold)
                               0)))
                         0))
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i2 (* -1.0 G))
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i1 (* -1.0 G)))
      0)
    #t))

; Resistor: G = 1/R
(define (daed:stamp-R! A n n1 n2 r)
  (if (or (not (number? r)) (<= r 0.0))
    #f
    (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 (/ 1.0 r))))

; Independent current source: current leaves n1 into n2 (n1 → n2).
; KCL: -I at n1, +I at n2 on RHS (sum leaving = 0 form with A v = b).
(define (daed:stamp-I! b n n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 I)
      0)
    #t))

; Independent voltage source n1(+)–n2(-) = val; vs-idx is branch unknown.
(define (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 val vs-idx)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 vs-idx 1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i1 1.0))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 vs-idx -1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i2 -1.0))
      0)
    (daed:vec-add! b vs-idx val)
    #t))

; Inject branch current contribution on RHS: +Ieq at n1, -Ieq at n2
; (for capacitor companion Geq*v_old).
(define (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 Ieq)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 Ieq)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 (* -1.0 Ieq))
      0)
    #t))

; ── DC stamp ──
; C open (skip). L short as 0 V voltage branch.
(define (daed:stamp-system comps)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (n-L (daed:count-type comps "L")))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs n-L)))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        (daed:comp-value c)
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N
                                      (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                      (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                      (daed:comp-value c)))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       ; DC short: 0 V between terminals
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N
                                        (daed:comp-n1 c)
                                        (daed:comp-n2 c)
                                        0.0
                                        vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       ; DC open
                       0)
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

; ── TRAN stamp (Backward Euler companions) ──
; state: hash with "v" (vector by node id) and "iL" (hash name → current)
(define (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (n-vs (daed:count-type comps "V"))
        (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash))))
    (let ((N (+ n-v n-vs)))
      (if (or (<= N 0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
              (b (make-vector N 0.0))
              (vs-next n-v))
          (let loop ((cs comps))
            (if (null? cs)
              (list N A b n-v)
              (begin
                (let ((c (car cs)))
                  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                        (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                        (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                    (cond
                      ((equal? ty "R")
                       (daed:stamp-R! A N n1 n2 val))
                      ((equal? ty "V")
                       (begin
                         (daed:stamp-V! A b N n1 n2 val vs-next)
                         (set! vs-next (+ vs-next 1))))
                      ((equal? ty "I")
                       (daed:stamp-I! b N n1 n2 val))
                      ((equal? ty "C")
                       (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                         (let ((Geq (/ val h))
                               (vold (- (daed:node-voltage vprev n1)
                                        (daed:node-voltage vprev n2))))
                           (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                           (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 (* Geq vold)))
                         0))
                      ((equal? ty "L")
                       (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                         (let ((Geq (/ h val))
                               (iold (hash-ref iL (daed:comp-name c) 0.0)))
                           (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                           ; b: -iold at n1, +iold at n2
                           (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
                                 (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
                             (if (>= i1 0)
                               (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 iold))
                               0)
                             (if (>= i2 0)
                               (daed:vec-add! b i2 iold)
                               0)))
                         0))
                      (else 0))))
                (loop (cdr cs))))))))))

input.source:
; lib/stamp.aura — Modified Nodal Analysis stamping (Phase 1–2)
;
; (require "stamp" all:)
;
; DC (.op): R, V, I; C open; L short (0 V branch).
; TRAN: same + Backward-Euler companion models for C and L.
; Matrix A is row-major flat vector length N*N; b length N.
; Unknowns: [v_1 … v_m | i_branch…]  (node 0 = GND).

(export daed:stamp-version
        daed:mna-size
        daed:mna-size-tran
        daed:needs-branch?
        daed:branch-map
        daed:stamp-system
        daed:stamp-system-tran
        daed:mat-ref
        daed:mat-set!
        daed:mat-add!
        daed:vec-ref
        daed:vec-set!
        daed:vec-add!
        daed:stamp-G!
        daed:stamp-I!)

(require "netlist" all:)

(define daed:stamp-version 3)

; Voltage-defined branch unknown: V, E, H; L only in DC (short).
(define (daed:needs-branch? ty dc?)
  (or (equal? ty "V")
      (equal? ty "E")
      (equal? ty "H")
      (and dc? (equal? ty "L"))))

(define (daed:count-branches comps dc?)
  (let ((n 0))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        n
        (begin
          (if (daed:needs-branch? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) dc?)
            (set! n (+ n 1))
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

; name → MNA branch index (after voltage unknowns).
(define (daed:branch-map comps dc?)
  (let ((h (hash))
        (idx (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)))
    (let loop ((cs comps))
      (if (null? cs)
        h
        (begin
          (if (daed:needs-branch? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) dc?)
            (begin
              (hash-set! h (daed:comp-name (car cs)) idx)
              (set! idx (+ idx 1)))
            0)
          (loop (cdr cs)))))))

(define (daed:mna-size comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-branches comps #t)))

(define (daed:mna-size-tran comps)
  (+ (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps)
     (daed:count-branches comps #f)))

(define (daed:mat-ref A n i j)
  (vector-ref A (+ (* i n) j)))

(define (daed:mat-set! A n i j val)
  (vector-set! A (+ (* i n) j) val))

(define (daed:mat-add! A n i j delta)
  (daed:mat-set! A n i j (+ (daed:mat-ref A n i j) delta)))

(define (daed:vec-ref b i)
  (vector-ref b i))

(define (daed:vec-set! b i val)
  (vector-set! b i val))

(define (daed:vec-add! b i delta)
  (vector-set! b i (+ (vector-ref b i) delta)))

; Conductance stamp between n1–n2 (G > 0).
(define (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 G)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i1 G)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i2 G)
      0)
    (if (and (>= i1 0) (>= i2 0))
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 i2 (* -1.0 G))
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 i1 (* -1.0 G)))
      0)
    #t))

; Resistor: G = 1/R
(define (daed:stamp-R! A n n1 n2 r)
  (if (or (not (number? r)) (<= r 0.0))
    #f
    (daed:stamp-G! A n n1 n2 (/ 1.0 r))))

; Independent current source: current leaves n1 into n2 (n1 → n2).
; KCL: -I at n1, +I at n2 on RHS (sum leaving = 0 form with A v = b).
(define (daed:stamp-I! b n n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 I)
      0)
    #t))

; Independent voltage source n1(+)–n2(-) = val; vs-idx is branch unknown.
(define (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 val vs-idx)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 vs-idx 1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i1 1.0))
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (begin
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 vs-idx -1.0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n vs-idx i2 -1.0))
      0)
    (daed:vec-add! b vs-idx val)
    #t))

; A[row-node, col-node] += coef (skip GND).
(define (daed:stamp-term! A n row-node col-node coef)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index row-node))
        (j (daed:node-index col-node)))
    (if (and (>= i 0) (>= j 0))
      (daed:mat-add! A n i j coef)
      0)))

; VCCS: i(n1→n2) = gm * (v_c+ − v_c−)
(define (daed:stamp-vccs! A n n1 n2 nc+ nc- gm)
  (if (not (number? gm))
    #f
    (begin
      (daed:stamp-term! A n n1 nc+ gm)
      (daed:stamp-term! A n n1 nc- (* -1.0 gm))
      (daed:stamp-term! A n n2 nc+ (* -1.0 gm))
      (daed:stamp-term! A n n2 nc- gm)
      #t)))

; VCVS: v(n1,n2) − mu*(v_c+ − v_c−) = 0
(define (daed:stamp-vcvs! A b n n1 n2 nc+ nc- mu k)
  (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 0.0 k)
  (let ((jc+ (daed:node-index nc+))
        (jc- (daed:node-index nc-)))
    (if (and (number? mu) (>= jc+ 0))
      (daed:mat-add! A n k jc+ (* -1.0 mu))
      0)
    (if (and (number? mu) (>= jc- 0))
      (daed:mat-add! A n k jc- mu)
      0)
    #t))

; CCCS: i(n1→n2) = beta * i_ctrl
(define (daed:stamp-cccs! A n n1 n2 beta k-ctrl)
  (if (or (not (number? beta)) (not (number? k-ctrl)))
    #f
    (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
          (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
      (if (>= i1 0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n i1 k-ctrl beta)
        0)
      (if (>= i2 0)
        (daed:mat-add! A n i2 k-ctrl (* -1.0 beta))
        0)
      #t)))

; CCVS: v(n1,n2) − rm * i_ctrl = 0
(define (daed:stamp-ccvs! A b n n1 n2 rm k k-ctrl)
  (daed:stamp-V! A b n n1 n2 0.0 k)
  (if (and (number? rm) (number? k-ctrl))
    (daed:mat-add! A n k k-ctrl (* -1.0 rm))
    0)
  #t)

; Inject branch current contribution on RHS: +Ieq at n1, -Ieq at n2
; (for capacitor companion Geq*v_old).
(define (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 Ieq)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i1 Ieq)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! b i2 (* -1.0 Ieq))
      0)
    #t))

; ── DC stamp ──
; C open (skip). L short as 0 V voltage branch.
(define (daed:stamp-system comps)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps #t))
        (N (daed:mna-size comps)))
    (if (<= N 0)
      (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
      (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
            (b (make-vector N 0.0)))
        (let loop ((cs comps))
          (if (null? cs)
            (list N A b n-v)
            (begin
              (daed:stamp-one! A b N (car cs) br #t)
              (loop (cdr cs)))))))))

(define (daed:stamp-one! A b N c br dc?)
  (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
        (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (val (daed:comp-value c))
        (nm (daed:comp-name c)))
    (cond
      ((equal? ty "R")
       (daed:stamp-R! A N n1 n2 val))
      ((equal? ty "V")
       (daed:stamp-V! A b N n1 n2 val (hash-ref br nm 0)))
      ((equal? ty "I")
       (daed:stamp-I! b N n1 n2 val))
      ((and dc? (equal? ty "L"))
       (daed:stamp-V! A b N n1 n2 0.0 (hash-ref br nm 0)))
      ((equal? ty "C")
       0)
      ((equal? ty "E")
       (daed:stamp-vcvs! A b N n1 n2
                         (daed:comp-n3 c) (daed:comp-n4 c)
                         val (hash-ref br nm 0)))
      ((equal? ty "G")
       (daed:stamp-vccs! A N n1 n2
                         (daed:comp-n3 c) (daed:comp-n4 c) val))
      ((equal? ty "F")
       (daed:stamp-cccs! A N n1 n2 val
                         (hash-ref br (daed:comp-ctrl c) #f)))
      ((equal? ty "H")
       (daed:stamp-ccvs! A b N n1 n2 val
                         (hash-ref br nm 0)
                         (hash-ref br (daed:comp-ctrl c) #f)))
      (else 0))))

; ── TRAN stamp (Backward Euler companions) ──
; state: hash with "v" (vector by node id) and "iL" (hash name → current)
(define (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)
  (let ((n-v (daed:n-voltage-unknowns comps))
        (br (daed:branch-map comps #f))
        (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0)))
        (iL (hash-ref state "iL" (hash)))
        (N (daed:mna-size-tran comps)))
    (if (or (<= N 0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
      (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
      (let ((A (make-vector (* N N) 0.0))
            (b (make-vector N 0.0)))
        (let loop ((cs comps))
          (if (null? cs)
            (list N A b n-v)
            (begin
              (let ((c (car cs)))
                (let ((ty (daed:comp-type c))
                      (n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
                      (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
                      (val (daed:comp-value c)))
                  (cond
                    ((or (equal? ty "R") (equal? ty "V") (equal? ty "I")
                         (equal? ty "E") (equal? ty "G")
                         (equal? ty "F") (equal? ty "H"))
                     (daed:stamp-one! A b N c br #f))
                    ((equal? ty "C")
                     (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                       (let ((Geq (/ val h))
                             (vold (- (daed:node-voltage vprev n1)
                                      (daed:node-voltage vprev n2))))
                         (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                         (daed:stamp-ieq! b n1 n2 (* Geq vold)))
                       0))
                    ((equal? ty "L")
                     (if (and (number? val) (> val 0.0))
                       (let ((Geq (/ h val))
                             (iold (hash-ref iL (daed:comp-name c) 0.0)))
                         (daed:stamp-G! A N n1 n2 Geq)
                         (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
                               (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
                           (if (>= i1 0)
                             (daed:vec-add! b i1 (* -1.0 iold))
                             0)
                           (if (>= i2 0)
                             (daed:vec-add! b i2 iold)
                             0)))
                       0))
                    (else 0))))
              (loop (cdr cs)))))))))

input.source:
; lib/devices.aura — Nonlinear devices + NR residual/Jacobian stamp (Phase 5)
;
; (require "devices" all:)
;
; Shockley diode and Ebers-Moll NPN. Educational-grade, FlatAST-friendly.
; Voltage limiting (SPICE pnjlim) + gmin keep dense NR inside V_A.
; Linear stamp path is unchanged; this module only runs when D/Q are present.

(export daed:devices-version
        daed:clip-exp
        daed:pnjlim
        daed:diode-vcrit
        daed:copy-vec
        daed:ax-minus-b
        daed:vec-norm-inf
        daed:vec-add-scaled!
        daed:limit-dx!
        daed:stamp-I-res!
        daed:jac-add!
        daed:res-add!
        daed:stamp-diode-nr!
        daed:stamp-bjt-nr!
        daed:stamp-nonlinear!
        daed:stamp-system-nr
        daed:stamp-system-nr-tran)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)

(define daed:devices-version 1)

(define daed:exp-clip 40.0)
(define daed:sqrt2 1.414213562)

; Saturated exp so Is*exp(vd/Vt) cannot overflow the host float.
(define (daed:clip-exp arg)
  (if (> arg daed:exp-clip)
    (exp daed:exp-clip)
    (if (< arg (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp arg))))

; SPICE pnjlim: limit junction voltage used for exp() between iterates.
(define (daed:pnjlim vnew vold vt vcrit)
  (let ((out vnew)
        (dv (- vnew vold))
        (two-vt (* 2.0 vt)))
    (if (and (> vnew vcrit) (> (abs dv) two-vt))
      (if (> vold 0.0)
        (let ((arg (+ 1.0 (/ dv vt))))
          (if (> arg 0.0)
            (set! out (+ vold (* vt (log arg))))
            (set! out vcrit)))
        (if (> vnew 0.0)
          (set! out (* vt (log (/ vnew vt))))
          (set! out vcrit)))
      0)
    out))

(define (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)
  (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0) (not (number? nvt)) (<= nvt 0.0))
    0.7
    (let ((arg (/ nvt (* daed:sqrt2 Is))))
      (if (<= arg 1.0)
        nvt
        (* nvt (log arg))))))

(define (daed:copy-vec v)
  (let ((n (vector-length v))
        (out (make-vector (vector-length v) 0.0))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (vector-set! out i (vector-ref v i))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    out))

; y = A x - b  (new vector, length n)
(define (daed:ax-minus-b A x b n)
  (let ((y (make-vector n 0.0))
        (xn (vector-length x))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((s 0.0)
              (j 0))
          (while (lambda () (< j n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((xj (if (>= j xn) 0.0 (daed:vec-ref x j))))
                (set! s (+ s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j) xj))))
              (set! j (+ j 1))))
          (daed:vec-set! y i (- s (daed:vec-ref b i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    y))

(define (daed:vec-norm-inf v n)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n))
    (if (> lim (vector-length v))
      (set! lim (vector-length v))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (vector-ref v i))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    m))

(define (daed:vec-add-scaled! dst src n scale)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! dst i
          (+ (daed:vec-ref dst i)
             (* scale (daed:vec-ref src i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    dst))

; Scale voltage-unknown entries of dx so max |dV| ≤ dvmax. Returns scale.
(define (daed:limit-dx! dx n-v dvmax)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (k 0)
        (nv n-v))
    (if (> nv (vector-length dx))
      (set! nv (vector-length dx))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< k nv))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (daed:vec-ref dx k))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    (if (or (<= m dvmax) (<= m 0.0) (not (number? dvmax)) (<= dvmax 0.0))
      1.0
      (let ((s (/ dvmax m))
            (i 0)
            (nn (vector-length dx)))
        (while (lambda () (< i nn))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! dx i (* s (daed:vec-ref dx i)))
            (set! i (+ i 1))))
        s))))

; Residual current I flowing n1 → n2 (KCL: +I at n1, -I at n2).
(define (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i1 I)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i2 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    #t))

(define (daed:jac-add! J n na nb val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index na))
        (j (daed:node-index nb)))
    (if (and (>= i 0) (>= j 0))
      (daed:mat-add! J n i j val)
      0)))

(define (daed:res-add! F node val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index node)))
    (if (>= i 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i val)
      0)))

; ── Shockley diode ──
; Id = Is (e^{vd/(n Vt)} - 1) + gmin vd
; gd = (Is/(n Vt)) e^{vd/(n Vt)} + gmin

(define (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (nn (hash-ref c "n" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12)))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? nn)) (<= nn 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (let ((nvt (* nn vt))
            (vd-new (- (daed:x-v x n1) (daed:x-v x n2)))
            (vd-old (- (daed:x-v x-old n1) (daed:x-v x-old n2))))
        (let ((vcrit (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)))
          (let ((vd (daed:pnjlim vd-new vd-old nvt vcrit)))
            (let ((ev (daed:clip-exp (/ vd nvt))))
              (let ((id (+ (* Is (- ev 1.0)) (* gmin vd)))
                    (gd (+ (/ (* Is ev) nvt) gmin)))
                (daed:stamp-G! J n n1 n2 gd)
                (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 id)
                #t))))))))

; ── Ebers-Moll NPN ──
; IF = Is (e^{vbe/Vt} - 1), IR = Is (e^{vbc/Vt} - 1)
; IC = IF - IR (1 + 1/βR)
; IB = IF/βF + IR/βR
; IE = -(IC + IB)

(define (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((nc (daed:comp-nc c))
        (nb (daed:comp-nb c))
        (ne (daed:comp-ne c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (bf (hash-ref c "bf" 100.0))
        (br (hash-ref c "br" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12))
        (vbe 0.0)
        (vbc 0.0)
        (IF 0.0)
        (IR 0.0)
        (gf 0.0)
        (gr 0.0)
        (ic 0.0)
        (ib 0.0)
        (ie 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbc 0.0))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? bf)) (<= bf 0.0)
            (not (number? br)) (<= br 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! vbe (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x ne))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old ne))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! vbc (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x nc))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old nc))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! IF (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! IR (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! gf (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt))) vt))
        (set! gr (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt))) vt))
        (set! ic (- IF (* IR (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! ib (+ (/ IF bf) (/ IR br)))
        (set! ie (* -1.0 (+ ic ib)))
        (daed:res-add! F nc ic)
        (daed:res-add! F nb ib)
        (daed:res-add! F ne ie)
        ; gmin as linear junction conductances (not mixed into gf/gr)
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb ne gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb ne (* gmin vbe))
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb nc gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb nc (* gmin vbc))
        (set! dIc-dVbe gf)
        (set! dIc-dVbc (* -1.0 (* gr (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! dIb-dVbe (/ gf bf))
        (set! dIb-dVbc (/ gr br))
        (set! dIe-dVbe (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbe dIb-dVbe)))
        (set! dIe-dVbc (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbc dIb-dVbc)))
        ; vbe = vB - vE, vbc = vB - vC
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nc (* -1.0 dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nb (+ dIc-dVbe dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc ne (* -1.0 dIc-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nc (* -1.0 dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nb (+ dIb-dVbe dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb ne (* -1.0 dIb-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nc (* -1.0 dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nb (+ dIe-dVbe dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne ne (* -1.0 dIe-dVbe))
        #t))))

(define (daed:stamp-nonlinear! J F n x x-old comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (let ((ty (daed:comp-type (car cs))))
          (cond
            ((equal? ty "D")
             (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            ((equal? ty "Q")
             (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            (else 0)))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; DC NR system: J and F such that J dx = -F. Linear devices via stamp-system.
; Returns (list N J F n-v)
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

; TRAN NR system: linear BE companions + same nonlinear stamps.
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr-tran comps h state x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

input.source:
; lib/devices.aura — Nonlinear devices + NR residual/Jacobian stamp (Phase 5)
;
; (require "devices" all:)
;
; Shockley diode and Ebers-Moll NPN. Educational-grade, FlatAST-friendly.
; Voltage limiting (SPICE pnjlim) + gmin keep dense NR inside V_A.
; Linear stamp path is unchanged; this module only runs when D/Q are present.

(export daed:devices-version
        daed:clip-exp
        daed:pnjlim
        daed:diode-vcrit
        daed:copy-vec
        daed:ax-minus-b
        daed:vec-norm-inf
        daed:vec-add-scaled!
        daed:limit-dx!
        daed:stamp-I-res!
        daed:jac-add!
        daed:res-add!
        daed:stamp-diode-nr!
        daed:stamp-bjt-nr!
        daed:stamp-nonlinear!
        daed:stamp-system-nr
        daed:stamp-system-nr-tran)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)

(define daed:devices-version 1)

(define daed:exp-clip 40.0)
(define daed:sqrt2 1.414213562)

; Saturated exp so Is*exp(vd/Vt) cannot overflow the host float.
(define (daed:clip-exp arg)
  (if (> arg daed:exp-clip)
    (exp daed:exp-clip)
    (if (< arg (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp arg))))

; SPICE pnjlim: limit junction voltage used for exp() between iterates.
(define (daed:pnjlim vnew vold vt vcrit)
  (let ((out vnew)
        (dv (- vnew vold))
        (two-vt (* 2.0 vt)))
    (if (and (> vnew vcrit) (> (abs dv) two-vt))
      (if (> vold 0.0)
        (let ((arg (+ 1.0 (/ dv vt))))
          (if (> arg 0.0)
            (set! out (+ vold (* vt (log arg))))
            (set! out vcrit)))
        (if (> vnew 0.0)
          (set! out (* vt (log (/ vnew vt))))
          (set! out vcrit)))
      0)
    out))

(define (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)
  (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0) (not (number? nvt)) (<= nvt 0.0))
    0.7
    (let ((arg (/ nvt (* daed:sqrt2 Is))))
      (if (<= arg 1.0)
        nvt
        (* nvt (log arg))))))

(define (daed:copy-vec v)
  (let ((n (vector-length v))
        (out (make-vector (vector-length v) 0.0))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (vector-set! out i (vector-ref v i))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    out))

; y = A x - b  (new vector, length n)
(define (daed:ax-minus-b A x b n)
  (let ((y (make-vector n 0.0))
        (xn (vector-length x))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((s 0.0)
              (j 0))
          (while (lambda () (< j n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((xj (if (>= j xn) 0.0 (daed:vec-ref x j))))
                (set! s (+ s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j) xj))))
              (set! j (+ j 1))))
          (daed:vec-set! y i (- s (daed:vec-ref b i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    y))

(define (daed:vec-norm-inf v n)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n))
    (if (> lim (vector-length v))
      (set! lim (vector-length v))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (vector-ref v i))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    m))

(define (daed:vec-add-scaled! dst src n scale)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! dst i
          (+ (daed:vec-ref dst i)
             (* scale (daed:vec-ref src i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    dst))

; Scale voltage-unknown entries of dx so max |dV| ≤ dvmax. Returns scale.
(define (daed:limit-dx! dx n-v dvmax)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (k 0)
        (nv n-v))
    (if (> nv (vector-length dx))
      (set! nv (vector-length dx))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< k nv))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (daed:vec-ref dx k))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    (if (or (<= m dvmax) (<= m 0.0) (not (number? dvmax)) (<= dvmax 0.0))
      1.0
      (let ((s (/ dvmax m))
            (i 0)
            (nn (vector-length dx)))
        (while (lambda () (< i nn))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! dx i (* s (daed:vec-ref dx i)))
            (set! i (+ i 1))))
        s))))

; Residual current I flowing n1 → n2 (KCL: +I at n1, -I at n2).
(define (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i1 I)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i2 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    #t))

(define (daed:jac-add! J n na nb val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index na))
        (j (daed:node-index nb)))
    (if (and (>= i 0) (>= j 0))
      (daed:mat-add! J n i j val)
      0)))

(define (daed:res-add! F node val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index node)))
    (if (>= i 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i val)
      0)))

; ── Shockley diode ──
; Id = Is (e^{vd/(n Vt)} - 1) + gmin vd
; gd = (Is/(n Vt)) e^{vd/(n Vt)} + gmin

(define (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (nn (hash-ref c "n" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12)))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? nn)) (<= nn 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (let ((nvt (* nn vt))
            (vd-new (- (daed:x-v x n1) (daed:x-v x n2)))
            (vd-old (- (daed:x-v x-old n1) (daed:x-v x-old n2))))
        (let ((vcrit (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)))
          (let ((vd (daed:pnjlim vd-new vd-old nvt vcrit)))
            (let ((ev (daed:clip-exp (/ vd nvt))))
              (let ((id (+ (* Is (- ev 1.0)) (* gmin vd)))
                    (gd (+ (/ (* Is ev) nvt) gmin)))
                (daed:stamp-G! J n n1 n2 gd)
                (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 id)
                #t))))))))

; ── Ebers-Moll NPN ──
; IF = Is (e^{vbe/Vt} - 1), IR = Is (e^{vbc/Vt} - 1)
; IC = IF - IR (1 + 1/βR)
; IB = IF/βF + IR/βR
; IE = -(IC + IB)

(define (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((nc (daed:comp-nc c))
        (nb (daed:comp-nb c))
        (ne (daed:comp-ne c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (bf (hash-ref c "bf" 100.0))
        (br (hash-ref c "br" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12))
        (vbe 0.0)
        (vbc 0.0)
        (IF 0.0)
        (IR 0.0)
        (gf 0.0)
        (gr 0.0)
        (ic 0.0)
        (ib 0.0)
        (ie 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbc 0.0))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? bf)) (<= bf 0.0)
            (not (number? br)) (<= br 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! vbe (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x ne))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old ne))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! vbc (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x nc))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old nc))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! IF (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! IR (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! gf (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt))) vt))
        (set! gr (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt))) vt))
        (set! ic (- IF (* IR (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! ib (+ (/ IF bf) (/ IR br)))
        (set! ie (* -1.0 (+ ic ib)))
        (daed:res-add! F nc ic)
        (daed:res-add! F nb ib)
        (daed:res-add! F ne ie)
        ; gmin as linear junction conductances (not mixed into gf/gr)
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb ne gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb ne (* gmin vbe))
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb nc gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb nc (* gmin vbc))
        (set! dIc-dVbe gf)
        (set! dIc-dVbc (* -1.0 (* gr (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! dIb-dVbe (/ gf bf))
        (set! dIb-dVbc (/ gr br))
        (set! dIe-dVbe (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbe dIb-dVbe)))
        (set! dIe-dVbc (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbc dIb-dVbc)))
        ; vbe = vB - vE, vbc = vB - vC
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nc (* -1.0 dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nb (+ dIc-dVbe dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc ne (* -1.0 dIc-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nc (* -1.0 dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nb (+ dIb-dVbe dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb ne (* -1.0 dIb-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nc (* -1.0 dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nb (+ dIe-dVbe dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne ne (* -1.0 dIe-dVbe))
        #t))))

(define (daed:stamp-nonlinear! J F n x x-old comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (let ((ty (daed:comp-type (car cs))))
          (cond
            ((equal? ty "D")
             (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            ((equal? ty "Q")
             (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            (else 0)))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; DC NR system: J and F such that J dx = -F. Linear devices via stamp-system.
; Returns (list N J F n-v)
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

; TRAN NR system: linear BE companions + same nonlinear stamps.
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr-tran comps h state x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

input.source:
; lib/devices.aura — Nonlinear devices + NR residual/Jacobian stamp (Phase 5)
;
; (require "devices" all:)
;
; Shockley diode, Ebers-Moll NPN, Level-1 NMOS (Shichman-Hodges).
; Voltage limiting (SPICE pnjlim) + gmin keep dense NR inside V_A.
; Linear stamp path is unchanged; this module only runs when D/Q/M are present.

(export daed:devices-version
        daed:clip-exp
        daed:pnjlim
        daed:diode-vcrit
        daed:copy-vec
        daed:ax-minus-b
        daed:vec-norm-inf
        daed:vec-add-scaled!
        daed:limit-dx!
        daed:stamp-I-res!
        daed:jac-add!
        daed:res-add!
        daed:stamp-diode-nr!
        daed:stamp-bjt-nr!
        daed:stamp-mos-nr!
        daed:stamp-nonlinear!
        daed:stamp-system-nr
        daed:stamp-system-nr-tran)

(require "netlist" all:)
(require "stamp" all:)

; 2 = issue #19 Level-1 MOSFET
(define daed:devices-version 2)

(define daed:exp-clip 40.0)
(define daed:sqrt2 1.414213562)

; Saturated exp so Is*exp(vd/Vt) cannot overflow the host float.
(define (daed:clip-exp arg)
  (if (> arg daed:exp-clip)
    (exp daed:exp-clip)
    (if (< arg (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp (* -1.0 daed:exp-clip))
      (exp arg))))

; SPICE pnjlim: limit junction voltage used for exp() between iterates.
(define (daed:pnjlim vnew vold vt vcrit)
  (let ((out vnew)
        (dv (- vnew vold))
        (two-vt (* 2.0 vt)))
    (if (and (> vnew vcrit) (> (abs dv) two-vt))
      (if (> vold 0.0)
        (let ((arg (+ 1.0 (/ dv vt))))
          (if (> arg 0.0)
            (set! out (+ vold (* vt (log arg))))
            (set! out vcrit)))
        (if (> vnew 0.0)
          (set! out (* vt (log (/ vnew vt))))
          (set! out vcrit)))
      0)
    out))

(define (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)
  (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0) (not (number? nvt)) (<= nvt 0.0))
    0.7
    (let ((arg (/ nvt (* daed:sqrt2 Is))))
      (if (<= arg 1.0)
        nvt
        (* nvt (log arg))))))

(define (daed:copy-vec v)
  (let ((n (vector-length v))
        (out (make-vector (vector-length v) 0.0))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (vector-set! out i (vector-ref v i))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    out))

; y = A x - b  (new vector, length n)
(define (daed:ax-minus-b A x b n)
  (let ((y (make-vector n 0.0))
        (xn (vector-length x))
        (i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((s 0.0)
              (j 0))
          (while (lambda () (< j n))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((xj (if (>= j xn) 0.0 (daed:vec-ref x j))))
                (set! s (+ s (* (daed:mat-ref A n i j) xj))))
              (set! j (+ j 1))))
          (daed:vec-set! y i (- s (daed:vec-ref b i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    y))

(define (daed:vec-norm-inf v n)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (i 0)
        (lim n))
    (if (> lim (vector-length v))
      (set! lim (vector-length v))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< i lim))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (vector-ref v i))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    m))

(define (daed:vec-add-scaled! dst src n scale)
  (let ((i 0))
    (while (lambda () (< i n))
      (lambda ()
        (daed:vec-set! dst i
          (+ (daed:vec-ref dst i)
             (* scale (daed:vec-ref src i))))
        (set! i (+ i 1))))
    dst))

; Scale voltage-unknown entries of dx so max |dV| ≤ dvmax. Returns scale.
(define (daed:limit-dx! dx n-v dvmax)
  (let ((m 0.0)
        (k 0)
        (nv n-v))
    (if (> nv (vector-length dx))
      (set! nv (vector-length dx))
      0)
    (while (lambda () (< k nv))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((a (abs (daed:vec-ref dx k))))
          (if (> a m) (set! m a) 0))
        (set! k (+ k 1))))
    (if (or (<= m dvmax) (<= m 0.0) (not (number? dvmax)) (<= dvmax 0.0))
      1.0
      (let ((s (/ dvmax m))
            (i 0)
            (nn (vector-length dx)))
        (while (lambda () (< i nn))
          (lambda ()
            (daed:vec-set! dx i (* s (daed:vec-ref dx i)))
            (set! i (+ i 1))))
        s))))

; Residual current I flowing n1 → n2 (KCL: +I at n1, -I at n2).
(define (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 I)
  (let ((i1 (daed:node-index n1))
        (i2 (daed:node-index n2)))
    (if (>= i1 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i1 I)
      0)
    (if (>= i2 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i2 (* -1.0 I))
      0)
    #t))

(define (daed:jac-add! J n na nb val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index na))
        (j (daed:node-index nb)))
    (if (and (>= i 0) (>= j 0))
      (daed:mat-add! J n i j val)
      0)))

(define (daed:res-add! F node val)
  (let ((i (daed:node-index node)))
    (if (>= i 0)
      (daed:vec-add! F i val)
      0)))

; ── Shockley diode ──
; Id = Is (e^{vd/(n Vt)} - 1) + gmin vd
; gd = (Is/(n Vt)) e^{vd/(n Vt)} + gmin

(define (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((n1 (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (n2 (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (nn (hash-ref c "n" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12)))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? nn)) (<= nn 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (let ((nvt (* nn vt))
            (vd-new (- (daed:x-v x n1) (daed:x-v x n2)))
            (vd-old (- (daed:x-v x-old n1) (daed:x-v x-old n2))))
        (let ((vcrit (daed:diode-vcrit nvt Is)))
          (let ((vd (daed:pnjlim vd-new vd-old nvt vcrit)))
            (let ((ev (daed:clip-exp (/ vd nvt))))
              (let ((id (+ (* Is (- ev 1.0)) (* gmin vd)))
                    (gd (+ (/ (* Is ev) nvt) gmin)))
                (daed:stamp-G! J n n1 n2 gd)
                (daed:stamp-I-res! F n1 n2 id)
                #t))))))))

; ── Ebers-Moll NPN ──
; IF = Is (e^{vbe/Vt} - 1), IR = Is (e^{vbc/Vt} - 1)
; IC = IF - IR (1 + 1/βR)
; IB = IF/βF + IR/βR
; IE = -(IC + IB)

(define (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((nc (daed:comp-nc c))
        (nb (daed:comp-nb c))
        (ne (daed:comp-ne c))
        (Is (daed:comp-value c))
        (bf (hash-ref c "bf" 100.0))
        (br (hash-ref c "br" 1.0))
        (vt (hash-ref c "vt" 0.026))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12))
        (vbe 0.0)
        (vbc 0.0)
        (IF 0.0)
        (IR 0.0)
        (gf 0.0)
        (gr 0.0)
        (ic 0.0)
        (ib 0.0)
        (ie 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIc-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIb-dVbc 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbe 0.0)
        (dIe-dVbc 0.0))
    (if (or (not (number? Is)) (<= Is 0.0)
            (not (number? bf)) (<= bf 0.0)
            (not (number? br)) (<= br 0.0)
            (not (number? vt)) (<= vt 0.0))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! vbe (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x ne))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old ne))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! vbc (daed:pnjlim
                    (- (daed:x-v x nb) (daed:x-v x nc))
                    (- (daed:x-v x-old nb) (daed:x-v x-old nc))
                    vt (daed:diode-vcrit vt Is)))
        (set! IF (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! IR (* Is (- (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt)) 1.0)))
        (set! gf (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbe vt))) vt))
        (set! gr (/ (* Is (daed:clip-exp (/ vbc vt))) vt))
        (set! ic (- IF (* IR (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! ib (+ (/ IF bf) (/ IR br)))
        (set! ie (* -1.0 (+ ic ib)))
        (daed:res-add! F nc ic)
        (daed:res-add! F nb ib)
        (daed:res-add! F ne ie)
        ; gmin as linear junction conductances (not mixed into gf/gr)
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb ne gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb ne (* gmin vbe))
        (daed:stamp-G! J n nb nc gmin)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F nb nc (* gmin vbc))
        (set! dIc-dVbe gf)
        (set! dIc-dVbc (* -1.0 (* gr (+ 1.0 (/ 1.0 br)))))
        (set! dIb-dVbe (/ gf bf))
        (set! dIb-dVbc (/ gr br))
        (set! dIe-dVbe (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbe dIb-dVbe)))
        (set! dIe-dVbc (* -1.0 (+ dIc-dVbc dIb-dVbc)))
        ; vbe = vB - vE, vbc = vB - vC
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nc (* -1.0 dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc nb (+ dIc-dVbe dIc-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nc ne (* -1.0 dIc-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nc (* -1.0 dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb nb (+ dIb-dVbe dIb-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n nb ne (* -1.0 dIb-dVbe))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nc (* -1.0 dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne nb (+ dIe-dVbe dIe-dVbc))
        (daed:jac-add! J n ne ne (* -1.0 dIe-dVbe))
        #t))))

; ── Level-1 NMOS (Shichman-Hodges), bulk = source ──
; β = Kp W/L
; cutoff  Vgs ≤ Vto:            Ids = 0
; linear  0 < Vds < Vgs−Vto:    Ids = β ((Vgs−Vto) Vds − Vds²/2) (1+λ Vds)
; sat     Vds ≥ Vgs−Vto:        Ids = (β/2) (Vgs−Vto)² (1+λ Vds)
; Reverse Vds < 0 swaps drain/source.
(define (daed:stamp-mos-nr! J F n x x-old c)
  (let ((nd (daed:comp-n1 c))
        (ng (daed:comp-n2 c))
        (ns (daed:comp-n3 c))
        (kp (daed:comp-value c))
        (w (hash-ref c "w" 20e-6))
        (l (hash-ref c "l" 2e-6))
        (vto (hash-ref c "vto" 0.8))
        (lam (hash-ref c "lambda" 0.0))
        (gmin (hash-ref c "gmin" 1e-12))
        (d 0)
        (s 0)
        (vd 0.0)
        (vg 0.0)
        (vs 0.0)
        (vds 0.0)
        (vgs 0.0)
        (vov 0.0)
        (beta 0.0)
        (mlam 1.0)
        (ids0 0.0)
        (ids 0.0)
        (gm 0.0)
        (gds 0.0))
    (if (or (not (number? kp)) (<= kp 0.0)
            (not (number? w)) (<= w 0.0)
            (not (number? l)) (<= l 0.0)
            (not (number? vto)))
      #f
      (begin
        (set! vg (daed:x-v x ng))
        (set! vd (daed:x-v x nd))
        (set! vs (daed:x-v x ns))
        (set! vds (- vd vs))
        (if (>= vds 0.0)
          (begin (set! d nd) (set! s ns))
          (begin
            (set! d ns)
            (set! s nd)
            (set! vds (* -1.0 vds))
            (set! vd (daed:x-v x d))
            (set! vs (daed:x-v x s))))
        (set! vgs (- vg vs))
        (set! beta (* kp (/ w l)))
        (if (or (not (number? lam)) (< lam 0.0))
          (set! lam 0.0)
          0)
        (if (or (not (number? gmin)) (< gmin 0.0))
          (set! gmin 1e-12)
          0)
        (set! vov (- vgs vto))
        (if (<= vov 0.0)
          (begin
            (set! ids 0.0)
            (set! gm 0.0)
            (set! gds gmin))
          (begin
            (set! mlam (+ 1.0 (* lam vds)))
            (if (< vds vov)
              (begin
                (set! ids0 (* beta (- (* vov vds) (* 0.5 (* vds vds)))))
                (set! ids (* ids0 mlam))
                (set! gm (* (* beta vds) mlam))
                (set! gds (+ (* (* beta (- vov vds)) mlam)
                             (* lam ids0)
                             gmin)))
              (begin
                (set! ids0 (* (* 0.5 beta) (* vov vov)))
                (set! ids (* ids0 mlam))
                (set! gm (* (* beta vov) mlam))
                (set! gds (+ (* lam ids0) gmin))))))
        (daed:jac-add! J n d d gds)
        (daed:jac-add! J n d s (* -1.0 (+ gds gm)))
        (daed:jac-add! J n d ng gm)
        (daed:jac-add! J n s d (* -1.0 gds))
        (daed:jac-add! J n s s (+ gds gm))
        (daed:jac-add! J n s ng (* -1.0 gm))
        (daed:res-add! F d ids)
        (daed:res-add! F s (* -1.0 ids))
        #t))))

; Constant Cgs / Cgd BE companions (only used on the .tran NR path).
(define (daed:stamp-one-cap-be! J F n x state h na nb C)
  (if (or (not (number? C)) (<= C 0.0) (not (number? h)) (<= h 0.0))
    #f
    (let ((Geq (/ C h))
          (vprev (hash-ref state "v" (make-vector 1 0.0))))
      (let ((vold (- (daed:node-voltage vprev na)
                     (daed:node-voltage vprev nb)))
            (vnow (- (daed:x-v x na) (daed:x-v x nb))))
        (daed:stamp-G! J n na nb Geq)
        (daed:stamp-I-res! F na nb (* Geq (- vnow vold)))
        #t))))

(define (daed:stamp-mos-caps! J F n x state h comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (if (equal? (daed:comp-type (car cs)) "M")
          (let ((c (car cs)))
            (daed:stamp-one-cap-be! J F n x state h
              (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n3 c) (hash-ref c "cgs" 0.0))
            (daed:stamp-one-cap-be! J F n x state h
              (daed:comp-n2 c) (daed:comp-n1 c) (hash-ref c "cgd" 0.0)))
          0)
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

(define (daed:stamp-nonlinear! J F n x x-old comps)
  (let loop ((cs comps))
    (if (null? cs)
      #t
      (begin
        (let ((ty (daed:comp-type (car cs))))
          (cond
            ((equal? ty "D")
             (daed:stamp-diode-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            ((equal? ty "Q")
             (daed:stamp-bjt-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            ((equal? ty "M")
             (daed:stamp-mos-nr! J F n x x-old (car cs)))
            (else 0)))
        (loop (cdr cs))))))

; DC NR system: J and F such that J dx = -F. Linear devices via stamp-system.
; Returns (list N J F n-v)
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr comps x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system comps)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))

; TRAN NR system: linear BE companions + same nonlinear stamps.
(define (daed:stamp-system-nr-tran comps h state x x-old)
  (let ((lin (daed:stamp-system-tran comps h state)))
    (let ((N (car lin))
          (A (car (cdr lin)))
          (b (car (cdr (cdr lin))))
          (n-v (car (cdr (cdr (cdr lin))))))
      (if (<= N 0)
        (list 0 (make-vector 0 0.0) (make-vector 0 0.0) 0)
        (let ((xx (if x x (make-vector N 0.0)))
              (xo (if x-old x-old (make-vector N 0.0))))
          (let ((F (daed:ax-minus-b A xx b N)))
            (daed:stamp-nonlinear! A F N xx xo comps)
            (daed:stamp-mos-caps! A F N xx state h comps)
            (list N A F n-v)))))))
