input.source:
; lib/prometheus-llm.aura — Axis D/E: propose edge (schema / wire / stub / live)
;
; (require "prometheus-llm" all:)
;
; Proposal is a 5-list:
;   (kind name body summary source)
;   kind   ∈ {"mutate","skip"}
;   name   must be "subject" (only continuous-edit target)
;   body   lambda source string for mutate:rebind
;   source ∈ {"rule","llm-stub","wire","llm-live",...}
;
; Denseness posture:
;   - rule / pure schema path: core E=0
;   - stub / wire-sim / live: edge E ≥ 1 (metered); schema still gates before rebind
;   - Live HTTPS is OPT-IN via PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE=live + LLM_API_KEY;
;     offline denseness suite never requires a live API.

(export prom:llm-version
        prom:propose-mode
        prom:proposal-kind
        prom:proposal-name
        prom:proposal-body
        prom:proposal-summary
        prom:proposal-source
        prom:proposal-errors
        prom:proposal-valid?
        prom:body-double
        prom:body-triple
        prom:body-quint
        prom:body-sept
        prom:body-poison
        prom:propose-rule
        prom:propose-stub
        prom:propose
        prom:parse-proposal-text
        prom:proposal-prompt
        prom:execute-proposal
        prom:note-edge-escape!)

(require "prometheus-measure" all:)
(require "prometheus-mutate" all:)
(require "std/string" all:)

(define prom:llm-version 1)

(define prom:body-double "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
(define prom:body-triple "(lambda (x) (* x 3))")
(define prom:body-quint "(lambda (x) (* x 5))")
(define prom:body-sept "(lambda (x) (* x 7))")
(define prom:body-poison "(lambda (x) (* x 99))")

(define (prom:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (prom:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (prom:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (prom:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (prom:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

; ── Mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

(define (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (prom:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (prom:stats-set! "last_escape_reason" 1)
  (prom:stats-ref "escapes"))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Allowed mutate bodies for Phase 4 denseness (whitelist + structural).
(define (prom:body-allowed? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 10)
       (< (string-length body) 80)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body "*")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (string-contains? body "define"))
       (not (string-contains? body "set!"))
       (not (string-contains? body "require"))
       (not (string-contains? body "eval"))
       (not (string-contains? body "gate"))
       (not (string-contains? body "subject"))
       (or (equal? body prom:body-double)
           (equal? body prom:body-triple)
           (equal? body prom:body-quint)
           (equal? body prom:body-sept)
           (equal? body prom:body-poison))))

(define (prom:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (car p))
            (name (car (cdr p)))
            (body (car (cdr (cdr p))))
            (summary (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
            (errs (quote ())))
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (and (string? name) (equal? name "subject")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (prom:body-allowed? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (prom:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (prom:proposal-errors p)))

; Closed-form want for sample-arg given a known body string.
(define (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? body prom:body-double) (* sample-arg 2))
    ((equal? body prom:body-triple) (* sample-arg 3))
    ((equal? body prom:body-quint) (* sample-arg 5))
    ((equal? body prom:body-sept) (* sample-arg 7))
    ((equal? body prom:body-poison) (* sample-arg 99))
    (else -1)))

; ── Wire parse ───────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)
  (string-append
    "Return ONLY one line: "
    "MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. "
    "N in {2,3,5,7}. sample-arg="
    (if (number? sample-arg) (number->string sample-arg) "7")
    " current-got="
    (if (number? current-got) (number->string current-got) "?")
    ". Prefer triple when current is double. No markdown."))

(define (prom:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((len (string-length text)))
      (let ((tail (if (<= len 240) text (substring text (- len 240) len))))
        (let ((parts (string-split tail "\n")))
          (let loop ((xs parts))
            (cond
              ((null? xs) #f)
              ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
               (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   #f
                   (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                     (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                             "mutate"
                             (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                               "skip"
                               k0))
                           (list-ref bits 1)
                           (list-ref bits 2)
                           (list-ref bits 3)
                           (if (string? source) source "wire"))))))
              (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))))

; ── Propose ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

; mode: "triple" | "quint" | "double" | "noop" | "auto" | "poison"
; current-got: last (subject sample-arg) observation for auto policy
(define (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "triple")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-triple" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "quint")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-quint "rule-quint" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "double")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-double "rule-double" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "poison")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-poison "rule-poison" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "auto")
     (if (and (number? current-got) (number? sample-arg)
              (= current-got (* sample-arg 2)))
       (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-auto-triple" "rule")
       (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule")))
    (else
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-default-noop" "rule"))))

(define (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((p (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Live path: opt-in only. Without key or on failure, fall back to rule body
; but still mark edge escape (attempted live edge).
(define (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((fallback (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey" "llm-live")
      (begin
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((sys
                "Reply with EXACTLY one line: MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. N in {2,3,5,7}. No markdown.")
              (usr (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)))
          (let ((resp (try (llm:chat sys usr) (catch (e) #f))))
            (let ((text
                    (if (string? resp)
                      resp
                      (if (hash? resp)
                        (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
                          (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
                            (if (string? c) c ""))
                          "")
                        ""))))
              (let ((parsed (prom:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
                (if (and (pair? parsed) (prom:proposal-valid? parsed))
                  parsed
                  (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                        (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                        "llm-parse-fallback" "llm-live"))))))))))

(define (prom:propose mode current-got sample-arg)
  (let ((pm (prom:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
        (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))))

; ── Execute (schema-gated rebind) ────────────────────────────

; Returns alist:
;   :ok :decision (commit|skip|refuse|rollback) :reason :snap :got :want :source
; sample-arg used for closed-form verify after mutate.
; n-leaves for leaf integrity check.
(define (prom:execute-proposal proposal sample-arg n-leaves)
  (if (not (prom:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (prom:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":got" -1)
          (cons ":want" -1)
          (cons ":source" (try (prom:proposal-source proposal) (catch (e) "?"))))
    (let ((kind (prom:proposal-kind proposal))
          (src (prom:proposal-source proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate")
              (cons ":snap" -1)
              (cons ":got" (prom:sample-subject sample-arg))
              (cons ":want" -1)
              (cons ":source" src))
        (let* ((body (prom:proposal-body proposal))
               (want (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg))
               (summary (prom:proposal-summary proposal))
               (r (prom:rebind-live "subject" body summary sample-arg))
               (got (prom:alist-ref ":got" r -1))
               (leaves (prom:leaves-intact? n-leaves))
               (applied (eq? (prom:alist-ref ":ok" r #f) #t))
               (good (and applied (= got want) leaves)))
          (if good
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_ok")
              (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                    (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                    (cons ":reason" "verified")
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_fail")
              (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                    (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                    (cons ":reason" (if applied "verify-failed" "rebind-failed"))
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))))))))

(lambda (text source) (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((clean (prom:strip-think text)))
      (let ((parts (string-split clean "\n")))
        (let loop ((xs parts))
          (cond
            ((null? xs) #f)
            ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
            ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
            ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                 (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                 (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                 (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
             (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
               (if (< (length bits) 4)
                 #f
                 (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                   (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                           "mutate"
                           (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                             "skip"
                             k0))
                         (list-ref bits 1)
                         (list-ref bits 2)
                         (list-ref bits 3)
                         (if (string? source) source "wire"))))))
            ; also accept a line that merely contains the wire prefix mid-line
            ((or (string-contains? (car xs) "MUTATE|subject|")
                 (string-contains? (car xs) "SKIP|subject|"))
             (let* ((line (car xs))
                    (idx (if (string-contains? line "MUTATE|subject|")
                           (string-index-of line "MUTATE|subject|")
                           (string-index-of line "SKIP|subject|")))
                    (sub (if (and (number? idx) (>= idx 0))
                           (substring line idx (string-length line))
                           line)))
               (let ((bits (string-split sub "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   (loop (cdr xs))
                   (list (if (string-prefix? (list-ref bits 0) "MUTATE") "mutate" "skip")
                         (list-ref bits 1)
                         (list-ref bits 2)
                         (list-ref bits 3)
                         (if (string? source) source "wire"))))))
            (else (loop (cdr xs)))))))))

input.source:
; lib/prometheus-llm.aura — Axis D/E: propose edge (schema / wire / stub / live)
;
; (require "prometheus-llm" all:)
;
; Proposal is a 5-list:
;   (kind name body summary source)
;   kind   ∈ {"mutate","skip"}
;   name   must be "subject" (only continuous-edit target)
;   body   lambda source string for mutate:rebind
;   source ∈ {"rule","llm-stub","wire","llm-live",...}
;
; Denseness posture:
;   - rule / pure schema path: core E=0
;   - stub / wire-sim / live: edge E ≥ 1 (metered); schema still gates before rebind
;   - Live HTTPS is OPT-IN via PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE=live + LLM_API_KEY;
;     offline denseness suite never requires a live API.

(export prom:llm-version
        prom:propose-mode
        prom:proposal-kind
        prom:proposal-name
        prom:proposal-body
        prom:proposal-summary
        prom:proposal-source
        prom:proposal-errors
        prom:proposal-valid?
        prom:body-double
        prom:body-triple
        prom:body-quint
        prom:body-sept
        prom:body-poison
        prom:propose-rule
        prom:propose-stub
        prom:propose
        prom:parse-proposal-text
        prom:proposal-prompt
        prom:execute-proposal
        prom:note-edge-escape!)

(require "prometheus-measure" all:)
(require "prometheus-mutate" all:)
(require "std/string" all:)

(define prom:llm-version 1)

(define prom:body-double "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
(define prom:body-triple "(lambda (x) (* x 3))")
(define prom:body-quint "(lambda (x) (* x 5))")
(define prom:body-sept "(lambda (x) (* x 7))")
(define prom:body-poison "(lambda (x) (* x 99))")

(define (prom:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (prom:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (prom:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (prom:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (prom:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

; ── Mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

(define (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (prom:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (prom:stats-set! "last_escape_reason" 1)
  (prom:stats-ref "escapes"))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Allowed mutate bodies for Phase 4 denseness (whitelist + structural).
(define (prom:body-allowed? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 10)
       (< (string-length body) 80)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body "*")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (string-contains? body "define"))
       (not (string-contains? body "set!"))
       (not (string-contains? body "require"))
       (not (string-contains? body "eval"))
       (not (string-contains? body "gate"))
       (not (string-contains? body "subject"))
       (or (equal? body prom:body-double)
           (equal? body prom:body-triple)
           (equal? body prom:body-quint)
           (equal? body prom:body-sept)
           (equal? body prom:body-poison))))

(define (prom:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (car p))
            (name (car (cdr p)))
            (body (car (cdr (cdr p))))
            (summary (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
            (errs (quote ())))
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (and (string? name) (equal? name "subject")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (prom:body-allowed? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (prom:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (prom:proposal-errors p)))

; Closed-form want for sample-arg given a known body string.
(define (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? body prom:body-double) (* sample-arg 2))
    ((equal? body prom:body-triple) (* sample-arg 3))
    ((equal? body prom:body-quint) (* sample-arg 5))
    ((equal? body prom:body-sept) (* sample-arg 7))
    ((equal? body prom:body-poison) (* sample-arg 99))
    (else -1)))

; ── Wire parse ───────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)
  (string-append
    "Return ONLY one line: "
    "MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. "
    "N in {2,3,5,7}. sample-arg="
    (if (number? sample-arg) (number->string sample-arg) "7")
    " current-got="
    (if (number? current-got) (number->string current-got) "?")
    ". Prefer triple when current is double. No markdown."))

(define (prom:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((len (string-length text)))
      (let ((tail (if (<= len 240) text (substring text (- len 240) len))))
        (let ((parts (string-split tail "\n")))
          (let loop ((xs parts))
            (cond
              ((null? xs) #f)
              ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
               (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   #f
                   (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                     (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                             "mutate"
                             (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                               "skip"
                               k0))
                           (list-ref bits 1)
                           (list-ref bits 2)
                           (list-ref bits 3)
                           (if (string? source) source "wire"))))))
              (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))))

; ── Propose ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

; mode: "triple" | "quint" | "double" | "noop" | "auto" | "poison"
; current-got: last (subject sample-arg) observation for auto policy
(define (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "triple")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-triple" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "quint")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-quint "rule-quint" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "double")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-double "rule-double" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "poison")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-poison "rule-poison" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "auto")
     (if (and (number? current-got) (number? sample-arg)
              (= current-got (* sample-arg 2)))
       (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-auto-triple" "rule")
       (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule")))
    (else
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-default-noop" "rule"))))

(define (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((p (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Live path: opt-in only. Without key or on failure, fall back to rule body
; but still mark edge escape (attempted live edge).
(define (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((fallback (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey" "llm-live")
      (begin
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((sys
                "Reply with EXACTLY one line: MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. N in {2,3,5,7}. No markdown.")
              (usr (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)))
          (let ((resp (try (llm:chat sys usr) (catch (e) #f))))
            (let ((text
                    (if (string? resp)
                      resp
                      (if (hash? resp)
                        (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
                          (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
                            (if (string? c) c ""))
                          "")
                        ""))))
              (let ((parsed (prom:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
                (if (and (pair? parsed) (prom:proposal-valid? parsed))
                  parsed
                  (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                        (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                        "llm-parse-fallback" "llm-live"))))))))))

(define (prom:propose mode current-got sample-arg)
  (let ((pm (prom:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
        (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))))

; ── Execute (schema-gated rebind) ────────────────────────────

; Returns alist:
;   :ok :decision (commit|skip|refuse|rollback) :reason :snap :got :want :source
; sample-arg used for closed-form verify after mutate.
; n-leaves for leaf integrity check.
(define (prom:execute-proposal proposal sample-arg n-leaves)
  (if (not (prom:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (prom:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":got" -1)
          (cons ":want" -1)
          (cons ":source" (try (prom:proposal-source proposal) (catch (e) "?"))))
    (let ((kind (prom:proposal-kind proposal))
          (src (prom:proposal-source proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate")
              (cons ":snap" -1)
              (cons ":got" (prom:sample-subject sample-arg))
              (cons ":want" -1)
              (cons ":source" src))
        (let* ((body (prom:proposal-body proposal))
               (want (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg))
               (summary (prom:proposal-summary proposal))
               (r (prom:rebind-live "subject" body summary sample-arg))
               (got (prom:alist-ref ":got" r -1))
               (leaves (prom:leaves-intact? n-leaves))
               (applied (eq? (prom:alist-ref ":ok" r #f) #t))
               (good (and applied (= got want) leaves)))
          (if good
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_ok")
              (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                    (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                    (cons ":reason" "verified")
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_fail")
              (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                    (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                    (cons ":reason" (if applied "verify-failed" "rebind-failed"))
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))))))))

(lambda (mode current-got sample-arg) (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((fallback (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey" "llm-live")
      (let* ((resp (try
                     (prom:llm-chat-live
                       (prom:proposal-system-live)
                       (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got))
                     (catch (e) #f)))
             (text (if (hash? resp) (hash-ref resp "content" "") ""))
             (parsed (prom:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
        (if (and (pair? parsed) (prom:proposal-valid? parsed))
          parsed
          ; Distinguish true live parse from rule fallback after failed wire.
          (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                (string-append
                  "llm-parse-fallback"
                  (if (hash? resp)
                    (string-append
                      ":err="
                      (let ((e (hash-ref resp "error" "")))
                        (if (string? e) e "?"))
                      ":ms="
                      (number->string (hash-ref resp "elapsed_ms" 0)))
                    ""))
                "llm-live-fallback"))))))

; lib/prometheus-llm.aura — Axis D/E: propose edge (schema / wire / stub / live)
;
; (require "prometheus-llm" all:)
;
; Proposal is a 5-list:
;   (kind name body summary source)
;   kind   ∈ {"mutate","skip"}
;   name   must be "subject" (only continuous-edit target)
;   body   lambda source string for mutate:rebind
;   source ∈ {"rule","llm-stub","wire","llm-live",...}
;
; Denseness posture:
;   - rule / pure schema path: core E=0
;   - stub / wire-sim / live: edge E ≥ 1 (metered); schema still gates before rebind
;   - Live HTTPS is OPT-IN via PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE=live + LLM_API_KEY;
;     offline denseness suite never requires a live API.

(export prom:llm-version
        prom:propose-mode
        prom:proposal-kind
        prom:proposal-name
        prom:proposal-body
        prom:proposal-summary
        prom:proposal-source
        prom:proposal-errors
        prom:proposal-valid?
        prom:body-double
        prom:body-triple
        prom:body-quint
        prom:body-sept
        prom:body-poison
        prom:propose-rule
        prom:propose-stub
        prom:propose
        prom:parse-proposal-text
        prom:proposal-prompt
        prom:execute-proposal
        prom:note-edge-escape!)

(require "prometheus-measure" all:)
(require "prometheus-mutate" all:)
(require "std/string" all:)

(define prom:llm-version 1)

(define prom:body-double "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
(define prom:body-triple "(lambda (x) (* x 3))")
(define prom:body-quint "(lambda (x) (* x 5))")
(define prom:body-sept "(lambda (x) (* x 7))")
(define prom:body-poison "(lambda (x) (* x 99))")

(define (prom:proposal-kind p) (car p))
(define (prom:proposal-name p) (car (cdr p)))
(define (prom:proposal-body p) (car (cdr (cdr p))))
(define (prom:proposal-summary p) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
(define (prom:proposal-source p)
  (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
    "rule"
    (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))))

; ── Mode ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:propose-mode)
  (let ((v (getenv "PROMETHEUS_LLM_PROPOSE")))
    (if (or (void? v) (not (string? v)) (equal? v "") (equal? v "0") (equal? v "rule"))
      "rule"
      (if (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "live") (equal? v "llm"))
        "live"
        (if (equal? v "stub")
          "stub"
          "rule")))))

(define (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (prom:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (prom:stats-set! "last_escape_reason" 1)
  (prom:stats-ref "escapes"))

; ── Schema ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

; Allowed mutate bodies for Phase 4 denseness (whitelist + structural).
(define (prom:body-allowed? body)
  (and (string? body)
       (> (string-length body) 10)
       (< (string-length body) 80)
       (string-prefix? body "(lambda")
       (string-contains? body "x")
       (string-contains? body "*")
       (string-contains? body ")")
       (not (string-contains? body "define"))
       (not (string-contains? body "set!"))
       (not (string-contains? body "require"))
       (not (string-contains? body "eval"))
       (not (string-contains? body "gate"))
       (not (string-contains? body "subject"))
       (or (equal? body prom:body-double)
           (equal? body prom:body-triple)
           (equal? body prom:body-quint)
           (equal? body prom:body-sept)
           (equal? body prom:body-poison))))

(define (prom:proposal-errors p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
    (list "not-a-list")
    (if (null? (cdr (cdr (cdr p))))
      (list "too-short")
      (let ((kind (car p))
            (name (car (cdr p)))
            (body (car (cdr (cdr p))))
            (summary (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
            (errs (quote ())))
        (if (not (or (equal? kind "mutate") (equal? kind "skip")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-kind" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (and (string? name) (equal? name "subject")))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-name" errs))
          #f)
        (if (not (string? summary))
          (set! errs (cons "bad-summary" errs))
          #f)
        (if (equal? kind "skip")
          (if (not (string? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-skip-body" errs))
            #f)
          (if (not (prom:body-allowed? body))
            (set! errs (cons "bad-mutate-body" errs))
            #f))
        errs))))

(define (prom:proposal-valid? p)
  (null? (prom:proposal-errors p)))

; Closed-form want for sample-arg given a known body string.
(define (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? body prom:body-double) (* sample-arg 2))
    ((equal? body prom:body-triple) (* sample-arg 3))
    ((equal? body prom:body-quint) (* sample-arg 5))
    ((equal? body prom:body-sept) (* sample-arg 7))
    ((equal? body prom:body-poison) (* sample-arg 99))
    (else -1)))

; ── Wire parse ───────────────────────────────────────────────

(define (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)
  (string-append
    "Return ONLY one line: "
    "MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. "
    "N in {2,3,5,7}. sample-arg="
    (if (number? sample-arg) (number->string sample-arg) "7")
    " current-got="
    (if (number? current-got) (number->string current-got) "?")
    ". Prefer triple when current is double. No markdown."))

(define (prom:parse-proposal-text text source)
  (if (not (string? text))
    #f
    (let ((len (string-length text)))
      (let ((tail (if (<= len 240) text (substring text (- len 240) len))))
        (let ((parts (string-split tail "\n")))
          (let loop ((xs parts))
            (cond
              ((null? xs) #f)
              ((equal? (car xs) "") (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((> (string-length (car xs)) 200) (loop (cdr xs)))
              ((or (string-prefix? (car xs) "MUTATE|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "mutate|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "SKIP|")
                   (string-prefix? (car xs) "skip|"))
               (let ((bits (string-split (car xs) "|")))
                 (if (< (length bits) 4)
                   #f
                   (let ((k0 (list-ref bits 0)))
                     (list (if (or (equal? k0 "MUTATE") (equal? k0 "mutate"))
                             "mutate"
                             (if (or (equal? k0 "SKIP") (equal? k0 "skip"))
                               "skip"
                               k0))
                           (list-ref bits 1)
                           (list-ref bits 2)
                           (list-ref bits 3)
                           (if (string? source) source "wire"))))))
              (else (loop (cdr xs))))))))))

; ── Propose ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

; mode: "triple" | "quint" | "double" | "noop" | "auto" | "poison"
; current-got: last (subject sample-arg) observation for auto policy
(define (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)
  (cond
    ((equal? mode "triple")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-triple" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "quint")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-quint "rule-quint" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "double")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-double "rule-double" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "poison")
     (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-poison "rule-poison" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "noop")
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-noop" "rule"))
    ((equal? mode "auto")
     (if (and (number? current-got) (number? sample-arg)
              (= current-got (* sample-arg 2)))
       (list "mutate" "subject" prom:body-triple "rule-auto-triple" "rule")
       (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-auto-noop" "rule")))
    (else
     (list "skip" "subject" "" "rule-default-noop" "rule"))))

(define (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((p (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))
    (list (car p)
          (car (cdr p))
          (car (cdr (cdr p)))
          (string-append "llm-stub:" (car (cdr (cdr (cdr p)))))
          "llm-stub")))

; Live path: opt-in only. Without key or on failure, fall back to rule body
; but still mark edge escape (attempted live edge).
(define (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
  (prom:note-edge-escape!)
  (let ((fallback (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg))
        (key (getenv "LLM_API_KEY")))
    (if (or (void? key) (not (string? key)) (equal? key "")
            (= (string-length key) 0))
      (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback)) (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
            "llm-nokey" "llm-live")
      (begin
        (require "std/llm" all:)
        (let ((sys
                "Reply with EXACTLY one line: MUTATE|subject|(lambda (x) (* x N))|summary OR SKIP|subject||summary. N in {2,3,5,7}. No markdown.")
              (usr (prom:proposal-prompt sample-arg current-got)))
          (let ((resp (try (llm:chat sys usr) (catch (e) #f))))
            (let ((text
                    (if (string? resp)
                      resp
                      (if (hash? resp)
                        (if (hash-ref resp "ok" #f)
                          (let ((c (hash-ref resp "content" "")))
                            (if (string? c) c ""))
                          "")
                        ""))))
              (let ((parsed (prom:parse-proposal-text text "llm-live")))
                (if (and (pair? parsed) (prom:proposal-valid? parsed))
                  parsed
                  (list (car fallback) (car (cdr fallback))
                        (car (cdr (cdr fallback)))
                        "llm-parse-fallback" "llm-live"))))))))))

(define (prom:propose mode current-got sample-arg)
  (let ((pm (prom:propose-mode)))
    (if (equal? pm "stub")
      (prom:propose-stub mode current-got sample-arg)
      (if (equal? pm "live")
        (prom:propose-live mode current-got sample-arg)
        (prom:propose-rule mode current-got sample-arg)))))

; ── Execute (schema-gated rebind) ────────────────────────────

; Returns alist:
;   :ok :decision (commit|skip|refuse|rollback) :reason :snap :got :want :source
; sample-arg used for closed-form verify after mutate.
; n-leaves for leaf integrity check.
(define (prom:execute-proposal proposal sample-arg n-leaves)
  (if (not (prom:proposal-valid? proposal))
    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)
          (cons ":reason" "schema-invalid")
          (cons ":errors" (prom:proposal-errors proposal))
          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":got" -1)
          (cons ":want" -1)
          (cons ":source" (try (prom:proposal-source proposal) (catch (e) "?"))))
    (let ((kind (prom:proposal-kind proposal))
          (src (prom:proposal-source proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate")
              (cons ":snap" -1)
              (cons ":got" (prom:sample-subject sample-arg))
              (cons ":want" -1)
              (cons ":source" src))
        (let* ((body (prom:proposal-body proposal))
               (want (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg))
               (summary (prom:proposal-summary proposal))
               (r (prom:rebind-live "subject" body summary sample-arg))
               (got (prom:alist-ref ":got" r -1))
               (leaves (prom:leaves-intact? n-leaves))
               (applied (eq? (prom:alist-ref ":ok" r #f) #t))
               (good (and applied (= got want) leaves)))
          (if good
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_ok")
              (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                    (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                    (cons ":reason" "verified")
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))
            (begin
              (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_fail")
              (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                    (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                    (cons ":reason" (if applied "verify-failed" "rebind-failed"))
                    (cons ":snap" -1)
                    (cons ":got" got)
                    (cons ":want" want)
                    (cons ":source" src)
                    (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))))))))

    (list (cons ":ok" #f)
          (cons ":decision" 'refuse)

          (cons ":snap" -1)
          (cons ":got" -1)
          (cons ":want" -1)
          (cons ":source" (try (prom:proposal-source proposal) (catch (e) "?"))))
    (let ((kind (prom:proposal-kind proposal))
          (src (prom:proposal-source proposal)))
      (if (equal? kind "skip")
        (list (cons ":ok" #t)
              (cons ":decision" 'skip)
              (cons ":reason" "no-mutate")
              (cons ":snap" -1)
              (cons ":got" (prom:sample-subject sample-arg))
              (cons ":want" -1)
              (cons ":source" src))
        ; Rebind + sample inside a 1-iter while (host residual H3: subject
        ; samples outside while after set-code can be stale/zero).
        (let ((body (prom:proposal-body proposal))
              (want (prom:want-for-body body sample-arg))
              (summary (prom:proposal-summary proposal))
              (got -1)
              (applied #f)
              (leaves #f)
              (done 0))
          (while (lambda () (< done 1))
            (lambda ()
              (let ((r (prom:rebind-live "subject" body summary sample-arg)))
                (set! applied (eq? (prom:alist-ref ":ok" r #f) #t))
                (set! got (prom:alist-ref ":got" r -1))
                (set! leaves (prom:leaves-intact? n-leaves))
                (set! done 1))))
          (let ((good (and applied (= got want) leaves)))
            (if good
              (begin
                (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_ok")
                (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                      (cons ":decision" 'commit)
                      (cons ":reason" "verified")
                      (cons ":snap" -1)
                      (cons ":got" got)
                      (cons ":want" want)
                      (cons ":source" src)
                      (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves)))
              (begin
                (prom:stats-bump! "correctness_fail")
                (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                      (cons ":decision" 'rollback)
                      (cons ":reason" (if applied "verify-failed" "rebind-failed"))
                      (cons ":snap" -1)
                      (cons ":got" got)
                      (cons ":want" want)
                      (cons ":source" src)
                      (cons ":leaves_ok" leaves))))))))))

input.source:
; lib/hermes-topology.aura — Axis A: pure-Aura multi-agent topology
;
; (require "hermes-topology" all:)
;
; Phase 1 surface: coordination topology as a first-class pure-Aura object.
; Single host / single process. No wire / transport (those are Phase 4 E).
;
; Topology model:
;   agents  — list of agent names (strings)
;   routes  — list of (from region next)  ; region "" = default/any
;   roles   — hash name → handler (lambda (msg) → msg-or-#f)
;   inbox   — hash name → list of delivered payloads (collector sinks)
;
; Message:
;   (id from to region payload hops)
;   id/from/to/region strings; payload number; hops count.
;
; Delivery: hop-by-hop via route table until to == current or max hops.

(export hermes:topology-version
        hermes:msg-id hermes:msg-from hermes:msg-to
        hermes:msg-region hermes:msg-payload hermes:msg-hops
        hermes:make-msg hermes:msg-with-hops hermes:msg-with-from
        hermes:make-topology
        hermes:topo-agents hermes:topo-routes hermes:topo-roles hermes:topo-inbox
        hermes:bind-role!
        hermes:route-next
        hermes:topo-complete?
        hermes:deliver-once!
        hermes:deliver!
        hermes:send!
        hermes:inbox-ref hermes:inbox-sum hermes:inbox-count
        hermes:snapshot-topology
        hermes:default-worker-east hermes:default-worker-west
        hermes:default-router-pass hermes:default-collector
        hermes:build-star-topology
        hermes:run-region-workload!)

(require "hermes-measure" all:)

(define hermes:topology-version 1)

; ── Message accessors ──

(define (hermes:msg-id m) (car m))
(define (hermes:msg-from m) (car (cdr m)))
(define (hermes:msg-to m) (car (cdr (cdr m))))
(define (hermes:msg-region m) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr m)))))
(define (hermes:msg-payload m) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr m))))))
(define (hermes:msg-hops m) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr m)))))))

(define (hermes:make-msg id from to region payload)
  (list id from to region payload 0))

(define (hermes:msg-with-hops m hops)
  (list (hermes:msg-id m)
        (hermes:msg-from m)
        (hermes:msg-to m)
        (hermes:msg-region m)
        (hermes:msg-payload m)
        hops))

(define (hermes:msg-with-from m from)
  (list (hermes:msg-id m)
        from
        (hermes:msg-to m)
        (hermes:msg-region m)
        (hermes:msg-payload m)
        (hermes:msg-hops m)))

; ── Topology object: (agents routes roles-hash inbox-hash) ──

(define (hermes:make-topology agents routes)
  (hermes:stats-bump! "topo_builds")
  (list agents routes (hash) (hash)))

(define (hermes:topo-agents t) (car t))
(define (hermes:topo-routes t) (car (cdr t)))
(define (hermes:topo-roles t) (car (cdr (cdr t))))
(define (hermes:topo-inbox t) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t)))))

(define (hermes:bind-role! t name handler)
  (hash-set! (hermes:topo-roles t) name handler)
  (hermes:stats-bump! "agents_bound")
  name)

; routes: list of (from region next)
; Prefer exact region match; fall back to default region "".
(define (hermes:route-next t from region)
  (let ((rs (hermes:topo-routes t)))
    (let loop ((xs rs) (fallback #f))
      (if (null? xs)
        (begin
          (if fallback
            (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "route_hits") fallback)
            (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "route_miss") #f)))
        (let ((r (car xs)))
          (let ((r-from (car r))
                (r-region (car (cdr r)))
                (r-next (car (cdr (cdr r)))))
            (if (equal? r-from from)
              (if (equal? r-region region)
                (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "route_hits") r-next)
                (if (and (equal? r-region "") (not fallback))
                  (loop (cdr xs) r-next)
                  (loop (cdr xs) fallback)))
              (loop (cdr xs) fallback))))))))

; Every agent has a bound role; every non-sink agent has at least one route out.
; sinks: agents that appear as route targets but need not route further
;         (we treat "collector" name convention + any agent with no out-route
;          as terminal if it has a role).
(define (hermes:topo-complete? t)
  (let ((agents (hermes:topo-agents t))
        (roles (hermes:topo-roles t))
        (routes (hermes:topo-routes t)))
    (let loop ((xs agents))
      (if (null? xs)
        #t
        (let ((name (car xs)))
          (if (not (procedure? (hash-ref roles name #f)))
            #f
            (loop (cdr xs))))))))

; Invoke agent handler at `at` with msg; returns rewritten msg or #f on fail.
(define (hermes:deliver-once! t at msg)
  (let ((handler (hash-ref (hermes:topo-roles t) at #f)))
    (if (not (procedure? handler))
      (begin
        (hermes:stats-bump! "messages_failed")
        #f)
      (let ((out (handler msg)))
        (if out
          out
          (begin
            (hermes:stats-bump! "messages_failed")
            #f))))))

; Multi-hop deliver starting at `start` agent.
; max-hops caps loops. Terminal when agent name == msg.to OR no further route
; and agent is the intended sink (msg.to).
; → alist :ok :hops :final_at :payload | :ok #f :reason
(define (hermes:deliver! t start msg max-hops)
  (let ((cap (if (and (number? max-hops) (> max-hops 0)) max-hops 16)))
    (let loop ((at start) (m msg) (hops 0))
      (if (> hops cap)
        (begin
          (hermes:stats-bump! "messages_failed")
          (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                (cons ":reason" "max-hops")
                (cons ":hops" hops)
                (cons ":final_at" at)))
        (let ((m1 (hermes:deliver-once! t at m)))
          (if (not m1)
            (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                  (cons ":reason" "handler-fail")
                  (cons ":hops" hops)
                  (cons ":final_at" at))
            (let ((m2 (hermes:msg-with-hops m1 (+ hops 1)))
                  (dest (hermes:msg-to m1)))
              (if (equal? at dest)
                (begin
                  (hermes:stats-bump! "messages_delivered")
                  (hermes:stats-set! "hops_total"
                    (+ (hermes:stats-ref "hops_total") (+ hops 1)))
                  (hermes:stats-set! "last_delivered"
                    (+ 1 (hermes:stats-ref "last_delivered")))
                  (hermes:stats-set! "last_hops" (+ hops 1))
                  (list (cons ":ok" #t)
                        (cons ":hops" (+ hops 1))
                        (cons ":final_at" at)
                        (cons ":payload" (hermes:msg-payload m2))))
                (let ((next (hermes:route-next t at (hermes:msg-region m2))))
                  (if (not next)
                    (begin
                      (hermes:stats-bump! "messages_failed")
                      (list (cons ":ok" #f)
                            (cons ":reason" "route-miss")
                            (cons ":hops" (+ hops 1))
                            (cons ":final_at" at)))
                    (loop next
                          (hermes:msg-with-from m2 at)
                          (+ hops 1))))))))))))

; Send a new message into topology at producer/start.
(define (hermes:send! t start msg max-hops)
  (hermes:stats-bump! "messages_sent")
  (hermes:deliver! t start msg max-hops))

(define (hermes:inbox-ref t name)
  (let ((v (hash-ref (hermes:topo-inbox t) name #f)))
    (if (list? v) v (quote ()))))

(define (hermes:inbox-sum t name)
  (let ((xs (hermes:inbox-ref t name)))
    (let loop ((ys xs) (acc 0))
      (if (null? ys)
        acc
        (let ((p (car ys)))
          (loop (cdr ys) (+ acc (if (number? p) p 0))))))))

(define (hermes:inbox-count t name)
  (length (hermes:inbox-ref t name)))

; Snapshot of topology structure (not live role closures): agents + routes +
; per-agent inbox counts. For dual-rollback baseline in later phases.
; → alist :agents :routes :inbox_counts :topo_version
(define (hermes:snapshot-topology t)
  (let ((agents (hermes:topo-agents t))
        (routes (hermes:topo-routes t))
        (inbox (hermes:topo-inbox t)))
    (let loop ((xs agents) (counts (quote ())))
      (if (null? xs)
        (list (cons ":agents" agents)
              (cons ":routes" routes)
              (cons ":inbox_counts" (reverse counts))
              (cons ":topo_version" hermes:topology-version))
        (let ((n (car xs)))
          (let ((c (length (hermes:inbox-ref t n))))
            (loop (cdr xs) (cons (cons n c) counts))))))))

; ── Default pure roles for star / region topology ──
;
; worker-east: payload' = payload * 2
; worker-west: payload' = payload * 3
; router: pass-through (routing done by table)
; collector: append payload to inbox; msg.to stays collector

(define (hermes:default-worker-east msg)
  (list (hermes:msg-id msg)
        (hermes:msg-from msg)
        "collector"
        (hermes:msg-region msg)
        (* (hermes:msg-payload msg) 2)
        (hermes:msg-hops msg)))

(define (hermes:default-worker-west msg)
  (list (hermes:msg-id msg)
        (hermes:msg-from msg)
        "collector"
        (hermes:msg-region msg)
        (* (hermes:msg-payload msg) 3)
        (hermes:msg-hops msg)))

(define (hermes:default-router-pass msg)
  msg)

; Collector closes over topology so it can write inbox.
(define (hermes:default-collector t)
  (lambda (msg)
    (let ((inbox (hermes:topo-inbox t))
          (payload (hermes:msg-payload msg)))
      (let ((prev (hash-ref inbox "collector" #f)))
        (let ((xs (if (list? prev) prev (quote ()))))
          (hash-set! inbox "collector" (cons payload xs))
          (list (hermes:msg-id msg)
                (hermes:msg-from msg)
                "collector"
                (hermes:msg-region msg)
                payload
                (hermes:msg-hops msg)))))))

; Star / region topology:
;   producer → router ─east→ worker-e → collector
;                      ─west→ worker-w → collector
(define (hermes:build-star-topology)
  (let ((agents (list "producer" "router" "worker-e" "worker-w" "collector"))
        (routes (list
                  (list "producer" "" "router")
                  (list "router" "east" "worker-e")
                  (list "router" "west" "worker-w")
                  (list "worker-e" "" "collector")
                  (list "worker-w" "" "collector"))))
    (let ((t (hermes:make-topology agents routes)))
      (hermes:bind-role! t "producer" hermes:default-router-pass)
      (hermes:bind-role! t "router" hermes:default-router-pass)
      (hermes:bind-role! t "worker-e" hermes:default-worker-east)
      (hermes:bind-role! t "worker-w" hermes:default-worker-west)
      (hermes:bind-role! t "collector" (hermes:default-collector t))
      t)))

; Run N messages alternating east/west with payloads 1..N.
; East: payload i → 2i ; West: payload i → 3i
; Expected sum = sum over i of (if east then 2i else 3i)
; → alist :delivered :failed :expected_sum :actual_sum :expected_count
(define (hermes:run-region-workload! t n)
  (hermes:stats-bump! "workloads_run")
  (hermes:stats-set! "last_delivered" 0)
  (let ((nn (if (and (number? n) (> n 0)) n 0)))
    (let loop ((i 1) (delivered 0) (failed 0) (expected 0))
      (if (> i nn)
        (list (cons ":delivered" delivered)
              (cons ":failed" failed)
              (cons ":expected_sum" expected)
              (cons ":actual_sum" (hermes:inbox-sum t "collector"))
              (cons ":expected_count" nn)
              (cons ":actual_count" (hermes:inbox-count t "collector")))
        (let ((region (if (= (modulo i 2) 1) "east" "west"))
              (factor (if (= (modulo i 2) 1) 2 3)))
          (let ((msg (hermes:make-msg
                       (string-append "m" (number->string i))
                       "producer"
                       "collector"
                       region
                       i)))
            (let ((r (hermes:send! t "producer" msg 16)))
              (if (hermes:alist-ref ":ok" r #f)
                (loop (+ i 1)
                      (+ delivered 1)
                      failed
                      (+ expected (* factor i)))
                (loop (+ i 1)
                      delivered
                      (+ failed 1)
                      (+ expected (* factor i)))))))))))

target.name: hermes:run-region-workload!
target.body: (lambda (t n) (hermes:run-region-workload-factors! t n 2 3))

; lib/hermes-measure.aura — Axis F: metrology for coordination denseness probes
;
; (require "hermes-measure" all:)
;
; Stats live in a process hash (same pattern as Hephaestus / Prometheus).
; Timing uses host (monotonic-ms). Alist helpers for probe result alists.

(export hermes:stats
        hermes:stats-reset!
        hermes:stats-ref
        hermes:stats-bump!
        hermes:stats-set!
        hermes:stats-alist
        hermes:alist-ref
        hermes:time-call
        hermes:check-eq
        hermes:check-true
        hermes:check-ge
        hermes:escape-note!)

(define (hermes:alist-ref key lst default)
  (let loop ((ys lst))
    (cond ((null? ys) default)
          ((not (pair? (car ys))) (loop (cdr ys)))
          ((equal? (car (car ys)) key) (cdr (car ys)))
          (else (loop (cdr ys))))))

(define (hermes:make-stats-hash)
  (let ((h (hash)))
    (hash-set! h "messages_sent" 0)
    (hash-set! h "messages_delivered" 0)
    (hash-set! h "messages_failed" 0)
    (hash-set! h "hops_total" 0)
    (hash-set! h "route_hits" 0)
    (hash-set! h "route_miss" 0)
    (hash-set! h "agents_bound" 0)
    (hash-set! h "topo_builds" 0)
    (hash-set! h "workloads_run" 0)
    (hash-set! h "route_rebinds" 0)
    (hash-set! h "role_rebinds" 0)
    (hash-set! h "mut_ok" 0)
    (hash-set! h "mut_fail" 0)
    (hash-set! h "rollback_ok" 0)
    (hash-set! h "rollback_fail" 0)
    (hash-set! h "inject_pauses" 0)
    (hash-set! h "inject_resumes" 0)
    (hash-set! h "inject_drops" 0)
    (hash-set! h "drops_consumed" 0)
    (hash-set! h "pause_hits" 0)
    (hash-set! h "failovers" 0)
    (hash-set! h "recoveries" 0)
    (hash-set! h "events_logged" 0)
    (hash-set! h "wire_encode" 0)
    (hash-set! h "wire_decode" 0)
    (hash-set! h "wire_ok" 0)
    (hash-set! h "wire_refuse" 0)
    (hash-set! h "wire_send" 0)
    (hash-set! h "wire_bytes" 0)
    (hash-set! h "correctness_ok" 0)
    (hash-set! h "correctness_fail" 0)
    (hash-set! h "escapes" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_escape_reason" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_elapsed_ms" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_elapsed_s" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_ops" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_result" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_delivered" 0)
    (hash-set! h "last_hops" 0)
    h))

(define *hermes-stats* (hermes:make-stats-hash))

(define (hermes:stats)
  *hermes-stats*)

(define (hermes:stats-reset!)
  (set! *hermes-stats* (hermes:make-stats-hash))
  *hermes-stats*)

(define (hermes:stats-ref key)
  (let ((v (hash-ref *hermes-stats* key 0)))
    (if (number? v) v 0)))

(define (hermes:stats-bump! key)
  (let ((n (+ 1 (hermes:stats-ref key))))
    (hash-set! *hermes-stats* key n)
    n))

(define (hermes:stats-set! key val)
  (hash-set! *hermes-stats* key val)
  val)

(define (hermes:stats-alist)
  (list (cons "messages_sent" (hermes:stats-ref "messages_sent"))
        (cons "messages_delivered" (hermes:stats-ref "messages_delivered"))
        (cons "messages_failed" (hermes:stats-ref "messages_failed"))
        (cons "hops_total" (hermes:stats-ref "hops_total"))
        (cons "route_hits" (hermes:stats-ref "route_hits"))
        (cons "route_miss" (hermes:stats-ref "route_miss"))
        (cons "agents_bound" (hermes:stats-ref "agents_bound"))
        (cons "topo_builds" (hermes:stats-ref "topo_builds"))
        (cons "workloads_run" (hermes:stats-ref "workloads_run"))
        (cons "route_rebinds" (hermes:stats-ref "route_rebinds"))
        (cons "role_rebinds" (hermes:stats-ref "role_rebinds"))
        (cons "mut_ok" (hermes:stats-ref "mut_ok"))
        (cons "mut_fail" (hermes:stats-ref "mut_fail"))
        (cons "rollback_ok" (hermes:stats-ref "rollback_ok"))
        (cons "rollback_fail" (hermes:stats-ref "rollback_fail"))

        (cons "inject_resumes" (hermes:stats-ref "inject_resumes"))

        (cons "drops_consumed" (hermes:stats-ref "drops_consumed"))
        (cons "pause_hits" (hermes:stats-ref "pause_hits"))
        (cons "failovers" (hermes:stats-ref "failovers"))
        (cons "recoveries" (hermes:stats-ref "recoveries"))
        (cons "events_logged" (hermes:stats-ref "events_logged"))
        (cons "wire_encode" (hermes:stats-ref "wire_encode"))
        (cons "wire_decode" (hermes:stats-ref "wire_decode"))
        (cons "wire_ok" (hermes:stats-ref "wire_ok"))
        (cons "wire_refuse" (hermes:stats-ref "wire_refuse"))
        (cons "wire_send" (hermes:stats-ref "wire_send"))
        (cons "wire_bytes" (hermes:stats-ref "wire_bytes"))
        (cons "correctness_ok" (hermes:stats-ref "correctness_ok"))
        (cons "correctness_fail" (hermes:stats-ref "correctness_fail"))
        (cons "escapes" (hermes:stats-ref "escapes"))
        (cons "last_escape_reason" (hermes:stats-ref "last_escape_reason"))
        (cons "last_elapsed_ms" (hermes:stats-ref "last_elapsed_ms"))
        (cons "last_elapsed_s" (hermes:stats-ref "last_elapsed_s"))
        (cons "last_ops" (hermes:stats-ref "last_ops"))
        (cons "last_result" (hermes:stats-ref "last_result"))
        (cons "last_delivered" (hermes:stats-ref "last_delivered"))
        (cons "last_hops" (hermes:stats-ref "last_hops"))))

; Run thunk once; record elapsed via host (monotonic-ms).
; ops: logical operation count (caller-defined, e.g. messages).
; → alist :result :elapsed_ms :elapsed_s :ops
(define (hermes:time-call thunk ops)
  (let ((t0 (monotonic-ms)))
    (let ((result (thunk)))
      (let ((t1 (monotonic-ms)))
        (let ((elapsed-ms
                (if (and (number? t0) (number? t1) (>= (- t1 t0) 0))
                  (- t1 t0)
                  0)))
          (let ((ops-n (if (number? ops) ops 0)))
            (hermes:stats-set! "last_elapsed_ms" elapsed-ms)
            (hermes:stats-set! "last_elapsed_s" (quotient elapsed-ms 1000))
            (hermes:stats-set! "last_ops" ops-n)
            (hermes:stats-set! "last_result" (if (number? result) result 0))
            (list (cons ":result" result)
                  (cons ":elapsed_ms" elapsed-ms)
                  (cons ":elapsed_s" (quotient elapsed-ms 1000))
                  (cons ":ops" ops-n))))))))

(define (hermes:check-eq actual expected)
  (if (and (number? actual) (number? expected) (= actual expected))
    (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "correctness_ok") #t)
    (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "correctness_fail") #f)))

(define (hermes:check-true v)
  (if v
    (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "correctness_ok") #t)
    (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "correctness_fail") #f)))

(define (hermes:check-ge actual lo)
  (if (and (number? actual) (number? lo) (>= actual lo))
    (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "correctness_ok") #t)
    (begin (hermes:stats-bump! "correctness_fail") #f)))

; Meter a leave from pure Aura on a coordination-critical path.
; reason: string or number tag for last_escape_reason observability.
(define (hermes:escape-note! reason)
  (hermes:stats-bump! "escapes")
  (if (number? reason)
    (hermes:stats-set! "last_escape_reason" reason)
    (hermes:stats-set! "last_escape_reason" 1))
  (hermes:stats-ref "escapes"))

input.source:
; resp.aura — RESP2 encode / decode for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/resp" all:)
;
; Wire values (internal):
;   ("simple" s)  — +simple string
;   ("error" s)   — -error
;   ("int" n)     — :integer
;   ("bulk" s)    — $bulk string (s is string)
;   ("null")      — $-1 null bulk
;   ("array" xs)  — *array of wire values
;
; Incomplete input → #f from resp-try-parse.
; Complete → (list next-index wire-value)

(export resp-crlf
        resp-encode-simple
        resp-encode-error
        resp-encode-int
        resp-encode-bulk
        resp-encode-null
        resp-encode-array
        resp-encode-ok
        resp-encode-pong
        resp-encode
        resp-find-crlf
        resp-parse-int-at
        resp-try-parse
        resp-unwrap-bulk
        resp-cmd-args)

(define (resp-crlf) "\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-simple s)
  (string-append "+" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-error s)
  (string-append "-" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-int n)
  (string-append ":" n "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-bulk s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    (resp-encode-null)
    (string-append "$" (string-length s) "\r\n" s "\r\n")))

(define (resp-encode-null)
  "$-1\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-ok) (resp-encode-simple "OK"))
(define (resp-encode-pong) (resp-encode-simple "PONG"))

(define (resp-encode-array items)
  (let ((n (length items))
        (body "")
        (xs items))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (set! body (string-append body (resp-encode (car xs))))
        (set! xs (cdr xs))))
    (string-append "*" n "\r\n" body)))

(define (resp-encode v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v))
     (if (string? v)
       (resp-encode-bulk v)
       (if (number? v)
         (resp-encode-int v)
         (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (resp-encode-simple (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "error") (resp-encode-error (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (resp-encode-int (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (resp-encode-bulk (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") (resp-encode-null))
    ((string=? (car v) "array") (resp-encode-array (car (cdr v))))
    (else (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))

; Find index of \r\n starting at `start`, or -1
(define (resp-find-crlf buf start)
  (let ((n (string-length buf))
        (i start)
        (found -1))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i (- n 1)) (< found 0)))
      (lambda ()
        (if (and (= (string-ref buf i) 13)
                 (= (string-ref buf (+ i 1)) 10))
          (set! found i)
          (set! i (+ i 1)))))
    found))

; Parse signed integer from buf[start .. crlf-index). Returns number or #f
(define (resp-parse-int-at buf start end)
  (if (>= start end)
    #f
    (let ((s (substring buf start end))
          (n (string->number (substring buf start end))))
      (if (number? n) n #f))))

; Try parse one RESP value at index `i`.
; Returns #f if incomplete, else (list next-index value)
(define (resp-try-parse buf i)
  (let ((n (string-length buf)))
    (if (>= i n)
      #f
      (let ((t (string-ref buf i)))
        (cond
          ((or (= t 43) (= t 45) (= t 58))
           (resp-parse-line buf i n t))
          ((= t 36)
           (resp-parse-bulk buf i n))
          ((= t 42)
           (resp-parse-array buf i n))
          (else
           (list (+ i 1) (list "error" "ERR protocol"))))))))

(define (resp-parse-line buf i n t)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((payload (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))
            (next (+ cr 2)))
        (cond
          ((= t 43) (list next (list "simple" payload)))
          ((= t 45) (list next (list "error" payload)))
          (else
           (let ((num (string->number payload)))
             (if (number? num)
               (list next (list "int" num))
               (list next (list "error" "ERR int"))))))))))

(define (resp-parse-bulk buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((len (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? len))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR bulk len"))
          (if (< len 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((data-start (+ cr 2))
                  (need (+ cr 2 len 2)))
              (if (> need n)
                #f
                (list need
                      (list "bulk"
                            (substring buf data-start (+ data-start len))))))))))))

(define (resp-parse-array buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((alen (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? alen))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR array len"))
          (if (< alen 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((pos (+ cr 2))
                  (items (list))
                  (k 0)
                  (ok #t)
                  (fail #f))
              (while (lambda () (and ok (< k alen)))
                (lambda ()
                  (let ((r (resp-try-parse buf pos)))
                    (if (not r)
                      (begin (set! ok #f) (set! fail #t))
                      (begin
                        (set! pos (car r))
                        (set! items (append items (list (car (cdr r)))))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))))
              (if fail
                #f
                (list pos (list "array" items))))))))))

; Unwrap bulk/simple/int to a string (for command args)
(define (resp-unwrap-bulk v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v)) (if (string? v) v ""))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (number->string (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") #f)
    (else "")))

; Convert a top-level array wire value into a list of string args
(define (resp-cmd-args v)
  (if (and (pair? v) (string=? (car v) "array"))
    (let ((xs (car (cdr v)))
          (out (list)))
      (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
        (lambda ()
          (let ((u (resp-unwrap-bulk (car xs))))
            (set! out (append out (list (if u u ""))))
            (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
      out)
    (list)))

target.body:
(lambda (n) (cond
    ((= n 0) *RESP-ZERO*)
    ((= n 1) *RESP-ONE*)
    (else (string-append ":" n "\r\n"))))

;   ("null")      — $-1 null bulk

        resp-encode-error

        resp-encode-bulk
        resp-encode-null
        resp-encode-array
        resp-encode-ok

        resp-parse-int-at
        resp-try-parse
        resp-unwrap-bulk
        resp-cmd-args)

(define (resp-crlf) "\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-simple s)
  (string-append "+" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-error s)
  (string-append "-" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-int n)
  (string-append ":" n "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-bulk s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    (resp-encode-null)
    (string-append "$" (string-length s) "\r\n" s "\r\n")))

(define (resp-encode-null)
  "$-1\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-ok) (resp-encode-simple "OK"))
(define (resp-encode-pong) (resp-encode-simple "PONG"))

(define (resp-encode-array items)
  (let ((n (length items))
        (body "")
        (xs items))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (set! body (string-append body (resp-encode (car xs))))
        (set! xs (cdr xs))))
    (string-append "*" n "\r\n" body)))

(define (resp-encode v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v))
     (if (string? v)
       (resp-encode-bulk v)
       (if (number? v)
         (resp-encode-int v)
         (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (resp-encode-simple (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "error") (resp-encode-error (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (resp-encode-int (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (resp-encode-bulk (car (cdr v))))

(define (resp-find-crlf buf start)
  (let ((n (string-length buf))
        (i start)
        (found -1))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i (- n 1)) (< found 0)))

(define (resp-try-parse buf i)
  (let ((n (string-length buf)))

      #f

          ((or (= t 43) (= t 45) (= t 58))

          ((= t 36)

      #f
      (let ((payload (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))

          ((= t 45) (list next (list "error" payload)))

  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))

      #f
      (let ((len (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))

          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR bulk len"))
          (if (< len 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))

                  (need (+ cr 2 len 2)))

                (list need

  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))

                  (k 0)
                  (ok #t)
                  (fail #f))

              (if fail

(define (resp-unwrap-bulk v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v)) (if (string? v) v ""))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (car (cdr v)))

(define (resp-cmd-args v)
  (if (and (pair? v) (string=? (car v) "array"))
    (let ((xs (car (cdr v)))
          (out (list)))
      (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
        (lambda ()
          (let ((u (resp-unwrap-bulk (car xs))))
            (set! out (append out (list (if u u ""))))
            (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
      out)
    (list)))

     (if (string? v)

  (let ((n (string-length buf))

; Wire values (internal):
;   ("simple" s)  — +simple string
;   ("error" s)   — -error
;   ("int" n)     — :integer
;   ("bulk" s)    — $bulk string (s is string)
;   ("null")      — $-1 null bulk
;   ("array" xs)  — *array of wire values
;
; Incomplete input → #f from resp-try-parse.
; Complete → (list next-index wire-value)

(export resp-crlf
        resp-encode-simple
        resp-encode-error
        resp-encode-int
        resp-encode-bulk
        resp-encode-null
        resp-encode-array
        resp-encode-ok
        resp-encode-pong
        resp-encode
        resp-find-crlf
        resp-parse-int-at
        resp-try-parse
        resp-unwrap-bulk
        resp-cmd-args)

(define (resp-crlf) "\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-simple s)
  (string-append "+" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-error s)
  (string-append "-" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-int n)
  (string-append ":" n "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-bulk s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    (resp-encode-null)
    (string-append "$" (string-length s) "\r\n" s "\r\n")))

(define (resp-encode-null)
  "$-1\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-ok) (resp-encode-simple "OK"))
(define (resp-encode-pong) (resp-encode-simple "PONG"))

(define (resp-encode-array items)
  (let ((n (length items))
        (body "")
        (xs items))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (set! body (string-append body (resp-encode (car xs))))
        (set! xs (cdr xs))))
    (string-append "*" n "\r\n" body)))

(define (resp-encode v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v))
     (if (string? v)
       (resp-encode-bulk v)
       (if (number? v)
         (resp-encode-int v)
         (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (resp-encode-simple (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "error") (resp-encode-error (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (resp-encode-int (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (resp-encode-bulk (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") (resp-encode-null))
    ((string=? (car v) "array") (resp-encode-array (car (cdr v))))
    (else (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))

; Find index of \r\n starting at `start`, or -1
(define (resp-find-crlf buf start)
  (let ((n (string-length buf))
        (i start)
        (found -1))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i (- n 1)) (< found 0)))
      (lambda ()
        (if (and (= (string-ref buf i) 13)
                 (= (string-ref buf (+ i 1)) 10))
          (set! found i)
          (set! i (+ i 1)))))
    found))

; Parse signed integer from buf[start .. crlf-index). Returns number or #f
(define (resp-parse-int-at buf start end)
  (if (>= start end)
    #f
    (let ((s (substring buf start end))
          (n (string->number (substring buf start end))))
      (if (number? n) n #f))))

; Try parse one RESP value at index `i`.
; Returns #f if incomplete, else (list next-index value)
(define (resp-try-parse buf i)
  (let ((n (string-length buf)))
    (if (>= i n)
      #f
      (let ((t (string-ref buf i)))
        (cond
          ((or (= t 43) (= t 45) (= t 58))
           (resp-parse-line buf i n t))
          ((= t 36)
           (resp-parse-bulk buf i n))
          ((= t 42)
           (resp-parse-array buf i n))
          (else
           (list (+ i 1) (list "error" "ERR protocol"))))))))

(define (resp-parse-line buf i n t)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((payload (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))
            (next (+ cr 2)))
        (cond
          ((= t 43) (list next (list "simple" payload)))
          ((= t 45) (list next (list "error" payload)))
          (else
           (let ((num (string->number payload)))
             (if (number? num)
               (list next (list "int" num))
               (list next (list "error" "ERR int"))))))))))

(define (resp-parse-bulk buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((len (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? len))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR bulk len"))
          (if (< len 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((data-start (+ cr 2))
                  (need (+ cr 2 len 2)))
              (if (> need n)
                #f
                (list need
                      (list "bulk"
                            (substring buf data-start (+ data-start len))))))))))))

(define (resp-parse-array buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((alen (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? alen))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR array len"))
          (if (< alen 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((pos (+ cr 2))
                  (items (list))
                  (k 0)
                  (ok #t)
                  (fail #f))
              (while (lambda () (and ok (< k alen)))
                (lambda ()
                  (let ((r (resp-try-parse buf pos)))
                    (if (not r)
                      (begin (set! ok #f) (set! fail #t))
                      (begin
                        (set! pos (car r))
                        (set! items (append items (list (car (cdr r)))))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))))
              (if fail
                #f
                (list pos (list "array" items))))))))))

; Unwrap bulk/simple/int to a string (for command args)
(define (resp-unwrap-bulk v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v)) (if (string? v) v ""))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (number->string (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") #f)
    (else "")))

; Convert a top-level array wire value into a list of string args
(define (resp-cmd-args v)
  (if (and (pair? v) (string=? (car v) "array"))
    (let ((xs (car (cdr v)))
          (out (list)))
      (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
        (lambda ()
          (let ((u (resp-unwrap-bulk (car xs))))
            (set! out (append out (list (if u u ""))))
            (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
      out)
    (list)))

     (if (string? v)
       (resp-encode-bulk v)

    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (resp-encode-simple (car (cdr v))))

    ((string=? (car v) "int") (resp-encode-int (car (cdr v))))

    ((string=? (car v) "null") *RESP-NULL*)
