; resp.aura — RESP2 encode / decode for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/resp" all:)
;
; Wire values (internal):
;   ("simple" s)  — +simple string
;   ("error" s)   — -error
;   ("int" n)     — :integer
;   ("bulk" s)    — $bulk string (s is string)
;   ("null")      — $-1 null bulk
;   ("array" xs)  — *array of wire values
;
; Incomplete input → #f from resp-try-parse.
; Complete → (list next-index wire-value)

(export resp-crlf
        resp-encode-simple
        resp-encode-error
        resp-encode-int
        resp-encode-bulk
        resp-encode-null
        resp-encode-array
        resp-encode-ok
        resp-encode-pong
        resp-encode
        resp-find-crlf
        resp-parse-int-at
        resp-try-parse
        resp-unwrap-bulk
        resp-cmd-args)

(define (resp-crlf) "\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-simple s)
  (string-append "+" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-error s)
  (string-append "-" s "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-int n)
  (string-append ":" n "\r\n"))

(define (resp-encode-bulk s)
  (if (not (string? s))
    (resp-encode-null)
    (string-append "$" (string-length s) "\r\n" s "\r\n")))

(define (resp-encode-null)
  "$-1\r\n")

(define (resp-encode-ok) (resp-encode-simple "OK"))
(define (resp-encode-pong) (resp-encode-simple "PONG"))

(define (resp-encode-array items)
  (let ((n (length items))
        (body "")
        (xs items))
    (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
      (lambda ()
        (set! body (string-append body (resp-encode (car xs))))
        (set! xs (cdr xs))))
    (string-append "*" n "\r\n" body)))

(define (resp-encode v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v))
     (if (string? v)
       (resp-encode-bulk v)
       (if (number? v)
         (resp-encode-int v)
         (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (resp-encode-simple (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "error") (resp-encode-error (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (resp-encode-int (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (resp-encode-bulk (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") (resp-encode-null))
    ((string=? (car v) "array") (resp-encode-array (car (cdr v))))
    (else (resp-encode-error "ERR encode"))))

; Find index of \r\n starting at `start`, or -1
(define (resp-find-crlf buf start)
  (let ((n (string-length buf))
        (i start)
        (found -1))
    (while (lambda () (and (< i (- n 1)) (< found 0)))
      (lambda ()
        (if (and (= (string-ref buf i) 13)
                 (= (string-ref buf (+ i 1)) 10))
          (set! found i)
          (set! i (+ i 1)))))
    found))

; Parse signed integer from buf[start .. crlf-index). Returns number or #f
(define (resp-parse-int-at buf start end)
  (if (>= start end)
    #f
    (let ((s (substring buf start end))
          (n (string->number (substring buf start end))))
      (if (number? n) n #f))))

; Try parse one RESP value at index `i`.
; Returns #f if incomplete, else (list next-index value)
(define (resp-try-parse buf i)
  (let ((n (string-length buf)))
    (if (>= i n)
      #f
      (let ((t (string-ref buf i)))
        (cond
          ((or (= t 43) (= t 45) (= t 58))
           (resp-parse-line buf i n t))
          ((= t 36)
           (resp-parse-bulk buf i n))
          ((= t 42)
           (resp-parse-array buf i n))
          (else
           (list (+ i 1) (list "error" "ERR protocol"))))))))

(define (resp-parse-line buf i n t)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((payload (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))
            (next (+ cr 2)))
        (cond
          ((= t 43) (list next (list "simple" payload)))
          ((= t 45) (list next (list "error" payload)))
          (else
           (let ((num (string->number payload)))
             (if (number? num)
               (list next (list "int" num))
               (list next (list "error" "ERR int"))))))))))

(define (resp-parse-bulk buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((len (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? len))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR bulk len"))
          (if (< len 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((data-start (+ cr 2))
                  (need (+ cr 2 len 2)))
              (if (> need n)
                #f
                (list need
                      (list "bulk"
                            (substring buf data-start (+ data-start len))))))))))))

(define (resp-parse-array buf i n)
  (let ((cr (resp-find-crlf buf (+ i 1))))
    (if (< cr 0)
      #f
      (let ((alen (string->number (substring buf (+ i 1) cr))))
        (if (not (number? alen))
          (list (+ cr 2) (list "error" "ERR array len"))
          (if (< alen 0)
            (list (+ cr 2) (list "null"))
            (let ((pos (+ cr 2))
                  (items (list))
                  (k 0)
                  (ok #t)
                  (fail #f))
              (while (lambda () (and ok (< k alen)))
                (lambda ()
                  (let ((r (resp-try-parse buf pos)))
                    (if (not r)
                      (begin (set! ok #f) (set! fail #t))
                      (begin
                        (set! pos (car r))
                        (set! items (append items (list (car (cdr r)))))
                        (set! k (+ k 1)))))))
              (if fail
                #f
                (list pos (list "array" items))))))))))

; Unwrap bulk/simple/int to a string (for command args)
(define (resp-unwrap-bulk v)
  (cond
    ((not (pair? v)) (if (string? v) v ""))
    ((string=? (car v) "bulk") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "simple") (car (cdr v)))
    ((string=? (car v) "int") (number->string (car (cdr v))))
    ((string=? (car v) "null") #f)
    (else "")))

; Convert a top-level array wire value into a list of string args
(define (resp-cmd-args v)
  (if (and (pair? v) (string=? (car v) "array"))
    (let ((xs (car (cdr v)))
          (out (list)))
      (while (lambda () (pair? xs))
        (lambda ()
          (let ((u (resp-unwrap-bulk (car xs))))
            (set! out (append out (list (if u u ""))))
            (set! xs (cdr xs)))))
      out)
    (list)))

; store.aura — in-memory Redis-like store for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/store" all:)
;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"
;   "v"  → string | list-of-strings | nested hash
;   "ex" → expire deadline ms (0 = none)

(export store-new
        store-alive?
        store-purge!
        store-get
        store-set-string!
        store-del!
        store-exists?
        store-keys
        store-flush!
        store-type
        store-ttl
        store-expire!
        store-incr!
        store-list-push!
        store-list-pop!
        store-list-len
        store-hash-set!
        store-hash-get
        store-hash-del!
        store-hash-getall)

(define (store-new)
  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

(define (store-get db key)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-ref db key #f))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

(define (store-del! db keys)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-exists? db keys)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (set! n (+ n 1)))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-keys db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-keys db))

(define (store-flush! db)
  (let ((ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (hash-remove! db (car ks))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    #t))

(define (store-type db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      "none"
      (hash-ref e "t" "none"))))

(define (store-ttl db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      -2
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          -1
          (let ((left (quotient (- ex (current-time-ms)) 1000)))
            (if (< left 0) -2 left)))))))

(define (store-expire! db key seconds)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      0
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "ex" (+ (current-time-ms) (* seconds 1000)))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        1))))

(define (store-incr! db key delta)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key (number->string delta) 0)
        delta)
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((cur (string->number (hash-ref e "v" "0"))))
          (if (not (number? cur))
            #f
            (let ((n (+ cur delta)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (number->string n))
              (hash-set! db key e)
              n)))))))

(define (store-ensure-list! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "list")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (list))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-list-push! db key val left?)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-list! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if left?
          (hash-set! e "v" (cons val xs))
          (hash-set! e "v" (append xs (list val))))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        (length (hash-ref e "v" (list)))))))

(define (store-list-pop! db key left?)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if (null? xs)
          #f
          (if left?
            (let ((v (car xs)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (cdr xs))
              (if (null? (cdr xs)) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
              v)
            (let ((rev (reverse xs)))
              (let ((v (car rev))
                    (rest (reverse (cdr rev))))
                (hash-set! e "v" rest)
                (if (null? rest) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
                v))))))))

(define (store-list-len db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      0
      (length (hash-ref e "v" (list))))))

(define (store-ensure-hash! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "hash")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (hash))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-hash-set! db key field val)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-hash! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (created 0))
        (set! created (if (hash-has-key? h field) 0 1))
        (hash-set! h field val)
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (hash-set! db key e)
        created))))

(define (store-hash-get db key field)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      #f
      (hash-ref (hash-ref e "v") field #f))))

(define (store-hash-del! db key fields)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      0
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (n 0)
            (fs fields))
        (while (lambda () (pair? fs))
          (lambda ()
            (if (hash-has-key? h (car fs))
              (begin
                (hash-remove! h (car fs))
                (set! n (+ n 1))))
            (set! fs (cdr fs))))
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (if (= (hash-length h) 0)
          (hash-remove! db key)
          (hash-set! db key e))
        n))))

(define (store-hash-getall db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      (list)
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (ks (hash-keys (hash-ref e "v")))
            (out (list)))
        (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
          (lambda ()
            (set! out (append out (list (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks) ""))))
            (set! ks (cdr ks))))
        out))))

;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"
;   "v"  → string | list-of-strings | nested hash
;   "ex" → expire deadline ms (0 = none)

(export store-new
        store-alive?
        store-purge!
        store-get
        store-set-string!
        store-del!
        store-exists?
        store-keys
        store-flush!
        store-type
        store-ttl
        store-expire!
        store-incr!
        store-list-push!
        store-list-pop!
        store-list-len
        store-hash-set!
        store-hash-get
        store-hash-del!
        store-hash-getall)

(define (store-new)
  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

(define (store-get db key)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-ref db key #f))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

(define (store-del! db keys)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-exists? db keys)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (set! n (+ n 1)))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-keys db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-keys db))

(define (store-flush! db)
  (let ((ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (hash-remove! db (car ks))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    #t))

  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      "none"
      (hash-ref e "t" "none"))))

(define (store-ttl db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      -2
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          -1
          (let ((left (quotient (- ex (current-time-ms)) 1000)))
            (if (< left 0) -2 left)))))))

(define (store-expire! db key seconds)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      0
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "ex" (+ (current-time-ms) (* seconds 1000)))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        1))))

  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key (number->string delta) 0)
        delta)
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((cur (string->number (hash-ref e "v" "0"))))

            #f
            (let ((n (+ cur delta)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (number->string n))
              (hash-set! db key e)
              n)))))))

  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "list")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (list))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list") e)
      (else #f))))

  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-list! db key)))

        (length (hash-ref e "v" (list)))))))

  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))

    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))

    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "hash")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (hash))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-hash-set! db key field val)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-hash! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (created 0))
        (set! created (if (hash-has-key? h field) 0 1))
        (hash-set! h field val)
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (hash-set! db key e)
        created))))

(define (store-hash-get db key field)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      #f
      (hash-ref (hash-ref e "v") field #f))))

(define (store-hash-del! db key fields)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      0
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (n 0)
            (fs fields))
        (while (lambda () (pair? fs))
          (lambda ()
            (if (hash-has-key? h (car fs))
              (begin
                (hash-remove! h (car fs))
                (set! n (+ n 1))))
            (set! fs (cdr fs))))
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (if (= (hash-length h) 0)
          (hash-remove! db key)
          (hash-set! db key e))
        n))))

(define (store-hash-getall db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      (list)
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (ks (hash-keys (hash-ref e "v")))
            (out (list)))
        (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
          (lambda ()
            (set! out (append out (list (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks) ""))))
            (set! ks (cdr ks))))
        out))))

;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"

  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))

        (ks (hash-keys db)))

        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))

        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))

    #t))

  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-ref db key #f))

  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

  (store-purge! db)

        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))

    #t))

; store.aura — in-memory Redis-like store for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/store" all:)
;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"
;   "v"  → string | list-of-strings | nested hash
;   "ex" → expire deadline ms (0 = none)

(export store-new
        store-alive?
        store-purge!
        store-get
        store-set-string!
        store-del!
        store-exists?
        store-keys
        store-flush!
        store-type
        store-ttl
        store-expire!
        store-incr!
        store-list-push!
        store-list-pop!
        store-list-len
        store-hash-set!
        store-hash-get
        store-hash-del!
        store-hash-getall)

(define (store-new)
  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

(define (store-get db key)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-ref db key #f))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

(define (store-del! db keys)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-exists? db keys)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (hash-has-key? db (car ks))
          (set! n (+ n 1)))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-keys db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-keys db))

(define (store-flush! db)
  (let ((ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (hash-remove! db (car ks))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    #t))

(define (store-type db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      "none"
      (hash-ref e "t" "none"))))

(define (store-ttl db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      -2
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          -1
          (let ((left (quotient (- ex (current-time-ms)) 1000)))
            (if (< left 0) -2 left)))))))

(define (store-expire! db key seconds)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      0
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "ex" (+ (current-time-ms) (* seconds 1000)))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        1))))

(define (store-incr! db key delta)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key (number->string delta) 0)
        delta)
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((cur (string->number (hash-ref e "v" "0"))))
          (if (not (number? cur))
            #f
            (let ((n (+ cur delta)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (number->string n))
              (hash-set! db key e)
              n)))))))

(define (store-ensure-list! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "list")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (list))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-list-push! db key val left?)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-list! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if left?
          (hash-set! e "v" (cons val xs))
          (hash-set! e "v" (append xs (list val))))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        (length (hash-ref e "v" (list)))))))

  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))

          #f
          (if left?
            (let ((v (car xs)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (cdr xs))
              (if (null? (cdr xs)) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
              v)
            (let ((rev (reverse xs)))
              (let ((v (car rev))
                    (rest (reverse (cdr rev))))
                (hash-set! e "v" rest)
                (if (null? rest) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
                v))))))))

  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      0
      (length (hash-ref e "v" (list))))))

(define (store-ensure-hash! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "hash")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (hash))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-hash-set! db key field val)
  (store-purge! db)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-hash! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (created 0))
        (set! created (if (hash-has-key? h field) 0 1))
        (hash-set! h field val)
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (hash-set! db key e)
        created))))

(define (store-hash-get db key field)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      #f
      (hash-ref (hash-ref e "v") field #f))))

(define (store-hash-del! db key fields)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      0
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (n 0)
            (fs fields))
        (while (lambda () (pair? fs))
          (lambda ()
            (if (hash-has-key? h (car fs))
              (begin

                (set! n (+ n 1))))
            (set! fs (cdr fs))))
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (if (= (hash-length h) 0)
          (hash-remove! db key)
          (hash-set! db key e))
        n))))

(define (store-hash-getall db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      (list)

          (lambda ()
            (set! out (append out (list (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks) ""))))
            (set! ks (cdr ks))))
        out))))

; store.aura — in-memory Redis-like store for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/store" all:)
;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"
;   "v"  → string | list-of-strings | nested hash
;   "ex" → expire deadline ms (0 = none)
;
; TTL is lazy per-key: hot-path ops call store-touch! (drop that key only
; if expired). store-purge! remains for KEYS / DBSIZE / FLUSH-adjacent use.

(export store-new
        store-alive?
        store-touch!
        store-purge!
        store-get
        store-set-string!
        store-del!
        store-exists?
        store-keys
        store-dbsize
        store-flush!
        store-type
        store-ttl
        store-expire!
        store-incr!
        store-append!
        store-strlen
        store-getset!
        store-rename!
        store-list-push!
        store-list-pop!
        store-list-len
        store-hash-set!
        store-hash-get
        store-hash-del!
        store-hash-getall)

(define (store-new)
  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

; Drop key if expired; return live entry or #f. O(1) hot path.
(define (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (if (store-alive? e (current-time-ms))
        e
        (begin
          (hash-remove! db key)
          #f)))))

; Full scan — use for KEYS / DBSIZE / periodic maintenance, not hot path.
(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

(define (store-get db key)
  (store-touch! db key))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

(define (store-del! db keys)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        ; Touch so expired keys count as absent (Redis: DEL on expired = 0)
        (if (store-touch! db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-exists? db keys)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (store-touch! db (car ks))
          (set! n (+ n 1)))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-keys db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-keys db))

(define (store-dbsize db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-length db))

(define (store-flush! db)
  (let ((ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (hash-remove! db (car ks))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    #t))

(define (store-type db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      "none"
      (hash-ref e "t" "none"))))

(define (store-ttl db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      -2
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          -1
          (let ((left (quotient (- ex (current-time-ms)) 1000)))
            (if (< left 0) -2 left)))))))

(define (store-expire! db key seconds)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      0
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "ex" (+ (current-time-ms) (* seconds 1000)))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        1))))

(define (store-incr! db key delta)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key (number->string delta) 0)
        delta)
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((cur (string->number (hash-ref e "v" "0"))))
          (if (not (number? cur))
            #f
            (let ((n (+ cur delta)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (number->string n))
              (hash-set! db key e)
              n)))))))

(define (store-append! db key val)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key val 0)
        (string-length val))
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((nv (string-append (hash-ref e "v" "") val)))
          (hash-set! e "v" nv)
          (hash-set! db key e)
          (string-length nv))))))

(define (store-strlen db key)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (cond
      ((not e) 0)
      ((not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string")) #f)
      (else (string-length (hash-ref e "v" ""))))))

; Returns (list ok old-or-null) — ok=#f means WRONGTYPE; old is string or #f
(define (store-getset! db key val)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (store-set-string! db key val 0)
       (list #t #f))
      ((not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
       (list #f #f))
      (else
       (let ((old (hash-ref e "v" "")))
         (hash-set! e "v" val)
         ; keep existing expire
         (hash-set! db key e)
         (list #t old))))))

; Returns: "ok" | "missing" | "busy" (RENAMENX dst exists) | "same"
(define (store-rename! db src dst nx?)
  (if (string=? src dst)
    "same"
    (let ((e (store-touch! db src)))
      (if (not e)
        "missing"
        (begin
          (store-touch! db dst)
          (if (and nx? (hash-has-key? db dst))
            "busy"
            (begin
              (hash-set! db dst e)
              (hash-remove! db src)
              "ok")))))))

(define (store-ensure-list! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "list")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (list))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))

; store.aura — in-memory Redis-like store for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/store" all:)
;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"
;   "v"  → string | list-of-strings | nested hash
;   "ex" → expire deadline ms (0 = none)
;
; TTL is lazy per-key: hot-path ops call store-touch! (drop that key only
; if expired). store-purge! remains for KEYS / DBSIZE / FLUSH-adjacent use.

(export store-new
        store-alive?
        store-touch!
        store-purge!
        store-get
        store-set-string!
        store-del!
        store-exists?
        store-keys
        store-dbsize
        store-flush!
        store-type
        store-ttl
        store-expire!
        store-incr!
        store-append!
        store-strlen
        store-getset!
        store-rename!
        store-list-push!
        store-list-pop!
        store-list-len
        store-hash-set!
        store-hash-get
        store-hash-del!
        store-hash-getall)

(define (store-new)
  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

; Drop key if expired; return live entry or #f. O(1) hot path.
(define (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (if (store-alive? e (current-time-ms))
        e
        (begin
          (hash-remove! db key)
          #f)))))

; Full scan — use for KEYS / DBSIZE / periodic maintenance, not hot path.
(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

(define (store-get db key)
  (store-touch! db key))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

(define (store-del! db keys)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        ; Touch so expired keys count as absent (Redis: DEL on expired = 0)
        (if (store-touch! db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-exists? db keys)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (store-touch! db (car ks))
          (set! n (+ n 1)))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-keys db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-keys db))

(define (store-dbsize db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-length db))

(define (store-flush! db)
  (let ((ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (hash-remove! db (car ks))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    #t))

(define (store-type db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      "none"
      (hash-ref e "t" "none"))))

(define (store-ttl db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      -2
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          -1
          (let ((left (quotient (- ex (current-time-ms)) 1000)))
            (if (< left 0) -2 left)))))))

(define (store-expire! db key seconds)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      0
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "ex" (+ (current-time-ms) (* seconds 1000)))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        1))))

(define (store-incr! db key delta)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key (number->string delta) 0)
        delta)
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((cur (string->number (hash-ref e "v" "0"))))
          (if (not (number? cur))
            #f
            (let ((n (+ cur delta)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (number->string n))
              (hash-set! db key e)
              n)))))))

(define (store-append! db key val)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key val 0)
        (string-length val))
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((nv (string-append (hash-ref e "v" "") val)))
          (hash-set! e "v" nv)
          (hash-set! db key e)
          (string-length nv))))))

(define (store-strlen db key)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (cond
      ((not e) 0)
      ((not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string")) #f)
      (else (string-length (hash-ref e "v" ""))))))

; Returns (list ok old-or-null) — ok=#f means WRONGTYPE; old is string or #f
(define (store-getset! db key val)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (store-set-string! db key val 0)
       (list #t #f))
      ((not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
       (list #f #f))
      (else
       (let ((old (hash-ref e "v" "")))
         (hash-set! e "v" val)
         ; keep existing expire
         (hash-set! db key e)
         (list #t old))))))

; Returns: "ok" | "missing" | "busy" (RENAMENX dst exists) | "same"
(define (store-rename! db src dst nx?)
  (if (string=? src dst)
    "same"
    (let ((e (store-touch! db src)))
      (if (not e)
        "missing"
        (begin
          (store-touch! db dst)
          (if (and nx? (hash-has-key? db dst))
            "busy"
            (begin
              (hash-set! db dst e)
              (hash-remove! db src)
              "ok")))))))

(define (store-ensure-list! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "list")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (list))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-list-push! db key val left?)
  (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-list! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if left?
          (hash-set! e "v" (cons val xs))
          (hash-set! e "v" (append xs (list val))))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        (length (hash-ref e "v" (list)))))))

(define (store-list-pop! db key left?)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if (null? xs)
          #f
          (if left?
            (let ((v (car xs)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (cdr xs))
              (if (null? (cdr xs)) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
              v)
            (let ((rev (reverse xs)))
              (let ((v (car rev))
                    (rest (reverse (cdr rev))))
                (hash-set! e "v" rest)
                (if (null? rest) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
                v))))))))

(define (store-list-len db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      0
      (length (hash-ref e "v" (list))))))

(define (store-ensure-hash! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "hash")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (hash))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-hash-set! db key field val)
  (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-hash! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (created 0))
        (set! created (if (hash-has-key? h field) 0 1))
        (hash-set! h field val)
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (hash-set! db key e)
        created))))

(define (store-hash-get db key field)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      #f
      (hash-ref (hash-ref e "v") field #f))))

(define (store-hash-del! db key fields)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      0
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (n 0)
            (fs fields))
        (while (lambda () (pair? fs))
          (lambda ()
            (if (hash-has-key? h (car fs))
              (begin
                (hash-remove! h (car fs))
                (set! n (+ n 1))))
            (set! fs (cdr fs))))
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (if (= (hash-length h) 0)
          (hash-remove! db key)
          (hash-set! db key e))
        n))))

(define (store-hash-getall db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      (list)
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (ks (hash-keys (hash-ref e "v")))
            (out (list)))
        (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
          (lambda ()
            (set! out (append out (list (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks) ""))))
            (set! ks (cdr ks))))
        out))))

; store.aura — in-memory Redis-like store for aura-redis v0
; (require "src/redis/store" all:)
;
; Entry shape (hash):
;   "t"  → "string" | "list" | "hash"
;   "v"  → string | list-of-strings | nested hash
;   "ex" → expire deadline ms (0 = none)
;
; TTL is lazy per-key: hot-path ops call store-touch! (drop that key only
; if expired). store-purge! remains for KEYS / DBSIZE / FLUSH-adjacent use.

(export store-new
        store-alive?
        store-touch!
        store-purge!
        store-get
        store-set-string!
        store-del!
        store-exists?
        store-keys
        store-dbsize
        store-flush!
        store-type
        store-ttl
        store-expire!
        store-incr!
        store-append!
        store-strlen
        store-getset!
        store-rename!
        store-list-push!
        store-list-pop!
        store-list-len
        store-hash-set!
        store-hash-get
        store-hash-del!
        store-hash-getall)

(define (store-new)
  (hash))

(define (store-alive? entry now)
  (let ((ex (hash-ref entry "ex" 0)))
    (or (= ex 0) (> ex now))))

; Drop key if expired; return live entry or #f. O(1) hot path.
(define (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (if (store-alive? e (current-time-ms))
        e
        (begin
          (hash-remove! db key)
          #f)))))

; Full scan — use for KEYS / DBSIZE / periodic maintenance, not hot path.
(define (store-purge! db)
  (let ((now (current-time-ms))
        (ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (let ((k (car ks))
              (e (hash-ref db k #f)))
          (if (and e (not (store-alive? e now)))
            (hash-remove! db k))
          (set! ks (cdr ks)))))
    db))

(define (store-get db key)
  (store-touch! db key))

(define (store-set-string! db key val ex-ms)
  (let ((entry (hash)))
    (hash-set! entry "t" "string")
    (hash-set! entry "v" val)
    (hash-set! entry "ex" (if (and (number? ex-ms) (> ex-ms 0)) ex-ms 0))
    (hash-set! db key entry)
    #t))

(define (store-del! db keys)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        ; Touch so expired keys count as absent (Redis: DEL on expired = 0)
        (if (store-touch! db (car ks))
          (begin
            (hash-remove! db (car ks))
            (set! n (+ n 1))))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-exists? db keys)
  (let ((n 0)
        (ks keys))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (if (store-touch! db (car ks))
          (set! n (+ n 1)))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    n))

(define (store-keys db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-keys db))

(define (store-dbsize db)
  (store-purge! db)
  (hash-length db))

(define (store-flush! db)
  (let ((ks (hash-keys db)))
    (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
      (lambda ()
        (hash-remove! db (car ks))
        (set! ks (cdr ks))))
    #t))

(define (store-type db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      "none"
      (hash-ref e "t" "none"))))

(define (store-ttl db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      -2
      (let ((ex (hash-ref e "ex" 0)))
        (if (= ex 0)
          -1
          (let ((left (quotient (- ex (current-time-ms)) 1000)))
            (if (< left 0) -2 left)))))))

(define (store-expire! db key seconds)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (not e)
      0
      (begin
        (hash-set! e "ex" (+ (current-time-ms) (* seconds 1000)))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        1))))

(define (store-incr! db key delta)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key (number->string delta) 0)
        delta)
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((cur (string->number (hash-ref e "v" "0"))))
          (if (not (number? cur))
            #f
            (let ((n (+ cur delta)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (number->string n))
              (hash-set! db key e)
              n)))))))

(define (store-append! db key val)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      (begin
        (store-set-string! db key val 0)
        (string-length val))
      (if (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
        #f
        (let ((nv (string-append (hash-ref e "v" "") val)))
          (hash-set! e "v" nv)
          (hash-set! db key e)
          (string-length nv))))))

(define (store-strlen db key)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (cond
      ((not e) 0)
      ((not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string")) #f)
      (else (string-length (hash-ref e "v" ""))))))

; Returns (list ok old-or-null) — ok=#f means WRONGTYPE; old is string or #f
(define (store-getset! db key val)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (store-set-string! db key val 0)
       (list #t #f))
      ((not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "string"))
       (list #f #f))
      (else
       (let ((old (hash-ref e "v" "")))
         (hash-set! e "v" val)
         ; keep existing expire
         (hash-set! db key e)
         (list #t old))))))

; Returns: "ok" | "missing" | "busy" (RENAMENX dst exists) | "same"
(define (store-rename! db src dst nx?)
  (if (string=? src dst)
    "same"
    (let ((e (store-touch! db src)))
      (if (not e)
        "missing"
        (begin
          (store-touch! db dst)
          (if (and nx? (hash-has-key? db dst))
            "busy"
            (begin
              (hash-set! db dst e)
              (hash-remove! db src)
              "ok")))))))

(define (store-ensure-list! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "list")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (list))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-list-push! db key val left?)
  (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-list! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if left?
          (hash-set! e "v" (cons val xs))
          (hash-set! e "v" (append xs (list val))))
        (hash-set! db key e)
        (length (hash-ref e "v" (list)))))))

(define (store-list-pop! db key left?)
  (let ((e (store-touch! db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      #f
      (let ((xs (hash-ref e "v" (list))))
        (if (null? xs)
          #f
          (if left?
            (let ((v (car xs)))
              (hash-set! e "v" (cdr xs))
              (if (null? (cdr xs)) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
              v)
            (let ((rev (reverse xs)))
              (let ((v (car rev))
                    (rest (reverse (cdr rev))))
                (hash-set! e "v" rest)
                (if (null? rest) (hash-remove! db key) (hash-set! db key e))
                v))))))))

(define (store-list-len db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "list")))
      0
      (length (hash-ref e "v" (list))))))

(define (store-ensure-hash! db key)
  (let ((e (hash-ref db key #f)))
    (cond
      ((not e)
       (let ((entry (hash)))
         (hash-set! entry "t" "hash")
         (hash-set! entry "v" (hash))
         (hash-set! entry "ex" 0)
         (hash-set! db key entry)
         entry))
      ((string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash") e)
      (else #f))))

(define (store-hash-set! db key field val)
  (store-touch! db key)
  (let ((e (store-ensure-hash! db key)))
    (if (not e)
      #f
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (created 0))
        (set! created (if (hash-has-key? h field) 0 1))
        (hash-set! h field val)
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (hash-set! db key e)
        created))))

(define (store-hash-get db key field)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      #f
      (hash-ref (hash-ref e "v") field #f))))

(define (store-hash-del! db key fields)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      0
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (n 0)
            (fs fields))
        (while (lambda () (pair? fs))
          (lambda ()
            (if (hash-has-key? h (car fs))
              (begin
                (hash-remove! h (car fs))
                (set! n (+ n 1))))
            (set! fs (cdr fs))))
        (hash-set! e "v" h)
        (if (= (hash-length h) 0)
          (hash-remove! db key)
          (hash-set! db key e))
        n))))

(define (store-hash-getall db key)
  (let ((e (store-get db key)))
    (if (or (not e) (not (string=? (hash-ref e "t" "") "hash")))
      (list)
      (let ((h (hash-ref e "v"))
            (ks (hash-keys (hash-ref e "v")))
            (out (list)))
        (while (lambda () (pair? ks))
          (lambda ()
            (set! out (append out (list (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks) ""))))
            (set! ks (cdr ks))))
        out))))

; Loaded into server_ffi via (load ...) after bind helper (not require).
; Same rules as adaptive.aura — keep in sync.

(define (adaptive-rules-doc _)
  "write-heavy→lfu; read-heavy+hit≥60%→lru; min-ops/hysteresis/cooldown")

(define *ad-min-ops* 80)
(define *ad-votes-need* 2)
(define *ad-cooldown-ms* 400)
(define *ad-window-ms* 200)

(define *ad-set-evict!* #f)
(define *ad-evict-name* #f)
(define *ad-metric-gets* #f)
(define *ad-metric-sets* #f)
(define *ad-metric-hits* #f)
(define *ad-metric-misses* #f)
(define *ad-used-memory* #f)
(define *ad-maxmemory* #f)

(define *ad-prev-gets* 0)
(define *ad-prev-sets* 0)
(define *ad-prev-hits* 0)
(define *ad-prev-misses* 0)
(define *ad-last-eval-ms* 0)
(define *ad-last-swap-ms* 0)
(define *ad-pending* "")
(define *ad-pending-votes* 0)
(define *ad-swaps* 0)
(define *ad-ready* #f)

(define (adaptive-swap-count _) *ad-swaps*)

(define (adaptive-choose dgets dsets dhits dmisses)
  (let ((ops (+ dgets dsets)))
    (if (< ops *ad-min-ops*)
      ""
      (let ((hit-pct (if (> (+ dhits dmisses) 0)
                       (quotient (* 100 dhits) (+ dhits dmisses))
                       0)))
        (cond
          ((> dsets (* dgets 2)) "lfu")
          ((and (> dgets (* dsets 5)) (>= hit-pct 60)) "lru")
          (else ""))))))

(define (adaptive-init! set-evict! evict-name
                        metric-gets metric-sets metric-hits metric-misses
                        used-memory maxmemory)
  (set! *ad-set-evict!* set-evict!)
  (set! *ad-evict-name* evict-name)
  (set! *ad-metric-gets* metric-gets)
  (set! *ad-metric-sets* metric-sets)
  (set! *ad-metric-hits* metric-hits)
  (set! *ad-metric-misses* metric-misses)
  (set! *ad-used-memory* used-memory)
  (set! *ad-maxmemory* maxmemory)
  (set! *ad-prev-gets* 0)
  (set! *ad-prev-sets* 0)
  (set! *ad-prev-hits* 0)
  (set! *ad-prev-misses* 0)
  (set! *ad-last-eval-ms* (monotonic-ms))
  (set! *ad-last-swap-ms* 0)
  (set! *ad-pending* "")
  (set! *ad-pending-votes* 0)
  (set! *ad-swaps* 0)
  (set! *ad-ready* #t)
  #t)

(define (adaptive-log-swap! from to dgets dsets dhits dmisses used)
  (display "adaptive: swap ")
  (display from)
  (display " → ")
  (display to)
  (display " (gets=")
  (display dgets)
  (display " sets=")
  (display dsets)
  (display " hits=")
  (display dhits)
  (display " misses=")
  (display dmisses)
  (display " mem=")
  (display used)
  (display ")\n")
  #t)

(define (adaptive-tick! core)
  (if (not *ad-ready*)
    #f
    (let ((now (monotonic-ms)))
      (if (< (- now *ad-last-eval-ms*) *ad-window-ms*)
        #f
        (let ((g (*ad-metric-gets* core))
              (s (*ad-metric-sets* core))
              (h (*ad-metric-hits* core))
              (m (*ad-metric-misses* core)))
          (let ((dgets (- g *ad-prev-gets*))
                (dsets (- s *ad-prev-sets*))
                (dhits (- h *ad-prev-hits*))
                (dmisses (- m *ad-prev-misses*)))
            (set! *ad-prev-gets* g)
            (set! *ad-prev-sets* s)
            (set! *ad-prev-hits* h)
            (set! *ad-prev-misses* m)
            (set! *ad-last-eval-ms* now)
            (let ((dbg (getenv "AURA_REDIS_ADAPTIVE_DEBUG")))
              (if (and (string? dbg) (or (string=? dbg "1") (string=? dbg "true")))
                (begin
                  (display "adaptive: window gets=")
                  (display dgets)
                  (display " sets=")
                  (display dsets)
                  (display " hits=")
                  (display dhits)
                  (display " misses=")
                  (display dmisses)
                  (display " choice=")
                  (display (adaptive-choose dgets dsets dhits dmisses))
                  (display " cur=")
                  (display (*ad-evict-name* core))
                  (newline))
                #t))
            (let ((choice (adaptive-choose dgets dsets dhits dmisses))
                  (cur (*ad-evict-name* core)))
              (if (or (string=? choice "") (string=? choice cur))
                (begin
                  (set! *ad-pending* "")
                  (set! *ad-pending-votes* 0)
                  #f)
                (begin
                  (if (string=? choice *ad-pending*)
                    (set! *ad-pending-votes* (+ *ad-pending-votes* 1))
                    (begin
                      (set! *ad-pending* choice)
                      (set! *ad-pending-votes* 1)))
                  (if (and (>= *ad-pending-votes* *ad-votes-need*)
                           (>= (- now *ad-last-swap-ms*) *ad-cooldown-ms*))
                    (begin
                      (*ad-set-evict!* core choice)
                      (set! *ad-swaps* (+ *ad-swaps* 1))
                      (set! *ad-last-swap-ms* now)
                      (set! *ad-pending* "")
                      (set! *ad-pending-votes* 0)
                      (adaptive-log-swap! cur choice dgets dsets dhits dmisses
                                          (*ad-used-memory* core))
                      #t)
                    #f))))))))))

;; aura-pad M4 -- macro propose. A macro is a Soft lambda in a
;; std/hot-strategy slot that returns a recorded list of keys for the two
;; pads (story / scratch):
;;   (lambda () (list "replace-all:cat=dog" "switch:scratch" ... "yank"))
;; pd:macro is the trial slot, pd:mshadow the current main macro.
;; Soft gates the body (code words from hot.aura + helper.aura + below, and
;; kid-unkind words), probes the shape, races trial vs main on the story
;; goal (one fiber each), KEEPs only a strictly better score, else heal! +
;; DROP. pd:macro-undo! takes back the last KEEP with an honest re-score.
;; Needs buffer.aura, rules.aura, lines.aura, helper.aura, edit.aura, m4.aura.
;; Soft does not speak HTTP.

(define *macro-main-body* "")
(define *macro-seeded* 0)
(define *macro-base* 0)
(define *macro-trial* 0)
(define *macro-tag* "boot")
(define *macro-word* "")
(define *macro-why* "")
(define *macro-keeps* 0)
(define *macro-drops* 0)
(define *macro-history* (list))
(define *macro-undos* 0)

(define *macro-banned*
  (list "pd:macro" "pd:mshadow" "pad:mstamp" "pad:msim" "pad:law-race" "*m4-"))

;; First banned code word, or "".
(define (pd:macro-bad-word s)
  (let ((w (pd:helper-bad-word s)))
    (if (> (string-length w) 0)
        w
        (let loop ((ws *macro-banned*))
          (cond
            ((null? ws) "")
            ((string-contains? s (car ws)) (car ws))
            (#t (loop (cdr ws))))))))

;; Why a body is refused before any slot is touched: "" ok, "gate", "kind".
(define (pd:macro-body-why body)
  (cond
    ((not (string? body)) "gate")
    ((< (string-length body) 11) "gate")
    ((> (string-length body) 1999) "gate")
    ((not (string-prefix? body "(lambda")) "gate")
    ((> (string-length (pd:macro-bad-word body)) 0) "gate")
    ((> (string-length (pad:mean-word body)) 0) "kind")
    (#t "")))

(define (pd:macro-seed! body)
  (if (= *macro-seeded* 1)
      (list #t "seed")
      (let* ((src (string-append
                   "(define pd:macro " body ")\n"
                   "(define pd:mshadow " body ")\n"))
             (sc (try (set-code src) (catch (e) e))))
        (if (not (equal? sc #t))
            (list #f "seed")
            (begin
              (eval-current)
              (hot-strategy:register! "pd:macro" body)
              (set! *macro-main-body* body)
              (set! *macro-seeded* 1)
              (let ((p (try (pd:mshadow) (catch (e) #f))))
                (if (and (pad:plan-ok? p)
                         (pad:plan-ok? (try (pd:macro) (catch (e) #f))))
                    (begin
                      (set! *main-name* "pd:mshadow")
                      (set! *main-score* (pad:mscore-plan p))
                      (display "MAIN macro start=")
                      (display (pad:nstr *main-score*))
                      (display " law=")
                      (display (pad:law-str *m4-law*))
                      (newline)
                      (pad:mstamp! p "pd:mshadow")
                      (list #t "seed"))
                    (list #f "probe"))))))))

(define (pd:macro-sync!)
  (hot-strategy:swap! "pd:mshadow" *macro-main-body* "macro-shadow")
  (hot-strategy:swap! "pd:macro" *macro-main-body* "macro-choose")
  *macro-main-body*)

(define (pd:macro-out! tag)
  (set! *macro-tag* tag)
  (display "PROPOSE kind=macro tag=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  (list (string=? tag "macro_keep") tag))

(define (pd:macro-race! clean)
  (let* ((base-plan (pd:mshadow))
         (trial-plan (pd:macro))
         (pair (pad:race-thunks!
                (lambda () (pad:mscore-plan base-plan))
                (lambda () (pad:mscore-plan trial-plan))))
         (base (car pair))
         (trial (car (cdr pair))))
    (set! *macro-base* base)
    (set! *macro-trial* trial)
    (let ((audit (pad:msim trial-plan *m4-law* "pd:macro" 1)))
      (if (> (pad:m-rej audit) 4)
          (begin
            (display "REJECTS kind=macro total=")
            (display (number->string (pad:m-rej audit)))
            (display " shown=4")
            (newline))))
    (display "RACE macro base=")
    (display (pad:nstr base))
    (display " trial=")
    (display (pad:nstr trial))
    (newline)
    (if (> trial base)
        (begin
          (set! *macro-history*
                (pad:take *history-max*
                          (cons (list *macro-main-body* base) *macro-history*)))
          (set! *macro-main-body* clean)
          (set! *main-score* trial)
          (set! *main-name* "pd:macro")
          (set! *keep-reason* "higher-score-stamp")
          (set! *macro-keeps* (+ *macro-keeps* 1))
          (display "KEEP kind=macro reason=higher-score-stamp score=")
          (display (pad:nstr trial))
          (display " say=\"the new macro wins, ")
          (display (pad:nstr trial))
          (display " beats ")
          (display (pad:nstr base))
          (display "\"")
          (newline)
          (pad:mstamp! trial-plan "pd:macro")
          (pd:macro-out! "macro_keep"))
        (begin
          (hot-strategy:heal!)
          (set! *drop-reason* (if (= trial base)
                                  "tie-is-not-better-rollback"
                                  "lower-score-rollback"))
          (set! *macro-drops* (+ *macro-drops* 1))
          (display "HEAL name=pd:macro reason=score")
          (newline)
          (display "DROP kind=macro reason=")
          (display *drop-reason*)
          (display " score=")
          (display (pad:nstr trial))
          (display (if (= trial base)
                       " say=\"same score, we keep the old macro\""
                       " say=\"the old macro is better, we keep it\""))
          (newline)
          (pd:macro-out! "macro_drop")))))

(define (pd:macro-propose-body! body)
  (let* ((clean (pd:clean body))
         (why (pd:macro-body-why clean)))
    (set! *macro-word* "")
    (set! *macro-why* "")
    (cond
      ((string=? why "gate")
       (set! *macro-word* (pd:macro-bad-word clean))
       (pd:gate-reject! "gate" *macro-word*)
       (pd:macro-out! "macro_reject"))
      ((string=? why "kind")
       (set! *macro-word* (pad:mean-word clean))
       (display "GATE reject reason=kind word=")
       (display *macro-word*)
       (display " say=\"")
       (display (pad:kid-say "not-kind"))
       (display "\"")
       (newline)
       (pd:macro-out! "macro_reject"))
      (#t
       (let ((sw (hot-strategy:swap! "pd:macro" clean "macro-propose")))
         (if (not (and (pair? sw) (equal? (car sw) #t)))
             (begin
               (pd:gate-reject! "swap" "")
               (pd:macro-out! "macro_reject"))
             (let ((pwhy (pad:plan-check (try (pd:macro) (catch (e) #f)))))
               (if (not (string=? pwhy "ok"))
                   (begin
                     (set! *macro-why* pwhy)
                     (hot-strategy:heal!)
                     (display "HEAL name=pd:macro reason=probe why=")
                     (display pwhy)
                     (newline)
                     (pd:macro-out! "macro_heal"))
                   (begin
                     (display "SWAP name=pd:macro reason=propose")
                     (newline)
                     (pd:macro-race! clean))))))))))

(define (pd:macro-propose-file! path)
  (pd:macro-sync!)
  (display "PROPOSE kind=macro file=")
  (display path)
  (newline)
  (let ((body (try (read-file path) (catch (e) #f))))
    (if (not (string? body))
        (begin
          (pd:gate-reject! "read" "")
          (pd:macro-out! "macro_reject"))
        (pd:macro-propose-body! body))))

;; Take back the last KEEP: the replaced main macro comes back, both slots
;; point at it, it is re-played and re-scored (must equal the recorded
;; score, else UNDO_FAIL). Nothing kept -> REJECT nothing-to-undo.
(define (pd:macro-undo!)
  (if (null? *macro-history*)
      (begin
        (display "REJECT mid=4 reason=nothing-to-undo cmd=macro-undo slot=")
        (display *main-name*)
        (display " say=\"")
        (display (pad:kid-say "nothing-to-undo"))
        (display "\"")
        (newline)
        (list #f "macro_undo_reject"))
      (let* ((top (car *macro-history*))
             (body (car top))
             (want (car (cdr top)))
             (from *main-score*))
        (set! *macro-history* (cdr *macro-history*))
        (set! *macro-main-body* body)
        (pd:macro-sync!)
        (let* ((p (try (pd:mshadow) (catch (e) #f)))
               (got (pad:mscore-plan p)))
          (set! *main-score* got)
          (set! *main-name* "pd:mshadow")
          (set! *macro-undos* (+ *macro-undos* 1))
          (display "UNDO kind=macro from=")
          (display (pad:nstr from))
          (display " to=")
          (display (pad:nstr got))
          (display " want=")
          (display (pad:nstr want))
          (display " left=")
          (display (number->string (length *macro-history*)))
          (display " say=\"took back the last keep\"")
          (newline)
          (pad:mstamp! p "pd:mshadow")
          (if (= got want)
              (list #t "macro_undo")
              (begin
                (display "UNDO_FAIL rescore\n")
                (list #f "macro_undo_fail")))))))

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft side of the thin C viewport ("加c").
;; Soft owns the editor state, the HL tape, jump marks and the kid words.
;; This file only *packs* what Soft already decided into a blit-friendly
;; SNAP block. The C viewport (c/pad_view.c) maps letters to colors and
;; draws; it never tokenizes, gates, edits or picks words.
;;
;; Wire (one block; a stream may carry many, last complete one wins):
;;   SNAP v1 pad
;;   TITLE <words>
;;   CURSOR line=<l> col=<c>
;;   SAY <kid words>
;;   LEGEND <L>=<word> ...
;;   ROWS n=<k>
;;   T <row text>      \
;;   H <HL tape>        > k times; |T| = |H| = |M|
;;   M <mark tape>     /
;;   END
;; HL letters (from hl.aura): P K S T C Q M N .
;; Mark letters: d = name is born here (def), r = name used here, . none.
;; Needs buffer.aura, hl.aura, jump.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *view-legend*
  "K=magic-word S=name T=quote C=note N=number P=paren Q=ask M=change d=born-here r=used-here")

;; Split on newline (char 10). "a\nb\n" -> ("a" "b" "").
(define (pad:v-split s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (start 0) (acc (list)))
      (cond
        ((>= i n) (reverse (cons (substring s start n) acc)))
        ((= (string-ref s i) 10)
         (loop (+ i 1) (+ i 1) (cons (substring s start i) acc)))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) start acc))))))

;; Editor lines (lists of char codes) <-> source string.
(define (pad:v-codes s) (map char->integer (string->list s)))
(define (pad:v-lines src) (map pad:v-codes (pad:v-split src)))
(define (pad:v-src L)
  (string-join (map (lambda (ln) (list->string (map integer->char ln))) L)
               "\n"))

;; Char offset of (line, col) in the joined source.
(define (pad:v-point L l col)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs L) (off 0))
    (if (or (null? xs) (>= i l))
        (+ off col)
        (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (+ off (+ (length (car xs)) 1))))))

;; Mark tape for the name under point: d at defs, r at other uses.
;; Same length as src; all "." when point is not on a name.
(define (pad:v-fill-span cs a k ch)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs cs) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
      ((and (>= i a) (< i (+ a k))) (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons ch acc)))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc))))))

(define (pad:v-in? x xs)
  (cond ((null? xs) #f) ((= x (car xs)) #t) (#t (pad:v-in? x (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:v-marks src point)
  (let* ((n (string-length src))
         (blank (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (>= i n) acc (loop (+ i 1) (cons #\. acc)))))
         (name (pad:sym-at src point)))
    (if (string=? name "")

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft side of the thin C viewport ("加c").
;; Soft owns the editor state, the HL tape, jump marks and the kid words.
;; This file only *packs* what Soft already decided into a blit-friendly
;; SNAP block. The C viewport (c/pad_view.c) maps letters to colors and
;; draws; it never tokenizes, gates, edits or picks words.
;;
;; Hot path: pad:snap-text tokenizes ONCE (pad:hl-bundle), builds the
;; color tape and def/use marks from the same toks — no full re-HL per
;; mark helper. Optional DIRTY line=<csv> when the caller knows which
;; rows changed (C may redraw only those; full rows still sent).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *view-legend*
  "K=magic-word S=name T=quote C=note N=number P=paren Q=ask M=change d=born-here r=used-here")

;; Split on newline (char 10). "a\nb\n" -> ("a" "b" "").
(define (pad:v-split s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (start 0) (acc (list)))
      (cond
        ((>= i n) (reverse (cons (substring s start n) acc)))
        ((= (string-ref s i) 10)
         (loop (+ i 1) (+ i 1) (cons (substring s start i) acc)))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) start acc))))))

;; Editor lines (lists of char codes) <-> source string.
(define (pad:v-codes s) (map char->integer (string->list s)))
(define (pad:v-lines src) (map pad:v-codes (pad:v-split src)))
(define (pad:v-src L)
  (string-join (map (lambda (ln) (list->string (map integer->char ln))) L)
               "\n"))

;; Char offset of (line, col) in the joined source.
(define (pad:v-point L l col)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs L) (off 0))
    (if (or (null? xs) (>= i l))
        (+ off col)
        (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (+ off (+ (length (car xs)) 1))))))

;; Mark tape helpers (reuse toks — no second/third tokenize).
(define (pad:v-fill-span cs a k ch)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs cs) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
      ((and (>= i a) (< i (+ a k))) (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons ch acc)))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc))))))

(define (pad:v-in? x xs)
  (cond ((null? xs) #f) ((= x (car xs)) #t) (#t (pad:v-in? x (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:v-marks-in src point toks)
  (let* ((n (string-length src))
         (blank (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (>= i n) acc (loop (+ i 1) (cons #\. acc)))))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks point)))
    (if (string=? name "")
        (list->string blank)
        (let* ((k (string-length name))
               (defs (pad:find-defs-in toks name))
               (refs (pad:find-refs-in toks name)))
          (let loop ((rs refs) (cs blank))
            (if (null? rs)
                (list->string cs)
                (loop (cdr rs)
                      (pad:v-fill-span cs (car rs) k
                                       (if (pad:v-in? (car rs) defs)
                                           #\d #\r)))))))))

(define (pad:v-marks src point)
  (pad:v-marks-in src point (pad:hl-tokens src)))

;; Row block: T/H/M for each line, sliced from whole-source tapes.
(define (pad:v-rows lines tape marks)
  (let loop ((xs lines) (off 0) (acc ""))
    (if (null? xs)
        acc
        (let* ((s (car xs))
               (k (string-length s))
               (e (+ off k)))
          (loop (cdr xs)
                (+ e 1)
                (string-append acc
                               "T " s "\n"
                               "H " (substring tape off e) "\n"
                               "M " (substring marks off e) "\n"))))))

;; DIRTY csv of 0-based row indexes, or "" if unknown / all dirty.
;; One Soft call for any row count (a named-let step is ~0.01 ms, a
;; recursive call ~0.3 ms with the pad loaded: opening a string dirties
;; every row below it).
(define (pad:v-dirty-csv xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      ""
      (let csv ((ys (cdr xs)) (acc (list (number->string (car xs)))))
        (if (null? ys)
            (apply string-append (reverse acc))
            (csv (cdr ys) (cons (number->string (car ys)) (cons "," acc)))))))

;; The whole SNAP block. Tokenize once; optional dirty row list.
(define (pad:snap-text title L l col say)
  (pad:snap-text-dirty title L l col say (list)))

(define (pad:snap-text-dirty title L l col say dirty)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (b (pad:hl-bundle src))
         (tape (car b))
         (toks (cadr b))
         (marks (pad:v-marks-in src (pad:v-point L l col) toks))
         (lines (pad:v-split src))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " say "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines tape marks)
      "END\n")))

;; Emit on stdout (stream protocol) and/or write to a file.
(define (pad:snap-emit! text) (display text) text)
(define (pad:snap-write! path text) (write-file path text) text)

;; Char offset -> (line col) in editor lines L (inverse of pad:v-point).
;; Clamped: a stale offset past the end lands on the last line's end, so a
;; jump-back after an edit never hands the viewport an out-of-range cursor.
(define (pad:v-linecol L point)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs L) (off (if (< point 0) 0 point)))
    (let ((len (length (car xs))))
      (cond
        ((<= off len) (list i off))
        ((null? (cdr xs)) (list i len))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (- off (+ len 1))))))))

  (try

      (eval-current)
      "ok")
    (catch (e) "load-fail")))

(define (pad:q-find name)
  (try
    (query :find name)
    (catch (e) (list))))

(define (pad:q-defuse name)
  (try
    (query :def-use name)
    (catch (e) (list))))

(define (pad:q-defines)
  (try
    (query:defines)
    (catch (e) (list))))

(define (pad:q-find-by-name name)
  (try
    (query:find-by-name name)
    (catch (e) (list))))

;; --- mutate observability (safe defaults on empty workspace) ---
(define (pad:m-summary) (mutate:summary))
(define (pad:m-safe?) (mutate:boundary-safe?))
(define (pad:m-depth) (mutate:boundary-depth))
(define (pad:m-quota?) (mutate:quota-ok?))
(define (pad:m-snapshot) (mutate:safety-snapshot))
(define (pad:m-rolled?) (mutate:rolled-back?))

;; Honest mutation: name + new lambda source string.
;; Returns #t / #f / or kid reason on catch.
(define (pad:m-rebind! name code reason)
  (try
    (mutate:rebind name code reason)
    (catch (e) #f)))

;; alist helper: get value for key string like ":total"
(define (pad:alist-get alist key)
  (cond
    ((null? alist) #f)
    ((and (pair? (car alist)) (string=? (car (car alist)) key))
     (cdr (car alist)))
    (#t (pad:alist-get (cdr alist) key))))

(define (pad:q-cats-str)
  (let loop ((xs (pad:q-categories)) (out ""))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) out)
      ((string=? out "") (loop (cdr xs) (car xs)))
      (#t (loop (cdr xs) (string-append out "." (car xs)))))))

  (let ((load-r (pad:q-load! src)))
    (display "QUERY load=")
    (display load-r)

    (newline)
    load-r))

  (let* ((ids (pad:q-find name))

    (display (length ids))
    (display " defuse_len=")
    (display (length du))
    (newline)
    ids))

(define (pad:mutate-line!)
  (let ((s (pad:m-summary)))
    (display "MUTATE total=")
    (display (pad:nstr (pad:alist-get s ":total")))
    (display " committed=")
    (display (pad:nstr (pad:alist-get s ":committed")))
    (display " rolled=")
    (display (pad:nstr (pad:alist-get s ":rolled-back")))
    (display " safe=")
    (display (if (pad:m-safe?) "yes" "no"))
    (display " depth=")
    (display (pad:nstr (pad:m-depth)))
    (display " quota=")
    (display (if (pad:m-quota?) "yes" "no"))

  (list "define-lookup" "query:code" "query:ref-counts" "query:node-types"))

(define (pad:q-gap? name)
  (let loop ((xs *pad-q-gaps*))
    (cond

  (display "GAPS ")
  (let loop ((xs *pad-q-gaps*) (first 1))
    (if (null? xs)
        (newline)
        (begin
          (if (= first 0) (display "."))
          (display (car xs))
          (loop (cdr xs) 0))))
  0)
