input.source:
;; aura-pad -- a first slice of emacs, on top of the vi map.
;; Loaded after vi.aura and file.aura. The modeless keymap is untouched:
;; these commands run only when *vi-on* is true (aura-pad sets PAD_VI=1).
;;
;;   M-x find-file / ff     open a file (a partial name is enough)
;;   M-x search / isearch   find text; ctrl-s finds the next one
;;   M-x list-buffers       every open buffer
;;   M-x switch-buffer      jump to one of them
;;   ctrl-x ctrl-f / ctrl-b / b   the same three, from the ctrl-x prefix
;;   ctrl-g                 cancel. A search goes back to where it started.
;;   alt-f / alt-b / alt-d  the next word, the previous word, delete the
;;                          word. One read must hold Esc and the letter.
;;
;; An empty M-x line still runs the page (pad:vi-colon! keeps that).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372). No
;; named let that closes over an outer local (aura#4353).

(define *em-io*
  (try (begin (require "std/io") #t) (catch (e) #f)))

(define *em-bufs* (list))
(define *em-cur* "")
(define *em-from* 0)
(define *em-hit* #f)

;; --- buffers ----------------------------------------------------------
;; A record is (path name src line col saved ro nl new). *em-cur* is the
;; path on screen. Other buffers keep the copy we stashed on the way out.

(define (pad:em-rec)
  (list *pf-path* *pf-name* (pad:play-src)
        (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
        *pf-saved* *pf-ro* *pf-nl* *pf-new*))

(define (pad:em-put path rec bufs)
  (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs (list)))

(define (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) (reverse (cons rec acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons rec (cdr bufs))))
    (#t (pad:em-put-acc path rec (cdr bufs) (cons (car bufs) acc)))))

(define (pad:em-get path bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path) (car bufs))
    (#t (pad:em-get path (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:em-stash!)
  (if *pf-on*
      (begin
        (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
        (set! *em-bufs* (pad:em-put *pf-path* (pad:em-rec) *em-bufs*)))
      0))

;; First dirty buffer that is not the one on screen. "" if every other
;; buffer is saved. Does not read *pf-path*: :q runs before file.aura.
(define (pad:em-dirty-walk xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((and (not (string=? (car (car xs)) *em-cur*))
          (not (string=? (list-ref (car xs) 2) (list-ref (car xs) 5))))
     (list-ref (car xs) 1))
    (#t (pad:em-dirty-walk (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:em-other-dirty) (pad:em-dirty-walk *em-bufs*))

(define (pad:em-after-open!)
  (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
  (if *vi-on* (pad:vi-title!) 0)
  (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
  (set! *em-files* #t)
  (set! *vw-top* 0)
  (set! *vw-left* 0)
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (pad:em-stash!)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-load! rec)
  (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *pf-on* #t)
  (set! *pf-path* (list-ref rec 0))
  (set! *pf-name* (list-ref rec 1))
  (set! *pf-saved* (list-ref rec 5))
  (set! *pf-ro* (list-ref rec 6))
  (set! *pf-nl* (list-ref rec 7))
  (set! *pf-new* (list-ref rec 8))
  (set! *pf-cx* #f)
  (set! *pf-quit* #f)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines (list-ref rec 2))
                           (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4)))
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " *pf-name*
                                  (if *pf-ro* " (look only)" "")))
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append "opened " *pf-name*))
  (pad:em-after-open!))

(define (pad:em-open! path)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((old (pad:em-get path *em-bufs*)))
    (if (and old (not (string=? (list-ref old 2) (list-ref old 5))))
        (pad:em-load! old)
        (begin
          (pad:pf-open! path)
          (pad:em-after-open!)))))

;; --- file names -------------------------------------------------------

(define (pad:em-low c)
  (if (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90)) (+ c 32) c))

(define (pad:em-slash-at p i at)
  (let ((j (string-index p "/" i)))
    (if (< j 0) at (pad:em-slash-at p (+ j 1) j))))

(define (pad:em-dir)
  (if (and *pf-on* (> (string-length *pf-path*) 0))
      (let ((j (pad:em-slash-at *pf-path* 0 -1)))
        (cond ((< j 0) ".") ((= j 0) "/") (#t (substring *pf-path* 0 j))))
      (let ((p (getenv "PWD")))
        (if (and (string? p) (> (string-length p) 0)) p "."))))

(define (pad:em-join dir name)
  (cond
    ((string=? name "") dir)
    ((= (string-ref name 0) 47) name)
    ((string=? dir "/") (string-append "/" name))
    (#t (string-append dir "/" name))))

(define (pad:em-sub-rest src q i qi n qn)
  (cond
    ((>= qi qn) #t)
    ((>= i n) #f)
    ((= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q qi)))
     (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) (+ qi 1) n qn))
    (#t (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) qi n qn))))

(define (pad:em-sub-at src q i n qn)
  (cond
    ((or (<= qn 0) (>= i n)) -1)
    ((and (= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q 0)))
          (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) 1 n qn))
     i)
    (#t (pad:em-sub-at src q (+ i 1) n qn))))

(define (pad:em-subseq? name q)
  (and (> (string-length q) 0)
       (<= (string-length name) 512)
       (>= (pad:em-sub-at name q 0 (string-length name) (string-length q)) 0)))

(define (pad:em-prefix? name q)
  (let ((qn (string-length q)) (nn (string-length name)))
    (and (> qn 0) (>= nn qn) (string=? (substring name 0 qn) q))))

;; exact, then a starting match, then a substring, then a sparse match.
(define (pad:em-rank name q)
  (cond
    ((string=? name q) 4)
    ((pad:em-prefix? name q) 3)
    ((>= (string-index name q 0) 0) 2)
    ((pad:em-subseq? name q) 1)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:em-better? r name best)
  (or (not best)
      (> r (car best))
      (and (= r (car best))
           (< (string-length name) (string-length (cadr best))))))

(define (pad:em-best names q best)
  (if (or (not (pair? names)) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let ((name (car names)))
        (if (not (string? name))
            (pad:em-best (cdr names) q best)
            (let ((r (pad:em-rank name q)))
              (pad:em-best (cdr names) q
                (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
                    best
                    (list r name))))))))

(define (pad:em-isdir? path)
  (and *em-io* (pair? (directory-list path))))

(define (pad:em-into-dir! path)
  (let ((p (if (and (> (string-length path) 0)
                    (= (string-ref path (- (string-length path) 1)) 47))
               path
               (string-append path "/"))))
    (set! *vi-op* "find")
    (set! *vi-line* p)
    (set! *vi-prompt* "Find file: ")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Find file: " p "  (directory)"))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)
  (let* ((dir (pad:em-dir))
         (names (if *em-io* (directory-list dir) (list)))
         (best (pad:em-best (if (pair? names) names (list)) typed #f)))
    (if (not best)
        (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do")
        (let ((full (pad:em-join dir (cadr best))))
          (let ((raw (read-file full)))
            (cond
              ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! full))
              ((pad:em-isdir? full) (pad:em-into-dir! full))
              (#t (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:em-open-typed! typed)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-find-start!)
      (let ((path (pad:em-join (pad:em-dir) typed)))
        (let ((raw (read-file path)))
          (cond
            ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! path))
            ((pad:em-isdir? path) (pad:em-into-dir! path))
            (#t (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)))))))

(define (pad:em-names xs acc)
  (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (pad:em-names (cdr xs)
        (if (string=? acc "")
            (list-ref (car xs) 1)
            (string-append acc " " (list-ref (car xs) 1))))))

(define (pad:em-list!)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((names (pad:em-names *em-bufs* "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (if (string=? names "")
              "no buffers yet"
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "buffers: " names))))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-best-buf xs q best)
  (if (or (null? xs) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let* ((name (list-ref (car xs) 1))
             (r (pad:em-rank name q)))
        (pad:em-best-buf (cdr xs) q
          (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
              best
              (list r name (car (car xs))))))))

(define (pad:em-switch! typed)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-buf-start!)
      (let ((best (pad:em-best-buf *em-bufs* typed #f)))
        (if (not best)
            (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no buffer " typed)) "vi-do")
            (pad:em-open! (list-ref best 2))))))

;; --- text search ------------------------------------------------------
;; Typing always restarts at the anchor, so one more letter cannot jump
;; to a later, worse hit. ctrl-s moves the anchor to just after this hit.

(define (pad:em-search-start!)
  (set! *em-anchor* (list (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)))
  (set! *em-from* (pad:play-point))
  (set! *em-hit* #f)
  (set! *vi-op* "s")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* "Search: ")
  (set! *pl-say* "Search: ")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-hit-at src q from)
  (let* ((n (if (string? src) (string-length src) 0))
         (i (if (and (> (string-length q) 0) (>= from 0) (< from n))
                (string-index src q from)
                -1)))
    (if (>= i 0)
        i
        (if (or (<= n 0) (> n 1024) (>= from n))
            -1
            (pad:em-sub-at src q (if (< from 0) 0 from) n (string-length q))))))

(define (pad:em-search-from! from wrapped)
  (let ((hit (pad:em-hit-at (pad:play-src) *vi-line* from)))
    (cond
      ((>= hit 0)
       (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (car *pl-st*) hit)))
         (set! *em-hit* hit)
         (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (car lc) (cadr lc)
                             (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
         (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Search: " *vi-line*))
         "vi-do"))
      ((and (not wrapped) (> from 0))
       (pad:em-search-from! 0 #t))
      (#t
       (set! *em-hit* #f)
       (set! *pl-say* "no match")
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-search-now!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f)))

(define (pad:em-search-next!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (begin
        (set! *em-from* (if (number? *em-hit*) (+ *em-hit* 1) (+ *em-from* 1)))
        (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f))))

(define (pad:em-enter!)
  (cond
    ((string=? *vi-op* "find")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-open-typed! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "buf")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-switch! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "s")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (set! *vi-line* "")
     (set! *em-anchor* #f)
     (if (string=? *pl-say* "no match")
         "vi-do"
         (begin (set! *pl-say* "found") "vi-do")))
    (#t (pad:vi-colon!))))

(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "find-file") (string=? w "ff"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-open-typed! rest) (pad:em-find-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "switch-buffer") (string=? w "buffer"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-switch! rest) (pad:em-buf-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "list-buffers") (string=? w "buffers"))
     (pad:em-list!))
    ((or (string=? w "search") (string=? w "isearch"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0)
         (begin (pad:em-search-start!) (set! *vi-line* rest) (pad:em-search-now!))
         (pad:em-search-start!)))
    (#t (if mx #f #f))))

;; --- words ------------------------------------------------------------
;; A word is a run of letters that are not spaces. alt-f lands just
;; after it; at the end of a line it continues once onto the next line.

(define (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col crossed)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i1 (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln col len))
         (i2 (pad:vi-skip-word ln i1 len)))
    (cond
      ((< i2 len) (list l i2))
      ((and (= i2 i1) (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      ((> i2 col) (list l i2))
      ((and (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      (#t #f))))

(define (pad:em-fwd!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st) #f)))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-kill-word!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col #f)))
    (if (or (not pos) (and (= (car pos) l) (= (cadr pos) col)))
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (let* ((l2 (car pos))
               (c2 (cadr pos))
               (kill (pad:region-text L l col l2 c2))
               (L2 (pad:region-delete L l col l2 c2))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted a word")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-meta! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-colon-start! #t))
    ((= b 102) (pad:em-fwd!))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-b!))
    ((= b 100) (pad:em-kill-word!))
    (#t "to-normal")))

target.name: pad:em-enter!
target.body:
(lambda () (cond
    ((string=? *vi-op* "find")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-open-typed! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "buf")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-switch! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "s")
     (let ((q *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (set! *em-anchor* #f)
       (if (> (string-length q) 0)
           (begin (set! *vi-pat* q) (set! *vi-pat-word* #f))
           0)
       (if (string=? *pl-say* "no match")
           "vi-do"
           (begin (set! *pl-say* "found") "vi-do"))))
    (#t (pad:vi-colon!))))

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- a first slice of emacs, on top of the vi map.
;; Loaded after vi.aura and file.aura. The modeless keymap is untouched:
;; these commands run only when *vi-on* is true (aura-pad sets PAD_VI=1).
;;
;;   M-x find-file / ff     open a file (a partial name is enough)
;;   M-x search / isearch   find text; ctrl-s finds the next one
;;   M-x list-buffers       every open buffer
;;   M-x switch-buffer      jump to one of them
;;   ctrl-x ctrl-f / ctrl-b / b   the same three, from the ctrl-x prefix
;;   ctrl-g                 cancel. A search goes back to where it started.
;;   alt-f / alt-b / alt-d  the next word, the previous word, delete the
;;                          word. One read must hold Esc and the letter.
;;
;; An empty M-x line still runs the page (pad:vi-colon! keeps that).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372). No
;; named let that closes over an outer local (aura#4353).

(define *em-io*
  (try (begin (require "std/io") #t) (catch (e) #f)))

(define *em-bufs* (list))
(define *em-cur* "")
(define *em-from* 0)
(define *em-hit* #f)

;; --- buffers ----------------------------------------------------------
;; A record is (path name src line col saved ro nl new). *em-cur* is the
;; path on screen. Other buffers keep the copy we stashed on the way out.

(define (pad:em-rec)
  (list *pf-path* *pf-name* (pad:play-src)
        (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
        *pf-saved* *pf-ro* *pf-nl* *pf-new*))

(define (pad:em-put path rec bufs)
  (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs (list)))

(define (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) (reverse (cons rec acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons rec (cdr bufs))))
    (#t (pad:em-put-acc path rec (cdr bufs) (cons (car bufs) acc)))))

(define (pad:em-get path bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path) (car bufs))
    (#t (pad:em-get path (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:em-stash!)
  (if *pf-on*
      (begin
        (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
        (set! *em-bufs* (pad:em-put *pf-path* (pad:em-rec) *em-bufs*)))
      0))

;; First dirty buffer that is not the one on screen. "" if every other
;; buffer is saved. Does not read *pf-path*: :q runs before file.aura.
(define (pad:em-dirty-walk xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((and (not (string=? (car (car xs)) *em-cur*))
          (not (string=? (list-ref (car xs) 2) (list-ref (car xs) 5))))
     (list-ref (car xs) 1))
    (#t (pad:em-dirty-walk (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:em-other-dirty) (pad:em-dirty-walk *em-bufs*))

(define (pad:em-after-open!)
  (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
  (if *vi-on* (pad:vi-title!) 0)
  (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
  (set! *em-files* #t)
  (set! *vw-top* 0)
  (set! *vw-left* 0)
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (pad:em-stash!)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-load! rec)
  (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *pf-on* #t)
  (set! *pf-path* (list-ref rec 0))
  (set! *pf-name* (list-ref rec 1))
  (set! *pf-saved* (list-ref rec 5))
  (set! *pf-ro* (list-ref rec 6))
  (set! *pf-nl* (list-ref rec 7))
  (set! *pf-new* (list-ref rec 8))
  (set! *pf-cx* #f)
  (set! *pf-quit* #f)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines (list-ref rec 2))
                           (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4)))
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " *pf-name*
                                  (if *pf-ro* " (look only)" "")))
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append "opened " *pf-name*))
  (pad:em-after-open!))

(define (pad:em-open! path)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((old (pad:em-get path *em-bufs*)))
    (if (and old (not (string=? (list-ref old 2) (list-ref old 5))))
        (pad:em-load! old)
        (begin
          (pad:pf-open! path)
          (pad:em-after-open!)))))

;; --- file names -------------------------------------------------------

(define (pad:em-low c)
  (if (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90)) (+ c 32) c))

(define (pad:em-slash-at p i at)
  (let ((j (string-index p "/" i)))
    (if (< j 0) at (pad:em-slash-at p (+ j 1) j))))

(define (pad:em-dir)
  (if (and *pf-on* (> (string-length *pf-path*) 0))
      (let ((j (pad:em-slash-at *pf-path* 0 -1)))
        (cond ((< j 0) ".") ((= j 0) "/") (#t (substring *pf-path* 0 j))))
      (let ((p (getenv "PWD")))
        (if (and (string? p) (> (string-length p) 0)) p "."))))

(define (pad:em-join dir name)
  (cond
    ((string=? name "") dir)
    ((= (string-ref name 0) 47) name)
    ((string=? dir "/") (string-append "/" name))
    (#t (string-append dir "/" name))))

(define (pad:em-sub-rest src q i qi n qn)
  (cond
    ((>= qi qn) #t)
    ((>= i n) #f)
    ((= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q qi)))
     (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) (+ qi 1) n qn))
    (#t (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) qi n qn))))

(define (pad:em-sub-at src q i n qn)
  (cond
    ((or (<= qn 0) (>= i n)) -1)
    ((and (= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q 0)))
          (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) 1 n qn))
     i)
    (#t (pad:em-sub-at src q (+ i 1) n qn))))

(define (pad:em-subseq? name q)
  (and (> (string-length q) 0)
       (<= (string-length name) 512)
       (>= (pad:em-sub-at name q 0 (string-length name) (string-length q)) 0)))

(define (pad:em-prefix? name q)
  (let ((qn (string-length q)) (nn (string-length name)))
    (and (> qn 0) (>= nn qn) (string=? (substring name 0 qn) q))))

;; exact, then a starting match, then a substring, then a sparse match.
(define (pad:em-rank name q)
  (cond
    ((string=? name q) 4)
    ((pad:em-prefix? name q) 3)
    ((>= (string-index name q 0) 0) 2)
    ((pad:em-subseq? name q) 1)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:em-better? r name best)
  (or (not best)
      (> r (car best))
      (and (= r (car best))
           (< (string-length name) (string-length (cadr best))))))

(define (pad:em-best names q best)
  (if (or (not (pair? names)) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let ((name (car names)))
        (if (not (string? name))
            (pad:em-best (cdr names) q best)
            (let ((r (pad:em-rank name q)))
              (pad:em-best (cdr names) q
                (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
                    best
                    (list r name))))))))

(define (pad:em-isdir? path)
  (and *em-io* (pair? (directory-list path))))

(define (pad:em-into-dir! path)
  (let ((p (if (and (> (string-length path) 0)
                    (= (string-ref path (- (string-length path) 1)) 47))
               path
               (string-append path "/"))))
    (set! *vi-op* "find")
    (set! *vi-line* p)
    (set! *vi-prompt* "Find file: ")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Find file: " p "  (directory)"))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)
  (let* ((dir (pad:em-dir))
         (names (if *em-io* (directory-list dir) (list)))
         (best (pad:em-best (if (pair? names) names (list)) typed #f)))
    (if (not best)
        (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do")
        (let ((full (pad:em-join dir (cadr best))))
          (let ((raw (read-file full)))
            (cond
              ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! full))
              ((pad:em-isdir? full) (pad:em-into-dir! full))
              (#t (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:em-open-typed! typed)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-find-start!)
      (let ((path (pad:em-join (pad:em-dir) typed)))
        (let ((raw (read-file path)))
          (cond
            ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! path))
            ((pad:em-isdir? path) (pad:em-into-dir! path))
            (#t (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)))))))

(define (pad:em-names xs acc)
  (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (pad:em-names (cdr xs)
        (if (string=? acc "")
            (list-ref (car xs) 1)
            (string-append acc " " (list-ref (car xs) 1))))))

(define (pad:em-list!)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((names (pad:em-names *em-bufs* "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (if (string=? names "")
              "no buffers yet"
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "buffers: " names))))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-best-buf xs q best)
  (if (or (null? xs) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let* ((name (list-ref (car xs) 1))
             (r (pad:em-rank name q)))
        (pad:em-best-buf (cdr xs) q
          (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
              best
              (list r name (car (car xs))))))))

(define (pad:em-switch! typed)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-buf-start!)
      (let ((best (pad:em-best-buf *em-bufs* typed #f)))
        (if (not best)
            (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no buffer " typed)) "vi-do")
            (pad:em-open! (list-ref best 2))))))

;; --- text search ------------------------------------------------------
;; Typing always restarts at the anchor, so one more letter cannot jump
;; to a later, worse hit. ctrl-s moves the anchor to just after this hit.

(define (pad:em-search-start!)
  (set! *em-anchor* (list (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)))
  (set! *em-from* (pad:play-point))
  (set! *em-hit* #f)
  (set! *vi-op* "s")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* "Search: ")
  (set! *pl-say* "Search: ")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-hit-at src q from)
  (let* ((n (if (string? src) (string-length src) 0))
         (i (if (and (> (string-length q) 0) (>= from 0) (< from n))
                (string-index src q from)
                -1)))
    (if (>= i 0)
        i
        (if (or (<= n 0) (> n 1024) (>= from n))
            -1
            (pad:em-sub-at src q (if (< from 0) 0 from) n (string-length q))))))

(define (pad:em-search-from! from wrapped)
  (let ((hit (pad:em-hit-at (pad:play-src) *vi-line* from)))
    (cond
      ((>= hit 0)
       (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (car *pl-st*) hit)))
         (set! *em-hit* hit)
         (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (car lc) (cadr lc)
                             (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
         (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Search: " *vi-line*))
         "vi-do"))
      ((and (not wrapped) (> from 0))
       (pad:em-search-from! 0 #t))
      (#t
       (set! *em-hit* #f)
       (set! *pl-say* "no match")
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-search-now!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f)))

(define (pad:em-search-next!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (begin
        (set! *em-from* (if (number? *em-hit*) (+ *em-hit* 1) (+ *em-from* 1)))
        (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f))))

(define (pad:em-enter!)
  (cond
    ((string=? *vi-op* "find")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-open-typed! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "buf")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-switch! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "s")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (set! *vi-line* "")
     (set! *em-anchor* #f)
     (if (string=? *pl-say* "no match")
         "vi-do"
         (begin (set! *pl-say* "found") "vi-do")))
    (#t (pad:vi-colon!))))

(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "find-file") (string=? w "ff"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-open-typed! rest) (pad:em-find-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "switch-buffer") (string=? w "buffer"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-switch! rest) (pad:em-buf-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "list-buffers") (string=? w "buffers"))
     (pad:em-list!))
    ((or (string=? w "search") (string=? w "isearch"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0)
         (begin (pad:em-search-start!) (set! *vi-line* rest) (pad:em-search-now!))
         (pad:em-search-start!)))
    (#t (if mx #f #f))))

;; --- words ------------------------------------------------------------
;; A word is a run of letters that are not spaces. alt-f lands just
;; after it; at the end of a line it continues once onto the next line.

(define (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col crossed)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i1 (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln col len))
         (i2 (pad:vi-skip-word ln i1 len)))
    (cond
      ((< i2 len) (list l i2))
      ((and (= i2 i1) (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      ((> i2 col) (list l i2))
      ((and (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      (#t #f))))

(define (pad:em-fwd!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st) #f)))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-kill-word!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col #f)))
    (if (or (not pos) (and (= (car pos) l) (= (cadr pos) col)))
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (let* ((l2 (car pos))
               (c2 (cadr pos))
               (kill (pad:region-text L l col l2 c2))
               (L2 (pad:region-delete L l col l2 c2))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted a word")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-meta! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-colon-start! #t))
    ((= b 102) (pad:em-fwd!))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-b!))
    ((= b 100) (pad:em-kill-word!))
    (#t "to-normal")))

(lambda (b) (cond

    ((= b 102) (pad:em-fwd!))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-b!))
    ((= b 100) (pad:em-kill-word!))
    ((= b 60) "bob")
    ((= b 62) "eob")
    (#t "to-normal")))

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- a first slice of emacs, on top of the vi map.
;; Loaded after vi.aura and file.aura. The modeless keymap is untouched:
;; these commands run only when *vi-on* is true (aura-pad sets PAD_VI=1).
;;
;;   M-x find-file / ff     open a file (a partial name is enough)
;;   M-x search / isearch   find text; ctrl-s finds the next one
;;   M-x list-buffers       every open buffer
;;   M-x switch-buffer      jump to one of them
;;   ctrl-x ctrl-f / ctrl-b / b   the same three, from the ctrl-x prefix
;;   ctrl-g                 cancel. A search goes back to where it started.
;;   ctrl-r                 the previous match (n is the next one).
;;   alt-f / alt-b / alt-d  the next word, the previous word, delete the
;;                          word. One read must hold Esc and the letter.
;;   alt-< / alt->          top and bottom. One read holds Esc and the mark.
;;
;; An empty M-x line still runs the page (pad:vi-colon! keeps that).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372). No
;; named let that closes over an outer local (aura#4353).

(define *em-io*
  (try (begin (require "std/io") #t) (catch (e) #f)))

(define *em-bufs* (list))
(define *em-cur* "")
;; *em-from* and *em-hit* live in vi.aura so n / N and isearch share them.

;; --- buffers ----------------------------------------------------------
;; A record is (path name src line col saved ro nl new). *em-cur* is the
;; path on screen. Other buffers keep the copy we stashed on the way out.

(define (pad:em-rec)
  (list *pf-path* *pf-name* (pad:play-src)
        (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
        *pf-saved* *pf-ro* *pf-nl* *pf-new*))

(define (pad:em-put path rec bufs)
  (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs (list)))

(define (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) (reverse (cons rec acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons rec (cdr bufs))))
    (#t (pad:em-put-acc path rec (cdr bufs) (cons (car bufs) acc)))))

(define (pad:em-get path bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path) (car bufs))
    (#t (pad:em-get path (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:em-stash!)
  (if *pf-on*
      (begin
        (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
        (set! *em-bufs* (pad:em-put *pf-path* (pad:em-rec) *em-bufs*)))
      0))

;; First dirty buffer that is not the one on screen. "" if every other
;; buffer is saved. Does not read *pf-path*: :q runs before file.aura.
(define (pad:em-dirty-walk xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((and (not (string=? (car (car xs)) *em-cur*))
          (not (string=? (list-ref (car xs) 2) (list-ref (car xs) 5))))
     (list-ref (car xs) 1))
    (#t (pad:em-dirty-walk (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:em-other-dirty) (pad:em-dirty-walk *em-bufs*))

(define (pad:em-after-open!)
  (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
  (if *vi-on* (pad:vi-title!) 0)
  (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
  (set! *em-files* #t)
  (set! *vw-top* 0)
  (set! *vw-left* 0)
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (pad:em-stash!)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-load! rec)
  (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *pf-on* #t)
  (set! *pf-path* (list-ref rec 0))
  (set! *pf-name* (list-ref rec 1))
  (set! *pf-saved* (list-ref rec 5))
  (set! *pf-ro* (list-ref rec 6))
  (set! *pf-nl* (list-ref rec 7))
  (set! *pf-new* (list-ref rec 8))
  (set! *pf-cx* #f)
  (set! *pf-quit* #f)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines (list-ref rec 2))
                           (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4)))
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " *pf-name*
                                  (if *pf-ro* " (look only)" "")))
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append "opened " *pf-name*))
  (pad:em-after-open!))

(define (pad:em-open! path)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((old (pad:em-get path *em-bufs*)))
    (if (and old (not (string=? (list-ref old 2) (list-ref old 5))))
        (pad:em-load! old)
        (begin
          (pad:pf-open! path)
          (pad:em-after-open!)))))

;; --- file names -------------------------------------------------------

(define (pad:em-low c)
  (if (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90)) (+ c 32) c))

(define (pad:em-slash-at p i at)
  (let ((j (string-index p "/" i)))
    (if (< j 0) at (pad:em-slash-at p (+ j 1) j))))

(define (pad:em-dir)
  (if (and *pf-on* (> (string-length *pf-path*) 0))
      (let ((j (pad:em-slash-at *pf-path* 0 -1)))
        (cond ((< j 0) ".") ((= j 0) "/") (#t (substring *pf-path* 0 j))))
      (let ((p (getenv "PWD")))

(define (pad:em-join dir name)
  (cond
    ((string=? name "") dir)
    ((= (string-ref name 0) 47) name)
    ((string=? dir "/") (string-append "/" name))
    (#t (string-append dir "/" name))))

(define (pad:em-sub-rest src q i qi n qn)
  (cond
    ((>= qi qn) #t)
    ((>= i n) #f)
    ((= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q qi)))
     (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) (+ qi 1) n qn))
    (#t (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) qi n qn))))

(define (pad:em-sub-at src q i n qn)
  (cond
    ((or (<= qn 0) (>= i n)) -1)
    ((and (= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q 0)))
          (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) 1 n qn))
     i)
    (#t (pad:em-sub-at src q (+ i 1) n qn))))

(define (pad:em-subseq? name q)
  (and (> (string-length q) 0)
       (<= (string-length name) 512)
       (>= (pad:em-sub-at name q 0 (string-length name) (string-length q)) 0)))

(define (pad:em-prefix? name q)
  (let ((qn (string-length q)) (nn (string-length name)))
    (and (> qn 0) (>= nn qn) (string=? (substring name 0 qn) q))))

;; exact, then a starting match, then a substring, then a sparse match.
(define (pad:em-rank name q)
  (cond
    ((string=? name q) 4)
    ((pad:em-prefix? name q) 3)
    ((>= (string-index name q 0) 0) 2)
    ((pad:em-subseq? name q) 1)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:em-better? r name best)
  (or (not best)
      (> r (car best))
      (and (= r (car best))
           (< (string-length name) (string-length (cadr best))))))

(define (pad:em-best names q best)
  (if (or (not (pair? names)) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let ((name (car names)))
        (if (not (string? name))
            (pad:em-best (cdr names) q best)
            (let ((r (pad:em-rank name q)))
              (pad:em-best (cdr names) q
                (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
                    best
                    (list r name))))))))

(define (pad:em-isdir? path)
  (and *em-io* (pair? (directory-list path))))

(define (pad:em-into-dir! path)
  (let ((p (if (and (> (string-length path) 0)
                    (= (string-ref path (- (string-length path) 1)) 47))
               path
               (string-append path "/"))))
    (set! *vi-op* "find")
    (set! *vi-line* p)
    (set! *vi-prompt* "Find file: ")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Find file: " p "  (directory)"))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)
  (let* ((dir (pad:em-dir))
         (names (if *em-io* (directory-list dir) (list)))
         (best (pad:em-best (if (pair? names) names (list)) typed #f)))
    (if (not best)
        (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do")
        (let ((full (pad:em-join dir (cadr best))))
          (let ((raw (read-file full)))
            (cond
              ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! full))
              ((pad:em-isdir? full) (pad:em-into-dir! full))
              (#t (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:em-open-typed! typed)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-find-start!)
      (let ((path (pad:em-join (pad:em-dir) typed)))
        (let ((raw (read-file path)))
          (cond
            ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! path))
            ((pad:em-isdir? path) (pad:em-into-dir! path))
            (#t (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)))))))

(define (pad:em-names xs acc)
  (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (pad:em-names (cdr xs)
        (if (string=? acc "")
            (list-ref (car xs) 1)
            (string-append acc " " (list-ref (car xs) 1))))))

(define (pad:em-list!)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((names (pad:em-names *em-bufs* "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (if (string=? names "")
              "no buffers yet"
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "buffers: " names))))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-best-buf xs q best)
  (if (or (null? xs) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let* ((name (list-ref (car xs) 1))
             (r (pad:em-rank name q)))
        (pad:em-best-buf (cdr xs) q
          (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
              best
              (list r name (car (car xs))))))))

  (pad:em-stash!)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-buf-start!)
      (let ((best (pad:em-best-buf *em-bufs* typed #f)))
        (if (not best)
            (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no buffer " typed)) "vi-do")
            (pad:em-open! (list-ref best 2))))))

;; --- text search ------------------------------------------------------
;; Typing always restarts at the anchor, so one more letter cannot jump
;; to a later, worse hit. ctrl-s moves the anchor to just after this hit.

(define (pad:em-search-start!)
  (set! *em-anchor* (list (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)))
  (set! *em-from* (pad:play-point))
  (set! *em-hit* #f)
  (set! *vi-op* "s")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* "Search: ")
  (set! *pl-say* "Search: ")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-hit-at src q from)
  (let* ((n (if (string? src) (string-length src) 0))
         (i (if (and (> (string-length q) 0) (>= from 0) (< from n))
                (string-index src q from)
                -1)))
    (if (>= i 0)
        i
        (if (or (<= n 0) (> n 1024) (>= from n))
            -1
            (pad:em-sub-at src q (if (< from 0) 0 from) n (string-length q))))))

  (let ((hit (pad:em-hit-at (pad:play-src) *vi-line* from)))
    (cond
      ((>= hit 0)
       (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (car *pl-st*) hit)))
         (set! *em-hit* hit)
         (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (car lc) (cadr lc)
                             (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
         (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Search: " *vi-line*))
         "vi-do"))
      ((and (not wrapped) (> from 0))
       (pad:em-search-from! 0 #t))
      (#t
       (set! *em-hit* #f)
       (set! *pl-say* "no match")
       "vi-do"))))

      (pad:em-hint!)
      (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f)))

(define (pad:em-search-next!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (begin
        (set! *em-from* (if (number? *em-hit*) (+ *em-hit* 1) (+ *em-from* 1)))
        (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f))))

(define (pad:em-enter!)
  (cond
    ((string=? *vi-op* "find")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-open-typed! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "buf")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-switch! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "s")
     (let ((q *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (set! *em-anchor* #f)
       (if (> (string-length q) 0)
           (begin (set! *vi-pat* q) (set! *vi-pat-word* #f))
           0)
       (if (string=? *pl-say* "no match")
           "vi-do"
           (begin (set! *pl-say* "found") "vi-do"))))
    (#t (pad:vi-colon!))))

(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "find-file") (string=? w "ff"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-open-typed! rest) (pad:em-find-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "switch-buffer") (string=? w "buffer"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-switch! rest) (pad:em-buf-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "list-buffers") (string=? w "buffers"))
     (pad:em-list!))
    ((or (string=? w "search") (string=? w "isearch"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0)
         (begin (pad:em-search-start!) (set! *vi-line* rest) (pad:em-search-now!))
         (pad:em-search-start!)))
    (#t (if mx #f #f))))

;; --- words ------------------------------------------------------------
;; A word is a run of letters that are not spaces. alt-f lands just
;; after it; at the end of a line it continues once onto the next line.

(define (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col crossed)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i1 (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln col len))
         (i2 (pad:vi-skip-word ln i1 len)))
    (cond
      ((< i2 len) (list l i2))
      ((and (= i2 i1) (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      ((> i2 col) (list l i2))
      ((and (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      (#t #f))))

(define (pad:em-fwd!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st) #f)))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-kill-word!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col #f)))
    (if (or (not pos) (and (= (car pos) l) (= (cadr pos) col)))
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (let* ((l2 (car pos))
               (c2 (cadr pos))
               (kill (pad:region-text L l col l2 c2))
               (L2 (pad:region-delete L l col l2 c2))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted a word")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-meta! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-colon-start! #t))
    ((= b 102) (pad:em-fwd!))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-b!))
    ((= b 100) (pad:em-kill-word!))
    ((= b 60) "bob")
    ((= b 62) "eob")
    (#t "to-normal")))

(if (or (string=? w "list-buffers") (string=? w "buffers")) (pad:em-list!) (if (or (string=? w "search") (string=? w "isearch")) (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (begin (pad:em-search-start!) (set! *vi-line* rest) (pad:em-search-now!)) (pad:em-search-start!)) (if mx #f #f))))))) (define pad:em-fwd-pos (lambda (L l col crossed) (let ((n (length L))) (let ((ln (list-ref L l))) (let ((len (length ln))) (let ((i1 (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln col len))) (let ((i2 (pad:vi-skip-word ln i1 len))) (if (< i2 len) (list l i2) (if (and (= i2 i1) (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed)) (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t) (if (> i2 col) (list l i2) (if (and (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed)) (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t) #f))))))))))) (define pad:em-fwd! (lambda () (let ((st *pl-st*)) (let ((pos (pad:em-fwd-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st) #f))) (if (not pos) (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do") (begin (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))) (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*) "vi-do")))))) (define pad:em-kill-word! (lambda () (let ((st *pl-st*)) (let ((L (car st))) (let ((l (cadr st))) (let ((col (caddr st))) (let ((pos (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col #f))) (if (or (not pos) (and (= (car pos) l) (= (cadr pos) col))) (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do") (let ((l2 (car pos))) (let ((c2 (cadr pos))) (let ((kill (pad:region-text L l col l2 c2))) (let ((L2 (pad:region-delete L l col l2 c2))) (let ((U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5))))) (begin (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col kill (list) U)) (pad:play-ok! input.source:
;; aura-pad -- a first slice of emacs, on top of the vi map.
;; Loaded after vi.aura and file.aura. The modeless keymap is untouched:
;; these commands run only when *vi-on* is true (aura-pad sets PAD_VI=1).
;;
;;   M-x find-file / ff     open a file (a partial name is enough)
;;   M-x search / isearch   find text; ctrl-s finds the next one
;;   M-x list-buffers       every open buffer
;;   M-x switch-buffer      jump to one of them
;;   ctrl-x ctrl-f / ctrl-b / b   the same three, from the ctrl-x prefix
;;   ctrl-g                 cancel. A search goes back to where it started.
;;   M-x ask / chat / rewrite   talk to DeepSeek v4.1 flash (ai.aura)
;;   ctrl-r                 the previous match (n is the next one).
;;   alt-f / alt-b / alt-d  the next word, the previous word, delete the
;;                          word. One read must hold Esc and the letter.
;;   alt-< / alt->          top and bottom. One read holds Esc and the mark.
;;
;; An empty M-x line still runs the page (pad:vi-colon! keeps that).
;; Tab completes the first word (pad:em-complete!). Space lists the
;; matches and types a space (pad:em-cands!). It does not grow the
;; word. A space after that word is the argument.
;; Short aliases (ff, q, w) are not in the completion table; enter
;; still accepts them.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372). No
;; named let that closes over an outer local (aura#4353).

(define *em-io*
  (try (begin (require "std/io") #t) (catch (e) #f)))

(define *em-bufs* (list))
(define *em-cur* "")
;; *em-from* and *em-hit* live in vi.aura so n / N and isearch share them.

;; --- buffers ----------------------------------------------------------
;; A record is (path name src line col saved ro nl new). *em-cur* is the
;; path on screen. Other buffers keep the copy we stashed on the way out.

(define (pad:em-rec)
  (list *pf-path* *pf-name* (pad:play-src)
        (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
        *pf-saved* *pf-ro* *pf-nl* *pf-new*))

(define (pad:em-put path rec bufs)
  (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs (list)))

(define (pad:em-put-acc path rec bufs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) (reverse (cons rec acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons rec (cdr bufs))))
    (#t (pad:em-put-acc path rec (cdr bufs) (cons (car bufs) acc)))))

(define (pad:em-get path bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car bufs)) path) (car bufs))
    (#t (pad:em-get path (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:em-stash!)
  (if *pf-on*
      (begin
        (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
        (set! *em-bufs* (pad:em-put *pf-path* (pad:em-rec) *em-bufs*)))
      0))

;; First dirty buffer that is not the one on screen. "" if every other
;; buffer is saved. Does not read *pf-path*: :q runs before file.aura.
(define (pad:em-dirty-walk xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((and (not (string=? (car (car xs)) *em-cur*))
          (not (string=? (list-ref (car xs) 2) (list-ref (car xs) 5))))
     (list-ref (car xs) 1))
    (#t (pad:em-dirty-walk (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:em-other-dirty) (pad:em-dirty-walk *em-bufs*))

(define (pad:em-after-open!)
  (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
  (if *vi-on* (pad:vi-title!) 0)
  (set! *em-cur* *pf-path*)
  (set! *em-files* #t)
  (set! *vw-top* 0)
  (set! *vw-left* 0)
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (pad:em-stash!)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-load! rec)
  (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *max-col* *pf-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
  (set! *pf-on* #t)
  (set! *pf-path* (list-ref rec 0))
  (set! *pf-name* (list-ref rec 1))
  (set! *pf-saved* (list-ref rec 5))
  (set! *pf-ro* (list-ref rec 6))
  (set! *pf-nl* (list-ref rec 7))
  (set! *pf-new* (list-ref rec 8))
  (set! *pf-cx* #f)
  (set! *pf-quit* #f)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines (list-ref rec 2))
                           (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4)))
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " *pf-name*
                                  (if *pf-ro* " (look only)" "")))
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append "opened " *pf-name*))
  (pad:em-after-open!))

(define (pad:em-open! path)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((old (pad:em-get path *em-bufs*)))
    (if (and old (not (string=? (list-ref old 2) (list-ref old 5))))
        (pad:em-load! old)
        (begin
          (pad:pf-open! path)
          (pad:em-after-open!)))))

;; --- file names -------------------------------------------------------

(define (pad:em-low c)
  (if (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90)) (+ c 32) c))

(define (pad:em-slash-at p i at)
  (let ((j (string-index p "/" i)))
    (if (< j 0) at (pad:em-slash-at p (+ j 1) j))))

(define (pad:em-dir)
  (if (and *pf-on* (> (string-length *pf-path*) 0))
      (let ((j (pad:em-slash-at *pf-path* 0 -1)))
        (cond ((< j 0) ".") ((= j 0) "/") (#t (substring *pf-path* 0 j))))
      (let ((p (getenv "PWD")))
        (if (and (string? p) (> (string-length p) 0)) p "."))))

(define (pad:em-join dir name)
  (cond
    ((string=? name "") dir)
    ((= (string-ref name 0) 47) name)
    ((string=? dir "/") (string-append "/" name))
    (#t (string-append dir "/" name))))

(define (pad:em-sub-rest src q i qi n qn)
  (cond
    ((>= qi qn) #t)
    ((>= i n) #f)
    ((= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q qi)))
     (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) (+ qi 1) n qn))
    (#t (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) qi n qn))))

(define (pad:em-sub-at src q i n qn)
  (cond
    ((or (<= qn 0) (>= i n)) -1)
    ((and (= (pad:em-low (string-ref src i)) (pad:em-low (string-ref q 0)))
          (pad:em-sub-rest src q (+ i 1) 1 n qn))
     i)
    (#t (pad:em-sub-at src q (+ i 1) n qn))))

(define (pad:em-subseq? name q)
  (and (> (string-length q) 0)
       (<= (string-length name) 512)
       (>= (pad:em-sub-at name q 0 (string-length name) (string-length q)) 0)))

(define (pad:em-prefix? name q)
  (let ((qn (string-length q)) (nn (string-length name)))
    (and (> qn 0) (>= nn qn) (string=? (substring name 0 qn) q))))

;; exact, then a starting match, then a substring, then a sparse match.
(define (pad:em-rank name q)
  (cond
    ((string=? name q) 4)
    ((pad:em-prefix? name q) 3)
    ((>= (string-index name q 0) 0) 2)
    ((pad:em-subseq? name q) 1)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:em-better? r name best)
  (or (not best)
      (> r (car best))
      (and (= r (car best))
           (< (string-length name) (string-length (cadr best))))))

(define (pad:em-best names q best)
  (if (or (not (pair? names)) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let ((name (car names)))
        (if (not (string? name))
            (pad:em-best (cdr names) q best)
            (let ((r (pad:em-rank name q)))
              (pad:em-best (cdr names) q
                (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
                    best
                    (list r name))))))))

(define (pad:em-isdir? path)
  (and *em-io* (pair? (directory-list path))))

(define (pad:em-into-dir! path)
  (let ((p (if (and (> (string-length path) 0)
                    (= (string-ref path (- (string-length path) 1)) 47))
               path
               (string-append path "/"))))
    (set! *vi-op* "find")
    (set! *vi-line* p)
    (set! *vi-prompt* "Find file: ")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Find file: " p "  (directory)"))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)
  (let* ((dir (pad:em-dir))
         (names (if *em-io* (directory-list dir) (list)))
         (best (pad:em-best (if (pair? names) names (list)) typed #f)))
    (if (not best)
        (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do")
        (let ((full (pad:em-join dir (cadr best))))
          (let ((raw (read-file full)))
            (cond
              ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! full))
              ((pad:em-isdir? full) (pad:em-into-dir! full))
              (#t (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no file " typed)) "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:em-open-typed! typed)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-find-start!)
      (let ((path (pad:em-join (pad:em-dir) typed)))
        (let ((raw (read-file path)))
          (cond
            ((string? raw) (pad:em-open! path))
            ((pad:em-isdir? path) (pad:em-into-dir! path))
            (#t (pad:em-fuzzy! typed)))))))

(define (pad:em-names xs acc)
  (if (null? xs)
      acc
      (pad:em-names (cdr xs)
        (if (string=? acc "")
            (list-ref (car xs) 1)
            (string-append acc " " (list-ref (car xs) 1))))))

(define (pad:em-list!)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (let ((names (pad:em-names *em-bufs* "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (if (string=? names "")
              "no buffers yet"
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "buffers: " names))))
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:em-best-buf xs q best)
  (if (or (null? xs) (string=? q ""))
      best
      (let* ((name (list-ref (car xs) 1))
             (r (pad:em-rank name q)))
        (pad:em-best-buf (cdr xs) q
          (if (or (= r 0) (not (pad:em-better? r name best)))
              best
              (list r name (car (car xs))))))))

(define (pad:em-switch! typed)
  (pad:em-stash!)
  (if (string=? typed "")
      (pad:em-buf-start!)
      (let ((best (pad:em-best-buf *em-bufs* typed #f)))
        (if (not best)
            (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no buffer " typed)) "vi-do")
            (pad:em-open! (list-ref best 2))))))

;; --- text search ------------------------------------------------------
;; Typing always restarts at the anchor, so one more letter cannot jump
;; to a later, worse hit. ctrl-s moves the anchor to just after this hit.

(define (pad:em-search-start!)
  (set! *em-anchor* (list (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)))
  (set! *em-from* (pad:play-point))
  (set! *em-hit* #f)
  (set! *vi-op* "s")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* "Search: ")
  (set! *pl-say* "Search: ")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:em-hit-at src q from)
  (let* ((n (if (string? src) (string-length src) 0))
         (i (if (and (> (string-length q) 0) (>= from 0) (< from n))
                (string-index src q from)
                -1)))
    (if (>= i 0)
        i
        (if (or (<= n 0) (> n 1024) (>= from n))
            -1
            (pad:em-sub-at src q (if (< from 0) 0 from) n (string-length q))))))

(define (pad:em-search-from! from wrapped)
  (let ((hit (pad:em-hit-at (pad:play-src) *vi-line* from)))
    (cond
      ((>= hit 0)
       (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (car *pl-st*) hit)))
         (set! *em-hit* hit)
         (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (car lc) (cadr lc)
                             (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
         (set! *pl-say* (string-append "Search: " *vi-line*))
         "vi-do"))
      ((and (not wrapped) (> from 0))
       (pad:em-search-from! 0 #t))
      (#t
       (set! *em-hit* #f)
       (set! *pl-say* "no match")
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-search-now!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f)))

(define (pad:em-search-next!)
  (if (string=? *vi-line* "")
      (pad:em-hint!)
      (begin
        (set! *em-from* (if (number? *em-hit*) (+ *em-hit* 1) (+ *em-from* 1)))
        (pad:em-search-from! *em-from* #f))))

(define (pad:em-enter!)
  (cond
    ((string=? *vi-op* "find")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-open-typed! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "buf")
     (let ((w *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (pad:em-switch! w)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "s")
     (let ((q *vi-line*))
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-line* "")
       (set! *em-anchor* #f)
       (if (> (string-length q) 0)
           (begin (set! *vi-pat* q) (set! *vi-pat-word* #f))
           0)
       (if (string=? *pl-say* "no match")
           "vi-do"
           (begin (set! *pl-say* "found") "vi-do"))))
    (#t (pad:vi-colon!))))

;; --- M-x tab completion -----------------------------------------------
;; Tab completes the first word, one step. One match becomes that name
;; plus a space. Several matches grow to the letters they share, and
;; the status line lists them. A word that is already a whole command
;; (layout, and also layout:story) takes a real space on the next tab,
;; so the rest can be an argument. Space does not complete: it lists
;; the matches and types a space, so "ask what" stays two words.
;; A space after that word is the argument. Nothing that starts that
;; way says no command.

(define *em-cmds*
  (list
   "ask"
   "chat"
   "delete-other-windows"
   "delete-window"
   "eval"
   "find-file"
   "flip"
   "gptel"
   "gptel-rewrite"
   "gptel-send"
   "help"
   "layout"
   "layout:beside"
   "layout:book"
   "layout:story"
   "layout:undo"
   "list-buffers"
   "map"
   "other-window"
   "preview"
   "preview:drop"
   "preview:keep"
   "preview:undo"
   "quit"
   "rewrite"
   "run"
   "save"
   "search"
   "split"
   "split-horiz"
   "story"
   "story:cheer"
   "story:grow"
   "story:mood"
   "story:shrink"
   "story:undo"
   "switch-buffer"
   "switch-window"
   "write"))

(define (pad:em-hit? name pre)
  (let ((pn (string-length pre)) (nn (string-length name)))
    (and (> pn 0) (>= nn pn) (string=? (substring name 0 pn) pre))))

(define (pad:em-hits names pre acc)
  (if (null? names)
      (reverse acc)
      (pad:em-hits (cdr names) pre
                   (if (pad:em-hit? (car names) pre)
                       (cons (car names) acc)
                       acc))))

(define (pad:em-share a b i)
  (let ((n (string-length a)) (m (string-length b)))
    (if (or (>= i n) (>= i m) (not (= (string-ref a i) (string-ref b i))))
        i
        (pad:em-share a b (+ i 1)))))

(define (pad:em-lcp names n)
  (if (or (null? names) (null? (cdr names)))
      n
      (let ((k (pad:em-share (car names) (cadr names) 0)))
        (pad:em-lcp (cdr names) (if (< k n) k n)))))

(define (pad:em-names-join xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((string=? acc "") (pad:em-names-join (cdr xs) (car xs)))
    (#t (pad:em-names-join (cdr xs) (string-append acc " " (car xs))))))

(define (pad:em-has? names s)
  (cond
    ((null? names) #f)
    ((string=? (car names) s) #t)
    (#t (pad:em-has? (cdr names) s))))

(define (pad:em-say-choices line hits)
  (pad:vi-cut (string-append *vi-prompt* line "  (" (pad:em-names-join hits "") ")")))

(define (pad:em-type-space! line)
  (set! *vi-line* (if (< (string-length line) 160)
                      (string-append line " ")
                      line))
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

;; Space lists matches and types a space. It does not grow the word.
(define (pad:em-cands!)
  (let ((line *vi-line*))
    (cond
      ((>= (string-index line " " 0) 0) (pad:em-type-space! line))
      ((string=? line "")
       (set! *pl-say* (pad:em-say-choices "" *em-cmds*))
       "vi-do")
      (#t
       (let ((hits (pad:em-hits *em-cmds* line (list))))
         (if (< (string-length line) 160)
             (set! *vi-line* (string-append line " "))
             0)
         (if (null? hits)
             (begin (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no command " line)) "vi-do")
             (begin (set! *pl-say* (pad:em-say-choices *vi-line* hits)) "vi-do")))))))

;; Tab completes the first word.
(define (pad:em-complete!)
  (let ((line *vi-line*))
    (cond
      ((>= (string-index line " " 0) 0)
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
       "vi-do")
      ((string=? line "")
       (set! *pl-say* (pad:em-say-choices "" *em-cmds*))
       "vi-do")
      (#t
       (let ((hits (pad:em-hits *em-cmds* line (list))))
         (cond
           ((null? hits)
            (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no command " line))
            "vi-do")
           ((null? (cdr hits))
            (set! *vi-line* (string-append (car hits) " "))
            (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
            "vi-do")
           (#t
            (let* ((k (pad:em-lcp hits (string-length (car hits))))
                   (grown (substring (car hits) 0 k)))
              (cond
                ((and (pad:em-has? hits line) (string=? grown line))
                 (set! *vi-line* (string-append line " "))
                 (set! *pl-say* (pad:em-say-choices *vi-line* hits))
                 "vi-do")
                ((> k (string-length line))
                 (set! *vi-line* grown)
                 (set! *pl-say* (pad:em-say-choices grown hits))
                 "vi-do")
                (#t
                 (set! *pl-say* (pad:em-say-choices line hits))
                 "vi-do"))))))))))

;; ai.aura loads on the first chat command, not on a normal key.
(define *ai-ready* #f)

(define (pad:ai-word? w)
  (or (string=? w "ask") (string=? w "chat") (string=? w "rewrite")
      (string=? w "gptel") (string=? w "gptel-send") (string=? w "gptel-rewrite")))

(define (pad:ai-dispatch! w rest)
  (if (not *ai-ready*)
      (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/ai.aura")))
  (if *ai-ready*
      (pad:ai-run! w rest)
      (begin (set! *pl-say* "the chat is not here yet") "vi-do")))

(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "find-file") (string=? w "ff"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-open-typed! rest) (pad:em-find-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "switch-buffer") (string=? w "buffer"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0) (pad:em-switch! rest) (pad:em-buf-start!)))
    ((or (string=? w "list-buffers") (string=? w "buffers"))
     (pad:em-list!))
    ((or (string=? w "search") (string=? w "isearch"))
     (if (> (string-length rest) 0)
         (begin (pad:em-search-start!) (set! *vi-line* rest) (pad:em-search-now!))
         (pad:em-search-start!)))
    ((pad:ai-word? w) (pad:ai-dispatch! w rest))
    (#t (if mx #f #f))))

;; --- words ------------------------------------------------------------
;; A word is a run of letters that are not spaces. alt-f lands just
;; after it; at the end of a line it continues once onto the next line.

(define (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col crossed)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i1 (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln col len))
         (i2 (pad:vi-skip-word ln i1 len)))
    (cond
      ((< i2 len) (list l i2))
      ((and (= i2 i1) (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      ((> i2 col) (list l i2))
      ((and (< l (- n 1)) (not crossed))
       (pad:em-fwd-pos L (+ l 1) 0 #t))
      (#t #f))))

(define (pad:em-fwd!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st) #f)))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-kill-word!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (pos (pad:em-fwd-pos L l col #f)))
    (if (or (not pos) (and (= (car pos) l) (= (cadr pos) col)))
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (let* ((l2 (car pos))
               (c2 (cadr pos))
               (kill (pad:region-text L l col l2 c2))
               (L2 (pad:region-delete L l col l2 c2))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted a word")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:em-meta! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-colon-start! #t))
    ((= b 102) (pad:em-fwd!))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-b!))
    ((= b 100) (pad:em-kill-word!))
    ((= b 60) "bob")
    ((= b 62) "eob")
    (#t "to-normal")))

;; aura-pad M9 -- the pen: KEEP edits from a helper / macro / law reach the
;; workspace as one mutate:rebind (the engine takes its own mutation
;; boundary inside rebind; the pad checks mutate:boundary-safe? first).
;;
;; Honesty:
;; - A REJECT never calls set-code, never bumps generation, never pushes undo.
;; - A KEEP bumps the workspace generation exactly once (read through the
;;   engine metrics face: bare ast:generation is unbound on tip, aura#4349).
;; - A step the Soft gate passes but the engine refuses is a failed probe:
;;   ast:snapshot before, ast:restore after, then one eval-current so page
;;   procedures are callable again (aura#4349). Never called a transaction.
;; Needs ws.aura (and everything it needs). Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *pen-undo* (list))     ; entries: (snap L l col name gen-before)
(define *pen-keeps* 0)
(define *pen-rejects* 0)
(define *pen-drops* 0)
(define *pen-max-len* 120)

(define *pen-banned*
  (list "set!" "vector-set!" "set-car!" "display" "write" "mutate" "eval"
        "load" "shell" "http" "read-file" "set-code" "fiber:" "require"
        "import" "define" "pad:" "pd:" "hot-strategy"))
(define *pen-mean* (list "stupid" "dumb" "hate" "idiot" "shut up"))
(define *pen-whos* (list "helper" "macro" "law"))

(define (pad:pen-word s ws)
  (let loop ((xs ws))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) "")
      ((string-contains? s (car xs)) (car xs))
      (#t (loop (cdr xs))))))

;; Workspace generation (engine metrics face) or -1 when unreadable.
(define (pad:pen-gen)
  (try
    (let ((g (engine:metrics "ast:generation")))
      (if (number? g) g -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define (pad:pen-total)
  (let ((t (pad:alist-get (pad:m-summary) ":total")))
    (if (number? t) t -1)))

;; Soft gate: reads only (define-lookup is a read). Returns "ok" or a kid tag.
(define (pad:pen-gate who name lam)
  (cond
    ((not (member who *pen-whos*)) "not-allowed")
    ((or (not (string? name)) (string=? name "")) "no-name")
    ((not (string? lam)) "not-lambda")
    ((> (string-length (pad:pen-word lam *pen-mean*)) 0) "not-kind")
    ((> (string-length (pad:pen-word lam *pen-banned*)) 0) "not-allowed")
    ((not (string-prefix? lam "(lambda")) "not-lambda")
    ((> (string-length lam) *pen-max-len*) "too-long")
    ((not (pad:ws-engine-born? name)) "no-def")
    ((not (pad:m-safe?)) "not-safe")
    (#t "ok")))

(define (pad:pen-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "no-name") "tell me which name to change")
    ((string=? reason "not-kind") "let's use kind words")
    ((string=? reason "not-allowed") "that change uses a word the pad keeps locked")
    ((string=? reason "not-lambda") "a change has to start with (lambda")
    ((string=? reason "too-long") "that change is too big for one step")
    ((string=? reason "no-def") "could not find where that name is born")
    ((string=? reason "not-safe") "aura is busy, try again")
    ((string=? reason "engine-no") "aura could not use that change, page put back")
    ((string=? reason "too-wide") "aura changed it, the line is too long to show")
    ((string=? reason "nothing-to-undo") "nothing to undo yet")
    (#t "the gate said no")))

;; Project a KEEP into the page: the one-line define of name becomes
;; "(define NAME LAM)". Multi-line defines and too-wide rows keep the
;; page as it is (the next check reconciles). Returns (L tag).
(define (pad:pen-project L name lam)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens src))
         (ds (pad:find-defs-in toks name)))
    (if (null? ds)
        (list L "no-row")
        (let* ((l (car (pad:v-linecol L (car ds))))
               (row (pad:v-src (list (pad:nth L l))))
               (rt (pad:hl-tokens row))
               (new (string-append "(define " name " " lam ")")))
          (cond
            ((not (string-prefix? row "(define")) (list L "multi-line"))
            ((not (= (pad:ws-paren-depth rt) 0)) (list L "multi-line"))
            ((> (string-length new) *play-max-col*) (list L "too-wide"))
            (#t (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:v-codes new)) "row")))))))

(define (pad:pen-set-page! L)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L (min (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (- (length L) 1)) 0
                       (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                       (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
  L)

;; Heal after ast:restore: one eval-current so workspace procedures are
;; not stale (aura#4349). Counted in M9STATS heals, never a set-code.
(define (pad:pen-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One pen step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta).
(define (pad:pen-step! who name lam why)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:pen-gate who name lam)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *pen-rejects* (+ *pen-rejects* 1))
          (list "REJECT" gate (pad:pen-say gate)
                (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0)))
        (let* ((snap (ast:snapshot))
               (r (pad:m-rebind! name lam why)))
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
                     (t1 (pad:pen-total))
                     (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                     (pr (pad:pen-project L0 name lam)))
                (set! *pen-undo*
                      (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                                  name g0)
                            *pen-undo*))
                (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
                (set! *pen-keeps* (+ *pen-keeps* 1))
                (list "KEEP" (cadr pr)
                      (if (string=? (cadr pr) "too-wide")
                          (pad:pen-say "too-wide")
                          (string-append who " changed " name))
                      (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0)))
              (begin
                (pad:pen-heal! snap)
                (set! *pen-drops* (+ *pen-drops* 1))
                (list "DROP" "engine-no" (pad:pen-say "engine-no")
                      (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0))))))))

;; Undo the last KEEP: ast:restore its snapshot + heal, page rows back.
(define (pad:pen-undo!)
  (if (null? *pen-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let ((u (car *pen-undo*)))
        (set! *pen-undo* (cdr *pen-undo*))
        (pad:pen-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es (pad:nth u 1) (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        "ok")))

(define (pad:pen-line! r who name)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " pen who=") (display who)
  (display " name=") (display name)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- open and save a text file: `aura-pad FILE` (c/aura_pad.c).
;; Soft owns the file. C only puts the absolute path in PAD_FILE and
;; forwards key bytes; it never reads, writes or names the file.
;; Tip primitives only: read-file gives a string, or () when the file is
;; missing or not a readable regular file; write-file gives 1 on success.
;; Needs keys.aura (play state) and play_in.aura (pad:play-step!);
;; play.aura loads this file and calls pad:pf-open! when PAD_FILE is set.
;;
;; Keys, file mode only (the play page without FILE is unchanged):
;;   ctrl-x ctrl-s        save (Emacs). ctrl-s alone is the M9 notebook
;;                        "check" key, so here it only says how to save.
;;   ctrl-q, ctrl-x ctrl-c  quit. With unsaved changes the first press
;;                        says so and the next quit key quits. ctrl-c
;;                        alone says how to quit (aura-pad hands ctrl-c
;;                        to Soft as a key byte, not as SIGINT).
;; Every other key goes to pad:play-step! as before.
;;
;; The pad never writes a file it could not load byte for byte. A file
;; with more than *pf-max-lines* lines, a line longer than *pf-max-col*,
;; or a byte outside printable ASCII (tab, CR, UTF-8, ...) opens to look
;; at only: rows cut to fit, odd bytes shown as "?", saving off.
;; A missing file is a new page; the first save creates it.
;; No named let captures an outer local (aura#4353); no top-level named
;; let (aura#4352). Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *pf-on* #f)       ; a file is open (PAD_FILE)
(define *pf-path* "")     ; absolute path from C
(define *pf-name* "")     ; last path part, for the title and the words
(define *pf-new* #f)      ; the file did not exist at open
(define *pf-ro* #f)       ; does not fit the pad exactly: look only
(define *pf-nl* #t)       ; the file ended with a newline (kept on save)
(define *pf-saved* "")    ; page text at open / last save
(define *pf-cx* #f)       ; ctrl-x pressed, waiting for the second key
(define *pf-quit* #f)     ; a quit key was refused once (unsaved)
;; File page: roomier than the 40 x 12 play page, still one screen
;; (6-char gutter + 72 = 78 columns; 18 rows + title, say, legend).
(define *pf-max-col* 72)
(define *pf-max-lines* 18)
;; protocol lines the file keys arrive as (ctrl-x 24, ctrl-q 17,
;; ctrl-s 19, ctrl-c 3; a fast ctrl-x ctrl-s can come in one read)
(define *pf-keys* (list "IN 24" "IN 17" "IN 19" "IN 24 19" "IN 24 3" "IN 3"))
(define *pf-help* "ctrl-x ctrl-s saves, ctrl-q quits")

;; "1 line", "3 lines"
(define (pad:pf-lines n)
  (string-append (number->string n) (if (= n 1) " line" " lines")))

;; Last path part: "/a/b/c.txt" -> "c.txt".
(define (pad:pf-base p)
  (let pf-b ((s p) (i 0) (from 0))
    (let ((j (string-index s "/" i)))
      (if (< j 0)
          (substring s from (string-length s))
          (pf-b s (+ j 1) (+ j 1))))))

;; Text -> line strings, split at "\n" with string-index (one step per
;; line, not one per char like pad:v-split).
(define (pad:pf-split s)
  (let pf-s ((t s) (i 0) (n (string-length s)) (acc (list)))
    (let ((j (if (< i n) (string-index t "\n" i) -1)))
      (if (< j 0)
          (reverse (cons (substring t i n) acc))
          (pf-s t (+ j 1) n (cons (substring t i j) acc))))))

;; Look-only row: cut to the page width, odd bytes as "?" (63).
(define (pad:pf-cut ln)
  (map (lambda (c) (if (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126)) c 63))
       (if (> (length ln) *pf-max-col*) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- (length ln) *pf-max-col*))) ln)))

;; Open PATH into the play page. Returns "new", "ok" or "ro".
(define (pad:pf-open! path)
  (let* ((raw (read-file path))
         (new (not (string? raw)))
         (s0 (if new "" raw))
         (n0 (string-length s0))
         ;; never split more than one page worth of text
         (cap (* *pf-max-lines* (+ *pf-max-col* 1)))
         (big (> n0 (+ cap 1)))
         (s1 (if big (substring s0 0 cap) s0))
         (nl (or new (and (> n0 0) (not big) (= (string-ref s0 (- n0 1)) 10))))
         (s (if (and nl (> (string-length s1) 0)) (substring s1 0 (- (string-length s1) 1)) s1))
         (L0 (map pad:v-codes (pad:pf-split s)))
         (flat (apply append L0))
         (lo (if (null? flat) 32 (apply min flat)))
         (hi (if (null? flat) 32 (apply max flat)))
         (wide (apply max (cons 0 (map length L0))))
         (ro (or big (> (length L0) *pf-max-lines*) (> wide *pf-max-col*) (< lo 32) (> hi 126)))
         (L (if ro
                (map pad:pf-cut (if (> (length L0) *pf-max-lines*)
                                    (reverse (drop (reverse L0) (- (length L0) *pf-max-lines*)))
                                    L0))
                L0))
         (name (pad:pf-base path)))
    (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
    (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
    (pad:play-reset! "")
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at L 0 0))
    (set! *pf-on* #t)
    (set! *pf-path* path)
    (set! *pf-name* name)
    (set! *pf-new* new)
    (set! *pf-ro* ro)
    (set! *pf-nl* nl)
    (set! *pf-saved* (pad:v-src L))
    (set! *pf-cx* #f)
    (set! *pf-quit* #f)
    (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " name (if ro " (look only)" "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (cond
            (new (string-append "new page " name " - " *pf-help*))
            (ro (string-append name " is too big or has letters the pad cannot show,"
                               " so the pad only looks - ctrl-q quits"))
            (#t (string-append "opened " name " (" (pad:pf-lines (length L)) ") - " *pf-help*))))
    (cond (new "new") (ro "ro") (#t "ok"))))

;; Write the page back. Returns "saved", "ro" or "fail"; sets the say.
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if *pf-ro*
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " stays as it was: the pad only looks at this file"))
        "ro")
      (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
             (body (cond
                     ((and *pf-new* (string=? src "")) "")
                     (*pf-nl* (string-append src "\n"))
                     (#t src)))
             (r (write-file *pf-path* body)))
        (if (equal? r 1)
            (begin
              (set! *pf-saved* src)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "saved " *pf-name* " ("
                                            (pad:pf-lines (length (car *pl-st*))) ")"))
              "saved")
            (begin
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "could not save " *pf-name* " - is the folder there?"))
              "fail")))))

;; A quit key. Unsaved changes: say so once; the next quit key quits.
(define (pad:pf-quit! armed)
  (if (or armed *pf-ro* (string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*))
      "quit"
      (begin
        (set! *pf-quit* #t)
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                                      " ctrl-q again quits"))
        (pad:play-emit!)
        "go")))

;; One protocol line in file mode, when it is a file key, ctrl-x is
;; pending or a quit was refused (play.aura checks that with builtins
;; before calling, so plain typing pays no extra Soft call). Returns
;; "quit" or "go" like pad:play-step!.
(define (pad:pf-line! line)
  (let ((cx *pf-cx*) (armed *pf-quit*))
    (set! *pf-cx* #f)
    (set! *pf-quit* #f)
    (cond
      ((or (and cx (string=? line "IN 19")) (string=? line "IN 24 19"))
       (pad:pf-save!)
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((or (string=? line "IN 17") (and cx (string=? line "IN 3")) (string=? line "IN 24 3"))
       (pad:pf-quit! armed))
      ((string=? line "IN 24")
       (set! *pf-cx* #t)
       (set! *pf-quit* armed)
       (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-s saves, ctrl-c quits")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      (cx
       (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x and that key do not go together")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 19")
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append "to save " *pf-name* ", press ctrl-x then ctrl-s"))
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 3")
       (set! *pl-say* "to quit press ctrl-q (ctrl-x ctrl-c works too)")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      (#t
       ;; another key after a refused quit: the warning no longer holds
       (if armed (set! *pl-say* *pf-help*) 0)
       (pad:play-step! line)))))
