target.body:
(lambda () (if *pf-ro*
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " stays as it was: the pad only looks at this file"))
        "ro")
      (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
             (body (cond
                     ((and *pf-new* (string=? src "")) "")
                     (*pf-nl* (string-append src "\n"))
                     (#t src)))
             (r (write-file *pf-path* body)))
        (if (equal? r 1)
            (begin
              (set! *pf-saved* src)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "saved " *pf-name* " ("
                                            (pad:pf-lines (length (car *pl-st*))) ")"))
              "saved")
            (begin
              ;; stdout, outside the SNAP block, so the C viewport can
              ;; copy it into the rotating error log. Not "error:" —
              ;; the smokes treat that word as a Soft crash.
              (display "ERR could not save ")
              (display *pf-name*)
              (newline)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "could not save " *pf-name* " - is the folder there?"))
              "fail")))))

;; aura-pad -- open and save a text file: `aura-pad FILE` (c/aura_pad.c).
;; Soft owns the file. C only puts the absolute path in PAD_FILE and
;; forwards key bytes; it never reads, writes or names the file.
;; Tip primitives only: read-file gives a string, or () when the file is
;; missing or not a readable regular file; write-file gives 1 on success.
;; Needs keys.aura (play state) and play_in.aura (pad:play-step!);
;; play.aura loads this file and calls pad:pf-open! when PAD_FILE is set.
;;
;; Keys, file mode only (the play page without FILE is unchanged):
;;   ctrl-x ctrl-s        save (Emacs). ctrl-s alone is the M9 notebook
;;                        "check" key, so here it only says how to save.
;;   ctrl-q, ctrl-x ctrl-c  quit. With unsaved changes the first press
;;                        says so and the next quit key quits. ctrl-c
;;                        alone says how to quit (aura-pad hands ctrl-c
;;                        to Soft as a key byte, not as SIGINT).
;; Every other key goes to pad:play-step! as before.
;;
;; The pad never writes a file it could not load byte for byte. A file
;; with more than *pf-max-lines* lines, a line longer than *pf-max-col*,
;; or a byte outside printable ASCII (tab, CR, UTF-8, ...) opens to look
;; at only: rows cut to fit, odd bytes shown as "?", saving off.
;; A missing file is a new page; the first save creates it.
;; No named let captures an outer local (aura#4353); no top-level named
;; let (aura#4352). Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *pf-on* #f)       ; a file is open (PAD_FILE)
(define *pf-path* "")     ; absolute path from C
(define *pf-name* "")     ; last path part, for the title and the words
(define *pf-new* #f)      ; the file did not exist at open
(define *pf-ro* #f)       ; does not fit the pad exactly: look only
(define *pf-nl* #t)       ; the file ended with a newline (kept on save)
(define *pf-saved* "")    ; page text at open / last save
(define *pf-cx* #f)       ; ctrl-x pressed, waiting for the second key
(define *pf-quit* #f)     ; a quit key was refused once (unsaved)
;; File page: roomier than the 40 x 12 play page, still one screen
;; (6-char gutter + 72 = 78 columns; 18 rows + title, say, legend).
(define *pf-max-col* 72)
(define *pf-max-lines* 18)
;; protocol lines the file keys arrive as (ctrl-x 24, ctrl-q 17,
;; ctrl-s 19, ctrl-c 3; a fast ctrl-x ctrl-s can come in one read)
(define *pf-keys* (list "IN 24" "IN 17" "IN 19" "IN 24 19" "IN 24 3" "IN 3"))
(define *pf-help* "ctrl-x ctrl-s saves, ctrl-q quits")

;; "1 line", "3 lines"
(define (pad:pf-lines n)
  (string-append (number->string n) (if (= n 1) " line" " lines")))

;; Last path part: "/a/b/c.txt" -> "c.txt".
(define (pad:pf-base p)
  (let pf-b ((s p) (i 0) (from 0))
    (let ((j (string-index s "/" i)))
      (if (< j 0)
          (substring s from (string-length s))
          (pf-b s (+ j 1) (+ j 1))))))

;; Text -> line strings, split at "\n" with string-index (one step per
;; line, not one per char like pad:v-split).
(define (pad:pf-split s)
  (let pf-s ((t s) (i 0) (n (string-length s)) (acc (list)))
    (let ((j (if (< i n) (string-index t "\n" i) -1)))
      (if (< j 0)
          (reverse (cons (substring t i n) acc))
          (pf-s t (+ j 1) n (cons (substring t i j) acc))))))

;; Look-only row: cut to the page width, odd bytes as "?" (63).
(define (pad:pf-cut ln)
  (map (lambda (c) (if (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126)) c 63))
       (if (> (length ln) *pf-max-col*) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- (length ln) *pf-max-col*))) ln)))

;; Open PATH into the play page. Returns "new", "ok" or "ro".
(define (pad:pf-open! path)
  (let* ((raw (read-file path))
         (new (not (string? raw)))
         (s0 (if new "" raw))
         (n0 (string-length s0))
         ;; never split more than one page worth of text
         (cap (* *pf-max-lines* (+ *pf-max-col* 1)))
         (big (> n0 (+ cap 1)))
         (s1 (if big (substring s0 0 cap) s0))
         (nl (or new (and (> n0 0) (not big) (= (string-ref s0 (- n0 1)) 10))))
         (s (if (and nl (> (string-length s1) 0)) (substring s1 0 (- (string-length s1) 1)) s1))
         (L0 (map pad:v-codes (pad:pf-split s)))
         (flat (apply append L0))
         (lo (if (null? flat) 32 (apply min flat)))
         (hi (if (null? flat) 32 (apply max flat)))
         (wide (apply max (cons 0 (map length L0))))
         (ro (or big (> (length L0) *pf-max-lines*) (> wide *pf-max-col*) (< lo 32) (> hi 126)))
         (L (if ro
                (map pad:pf-cut (if (> (length L0) *pf-max-lines*)
                                    (reverse (drop (reverse L0) (- (length L0) *pf-max-lines*)))
                                    L0))
                L0))
         (name (pad:pf-base path)))
    (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
    (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
    (pad:play-reset! "")
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at L 0 0))
    (set! *pf-on* #t)
    (set! *pf-path* path)
    (set! *pf-name* name)
    (set! *pf-new* new)
    (set! *pf-ro* ro)
    (set! *pf-nl* nl)
    (set! *pf-saved* (pad:v-src L))
    (set! *pf-cx* #f)
    (set! *pf-quit* #f)
    (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " name (if ro " (look only)" "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (cond
            (new (string-append "new page " name " - " *pf-help*))
            (ro (string-append name " is too big or has letters the pad cannot show,"
                               " so the pad only looks - ctrl-q quits"))
            (#t (string-append "opened " name " (" (pad:pf-lines (length L)) ") - " *pf-help*))))
    (cond (new "new") (ro "ro") (#t "ok"))))

;; Write the page back. Returns "saved", "ro" or "fail"; sets the say.
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if *pf-ro*
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " stays as it was: the pad only looks at this file"))
        "ro")
      (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
             (body (cond
                     ((and *pf-new* (string=? src "")) "")
                     (*pf-nl* (string-append src "\n"))
                     (#t src)))
             (r (write-file *pf-path* body)))
        (if (equal? r 1)
            (begin
              (set! *pf-saved* src)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "saved " *pf-name* " ("
                                            (pad:pf-lines (length (car *pl-st*))) ")"))
              "saved")
            (begin
              ;; stdout, outside the SNAP block, so the C viewport can
              ;; copy it into the rotating error log. Not "error:" —
              ;; the smokes treat that word as a Soft crash.
              (display "ERR could not save ")
              (display *pf-name*)
              (newline)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "could not save " *pf-name* " - is the folder there?"))
              "fail")))))

;; A quit key. Unsaved changes: say so once; the next quit key quits.
(define (pad:pf-quit! armed)
  (if (or armed *pf-ro* (string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*))
      "quit"
      (begin
        (set! *pf-quit* #t)
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                                      " ctrl-q again quits"))
        (pad:play-emit!)
        "go")))

;; One protocol line in file mode, when it is a file key, ctrl-x is
;; pending or a quit was refused (play.aura checks that with builtins
;; before calling, so plain typing pays no extra Soft call). Returns
;; "quit" or "go" like pad:play-step!.
(define (pad:pf-line! line)
  (let ((cx *pf-cx*) (armed *pf-quit*))
    (set! *pf-cx* #f)
    (set! *pf-quit* #f)
    (cond
      ((or (and cx (string=? line "IN 19")) (string=? line "IN 24 19"))
       (pad:pf-save!)
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((or (string=? line "IN 17") (and cx (string=? line "IN 3")) (string=? line "IN 24 3"))
       (pad:pf-quit! armed))
      ((string=? line "IN 24")
       (set! *pf-cx* #t)
       (set! *pf-quit* armed)
       (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-s saves, ctrl-c quits")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      (cx
       (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x and that key do not go together")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 19")
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append "to save " *pf-name* ", press ctrl-x then ctrl-s"))
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 3")
       (set! *pl-say* "to quit press ctrl-q (ctrl-x ctrl-c works too)")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      (#t
       ;; another key after a refused quit: the warning no longer holds
       (if armed (set! *pl-say* *pf-help*) 0)
       (pad:play-step! line)))))

         (L0 (map pad:v-codes (pad:pf-split s)))
         (flat (apply append L0))
         (lo (if (null? flat) 32 (apply min flat)))
         (hi (if (null? flat) 32 (apply max flat)))
         (wide (apply max (cons 0 (map length L0))))
         (ro (or big (> (length L0) *pf-max-lines*) (> wide *pf-max-col*) (< lo 32) (> hi 126)))
         (L (if ro
                (map pad:pf-cut (if (> (length L0) *pf-max-lines*)
                                    (reverse (drop (reverse L0) (- (length L0) *pf-max-lines*)))
                                    L0))
                L0))
         (name (pad:pf-base path)))
    (set! *play-max-col* *pf-max-col*)
    (set! *play-max-lines* *pf-max-lines*)
    (pad:play-reset! "")
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at L 0 0))
    (set! *pf-on* #t)
    (set! *pf-path* path)
    (set! *pf-name* name)
    (set! *pf-new* new)
    (set! *pf-ro* ro)
    (set! *pf-nl* nl)
    (set! *pf-saved* (pad:v-src L))
    (set! *pf-cx* #f)
    (set! *pf-quit* #f)
    (set! *pl-title* (string-append "aura pad: " name (if ro " (look only)" "")))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (cond
            (new (string-append "new page " name " - " *pf-help*))
            (ro (string-append name " is too big or has letters the pad cannot show,"
                               " so the pad only looks - ctrl-q quits"))
            (#t (string-append "opened " name " (" (pad:pf-lines (length L)) ") - " *pf-help*))))
    (cond (new "new") (ro "ro") (#t "ok"))))

;; Write the page back. Returns "saved", "ro" or "fail"; sets the say.
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if *pf-ro*
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " stays as it was: the pad only looks at this file"))
        "ro")
      (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
             (body (cond
                     ((and *pf-new* (string=? src "")) "")
                     (*pf-nl* (string-append src "\n"))
                     (#t src)))
             (r (write-file *pf-path* body)))
        (if (equal? r 1)
            (begin
              (set! *pf-saved* src)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "saved " *pf-name* " ("
                                            (pad:pf-lines (length (car *pl-st*))) ")"))
              "saved")
            (begin
              ;; stdout, outside the SNAP block, so the C viewport can
              ;; copy it into the rotating error log. Not "error:" —
              ;; the smokes treat that word as a Soft crash.
              (display "ERR could not save ")
              (display *pf-name*)
              (newline)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "could not save " *pf-name* " - is the folder there?"))
              "fail")))))

;; A quit key. Unsaved changes: say so once; the next quit key quits.
(define (pad:pf-quit! armed)
  (if (or armed *pf-ro* (string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*))
      "quit"
      (begin
        (set! *pf-quit* #t)
        (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                                      " ctrl-x ctrl-c again quits"))
        (pad:play-emit!)
        "go")))

;; One protocol line in file mode, when it is a file key, ctrl-x is
;; pending or a quit was refused (play.aura checks that with builtins
;; before calling, so plain typing pays no extra Soft call). Returns
;; "quit" or "go" like pad:play-step!.
(define (pad:pf-line! line)
  (let ((cx *pf-cx*) (armed *pf-quit*))
    (set! *pf-cx* #f)
    (set! *pf-quit* #f)
    (cond
      ((or (and cx (string=? line "IN 19")) (string=? line "IN 24 19"))
       (pad:pf-save!)
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((or (string=? line "IN 17")
           (and cx (string=? line "IN 3"))
           (string=? line "IN 24 3")
           ;; the warning is up: a lone ctrl-c counts as the second press
           (and armed (string=? line "IN 3")))
       (pad:pf-quit! armed))
      ((or (and cx (string=? line "IN 5")) (string=? line "IN 24 5"))
       (pad:vi-eval!)
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 24")
       (set! *pf-cx* #t)
       (set! *pf-quit* armed)
       (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-s saves, ctrl-c quits, ctrl-e runs this page")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      (cx
       (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x and that key do not go together")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 19")
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append "to save " *pf-name* ", press ctrl-x then ctrl-s"))
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      ((string=? line "IN 3")
       (set! *pl-say* "to quit press ctrl-q (ctrl-x ctrl-c works too)")
       (pad:play-emit!)
       "go")
      (#t
       ;; another key after a refused quit: the warning no longer holds
       (if armed (set! *pl-say* *pf-help*) 0)
       (pad:play-step! line)))))

(lambda (armed) (let ((other (pad:em-other-dirty)))

            (and (string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*) (string=? other "")))
        "quit"
        (begin
          (set! *pf-quit* #t)
          (set! *pl-say* (string-append
                           (if (string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*) other *pf-name*)
                           " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                           " ctrl-x ctrl-c again quits"))
          (pad:play-emit!)
          "go"))))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M14 -- Emacs windows on one frame.
;;
;; A buffer is the text. A window is a view (buffer, point, window-start).
;; The frame is one binary tree for this terminal: "V" is split-window-below,
;; "H" is split-window-right. Keys go to the selected window. Deleting a
;; window does not delete its buffer.
;;
;; One window (the tree is empty) keeps today's SNAP, byte for byte.
;; Two or more windows emit WINS / WIN rectangles. C only paints them.
;; M-x help opens a page that explains the game. Soft reserved: never
;; bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372).

(define *wn-tree* #f)
(define *wn-live* "")
(define *wn-back* "page")
(define *wn-store* (list))
(define *wn-sel* 0)
(define *wn-seq* 0)
(define *wn-taught* #f)

(define (pad:wn-many?)
  (and (pair? *wn-tree*) (string? (car *wn-tree*))))

(define (pad:wn-rows) (pad:vw-rows-now))
(define (pad:wn-cols) (pad:vw-cols-now))

(define (pad:wn-here)
  (if (and *pf-on* (string? *pf-name*) (> (string-length *pf-name*) 0))
      *pf-name*
      "page"))

(define (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines acc)
  (cond
    ((null? store) (reverse (cons (list name lines) acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons (list name lines) (cdr store))))
    (#t (pad:wn-put-acc (cdr store) name lines (cons (car store) acc)))))

(define (pad:wn-put store name lines)
  (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines (list)))

(define (pad:wn-got store name)
  (cond
    ((null? store) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name) (cadr (car store)))
    (#t (pad:wn-got (cdr store) name))))

(define (pad:wn-em-name name bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (list-ref (car bufs) 1) name)
     (pad:v-lines (list-ref (car bufs) 2)))
    (#t (pad:wn-em-name name (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:wn-reset!)
  (set! *wn-tree* #f)
  (set! *wn-live* "")
  (set! *wn-store* (list))
  (set! *wn-sel* 0)
  (set! *wn-taught* #f)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-live* (pad:wn-here))
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*))))
      0))

(define (pad:wn-buf! name src)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* name (pad:v-lines src)))
  name)

(define (pad:wn-lookup name)
  (if (or (not (string? name)) (string=? name ""))
      #f
      (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
          (car *pl-st*)
          (let ((g (pad:wn-got *wn-store* name)))
            (if g g (pad:wn-em-name name *em-bufs*))))))

(define (pad:wn-lines-of name)
  (let ((g (pad:wn-lookup name)))
    (if g g (list (list)))))

(define (pad:wn-rej say)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:wn-show! name lines line col top left)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) line col
                          (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at lines line col))
        (set! *wn-live* name)
        (pad:lc-reset!)))
  (set! *vw-top* top)
  (set! *vw-left* left)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-leaf id name line col top left)
  (list id name line col top left 0 0 "kid"))

(define (pad:wn-leaf-now)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (set! *wn-sel* *wn-seq*)
  (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*) *vw-top* *vw-left*))

(define (pad:wn-ratio node)
  (if (and (> (length node) 3) (number? (list-ref node 3)))
      (list-ref node 3)
      50))

(define (pad:wn-count node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      1
      (+ (pad:wn-count (cadr node)) (pad:wn-count (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-find node id)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) node #f))
    (#t (let ((a (pad:wn-find (cadr node) id)))
          (if a a (pad:wn-find (caddr node) id))))))

(define (pad:wn-ids node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (car node))
      (append (pad:wn-ids (cadr node)) (pad:wn-ids (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-repl node id born)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) born node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-repl (cadr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-repl (caddr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-sync node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) *wn-sel*)
          (list (car node) *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                *vw-top* *vw-left*
                (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
          node)
      (list (car node)
            (pad:wn-sync (cadr node))
            (pad:wn-sync (caddr node))
            (pad:wn-ratio node))))

(define (pad:wn-set-leaf node id name line col top left)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node))
     (if (= (car node) id)
         (list id name line col top left
               (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
         node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (cadr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (caddr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-put-leaf node leaf)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) (car leaf)) leaf node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (cadr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (caddr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-del node id)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) id) (list "gone") (list "keep" node))
      (let ((a (pad:wn-del (cadr node) id))
            (b (pad:wn-del (caddr node) id)))
        (cond
          ((string=? (car a) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr b)))
          ((string=? (car b) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr a)))
          (#t (list "keep"
                    (list (car node) (cadr a) (cadr b) (pad:wn-ratio node))))))))

(define (pad:wn-share total ratio)
  (if (< total 4)
      1
      (let ((n (quotient (* total ratio) 100)))
        (cond ((< n 2) 2) ((> n (- total 2)) (- total 2)) (#t n)))))

(define (pad:wn-place node r c h w)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (list node r c h w))
      (if (string=? (car node) "V")
          (let ((h1 (pad:wn-share h (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h1 w)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) (+ r h1) c (- h h1) w)))
          (let ((w1 (pad:wn-share w (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h w1)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) r (+ c w1) h (- w w1)))))))

(define (pad:wn-tiny? rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) #f)
    ((let ((h (list-ref (car rects) 3)) (w (list-ref (car rects) 4)))
       (or (< h 2) (< w 8))) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-tiny? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-hit? a b)
  (let ((ar (cadr a)) (ac (list-ref a 2)) (ah (list-ref a 3)) (aw (list-ref a 4))
        (br (cadr b)) (bc (list-ref b 2)) (bh (list-ref b 3)) (bw (list-ref b 4)))
    (and (< ar (+ br bh)) (< br (+ ar ah))
         (< ac (+ bc bw)) (< bc (+ ac aw)))))

(define (pad:wn-ov1 a rest)
  (cond
    ((null? rest) #f)
    ((pad:wn-hit? a (car rest)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-ov1 a (cdr rest)))))

(define (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
  (cond
    ((or (null? rects) (null? (cdr rects))) #f)
    ((pad:wn-ov1 (car rects) (cdr rects)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-overlap? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-scrolled leaf h w)
  (let* ((textw (if (> w 1) (- w 1) 1))
         (n (length (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))))
         (top (pad:vw-clamp (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 4) h) h n))
         (left (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 3) (list-ref leaf 5) textw)))
    (list (car leaf) (cadr leaf) (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
          top left (list-ref leaf 6) (list-ref leaf 7) (list-ref leaf 8))))

(define (pad:wn-apply rects tree)
  (if (null? rects)
      tree
      (let* ((rec (car rects))
             (leaf (pad:wn-scrolled (car rec) (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4))))
        (pad:wn-apply (cdr rects) (pad:wn-put-leaf tree leaf)))))

(define (pad:wn-note! rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) 0)
    ((= (car (car (car rects))) *wn-sel*)
     (set! *vw-top* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 4))
     (set! *vw-left* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 5)))
    (#t (pad:wn-note! (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
  (set! *wn-sel* (car leaf))
  (pad:wn-show! (cadr leaf)
                (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))
                (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5)))

(define (pad:wn-install! node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (begin (pad:wn-focus! node) (set! *wn-tree* #f))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-tree* node)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find node (car (pad:wn-ids node))))))
  0)

(define (pad:wn-born leaf kind)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (list kind leaf
        (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* (cadr leaf)
                     (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                     (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5))
        50))

(define (pad:wn-split! kind)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (let ((base (if *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) (pad:wn-leaf-now))))
    (if (>= (pad:wn-count base) 4)
        (pad:wn-rej "too many pages on the screen")
        (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find base *wn-sel*)))
          (if (not leaf)
              (pad:wn-rej "that page would be too tiny")
              (let* ((born (pad:wn-born leaf kind))
                     (next (pad:wn-repl base *wn-sel* born))
                     (rects (pad:wn-place next 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
                (if (or (pad:wn-tiny? rects) (pad:wn-overlap? rects))
                    (pad:wn-rej (if (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
                                    "those pages would sit on top of each other"
                                    "that page would be too tiny"))
                    (begin
                      (set! *wn-tree* next)
                      (set! *pl-say*
                            (if *wn-taught*
                                (if (string=? kind "H")
                                    "another page opened beside this one"
                                    "another page opened")
                                "you can open another page next to this one"))
                      (set! *wn-taught* #t)
                      "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:wn-other!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let* ((synced (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
             (nid (pad:wn-after (pad:wn-ids synced) *wn-sel*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* synced)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find synced nid))
        (set! *pl-say* "now this page")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-after ids cur)
  (pad:wn-after2 ids ids cur))

(define (pad:wn-after2 all ids cur)
  (cond
    ((null? ids) (car all))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur) (pair? (cdr ids))) (cadr ids))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur)) (car all))
    (#t (pad:wn-after2 all (cdr ids) cur))))

(define (pad:wn-delete!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (begin
        (pad:wn-install! (cadr (pad:wn-del (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (set! *pl-say* "closed that page")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-only!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
        (set! *wn-tree* #f)
        (set! *pl-say* "just this page now")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-switch! name)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (pad:wn-rej "you are already there")
      (let ((lines (pad:wn-lookup name)))
        (if (not lines)
            (pad:wn-rej "there is no pad with that name")
            (begin
              (if *wn-tree*
                  (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-set-leaf (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*)
                                                   *wn-sel* name 0 0 0 0))
                  0)
              (pad:wn-show! name lines 0 0 0 0)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "now page " name))
              "vi-do")))))

(define (pad:wn-map back)
  (string-append
    "Aura pad map\n"
    "Type M-x, a command, then enter. This page is the whole game.\n"
    "Your page is named " back ". M-x switch:" back " brings it back.\n"
    "find-file opens a file. A short name is enough.\n"
    "search finds text. ctrl-s finds the next. ctrl-g puts you back.\n"
    "list-buffers names open pages. switch-buffer jumps to one.\n"
    "split opens another page under this one.\n"
    "split-horiz opens another page beside this one.\n"
    "other-window moves to the other page.\n"
    "delete-window closes this page. The last page stays.\n"
    "delete-other-windows keeps only this page.\n"
    "ctrl-x 2 splits under. ctrl-x 3 splits beside.\n"
    "ctrl-x o moves. ctrl-x 0 closes. ctrl-x 1 keeps one.\n"
    "Two pages can show one writing, each with its own cursor.\n"))

(define (pad:wn-help! rest)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "help")
      (pad:wn-rej "this page is the map")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-back* *wn-live*)
        (pad:wn-buf! "help" (pad:wn-map *wn-back*))
        (pad:wn-switch! "help")
        (set! *pl-say*
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "this page is the map. M-x switch:"
                                         *wn-back* " goes back")))
        rest
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-sw? w)
  (and (>= (string-length w) 7) (string=? (substring w 0 7) "switch:")))

(define (pad:wn-command w rest)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "split") (string=? w "split-vert")) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? w "split-horiz") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((or (string=? w "other-window") (string=? w "other")) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? w "delete-window") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? w "delete-other-windows") (pad:wn-only!))
    ((or (string=? w "help") (string=? w "map")) (pad:wn-help! rest))
    ((string=? w "switch-window") (pad:wn-switch! rest))
    ((pad:wn-sw? w) (pad:wn-switch! (substring w 7 (string-length w))))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-cx! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 50) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((= b 51) (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((= b 48) (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((= b 49) (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "IN 50") (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? line "IN 51") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((string=? line "IN 111") (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? line "IN 48") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? line "IN 49") (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-vis n)
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 32) (<= n 126))
      (list->string (list n))
      "?"))

(define (pad:wn-spaces s n)
  (if (<= n 0) s (pad:wn-spaces (string-append s " ") (- n 1))))

(define (pad:wn-slice codes i left end acc)
  (cond
    ((>= i end) acc)
    ((null? codes) (pad:wn-spaces acc (- end i)))
    ((< i left) (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end acc))
    (#t (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end
                      (string-append acc (pad:wn-vis (car codes)))))))

(define (pad:wn-rep ch n)
  (cond
    ((<= n 0) "")
    ((= n 1) ch)
    (#t (let ((h (pad:wn-rep ch (quotient n 2))))
          (if (= (modulo n 2) 0)
              (string-append h h)
              (string-append h h ch))))))

(define (pad:wn-nth lines i)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((= i 0) (car lines))
    (#t (pad:wn-nth (cdr lines) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:wn-border st)
  (cond ((= st 1) "*") ((= st 2) "+") (#t "|")))

(define (pad:wn-wh s)
  (cond
    ((string=? s "helper") 1)
    ((string=? s "macro") 2)
    ((string=? s "law") 3)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:wn-cy line top h)
  (let ((y (- line top)))
    (cond ((< y 0) 0) ((>= y h) (- h 1)) (#t y))))

(define (pad:wn-cx col left w)
  (let ((x (- col left)))
    (cond ((< x 0) 0) ((> x w) w) (#t x))))

(define (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border i)
  (if (>= i h)
      ""
      (let ((pay (string-append
                   (pad:wn-slice (pad:wn-nth lines (+ top i)) 0 left (+ left (- w 1)) "")
                   border))
            (dots (pad:wn-rep "." w)))
        (string-append "T " pay "\nH " dots "\nM " dots "\n"
                       (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border (+ i 1))))))

(define (pad:wn-one rec)
  (let* ((leaf (car rec))
         (r (cadr rec))
         (c (list-ref rec 2))
         (h (list-ref rec 3))
         (w (list-ref rec 4))
         (top (list-ref leaf 4))
         (left (list-ref leaf 5))
         (sel (if (= (car leaf) *wn-sel*) 1 0))
         (cy (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cy (list-ref leaf 2) top h) 0))
         (cx (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cx (list-ref leaf 3) left w) 0)))
    (string-append
      "WIN r=" (number->string r)
      " c=" (number->string c)
      " h=" (number->string h)
      " w=" (number->string w)
      " sel=" (number->string sel)
      " top=" (number->string top)
      " left=" (number->string left)
      " cy=" (number->string cy)
      " cx=" (number->string cx)
      " st=" (number->string (list-ref leaf 7))
      " wh=" (number->string (pad:wn-wh (list-ref leaf 8)))
      "\n"
      (pad:wn-block (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf)) top left h w
                    (pad:wn-border (list-ref leaf 7)) 0))))

(define (pad:wn-body rects)
  (if (null? rects) "" (string-append (pad:wn-one (car rects)) (pad:wn-body (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-snap)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:play-snap)
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-apply (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))
                                      *wn-tree*))
        (let ((rects (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
          (pad:wn-note! rects)
          (string-append
            "SNAP v1 pad\n"
            "TITLE " (pad:play-title) "\n"
            "CURSOR line=0 col=0\n"
            "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
            "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
            "WINS n=" (number->string (length rects)) "\n"
            (pad:wn-body rects)
            "END\n")))))

(define pad:em-command-1 pad:em-command)
(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (let ((d (pad:wn-command w rest)))
    (if d d (pad:em-command-1 w rest mx))))

(define pad:pf-save-1 pad:pf-save!)
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if (or (string=? *wn-live* "")
          (not *pf-on*)
          (string=? *wn-live* *pf-name*))
      (pad:pf-save-1)
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "switch to the file page to save")
        "skip")))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M14 -- Emacs windows on one frame.
;;
;; A buffer is the text. A window is a view (buffer, point, window-start).
;; The frame is one binary tree for this terminal: "V" is split-window-below,
;; "H" is split-window-right. Keys go to the selected window. Deleting a
;; window does not delete its buffer.
;;
;; One window (the tree is empty) keeps today's SNAP, byte for byte.
;; Two or more windows emit WINS / WIN rectangles. C only paints them.
;; M-x help opens a page that explains the game. Soft reserved: never
;; bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372).

(define *wn-tree* #f)
(define *wn-live* "")
(define *wn-back* "page")
(define *wn-store* (list))
(define *wn-sel* 0)
(define *wn-seq* 0)
(define *wn-taught* #f)

(define (pad:wn-many?)
  (and (pair? *wn-tree*) (string? (car *wn-tree*))))

(define (pad:wn-rows) (pad:vw-rows-now))
(define (pad:wn-cols) (pad:vw-cols-now))

(define (pad:wn-here)
  (if (and *pf-on* (string? *pf-name*) (> (string-length *pf-name*) 0))
      *pf-name*
      "page"))

(define (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines acc)
  (cond
    ((null? store) (reverse (cons (list name lines) acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons (list name lines) (cdr store))))
    (#t (pad:wn-put-acc (cdr store) name lines (cons (car store) acc)))))

(define (pad:wn-put store name lines)
  (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines (list)))

(define (pad:wn-got store name)
  (cond
    ((null? store) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name) (cadr (car store)))
    (#t (pad:wn-got (cdr store) name))))

(define (pad:wn-em-name name bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (list-ref (car bufs) 1) name)
     (pad:v-lines (list-ref (car bufs) 2)))
    (#t (pad:wn-em-name name (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:wn-reset!)
  (set! *wn-tree* #f)
  (set! *wn-live* "")
  (set! *wn-store* (list))
  (set! *wn-sel* 0)
  (set! *wn-taught* #f)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-live* (pad:wn-here))
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*))))
      0))

(define (pad:wn-buf! name src)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* name (pad:v-lines src)))
  name)

(define (pad:wn-lookup name)
  (if (or (not (string? name)) (string=? name ""))
      #f
      (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
          (car *pl-st*)
          (let ((g (pad:wn-got *wn-store* name)))
            (if g g (pad:wn-em-name name *em-bufs*))))))

(define (pad:wn-lines-of name)
  (let ((g (pad:wn-lookup name)))
    (if g g (list (list)))))

(define (pad:wn-rej say)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:wn-show! name lines line col top left)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) line col
                          (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at lines line col))
        (set! *wn-live* name)
        (pad:lc-reset!)))
  (set! *vw-top* top)
  (set! *vw-left* left)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-leaf id name line col top left)
  (list id name line col top left 0 0 "kid"))

(define (pad:wn-leaf-now)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (set! *wn-sel* *wn-seq*)
  (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*) *vw-top* *vw-left*))

(define (pad:wn-ratio node)
  (if (and (> (length node) 3) (number? (list-ref node 3)))
      (list-ref node 3)
      50))

(define (pad:wn-count node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      1
      (+ (pad:wn-count (cadr node)) (pad:wn-count (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-find node id)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) node #f))
    (#t (let ((a (pad:wn-find (cadr node) id)))
          (if a a (pad:wn-find (caddr node) id))))))

(define (pad:wn-ids node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (car node))
      (append (pad:wn-ids (cadr node)) (pad:wn-ids (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-repl node id born)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) born node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-repl (cadr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-repl (caddr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-sync node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) *wn-sel*)
          (list (car node) *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                *vw-top* *vw-left*
                (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
          node)
      (list (car node)
            (pad:wn-sync (cadr node))
            (pad:wn-sync (caddr node))
            (pad:wn-ratio node))))

(define (pad:wn-set-leaf node id name line col top left)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node))
     (if (= (car node) id)
         (list id name line col top left
               (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
         node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (cadr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (caddr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-put-leaf node leaf)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) (car leaf)) leaf node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (cadr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (caddr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-del node id)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) id) (list "gone") (list "keep" node))
      (let ((a (pad:wn-del (cadr node) id))
            (b (pad:wn-del (caddr node) id)))
        (cond
          ((string=? (car a) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr b)))
          ((string=? (car b) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr a)))
          (#t (list "keep"
                    (list (car node) (cadr a) (cadr b) (pad:wn-ratio node))))))))

(define (pad:wn-share total ratio)
  (if (< total 4)
      1
      (let ((n (quotient (* total ratio) 100)))
        (cond ((< n 2) 2) ((> n (- total 2)) (- total 2)) (#t n)))))

(define (pad:wn-place node r c h w)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (list node r c h w))
      (if (string=? (car node) "V")
          (let ((h1 (pad:wn-share h (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h1 w)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) (+ r h1) c (- h h1) w)))
          (let ((w1 (pad:wn-share w (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h w1)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) r (+ c w1) h (- w w1)))))))

(define (pad:wn-tiny? rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) #f)
    ((let ((h (list-ref (car rects) 3)) (w (list-ref (car rects) 4)))
       (or (< h 2) (< w 8))) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-tiny? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-hit? a b)
  (let ((ar (cadr a)) (ac (list-ref a 2)) (ah (list-ref a 3)) (aw (list-ref a 4))
        (br (cadr b)) (bc (list-ref b 2)) (bh (list-ref b 3)) (bw (list-ref b 4)))
    (and (< ar (+ br bh)) (< br (+ ar ah))
         (< ac (+ bc bw)) (< bc (+ ac aw)))))

(define (pad:wn-ov1 a rest)
  (cond
    ((null? rest) #f)
    ((pad:wn-hit? a (car rest)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-ov1 a (cdr rest)))))

(define (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
  (cond
    ((or (null? rects) (null? (cdr rects))) #f)
    ((pad:wn-ov1 (car rects) (cdr rects)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-overlap? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-scrolled leaf h w)
  (let* ((textw (if (> w 1) (- w 1) 1))
         (n (length (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))))
         (top (pad:vw-clamp (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 4) h) h n))
         (left (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 3) (list-ref leaf 5) textw)))
    (list (car leaf) (cadr leaf) (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
          top left (list-ref leaf 6) (list-ref leaf 7) (list-ref leaf 8))))

(define (pad:wn-apply rects tree)
  (if (null? rects)
      tree
      (let* ((rec (car rects))
             (leaf (pad:wn-scrolled (car rec) (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4))))
        (pad:wn-apply (cdr rects) (pad:wn-put-leaf tree leaf)))))

(define (pad:wn-note! rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) 0)
    ((= (car (car (car rects))) *wn-sel*)
     (set! *vw-top* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 4))
     (set! *vw-left* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 5)))
    (#t (pad:wn-note! (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
  (set! *wn-sel* (car leaf))
  (pad:wn-show! (cadr leaf)
                (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))
                (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5)))

(define (pad:wn-install! node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (begin (pad:wn-focus! node) (set! *wn-tree* #f))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-tree* node)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find node (car (pad:wn-ids node))))))
  0)

(define (pad:wn-born leaf kind)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (list kind leaf
        (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* (cadr leaf)
                     (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                     (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5))
        50))

(define (pad:wn-split! kind)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (let ((base (if *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) (pad:wn-leaf-now))))
    (if (>= (pad:wn-count base) 4)
        (pad:wn-rej "too many pages on the screen")
        (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find base *wn-sel*)))
          (if (not leaf)
              (pad:wn-rej "that page would be too tiny")
              (let* ((born (pad:wn-born leaf kind))
                     (next (pad:wn-repl base *wn-sel* born))
                     (rects (pad:wn-place next 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
                (if (or (pad:wn-tiny? rects) (pad:wn-overlap? rects))
                    (pad:wn-rej (if (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
                                    "those pages would sit on top of each other"
                                    "that page would be too tiny"))
                    (begin
                      (set! *wn-tree* next)
                      (set! *pl-say*
                            (if *wn-taught*
                                (if (string=? kind "H")
                                    "another page opened beside this one"
                                    "another page opened")
                                "you can open another page next to this one"))
                      (set! *wn-taught* #t)
                      "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:wn-other!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let* ((synced (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
             (nid (pad:wn-after (pad:wn-ids synced) *wn-sel*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* synced)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find synced nid))
        (set! *pl-say* "now this page")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-after ids cur)
  (pad:wn-after2 ids ids cur))

(define (pad:wn-after2 all ids cur)
  (cond
    ((null? ids) (car all))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur) (pair? (cdr ids))) (cadr ids))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur)) (car all))
    (#t (pad:wn-after2 all (cdr ids) cur))))

(define (pad:wn-delete!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (begin
        (pad:wn-install! (cadr (pad:wn-del (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (set! *pl-say* "closed that page")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-only!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
        (set! *wn-tree* #f)
        (set! *pl-say* "just this page now")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-switch! name)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (pad:wn-rej "you are already there")
      (let ((lines (pad:wn-lookup name)))
        (if (not lines)
            (pad:wn-rej "there is no pad with that name")
            (begin
              (if *wn-tree*
                  (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-set-leaf (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*)
                                                   *wn-sel* name 0 0 0 0))
                  0)
              (pad:wn-show! name lines 0 0 0 0)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "now page " name))
              "vi-do")))))

(define (pad:wn-map back)
  (string-append
    "Aura pad map\n"
    "Type M-x, a command, then enter. This page is the whole game.\n"
    "Your page is named " back ". M-x switch:" back " brings it back.\n"
    "find-file opens a file. A short name is enough.\n"
    "search finds text. ctrl-s finds the next. ctrl-g puts you back.\n"
    "list-buffers names open pages. switch-buffer jumps to one.\n"
    "split opens another page under this one.\n"
    "split-horiz opens another page beside this one.\n"
    "other-window moves to the other page.\n"
    "delete-window closes this page. The last page stays.\n"
    "delete-other-windows keeps only this page.\n"
    "ctrl-x 2 splits under. ctrl-x 3 splits beside.\n"
    "ctrl-x o moves. ctrl-x 0 closes. ctrl-x 1 keeps one.\n"
    "Two pages can show one writing, each with its own cursor.\n"))

(define (pad:wn-help! rest)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "help")
      (pad:wn-rej "this page is the map")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-back* *wn-live*)
        (pad:wn-buf! "help" (pad:wn-map *wn-back*))
        (pad:wn-switch! "help")
        (set! *pl-say*
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "this page is the map. M-x switch:"
                                         *wn-back* " goes back")))
        rest
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-sw? w)
  (and (>= (string-length w) 7) (string=? (substring w 0 7) "switch:")))

(define (pad:wn-command w rest)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "split") (string=? w "split-vert")) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? w "split-horiz") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((or (string=? w "other-window") (string=? w "other")) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? w "delete-window") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? w "delete-other-windows") (pad:wn-only!))
    ((or (string=? w "help") (string=? w "map")) (pad:wn-help! rest))
    ((string=? w "switch-window") (pad:wn-switch! rest))
    ((pad:wn-sw? w) (pad:wn-switch! (substring w 7 (string-length w))))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-cx! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 50) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((= b 51) (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((= b 48) (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((= b 49) (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "IN 50") (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? line "IN 51") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((string=? line "IN 111") (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? line "IN 48") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? line "IN 49") (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-vis n)
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 32) (<= n 126))
      (list->string (list n))
      "?"))

(define (pad:wn-spaces s n)
  (if (<= n 0) s (pad:wn-spaces (string-append s " ") (- n 1))))

(define (pad:wn-slice codes i left end acc)
  (cond
    ((>= i end) acc)
    ((null? codes) (pad:wn-spaces acc (- end i)))
    ((< i left) (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end acc))
    (#t (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end
                      (string-append acc (pad:wn-vis (car codes)))))))

(define (pad:wn-rep ch n)
  (cond
    ((<= n 0) "")
    ((= n 1) ch)
    (#t (let ((h (pad:wn-rep ch (quotient n 2))))
          (if (= (modulo n 2) 0)
              (string-append h h)
              (string-append h h ch))))))

(define (pad:wn-nth lines i)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((= i 0) (car lines))
    (#t (pad:wn-nth (cdr lines) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:wn-border st)
  (cond ((= st 1) "*") ((= st 2) "+") (#t "|")))

(define (pad:wn-wh s)
  (cond
    ((string=? s "helper") 1)
    ((string=? s "macro") 2)
    ((string=? s "law") 3)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:wn-cy line top h)
  (let ((y (- line top)))
    (cond ((< y 0) 0) ((>= y h) (- h 1)) (#t y))))

(define (pad:wn-cx col left w)
  (let ((x (- col left)))
    (cond ((< x 0) 0) ((> x w) w) (#t x))))

(define (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border i)
  (if (>= i h)
      ""
      (let ((pay (string-append
                   (pad:wn-slice (pad:wn-nth lines (+ top i)) 0 left (+ left (- w 1)) "")
                   border))
            (dots (pad:wn-rep "." w)))
        (string-append "T " pay "\nH " dots "\nM " dots "\n"
                       (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border (+ i 1))))))

(define (pad:wn-one rec)
  (let* ((leaf (car rec))
         (r (cadr rec))
         (c (list-ref rec 2))
         (h (list-ref rec 3))
         (w (list-ref rec 4))
         (top (list-ref leaf 4))
         (left (list-ref leaf 5))
         (sel (if (= (car leaf) *wn-sel*) 1 0))
         (cy (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cy (list-ref leaf 2) top h) 0))
         (cx (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cx (list-ref leaf 3) left w) 0)))
    (string-append
      "WIN r=" (number->string r)
      " c=" (number->string c)
      " h=" (number->string h)
      " w=" (number->string w)
      " sel=" (number->string sel)
      " top=" (number->string top)
      " left=" (number->string left)
      " cy=" (number->string cy)
      " cx=" (number->string cx)
      " st=" (number->string (list-ref leaf 7))
      " wh=" (number->string (pad:wn-wh (list-ref leaf 8)))
      "\n"
      (pad:wn-block (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf)) top left h w
                    (pad:wn-border (list-ref leaf 7)) 0))))

(define (pad:wn-body rects)
  (if (null? rects) "" (string-append (pad:wn-one (car rects)) (pad:wn-body (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-snap)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:play-snap)
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-apply (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))
                                      *wn-tree*))
        (let ((rects (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
          (pad:wn-note! rects)
          (string-append
            "SNAP v1 pad\n"
            "TITLE " (pad:play-title) "\n"
            "CURSOR line=0 col=0\n"
            "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
            "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
            "WINS n=" (number->string (length rects)) "\n"
            (pad:wn-body rects)
            "END\n")))))

(define pad:em-command-1 pad:em-command)
(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (let ((d (pad:wn-command w rest)))
    (if d d (pad:em-command-1 w rest mx))))

(define pad:pf-save-1 pad:pf-save!)
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if (or (string=? *wn-live* "")
          (not *pf-on*)
          (string=? *wn-live* *pf-name*))
      (pad:pf-save-1)
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "switch to the file page to save")
        "skip")))

target.body:
(lambda (w rest) (cond
    ((or (string=? w "split") (string=? w "split-vert")) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? w "split-horiz") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((or (string=? w "other-window") (string=? w "other")) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? w "delete-window") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? w "delete-other-windows") (pad:wn-only!))
    ((or (string=? w "help") (string=? w "map")) (pad:wn-help! rest))
    ((string=? w "switch-window") (pad:wn-switch! rest))
    ((pad:wn-sw? w) (pad:wn-switch! (substring w 7 (string-length w))))
    ((pad:ly-word? w) (pad:wn-layout! w rest))
    (#t #f)))

;; aura-pad M14 -- Emacs windows on one frame.
;;
;; A buffer is the text. A window is a view (buffer, point, window-start).
;; The frame is one binary tree for this terminal: "V" is split-window-below,
;; "H" is split-window-right. Keys go to the selected window. Deleting a
;; window does not delete its buffer.
;;
;; One window (the tree is empty) keeps today's SNAP, byte for byte.
;; Two or more windows emit WINS / WIN rectangles. C only paints them.
;; M-x help opens a page that explains the game. Soft reserved: never
;; bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372).

(define *wn-tree* #f)
(define *wn-live* "")
(define *wn-back* "page")
(define *wn-store* (list))
(define *wn-sel* 0)
(define *wn-seq* 0)
(define *wn-taught* #f)

(define (pad:wn-many?)
  (and (pair? *wn-tree*) (string? (car *wn-tree*))))

(define (pad:wn-rows) (pad:vw-rows-now))
(define (pad:wn-cols) (pad:vw-cols-now))

(define (pad:wn-here)
  (if (and *pf-on* (string? *pf-name*) (> (string-length *pf-name*) 0))
      *pf-name*
      "page"))

(define (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines acc)
  (cond
    ((null? store) (reverse (cons (list name lines) acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons (list name lines) (cdr store))))
    (#t (pad:wn-put-acc (cdr store) name lines (cons (car store) acc)))))

(define (pad:wn-put store name lines)
  (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines (list)))

(define (pad:wn-got store name)
  (cond
    ((null? store) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name) (cadr (car store)))
    (#t (pad:wn-got (cdr store) name))))

(define (pad:wn-em-name name bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (list-ref (car bufs) 1) name)
     (pad:v-lines (list-ref (car bufs) 2)))
    (#t (pad:wn-em-name name (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:wn-reset!)
  (set! *wn-tree* #f)
  (set! *wn-live* "")
  (set! *wn-store* (list))
  (set! *wn-sel* 0)
  (set! *wn-taught* #f)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-live* (pad:wn-here))
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*))))
      0))

(define (pad:wn-buf! name src)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* name (pad:v-lines src)))
  name)

(define (pad:wn-lookup name)
  (if (or (not (string? name)) (string=? name ""))
      #f
      (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
          (car *pl-st*)
          (let ((g (pad:wn-got *wn-store* name)))
            (if g g (pad:wn-em-name name *em-bufs*))))))

(define (pad:wn-lines-of name)
  (let ((g (pad:wn-lookup name)))
    (if g g (list (list)))))

(define (pad:wn-rej say)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:wn-show! name lines line col top left)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) line col
                          (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at lines line col))
        (set! *wn-live* name)
        (pad:lc-reset!)))
  (set! *vw-top* top)
  (set! *vw-left* left)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-leaf id name line col top left)
  (list id name line col top left 0 0 "kid"))

(define (pad:wn-leaf-now)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (set! *wn-sel* *wn-seq*)
  (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*) *vw-top* *vw-left*))

(define (pad:wn-ratio node)
  (if (and (> (length node) 3) (number? (list-ref node 3)))
      (list-ref node 3)
      50))

(define (pad:wn-count node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      1
      (+ (pad:wn-count (cadr node)) (pad:wn-count (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-find node id)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) node #f))
    (#t (let ((a (pad:wn-find (cadr node) id)))
          (if a a (pad:wn-find (caddr node) id))))))

(define (pad:wn-ids node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (car node))
      (append (pad:wn-ids (cadr node)) (pad:wn-ids (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-repl node id born)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) born node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-repl (cadr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-repl (caddr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-sync node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) *wn-sel*)
          (list (car node) *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                *vw-top* *vw-left*
                (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
          node)
      (list (car node)
            (pad:wn-sync (cadr node))
            (pad:wn-sync (caddr node))
            (pad:wn-ratio node))))

(define (pad:wn-set-leaf node id name line col top left)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node))
     (if (= (car node) id)
         (list id name line col top left
               (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
         node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (cadr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (caddr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-put-leaf node leaf)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) (car leaf)) leaf node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (cadr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (caddr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-del node id)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) id) (list "gone") (list "keep" node))
      (let ((a (pad:wn-del (cadr node) id))
            (b (pad:wn-del (caddr node) id)))
        (cond
          ((string=? (car a) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr b)))
          ((string=? (car b) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr a)))
          (#t (list "keep"
                    (list (car node) (cadr a) (cadr b) (pad:wn-ratio node))))))))

(define (pad:wn-share total ratio)
  (if (< total 4)
      1
      (let ((n (quotient (* total ratio) 100)))
        (cond ((< n 2) 2) ((> n (- total 2)) (- total 2)) (#t n)))))

(define (pad:wn-place node r c h w)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (list node r c h w))
      (if (string=? (car node) "V")
          (let ((h1 (pad:wn-share h (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h1 w)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) (+ r h1) c (- h h1) w)))
          (let ((w1 (pad:wn-share w (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h w1)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) r (+ c w1) h (- w w1)))))))

(define (pad:wn-tiny? rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) #f)
    ((let ((h (list-ref (car rects) 3)) (w (list-ref (car rects) 4)))
       (or (< h 2) (< w 8))) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-tiny? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-hit? a b)
  (let ((ar (cadr a)) (ac (list-ref a 2)) (ah (list-ref a 3)) (aw (list-ref a 4))
        (br (cadr b)) (bc (list-ref b 2)) (bh (list-ref b 3)) (bw (list-ref b 4)))
    (and (< ar (+ br bh)) (< br (+ ar ah))
         (< ac (+ bc bw)) (< bc (+ ac aw)))))

(define (pad:wn-ov1 a rest)
  (cond
    ((null? rest) #f)
    ((pad:wn-hit? a (car rest)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-ov1 a (cdr rest)))))

(define (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
  (cond
    ((or (null? rects) (null? (cdr rects))) #f)
    ((pad:wn-ov1 (car rects) (cdr rects)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-overlap? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-scrolled leaf h w)
  (let* ((textw (if (> w 1) (- w 1) 1))
         (n (length (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))))
         (top (pad:vw-clamp (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 4) h) h n))
         (left (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 3) (list-ref leaf 5) textw)))
    (list (car leaf) (cadr leaf) (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
          top left (list-ref leaf 6) (list-ref leaf 7) (list-ref leaf 8))))

(define (pad:wn-apply rects tree)
  (if (null? rects)
      tree
      (let* ((rec (car rects))
             (leaf (pad:wn-scrolled (car rec) (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4))))
        (pad:wn-apply (cdr rects) (pad:wn-put-leaf tree leaf)))))

(define (pad:wn-note! rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) 0)
    ((= (car (car (car rects))) *wn-sel*)
     (set! *vw-top* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 4))
     (set! *vw-left* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 5)))
    (#t (pad:wn-note! (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
  (set! *wn-sel* (car leaf))
  (pad:wn-show! (cadr leaf)
                (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))
                (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5)))

(define (pad:wn-install! node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (begin (pad:wn-focus! node) (set! *wn-tree* #f))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-tree* node)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find node (car (pad:wn-ids node))))))
  0)

(define (pad:wn-born leaf kind)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (list kind leaf
        (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* (cadr leaf)
                     (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                     (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5))
        50))

(define (pad:wn-split! kind)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (let ((base (if *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) (pad:wn-leaf-now))))
    (if (>= (pad:wn-count base) 4)
        (pad:wn-rej "too many pages on the screen")
        (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find base *wn-sel*)))
          (if (not leaf)
              (pad:wn-rej "that page would be too tiny")
              (let* ((born (pad:wn-born leaf kind))
                     (next (pad:wn-repl base *wn-sel* born))
                     (rects (pad:wn-place next 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
                (if (or (pad:wn-tiny? rects) (pad:wn-overlap? rects))
                    (pad:wn-rej (if (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
                                    "those pages would sit on top of each other"
                                    "that page would be too tiny"))
                    (begin
                      (set! *wn-tree* next)
                      (set! *pl-say*
                            (if *wn-taught*
                                (if (string=? kind "H")
                                    "another page opened beside this one"
                                    "another page opened")
                                "you can open another page next to this one"))
                      (set! *wn-taught* #t)
                      "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:wn-other!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let* ((synced (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
             (nid (pad:wn-after (pad:wn-ids synced) *wn-sel*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* synced)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find synced nid))
        (set! *pl-say* "now this page")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-after ids cur)
  (pad:wn-after2 ids ids cur))

(define (pad:wn-after2 all ids cur)
  (cond
    ((null? ids) (car all))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur) (pair? (cdr ids))) (cadr ids))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur)) (car all))
    (#t (pad:wn-after2 all (cdr ids) cur))))

(define (pad:wn-delete!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (begin
        (pad:wn-install! (cadr (pad:wn-del (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (set! *pl-say* "closed that page")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-only!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
        (set! *wn-tree* #f)
        (set! *pl-say* "just this page now")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-switch! name)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (pad:wn-rej "you are already there")
      (let ((lines (pad:wn-lookup name)))
        (if (not lines)
            (pad:wn-rej "there is no pad with that name")
            (begin
              (if *wn-tree*
                  (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-set-leaf (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*)
                                                   *wn-sel* name 0 0 0 0))
                  0)
              (pad:wn-show! name lines 0 0 0 0)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "now page " name))
              "vi-do")))))

(define (pad:wn-map back)
  (string-append
    "Aura pad map\n"
    "Type M-x, a command, then enter. This page is the whole game.\n"
    "Your page is named " back ". M-x switch:" back " brings it back.\n"
    "find-file opens a file. A short name is enough.\n"
    "search finds text. ctrl-s finds the next. ctrl-g puts you back.\n"
    "list-buffers names open pages. switch-buffer jumps to one.\n"
    "split opens another page under this one.\n"
    "split-horiz opens another page beside this one.\n"
    "other-window moves to the other page.\n"
    "delete-window closes this page. The last page stays.\n"
    "delete-other-windows keeps only this page.\n"
    "ctrl-x 2 splits under. ctrl-x 3 splits beside.\n"
    "ctrl-x o moves. ctrl-x 0 closes. ctrl-x 1 keeps one.\n"
    "Two pages can show one writing, each with its own cursor.\n"
    "layout races pictures of your pages. The best one stays.\n"
    "The line says this layout wins.\n"
    "layout:story fills the screen with the story.\n"
    "layout:beside opens a helper page beside the story.\n"
    "layout:book stacks the pages like a book.\n"
    "layout:undo puts the old picture back.\n"))

(define (pad:wn-help! rest)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "help")
      (pad:wn-rej "this page is the map")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-back* *wn-live*)
        (pad:wn-buf! "help" (pad:wn-map *wn-back*))
        (pad:wn-switch! "help")
        (set! *pl-say*
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "this page is the map. M-x switch:"
                                         *wn-back* " goes back")))
        rest
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-sw? w)
  (and (>= (string-length w) 7) (string=? (substring w 0 7) "switch:")))

;; Layout worldlines stay off the key path. The first layout: command
;; loads layout.aura. A normal key never does.
(define *ly-ready* #f)

(define (pad:ly-word? w)
  (and (string? w) (>= (string-length w) 6)
       (string=? (substring w 0 6) "layout")))

(define (pad:wn-layout! w rest)
  (if (not *ly-ready*)
      (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/layout.aura")))
  (if *ly-ready* (pad:ly-run! w rest) #f))

(define (pad:wn-command w rest)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "split") (string=? w "split-vert")) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? w "split-horiz") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((or (string=? w "other-window") (string=? w "other")) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? w "delete-window") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? w "delete-other-windows") (pad:wn-only!))
    ((or (string=? w "help") (string=? w "map")) (pad:wn-help! rest))
    ((string=? w "switch-window") (pad:wn-switch! rest))
    ((pad:wn-sw? w) (pad:wn-switch! (substring w 7 (string-length w))))
    ((pad:ly-word? w) (pad:wn-layout! w rest))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-cx! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 50) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((= b 51) (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((= b 48) (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((= b 49) (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "IN 50") (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? line "IN 51") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((string=? line "IN 111") (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? line "IN 48") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? line "IN 49") (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-vis n)
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 32) (<= n 126))
      (list->string (list n))
      "?"))

(define (pad:wn-spaces s n)
  (if (<= n 0) s (pad:wn-spaces (string-append s " ") (- n 1))))

(define (pad:wn-slice codes i left end acc)
  (cond
    ((>= i end) acc)
    ((null? codes) (pad:wn-spaces acc (- end i)))
    ((< i left) (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end acc))
    (#t (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end
                      (string-append acc (pad:wn-vis (car codes)))))))

(define (pad:wn-rep ch n)
  (cond
    ((<= n 0) "")
    ((= n 1) ch)
    (#t (let ((h (pad:wn-rep ch (quotient n 2))))
          (if (= (modulo n 2) 0)
              (string-append h h)
              (string-append h h ch))))))

(define (pad:wn-nth lines i)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((= i 0) (car lines))
    (#t (pad:wn-nth (cdr lines) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:wn-border st)
  (cond ((= st 1) "*") ((= st 2) "+") (#t "|")))

(define (pad:wn-wh s)
  (cond
    ((string=? s "helper") 1)
    ((string=? s "macro") 2)
    ((string=? s "law") 3)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:wn-cy line top h)
  (let ((y (- line top)))
    (cond ((< y 0) 0) ((>= y h) (- h 1)) (#t y))))

(define (pad:wn-cx col left w)
  (let ((x (- col left)))
    (cond ((< x 0) 0) ((> x w) w) (#t x))))

(define (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border i)
  (if (>= i h)
      ""
      (let ((pay (string-append
                   (pad:wn-slice (pad:wn-nth lines (+ top i)) 0 left (+ left (- w 1)) "")
                   border))
            (dots (pad:wn-rep "." w)))
        (string-append "T " pay "\nH " dots "\nM " dots "\n"
                       (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border (+ i 1))))))

(define (pad:wn-one rec)
  (let* ((leaf (car rec))
         (r (cadr rec))
         (c (list-ref rec 2))
         (h (list-ref rec 3))
         (w (list-ref rec 4))
         (top (list-ref leaf 4))
         (left (list-ref leaf 5))
         (sel (if (= (car leaf) *wn-sel*) 1 0))
         (cy (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cy (list-ref leaf 2) top h) 0))
         (cx (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cx (list-ref leaf 3) left w) 0)))
    (string-append
      "WIN r=" (number->string r)
      " c=" (number->string c)
      " h=" (number->string h)
      " w=" (number->string w)
      " sel=" (number->string sel)
      " top=" (number->string top)
      " left=" (number->string left)
      " cy=" (number->string cy)
      " cx=" (number->string cx)
      " st=" (number->string (list-ref leaf 7))
      " wh=" (number->string (pad:wn-wh (list-ref leaf 8)))
      "\n"
      (pad:wn-block (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf)) top left h w
                    (pad:wn-border (list-ref leaf 7)) 0))))

(define (pad:wn-body rects)
  (if (null? rects) "" (string-append (pad:wn-one (car rects)) (pad:wn-body (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-snap)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:play-snap)
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-apply (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))
                                      *wn-tree*))
        (let ((rects (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
          (pad:wn-note! rects)
          (string-append
            "SNAP v1 pad\n"
            "TITLE " (pad:play-title) "\n"
            "CURSOR line=0 col=0\n"
            "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
            "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
            "WINS n=" (number->string (length rects)) "\n"
            (pad:wn-body rects)
            "END\n")))))

(define pad:em-command-1 pad:em-command)
(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (let ((d (pad:wn-command w rest)))
    (if d d (pad:em-command-1 w rest mx))))

(define pad:pf-save-1 pad:pf-save!)
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if (or (string=? *wn-live* "")
          (not *pf-on*)
          (string=? *wn-live* *pf-name*))
      (pad:pf-save-1)
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "switch to the file page to save")
        "skip")))

target.name: pad:wn-other!
target.body:
(lambda () (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let* ((synced (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
             (nid (pad:wn-after (pad:wn-ids synced) *wn-sel*))
             (leaf (pad:wn-find synced nid)))
        (set! *wn-tree* synced)
        (if (pad:wn-ded? leaf)
            (begin
              (set! *pl-say* "that page is the helper")
              "vi-do")
            (begin
              (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
              (set! *pl-say* "now this page")
              "vi-do")))))
