;; aura-pad M14 -- Emacs windows on one frame.
;;
;; A buffer is the text. A window is a view (buffer, point, window-start).
;; The frame is one binary tree for this terminal: "V" is split-window-below,
;; "H" is split-window-right. Keys go to the selected window. Deleting a
;; window does not delete its buffer.
;;
;; One window (the tree is empty) keeps today's SNAP, byte for byte.
;; Two or more windows emit WINS / WIN rectangles. C only paints them.
;; M-x help opens a page that explains the game. Soft reserved: never
;; bind quote. No while+set! (aura#4372).

(define *wn-tree* #f)
(define *wn-live* "")
(define *wn-back* "page")
(define *wn-store* (list))
(define *wn-sel* 0)
(define *wn-seq* 0)
(define *wn-taught* #f)

(define (pad:wn-many?)
  (and (pair? *wn-tree*) (string? (car *wn-tree*))))

(define (pad:wn-rows) (pad:vw-rows-now))
(define (pad:wn-cols) (pad:vw-cols-now))

(define (pad:wn-here)
  (if (and *pf-on* (string? *pf-name*) (> (string-length *pf-name*) 0))
      *pf-name*
      "page"))

(define (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines acc)
  (cond
    ((null? store) (reverse (cons (list name lines) acc)))
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name)
     (append (reverse acc) (cons (list name lines) (cdr store))))
    (#t (pad:wn-put-acc (cdr store) name lines (cons (car store) acc)))))

(define (pad:wn-put store name lines)
  (pad:wn-put-acc store name lines (list)))

(define (pad:wn-got store name)
  (cond
    ((null? store) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car store)) name) (cadr (car store)))
    (#t (pad:wn-got (cdr store) name))))

(define (pad:wn-em-name name bufs)
  (cond
    ((null? bufs) #f)
    ((string=? (list-ref (car bufs) 1) name)
     (pad:v-lines (list-ref (car bufs) 2)))
    (#t (pad:wn-em-name name (cdr bufs)))))

(define (pad:wn-reset!)
  (set! *wn-tree* #f)
  (set! *wn-live* "")
  (set! *wn-store* (list))
  (set! *wn-sel* 0)
  (set! *wn-taught* #f)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-live* (pad:wn-here))
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*))))
      0))

(define (pad:wn-buf! name src)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* name (pad:v-lines src)))
  name)

(define (pad:wn-lookup name)
  (if (or (not (string? name)) (string=? name ""))
      #f
      (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
          (car *pl-st*)
          (let ((g (pad:wn-got *wn-store* name)))
            (if g g (pad:wn-em-name name *em-bufs*))))))

(define (pad:wn-lines-of name)
  (let ((g (pad:wn-lookup name)))
    (if g g (list (list)))))

(define (pad:wn-rej say)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:wn-show! name lines line col top left)
  (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) line col
                          (list-ref *pl-st* 3) (list-ref *pl-st* 4) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at lines line col))
        (set! *wn-live* name)
        (pad:lc-reset!)))
  (set! *vw-top* top)
  (set! *vw-left* left)
  0)

(define (pad:wn-leaf id name line col top left)
  (list id name line col top left 0 0 "kid"))

(define (pad:wn-leaf-now)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (set! *wn-sel* *wn-seq*)
  (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*) *vw-top* *vw-left*))

(define (pad:wn-ratio node)
  (if (and (> (length node) 3) (number? (list-ref node 3)))
      (list-ref node 3)
      50))

(define (pad:wn-count node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      1
      (+ (pad:wn-count (cadr node)) (pad:wn-count (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-find node id)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) node #f))
    (#t (let ((a (pad:wn-find (cadr node) id)))
          (if a a (pad:wn-find (caddr node) id))))))

(define (pad:wn-ids node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (car node))
      (append (pad:wn-ids (cadr node)) (pad:wn-ids (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-repl node id born)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) id) born node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-repl (cadr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-repl (caddr node) id born)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-sync node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) *wn-sel*)
          (list (car node) *wn-live* (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                *vw-top* *vw-left*
                (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
          node)
      (list (car node)
            (pad:wn-sync (cadr node))
            (pad:wn-sync (caddr node))
            (pad:wn-ratio node))))

(define (pad:wn-set-leaf node id name line col top left)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node))
     (if (= (car node) id)
         (list id name line col top left
               (list-ref node 6) (list-ref node 7) (list-ref node 8))
         node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (cadr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-set-leaf (caddr node) id name line col top left)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-put-leaf node leaf)
  (cond
    ((number? (car node)) (if (= (car node) (car leaf)) leaf node))
    (#t (list (car node)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (cadr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-put-leaf (caddr node) leaf)
              (pad:wn-ratio node)))))

(define (pad:wn-del node id)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (= (car node) id) (list "gone") (list "keep" node))
      (let ((a (pad:wn-del (cadr node) id))
            (b (pad:wn-del (caddr node) id)))
        (cond
          ((string=? (car a) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr b)))
          ((string=? (car b) "gone") (list "keep" (cadr a)))
          (#t (list "keep"
                    (list (car node) (cadr a) (cadr b) (pad:wn-ratio node))))))))

(define (pad:wn-share total ratio)
  (if (< total 4)
      1
      (let ((n (quotient (* total ratio) 100)))
        (cond ((< n 2) 2) ((> n (- total 2)) (- total 2)) (#t n)))))

(define (pad:wn-place node r c h w)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (list (list node r c h w))
      (if (string=? (car node) "V")
          (let ((h1 (pad:wn-share h (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h1 w)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) (+ r h1) c (- h h1) w)))
          (let ((w1 (pad:wn-share w (pad:wn-ratio node))))
            (append (pad:wn-place (cadr node) r c h w1)
                    (pad:wn-place (caddr node) r (+ c w1) h (- w w1)))))))

(define (pad:wn-tiny? rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) #f)
    ((let ((h (list-ref (car rects) 3)) (w (list-ref (car rects) 4)))
       (or (< h 2) (< w 8))) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-tiny? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-hit? a b)
  (let ((ar (cadr a)) (ac (list-ref a 2)) (ah (list-ref a 3)) (aw (list-ref a 4))
        (br (cadr b)) (bc (list-ref b 2)) (bh (list-ref b 3)) (bw (list-ref b 4)))
    (and (< ar (+ br bh)) (< br (+ ar ah))
         (< ac (+ bc bw)) (< bc (+ ac aw)))))

(define (pad:wn-ov1 a rest)
  (cond
    ((null? rest) #f)
    ((pad:wn-hit? a (car rest)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-ov1 a (cdr rest)))))

(define (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
  (cond
    ((or (null? rects) (null? (cdr rects))) #f)
    ((pad:wn-ov1 (car rects) (cdr rects)) #t)
    (#t (pad:wn-overlap? (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-scrolled leaf h w)
  (let* ((textw (if (> w 1) (- w 1) 1))
         (n (length (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))))
         (top (pad:vw-clamp (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 4) h) h n))
         (left (pad:vw-scroll (list-ref leaf 3) (list-ref leaf 5) textw)))
    (list (car leaf) (cadr leaf) (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
          top left (list-ref leaf 6) (list-ref leaf 7) (list-ref leaf 8))))

(define (pad:wn-apply rects tree)
  (if (null? rects)
      tree
      (let* ((rec (car rects))
             (leaf (pad:wn-scrolled (car rec) (list-ref rec 3) (list-ref rec 4))))
        (pad:wn-apply (cdr rects) (pad:wn-put-leaf tree leaf)))))

(define (pad:wn-note! rects)
  (cond
    ((null? rects) 0)
    ((= (car (car (car rects))) *wn-sel*)
     (set! *vw-top* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 4))
     (set! *vw-left* (list-ref (car (car rects)) 5)))
    (#t (pad:wn-note! (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
  (set! *wn-sel* (car leaf))
  (pad:wn-show! (cadr leaf)
                (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf))
                (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5)))

(define (pad:wn-install! node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (begin (pad:wn-focus! node) (set! *wn-tree* #f))
      (begin
        (set! *wn-tree* node)
        (pad:wn-focus! (pad:wn-find node (car (pad:wn-ids node))))))
  0)

(define (pad:wn-born leaf kind)
  (set! *wn-seq* (+ *wn-seq* 1))
  (list kind leaf
        (pad:wn-leaf *wn-seq* (cadr leaf)
                     (list-ref leaf 2) (list-ref leaf 3)
                     (list-ref leaf 4) (list-ref leaf 5))
        50))

(define (pad:wn-split! kind)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (let ((base (if *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) (pad:wn-leaf-now))))
    (if (>= (pad:wn-count base) 4)
        (pad:wn-rej "too many pages on the screen")
        (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find base *wn-sel*)))
          (if (not leaf)
              (pad:wn-rej "that page would be too tiny")
              (let* ((born (pad:wn-born leaf kind))
                     (next (pad:wn-repl base *wn-sel* born))
                     (rects (pad:wn-place next 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
                (if (or (pad:wn-tiny? rects) (pad:wn-overlap? rects))
                    (pad:wn-rej (if (pad:wn-overlap? rects)
                                    "those pages would sit on top of each other"
                                    "that page would be too tiny"))
                    (begin
                      (set! *wn-tree* next)
                      (set! *pl-say*
                            (if *wn-taught*
                                (if (string=? kind "H")
                                    "another page opened beside this one"
                                    "another page opened")
                                "you can open another page next to this one"))
                      (set! *wn-taught* #t)
                      "vi-do"))))))))

(define (pad:wn-ded? leaf)
  (and (pair? leaf) (>= (length leaf) 7) (= (list-ref leaf 6) 1)))

(define (pad:wn-nded node)
  (if (number? (car node))
      (if (pad:wn-ded? node) 0 1)
      (+ (pad:wn-nded (cadr node)) (pad:wn-nded (caddr node)))))

(define (pad:wn-other!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let* ((synced (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
             (nid (pad:wn-after (pad:wn-ids synced) *wn-sel*))
             (leaf (pad:wn-find synced nid)))
        (set! *wn-tree* synced)
        (if (pad:wn-ded? leaf)
            (begin
              (set! *pl-say* "that page is the helper")
              "vi-do")
            (begin
              (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
              (set! *pl-say* "now this page")
              "vi-do")))))

(define (pad:wn-after ids cur)
  (pad:wn-after2 ids ids cur))

(define (pad:wn-after2 all ids cur)
  (cond
    ((null? ids) (car all))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur) (pair? (cdr ids))) (cadr ids))
    ((and (= (car ids) cur)) (car all))
    (#t (pad:wn-after2 all (cdr ids) cur))))

(define (pad:wn-delete!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (if (or (pad:wn-ded? (pad:wn-find *wn-tree* *wn-sel*))
              (<= (pad:wn-nded *wn-tree*) 1))
          (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
          (begin
            (pad:wn-install! (cadr (pad:wn-del (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
            (set! *pl-say* "closed that page")
            "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:wn-only!)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:wn-rej "this is the only page")
      (let ((leaf (pad:wn-find (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*) *wn-sel*)))
        (pad:wn-focus! leaf)
        (set! *wn-tree* #f)
        (set! *pl-say* "just this page now")
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-switch! name)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (and *wn-tree* (pad:wn-ded? (pad:wn-find *wn-tree* *wn-sel*)))
      (pad:wn-rej "that page stays")
      (if (string=? name *wn-live*)
      (pad:wn-rej "you are already there")
      (let ((lines (pad:wn-lookup name)))
        (if (not lines)
            (pad:wn-rej "there is no pad with that name")
            (begin
              (if *wn-tree*
                  (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-set-leaf (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*)
                                                   *wn-sel* name 0 0 0 0))
                  0)
              (pad:wn-show! name lines 0 0 0 0)
              (set! *pl-say* (string-append "now page " name))
              "vi-do"))))))

(define (pad:wn-map back)
  (string-append
    "Aura pad map\n"
    "Type M-x, then a command. Tab completes the word. Space shows the matches and types a space. Enter runs it.\n"
    "Your page is named " back ". M-x switch:" back " brings it back.\n"
    "find-file opens a file. A short name is enough.\n"
    "ask QUESTION chats about this page. The answer opens on the chat page.\n"
    "chat opens that page. rewrite HOW changes this page. u puts yours back.\n"
    "The chat uses DeepSeek v4.1 flash.\n"
    "search finds text. ctrl-s finds the next. ctrl-r finds the previous. ctrl-g puts you back.\n"
    "gd jumps to where this name is born. space c d does that too.\n"
    "gD and space c D find every use. The line says 2/3 and the line. space c N goes back.\n"
    "* finds the word under the cursor. n finds the next. N finds the previous. / searches.\n"
    "V selects lines in blue. y copies them. d deletes them. p pastes.\n"
    "d then a motion deletes. dG deletes through the bottom. dgg deletes through the top.\n"
    "c changes that text and lets you type. y copies it. cc changes one line.\n"
    "ctrl-a and ctrl-e go to the ends of the line. ctrl-k deletes to the end.\n"
    "alt-< goes to the top. alt-> goes to the bottom.\n"
    "list-buffers names open pages. switch-buffer jumps to one.\n"
    "split opens another page under this one.\n"
    "split-horiz opens another page beside this one.\n"
    "other-window moves to the other page.\n"
    "delete-window closes this page. The last page stays.\n"
    "delete-other-windows keeps only this page.\n"
    "ctrl-x 2 splits under. ctrl-x 3 splits beside.\n"
    "ctrl-x o moves. ctrl-x 0 closes. ctrl-x 1 keeps one.\n"
    "Two pages can show one writing, each with its own cursor.\n"
    "layout races pictures of your pages. The best one stays.\n"
    "The line says this layout wins.\n"
    "layout:story fills the screen with the story.\n"
    "layout:beside opens a helper page beside the story.\n"
    "layout:book stacks the pages like a book.\n"
    "layout:undo puts the old picture back.\n"
    "preview TEXT asks the helper for a page beside yours.\n"
    "Unkind or not-allowed words make no page.\n"
    "The line says Look, the helper made a new page next to yours!\n"
    "preview:keep keeps it when it is better. preview:drop puts it away.\n"
    "preview:undo takes a keep back. Keys stay on your page.\n"
    "story:grow makes this page a little bigger.\n"
    "story:shrink makes a short page a little smaller.\n"
    "The line says this page is growing!\n"
    "story:mood says almost there! when you are close.\n"
    "story:cheer opens a celebration page when the story is ready.\n"
    "The line says celebration page opened.\n"
    "flip turns to the next page of the book.\n"
    "story:undo puts the old picture back.\n"))

(define (pad:wn-help! rest)
  (pad:wn-ensure!)
  (if (string=? *wn-live* "help")
      (pad:wn-rej "this page is the map")
      (begin
        (set! *wn-back* *wn-live*)
        (pad:wn-buf! "help" (pad:wn-map *wn-back*))
        (pad:wn-switch! "help")
        (set! *pl-say*
              (pad:vi-cut (string-append "this page is the map. M-x switch:"
                                         *wn-back* " goes back")))
        rest
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:wn-sw? w)
  (and (>= (string-length w) 7) (string=? (substring w 0 7) "switch:")))

;; Layout worldlines stay off the key path. The first layout: command
;; loads layout.aura. A normal key never does.
(define *ly-ready* #f)

(define (pad:ly-word? w)
  (and (string? w) (>= (string-length w) 6)
       (string=? (substring w 0 6) "layout")))

(define (pad:wn-layout! w rest)
  (if (not *ly-ready*)
      (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/layout.aura")))
  (if *ly-ready* (pad:ly-run! w rest) #f))

;; Preview is a dedicated side window. It loads on the first preview
;; command, not on a normal key.
(define *pv-ready* #f)

(define (pad:pv-word? w)
  (and (string? w) (>= (string-length w) 7)
       (string=? (substring w 0 7) "preview")))

(define (pad:wn-preview! w rest)
  (if (not *pv-ready*)
      (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/preview.aura")))
  (if *pv-ready* (pad:pv-run! w rest) #f))

;; The storybook policy stays off the key path. The first story: or
;; flip command loads story.aura. A normal key never does.
(define *sb-ready* #f)

(define (pad:sb-word? w)
  (or (string=? w "flip")
      (and (string? w) (>= (string-length w) 5)
           (string=? (substring w 0 5) "story"))))

(define (pad:wn-story! w rest)
  (if (not *sb-ready*)
      (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/story.aura")))
  (if *sb-ready* (pad:sb-run! w rest) #f))

(define (pad:wn-command w rest)
  (cond
    ((or (string=? w "split") (string=? w "split-vert")) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? w "split-horiz") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((or (string=? w "other-window") (string=? w "other")) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? w "delete-window") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? w "delete-other-windows") (pad:wn-only!))
    ((or (string=? w "help") (string=? w "map")) (pad:wn-help! rest))
    ((string=? w "switch-window") (pad:wn-switch! rest))
    ((pad:wn-sw? w) (pad:wn-switch! (substring w 7 (string-length w))))
    ((pad:ly-word? w) (pad:wn-layout! w rest))
    ((pad:pv-word? w) (pad:wn-preview! w rest))
    ((pad:sb-word? w) (pad:wn-story! w rest))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-cx! b)
  (cond
    ((= b 50) (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((= b 51) (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:wn-other!))
    ((= b 48) (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((= b 49) (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-on-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "IN 50") (pad:wn-split! "V"))
    ((string=? line "IN 51") (pad:wn-split! "H"))
    ((string=? line "IN 111") (pad:wn-other!))
    ((string=? line "IN 48") (pad:wn-delete!))
    ((string=? line "IN 49") (pad:wn-only!))
    (#t #f)))

(define (pad:wn-vis n)
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 32) (<= n 126))
      (list->string (list n))
      "?"))

(define (pad:wn-spaces s n)
  (if (<= n 0) s (pad:wn-spaces (string-append s " ") (- n 1))))

(define (pad:wn-slice codes i left end acc)
  (cond
    ((>= i end) acc)
    ((null? codes) (pad:wn-spaces acc (- end i)))
    ((< i left) (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end acc))
    (#t (pad:wn-slice (cdr codes) (+ i 1) left end
                      (string-append acc (pad:wn-vis (car codes)))))))

(define (pad:wn-rep ch n)
  (cond
    ((<= n 0) "")
    ((= n 1) ch)
    (#t (let ((h (pad:wn-rep ch (quotient n 2))))
          (if (= (modulo n 2) 0)
              (string-append h h)
              (string-append h h ch))))))

(define (pad:wn-nth lines i)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((= i 0) (car lines))
    (#t (pad:wn-nth (cdr lines) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:wn-border st)
  (cond ((= st 1) "*") ((= st 2) "+") (#t "|")))

(define (pad:wn-wh s)
  (cond
    ((string=? s "helper") 1)
    ((string=? s "macro") 2)
    ((string=? s "law") 3)
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:wn-cy line top h)
  (let ((y (- line top)))
    (cond ((< y 0) 0) ((>= y h) (- h 1)) (#t y))))

(define (pad:wn-cx col left w)
  (let ((x (- col left)))
    (cond ((< x 0) 0) ((> x w) w) (#t x))))

(define (pad:wn-vis-line? sel line)
  (if (not (and (= sel 1) (pad:vw-visual-on?)))
      #f
      (let ((a *vi-vanchor*) (b (cadr *pl-st*)))
        (if (<= a b)
            (and (>= line a) (<= line b))
            (and (>= line b) (<= line a))))))

(define (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border sel i)
  (if (>= i h)
      ""
      (let ((pay (string-append
                   (pad:wn-slice (pad:wn-nth lines (+ top i)) 0 left (+ left (- w 1)) "")
                   border))
            (dots (pad:wn-rep "." w))
            (mk (if (pad:wn-vis-line? sel (+ top i))
                    (pad:wn-rep "v" w)
                    (pad:wn-rep "." w))))
        (string-append "T " pay "\nH " dots "\nM " mk "\n"
                       (pad:wn-block lines top left h w border sel (+ i 1))))))

(define (pad:wn-one rec)
  (let* ((leaf (car rec))
         (r (cadr rec))
         (c (list-ref rec 2))
         (h (list-ref rec 3))
         (w (list-ref rec 4))
         (top (list-ref leaf 4))
         (left (list-ref leaf 5))
         (sel (if (= (car leaf) *wn-sel*) 1 0))
         (cy (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cy (list-ref leaf 2) top h) 0))
         (cx (if (= sel 1) (pad:wn-cx (list-ref leaf 3) left w) 0)))
    (string-append
      "WIN r=" (number->string r)
      " c=" (number->string c)
      " h=" (number->string h)
      " w=" (number->string w)
      " sel=" (number->string sel)
      " top=" (number->string top)
      " left=" (number->string left)
      " cy=" (number->string cy)
      " cx=" (number->string cx)
      " st=" (number->string (list-ref leaf 7))
      " wh=" (number->string (pad:wn-wh (list-ref leaf 8)))
      "\n"
      (pad:wn-block (pad:wn-lines-of (cadr leaf)) top left h w
                    (pad:wn-border (list-ref leaf 7)) sel 0))))

(define (pad:wn-body rects)
  (if (null? rects) "" (string-append (pad:wn-one (car rects)) (pad:wn-body (cdr rects)))))

(define (pad:wn-snap)
  (if (not (pad:wn-many?))
      (pad:play-snap)
      (begin
        (set! *wn-store* (pad:wn-put *wn-store* *wn-live* (car *pl-st*)))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-sync *wn-tree*))
        (set! *wn-tree* (pad:wn-apply (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))
                                      *wn-tree*))
        (let ((rects (pad:wn-place *wn-tree* 0 0 (pad:wn-rows) (pad:wn-cols))))
          (pad:wn-note! rects)
          (string-append
            "SNAP v1 pad\n"
            "TITLE " (pad:play-title) "\n"
            "CURSOR line=0 col=0\n"
            "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
            "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
            "WINS n=" (number->string (length rects)) "\n"
            (pad:wn-body rects)
            "END\n")))))

(define pad:em-command-1 pad:em-command)
(define (pad:em-command w rest mx)
  (let ((d (pad:wn-command w rest)))
    (if d d (pad:em-command-1 w rest mx))))

(define pad:pf-save-1 pad:pf-save!)
(define (pad:pf-save!)
  (if (or (string=? *wn-live* "")
          (not *pf-on*)
          (string=? *wn-live* *pf-name*))
      (pad:pf-save-1)
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "switch to the file page to save")
        "skip")))

;; Every section is a function; the entry file runs ONE top-level call
;; (forms after a set-code + eval-current are read back wrong, docs/m9.md).
;; Test globals carry an m11 prefix only (aura#4353). Prints T lines,
;; M11A_ACC n OK per acceptance item, M11STATS, then PAD_M11_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-fail* 0)
(define *m11-checks* 0)
(define *m11-acc0* 0)

(define (m11:mark! ok tag shown want)
  (set! *m11-checks* (+ *m11-checks* 1))
  (newline)
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display "=") (display shown)
  (if ok
      (display " OK")
      (begin (display " WANT=") (display want) (set! *m11-fail* (+ *m11-fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  ok)
(define (m11:expect tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (number? got) (= got want)) tag (if (number? got) (number->string got) "?")
             (number->string want)))
(define (m11:expect-str tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (string? got) (string=? got want)) tag (if (string? got) got "?") want))
(define (m11:expect-true tag got)
  (m11:expect-str tag (if got "yes" "no") "yes"))

(define (m11:acc-begin!) (set! *m11-acc0* *m11-fail*))
(define (m11:acc-end! part n)
  (newline)
  (display part) (display "_ACC ") (display (number->string n))
  (display (if (= *m11-fail* *m11-acc0*) " OK" " FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define *m11-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(add 2 3)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

(define (m11:row-src l) (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l))))
(define (m11:keys! ks)
  (if (null? ks) 0 (begin (pad:robot-line! (car ks)) (m11:keys! (cdr ks)))))

(define (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:play-reset! *m11-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pen-undo* (list))
  (set! *robot-undo* (list))
  (set! *who-keep-codes* (list))
  (pad:play-snap)
  (m11:expect-str "CHECK" (car (pad:who-check!)) "ok")
  #t)

;; query:mutations-since 0 -> its records split into "key=value" tokens.
(define (m11:muts)
  (try
    (let ((m (query:mutations-since 0)))
      (cond
        ((string? m) (string-split m " "))
        ((pair? m) (m11:strs m))
        (#t (list))))
    (catch (e) (list))))
;; one string per mutation record ("id=1 target=5 op=rebind ... composite=0")
(define (m11:strs xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string? (car xs)) (append (string-split (car xs) " ") (m11:strs (cdr xs))))
    (#t (m11:strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (m11:uniq xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
    ((member (car xs) acc) (m11:uniq (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (m11:uniq (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
;; composite ids of the mutation records with id > id0, and their authors
(define (m11:rec-field ts key cur id0 acc)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
    ((string-prefix? (car ts) "id=")
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key (string->number (substring (car ts) 3 (string-length (car ts)))) id0 acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car ts) key) (number? cur) (> cur id0))
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 (cons (substring (car ts) (string-length key) (string-length (car ts))) acc)))
    (#t (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 acc))))
(define (m11:last-id)
  (try
    (let ((v (hash-ref (mutation-log:summary) "last-mutation-id")))
      (if (number? v) v -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define *m11-gate* (if (string? (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE")) (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE") ""))
(define *m11-ops-good*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (- (hello y)))")))
(define *m11-ops-type*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 3))") (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (string-append n 1))")))
(define *m11-ops-arity*
  (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (* a b))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))

(define (m11:intro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11 Aura-unique features on Soft tip")
  (newline)
  (display "M11GATE type_gate=") (display (if (string=? *m11-gate* "") "default" *m11-gate*))
  (newline)
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_Q" (pad:robot-q "a\"b") (list->string (list 34 97 92 34 98 34)))
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_SEXPR" (pad:robot-sexpr (list "f" "(lambda (x) x)") "hi")
                  "(mutate:rebind \"f\" \"(lambda (x) x)\" \"hi\")")
  #t)

;; M11a: a robot proposal is one typed engine transaction; ctrl-z undoes it.
(define (m11:sec-a1)
  ;; 1. A two-define proposal lands whole: both defines change in the
  ;;    engine, both rows in the page, one composite transaction id, the
  ;;    rows are stamped helper.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (m (m11:muts))
         (cs (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "A1_GEN_UP" (>= (pad:nth r 3) 1))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_HELLO" (string-contains? code1 "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_BYE" (string-contains? code1 "(- (hello y))"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_CHANGED" (not (string=? code0 code1)))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define bye (lambda (y) (- (hello y))))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_TAGS" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth r 5)) "row.row")
    (newline) (display "M11TXN records=") (display (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))))
    (display " composite=") (display (pad:ws-names-str cs)) (newline)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_RECORDS" (>= (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))) 2))
    (m11:expect "A1_ONE_TXN" (length cs) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_TXN_NONZERO" (and (pair? cs) (not (string=? (car cs) "0"))))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_LOG_GREW" (> (m11:last-id) id0))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (pad:pen-gen))))
    (m11:expect "A1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z (IN 26) undoes the whole robot change in one key: engine
  ;;    code back to before the proposal, both rows back, stamps back;
  ;;    a second ctrl-z says there is nothing to undo.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (u0 *robot-undos*))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect "A2_ONE_KEY" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's whole change is gone")
    (m11:expect-true "A2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_PAGE_BACK" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define (bye y) (hello y))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY_EMPTY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (m11:expect "A2_NO_MORE" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1))
  ;; two robot changes, kid typing between: ctrl-z twice walks back LIFO
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_1" (string=? (pad:q-code) code1))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_2" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect "A2_UNDO_EMPTY" (length *robot-undo*) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a3)
  ;; 3. A refused proposal moves nothing: one edit is fine, the other
  ;;    breaks arity (refused in every gate mode) or types (refused with
  ;;    AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard). Engine code, page and stamps stay;
  ;;    nothing is pushed for ctrl-z; workspace procedures still answer
  ;;    (restore + eval-current, aura#4361).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_SAY" (pad:nth r 2) "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ADD_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* a b)")))
    (m11:expect "A3_HEALED" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "A3_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "A3_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
             (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "A3_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-true "A3_TYPE_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
        (m11:expect-true "A3_HELLO_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 3)"))))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE type_proposal=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; the gate refuses before the engine: no snapshot, generation unchanged
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (set! x 1))")) "sneaky") "helper"))
         (r2 (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)") (list "hello" "(lambda (x) 0)")) "twice")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REJECT" (car r) "REJECT")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REASON" (cadr r) "not-allowed")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_TWICE" (cadr r2) "twice")
    (m11:expect "A3_GATE_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 3)
  #t)

(define (m11:outro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11STATS ") (display (pad:robot-stats-str))
  (newline)
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display (number->string *m11-checks*))
  (display " fail=") (display (number->string *m11-fail*))
  (newline)
  (if (= *m11-fail* 0) (display "PAD_M11_TEST_OK") (display "PAD_M11_TEST_FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define (m11:run-all)
  (m11:intro)
  (m11:sec-a1)
  (m11:sec-a2)
  (m11:sec-a3)
  (m11:outro))

  (m11:sec-b3)

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11 test cases (Aura-unique features), loaded by m11_test.aura.
;; Every section is a function; the entry file runs ONE top-level call
;; (forms after a set-code + eval-current are read back wrong, docs/m9.md).
;; Test globals carry an m11 prefix only (aura#4353). Prints T lines,
;; M11A_ACC / M11B_ACC n OK per acceptance item, M11STATS, then PAD_M11_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-fail* 0)
(define *m11-checks* 0)
(define *m11-acc0* 0)

(define (m11:mark! ok tag shown want)
  (set! *m11-checks* (+ *m11-checks* 1))
  (newline)
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display "=") (display shown)
  (if ok
      (display " OK")
      (begin (display " WANT=") (display want) (set! *m11-fail* (+ *m11-fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  ok)
(define (m11:expect tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (number? got) (= got want)) tag (if (number? got) (number->string got) "?")
             (number->string want)))
(define (m11:expect-str tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (string? got) (string=? got want)) tag (if (string? got) got "?") want))
(define (m11:expect-true tag got)
  (m11:expect-str tag (if got "yes" "no") "yes"))

(define (m11:acc-begin!) (set! *m11-acc0* *m11-fail*))
(define (m11:acc-end! part n)
  (newline)
  (display part) (display "_ACC ") (display (number->string n))
  (display (if (= *m11-fail* *m11-acc0*) " OK" " FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define *m11-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(add 2 3)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

(define (m11:row-src l) (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l))))
(define (m11:keys! ks)
  (if (null? ks) 0 (begin (pad:robot-line! (car ks)) (m11:keys! (cdr ks)))))

(define (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:play-reset! *m11-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pen-undo* (list))
  (set! *robot-undo* (list))
  (set! *who-keep-codes* (list))
  (pad:play-snap)
  (m11:expect-str "CHECK" (car (pad:who-check!)) "ok")
  #t)

;; query:mutations-since 0 -> its records split into "key=value" tokens.
(define (m11:muts)
  (try
    (let ((m (query:mutations-since 0)))
      (cond
        ((string? m) (string-split m " "))
        ((pair? m) (m11:strs m))
        (#t (list))))
    (catch (e) (list))))
;; one string per mutation record ("id=1 target=5 op=rebind ... composite=0")
(define (m11:strs xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string? (car xs)) (append (string-split (car xs) " ") (m11:strs (cdr xs))))
    (#t (m11:strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (m11:uniq xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
    ((member (car xs) acc) (m11:uniq (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (m11:uniq (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
;; composite ids of the mutation records with id > id0, and their authors
(define (m11:rec-field ts key cur id0 acc)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
    ((string-prefix? (car ts) "id=")
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key (string->number (substring (car ts) 3 (string-length (car ts)))) id0 acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car ts) key) (number? cur) (> cur id0))
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 (cons (substring (car ts) (string-length key) (string-length (car ts))) acc)))
    (#t (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 acc))))
(define (m11:last-id)
  (try
    (let ((v (hash-ref (mutation-log:summary) "last-mutation-id")))
      (if (number? v) v -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define *m11-gate* (if (string? (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE")) (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE") ""))
(define *m11-ops-good*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (- (hello y)))")))
(define *m11-ops-type*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 3))") (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (string-append n 1))")))
(define *m11-ops-arity*
  (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (* a b))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))

(define (m11:intro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11 Aura-unique features on Soft tip")
  (newline)
  (display "M11GATE type_gate=") (display (if (string=? *m11-gate* "") "default" *m11-gate*))
  (newline)
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_Q" (pad:robot-q "a\"b") (list->string (list 34 97 92 34 98 34)))
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_SEXPR" (pad:robot-sexpr (list "f" "(lambda (x) x)") "hi")
                  "(mutate:rebind \"f\" \"(lambda (x) x)\" \"hi\")")
  #t)

;; M11a: a robot proposal is one typed engine transaction; ctrl-z undoes it.
(define (m11:sec-a1)
  ;; 1. A two-define proposal lands whole: both defines change in the
  ;;    engine, both rows in the page, one composite transaction id, the
  ;;    rows are stamped helper.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (m (m11:muts))
         (cs (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "A1_GEN_UP" (>= (pad:nth r 3) 1))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_HELLO" (string-contains? code1 "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_BYE" (string-contains? code1 "(- (hello y))"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_CHANGED" (not (string=? code0 code1)))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define bye (lambda (y) (- (hello y))))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_TAGS" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth r 5)) "row.row")
    (newline) (display "M11TXN records=") (display (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))))
    (display " composite=") (display (pad:ws-names-str cs)) (newline)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_RECORDS" (>= (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))) 2))
    (m11:expect "A1_ONE_TXN" (length cs) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_TXN_NONZERO" (and (pair? cs) (not (string=? (car cs) "0"))))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_LOG_GREW" (> (m11:last-id) id0))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (pad:pen-gen))))
    (m11:expect "A1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z (IN 26) undoes the whole robot change in one key: engine
  ;;    code back to before the proposal, both rows back, stamps back;
  ;;    a second ctrl-z says there is nothing to undo.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (u0 *robot-undos*))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect "A2_ONE_KEY" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's whole change is gone")
    (m11:expect-true "A2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_PAGE_BACK" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define (bye y) (hello y))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY_EMPTY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (m11:expect "A2_NO_MORE" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1))
  ;; two robot changes, kid typing between: ctrl-z twice walks back LIFO
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_1" (string=? (pad:q-code) code1))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_2" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect "A2_UNDO_EMPTY" (length *robot-undo*) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a3)
  ;; 3. A refused proposal moves nothing: one edit is fine, the other
  ;;    breaks arity (refused in every gate mode) or types (refused with
  ;;    AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard). Engine code, page and stamps stay;
  ;;    nothing is pushed for ctrl-z; workspace procedures still answer
  ;;    (restore + eval-current, aura#4361).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_SAY" (pad:nth r 2) "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ADD_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* a b)")))
    (m11:expect "A3_HEALED" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "A3_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "A3_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
             (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "A3_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-true "A3_TYPE_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
        (m11:expect-true "A3_HELLO_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 3)"))))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE type_proposal=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; the gate refuses before the engine: no snapshot, generation unchanged
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (set! x 1))")) "sneaky") "helper"))
         (r2 (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)") (list "hello" "(lambda (x) 0)")) "twice")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REJECT" (car r) "REJECT")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REASON" (cadr r) "not-allowed")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_TWICE" (cadr r2) "twice")
    (m11:expect "A3_GATE_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 3)
  #t)

;; M11b: engine-level "who wrote this" (eng_who.aura).
(define (m11:ew! l)
  (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l 0 (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                        (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
  (let ((r (pad:ew-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (display " say=\"") (display (cadr r)) (display "\"") (newline)
    r))
(define (m11:ew-field tag key)
  (pad:ew-field (string-split tag " ") key))
(define (m11:ew-rows-line!)
  (let ((rows (pad:ew-rows)))
    (newline) (display "EWHOROWS ") (display (pad:ew-rows-str rows)) (newline)
    rows))

(define (m11:sec-b1)
  ;; 1. A robot KEEP and a pen KEEP are stamped by the engine with the
  ;;    writer's fingerprint; ctrl-o answers from query:node-provenance +
  ;;    the rebind record's reason, and agrees with the Soft row stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-true "B1_FP_BOUND" *ew-bound*)
  (m11:expect "B1_FP_HELPER" (pad:ew-fp "helper") 42)
  (m11:expect-str "B1_FP_WHO" (pad:ew-who-of 4) "law")
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_SAY" (cadr a) "nobody has changed this yet"))
  (let* ((id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (m (m11:muts)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_AUTHORS" (pad:ws-names-str (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "author=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))) "42"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "closer")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_SOFT" (m11:ew-field (car a) "soft=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW0_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "the AI helper wrote hello: closer (change ")))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 1)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 6)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW6_V" (caddr a) "soft-only"))
  ;; pen step by a law, under fingerprint 4
  (let ((rs (pad:ew-pen-step! "law" "greet" "(lambda (n) (add n 2))" "rule")))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_LAW_KEEP" (car (car rs)) "KEEP"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 5)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "law")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "rule")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW5_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "a law wrote greet: rule")))
  (let ((rows (m11:ew-rows-line!)))
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS" (length rows) 5)
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v rows "disagree") 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b2)
  ;; 2. Undo puts the engine's authorship back too: ast:restore restores
  ;;    node provenance and the mutation log to the snapshot, so after
  ;;    each ctrl-z the engine and the Soft stamps still agree.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "macro" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP"))
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW0_MACRO" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 0)) "who=") "macro")
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW2_HELPER" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 2)) "who=") "helper")
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a0 (m11:ew! 0)) (a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0" (m11:ew-field (car a0) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0_V" (caddr a0) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:expect "B2_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v (m11:ew-rows-line!) "disagree") 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b3)
  ;; 3. ctrl-o (IN 15) on the notebook face answers in the say line; a
  ;;    row the kid typed on after a helper KEEP says so; the checker
  ;;    catches a forged Soft stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")
  (m11:ew! 0)
  (m11:keys! (list "KEY end" "IN 32" "IN 15"))
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KEY_SAY" *pl-say* "the AI helper wrote hello, then you changed it")
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KID_AFTER" (caddr (pad:ew-at 0)) "kid-after")
  (let ((e (list "hello" "helper" "closer" 2 3 42)))
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHO" (pad:ew-verdict (list "macro" "closer" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHY" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "faster" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict #f e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_REAL" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) e) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_ENGINE_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) (list "hello" "nobody" "" 0 1 0)) "disagree"))
  (m11:expect "B3_NO_DISAGREE" *ew-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 3)
  #t)

(define (m11:outro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11STATS ") (display (pad:robot-stats-str))
  (newline)
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display (number->string *m11-checks*))
  (display " fail=") (display (number->string *m11-fail*))
  (newline)
  (if (= *m11-fail* 0) (display "PAD_M11_TEST_OK") (display "PAD_M11_TEST_FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define (m11:run-all)
  (m11:intro)
  (m11:sec-a1)
  (m11:sec-a2)
  (m11:sec-a3)
  (m11:sec-b1)
  (m11:sec-b2)
  (m11:sec-b3)
  (m11:outro))

target.name: m11:run-all
target.body:
(lambda () (m11:intro)
  (m11:sec-a1)
  (m11:sec-a2)
  (m11:sec-a3)
  (m11:sec-b1)
  (m11:sec-b2)
  (m11:sec-b3)
  (m11:sec-c1)
  (m11:sec-c2)
  (m11:sec-c3)
  (m11:outro))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11 test cases (Aura-unique features), loaded by m11_test.aura.
;; Every section is a function; the entry file runs ONE top-level call
;; (forms after a set-code + eval-current are read back wrong, docs/m9.md).
;; Test globals carry an m11 prefix only (aura#4353). Prints T lines,
;; M11A_ACC / M11B_ACC / M11C_ACC n OK per acceptance item, M11STATS, then PAD_M11_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-fail* 0)
(define *m11-checks* 0)
(define *m11-acc0* 0)

(define (m11:mark! ok tag shown want)
  (set! *m11-checks* (+ *m11-checks* 1))
  (newline)
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display "=") (display shown)
  (if ok
      (display " OK")
      (begin (display " WANT=") (display want) (set! *m11-fail* (+ *m11-fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  ok)
(define (m11:expect tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (number? got) (= got want)) tag (if (number? got) (number->string got) "?")
             (number->string want)))
(define (m11:expect-str tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (string? got) (string=? got want)) tag (if (string? got) got "?") want))
(define (m11:expect-true tag got)
  (m11:expect-str tag (if got "yes" "no") "yes"))

(define (m11:acc-begin!) (set! *m11-acc0* *m11-fail*))
(define (m11:acc-end! part n)
  (newline)
  (display part) (display "_ACC ") (display (number->string n))
  (display (if (= *m11-fail* *m11-acc0*) " OK" " FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define *m11-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(add 2 3)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

(define (m11:row-src l) (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l))))
(define (m11:keys! ks)
  (if (null? ks) 0 (begin (pad:robot-line! (car ks)) (m11:keys! (cdr ks)))))

(define (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:play-reset! *m11-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pen-undo* (list))
  (set! *robot-undo* (list))
  (set! *who-keep-codes* (list))
  (pad:play-snap)
  (m11:expect-str "CHECK" (car (pad:who-check!)) "ok")
  #t)

;; query:mutations-since 0 -> its records split into "key=value" tokens.
(define (m11:muts)
  (try
    (let ((m (query:mutations-since 0)))
      (cond
        ((string? m) (string-split m " "))
        ((pair? m) (m11:strs m))
        (#t (list))))
    (catch (e) (list))))
;; one string per mutation record ("id=1 target=5 op=rebind ... composite=0")
(define (m11:strs xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string? (car xs)) (append (string-split (car xs) " ") (m11:strs (cdr xs))))
    (#t (m11:strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (m11:uniq xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
    ((member (car xs) acc) (m11:uniq (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (m11:uniq (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
;; composite ids of the mutation records with id > id0, and their authors
(define (m11:rec-field ts key cur id0 acc)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
    ((string-prefix? (car ts) "id=")
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key (string->number (substring (car ts) 3 (string-length (car ts)))) id0 acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car ts) key) (number? cur) (> cur id0))
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 (cons (substring (car ts) (string-length key) (string-length (car ts))) acc)))
    (#t (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 acc))))
(define (m11:last-id)
  (try
    (let ((v (hash-ref (mutation-log:summary) "last-mutation-id")))
      (if (number? v) v -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define *m11-gate* (if (string? (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE")) (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE") ""))
(define *m11-ops-good*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (- (hello y)))")))
(define *m11-ops-type*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 3))") (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (string-append n 1))")))
(define *m11-ops-arity*
  (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (* a b))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))

(define (m11:intro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11 Aura-unique features on Soft tip")
  (newline)
  (display "M11GATE type_gate=") (display (if (string=? *m11-gate* "") "default" *m11-gate*))
  (newline)
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_Q" (pad:robot-q "a\"b") (list->string (list 34 97 92 34 98 34)))
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_SEXPR" (pad:robot-sexpr (list "f" "(lambda (x) x)") "hi")
                  "(mutate:rebind \"f\" \"(lambda (x) x)\" \"hi\")")
  #t)

;; M11a: a robot proposal is one typed engine transaction; ctrl-z undoes it.
(define (m11:sec-a1)
  ;; 1. A two-define proposal lands whole: both defines change in the
  ;;    engine, both rows in the page, one composite transaction id, the
  ;;    rows are stamped helper.
  (m11:acc-begin!)

(define (m11:sec-c3)
