;; M11c: "why did it break?" in kid words (why.aura).
(define *m11-tx-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: type error: argument 1: expected String, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:20: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 2;")
(define *m11-tx-arity0* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 0;")
(define *m11-tx-unbound* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: unbound variable: frob\n  did you mean 'drop'?;")
(define *m11-tx-parse* "parse-error: 1:21: unexpected ')'")
(define *m11-tx-caller-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 8:2: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile); 12:9: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-caller-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 2:24: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1; arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1;")
(define *m11-tc-pet* "re-inferred: 2\ndiagnostics:\n  [3] 1:28: unbound variable: pet\n  did you mean 'set'?\n")
(define *m11-tc-mixed* "re-inferred: 3\ndiagnostics:\n  [6] 1:20: unbound variable: frob\n  [14] warning: incompatible ground types: expected String, got Int\n")

(define (m11:sec-c1)
  ;; 1. The Soft table turns the engine's own refusal and diagnostic texts
  ;;    (captured on c69e644, probes p6 / p9 / p10) into one short kid
  ;;    sentence; a blamed caller line is named by its define or text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-type* "helper" "greet") "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY0" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity0* "macro" "bye") "the macro's bye gives hello 0 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_UNBOUND" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-unbound* "law" "bye") "the law's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_PARSE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-parse* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye has a bracket in the wrong place")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-type* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-arity* "helper" "hello") "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPEVAR" (pad:why-type-word "y") "something else")
  (m11:expect "C1_LINE" (pad:why-line *m11-tx-caller-type*) 8)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_OTHER" (pad:why-kid "refused" "helper" "bye") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_KINDS" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (list *m11-tx-type* *m11-tx-arity* *m11-tx-unbound* *m11-tx-parse* "x")))
                  "type.arity.unbound.brackets.other")
  ;; typecheck-incremental: pet is a notebook define, so its "unbound" is
  ;; dropped (aura#4363); frob is not, so it stays; a warning line maps too
  (m11:expect "C1_TC_PET_DROPPED" (length (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-pet*)) 0)
  ;; (shown as kinds: a raw "unbound variable" text would trip smoke's Soft-error grep)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_MIXED" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*))) "unbound.type")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_TC_MIXED_FROB" (pad:why-has? (car (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "variable: frob"))
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_WARN_KID" (pad:why-kid (cadr (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "helper" "greet")
                  "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_BAD" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_EXTRA" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)))")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_OK" (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2))"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c2)
  ;; 2. Live: aura refuses a robot proposal; the say line tells the kid
  ;;    which define broke and why, in kid words; the replay that found
  ;;    the reason leaves nothing behind (one heal, code and page same).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (p0 *why-probes*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
                                                                 (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")) "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_WHO" (car *why-last*) "bye")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "arity")
    (m11:expect "C2_PROBED" (- *why-probes* p0) 1)
    (m11:expect "C2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "C2_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "C2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (frob y))")) "fun") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet"))
  ;; a change that breaks the lines that use it: aura blames a caller
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x y) (+ x y))")) "two") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "type"))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE why_type=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; brackets: the engine would close a missing ")" by itself, so the
  ;; Soft gate refuses first, before any snapshot
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")) "short") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS" (cadr r) "brackets")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (m11:expect "C2_BRACKETS_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c3)
  ;; 3. A KEEP whose typecheck-incremental only reports the false
  ;;    "unbound" of a notebook define (aura#4363) is not turned into a
  ;;    warning: the say line stays the normal KEEP sentence. A refusal
  ;;    blamed on a caller line names that line.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y (string-length pet)))")) "pet") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C3_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "C3_TC_SAID_PET" (pad:why-has? *robot-tc-raw* "variable: pet"))
    (m11:expect "C3_NO_FALSE_WARN" (length *robot-diags*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "C3_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed bye, ctrl-z takes it all back"))
  ;; a type refusal blamed on a caller line: bye now wants words, (bye 4)
  ;; gives it a number
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (string-append pet y))")) "pet") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)"))
      #f)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 3)
  #t)

;; M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura).
(define (m11:card-out! r)
  (pad:robot-line-out! r "helper")
  (if (string=? (car r) "CARD")
      (begin (newline) (display (pad:blast-line *blast-last*)) (newline))
      #f)
  r)

(define (m11:sec-d1)
  ;; 1. The card lists what the change would move, before anything is
  ;;    kept: the page does not change, the engine has the change inside
  ;;    a snapshot, and Soft's call-site count equals query:calls.
  ;;    Enter keeps it like a robot KEEP; ctrl-z then undoes it.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_CARD" (car r) "CARD")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SAY" *pl-say* "changing hello and bye moves 3 places: (hello 3), (bye 4), (hello (bye 5)). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_USES" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr *blast-last*)) "6.7.11")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_GROWN" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 4)) "hello.bye")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "D1_PAGE_WAITS" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_ENGINE_HAS_IT" (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect "D1_NO_UNDO_YET" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 13"))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_KEEP_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed hello and bye, ctrl-z takes it all back")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect "D1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "D1_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_PAGE" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z on a waiting card says no: the snapshot is restored,
  ;;    nothing moved, nothing to undo afterwards. Row names on the card:
  ;;    a define row by its name, a short row by its text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SAY" *pl-say* "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "add:3/3:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_NO_SAY" *pl-say* "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed")
    (m11:expect-true "D2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect "D2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "D2_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "D2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_THEN_UNDO_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d3)
  ;; 3. A card the engine refuses never waits: DROP with the kid reason
  ;;    (M11c). A card with more places than fit says "and N more"; one
  ;;    with none says "moves nothing else". The checker flags a count
  ;;    that disagrees with the engine.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "D3_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*)))
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_NONE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "pet") (list) (list) (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing pet moves nothing else. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_MORE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "f") (list 1 2 3 4 5) (list "a" "b" "c" "d" "e") (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing f moves 5 places: a, b, c and 2 more. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_BAD" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 2 2 1)))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_STALE_OK" (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 4 3 1))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_NO_ENGINE" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 0 -1 -1 0)))))
  (m11:expect "D3_NO_DISAGREE" *blast-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 3)
  #t)

  (newline)
  (display "M11STATS ") (display (pad:robot-stats-str))

  (newline))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11 test cases (Aura-unique features), loaded by m11_test.aura.
;; Every section is a function; the entry file runs ONE top-level call
;; (forms after a set-code + eval-current are read back wrong, docs/m9.md).
;; Test globals carry an m11 prefix only (aura#4353). Prints T lines,
;; M11A_ACC .. M11F_ACC n OK per acceptance item (M11e / M11f cases live
;; in m11e_cases.aura / m11f_cases.aura), M11STATS, then PAD_M11_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-fail* 0)
(define *m11-checks* 0)
(define *m11-acc0* 0)

(define (m11:mark! ok tag shown want)
  (set! *m11-checks* (+ *m11-checks* 1))
  (newline)
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display "=") (display shown)
  (if ok
      (display " OK")
      (begin (display " WANT=") (display want) (set! *m11-fail* (+ *m11-fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  ok)
(define (m11:expect tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (number? got) (= got want)) tag (if (number? got) (number->string got) "?")
             (number->string want)))
(define (m11:expect-str tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (string? got) (string=? got want)) tag (if (string? got) got "?") want))
(define (m11:expect-true tag got)
  (m11:expect-str tag (if got "yes" "no") "yes"))

(define (m11:acc-begin!) (set! *m11-acc0* *m11-fail*))
(define (m11:acc-end! part n)
  (newline)
  (display part) (display "_ACC ") (display (number->string n))
  (display (if (= *m11-fail* *m11-acc0*) " OK" " FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define *m11-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(add 2 3)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

(define (m11:row-src l) (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l))))
(define (m11:keys! ks)
  (if (null? ks) 0 (begin (pad:robot-line! (car ks)) (m11:keys! (cdr ks)))))

(define (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:play-reset! *m11-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pen-undo* (list))
  (set! *robot-undo* (list))
  (set! *who-keep-codes* (list))
  (pad:play-snap)
  (m11:expect-str "CHECK" (car (pad:who-check!)) "ok")
  #t)

;; query:mutations-since 0 -> its records split into "key=value" tokens.
(define (m11:muts)
  (try
    (let ((m (query:mutations-since 0)))
      (cond
        ((string? m) (string-split m " "))
        ((pair? m) (m11:strs m))
        (#t (list))))
    (catch (e) (list))))
;; one string per mutation record ("id=1 target=5 op=rebind ... composite=0")
(define (m11:strs xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string? (car xs)) (append (string-split (car xs) " ") (m11:strs (cdr xs))))
    (#t (m11:strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (m11:uniq xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
    ((member (car xs) acc) (m11:uniq (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (m11:uniq (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
;; composite ids of the mutation records with id > id0, and their authors
(define (m11:rec-field ts key cur id0 acc)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
    ((string-prefix? (car ts) "id=")
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key (string->number (substring (car ts) 3 (string-length (car ts)))) id0 acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car ts) key) (number? cur) (> cur id0))
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 (cons (substring (car ts) (string-length key) (string-length (car ts))) acc)))
    (#t (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 acc))))
(define (m11:last-id)
  (try
    (let ((v (hash-ref (mutation-log:summary) "last-mutation-id")))
      (if (number? v) v -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define *m11-gate* (if (string? (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE")) (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE") ""))
(define *m11-ops-good*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (- (hello y)))")))
(define *m11-ops-type*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 3))") (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (string-append n 1))")))
(define *m11-ops-arity*
  (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (* a b))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))

(define (m11:intro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11 Aura-unique features on Soft tip")
  (newline)
  (display "M11GATE type_gate=") (display (if (string=? *m11-gate* "") "default" *m11-gate*))
  (newline)
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_Q" (pad:robot-q "a\"b") (list->string (list 34 97 92 34 98 34)))
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_SEXPR" (pad:robot-sexpr (list "f" "(lambda (x) x)") "hi")
                  "(mutate:rebind \"f\" \"(lambda (x) x)\" \"hi\")")
  #t)

;; M11a: a robot proposal is one typed engine transaction; ctrl-z undoes it.
(define (m11:sec-a1)
  ;; 1. A two-define proposal lands whole: both defines change in the
  ;;    engine, both rows in the page, one composite transaction id, the
  ;;    rows are stamped helper.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (m (m11:muts))
         (cs (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "A1_GEN_UP" (>= (pad:nth r 3) 1))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_HELLO" (string-contains? code1 "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_BYE" (string-contains? code1 "(- (hello y))"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_CHANGED" (not (string=? code0 code1)))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define bye (lambda (y) (- (hello y))))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_TAGS" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth r 5)) "row.row")
    (newline) (display "M11TXN records=") (display (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))))
    (display " composite=") (display (pad:ws-names-str cs)) (newline)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_RECORDS" (>= (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))) 2))
    (m11:expect "A1_ONE_TXN" (length cs) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_TXN_NONZERO" (and (pair? cs) (not (string=? (car cs) "0"))))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_LOG_GREW" (> (m11:last-id) id0))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (pad:pen-gen))))
    (m11:expect "A1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z (IN 26) undoes the whole robot change in one key: engine
  ;;    code back to before the proposal, both rows back, stamps back;
  ;;    a second ctrl-z says there is nothing to undo.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (u0 *robot-undos*))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect "A2_ONE_KEY" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's whole change is gone")
    (m11:expect-true "A2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_PAGE_BACK" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define (bye y) (hello y))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY_EMPTY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (m11:expect "A2_NO_MORE" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1))
  ;; two robot changes, kid typing between: ctrl-z twice walks back LIFO
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_1" (string=? (pad:q-code) code1))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_2" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect "A2_UNDO_EMPTY" (length *robot-undo*) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a3)
  ;; 3. A refused proposal moves nothing: one edit is fine, the other
  ;;    breaks arity (refused in every gate mode) or types (refused with
  ;;    AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard). Engine code, page and stamps stay;
  ;;    nothing is pushed for ctrl-z; workspace procedures still answer
  ;;    (restore + eval-current, aura#4361).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_SAY" (pad:nth r 2) "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ADD_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* a b)")))
    (m11:expect "A3_HEALED" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "A3_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "A3_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
             (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "A3_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-true "A3_TYPE_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
        (m11:expect-true "A3_HELLO_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 3)"))))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE type_proposal=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; the gate refuses before the engine: no snapshot, generation unchanged
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (set! x 1))")) "sneaky") "helper"))
         (r2 (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)") (list "hello" "(lambda (x) 0)")) "twice")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REJECT" (car r) "REJECT")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REASON" (cadr r) "not-allowed")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_TWICE" (cadr r2) "twice")
    (m11:expect "A3_GATE_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 3)
  #t)

;; M11b: engine-level "who wrote this" (eng_who.aura).
(define (m11:ew! l)
  (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l 0 (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                        (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
  (let ((r (pad:ew-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (display " say=\"") (display (cadr r)) (display "\"") (newline)
    r))
(define (m11:ew-field tag key)
  (pad:ew-field (string-split tag " ") key))
(define (m11:ew-rows-line!)
  (let ((rows (pad:ew-rows)))
    (newline) (display "EWHOROWS ") (display (pad:ew-rows-str rows)) (newline)
    rows))

(define (m11:sec-b1)
  ;; 1. A robot KEEP and a pen KEEP are stamped by the engine with the
  ;;    writer's fingerprint; ctrl-o answers from query:node-provenance +
  ;;    the rebind record's reason, and agrees with the Soft row stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-true "B1_FP_BOUND" *ew-bound*)
  (m11:expect "B1_FP_HELPER" (pad:ew-fp "helper") 42)
  (m11:expect-str "B1_FP_WHO" (pad:ew-who-of 4) "law")
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_SAY" (cadr a) "nobody has changed this yet"))
  (let* ((id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (m (m11:muts)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_AUTHORS" (pad:ws-names-str (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "author=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))) "42"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "closer")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_SOFT" (m11:ew-field (car a) "soft=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW0_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "the AI helper wrote hello: closer (change ")))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 1)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 6)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW6_V" (caddr a) "soft-only"))
  ;; pen step by a law, under fingerprint 4
  (let ((rs (pad:ew-pen-step! "law" "greet" "(lambda (n) (add n 2))" "rule")))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_LAW_KEEP" (car (car rs)) "KEEP"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 5)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "law")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "rule")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW5_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "a law wrote greet: rule")))
  (let ((rows (m11:ew-rows-line!)))
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS" (length rows) 5)
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v rows "disagree") 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b2)
  ;; 2. Undo puts the engine's authorship back too: ast:restore restores
  ;;    node provenance and the mutation log to the snapshot, so after
  ;;    each ctrl-z the engine and the Soft stamps still agree.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "macro" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP"))
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW0_MACRO" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 0)) "who=") "macro")
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW2_HELPER" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 2)) "who=") "helper")
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a0 (m11:ew! 0)) (a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0" (m11:ew-field (car a0) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0_V" (caddr a0) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:expect "B2_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v (m11:ew-rows-line!) "disagree") 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b3)
  ;; 3. ctrl-o (IN 15) on the notebook face answers in the say line; a
  ;;    row the kid typed on after a helper KEEP says so; the checker
  ;;    catches a forged Soft stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")
  (m11:ew! 0)
  (m11:keys! (list "KEY end" "IN 32" "IN 15"))
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KEY_SAY" *pl-say* "the AI helper wrote hello, then you changed it")
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KID_AFTER" (caddr (pad:ew-at 0)) "kid-after")
  (let ((e (list "hello" "helper" "closer" 2 3 42)))
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHO" (pad:ew-verdict (list "macro" "closer" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHY" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "faster" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict #f e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_REAL" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) e) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_ENGINE_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) (list "hello" "nobody" "" 0 1 0)) "disagree"))
  (m11:expect "B3_NO_DISAGREE" *ew-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 3)
  #t)

;; M11c: "why did it break?" in kid words (why.aura).
(define *m11-tx-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: type error: argument 1: expected String, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:20: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 2;")
(define *m11-tx-arity0* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 0;")
(define *m11-tx-unbound* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: unbound variable: frob\n  did you mean 'drop'?;")
(define *m11-tx-parse* "parse-error: 1:21: unexpected ')'")
(define *m11-tx-caller-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 8:2: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile); 12:9: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-caller-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 2:24: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1; arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1;")
(define *m11-tc-pet* "re-inferred: 2\ndiagnostics:\n  [3] 1:28: unbound variable: pet\n  did you mean 'set'?\n")
(define *m11-tc-mixed* "re-inferred: 3\ndiagnostics:\n  [6] 1:20: unbound variable: frob\n  [14] warning: incompatible ground types: expected String, got Int\n")

(define (m11:sec-c1)
  ;; 1. The Soft table turns the engine's own refusal and diagnostic texts
  ;;    (captured on c69e644, probes p6 / p9 / p10) into one short kid
  ;;    sentence; a blamed caller line is named by its define or text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-type* "helper" "greet") "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY0" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity0* "macro" "bye") "the macro's bye gives hello 0 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_UNBOUND" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-unbound* "law" "bye") "the law's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_PARSE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-parse* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye has a bracket in the wrong place")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-type* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-arity* "helper" "hello") "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPEVAR" (pad:why-type-word "y") "something else")
  (m11:expect "C1_LINE" (pad:why-line *m11-tx-caller-type*) 8)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_OTHER" (pad:why-kid "refused" "helper" "bye") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_KINDS" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (list *m11-tx-type* *m11-tx-arity* *m11-tx-unbound* *m11-tx-parse* "x")))
                  "type.arity.unbound.brackets.other")
  ;; typecheck-incremental: pet is a notebook define, so its "unbound" is
  ;; dropped (aura#4363); frob is not, so it stays; a warning line maps too
  (m11:expect "C1_TC_PET_DROPPED" (length (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-pet*)) 0)
  ;; (shown as kinds: a raw "unbound variable" text would trip smoke's Soft-error grep)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_MIXED" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*))) "unbound.type")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_TC_MIXED_FROB" (pad:why-has? (car (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "variable: frob"))
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_WARN_KID" (pad:why-kid (cadr (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "helper" "greet")
                  "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_BAD" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_EXTRA" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)))")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_OK" (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2))"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c2)
  ;; 2. Live: aura refuses a robot proposal; the say line tells the kid
  ;;    which define broke and why, in kid words; the replay that found
  ;;    the reason leaves nothing behind (one heal, code and page same).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (p0 *why-probes*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
                                                                 (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")) "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_WHO" (car *why-last*) "bye")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "arity")
    (m11:expect "C2_PROBED" (- *why-probes* p0) 1)
    (m11:expect "C2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "C2_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "C2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (frob y))")) "fun") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet"))
  ;; a change that breaks the lines that use it: aura blames a caller
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x y) (+ x y))")) "two") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "type"))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE why_type=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; brackets: the engine would close a missing ")" by itself, so the
  ;; Soft gate refuses first, before any snapshot
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")) "short") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS" (cadr r) "brackets")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (m11:expect "C2_BRACKETS_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c3)
  ;; 3. A KEEP whose typecheck-incremental only reports the false
  ;;    "unbound" of a notebook define (aura#4363) is not turned into a
  ;;    warning: the say line stays the normal KEEP sentence. A refusal
  ;;    blamed on a caller line names that line.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y (string-length pet)))")) "pet") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C3_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "C3_TC_SAID_PET" (pad:why-has? *robot-tc-raw* "variable: pet"))
    (m11:expect "C3_NO_FALSE_WARN" (length *robot-diags*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "C3_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed bye, ctrl-z takes it all back"))
  ;; a type refusal blamed on a caller line: bye now wants words, (bye 4)
  ;; gives it a number
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (string-append pet y))")) "pet") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)"))
      #f)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 3)
  #t)

;; M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura).
(define (m11:card-out! r)
  (pad:robot-line-out! r "helper")
  (if (string=? (car r) "CARD")
      (begin (newline) (display (pad:blast-line *blast-last*)) (newline))
      #f)
  r)

(define (m11:sec-d1)
  ;; 1. The card lists what the change would move, before anything is
  ;;    kept: the page does not change, the engine has the change inside
  ;;    a snapshot, and Soft's call-site count equals query:calls.
  ;;    Enter keeps it like a robot KEEP; ctrl-z then undoes it.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_CARD" (car r) "CARD")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SAY" *pl-say* "changing hello and bye moves 3 places: (hello 3), (bye 4), (hello (bye 5)). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_USES" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr *blast-last*)) "6.7.11")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_GROWN" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 4)) "hello.bye")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "D1_PAGE_WAITS" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_ENGINE_HAS_IT" (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect "D1_NO_UNDO_YET" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 13"))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_KEEP_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed hello and bye, ctrl-z takes it all back")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect "D1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "D1_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_PAGE" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z on a waiting card says no: the snapshot is restored,
  ;;    nothing moved, nothing to undo afterwards. Row names on the card:
  ;;    a define row by its name, a short row by its text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SAY" *pl-say* "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "add:3/3:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_NO_SAY" *pl-say* "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed")
    (m11:expect-true "D2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect "D2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "D2_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "D2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_THEN_UNDO_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d3)
  ;; 3. A card the engine refuses never waits: DROP with the kid reason
  ;;    (M11c). A card with more places than fit says "and N more"; one
  ;;    with none says "moves nothing else". The checker flags a count
  ;;    that disagrees with the engine.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "D3_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*)))
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_NONE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "pet") (list) (list) (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing pet moves nothing else. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_MORE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "f") (list 1 2 3 4 5) (list "a" "b" "c" "d" "e") (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing f moves 5 places: a, b, c and 2 more. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_BAD" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 2 2 1)))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_STALE_OK" (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 4 3 1))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_NO_ENGINE" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 0 -1 -1 0)))))
  (m11:expect "D3_NO_DISAGREE" *blast-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 3)
  #t)

(define (m11:outro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11STATS ") (display (pad:robot-stats-str))
  (display " ") (display (pad:time-stats-str))
  (display " ") (display (pad:world-stats-str))
  (newline)
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display (number->string *m11-checks*))
  (display " fail=") (display (number->string *m11-fail*))
  (newline)
  (if (= *m11-fail* 0) (display "PAD_M11_TEST_OK") (display "PAD_M11_TEST_FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define (m11:run-all)
  (m11:intro)
  (m11:sec-a1)
  (m11:sec-a2)
  (m11:sec-a3)
  (m11:sec-b1)
  (m11:sec-b2)
  (m11:sec-b3)
  (m11:sec-c1)
  (m11:sec-c2)
  (m11:sec-c3)
  (m11:sec-d1)
  (m11:sec-d2)
  (m11:sec-d3)
  (m11:sec-e1)
  (m11:sec-e2)
  (m11:sec-e3)
  (m11:sec-f1)
  (m11:sec-f2)
  (m11:outro))

(lambda () ;; 3. A KEEP that reads a notebook value define (pet) gets no
  ;;    warning: typecheck-incremental no longer calls pet unbound
  ;;    (aura#4363 fixed), so the say line stays the normal KEEP
  ;;    sentence. A refusal blamed on a caller line names that line.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y (string-length pet)))")) "pet") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C3_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "C3_TC_NO_FALSE_PET" (not (pad:why-has? *robot-tc-raw* "variable: pet")))
    (m11:expect "C3_NO_FALSE_WARN" (length *robot-diags*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "C3_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed bye, ctrl-z takes it all back"))
  ;; a type refusal blamed on a caller line: bye now wants words, (bye 4)

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11 test cases (Aura-unique features), loaded by m11_test.aura.
;; Every section is a function; the entry file runs ONE top-level call
;; (forms after a set-code + eval-current are read back wrong, docs/m9.md).
;; Test globals carry an m11 prefix only (aura#4353). Prints T lines,
;; M11A_ACC .. M11F_ACC n OK per acceptance item (M11e / M11f cases live
;; in m11e_cases.aura / m11f_cases.aura), M11STATS, then PAD_M11_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-fail* 0)
(define *m11-checks* 0)
(define *m11-acc0* 0)

(define (m11:mark! ok tag shown want)
  (set! *m11-checks* (+ *m11-checks* 1))
  (newline)
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display "=") (display shown)
  (if ok
      (display " OK")
      (begin (display " WANT=") (display want) (set! *m11-fail* (+ *m11-fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  ok)
(define (m11:expect tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (number? got) (= got want)) tag (if (number? got) (number->string got) "?")
             (number->string want)))
(define (m11:expect-str tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (string? got) (string=? got want)) tag (if (string? got) got "?") want))
(define (m11:expect-true tag got)
  (m11:expect-str tag (if got "yes" "no") "yes"))

(define (m11:acc-begin!) (set! *m11-acc0* *m11-fail*))
(define (m11:acc-end! part n)
  (newline)
  (display part) (display "_ACC ") (display (number->string n))
  (display (if (= *m11-fail* *m11-acc0*) " OK" " FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define *m11-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(add 2 3)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

(define (m11:row-src l) (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l))))
(define (m11:keys! ks)
  (if (null? ks) 0 (begin (pad:robot-line! (car ks)) (m11:keys! (cdr ks)))))

(define (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:play-reset! *m11-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pen-undo* (list))
  (set! *robot-undo* (list))
  (set! *who-keep-codes* (list))
  (pad:play-snap)
  (m11:expect-str "CHECK" (car (pad:who-check!)) "ok")
  #t)

;; query:mutations-since 0 -> its records split into "key=value" tokens.
(define (m11:muts)
  (try
    (let ((m (query:mutations-since 0)))
      (cond
        ((string? m) (string-split m " "))
        ((pair? m) (m11:strs m))
        (#t (list))))
    (catch (e) (list))))
;; one string per mutation record ("id=1 target=5 op=rebind ... composite=0")
(define (m11:strs xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string? (car xs)) (append (string-split (car xs) " ") (m11:strs (cdr xs))))
    (#t (m11:strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (m11:uniq xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
    ((member (car xs) acc) (m11:uniq (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (m11:uniq (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
;; composite ids of the mutation records with id > id0, and their authors
(define (m11:rec-field ts key cur id0 acc)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
    ((string-prefix? (car ts) "id=")
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key (string->number (substring (car ts) 3 (string-length (car ts)))) id0 acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car ts) key) (number? cur) (> cur id0))
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 (cons (substring (car ts) (string-length key) (string-length (car ts))) acc)))
    (#t (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 acc))))
(define (m11:last-id)
  (try
    (let ((v (hash-ref (mutation-log:summary) "last-mutation-id")))
      (if (number? v) v -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define *m11-gate* (if (string? (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE")) (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE") ""))
(define *m11-ops-good*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (- (hello y)))")))
(define *m11-ops-type*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 3))") (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (string-append n 1))")))
(define *m11-ops-arity*
  (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (* a b))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))

(define (m11:intro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11 Aura-unique features on Soft tip")
  (newline)
  (display "M11GATE type_gate=") (display (if (string=? *m11-gate* "") "default" *m11-gate*))
  (newline)
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_Q" (pad:robot-q "a\"b") (list->string (list 34 97 92 34 98 34)))
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_SEXPR" (pad:robot-sexpr (list "f" "(lambda (x) x)") "hi")
                  "(mutate:rebind \"f\" \"(lambda (x) x)\" \"hi\")")
  #t)

;; M11a: a robot proposal is one typed engine transaction; ctrl-z undoes it.
(define (m11:sec-a1)
  ;; 1. A two-define proposal lands whole: both defines change in the
  ;;    engine, both rows in the page, one composite transaction id, the
  ;;    rows are stamped helper.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (m (m11:muts))
         (cs (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "A1_GEN_UP" (>= (pad:nth r 3) 1))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_HELLO" (string-contains? code1 "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_BYE" (string-contains? code1 "(- (hello y))"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_CHANGED" (not (string=? code0 code1)))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define bye (lambda (y) (- (hello y))))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_TAGS" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth r 5)) "row.row")
    (newline) (display "M11TXN records=") (display (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))))
    (display " composite=") (display (pad:ws-names-str cs)) (newline)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_RECORDS" (>= (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))) 2))
    (m11:expect "A1_ONE_TXN" (length cs) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_TXN_NONZERO" (and (pair? cs) (not (string=? (car cs) "0"))))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_LOG_GREW" (> (m11:last-id) id0))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (pad:pen-gen))))
    (m11:expect "A1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z (IN 26) undoes the whole robot change in one key: engine
  ;;    code back to before the proposal, both rows back, stamps back;
  ;;    a second ctrl-z says there is nothing to undo.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (u0 *robot-undos*))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect "A2_ONE_KEY" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's whole change is gone")
    (m11:expect-true "A2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_PAGE_BACK" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define (bye y) (hello y))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY_EMPTY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (m11:expect "A2_NO_MORE" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1))
  ;; two robot changes, kid typing between: ctrl-z twice walks back LIFO
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_1" (string=? (pad:q-code) code1))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_2" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect "A2_UNDO_EMPTY" (length *robot-undo*) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a3)
  ;; 3. A refused proposal moves nothing: one edit is fine, the other
  ;;    breaks arity (refused in every gate mode) or types (refused with
  ;;    AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard). Engine code, page and stamps stay;
  ;;    nothing is pushed for ctrl-z; workspace procedures still answer
  ;;    (restore + eval-current, aura#4361).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_SAY" (pad:nth r 2) "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ADD_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* a b)")))
    (m11:expect "A3_HEALED" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "A3_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "A3_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
             (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "A3_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-true "A3_TYPE_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
        (m11:expect-true "A3_HELLO_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 3)"))))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE type_proposal=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; the gate refuses before the engine: no snapshot, generation unchanged
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (set! x 1))")) "sneaky") "helper"))
         (r2 (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)") (list "hello" "(lambda (x) 0)")) "twice")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REJECT" (car r) "REJECT")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REASON" (cadr r) "not-allowed")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_TWICE" (cadr r2) "twice")
    (m11:expect "A3_GATE_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 3)
  #t)

;; M11b: engine-level "who wrote this" (eng_who.aura).
(define (m11:ew! l)
  (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l 0 (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                        (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
  (let ((r (pad:ew-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (display " say=\"") (display (cadr r)) (display "\"") (newline)
    r))
(define (m11:ew-field tag key)
  (pad:ew-field (string-split tag " ") key))
(define (m11:ew-rows-line!)
  (let ((rows (pad:ew-rows)))
    (newline) (display "EWHOROWS ") (display (pad:ew-rows-str rows)) (newline)
    rows))

(define (m11:sec-b1)
  ;; 1. A robot KEEP and a pen KEEP are stamped by the engine with the
  ;;    writer's fingerprint; ctrl-o answers from query:node-provenance +
  ;;    the rebind record's reason, and agrees with the Soft row stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-true "B1_FP_BOUND" *ew-bound*)
  (m11:expect "B1_FP_HELPER" (pad:ew-fp "helper") 42)
  (m11:expect-str "B1_FP_WHO" (pad:ew-who-of 4) "law")
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_SAY" (cadr a) "nobody has changed this yet"))
  (let* ((id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (m (m11:muts)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_AUTHORS" (pad:ws-names-str (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "author=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))) "42"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "closer")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_SOFT" (m11:ew-field (car a) "soft=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW0_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "the AI helper wrote hello: closer (change ")))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 1)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 6)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW6_V" (caddr a) "soft-only"))
  ;; pen step by a law, under fingerprint 4
  (let ((rs (pad:ew-pen-step! "law" "greet" "(lambda (n) (add n 2))" "rule")))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_LAW_KEEP" (car (car rs)) "KEEP"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 5)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "law")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "rule")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW5_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "a law wrote greet: rule")))
  (let ((rows (m11:ew-rows-line!)))
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS" (length rows) 5)
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v rows "disagree") 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b2)
  ;; 2. Undo puts the engine's authorship back too: ast:restore restores
  ;;    node provenance and the mutation log to the snapshot, so after
  ;;    each ctrl-z the engine and the Soft stamps still agree.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "macro" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP"))
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW0_MACRO" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 0)) "who=") "macro")
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW2_HELPER" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 2)) "who=") "helper")
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a0 (m11:ew! 0)) (a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0" (m11:ew-field (car a0) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0_V" (caddr a0) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:expect "B2_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v (m11:ew-rows-line!) "disagree") 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b3)
  ;; 3. ctrl-o (IN 15) on the notebook face answers in the say line; a
  ;;    row the kid typed on after a helper KEEP says so; the checker
  ;;    catches a forged Soft stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")
  (m11:ew! 0)
  (m11:keys! (list "KEY end" "IN 32" "IN 15"))
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KEY_SAY" *pl-say* "the AI helper wrote hello, then you changed it")
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KID_AFTER" (caddr (pad:ew-at 0)) "kid-after")
  (let ((e (list "hello" "helper" "closer" 2 3 42)))
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHO" (pad:ew-verdict (list "macro" "closer" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHY" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "faster" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict #f e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_REAL" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) e) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_ENGINE_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) (list "hello" "nobody" "" 0 1 0)) "disagree"))
  (m11:expect "B3_NO_DISAGREE" *ew-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 3)
  #t)

;; M11c: "why did it break?" in kid words (why.aura).
(define *m11-tx-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: type error: argument 1: expected String, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:20: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 2;")
(define *m11-tx-arity0* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 0;")
(define *m11-tx-unbound* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: unbound variable: frob\n  did you mean 'drop'?;")
(define *m11-tx-parse* "parse-error: 1:21: unexpected ')'")
(define *m11-tx-caller-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 8:2: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile); 12:9: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-caller-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 2:24: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1; arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1;")
(define *m11-tc-pet* "re-inferred: 2\ndiagnostics:\n  [3] 1:28: unbound variable: pet\n  did you mean 'set'?\n")
(define *m11-tc-mixed* "re-inferred: 3\ndiagnostics:\n  [6] 1:20: unbound variable: frob\n  [14] warning: incompatible ground types: expected String, got Int\n")

(define (m11:sec-c1)
  ;; 1. The Soft table turns the engine's own refusal and diagnostic texts
  ;;    (captured on c69e644, probes p6 / p9 / p10) into one short kid
  ;;    sentence; a blamed caller line is named by its define or text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-type* "helper" "greet") "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY0" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity0* "macro" "bye") "the macro's bye gives hello 0 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_UNBOUND" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-unbound* "law" "bye") "the law's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_PARSE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-parse* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye has a bracket in the wrong place")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-type* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-arity* "helper" "hello") "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPEVAR" (pad:why-type-word "y") "something else")
  (m11:expect "C1_LINE" (pad:why-line *m11-tx-caller-type*) 8)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_OTHER" (pad:why-kid "refused" "helper" "bye") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_KINDS" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (list *m11-tx-type* *m11-tx-arity* *m11-tx-unbound* *m11-tx-parse* "x")))
                  "type.arity.unbound.brackets.other")
  ;; typecheck-incremental: pet is a notebook define, so its "unbound" is
  ;; dropped (aura#4363); frob is not, so it stays; a warning line maps too
  (m11:expect "C1_TC_PET_DROPPED" (length (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-pet*)) 0)
  ;; (shown as kinds: a raw "unbound variable" text would trip smoke's Soft-error grep)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_MIXED" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*))) "unbound.type")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_TC_MIXED_FROB" (pad:why-has? (car (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "variable: frob"))
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_WARN_KID" (pad:why-kid (cadr (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "helper" "greet")
                  "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_BAD" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_EXTRA" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)))")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_OK" (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2))"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c2)
  ;; 2. Live: aura refuses a robot proposal; the say line tells the kid
  ;;    which define broke and why, in kid words; the replay that found
  ;;    the reason leaves nothing behind (one heal, code and page same).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (p0 *why-probes*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
                                                                 (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")) "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_WHO" (car *why-last*) "bye")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "arity")
    (m11:expect "C2_PROBED" (- *why-probes* p0) 1)
    (m11:expect "C2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "C2_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "C2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (frob y))")) "fun") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet"))
  ;; a change that breaks the lines that use it: aura blames a caller
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x y) (+ x y))")) "two") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "type"))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE why_type=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; brackets: the engine would close a missing ")" by itself, so the
  ;; Soft gate refuses first, before any snapshot
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")) "short") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS" (cadr r) "brackets")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (m11:expect "C2_BRACKETS_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c3)
  ;; 3. A KEEP whose typecheck-incremental only reports the false
  ;;    "unbound" of a notebook define (aura#4363) is not turned into a
  ;;    warning: the say line stays the normal KEEP sentence. A refusal
  ;;    blamed on a caller line names that line.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y (string-length pet)))")) "pet") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C3_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "C3_TC_SAID_PET" (pad:why-has? *robot-tc-raw* "variable: pet"))
    (m11:expect "C3_NO_FALSE_WARN" (length *robot-diags*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "C3_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed bye, ctrl-z takes it all back"))
  ;; a type refusal blamed on a caller line: bye now wants words, (bye 4)
  ;; gives it a number
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (string-append pet y))")) "pet") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)"))
      #f)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 3)
  #t)

;; M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura).
(define (m11:card-out! r)
  (pad:robot-line-out! r "helper")
  (if (string=? (car r) "CARD")
      (begin (newline) (display (pad:blast-line *blast-last*)) (newline))
      #f)
  r)

(define (m11:sec-d1)
  ;; 1. The card lists what the change would move, before anything is
  ;;    kept: the page does not change, the engine has the change inside
  ;;    a snapshot, and Soft's call-site count equals query:calls.
  ;;    Enter keeps it like a robot KEEP; ctrl-z then undoes it.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_CARD" (car r) "CARD")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SAY" *pl-say* "changing hello and bye moves 3 places: (hello 3), (bye 4), (hello (bye 5)). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_USES" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr *blast-last*)) "6.7.11")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_GROWN" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 4)) "hello.bye")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "D1_PAGE_WAITS" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_ENGINE_HAS_IT" (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect "D1_NO_UNDO_YET" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 13"))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_KEEP_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed hello and bye, ctrl-z takes it all back")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect "D1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "D1_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_PAGE" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z on a waiting card says no: the snapshot is restored,
  ;;    nothing moved, nothing to undo afterwards. Row names on the card:
  ;;    a define row by its name, a short row by its text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SAY" *pl-say* "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "add:3/3:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_NO_SAY" *pl-say* "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed")
    (m11:expect-true "D2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect "D2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "D2_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "D2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_THEN_UNDO_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d3)
  ;; 3. A card the engine refuses never waits: DROP with the kid reason
  ;;    (M11c). A card with more places than fit says "and N more"; one
  ;;    with none says "moves nothing else". The checker flags a count
  ;;    that disagrees with the engine.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "D3_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*)))
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_NONE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "pet") (list) (list) (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing pet moves nothing else. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_MORE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "f") (list 1 2 3 4 5) (list "a" "b" "c" "d" "e") (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing f moves 5 places: a, b, c and 2 more. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_BAD" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 2 2 1)))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_STALE_OK" (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 4 3 1))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_NO_ENGINE" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 0 -1 -1 0)))))
  (m11:expect "D3_NO_DISAGREE" *blast-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 3)
  #t)

(define (m11:outro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11STATS ") (display (pad:robot-stats-str))
  (display " ") (display (pad:time-stats-str))
  (display " ") (display (pad:world-stats-str))
  (newline)
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display (number->string *m11-checks*))
  (display " fail=") (display (number->string *m11-fail*))
  (newline)
  (if (= *m11-fail* 0) (display "PAD_M11_TEST_OK") (display "PAD_M11_TEST_FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define (m11:run-all)
  (m11:intro)
  (m11:sec-a1)
  (m11:sec-a2)
  (m11:sec-a3)
  (m11:sec-b1)
  (m11:sec-b2)
  (m11:sec-b3)
  (m11:sec-c1)
  (m11:sec-c2)
  (m11:sec-c3)
  (m11:sec-d1)
  (m11:sec-d2)
  (m11:sec-d3)
  (m11:sec-e1)
  (m11:sec-e2)
  (m11:sec-e3)
  (m11:sec-f1)
  (m11:sec-f2)
  (m11:outro))

(lambda () ;; 2. ctrl-z on a waiting card says no: the snapshot is restored,
  ;;    nothing moved, nothing to undo afterwards. Row names on the card:

  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
