input.source:
;; aura-pad M11 test cases (Aura-unique features), loaded by m11_test.aura.
;; Every section is a function; the entry file runs ONE top-level call
;; (forms after a set-code + eval-current are read back wrong, docs/m9.md).
;; Test globals carry an m11 prefix only (aura#4353). Prints T lines,
;; M11A_ACC .. M11F_ACC n OK per acceptance item (M11e / M11f cases live
;; in m11e_cases.aura / m11f_cases.aura), M11STATS, then PAD_M11_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-fail* 0)
(define *m11-checks* 0)
(define *m11-acc0* 0)

(define (m11:mark! ok tag shown want)
  (set! *m11-checks* (+ *m11-checks* 1))
  (newline)
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display "=") (display shown)
  (if ok
      (display " OK")
      (begin (display " WANT=") (display want) (set! *m11-fail* (+ *m11-fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  ok)
(define (m11:expect tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (number? got) (= got want)) tag (if (number? got) (number->string got) "?")
             (number->string want)))
(define (m11:expect-str tag got want)
  (m11:mark! (and (string? got) (string=? got want)) tag (if (string? got) got "?") want))
(define (m11:expect-true tag got)
  (m11:expect-str tag (if got "yes" "no") "yes"))

(define (m11:acc-begin!) (set! *m11-acc0* *m11-fail*))
(define (m11:acc-end! part n)
  (newline)
  (display part) (display "_ACC ") (display (number->string n))
  (display (if (= *m11-fail* *m11-acc0*) " OK" " FAIL"))
  (newline))

(define *m11-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(add 2 3)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

(define (m11:row-src l) (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l))))
(define (m11:keys! ks)
  (if (null? ks) 0 (begin (pad:robot-line! (car ks)) (m11:keys! (cdr ks)))))

(define (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:play-reset! *m11-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pen-undo* (list))
  (set! *robot-undo* (list))
  (set! *who-keep-codes* (list))
  (pad:play-snap)
  (m11:expect-str "CHECK" (car (pad:who-check!)) "ok")
  #t)

;; query:mutations-since 0 -> its records split into "key=value" tokens.
(define (m11:muts)
  (try
    (let ((m (query:mutations-since 0)))
      (cond
        ((string? m) (string-split m " "))
        ((pair? m) (m11:strs m))
        (#t (list))))
    (catch (e) (list))))
;; one string per mutation record ("id=1 target=5 op=rebind ... composite=0")
(define (m11:strs xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string? (car xs)) (append (string-split (car xs) " ") (m11:strs (cdr xs))))
    (#t (m11:strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (m11:uniq xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (reverse acc))
    ((member (car xs) acc) (m11:uniq (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (m11:uniq (cdr xs) (cons (car xs) acc)))))
;; composite ids of the mutation records with id > id0, and their authors
(define (m11:rec-field ts key cur id0 acc)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
    ((string-prefix? (car ts) "id=")
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key (string->number (substring (car ts) 3 (string-length (car ts)))) id0 acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car ts) key) (number? cur) (> cur id0))
     (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 (cons (substring (car ts) (string-length key) (string-length (car ts))) acc)))
    (#t (m11:rec-field (cdr ts) key cur id0 acc))))
(define (m11:last-id)
  (try
    (let ((v (hash-ref (mutation-log:summary) "last-mutation-id")))
      (if (number? v) v -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))

(define *m11-gate* (if (string? (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE")) (getenv "AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE") ""))
(define *m11-ops-good*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (- (hello y)))")))
(define *m11-ops-type*
  (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 3))") (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (string-append n 1))")))
(define *m11-ops-arity*
  (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (* a b))") (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))

(define (m11:intro)
  (newline)
  (display "M11 Aura-unique features on Soft tip")
  (newline)
  (display "M11GATE type_gate=") (display (if (string=? *m11-gate* "") "default" *m11-gate*))
  (newline)
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_Q" (pad:robot-q "a\"b") (list->string (list 34 97 92 34 98 34)))
  (m11:expect-str "ROBOT_SEXPR" (pad:robot-sexpr (list "f" "(lambda (x) x)") "hi")
                  "(mutate:rebind \"f\" \"(lambda (x) x)\" \"hi\")")
  #t)

;; M11a: a robot proposal is one typed engine transaction; ctrl-z undoes it.
(define (m11:sec-a1)
  ;; 1. A two-define proposal lands whole: both defines change in the
  ;;    engine, both rows in the page, one composite transaction id, the
  ;;    rows are stamped helper.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (m (m11:muts))
         (cs (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "A1_GEN_UP" (>= (pad:nth r 3) 1))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_HELLO" (string-contains? code1 "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_BYE" (string-contains? code1 "(- (hello y))"))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_CODE_CHANGED" (not (string=? code0 code1)))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define bye (lambda (y) (- (hello y))))")
    (m11:expect-str "A1_TAGS" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth r 5)) "row.row")
    (newline) (display "M11TXN records=") (display (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))))
    (display " composite=") (display (pad:ws-names-str cs)) (newline)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_RECORDS" (>= (length (m11:rec-field m "composite=" -1 id0 (list))) 2))
    (m11:expect "A1_ONE_TXN" (length cs) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "A1_TXN_NONZERO" (and (pair? cs) (not (string=? (car cs) "0"))))
    (m11:expect-true "A1_LOG_GREW" (> (m11:last-id) id0))
    (m11:expect-str "A1_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (pad:pen-gen))))
    (m11:expect "A1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z (IN 26) undoes the whole robot change in one key: engine
  ;;    code back to before the proposal, both rows back, stamps back;
  ;;    a second ctrl-z says there is nothing to undo.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (u0 *robot-undos*))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect "A2_ONE_KEY" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's whole change is gone")
    (m11:expect-true "A2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_PAGE_BACK" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_ROW1" (m11:row-src 1) "(define (bye y) (hello y))")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_SAY_EMPTY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (m11:expect "A2_NO_MORE" (- *robot-undos* u0) 1))
  ;; two robot changes, kid typing between: ctrl-z twice walks back LIFO
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (code1 (pad:q-code))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "A2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_1" (string=? (pad:q-code) code1))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "A2_LIFO_2" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect "A2_UNDO_EMPTY" (length *robot-undo*) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-a3)
  ;; 3. A refused proposal moves nothing: one edit is fine, the other
  ;;    breaks arity (refused in every gate mode) or types (refused with
  ;;    AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard). Engine code, page and stamps stay;
  ;;    nothing is pushed for ctrl-z; workspace procedures still answer
  ;;    (restore + eval-current, aura#4361).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_ARITY_SAY" (pad:nth r 2) "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ARITY_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "A3_ADD_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* a b)")))
    (m11:expect "A3_HEALED" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "A3_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "A3_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
             (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "A3_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-true "A3_TYPE_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
        (m11:expect-true "A3_HELLO_NOT_HALF" (not (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 3)"))))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE type_proposal=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; the gate refuses before the engine: no snapshot, generation unchanged
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (set! x 1))")) "sneaky") "helper"))
         (r2 (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)") (list "hello" "(lambda (x) 0)")) "twice")))
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REJECT" (car r) "REJECT")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_GATE_REASON" (cadr r) "not-allowed")
    (m11:expect-str "A3_TWICE" (cadr r2) "twice")
    (m11:expect "A3_GATE_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11A" 3)
  #t)

;; M11b: engine-level "who wrote this" (eng_who.aura).
(define (m11:ew! l)
  (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l 0 (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                        (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
  (let ((r (pad:ew-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (display " say=\"") (display (cadr r)) (display "\"") (newline)
    r))
(define (m11:ew-field tag key)
  (pad:ew-field (string-split tag " ") key))
(define (m11:ew-rows-line!)
  (let ((rows (pad:ew-rows)))
    (newline) (display "EWHOROWS ") (display (pad:ew-rows-str rows)) (newline)
    rows))

(define (m11:sec-b1)
  ;; 1. A robot KEEP and a pen KEEP are stamped by the engine with the
  ;;    writer's fingerprint; ctrl-o answers from query:node-provenance +
  ;;    the rebind record's reason, and agrees with the Soft row stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-true "B1_FP_BOUND" *ew-bound*)
  (m11:expect "B1_FP_HELPER" (pad:ew-fp "helper") 42)
  (m11:expect-str "B1_FP_WHO" (pad:ew-who-of 4) "law")
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_FRESH_SAY" (cadr a) "nobody has changed this yet"))
  (let* ((id0 (m11:last-id))
         (r (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))
         (m (m11:muts)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_AUTHORS" (pad:ws-names-str (m11:uniq (m11:rec-field m "author=" -1 id0 (list)) (list))) "42"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 0)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "closer")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_SOFT" (m11:ew-field (car a) "soft=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW0_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW0_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "the AI helper wrote hello: closer (change ")))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 1)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW1_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW2_V" (caddr a) "agree"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 6)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW6_V" (caddr a) "soft-only"))
  ;; pen step by a law, under fingerprint 4
  (let ((rs (pad:ew-pen-step! "law" "greet" "(lambda (n) (add n 2))" "rule")))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_LAW_KEEP" (car (car rs)) "KEEP"))
  (let ((a (m11:ew! 5)))
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHO" (m11:ew-field (car a) "who=") "law")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_WHY" (m11:ew-field (car a) "why=") "rule")
    (m11:expect-str "B1_ROW5_V" (caddr a) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "B1_ROW5_SAY" (string-prefix? (cadr a) "a law wrote greet: rule")))
  (let ((rows (m11:ew-rows-line!)))
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS" (length rows) 5)
    (m11:expect "B1_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v rows "disagree") 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b2)
  ;; 2. Undo puts the engine's authorship back too: ast:restore restores
  ;;    node provenance and the mutation log to the snapshot, so after
  ;;    each ctrl-z the engine and the Soft stamps still agree.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((ra (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))
         (rb (pad:robot-step! "macro" *m11-ops-good* "closer")))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_A" (car ra) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_KEEP_B" (car rb) "KEEP"))
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW0_MACRO" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 0)) "who=") "macro")
  (m11:expect-str "B2_ROW2_HELPER" (m11:ew-field (car (m11:ew! 2)) "who=") "helper")
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a0 (m11:ew! 0)) (a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0" (m11:ew-field (car a0) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW0_V" (caddr a0) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "helper")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO1_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (let ((a2 (m11:ew! 2)))
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2" (m11:ew-field (car a2) "who=") "nobody")
    (m11:expect-str "B2_UNDO2_ROW2_V" (caddr a2) "agree"))
  (m11:expect "B2_ROWS_DISAGREE" (pad:ew-count-v (m11:ew-rows-line!) "disagree") 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-b3)
  ;; 3. ctrl-o (IN 15) on the notebook face answers in the say line; a
  ;;    row the kid typed on after a helper KEEP says so; the checker
  ;;    catches a forged Soft stamp.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer")
  (m11:ew! 0)
  (m11:keys! (list "KEY end" "IN 32" "IN 15"))
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KEY_SAY" *pl-say* "the AI helper wrote hello, then you changed it")
  (m11:expect-str "B3_KID_AFTER" (caddr (pad:ew-at 0)) "kid-after")
  (let ((e (list "hello" "helper" "closer" 2 3 42)))
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHO" (pad:ew-verdict (list "macro" "closer" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_WHY" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "faster" 3) e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_FORGED_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict #f e) "disagree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_REAL" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) e) "agree")
    (m11:expect-str "B3_ENGINE_NONE" (pad:ew-verdict (list "helper" "closer" 3) (list "hello" "nobody" "" 0 1 0)) "disagree"))
  (m11:expect "B3_NO_DISAGREE" *ew-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11B" 3)
  #t)

;; M11c: "why did it break?" in kid words (why.aura).
(define *m11-tx-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: type error: argument 1: expected String, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:20: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 2;")
(define *m11-tx-arity0* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 0;")
(define *m11-tx-unbound* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 1:14: unbound variable: frob\n  did you mean 'drop'?;")
(define *m11-tx-parse* "parse-error: 1:21: unexpected ')'")
(define *m11-tx-caller-type* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 8:2: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile); 12:9: type error: argument 0: expected y, got Int\n  blamed: caller (compile);")
(define *m11-tx-caller-arity* "mutation-failed: mutation rejected: typecheck after mutate (selective) failed: 2:24: arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1; arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 2 arguments, got 1;")
(define *m11-tc-pet* "re-inferred: 2\ndiagnostics:\n  [3] 1:28: unbound variable: pet\n  did you mean 'set'?\n")
(define *m11-tc-mixed* "re-inferred: 3\ndiagnostics:\n  [6] 1:20: unbound variable: frob\n  [14] warning: incompatible ground types: expected String, got Int\n")

(define (m11:sec-c1)
  ;; 1. The Soft table turns the engine's own refusal and diagnostic texts
  ;;    (captured on c69e644, probes p6 / p9 / p10) into one short kid
  ;;    sentence; a blamed caller line is named by its define or text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-type* "helper" "greet") "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_ARITY0" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-arity0* "macro" "bye") "the macro's bye gives hello 0 things, it wants 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_UNBOUND" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-unbound* "law" "bye") "the law's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_PARSE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-parse* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye has a bracket in the wrong place")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_TYPE" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-type* "helper" "bye") "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_CALLER_ARITY" (pad:why-kid *m11-tx-caller-arity* "helper" "hello") "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TYPEVAR" (pad:why-type-word "y") "something else")
  (m11:expect "C1_LINE" (pad:why-line *m11-tx-caller-type*) 8)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_OTHER" (pad:why-kid "refused" "helper" "bye") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
  (m11:expect-str "C1_KINDS" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (list *m11-tx-type* *m11-tx-arity* *m11-tx-unbound* *m11-tx-parse* "x")))
                  "type.arity.unbound.brackets.other")
  ;; typecheck-incremental: pet is a notebook define, so its "unbound" is
  ;; dropped (aura#4363); frob is not, so it stays; a warning line maps too
  (m11:expect "C1_TC_PET_DROPPED" (length (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-pet*)) 0)
  ;; (shown as kinds: a raw "unbound variable" text would trip smoke's Soft-error grep)
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_MIXED" (pad:ws-names-str (map pad:why-kind (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*))) "unbound.type")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_TC_MIXED_FROB" (pad:why-has? (car (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "variable: frob"))
  (m11:expect-str "C1_TC_WARN_KID" (pad:why-kid (cadr (pad:why-diags *m11-tc-mixed*)) "helper" "greet")
                  "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_BAD" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_EXTRA" (not (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)))")))
  (m11:expect-true "C1_BRACKETS_OK" (pad:why-brackets-ok? "(lambda (y) (+ y 2))"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c2)
  ;; 2. Live: aura refuses a robot proposal; the say line tells the kid
  ;;    which define broke and why, in kid words; the replay that found
  ;;    the reason leaves nothing behind (one heal, code and page same).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (p0 *why-probes*)
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")
                                                                 (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")) "faster") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_WHO" (car *why-last*) "bye")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_ARITY_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "arity")
    (m11:expect "C2_PROBED" (- *why-probes* p0) 1)
    (m11:expect "C2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "C2_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "C2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLABLE" (try (number->string (hello 3)) (catch (e) "stale")) "4"))
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (frob y))")) "fun") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_UNBOUND_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet"))
  ;; a change that breaks the lines that use it: aura blames a caller
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x y) (+ x y))")) "two") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_CALLER_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1"))
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-type* "louder") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's greet used a number where words go")
        (m11:expect-str "C2_TYPE_KIND" (cadr *why-last*) "type"))
      (begin
        (newline) (display "M11GATE why_type=skipped (needs AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard)") (newline)))
  ;; brackets: the engine would close a missing ")" by itself, so the
  ;; Soft gate refuses first, before any snapshot
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y 2)")) "short") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS" (cadr r) "brackets")
    (m11:expect-str "C2_BRACKETS_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (m11:expect "C2_BRACKETS_GEN" (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-c3)
  ;; 3. A KEEP whose typecheck-incremental only reports the false
  ;;    "unbound" of a notebook define (aura#4363) is not turned into a
  ;;    warning: the say line stays the normal KEEP sentence. A refusal
  ;;    blamed on a caller line names that line.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (+ y (string-length pet)))")) "pet") "helper")))
    (m11:expect-str "C3_KEEP" (car r) "KEEP")
    (m11:expect-true "C3_TC_SAID_PET" (pad:why-has? *robot-tc-raw* "variable: pet"))
    (m11:expect "C3_NO_FALSE_WARN" (length *robot-diags*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "C3_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed bye, ctrl-z takes it all back"))
  ;; a type refusal blamed on a caller line: bye now wants words, (bye 4)
  ;; gives it a number
  (if (string=? *m11-gate* "hard")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (string-append pet y))")) "pet") "helper")))
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_DROP" (car r) "DROP")
        (m11:expect-str "C3_CALLER_TYPE_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)"))
      #f)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11C" 3)
  #t)

;; M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura).
(define (m11:card-out! r)
  (pad:robot-line-out! r "helper")
  (if (string=? (car r) "CARD")
      (begin (newline) (display (pad:blast-line *blast-last*)) (newline))
      #f)
  r)

(define (m11:sec-d1)
  ;; 1. The card lists what the change would move, before anything is
  ;;    kept: the page does not change, the engine has the change inside
  ;;    a snapshot, and Soft's call-site count equals query:calls.
  ;;    Enter keeps it like a robot KEEP; ctrl-z then undoes it.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_CARD" (car r) "CARD")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SAY" *pl-say* "changing hello and bye moves 3 places: (hello 3), (bye 4), (hello (bye 5)). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_USES" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr *blast-last*)) "6.7.11")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_GROWN" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 4)) "hello.bye")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "D1_PAGE_WAITS" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_ENGINE_HAS_IT" (string-contains? (pad:q-code) "(* x 2)"))
    (m11:expect "D1_NO_UNDO_YET" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 13"))
    (m11:expect-str "D1_KEEP_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper changed hello and bye, ctrl-z takes it all back")
    (m11:expect-str "D1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect "D1_UNDO_DEPTH" (length *robot-undo*) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "D1_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D1_UNDO_PAGE" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d2)
  ;; 2. ctrl-z on a waiting card says no: the snapshot is restored,
  ;;    nothing moved, nothing to undo afterwards. Row names on the card:
  ;;    a define row by its name, a short row by its text.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (h0 *ws-heals*)
         (r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")) "swap"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SAY" *pl-say* "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3). enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_SITES" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth *blast-last* 3)) "add:3/3:+0")
    (m11:expect-str "D2_VERDICT" (pad:nth *blast-last* 6) "agree")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_NO_SAY" *pl-say* "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed")
    (m11:expect-true "D2_CODE_BACK" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "D2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect "D2_ONE_HEAL" (- *ws-heals* h0) 1)
    (m11:expect "D2_NO_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "D2_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-str "D2_THEN_UNDO_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo"))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-d3)
  ;; 3. A card the engine refuses never waits: DROP with the kid reason
  ;;    (M11c). A card with more places than fit says "and N more"; one
  ;;    with none says "moves nothing else". The checker flags a count
  ;;    that disagrees with the engine.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "D3_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*)))
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_NONE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "pet") (list) (list) (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing pet moves nothing else. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_MORE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "f") (list 1 2 3 4 5) (list "a" "b" "c" "d" "e") (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing f moves 5 places: a, b, c and 2 more. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_BAD" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 2 2 1)))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_STALE_OK" (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 4 3 1))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_NO_ENGINE" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 0 -1 -1 0)))))
  (m11:expect "D3_NO_DISAGREE" *blast-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 3)
  #t)

target.body:
(lambda () ;; 3. A card the engine refuses never waits: DROP with the kid reason
  ;;    (M11c). A card with more places than fit says "and N more"; one
  ;;    with none says "moves nothing else". The checker flags a count
  ;;    that disagrees with the engine.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let ((r (m11:card-out! (pad:robot-card! "helper" *m11-ops-arity* "faster"))))
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED" (car r) "DROP")
    (m11:expect-str "D3_REFUSED_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1")
    (m11:expect-true "D3_NOT_PENDING" (not *robot-pending*)))
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_NONE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "pet") (list) (list) (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing pet moves nothing else. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-str "D3_SAY_MORE" (pad:blast-say (list (list "f") (list 1 2 3 4 5) (list "a" "b" "c" "d" "e") (list) (list) (list) "agree"))
                  "changing f moves 5 places: a, b, c and 2 more. enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_BAD" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 2)))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_MORE_BAD" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 3 4)))))
  (m11:expect-true "D3_COUNTS_NO_ENGINE" (not (pad:blast-counts-ok? (list (list "hello" 0 -1)))))
  (m11:expect "D3_NO_DISAGREE" *blast-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11D" 3)
  #t)

input.source:
;; Vi normal / insert and emacs ctrl-b f p n. Runs the play key path
;; (play_in.aura + vi.aura) without PAD_VI, then turns the mode on
;; itself. Prints PAD_VI_TEST_OK or PAD_VI_TEST_FAIL.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
(define *pad-home*
  (let ((h (getenv "AURA_PAD_HOME")))
    (if (and (string? h) (> (string-length h) 0)) h "/workspace/aura-pad")))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/buffer.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lines.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/edit.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/hl.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/jump.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/view.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lc.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/keys.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/card.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/who.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/play_in.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/vi.aura"))

(define *fail* 0)
(define *checks* 0)

(define (vt-ok tag)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " OK") (newline))

(define (vt-bad tag got)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (set! *fail* (+ *fail* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " FAIL ") (display got) (newline))

(define (vt-eq tag got want)
  (if (equal? got want) (vt-ok tag) (vt-bad tag got)))

(define (vt-arm! src)
  (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *vi-on* #t)
  (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
  (set! *vi-base* "t")
  (pad:vi-title!))

(define (vt-at tag l col)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-l") (pad:es-l *pl-st*) l)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-c") (pad:es-col *pl-st*) col))

;; emacs movement in normal mode
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(vt-eq "boot-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(vt-eq "boot-title" *pl-title* "t [normal]")
(pad:play-step! "IN 6")
(vt-at "cf" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 14")
(vt-at "cn" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 16")
(vt-at "cp" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-at "cb" 0 0)
(vt-eq "move-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; edge: ctrl-b at the start does not insert and does not jump back
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "cb-edge" *pl-say* "cannot move past the edge")
(vt-at "cb-stay" 0 0)

;; hjkl
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 107")
(pad:play-step! "IN 104")
(vt-at "hjkl" 0 0)
(vt-eq "hjkl-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; a normal-mode letter with no command is not inserted
(pad:play-step! "IN 113")
(vt-eq "q-say" *pl-say* "press i to type")
(vt-eq "q-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")
(vt-eq "q-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; i types, esc returns, l moves
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(vt-eq "ins-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-eq "ins-title" *pl-title* "t [insert]")
(vt-eq "ins-say" *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
(pad:play-step! "IN 90")
(vt-eq "typed" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(vt-eq "still-ins" *vi-mode* "insert")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27")
(vt-eq "esc-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(vt-eq "esc-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(vt-at "l-moves" 0 2)
(vt-eq "l-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")

;; emacs keys in insert mode move and stay in insert
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 6")
(pad:play-step! "IN 14")
(vt-eq "ins-move-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "ins-move" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 81")
(vt-eq "ins-q" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncQd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "ins-cb-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "ins-cb" 1 1)
(vt-eq "ins-cb-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncQd")

;; append moves one step then types
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 97")
(vt-eq "app-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "app-at" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 88")
(vt-eq "app-text" (pad:play-src) "aXb\ncd")

;; append at the end of the buffer just types
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 5")
(pad:play-step! "IN 97")
(vt-eq "app-end-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "app-end-at" 0 2)
(pad:play-step! "IN 89")
(vt-eq "app-end-text" (pad:play-src) "abY")

;; one read, several bytes: hj, then i A B esc
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108 106")
(vt-at "multi-move" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 105 65 66 27")
(vt-eq "multi-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncABd")
(vt-eq "multi-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; arrow in the same read still moves, and does not leave insert
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 91 66")
(vt-at "arrow-n" 1 0)
(vt-eq "arrow-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 91 67")
(vt-eq "arrow-ins" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "arrow-f" 1 1)

;; old ctrl-b / ctrl-p jobs moved, they did not disappear
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 29")
(vt-eq "jump" *pl-say* "nowhere to jump back to")
(pad:play-step! "IN 22")
(vt-eq "copy" *pl-say* "set a mark first")
(vt-eq "copy-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; x deletes the letter under the cursor; X deletes the one before
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 120")
(vt-eq "x-text" (pad:play-src) "b\ncd")
(vt-eq "x-say" *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
(vt-at "x-at" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 36")
(pad:play-step! "IN 120")
(vt-eq "x-eol" *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
(vt-eq "x-eol-t" (pad:play-src) "b\ncd")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 88")
(vt-eq "X-text" (pad:play-src) "b")
(vt-at "X-at" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 88")
(vt-eq "X-edge" *pl-say* "nothing before the cursor")

;; D deletes to the end of the line and does not join
(vt-arm! "abcd\nzz")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 68")
(vt-eq "D-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\nzz")

;; dd deletes the line; p puts it back; u takes the paste back
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd\nef")
(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100")
(vt-eq "d-wait" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd\nef")
(vt-eq "d-say" *pl-say* "d - press d again to delete the line")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100")
(vt-eq "dd-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\nef")
(vt-eq "dd-say" *pl-say* "deleted the line")
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")
(vt-eq "p-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd\nef")
(pad:play-step! "IN 117")
(vt-eq "u-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\nef")
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")
(vt-eq "dd-last" (pad:play-src) "ab")
(vt-at "dd-last-at" 0 2)
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")
(vt-eq "p-last" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")
(vt-eq "dd-only" (pad:play-src) "")
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")
(vt-eq "p-only" (pad:play-src) "ab")
(vt-arm! "")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")
(vt-eq "dd-empty" *pl-say* "nothing to delete")
(vt-eq "dd-empty-t" (pad:play-src) "")

;; yy copies the line
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 121 121")
(vt-eq "yy-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 48")
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")
(vt-eq "yy-p" (pad:play-src) "ab\nab\ncd")

;; ends of the line, top and bottom, words
(vt-arm! "ab cd\nzz")
(pad:play-step! "IN 36")
(vt-at "dollar" 0 5)
(pad:play-step! "IN 48")
(vt-at "zero" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 119")
(vt-at "w" 0 3)
(pad:play-step! "IN 98")
(vt-at "b" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 71")
(vt-at "G" 1 2)
(pad:play-step! "IN 103 103")
(vt-at "gg" 0 0)

;; r replaces one letter and u puts it back
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 114 90")
(vt-eq "r-text" (pad:play-src) "Zb")
(vt-at "r-at" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 117")
(vt-eq "r-undo" (pad:play-src) "ab")

;; I A o O
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 73")
(vt-eq "I-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "I-at" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 90")
(vt-eq "I-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27")
(pad:play-step! "IN 65")
(vt-eq "A-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "A-at" 0 3)
(pad:play-step! "IN 89")
(vt-eq "A-text" (pad:play-src) "ZabY\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27")
(pad:play-step! "IN 111")
(vt-eq "o-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-eq "o-text" (pad:play-src) "ZabY\n\ncd")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 79")
(vt-eq "O-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-eq "O-text" (pad:play-src) "\nab")
(vt-at "O-at" 0 0)

;; insert-mode dd types, it does not delete
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")
(vt-eq "ins-dd" (pad:play-src) "ddab")
(vt-eq "ins-dd-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58")
(vt-eq "ins-colon" (pad:play-src) "dd:ab")

;; :e runs the page. Alt-x then enter does too. A lone Esc then x deletes.
(vt-arm! "(+ 1 2)")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 101 13")
(vt-eq "eval-e" *pl-say* "ran: 3")
(vt-eq "eval-src" (pad:play-src) "(+ 1 2)")
(vt-arm! "(define (h x) (+ x 1))\n(h 3)")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 101 118 97 108 13")
(vt-eq "eval-def" *pl-say* "ran: 4")
(vt-arm! "(display 9)\n(+ 1 2)")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 101 13")
(vt-eq "eval-out" *pl-say* "ran: 3 printed: 9")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(vt-at "after-eval" 0 1)
(vt-arm! "(+ 1 2)")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 120")
(pad:play-step! "IN 13")
(vt-eq "mx" *pl-say* "ran: 3")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27")
(pad:play-step! "IN 120")
(vt-eq "split-x" (pad:play-src) "b")
(vt-arm! "(no-such 1)")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 101 13")
(vt-eq "eval-bad" *pl-say* "did not run: no-such is not defined yet")
(vt-arm! "(+ 1")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 101 13")
(vt-eq "eval-paren" *pl-say* "did not run - check the parens")
(vt-arm! "   ")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 101 13")
(vt-eq "eval-blank" *pl-say* "the page is empty")

;; quit and commands, no file open
(vt-arm! "ab")
(vt-eq "cxc" (pad:play-step! "IN 24 3") "quit")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(vt-eq "cx-go" (pad:play-step! "IN 24") "go")
(vt-eq "cx-say" *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-c quits, ctrl-e runs this page")
(vt-eq "cx-q" (pad:play-step! "IN 3") "quit")
(vt-arm! "(+ 4 5)")
(vt-eq "cxe" (pad:play-step! "IN 24 5") "go")
(vt-eq "cxe-say" *pl-say* "ran: 9")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(vt-eq "colon-q" (pad:play-step! "IN 58 113 13") "quit")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(vt-eq "zq" (pad:play-step! "IN 90 81") "quit")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(vt-eq "zz" (pad:play-step! "IN 90 90") "quit")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 58 119 13")
(vt-eq "nowrite" *pl-say* "no file to save")
(vt-eq "nowrite-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; PAD_VI off: letters insert, ctrl-b is still jump-back
(pad:play-reset! "ab\ncd")
(set! *vi-on* #f)
(pad:play-step! "IN 104")
(vt-eq "off-text" (pad:play-src) "hab\ncd")
(pad:play-reset! "ab\ncd")
(set! *vi-on* #f)
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "off-cb" *pl-say* "nowhere to jump back to")
(vt-at "off-stay" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 16")
(vt-eq "off-cp" *pl-say* "set a mark first")
(pad:play-reset! "ab")
(set! *vi-on* #f)
(pad:play-step! "IN 100")
(vt-eq "off-d" (pad:play-src) "dab")

;; file chord: first press warns, the next ctrl-x ctrl-c quits,
;; and a lone ctrl-c after the warning quits too.
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/file.aura"))
(pad:pf-open! "/tmp/aura-pad-vi-quit.txt")
(set! *vi-on* #f)
(pad:play-step! "IN 65")
(vt-eq "fdirty" (pad:play-src) "A")
(vt-eq "fq1" (pad:pf-line! "IN 24 3") "go")
(vt-eq "fq1-warn" (if (string-contains? *pl-say* "not saved yet") 1 0) 1)
(vt-eq "fq1-again" (if (string-contains? *pl-say* "ctrl-x ctrl-c again") 1 0) 1)
(vt-eq "fq2" (pad:pf-line! "IN 24 3") "quit")
(vt-eq "fc1" (pad:pf-line! "IN 24 3") "go")
(vt-eq "fc2" (pad:pf-line! "IN 3") "quit")
(pad:pf-open! "/tmp/aura-pad-vi-empty.txt")
(vt-eq "fempty" (pad:pf-line! "IN 24 3") "quit")
(pad:pf-open! "/tmp/aura-pad-vi-ev.txt")
(pad:play-reset! "(+ 1 2)")
(vt-eq "fe" (pad:pf-line! "IN 24 5") "go")
(vt-eq "fe-say" *pl-say* "ran: 3")

(display "CHECKS ")
(display (number->string *checks*))
(display " FAIL ")
(display (number->string *fail*))
(newline)
(if (= *fail* 0)
    (display "PAD_VI_TEST_OK\n")
    (display "PAD_VI_TEST_FAIL\n"))

input.source:
;; Vi normal / insert and emacs ctrl-b f p n. Runs the play key path
;; (play_in.aura + vi.aura) without PAD_VI, then turns the mode on
;; itself. Prints PAD_VI_TEST_OK or PAD_VI_TEST_FAIL.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
(define *pad-home*
  (let ((h (getenv "AURA_PAD_HOME")))
    (if (and (string? h) (> (string-length h) 0)) h "/workspace/aura-pad")))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/buffer.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lines.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/edit.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/hl.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/jump.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/view.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lc.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/keys.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/card.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/who.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/play_in.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/vi.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/screen.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/emacs.aura"))

(define *fail* 0)
(define *checks* 0)

(define (vt-ok tag)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " OK") (newline))

(define (vt-bad tag got)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (set! *fail* (+ *fail* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " FAIL ") (display got) (newline))

(define (vt-eq tag got want)
  (if (equal? got want) (vt-ok tag) (vt-bad tag got)))

(define (vt-arm! src)
  (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *vi-on* #t)
  (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *em-anchor* #f)
  (set! *vi-base* "t")
  (pad:vi-title!))

(define (vt-at tag l col)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-l") (pad:es-l *pl-st*) l)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-c") (pad:es-col *pl-st*) col))

;; emacs movement in normal mode
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(vt-eq "boot-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(vt-eq "boot-title" *pl-title* "t [normal]")
(pad:play-step! "IN 6")
(vt-at "cf" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 14")
(vt-at "cn" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 16")
(vt-at "cp" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-at "cb" 0 0)
(vt-eq "move-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; edge: ctrl-b at the start does not insert and does not jump back
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "cb-edge" *pl-say* "cannot move past the edge")
(vt-at "cb-stay" 0 0)

;; hjkl
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 107")
(pad:play-step! "IN 104")
(vt-at "hjkl" 0 0)
(vt-eq "hjkl-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; a normal-mode letter with no command is not inserted
(pad:play-step! "IN 113")
(vt-eq "q-say" *pl-say* "press i to type")
(vt-eq "q-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")
(vt-eq "q-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; i types, esc returns, l moves
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(vt-eq "ins-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-eq "ins-title" *pl-title* "t [insert]")
(vt-eq "ins-say" *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
(pad:play-step! "IN 90")
(vt-eq "typed" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(vt-eq "still-ins" *vi-mode* "insert")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27")
(vt-eq "esc-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(vt-eq "esc-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(vt-at "l-moves" 0 2)
(vt-eq "l-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")

;; emacs keys in insert mode move and stay in insert
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 6")
(pad:play-step! "IN 14")
(vt-eq "ins-move-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "ins-move" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 81")
(vt-eq "ins-q" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncQd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "ins-cb-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "ins-cb" 1 1)
(vt-eq "ins-cb-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncQd")

;; append moves one step then types
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 97")
(vt-eq "app-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "app-at" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 88")
(vt-eq "app-text" (pad:play-src) "aXb\ncd")

;; append at the end of the buffer just types
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 5")
(pad:play-step! "IN 97")
(vt-eq "app-end-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "app-end-at" 0 2)
(pad:play-step! "IN 89")
(vt-eq "app-end-text" (pad:play-src) "abY")

;; one read, several bytes: hj, then i A B esc
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108 106")
(vt-at "multi-move" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 105 65 66 27")
(vt-eq "multi-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncABd")
(vt-eq "multi-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; arrow in the same read still moves, and does not leave insert
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 91 66")
(vt-at "arrow-n" 1 0)
(vt-eq "arrow-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 91 67")
(vt-eq "arrow-ins" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "arrow-f" 1 1)

input.source:
;; Vi normal / insert and emacs ctrl-b f p n. Runs the play key path
;; (play_in.aura + vi.aura) without PAD_VI, then turns the mode on
;; itself. Prints PAD_VI_TEST_OK or PAD_VI_TEST_FAIL.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
(define *pad-home*
  (let ((h (getenv "AURA_PAD_HOME")))
    (if (and (string? h) (> (string-length h) 0)) h "/workspace/aura-pad")))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/buffer.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lines.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/edit.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/hl.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/jump.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/view.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lc.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/keys.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/card.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/who.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/play_in.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/vi.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/screen.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/emacs.aura"))

(define *fail* 0)
(define *checks* 0)

(define (vt-ok tag)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " OK") (newline))

(define (vt-bad tag got)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (set! *fail* (+ *fail* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " FAIL ") (display got) (newline))

(define (vt-eq tag got want)
  (if (equal? got want) (vt-ok tag) (vt-bad tag got)))

(define (vt-arm! src)
  (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *vi-on* #t)
  (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-pat* "")
  (set! *vi-pat-word* #f)
  (set! *em-hit* #f)
  (set! *em-anchor* #f)
  (set! *vi-base* "t")
  (pad:vi-title!))

(define (vt-at tag l col)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-l") (pad:es-l *pl-st*) l)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-c") (pad:es-col *pl-st*) col))

;; emacs movement in normal mode
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(vt-eq "boot-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(vt-eq "boot-title" *pl-title* "t [normal]")
(pad:play-step! "IN 6")
(vt-at "cf" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 14")
(vt-at "cn" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 16")
(vt-at "cp" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-at "cb" 0 0)
(vt-eq "move-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; edge: ctrl-b at the start does not insert and does not jump back
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "cb-edge" *pl-say* "cannot move past the edge")
(vt-at "cb-stay" 0 0)

;; hjkl
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 107")
(pad:play-step! "IN 104")
(vt-at "hjkl" 0 0)
(vt-eq "hjkl-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; a normal-mode letter with no command is not inserted
(pad:play-step! "IN 113")
(vt-eq "q-say" *pl-say* "press i to type")
(vt-eq "q-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")
(vt-eq "q-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; i types, esc returns, l moves
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(vt-eq "ins-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-eq "ins-title" *pl-title* "t [insert]")
(vt-eq "ins-say" *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
(pad:play-step! "IN 90")
(vt-eq "typed" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(vt-eq "still-ins" *vi-mode* "insert")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27")
(vt-eq "esc-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(vt-eq "esc-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(vt-at "l-moves" 0 2)
(vt-eq "l-text" (pad:play-src) "Zab\ncd")

;; emacs keys in insert mode move and stay in insert
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 6")
(pad:play-step! "IN 14")
(vt-eq "ins-move-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "ins-move" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 81")
(vt-eq "ins-q" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncQd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")
(vt-eq "ins-cb-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "ins-cb" 1 1)
(vt-eq "ins-cb-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncQd")

;; append moves one step then types
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 97")
(vt-eq "app-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "app-at" 0 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 88")
(vt-eq "app-text" (pad:play-src) "aXb\ncd")

;; append at the end of the buffer just types
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 5")
(pad:play-step! "IN 97")
(vt-eq "app-end-mode" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "app-end-at" 0 2)
(pad:play-step! "IN 89")
(vt-eq "app-end-text" (pad:play-src) "abY")

;; one read, several bytes: hj, then i A B esc
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 108 106")
(vt-at "multi-move" 1 1)
(pad:play-step! "IN 105 65 66 27")
(vt-eq "multi-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncABd")
(vt-eq "multi-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")

;; arrow in the same read still moves, and does not leave insert
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 91 66")
(vt-at "arrow-n" 1 0)
(vt-eq "arrow-mode" *vi-mode* "normal")
(pad:play-step! "IN 105")
(pad:play-step! "IN 27 91 67")
(vt-eq "arrow-ins" *vi-mode* "insert")
(vt-at "arrow-f" 1 1)

;; old ctrl-b / ctrl-p jobs moved, they did not disappear
(vt-arm! "ab\ncd")
(pad:play-step! "IN 29")
(vt-eq "jump" *pl-say* "nowhere to jump back to")
(pad:play-step! "IN 22")
(vt-eq "copy" *pl-say* "set a mark first")
(vt-eq "copy-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")

;; x deletes the letter under the cursor; X deletes the one before

(pad:play-step! "IN 120")

(pad:play-step! "IN 36")
(pad:play-step! "IN 120")

(pad:play-step! "IN 88")

(vt-at "X-at" 0 0)
(pad:play-step! "IN 88")

(pad:play-step! "IN 108")
(pad:play-step! "IN 68")

(vt-eq "dd-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\nef")

(vt-eq "p-text" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd\nef")

(pad:play-step! "IN 106")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")
(vt-eq "dd-last" (pad:play-src) "ab")
(vt-at "dd-last-at" 0 2)
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")
(vt-eq "p-last" (pad:play-src) "ab\ncd")
(vt-arm! "ab")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")
(vt-eq "dd-only" (pad:play-src) "")
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")
(vt-eq "p-only" (pad:play-src) "ab")
(vt-arm! "")
(pad:play-step! "IN 100 100")

(pad:play-step! "IN 48")
(pad:play-step! "IN 112")

;; Vi normal / insert and emacs ctrl-b f p n. Runs the play key path
;; (play_in.aura + vi.aura) without PAD_VI, then turns the mode on
;; itself. Prints PAD_VI_TEST_OK or PAD_VI_TEST_FAIL.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
(define *pad-home*
  (let ((h (getenv "AURA_PAD_HOME")))
    (if (and (string? h) (> (string-length h) 0)) h "/workspace/aura-pad")))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/buffer.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lines.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/edit.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/hl.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/jump.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/view.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lc.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/keys.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/card.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/who.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/play_in.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/vi.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/screen.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/emacs.aura"))

(define *fail* 0)
(define *checks* 0)

(define (vt-ok tag)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " OK") (newline))

(define (vt-bad tag got)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (set! *fail* (+ *fail* 1))
  (display "T ") (display tag) (display " FAIL ") (display got) (newline))

(define (vt-eq tag got want)
  (if (equal? got want) (vt-ok tag) (vt-bad tag got)))

(define (vt-arm! src)
  (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *vi-on* #t)
  (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
  (set! *vi-vanchor* -1)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-pat* "")
  (set! *vi-pat-word* #f)
  (set! *em-hit* #f)
  (set! *em-anchor* #f)
  (set! *vi-base* "t")
  (pad:vi-title!))

(define (vt-at tag l col)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-l") (pad:es-l *pl-st*) l)
  (vt-eq (string-append tag "-c") (pad:es-col *pl-st*) col))

;; edge: ctrl-b at the start does not insert and does not jump back
(pad:play-step! "IN 2")

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11f test cases (sandbox worlds for AI tries), loaded by
;; m11_test.aura after m11e_cases.aura (m11:run-all calls these sections).
;; Prints T lines and M11F_ACC n OK. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; The kid's goal for the M11 page: base page passes 1 of 3 (greet).
(define *m11-goal*
  (list (list "hello 3 is 6" (lambda () (hello 3)) 6)
        (list "bye 2 is 4" (lambda () (bye 2)) 4)
        (list "greet 1 is 2" (lambda () (greet 1)) 2)))

(define *m11-ideas-win*
  (list (list "closer" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (* x 2))")))
        (list "louder" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) (+ x 3))")))
        (list "faster" (list (list "bye" "(lambda (y) (hello y y))")))))
(define *m11-ideas-none*
  (list (list "bigger" (list (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (add n 5))")))
        (list "twice" (list (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)") (list "hello" "(lambda (x) x)")))))

(define (m11:world-out! r)
  (newline) (display (car r)) (display " world say=\"") (display (cadr r)) (display "\"") (newline)
  (display (pad:world-line *world-last*)) (newline)
  r)

(define (m11:idea k) (list-ref (cadr *world-last*) (- k 1)))

(define (m11:sec-f1)
  ;; 1. Three ideas race in their own worlds; the page and root code do
  ;;    not change while they run; the best (strictly better than the
  ;;    page) comes back as one robot KEEP; ctrl-z takes it back.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (u0 (length *robot-undo*))
         (r (m11:world-out! (pad:world-race! "helper" *m11-ideas-win* *m11-goal*))))
    (m11:expect-str "F1_TAG" (car r) "WIN")
    (m11:expect-str "F1_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper tried 3 ideas in its own worlds: idea 1 passes 3 of 3 checks (your page 1 of 3), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back")
    (m11:expect-str "F1_VERDICT" (caddr r) "agree")
    (m11:expect-true "F1_ROOT_SAME_DURING" (pad:nth *world-last* 4))
    (m11:expect "F1_BASE" (car *world-last*) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "F1_IDEA1" (pad:nth (m11:idea 1) 1) "tried")
    (m11:expect "F1_IDEA1_SCORE" (pad:nth (m11:idea 1) 2) 3)
    (m11:expect-str "F1_IDEA1_ENG" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth (m11:idea 1) 3)) "hello")
    (m11:expect "F1_IDEA2_SCORE" (pad:nth (m11:idea 2) 2) 2)
    (m11:expect-str "F1_IDEA3" (pad:nth (m11:idea 3) 1) "refused")
    (m11:expect "F1_ROOT_CURRENT" (workspace :current) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "F1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
    (m11:expect "F1_HELLO_ROOT" (hello 3) 6)
    (m11:expect "F1_ONE_UNDO" (- (length *robot-undo*) u0) 1)
    (m11:expect-str "F1_WHO0" (car (pad:who-ask!)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (caddr (pad:who-stamp-of 0)))))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
    (m11:expect-true "F1_UNDO_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "F1_UNDO_PAGE" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect "F1_UNDO_HELLO" (hello 3) 4))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11F" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-f2)
  ;; 2. No idea beats the page: nothing comes back, root code, page and
  ;;    root bindings are as before (aura#4368 heal), no undo entry. A
  ;;    gated idea never gets a world.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (u0 (length *robot-undo*))
         (k0 *world-children*)
         (r (m11:world-out! (pad:world-race! "helper" *m11-ideas-none* *m11-goal*))))
    (m11:expect-str "F2_TAG" (car r) "NOWIN")
    (m11:expect-str "F2_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper tried 2 ideas in its own worlds, none did better than your page (1 of 3 checks), nothing changed")
    (m11:expect-str "F2_VERDICT" (caddr r) "agree")
    (m11:expect "F2_IDEA1_SCORE" (pad:nth (m11:idea 1) 2) 0)
    (m11:expect-str "F2_IDEA2" (pad:nth (m11:idea 2) 1) "gate")
    (m11:expect "F2_ONE_WORLD" (- *world-children* k0) 1)
    (m11:expect-true "F2_CODE_SAME" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
    (m11:expect-true "F2_PAGE_SAME" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
    (m11:expect "F2_GREET_ROOT" (greet 1) 2)
    (m11:expect "F2_NO_UNDO" (- (length *robot-undo*) u0) 0)
    (m11:expect "F2_ROOT_CURRENT" (workspace :current) 0)
    (m11:expect "F2_NO_DISAGREE" *world-disagree* 0))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11F" 2)
  #t)

;; HL color tape (one letter per source char). Kinds:

(define (pad:hl-nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0) (car xs) (pad:hl-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1))))

(define *hl-keywords*
  (list "define" "lambda" "if" "load" "cond" "let" "begin"
        "set!" "and" "or" "not" "else" "require" "export"
        "try" "catch" "list" "cons" "car" "cdr" "null?"
        "string=?" "number?" "string?" "display" "newline"))

(define (pad:hl-ci s i) (string-ref s i))

(define (pad:hl-space? c)
  (or (= c 32) (= c 9) (= c 10) (= c 13)))

(define (pad:hl-digit? c) (and (>= c 48) (<= c 57)))

(define (pad:hl-sym? c)
  (or (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122))
      (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90))
      (pad:hl-digit? c)
      (= c 45) (= c 95) (= c 58) (= c 43) (= c 42) (= c 47)
      (= c 61) (= c 63) (= c 33) (= c 46) (= c 60) (= c 62)
      (= c 36) (= c 37) (= c 38) (= c 94) (= c 126)))

(define (pad:hl-kw? name)
  (let loop ((ks *hl-keywords*))
    (cond
      ((null? ks) #f)
      ((string=? name (car ks)) #t)
      (#t (loop (cdr ks))))))

(define (pad:hl-kind-of name)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (string-length name) 6)
          (string=? (substring name 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
    ((and (>= (string-length name) 7)
          (string=? (substring name 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
    ((pad:hl-kw? name) "K")
    (#t "S")))

;; (#f i i i) at EOF. Kind letters: P K S T C Q M N .
(define (pad:hl-one s i n)
  (if (>= i n)
      (list #f i i i)
      (let ((c (pad:hl-ci s i)))
        (cond
          ((or (= c 40) (= c 41))
           (list "P" i (+ i 1) (+ i 1)))
          ((= c 59)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (if (or (>= j n) (= (pad:hl-ci s j) 10))
                 (list "C" i j j)
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))
          ((= c 34)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (cond
               ((>= j n) (list "T" i j j))
               ((= (pad:hl-ci s j) 92)
                (loop (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
               ((= (pad:hl-ci s j) 34)
                (list "T" i (+ j 1) (+ j 1)))
               (#t (loop (+ j 1))))))
          ((pad:hl-space? c)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (if (or (>= j n) (not (pad:hl-space? (pad:hl-ci s j))))
                 (list "." i j j)
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))

                 (list "N" i j j)
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))

(define (pad:hl-tokens s)

    (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (>= i n)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((t (pad:hl-one s i n))

                 (a (pad:hl-nth t 1))
                 (b (pad:hl-nth t 2))
                 (ni (pad:hl-nth t 3)))

                (reverse acc)

    (let loop ((i 0) (out ""))

          out

                 (k (car t))
                 (a (pad:hl-nth t 1))
                 (b (pad:hl-nth t 2))
                 (ni (pad:hl-nth t 3))
                 (letter (if k k "."))
                 (chunk
                  (let fill ((j a) (cs ""))
                    (if (>= j b)
                        cs
                        (fill (+ j 1) (string-append cs letter))))))

(define (pad:hl-count tokens kind)
  (let loop ((ts tokens) (n 0))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) n)
      ((string=? (car (car ts)) kind) (loop (cdr ts) (+ n 1)))
      (#t (loop (cdr ts) n)))))

(define (pad:hl-tape! s)
  (let* ((color (pad:hl-color s))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens s)))
    (display "HL n=")
    (display (number->string (string-length s)))
    (display " toks=")
    (display (number->string (length toks)))
    (display " K=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "K")))
    (display " Q=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "Q")))
    (display " M=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "M")))
    (display " C=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "C")))
    (display " T=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "T")))
    (display " color=")
    (display color)
    (newline)
    color))

(define (pad:hl-tok-line! i tok)
  (display "HL tok=")
  (display (number->string i))
  (display " kind=")
  (display (car tok))
  (display " at=")
  (display (number->string (pad:hl-nth tok 1)))
  (display "..")
  (display (number->string (pad:hl-nth tok 2)))
  (display " text=")
  (display (pad:hl-nth tok 3))
  (newline)
  0)

;; aura-pad M5 -- Soft-side Aura syntax highlight (no C viewport).
;; Tokenize an .aura / sexp string into kind tags and a kid-readable
;; HL color tape (one letter per source char). Kinds:
;;   P paren   K keyword (define/lambda/if/load/...)
;;   S symbol  T string   C comment
;;   Q query:  M mutate:  N number   . space/other
;; Pure Soft. Needs buffer.aura (pad:nstr). Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(require "std/string" all:)

(define (pad:hl-nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0) (car xs) (pad:hl-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1))))

(define *hl-keywords*
  (list "define" "lambda" "if" "load" "cond" "let" "begin"
        "set!" "and" "or" "not" "else" "require" "export"
        "try" "catch" "list" "cons" "car" "cdr" "null?"
        "string=?" "number?" "string?" "display" "newline"))

(define (pad:hl-ci s i) (string-ref s i))

(define (pad:hl-space? c)
  (or (= c 32) (= c 9) (= c 10) (= c 13)))

(define (pad:hl-digit? c) (and (>= c 48) (<= c 57)))

(define (pad:hl-sym? c)
  (or (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122))
      (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90))
      (pad:hl-digit? c)
      (= c 45) (= c 95) (= c 58) (= c 43) (= c 42) (= c 47)
      (= c 61) (= c 63) (= c 33) (= c 46) (= c 60) (= c 62)
      (= c 36) (= c 37) (= c 38) (= c 94) (= c 126)))

(define (pad:hl-kw? name)
  (let loop ((ks *hl-keywords*))
    (cond
      ((null? ks) #f)
      ((string=? name (car ks)) #t)
      (#t (loop (cdr ks))))))

(define (pad:hl-kind-of name)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (string-length name) 6)
          (string=? (substring name 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
    ((and (>= (string-length name) 7)
          (string=? (substring name 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
    ((pad:hl-kw? name) "K")
    (#t "S")))

;; Read one token from s at i. Returns (kind start end next-i) or
;; (#f i i i) at EOF. Kind letters: P K S T C Q M N .
(define (pad:hl-one s i n)
  (if (>= i n)
      (list #f i i i)
      (let ((c (pad:hl-ci s i)))
        (cond
          ((or (= c 40) (= c 41))
           (list "P" i (+ i 1) (+ i 1)))
          ((= c 59)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (if (or (>= j n) (= (pad:hl-ci s j) 10))
                 (list "C" i j j)
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))
          ((= c 34)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (cond
               ((>= j n) (list "T" i j j))
               ((= (pad:hl-ci s j) 92)
                (loop (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
               ((= (pad:hl-ci s j) 34)
                (list "T" i (+ j 1) (+ j 1)))
               (#t (loop (+ j 1))))))
          ((pad:hl-space? c)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (if (or (>= j n) (not (pad:hl-space? (pad:hl-ci s j))))
                 (list "." i j j)
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))
          ((and (pad:hl-digit? c)
                (or (= i 0)
                    (let ((p (pad:hl-ci s (- i 1))))
                      (or (pad:hl-space? p) (= p 40) (= p 41)))))
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (if (or (>= j n) (not (pad:hl-digit? (pad:hl-ci s j))))
                 (list "N" i j j)
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))
          ((pad:hl-sym? c)
           (let loop ((j (+ i 1)))
             (if (or (>= j n) (not (pad:hl-sym? (pad:hl-ci s j))))
                 (let* ((txt (substring s i j))
                        (k (pad:hl-kind-of txt)))
                   (list k i j j))
                 (loop (+ j 1)))))
          (#t (list "." i (+ i 1) (+ i 1)))))))

;; All tokens as ((kind start end text) ...), skipping space ".".
(define (pad:hl-tokens s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (>= i n)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((t (pad:hl-one s i n))
                 (k (car t))
                 (a (pad:hl-nth t 1))
                 (b (pad:hl-nth t 2))
                 (ni (pad:hl-nth t 3)))
            (if (not k)
                (reverse acc)
                (if (string=? k ".")
                    (loop ni acc)
                    (loop ni
                          (cons (list k a b (substring s a b)) acc)))))))))

;; Color tape: one letter per source char.
(define (pad:hl-color s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (out ""))
      (if (>= i n)
          out
          (let* ((t (pad:hl-one s i n))
                 (k (car t))
                 (a (pad:hl-nth t 1))
                 (b (pad:hl-nth t 2))
                 (ni (pad:hl-nth t 3))
                 (letter (if k k "."))
                 (chunk
                  (let fill ((j a) (cs ""))
                    (if (>= j b)
                        cs
                        (fill (+ j 1) (string-append cs letter))))))
            (loop ni (string-append out chunk)))))))

(define (pad:hl-count tokens kind)
  (let loop ((ts tokens) (n 0))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) n)
      ((string=? (car (car ts)) kind) (loop (cdr ts) (+ n 1)))
      (#t (loop (cdr ts) n)))))

(define (pad:hl-tape! s)
  (let* ((color (pad:hl-color s))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens s)))
    (display "HL n=")
    (display (number->string (string-length s)))
    (display " toks=")
    (display (number->string (length toks)))
    (display " K=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "K")))
    (display " Q=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "Q")))
    (display " M=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "M")))
    (display " C=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "C")))
    (display " T=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "T")))
    (display " color=")
    (display color)
    (newline)
    color))

(define (pad:hl-tok-line! i tok)
  (display "HL tok=")
  (display (number->string i))
  (display " kind=")
  (display (car tok))
  (display " at=")
  (display (number->string (pad:hl-nth tok 1)))
  (display "..")
  (display (number->string (pad:hl-nth tok 2)))
  (display " text=")
  (display (pad:hl-nth tok 3))
  (newline)
  0)

         (color (car b))
         (toks (cadr b)))
    (display "HL n=")

    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "C")))
    (display " T=")
    (display (number->string (pad:hl-count toks "T")))
    (display " color=")
    (display color)
    (newline)
    color))
