;; aura-pad gap round tests, loaded by gap_test.aura (the one-entry play
;; path and the flat line scanner against their references).
;;  GAP_SCAN    pad:lc-scan (one flat loop) == the nested scan it replaced
;;              (kept below as gp:lc-scan-nested) on generated lines, with
;;              and without a string carried in
;;  GAP_FRAMES  pad:play-step! with one "IN b1 .. bn" line per key (what
;;              c/pad_play sends) writes the same frames as the reference
;;              path: one "IN b" line per byte through pad:pi-line!
;;              (keys.aura decode + pad:play-cmd!) and pad:play-snap
;;  GAP_FAST    the inline cursor / insert / backspace paths were taken
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define gp-checks 0)
(define gp-fails 0)
(define (gp:expect name ok detail)
  (set! gp-checks (+ gp-checks 1))
  (if ok
      (begin (display "T ") (display name) (display " OK") (newline))
      (begin
        (set! gp-fails (+ gp-fails 1))
        (display "T ") (display name) (display " WANT=") (display detail) (newline))))

;; small LCG, deterministic
(define gp-seed 7)
(define (gp:rand k)
  (set! gp-seed (modulo (+ (* gp-seed 75) 74) 65537))
  (modulo gp-seed k))

(define (gp:lc-scan-nested s codes r acc0 tp0 sy0 ins)
  (let* ((n (string-length s)) (cls *lc-cls*) (mx *lc-run-max*) (dots *lc-dots*)
         ;; syntax-ppss carry: a line that starts inside a string first
         ;; finishes that string (one T token from 0) before normal
         ;; lexing. qq = end of that token, -2 = no closing quote here
         ;; (the whole line is string and it stays open), -1 = not in one.
         (qq (if (and ins (= r 0))
                 (if (< (string-index s "\"" 0) 0)
                     -2                     ; no quote at all: stays open
                 (let str0 ((j 0))
                   (cond
                     ((>= j n) -2)
                     ((= (string-ref s j) 92) (if (>= (+ j 1) n) -2 (str0 (+ j 2))))
                     ((= (string-ref s j) 34) (+ j 1))
                     (#t (str0 (+ j 1))))))
                 -1))
         (open-all (= qq -2))
         (q (cond (open-all n) (#t qq)))
         (i0 (if (>= q 0) q r)))
    (let loop ((i i0)
               (acc (if (> q 0) (cons (list "T" 0 q (substring s 0 q)) acc0) acc0))
               (tp (if (> q 0) (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (if (> q mx) mx q)) tp0) tp0))
               (e i0)
               (sy sy0))
      (if (>= i n)
          (let ((toks (reverse acc)))
            (list codes s toks
                  (if (> n mx)
                      (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
                      (apply string-append
                             (reverse (cons (substring dots 0 (- n e)) tp))))
                  open-all
                  (if (pair? acc) (car acc) #f)
                  (if (and (pair? acc) (pair? (cdr acc))) (cadr acc) #f)
                  sy
                  acc
                  ins))
          (let* ((c (string-ref s i))
                 (k (if (< c 128) (vector-ref cls c) 0)))
            (cond
              ((= k 1)
               (let sp ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (>= j n)
                     (loop j acc tp e sy)
                     (let ((q (string-ref s j)))
                       (if (and (< q 128) (= (vector-ref cls q) 1))
                           (sp (+ j 1))
                           (loop j acc tp e sy))))))
              ((= k 4)
               (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list "P" i (+ i 1) (substring s i (+ i 1))) acc)
                     (cons "P" (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                     (+ i 1) sy))
              ((and (= k 2)
                    (or (= i 0)
                        (let* ((pc (string-ref s (- i 1)))
                               (p (if (< pc 128) (vector-ref cls pc) 0)))
                          (or (= p 1) (= p 4)))))
               (let num ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let ((q (string-ref s j)))
                           (not (and (< q 128) (= (vector-ref cls q) 2)))))
                     (loop j (cons (list "N" i j (substring s i j)) acc)
                           (cons (substring *lc-run-N* 0 (if (> (- j i) mx) mx (- j i)))
                                 (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                           j sy)
                     (num (+ j 1)))))
              ((or (= k 2) (= k 3))
               (let sym ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let* ((q (string-ref s j))
                                (qk (if (< q 128) (vector-ref cls q) 0)))
                           (not (or (= qk 3) (= qk 2)))))
                     (let* ((txt (substring s i j))
                            (w (- j i))
                            (kd (cond
                                  ((and (>= w 6) (string=? (substring txt 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
                                  ((and (>= w 7) (string=? (substring txt 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
                                  ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
                                  (#t "S"))))
                       (loop j (cons (list kd i j txt) acc)
                             (cons (substring (cond
                                                ((string=? kd "S") *lc-run-S*)
                                                ((string=? kd "K") *lc-run-K*)
                                                ((string=? kd "Q") *lc-run-Q*)
                                                (#t *lc-run-M*))
                                              0 (if (> w mx) mx w))
                                   (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                             j (cons txt sy)))
                     (sym (+ j 1)))))
              ((= k 5)
               (let cm ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (= (string-ref s j) 10))
                     (loop j (cons (list "C" i j (substring s i j)) acc)
                           (cons (substring *lc-run-C* 0 (if (> (- j i) mx) mx (- j i)))
                                 (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                           j sy)
                     (cm (+ j 1)))))
              ((= k 6)
               (let str ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (cond
                   ((>= j n)
                    (let* ((a2 (cons (list "T" i n (substring s i n)) acc))
                           (toks (reverse a2)))
                      (list codes s toks
                            (if (> n mx)
                                (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
                                (apply string-append
                                       (reverse (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (- n i))
                                                      (cons (substring dots 0 (- i e)) tp)))))
                            #t
                            (car a2)
                            (if (pair? (cdr a2)) (cadr a2) #f)
                            sy
                            a2
                            ins)))
                   ((= (string-ref s j) 92)
                    (str (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
                   ((= (string-ref s j) 34)
                    (loop (+ j 1)
                          (cons (list "T" i (+ j 1) (substring s i (+ j 1))) acc)
                          (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (if (> (- (+ j 1) i) mx) mx (- (+ j 1) i)))
                                (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                          (+ j 1) sy))
                   (#t (str (+ j 1))))))
              (#t (loop (+ i 1) acc tp e sy))))))))


(define gp-alpha (list 40 41 97 98 100 101 102 105 110 113 117 114 121 58 49 50 32 32 59 34 92 45 116 109))
(define gp-words (list "define" "query:find" "mutate:set" "\"hi\"" "(a 1)" "; note" "12x" "x12"))
(define (gp:line k acc)
  (if (<= k 0)
      acc
      (if (= (gp:rand 9) 0)
          (gp:line (- k 1) (string-append acc (list-ref gp-words (gp:rand (length gp-words)))))
          (gp:line (- k 1) (string-append acc (list->string (list (list-ref gp-alpha (gp:rand (length gp-alpha))))))))))

(define (gp:scan-cases i bad)
  (if (<= i 0)
      bad
      (let* ((s (gp:line (+ 1 (gp:rand 14)) ""))
             (ins (= (gp:rand 3) 0))
             (a (pad:lc-scan s #f 0 (list) (list) (list) ins))
             (b (gp:lc-scan-nested s #f 0 (list) (list) (list) ins)))
        (gp:scan-cases (- i 1) (if (equal? a b) bad (cons (list s ins) bad))))))

;; key pool: printable, backspace, arrows, home/end, enter, kill/yank,
;; undo, quote, ctrl-o (who), goto-def / back / refs, a two-key read
(define gp-keys
  (list (list 97) (list 98) (list 100) (list 101) (list 113) (list 58) (list 49)
        (list 32) (list 59) (list 92) (list 34) (list 40) (list 41)
        (list 127) (list 127) (list 27 91 68) (list 27 91 68) (list 27 91 67)
        (list 27 91 65) (list 27 91 66) (list 1) (list 5) (list 13) (list 11)
        (list 25) (list 31) (list 15) (list 7) (list 2) (list 18) (list 97 98)))
(define (gp:keylist k acc)
  (if (<= k 0) (reverse acc) (gp:keylist (- k 1) (cons (list-ref gp-keys (gp:rand (length gp-keys))) acc))))
(define (gp:join bs acc)
  (if (null? bs) acc (gp:join (cdr bs) (string-append acc " " (number->string (car bs))))))

(define (gp:start!)
  (pad:play-reset! *lc-big-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pi-out* (list))
  (set! *pi-fast* 0)
  (set! *pi-slow* 0)
  (pad:play-snap))

(define (gp:ref-bytes bs acc)
  (if (null? bs)
      acc
      (let ((r (pad:pi-line! (string-append "IN " (number->string (car bs))))))
        (gp:ref-bytes (cdr bs)
                      (if (or (string=? r "pending") (string=? r "quit")) acc (cons (pad:play-snap) acc))))))
(define (gp:ref-keys ks acc)
  (if (null? ks) (reverse acc) (gp:ref-keys (cdr ks) (gp:ref-bytes (car ks) acc))))
(define (gp:step-keys ks)
  (if (null? ks)
      (reverse *pi-out*)
      (begin (pad:play-step! (gp:join (car ks) "IN")) (gp:step-keys (cdr ks)))))
(define (gp:first-diff a b i)
  (cond
    ((and (null? a) (null? b)) -1)
    ((or (null? a) (null? b)) i)
    ((string=? (car a) (car b)) (gp:first-diff (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ i 1)))
    (#t i)))

(define (gp:run)
  (display "GAP one-entry play path on Soft tip") (newline)
  (let ((bad (gp:scan-cases 300 (list))))
    (gp:expect "GAP_SCAN_300" (null? bad) (if (null? bad) "" (car bad))))
  (let* ((ks (gp:keylist 260 (list)))
         (r0 (gp:start!))
         (ref (gp:ref-keys ks (list)))
         (r1 (gp:start!))
         (r2 (set! *pi-collect* #t))
         (got (gp:step-keys ks))
         (r3 (set! *pi-collect* #f))
         (d (gp:first-diff ref got 0)))
    (display "GAPSTATS keys=") (display (length ks)) (display " frames=") (display (length got))
    (display " ref=") (display (length ref)) (display " fast=") (display *pi-fast*)
    (display " slow=") (display *pi-slow*) (newline)
    (gp:expect "GAP_FRAMES" (= d -1) (if (= d -1) "" (string-append "frame " (number->string d))))
    (gp:expect "GAP_FRAMES_MANY" (> (length got) 200) (length got))
    (gp:expect "GAP_FAST" (> *pi-fast* 100) *pi-fast*))
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display gp-checks) (display " fail=") (display gp-fails) (newline)
  (if (= gp-fails 0) (begin (display "PAD_GAP_TEST_OK") (newline)) 0))

;; aura-pad gap round tests, loaded by gap_test.aura (the one-entry play
;; path and the flat line scanner against their references).
;;  GAP_SCAN    pad:lc-scan (one flat loop) == the nested scan it replaced
;;              (kept below as gp:lc-scan-nested) on generated lines, with
;;              and without a string carried in
;;  GAP_FRAMES  pad:play-step! with one "IN b1 .. bn" line per key (what
;;              c/pad_play sends) writes the same frames as the reference
;;              path: one "IN b" line per byte through pad:pi-line!
;;              (keys.aura decode + pad:play-cmd!) and pad:play-snap
;;  GAP_FAST    the inline cursor / insert / backspace paths were taken
;;  GAP2_*      a quote-heavy stream (strings opened / closed on many rows,
;;              typing inside strings and words): frames == reference, the
;;              row splice and the O(1) memo swap were taken, and the cached
;;              ROWS body == a whole-page pad:snap-text render after every key
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define gp-checks 0)
(define gp-fails 0)
(define (gp:expect name ok detail)
  (set! gp-checks (+ gp-checks 1))
  (if ok
      (begin (display "T ") (display name) (display " OK") (newline))
      (begin
        (set! gp-fails (+ gp-fails 1))
        (display "T ") (display name) (display " WANT=") (display detail) (newline))))

;; small LCG, deterministic
(define gp-seed 7)
(define (gp:rand k)
  (set! gp-seed (modulo (+ (* gp-seed 75) 74) 65537))
  (modulo gp-seed k))

(define (gp:lc-scan-nested s codes r acc0 tp0 sy0 ins)
  (let* ((n (string-length s)) (cls *lc-cls*) (mx *lc-run-max*) (dots *lc-dots*)
         ;; syntax-ppss carry: a line that starts inside a string first
         ;; finishes that string (one T token from 0) before normal
         ;; lexing. qq = end of that token, -2 = no closing quote here
         ;; (the whole line is string and it stays open), -1 = not in one.
         (qq (if (and ins (= r 0))
                 (if (< (string-index s "\"" 0) 0)
                     -2                     ; no quote at all: stays open
                 (let str0 ((j 0))
                   (cond
                     ((>= j n) -2)
                     ((= (string-ref s j) 92) (if (>= (+ j 1) n) -2 (str0 (+ j 2))))
                     ((= (string-ref s j) 34) (+ j 1))
                     (#t (str0 (+ j 1))))))
                 -1))
         (open-all (= qq -2))
         (q (cond (open-all n) (#t qq)))
         (i0 (if (>= q 0) q r)))
    (let loop ((i i0)
               (acc (if (> q 0) (cons (list "T" 0 q (substring s 0 q)) acc0) acc0))
               (tp (if (> q 0) (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (if (> q mx) mx q)) tp0) tp0))
               (e i0)
               (sy sy0))
      (if (>= i n)
          (let ((toks (reverse acc)))
            (list codes s toks
                  (if (> n mx)
                      (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
                      (apply string-append
                             (reverse (cons (substring dots 0 (- n e)) tp))))
                  open-all
                  (if (pair? acc) (car acc) #f)
                  (if (and (pair? acc) (pair? (cdr acc))) (cadr acc) #f)
                  sy
                  acc
                  ins))
          (let* ((c (string-ref s i))
                 (k (if (< c 128) (vector-ref cls c) 0)))
            (cond
              ((= k 1)
               (let sp ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (>= j n)
                     (loop j acc tp e sy)
                     (let ((q (string-ref s j)))
                       (if (and (< q 128) (= (vector-ref cls q) 1))
                           (sp (+ j 1))
                           (loop j acc tp e sy))))))
              ((= k 4)
               (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list "P" i (+ i 1) (substring s i (+ i 1))) acc)
                     (cons "P" (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                     (+ i 1) sy))
              ((and (= k 2)
                    (or (= i 0)
                        (let* ((pc (string-ref s (- i 1)))
                               (p (if (< pc 128) (vector-ref cls pc) 0)))
                          (or (= p 1) (= p 4)))))
               (let num ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let ((q (string-ref s j)))
                           (not (and (< q 128) (= (vector-ref cls q) 2)))))
                     (loop j (cons (list "N" i j (substring s i j)) acc)
                           (cons (substring *lc-run-N* 0 (if (> (- j i) mx) mx (- j i)))
                                 (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                           j sy)
                     (num (+ j 1)))))
              ((or (= k 2) (= k 3))
               (let sym ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let* ((q (string-ref s j))
                                (qk (if (< q 128) (vector-ref cls q) 0)))
                           (not (or (= qk 3) (= qk 2)))))
                     (let* ((txt (substring s i j))
                            (w (- j i))
                            (kd (cond
                                  ((and (>= w 6) (string=? (substring txt 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
                                  ((and (>= w 7) (string=? (substring txt 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
                                  ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
                                  (#t "S"))))
                       (loop j (cons (list kd i j txt) acc)
                             (cons (substring (cond
                                                ((string=? kd "S") *lc-run-S*)
                                                ((string=? kd "K") *lc-run-K*)
                                                ((string=? kd "Q") *lc-run-Q*)
                                                (#t *lc-run-M*))
                                              0 (if (> w mx) mx w))
                                   (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                             j (cons txt sy)))
                     (sym (+ j 1)))))
              ((= k 5)
               (let cm ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (= (string-ref s j) 10))
                     (loop j (cons (list "C" i j (substring s i j)) acc)
                           (cons (substring *lc-run-C* 0 (if (> (- j i) mx) mx (- j i)))
                                 (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                           j sy)
                     (cm (+ j 1)))))
              ((= k 6)
               (let str ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (cond
                   ((>= j n)
                    (let* ((a2 (cons (list "T" i n (substring s i n)) acc))
                           (toks (reverse a2)))
                      (list codes s toks
                            (if (> n mx)
                                (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
                                (apply string-append
                                       (reverse (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (- n i))
                                                      (cons (substring dots 0 (- i e)) tp)))))
                            #t
                            (car a2)
                            (if (pair? (cdr a2)) (cadr a2) #f)
                            sy
                            a2
                            ins)))
                   ((= (string-ref s j) 92)
                    (str (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
                   ((= (string-ref s j) 34)
                    (loop (+ j 1)
                          (cons (list "T" i (+ j 1) (substring s i (+ j 1))) acc)
                          (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (if (> (- (+ j 1) i) mx) mx (- (+ j 1) i)))
                                (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                          (+ j 1) sy))
                   (#t (str (+ j 1))))))
              (#t (loop (+ i 1) acc tp e sy))))))))


(define gp-alpha (list 40 41 97 98 100 101 102 105 110 113 117 114 121 58 49 50 32 32 59 34 92 45 116 109))
(define gp-words (list "define" "query:find" "mutate:set" "\"hi\"" "(a 1)" "; note" "12x" "x12"))
(define (gp:line k acc)
  (if (<= k 0)
      acc
      (if (= (gp:rand 9) 0)
          (gp:line (- k 1) (string-append acc (list-ref gp-words (gp:rand (length gp-words)))))
          (gp:line (- k 1) (string-append acc (list->string (list (list-ref gp-alpha (gp:rand (length gp-alpha))))))))))

(define (gp:scan-cases i bad)
  (if (<= i 0)
      bad
      (let* ((s (gp:line (+ 1 (gp:rand 14)) ""))
             (ins (= (gp:rand 3) 0))
             (a (pad:lc-scan s #f 0 (list) (list) (list) ins))
             (b (gp:lc-scan-nested s #f 0 (list) (list) (list) ins)))
        (gp:scan-cases (- i 1) (if (equal? a b) bad (cons (list s ins) bad))))))

;; key pool: printable, backspace, arrows, home/end, enter, kill/yank,
;; undo, quote, ctrl-o (who), goto-def / back / refs, a two-key read
(define gp-keys
  (list (list 97) (list 98) (list 100) (list 101) (list 113) (list 58) (list 49)
        (list 32) (list 59) (list 92) (list 34) (list 40) (list 41)
        (list 127) (list 127) (list 27 91 68) (list 27 91 68) (list 27 91 67)
        (list 27 91 65) (list 27 91 66) (list 1) (list 5) (list 13) (list 11)
        (list 25) (list 31) (list 15) (list 7) (list 2) (list 18) (list 97 98)))
(define (gp:keylist k acc)
  (if (<= k 0) (reverse acc) (gp:keylist (- k 1) (cons (list-ref gp-keys (gp:rand (length gp-keys))) acc))))
;; gap2 pool: string open/close on many rows (memo swaps), typing and
;; deleting mid-word / inside strings (row splice), moves between
(define gp-keys2
  (list (list 34) (list 34) (list 34) (list 127) (list 127) (list 97) (list 120)
        (list 32) (list 40) (list 41) (list 27 91 68) (list 27 91 67) (list 27 91 65)
        (list 27 91 66) (list 27 91 66) (list 1) (list 5) (list 15)))
(define (gp:keylist2 k acc)
  (if (<= k 0) (reverse acc) (gp:keylist2 (- k 1) (cons (list-ref gp-keys2 (gp:rand (length gp-keys2))) acc))))
(define (gp:join bs acc)
  (if (null? bs) acc (gp:join (cdr bs) (string-append acc " " (number->string (car bs))))))

(define (gp:start!)
  (pad:play-reset! *lc-big-page*)
  (pad:who-reset!)
  (set! *pi-out* (list))
  (set! *pi-fast* 0)
  (set! *pi-slow* 0)
  (pad:play-snap))

(define (gp:ref-bytes bs acc)
  (if (null? bs)
      acc
      (let ((r (pad:pi-line! (string-append "IN " (number->string (car bs))))))
        (gp:ref-bytes (cdr bs)
                      (if (or (string=? r "pending") (string=? r "quit")) acc (cons (pad:play-snap) acc))))))
(define (gp:ref-keys ks acc)
  (if (null? ks) (reverse acc) (gp:ref-keys (cdr ks) (gp:ref-bytes (car ks) acc))))
(define (gp:step-keys ks)
  (if (null? ks)
      (reverse *pi-out*)
      (begin (pad:play-step! (gp:join (car ks) "IN")) (gp:step-keys (cdr ks)))))
;; independent oracle: the cached ROWS body vs a whole-page render
(define (gp:body-ok)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (tx (pad:snap-text "x" (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st) ""))
         (i (string-index tx "ROWS n=" 0))
         (j (string-index tx "\n" i))
         (body (substring tx (+ j 1) (- (string-length tx) 4))))
    (string=? body *lc-body*)))
(define (gp:step-keys-chk ks bad)
  (if (null? ks)
      bad
      (begin (pad:play-step! (gp:join (car ks) "IN"))
             (gp:step-keys-chk (cdr ks) (if (gp:body-ok) bad (+ bad 1))))))
(define (gp:first-diff a b i)
  (cond
    ((and (null? a) (null? b)) -1)
    ((or (null? a) (null? b)) i)
    ((string=? (car a) (car b)) (gp:first-diff (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ i 1)))
    (#t i)))

(define (gp:run)
  (display "GAP one-entry play path on Soft tip") (newline)
  (let ((bad (gp:scan-cases 300 (list))))
    (gp:expect "GAP_SCAN_300" (null? bad) (if (null? bad) "" (car bad))))
  (let* ((ks (gp:keylist 260 (list)))
         (r0 (gp:start!))
         (ref (gp:ref-keys ks (list)))
         (r1 (gp:start!))
         (r2 (set! *pi-collect* #t))
         (got (gp:step-keys ks))
         (r3 (set! *pi-collect* #f))
         (d (gp:first-diff ref got 0)))
    (display "GAPSTATS keys=") (display (length ks)) (display " frames=") (display (length got))
    (display " ref=") (display (length ref)) (display " fast=") (display *pi-fast*)
    (display " slow=") (display *pi-slow*) (newline)
    (gp:expect "GAP_FRAMES" (= d -1) (if (= d -1) "" (string-append "frame " (number->string d))))
    (gp:expect "GAP_FRAMES_MANY" (> (length got) 200) (length got))
    (gp:expect "GAP_FAST" (> *pi-fast* 100) *pi-fast*))
  (let* ((ks (gp:keylist2 300 (list)))
         (r0 (gp:start!))
         (ref (gp:ref-keys ks (list)))
         (r1 (gp:start!))
         (h0 *lc-thit*)
         (s0 *pi-rows*)
         (r2 (set! *pi-collect* #t))
         (got (gp:step-keys ks))
         (r3 (set! *pi-collect* #f))
         (d (gp:first-diff ref got 0)))
    (display "GAP2STATS keys=") (display (length ks)) (display " frames=") (display (length got))
    (display " spliced=") (display (- *pi-rows* s0)) (display " memo_o1=") (display (- *lc-thit* h0)) (newline)
    (gp:expect "GAP2_QUOTE_FRAMES" (= d -1) (if (= d -1) "" (string-append "frame " (number->string d))))
    (gp:expect "GAP2_SPLICED" (> (- *pi-rows* s0) 30) (- *pi-rows* s0))
    (gp:expect "GAP2_MEMO_O1" (> (- *lc-thit* h0) 5) (- *lc-thit* h0)))
  (let* ((ks (gp:keylist2 120 (list)))
         (r0 (gp:start!))
         (r1 (set! *pi-collect* #t))
         (bad (gp:step-keys-chk ks 0))
         (r2 (set! *pi-collect* #f)))
    (gp:expect "GAP2_BODY_VS_FULL" (= bad 0) bad))
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display gp-checks) (display " fail=") (display gp-fails) (newline)
  (if (= gp-fails 0) (begin (display "PAD_GAP_TEST_OK") (newline)) 0))

;; aura-pad -- one Soft entry per protocol line for play.aura.
;; Needs keys.aura, card.aura and who.aura (play.aura loads them first).
;;
;; c/pad_play forwards every read() of key bytes as ONE line,
;; "IN b1 b2 ... bn" (still raw bytes, never interpreted in C). An arrow
;; key is one line "IN 27 91 68" instead of three. Soft takes the line in
;; pad:play-step!, which does the dispatch, runs the command, and writes
;; the frame itself. A cursor move is one Soft call per key and a typed
;; char or backspace three (pad:play-step!, pad:lc-line!, pad:lc-scan),
;; instead of the old chain (play-line! wrapper -> keys.aura play-line!
;; -> key-step -> kv-get per keymap entry -> play-cmd! -> play-snap ->
;; lc-line! -> lc-scan, and three lines per arrow key).
;; Every closure call costs ~0.26 ms on Soft tip c69e644 with the pad
;; loaded (aura#4350), so the chain alone was ~1.5 ms per line and 2.5 ms
;; for backspace.
;;
;; The hot cases are table lookups made with builtins:
;; - one byte, idle escape state: *pi-keyv*, the idle-state result of
;;   pad:key-step for each byte 0..255, computed once at load;
;; - a whole escape sequence on one line ("IN 27 91 68"): *pi-seq-lines*.
;; Anything else (an escape split over lines, as the smoke streams send
;; it, several keys in one read, byte 15) goes through pad:pi-bytes!,
;; which feeds each byte through the same steps the old path used and
;; writes one frame per accepted command, as before. So every frame is
;; the frame the old path wrote (checked by gap_test.aura).
;; No named let captures an outer local here (aura#4353).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define (pad:pi-keyv-list b acc)
  (if (< b 0)
      acc
      (pad:pi-keyv-list (- b 1) (cons (car (pad:key-step (list) b)) acc))))
(define *pi-keyv* (list->vector (pad:pi-keyv-list 255 (list))))

;; "IN 27 91 X" / "IN 27 79 X" for every arrow X -> its command word.
(define (pad:pi-seq-lines xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let ((x (number->string (car (car xs)))))
        (cons (string-append "IN 27 91 " x)
              (cons (string-append "IN 27 79 " x) (pad:pi-seq-lines (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:pi-seq-cmds xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (cons (cadr (car xs)) (cons (cadr (car xs)) (pad:pi-seq-cmds (cdr xs))))))
(define *pi-seq-lines* (pad:pi-seq-lines *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-cmds* (pad:pi-seq-cmds *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-n* (length *pi-seq-lines*))

;; Tests collect frames instead of writing them.
(define *pi-collect* #f)
(define *pi-out* (list))
(define *pi-fast* 0)    ; lines taken by the table fast path
(define *pi-slow* 0)    ; lines taken byte by byte

;; M8: KEY goal:... and M10: IN 15 (ctrl-o) on top of keys.aura's
;; pad:play-line!. Same contract as keys.aura (returns "ok", "pending",
;; "quit" or a reason; the caller writes the frame). A new name, not a
;; redefinition: in a loaded file, "(define base f) (define (f ..))"
;; makes base run the NEW f on Soft tip c69e644 (inline it works), so the
;; old wrapper moved here looped forever on QUIT (repro filed upstream).
(define (pad:pi-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string=? line "IN 15") (null? *pl-esc*))
      (pad:who-key!)
      (if (and (string? line) (string-prefix? line "KEY ")
               (>= (string-length line) 9)
               (string=? (substring line 4 9) "goal:"))
          (let ((r (pad:card-goal! (substring line 4 (string-length line)))))
            (if (car r)
                (pad:play-ok! (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                (begin
                  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
                  (set! *pl-say* (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                  (car (cdr r)))))
          (pad:play-line! line))))

;; Byte list of "IN b1 b2 ..." or #f when a field is not a byte.
(define (pad:pi-parse line)
  (let pi-walk ((s line) (k (string-length line)) (i 3) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i k)
        (if (null? acc) #f (reverse acc))
        (let* ((sp (string-index s " " i))
               (j (if (< sp 0) k sp))
               (v (string->number (substring s i j))))
          (if (and (number? v) (>= v 0) (< v 256))
              (pi-walk s k (+ j 1) (cons v acc))
              #f)))))

;; Byte by byte, exactly what one "IN b" line per byte did before: ctrl-o
;; (15, idle) asks who wrote the row, every other byte goes through
;; pad:key-step and pad:play-cmd!. One frame per accepted or rejected
;; command; a pending escape byte writes nothing. Returns "quit" or "go".
(define (pad:pi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (let pi-each ((xs bs))
          (if (null? xs)
              "go"
              (let* ((b (car xs))
                     (r (if (and (= b 15) (null? *pl-esc*))
                            (pad:who-key!)
                            (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
                              (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
                              (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                                  "pending"
                                  (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
                (cond
                  ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
                  ((string=? r "pending") (pi-each (cdr xs)))
                  (#t
                   (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
                   (pi-each (cdr xs))))))))))

;; One protocol line: dispatch, run, write the frame. Returns "quit" or
;; "go". One Soft entry per key on the hot paths: when the lc cache is in
;; step with the state (*lc-L* is the current lines object), a cursor
;; move on the row that keeps the name under the cursor (left, right,
;; home, end) and a typed char or a backspace inside a row are done here
;; inline -- the same state change as pad:play-cmd! and the same frame as
;; pad:play-snap (try_cursor_movement, or pad:lc-line! for the edited
;; row, which needs no try_window_id check because only row l changed).
;; Everything else calls pad:play-cmd! + pad:play-snap as before.
(define (pad:play-step! line)
  (let* ((n0 (string-length line))
         (in (and (> n0 3) (string=? (substring line 0 3) "IN ")))
         (idle (null? *pl-esc*))
         (b (and in idle (string->number (substring line 3 n0))))
         (c (cond
              ((not (and in idle)) #f)
              ((number? b) (if (and (>= b 0) (< b 256) (not (= b 15))) (vector-ref *pi-keyv* b) #f))
              (#t (let ((t (member line *pi-seq-lines*)))
                    (if t (list-ref *pi-seq-cmds* (- *pi-seq-n* (length t))) #f)))))
         (fast (and c (not (equal? c "pending"))))
         (st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (sync (and fast (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (if sync (list-ref L l) (list)))
         (len (length ln))
         (mv (cond
               ((not sync) -1)
               ((number? c) -1)
               ((string=? c "left") (if (> col 0) (- col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "right") (if (< col len) (+ col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "home") 0)
               ((string=? c "end") len)
               (#t -1)))
         ;; the HL tape letter at the new column says whether a name is
         ;; there at all (S K Q M); only then walk the row's tokens (a
         ;; named-let entry costs ~0.1-0.25 ms on Soft tip c69e644)
         (tape (if (< mv 0) "" (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 3)))
         (tc (if (< mv (string-length tape)) (string-ref tape mv) 46))
         (name (cond
                 ((< mv 0) #f)
                 ((not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))) "")
                 (#t
                   (let pi-nm ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)) (cc mv))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (pi-nm (cdr ts) cc))))))))
         (cur (and name (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (ins (and sync (number? c) (>= c 32) (<= c 126) (< len *max-col*)))
         (del (and sync (not ins) (string? c) (string=? c "back") (> col 0)))
         (r (cond
              (cur
               (set! *pl-st* (list L l mv (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
               (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
               (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
               (set! *lc-cur* l)
               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
               (list l))
              ((or ins del)
               (let* ((n (length L))
                      (ln2 (if ins
                               (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                                       (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col))))
                               (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                                       (drop ln col))))
                      (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                                  (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                      (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                      (un (length U))
                      (col2 (if ins (+ col 1) (- col 1))))
                 (set! *pl-st*
                       (list L2 l col2 (list-ref st 3) (list)
                             (cond
                               ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                               ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                               (#t U))))
                 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
                 (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)))
              (fast (if (equal? (pad:play-cmd! c) "quit") "quit" "snap"))
              (in (pad:pi-bytes! line))
              (#t
               (let ((r1 (pad:pi-line! line)))
                 (cond
                   ((string=? r1 "quit") "quit")
                   ((string=? r1 "pending") "go")
                   (#t "snap")))))))
    (cond
      ((list? r)
       (set! *pi-fast* (+ *pi-fast* 1))
       (let* ((st2 *pl-st*)
              (fr (string-append
                    "SNAP v1 pad\n"
                    "TITLE aura pad (Soft) keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                    " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                    "CURSOR line=" (number->string (cadr st2))
                    " col=" (number->string (caddr st2)) "\n"
                    "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                    "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                    (cond
                      ((null? r) "")
                      ((null? (cdr r)) (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (number->string (car r)) "\n"))
                      (#t (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (pad:v-dirty-csv r) "\n")))
                    "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
                    *lc-body*
                    "END\n")))
         (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons fr *pi-out*)) (display fr))

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- one Soft entry per protocol line for play.aura.
;; Needs keys.aura, card.aura and who.aura (play.aura loads them first).
;;
;; c/pad_play forwards every read() of key bytes as ONE line,
;; "IN b1 b2 ... bn" (still raw bytes, never interpreted in C). An arrow
;; key is one line "IN 27 91 68" instead of three. Soft takes the line in
;; pad:play-step!, which does the dispatch, runs the command, and writes
;; the frame itself. A cursor move is one Soft call per key and a typed
;; char or backspace three (pad:play-step!, pad:lc-line!, pad:lc-scan),
;; instead of the old chain (play-line! wrapper -> keys.aura play-line!
;; -> key-step -> kv-get per keymap entry -> play-cmd! -> play-snap ->
;; lc-line! -> lc-scan, and three lines per arrow key).
;; Every closure call costs ~0.26 ms on Soft tip c69e644 with the pad
;; loaded (aura#4350), so the chain alone was ~1.5 ms per line and 2.5 ms
;; for backspace.
;;
;; The hot cases are table lookups made with builtins:
;; - one byte, idle escape state: the idle-state result of pad:key-step
;;   for that byte, memoized on first use in *pi-kb* / *pi-kc* (a table
;;   for all 256 bytes built at load cost ~1 s of pad startup);
;; - a whole escape sequence on one line ("IN 27 91 68"): *pi-seq-lines*.
;; Anything else (an escape split over lines, as the smoke streams send
;; it, several keys in one read, byte 15) goes through pad:pi-bytes!,
;; which feeds each byte through the same steps the old path used and
;; writes one frame per accepted command, as before. So every frame is
;; the frame the old path wrote (checked by gap_test.aura).
;; No named let captures an outer local here (aura#4353).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; Idle key-step memo: bytes seen (newest first) and their commands; a
;; hit is member + length + list-ref (builtins), a miss runs pad:key-step
;; once (what the old path ran for every byte) and remembers it.
(define *pi-kb* (list))
(define *pi-kc* (list))
(define *pi-kn* 0)
(define (pad:pi-key-miss! b)
  (let ((c (car (pad:key-step (list) b))))
    (set! *pi-kb* (cons b *pi-kb*))
    (set! *pi-kc* (cons c *pi-kc*))
    (set! *pi-kn* (+ *pi-kn* 1))
    c))

;; "IN 27 91 X" / "IN 27 79 X" for every arrow X -> its command word.
(define (pad:pi-seq-lines xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let ((x (number->string (car (car xs)))))
        (cons (string-append "IN 27 91 " x)
              (cons (string-append "IN 27 79 " x) (pad:pi-seq-lines (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:pi-seq-cmds xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (cons (cadr (car xs)) (cons (cadr (car xs)) (pad:pi-seq-cmds (cdr xs))))))
(define *pi-seq-lines* (pad:pi-seq-lines *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-cmds* (pad:pi-seq-cmds *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-n* (length *pi-seq-lines*))

;; Tests collect frames instead of writing them.
(define *pi-collect* #f)
(define *pi-out* (list))
(define *pi-fast* 0)    ; lines taken by the table fast path
(define *pi-slow* 0)    ; lines taken byte by byte

;; M8: KEY goal:... and M10: IN 15 (ctrl-o) on top of keys.aura's
;; pad:play-line!. Same contract as keys.aura (returns "ok", "pending",
;; "quit" or a reason; the caller writes the frame). A new name, not a
;; redefinition: in a loaded file, "(define base f) (define (f ..))"
;; makes base run the NEW f on Soft tip c69e644 (inline it works), so the
;; old wrapper moved here looped forever on QUIT (aura#4354).
(define (pad:pi-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string=? line "IN 15") (null? *pl-esc*))
      (pad:who-key!)
      (if (and (string? line) (string-prefix? line "KEY ")
               (>= (string-length line) 9)
               (string=? (substring line 4 9) "goal:"))
          (let ((r (pad:card-goal! (substring line 4 (string-length line)))))
            (if (car r)
                (pad:play-ok! (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                (begin
                  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
                  (set! *pl-say* (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                  (car (cdr r)))))
          (pad:play-line! line))))

;; Byte list of "IN b1 b2 ..." or #f when a field is not a byte.
(define (pad:pi-parse line)
  (let pi-walk ((s line) (k (string-length line)) (i 3) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i k)
        (if (null? acc) #f (reverse acc))
        (let* ((sp (string-index s " " i))
               (j (if (< sp 0) k sp))
               (v (string->number (substring s i j))))
          (if (and (number? v) (>= v 0) (< v 256))
              (pi-walk s k (+ j 1) (cons v acc))
              #f)))))

;; Byte by byte, exactly what one "IN b" line per byte did before: ctrl-o
;; (15, idle) asks who wrote the row, every other byte goes through
;; pad:key-step and pad:play-cmd!. One frame per accepted or rejected
;; command; a pending escape byte writes nothing. Returns "quit" or "go".
(define (pad:pi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (let pi-each ((xs bs))
          (if (null? xs)
              "go"
              (let* ((b (car xs))
                     (r (if (and (= b 15) (null? *pl-esc*))
                            (pad:who-key!)
                            (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
                              (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
                              (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                                  "pending"
                                  (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
                (cond
                  ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
                  ((string=? r "pending") (pi-each (cdr xs)))
                  (#t
                   (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
                   (pi-each (cdr xs))))))))))

;; One protocol line: dispatch, run, write the frame. Returns "quit" or
;; "go". One Soft entry per key on the hot paths: when the lc cache is in
;; step with the state (*lc-L* is the current lines object), a cursor
;; move on the row that keeps the name under the cursor (left, right,
;; home, end) and a typed char or a backspace inside a row are done here
;; inline -- the same state change as pad:play-cmd! and the same frame as
;; pad:play-snap (try_cursor_movement, or pad:lc-line! for the edited
;; row, which needs no try_window_id check because only row l changed).
;; Everything else calls pad:play-cmd! + pad:play-snap as before.
(define (pad:play-step! line)
  (let* ((n0 (string-length line))
         (in (and (> n0 3) (string=? (substring line 0 3) "IN ")))
         (idle (null? *pl-esc*))
         (b (and in idle (string->number (substring line 3 n0))))
         (c (cond
              ((not (and in idle)) #f)
              ((number? b) (if (and (>= b 0) (< b 256) (not (= b 15)))
                               (let ((t (member b *pi-kb*)))
                                 (if t (list-ref *pi-kc* (- *pi-kn* (length t))) (pad:pi-key-miss! b)))
                               #f))
              (#t (let ((t (member line *pi-seq-lines*)))
                    (if t (list-ref *pi-seq-cmds* (- *pi-seq-n* (length t))) #f)))))
         (fast (and c (not (equal? c "pending"))))
         (st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (sync (and fast (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (if sync (list-ref L l) (list)))
         (len (length ln))
         (mv (cond
               ((not sync) -1)
               ((number? c) -1)
               ((string=? c "left") (if (> col 0) (- col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "right") (if (< col len) (+ col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "home") 0)
               ((string=? c "end") len)
               (#t -1)))
         ;; the HL tape letter at the new column says whether a name is
         ;; there at all (S K Q M); only then walk the row's tokens (a
         ;; named-let entry costs ~0.1-0.25 ms on Soft tip c69e644)
         (tape (if (< mv 0) "" (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 3)))
         (tc (if (< mv (string-length tape)) (string-ref tape mv) 46))
         (name (cond
                 ((< mv 0) #f)
                 ((not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))) "")
                 (#t
                   (let pi-nm ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)) (cc mv))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (pi-nm (cdr ts) cc))))))))
         (cur (and name (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (ins (and sync (number? c) (>= c 32) (<= c 126) (< len *max-col*)))
         (del (and sync (not ins) (string? c) (string=? c "back") (> col 0)))
         (r (cond
              (cur
               (set! *pl-st* (list L l mv (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
               (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
               (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
               (set! *lc-cur* l)
               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
               (list l))
              ((or ins del)
               (let* ((n (length L))
                      (ln2 (if ins
                               (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                                       (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col))))
                               (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                                       (drop ln col))))
                      (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                                  (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                      (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                      (un (length U))
                      (col2 (if ins (+ col 1) (- col 1))))
                 (set! *pl-st*
                       (list L2 l col2 (list-ref st 3) (list)
                             (cond
                               ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                               ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                               (#t U))))
                 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
                 (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)))

                    "CURSOR line=" (number->string (cadr st2))
                    " col=" (number->string (caddr st2)) "\n"
                    "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                    "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                    (cond
                      ((null? r) "")
                      ((null? (cdr r)) (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (number->string (car r)) "\n"))

              (cur

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- one Soft entry per protocol line for play.aura.
;; Needs keys.aura, card.aura and who.aura (play.aura loads them first).
;;
;; c/pad_play forwards every read() of key bytes as ONE line,
;; "IN b1 b2 ... bn" (still raw bytes, never interpreted in C). An arrow
;; key is one line "IN 27 91 68" instead of three. Soft takes the line in
;; pad:play-step!, which does the dispatch, runs the command, and writes
;; the frame itself. A cursor move is one Soft call per key and a typed
;; char or backspace inside a row two (pad:play-step!, pad:lc-scan; three
;; when a string opens or closes: + pad:lc-line!), instead of the old
;; chain (play-line! wrapper -> keys.aura play-line! -> key-step ->
;; kv-get per keymap entry -> play-cmd! -> play-snap -> lc-line! ->
;; lc-scan, and three lines per arrow key).
;; Every closure call costs ~0.26 ms on Soft tip c69e644 with the pad
;; loaded (aura#4350), so the chain alone was ~1.5 ms per line and 2.5 ms
;; for backspace.
;;
;; The hot cases are table lookups made with builtins:
;; - one byte, idle escape state: the idle-state result of pad:key-step
;;   for that byte, memoized on first use in *pi-kb* / *pi-kc* (a table
;;   for all 256 bytes built at load cost ~1 s of pad startup);
;; - a whole escape sequence on one line ("IN 27 91 68"): *pi-seq-lines*.
;; Anything else (an escape split over lines, as the smoke streams send
;; it, several keys in one read, byte 15) goes through pad:pi-bytes!,
;; which feeds each byte through the same steps the old path used and
;; writes one frame per accepted command, as before. So every frame is
;; the frame the old path wrote (checked by gap_test.aura).
;; No named let captures an outer local here (aura#4353).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; Idle key-step memo: bytes seen (newest first) and their commands; a
;; hit is member + length + list-ref (builtins), a miss runs pad:key-step
;; once (what the old path ran for every byte) and remembers it.
(define *pi-kb* (list))
(define *pi-kc* (list))
(define *pi-kn* 0)
(define (pad:pi-key-miss! b)
  (let ((c (car (pad:key-step (list) b))))
    (set! *pi-kb* (cons b *pi-kb*))
    (set! *pi-kc* (cons c *pi-kc*))
    (set! *pi-kn* (+ *pi-kn* 1))
    c))

;; "IN 27 91 X" / "IN 27 79 X" for every arrow X -> its command word.
(define (pad:pi-seq-lines xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let ((x (number->string (car (car xs)))))
        (cons (string-append "IN 27 91 " x)
              (cons (string-append "IN 27 79 " x) (pad:pi-seq-lines (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:pi-seq-cmds xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (cons (cadr (car xs)) (cons (cadr (car xs)) (pad:pi-seq-cmds (cdr xs))))))
(define *pi-seq-lines* (pad:pi-seq-lines *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-cmds* (pad:pi-seq-cmds *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-n* (length *pi-seq-lines*))

;; Tests collect frames instead of writing them.
(define *pi-collect* #f)
(define *pi-out* (list))
(define *pi-fast* 0)    ; lines taken by the table fast path
(define *pi-slow* 0)    ; lines taken byte by byte

;; M8: KEY goal:... and M10: IN 15 (ctrl-o) on top of keys.aura's
;; pad:play-line!. Same contract as keys.aura (returns "ok", "pending",
;; "quit" or a reason; the caller writes the frame). A new name, not a
;; redefinition: in a loaded file, "(define base f) (define (f ..))"
;; makes base run the NEW f on Soft tip c69e644 (inline it works), so the
;; old wrapper moved here looped forever on QUIT (aura#4354).
(define (pad:pi-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string=? line "IN 15") (null? *pl-esc*))
      (pad:who-key!)
      (if (and (string? line) (string-prefix? line "KEY ")
               (>= (string-length line) 9)
               (string=? (substring line 4 9) "goal:"))
          (let ((r (pad:card-goal! (substring line 4 (string-length line)))))
            (if (car r)
                (pad:play-ok! (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                (begin
                  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
                  (set! *pl-say* (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                  (car (cdr r)))))
          (pad:play-line! line))))

;; Byte list of "IN b1 b2 ..." or #f when a field is not a byte.
(define (pad:pi-parse line)
  (let pi-walk ((s line) (k (string-length line)) (i 3) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i k)
        (if (null? acc) #f (reverse acc))
        (let* ((sp (string-index s " " i))
               (j (if (< sp 0) k sp))
               (v (string->number (substring s i j))))
          (if (and (number? v) (>= v 0) (< v 256))
              (pi-walk s k (+ j 1) (cons v acc))
              #f)))))

;; Byte by byte, exactly what one "IN b" line per byte did before: ctrl-o
;; (15, idle) asks who wrote the row, every other byte goes through
;; pad:key-step and pad:play-cmd!. One frame per accepted or rejected
;; command; a pending escape byte writes nothing. Returns "quit" or "go".
(define (pad:pi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (let pi-each ((xs bs))
          (if (null? xs)
              "go"
              (let* ((b (car xs))
                     (r (if (and (= b 15) (null? *pl-esc*))
                            (pad:who-key!)
                            (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
                              (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
                              (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                                  "pending"
                                  (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
                (cond
                  ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
                  ((string=? r "pending") (pi-each (cdr xs)))
                  (#t
                   (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
                   (pi-each (cdr xs))))))))))

;; A typed char or backspace changed row l only (L2 = new lines, ln2 = new
;; row codes, col2 = new column). This is pad:lc-line!'s common case
;; written out with builtins, so a key costs two Soft calls (play-step!
;; and pad:lc-scan): re-lex row l from the first token that can change
;; (font-lock-extend-region: tokens ending before col2 - 1 are kept, the
;; same cut lc-line! makes), then, when the row's end state (inside a
;; string?) and the def-carry it hands to row l+1 equal what row l+1's
;; cached record was built with, no other row can change
;; (jit-lock-context stops at once), so only row l is spliced in. Any
;; other case -- more than three tokens to drop, no cached mark row, the
;; end state or carry changed (a string opened or closed) -- goes to
;; pad:lc-line! with the entry already scanned (*lc-pre*), so the frame
;; is the one lc-line! builds either way. Written inline in
;; pad:play-step! (a Soft call costs ~0.23 ms). Yields the dirty rows.
(define *pi-symk* (list "S" "K" "Q" "M"))
(define *pi-rows* 0)    ; keys spliced here (row l only)
;; One protocol line: dispatch, run, write the frame. Returns "quit" or
;; "go". One Soft entry per key on the hot paths: when the lc cache is in
;; step with the state (*lc-L* is the current lines object), a cursor
;; move on the row that keeps the name under the cursor (left, right,
;; home, end) and a typed char or a backspace inside a row are done here
;; inline -- the same state change as pad:play-cmd! and the same frame as
;; pad:play-snap (try_cursor_movement, or pad:lc-line! for the edited
;; row, which needs no try_window_id check because only row l changed).
;; Everything else calls pad:play-cmd! + pad:play-snap as before.
(define (pad:play-step! line)

         (in (and (> n0 3) (string=? (substring line 0 3) "IN ")))
         (idle (null? *pl-esc*))
         (b (and in idle (string->number (substring line 3 n0))))
         (c (cond
              ((not (and in idle)) #f)
              ((number? b) (if (and (>= b 0) (< b 256) (not (= b 15)))
                               (let ((t (member b *pi-kb*)))
                                 (if t (list-ref *pi-kc* (- *pi-kn* (length t))) (pad:pi-key-miss! b)))
                               #f))
              (#t (let ((t (member line *pi-seq-lines*)))
                    (if t (list-ref *pi-seq-cmds* (- *pi-seq-n* (length t))) #f)))))

         (st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (sync (and fast (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (if sync (list-ref L l) (list)))
         (len (length ln))
         (mv (cond
               ((not sync) -1)
               ((number? c) -1)
               ((string=? c "left") (if (> col 0) (- col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "right") (if (< col len) (+ col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "home") 0)
               ((string=? c "end") len)
               (#t -1)))

         ;; there at all (S K Q M); only then walk the row's tokens (a
         ;; named-let entry costs ~0.1-0.25 ms on Soft tip c69e644)
         (tape (if (< mv 0) "" (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 3)))
         (tc (if (< mv (string-length tape)) (string-ref tape mv) 46))
         (name (cond
                 ((< mv 0) #f)
                 ((not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))) "")
                 (#t
                   (let pi-nm ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)) (cc mv))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (pi-nm (cdr ts) cc))))))))

         (ins (and sync (number? c) (>= c 32) (<= c 126) (< len *max-col*)))
         (del (and sync (not ins) (string? c) (string=? c "back") (> col 0)))
         (r (cond
              (cur
               (set! *pl-st* (list L l mv (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
               (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
               (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
               (set! *lc-cur* l)
               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
               (list l))
              ((or ins del)

                               (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))

                               (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))

                        (p (if (> col2 0) (- col2 1) 0))
                        (xs (list-ref oe 8))

                        (x1 (and t1 (>= (caddr t1) p)))
                        (t2 (if (and x1 (pair? (cdr xs))) (cadr xs) #f))
                        (x2 (and t2 (>= (caddr t2) p)))
                        (t3 (if (and x2 (pair? (cddr xs))) (caddr xs) #f))
                        (x3 (and t3 (>= (caddr t3) p)))
                        (t4 (if (and x3 (pair? (cdddr xs))) (list-ref xs 3) #f))
                        (x4 (and t4 (>= (caddr t4) p))))
                   (if (or x4 (not (list-ref old 2)))
                       (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)
                       (let* ((acc0 (cond (x3 (cdddr xs)) (x2 (cddr xs)) (x1 (cdr xs)) (#t xs)))
                              (mr (+ (if (and x1 (member (car t1) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)
                                     (if (and x2 (member (car t2) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)
                                     (if (and x3 (member (car t3) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)))
                              (r (if (pair? acc0) (caddr (car acc0)) 0))
                              (le (pad:lc-scan (list->string ln2) ln2 r acc0
                                               (if (> r 0) (list (substring (list-ref oe 3) 0 r)) (list))
                                               (drop (list-ref oe 7) mr)
                                               (list-ref oe 9)))
                              (h0 (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1)))
                              (a (list-ref le 5))
                              (b (list-ref le 6))
                              (p1 (list-ref old 3))
                              (p2 (list-ref old 4))
                              (q1 (if a a p1))
                              (q2 (cond ((not a) p2) ((not b) p1) (#t b)))
                              (rs (vector->list *lc-recv*))
                              (below (drop rs (+ l 1)))
                              (nx (if (pair? below) (car below) #f))
                              (keep (or (not nx)
                                        (and (eq? (list-ref le 4) (list-ref (car nx) 9))
                                             (list-ref nx 2)
                                             (= (cadr (list-ref nx 1))
                                                (if (and q1 (string=? (car q1) "K") (string=? (list-ref q1 3) "define")) 1 0))
                                             (= (caddr (list-ref nx 1))
                                                (if (and q1 (string=? (car q1) "P") q2 (string=? (car q2) "K")
                                                         (string=? (list-ref q2 3) "define"))
                                                    1 0))))))
                         (if (not keep)
                             (begin (set! *lc-pre* le) (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2))
                             (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                    (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46))
                                    (name (if (not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77)))
                                              ""
                                              (let pi-nm2 ((ts (list-ref le 2)) (cc col2))
                                                (if (null? ts)
                                                    ""

                                                          (list-ref t 3)
                                                          (pi-nm2 (cdr ts) cc)))))))
                                    (oname *lc-name*)
                                    (str (list-ref le 1))
                                    (k (string-length str))
                                    (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                   (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                              (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                              (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                    (row (string-append "T " str "\nH " tp "\nM " mrow "\n"))
                                    (n (length rs))
                                    (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                    (nopen (+ *lc-nopen* (if (list-ref le 4) 1 0) (if (list-ref oe 4) -1 0)))
                                    (rows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l))) (cons row (drop ws (+ l 1))))))
                               (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector
                                                 (append (reverse (drop (reverse rs) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (list le (cons oname (cdr (list-ref old 1))) mrow p1 p2 #f)
                                                               below))))
                               (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
                               (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
                               (set! *lc-nopen* nopen)
                               (set! *lc-full* (if (> nopen 0) 1 0))
                               (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                               (set! *lc-L* L2)
                               (set! *lc-cur* l)
                               (set! *lc-framed* 1)
                               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                               (set! *pi-rows* (+ *pi-rows* 1))
                               (if (string=? name oname)
                                   (list l)
                                   (let ((dm (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
                                     (set! *lc-name* name)
                                     dm)))))))))
              (fast (if (equal? (pad:play-cmd! c) "quit") "quit" "snap"))
              (in (pad:pi-bytes! line))
              (#t
               (let ((r1 (pad:pi-line! line)))
                 (cond
                   ((string=? r1 "quit") "quit")
                   ((string=? r1 "pending") "go")
                   (#t "snap")))))))
    (cond
      ((list? r)
       (set! *pi-fast* (+ *pi-fast* 1))
       (let* ((st2 *pl-st*)
              (fr (string-append
                    "SNAP v1 pad\n"
                    "TITLE aura pad (Soft) keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                    " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                    "CURSOR line=" (number->string (cadr st2))
                    " col=" (number->string (caddr st2)) "\n"
                    "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                    "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                    (cond
                      ((null? r) "")
                      ((null? (cdr r)) (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (number->string (car r)) "\n"))
                      (#t (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (string-join (map number->string r) ",") "\n")))
                    "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
                    *lc-body*
                    "END\n")))
         (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons fr *pi-out*)) (display fr))
         "go"))
      ((string=? r "snap")
       (if fast (set! *pi-fast* (+ *pi-fast* 1)) 0)
       (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
       "go")
      (#t r))))

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- one Soft entry per protocol line for play.aura.
;; Needs keys.aura, card.aura and who.aura (play.aura loads them first).
;;
;; c/pad_play forwards every read() of key bytes as ONE line,
;; "IN b1 b2 ... bn" (still raw bytes, never interpreted in C). An arrow
;; key is one line "IN 27 91 68" instead of three. Soft takes the line in
;; pad:play-step!, which does the dispatch, runs the command, and writes
;; the frame itself. A cursor move is one Soft call per key and a typed
;; char or backspace inside a row two (pad:play-step!, pad:lc-scan; three
;; when a string opens or closes: + pad:lc-line!), instead of the old
;; chain (play-line! wrapper -> keys.aura play-line! -> key-step ->
;; kv-get per keymap entry -> play-cmd! -> play-snap -> lc-line! ->
;; lc-scan, and three lines per arrow key).
;; Every closure call costs ~0.26 ms on Soft tip c69e644 with the pad
;; loaded (aura#4350), so the chain alone was ~1.5 ms per line and 2.5 ms
;; for backspace.
;;
;; The hot cases are table lookups made with builtins:
;; - one byte, idle escape state: the idle-state result of pad:key-step
;;   for that byte, memoized on first use in *pi-kb* / *pi-kc* (a table
;;   for all 256 bytes built at load cost ~1 s of pad startup);
;; - a whole escape sequence on one line ("IN 27 91 68"): *pi-seq-lines*.
;; Anything else (an escape split over lines, as the smoke streams send
;; it, several keys in one read, byte 15) goes through pad:pi-bytes!,
;; which feeds each byte through the same steps the old path used and
;; writes one frame per accepted command, as before. So every frame is
;; the frame the old path wrote (checked by gap_test.aura).
;; No named let captures an outer local here (aura#4353).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; Idle key-step memo: bytes seen (newest first) and their commands; a
;; hit is member + length + list-ref (builtins), a miss runs pad:key-step
;; once (what the old path ran for every byte) and remembers it.
(define *pi-kb* (list))
(define *pi-kc* (list))
(define *pi-kn* 0)
(define (pad:pi-key-miss! b)
  (let ((c (car (pad:key-step (list) b))))
    (set! *pi-kb* (cons b *pi-kb*))
    (set! *pi-kc* (cons c *pi-kc*))
    (set! *pi-kn* (+ *pi-kn* 1))
    c))

;; "IN 27 91 X" / "IN 27 79 X" for every arrow X -> its command word.
(define (pad:pi-seq-lines xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let ((x (number->string (car (car xs)))))
        (cons (string-append "IN 27 91 " x)
              (cons (string-append "IN 27 79 " x) (pad:pi-seq-lines (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:pi-seq-cmds xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (cons (cadr (car xs)) (cons (cadr (car xs)) (pad:pi-seq-cmds (cdr xs))))))
(define *pi-seq-lines* (pad:pi-seq-lines *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-cmds* (pad:pi-seq-cmds *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-n* (length *pi-seq-lines*))

;; Tests collect frames instead of writing them.
(define *pi-collect* #f)
(define *pi-out* (list))
(define *pi-fast* 0)    ; lines taken by the table fast path
(define *pi-slow* 0)    ; lines taken byte by byte

;; M8: KEY goal:... and M10: IN 15 (ctrl-o) on top of keys.aura's
;; pad:play-line!. Same contract as keys.aura (returns "ok", "pending",
;; "quit" or a reason; the caller writes the frame). A new name, not a
;; redefinition: in a loaded file, "(define base f) (define (f ..))"
;; makes base run the NEW f on Soft tip c69e644 (inline it works), so the
;; old wrapper moved here looped forever on QUIT (aura#4354).
(define (pad:pi-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string=? line "IN 15") (null? *pl-esc*))
      (pad:who-key!)
      (if (and (string? line) (string-prefix? line "KEY ")
               (>= (string-length line) 9)
               (string=? (substring line 4 9) "goal:"))
          (let ((r (pad:card-goal! (substring line 4 (string-length line)))))
            (if (car r)
                (pad:play-ok! (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                (begin
                  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
                  (set! *pl-say* (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                  (car (cdr r)))))
          (pad:play-line! line))))

;; Byte list of "IN b1 b2 ..." or #f when a field is not a byte.
(define (pad:pi-parse line)
  (let pi-walk ((s line) (k (string-length line)) (i 3) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i k)
        (if (null? acc) #f (reverse acc))
        (let* ((sp (string-index s " " i))
               (j (if (< sp 0) k sp))
               (v (string->number (substring s i j))))
          (if (and (number? v) (>= v 0) (< v 256))
              (pi-walk s k (+ j 1) (cons v acc))
              #f)))))

;; Byte by byte, exactly what one "IN b" line per byte did before: ctrl-o
;; (15, idle) asks who wrote the row, every other byte goes through
;; pad:key-step and pad:play-cmd!. One frame per accepted or rejected
;; command; a pending escape byte writes nothing. Returns "quit" or "go".
(define (pad:pi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (let pi-each ((xs bs))
          (if (null? xs)
              "go"
              (let* ((b (car xs))
                     (r (if (and (= b 15) (null? *pl-esc*))
                            (pad:who-key!)
                            (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
                              (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
                              (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                                  "pending"
                                  (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
                (cond
                  ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
                  ((string=? r "pending") (pi-each (cdr xs)))
                  (#t
                   (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
                   (pi-each (cdr xs))))))))))

;; A typed char or backspace changed row l only (L2 = new lines, ln2 = new
;; row codes, col2 = new column). This is pad:lc-line!'s common case
;; written out with builtins, so a key costs two Soft calls (play-step!
;; and pad:lc-scan): re-lex row l from the first token that can change
;; (font-lock-extend-region: tokens ending before col2 - 1 are kept, the
;; same cut lc-line! makes), then, when the row's end state (inside a
;; string?) and the def-carry it hands to row l+1 equal what row l+1's
;; cached record was built with, no other row can change
;; (jit-lock-context stops at once), so only row l is spliced in. Any
;; other case -- more than three tokens to drop, no cached mark row, the
;; end state or carry changed (a string opened or closed) -- goes to
;; pad:lc-line! with the entry already scanned (*lc-pre*), so the frame
;; is the one lc-line! builds either way. Written inline in
;; pad:play-step! (a Soft call costs ~0.23 ms). Yields the dirty rows.
(define *pi-symk* (list "S" "K" "Q" "M"))
(define *pi-rows* 0)    ; keys spliced here (row l only)
;; Early frame (PAD_DEFER=1, docs/perf-aura.md): when a key changes the
;; start state of the rows below (a string opened or closed), first write
;; a frame with row l exact and the rows below as cached (DIRTY = l), then
;; the exact frame, which is byte for byte the frame written without
;; deferral (its DIRTY = rows changed + cursor row, the same set relative
;; to the early frame). jit-lock-defer style: the key's own row shows at
;; once, the rows below follow ~2 ms later. Done on the main thread: a
;; fiber cannot run this while the loop waits in read-line (aura#4356).
(define *pi-defer* #f)
(define *pi-early* 0)   ; early frames written
;; One protocol line: dispatch, run, write the frame. Returns "quit" or
;; "go". One Soft entry per key on the hot paths: when the lc cache is in
;; step with the state (*lc-L* is the current lines object), a cursor
;; move on the row that keeps the name under the cursor (left, right,
;; home, end) and a typed char or a backspace inside a row are done here
;; inline -- the same state change as pad:play-cmd! and the same frame as
;; pad:play-snap (try_cursor_movement, or pad:lc-line! for the edited
;; row, which needs no try_window_id check because only row l changed).
;; Everything else calls pad:play-cmd! + pad:play-snap as before.
(define (pad:play-step! line)
  (let* ((n0 (string-length line))
         (in (and (> n0 3) (string=? (substring line 0 3) "IN ")))
         (idle (null? *pl-esc*))
         (b (and in idle (string->number (substring line 3 n0))))
         (c (cond
              ((not (and in idle)) #f)
              ((number? b) (if (and (>= b 0) (< b 256) (not (= b 15)))
                               (let ((t (member b *pi-kb*)))
                                 (if t (list-ref *pi-kc* (- *pi-kn* (length t))) (pad:pi-key-miss! b)))
                               #f))
              (#t (let ((t (member line *pi-seq-lines*)))
                    (if t (list-ref *pi-seq-cmds* (- *pi-seq-n* (length t))) #f)))))
         (fast (and c (not (equal? c "pending"))))
         (st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (sync (and fast (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (if sync (list-ref L l) (list)))
         (len (length ln))
         (mv (cond
               ((not sync) -1)
               ((number? c) -1)
               ((string=? c "left") (if (> col 0) (- col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "right") (if (< col len) (+ col 1) -1))
