                                       (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                              (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46)))
                                         (if (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))
                                             (string=? *lc-name* (pad:lc-name-at le col2))
                                             (string=? *lc-name* ""))))
                                   ;; early frame: row l exact, rows below as
                                   ;; cached (their start state is stale for
                                   ;; ~2 ms); the exact frame follows at once
                                   (let* ((oname *lc-name*)
                                          (str (list-ref le 1))
                                          (k (string-length str))
                                          (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                         (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                                    (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                                    (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                          (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                          (n (length ws))
                                          (erows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref le 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")
                                                               (drop ws (+ l 1)))))
                                          (ebody (apply string-append erows))
                                          (fr (if *w2-on*
                                                  ;; v2: row l only; C still holds *lc-rowv*'s
                                                  ;; row l, so the next frame resends it
                                                  (let ((f (pad:w2-frame l col2 (list l) (list->vector erows) ebody)))
                                                    (set! *w2-plus* l)
                                                    f)
                                                  (string-append
                                                    "SNAP v1 pad\n"
                                                    "TITLE " *pl-title* " keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                                                    " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                                                    "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col2) "\n"
                                                    "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                                                    "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                                                    "DIRTY lines=" (number->string l) "\n"
                                                    "ROWS n=" (number->string n) "\n"
                                                    ebody
                                                    "END\n"))))
                                     (set! *pi-early* (+ *pi-early* 1))
                                     (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (string-append "EARLY\n" fr) *pi-out*)) (display fr))
                                     (list erows ebody))
                                   #f)))
                                 (if (and ef *pi-pending* (*pi-pending*))
                                     ;; a key is waiting: skip the settle
                                     (begin
                                       (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector (car ef)))
                                       (set! *lc-body* (cadr ef))
                                       (set! *pi-skips* (+ *pi-skips* 1))
                                       "go")
                                     (begin
                                       (set! *lc-pre* le)
                                       (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)))))
                             (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                    (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46))
                                    (name (if (not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77)))
                                              ""
                                              (let pi-nm2 ((ts (list-ref le 2)) (cc col2))
                                                (if (null? ts)
                                                    ""
                                                    (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                                                      (if (and (member kd *pi-symk*) (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                                                          (list-ref t 3)
                                                          (pi-nm2 (cdr ts) cc)))))))
                                    (oname *lc-name*)
                                    (str (list-ref le 1))
                                    (k (string-length str))
                                    (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                   (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                              (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                              (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                    (row (string-append "T " str "\nH " tp "\nM " mrow "\n"))
                                    (n (length rs))
                                    (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                    (nopen (+ *lc-nopen* (if (list-ref le 4) 1 0) (if (list-ref oe 4) -1 0)))
                                    (rows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l))) (cons row (drop ws (+ l 1))))))
                               (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector
                                                 (append (reverse (drop (reverse rs) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (list le (cons oname (cdr (list-ref old 1))) mrow p1 p2 #f)
                                                               below))))
                               (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
                               (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
                               (set! *lc-nopen* nopen)
                               (set! *lc-full* (if (> nopen 0) 1 0))
                               (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                               (set! *lc-L* L2)
                               (set! *lc-cur* l)
                               (set! *lc-framed* 1)
                               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                               (set! *pi-rows* (+ *pi-rows* 1))
                               (if (string=? name oname)
                                   (list l)
                                   (let ((dm (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
                                     (set! *lc-name* name)
                                     dm)))))))))
              (fast (if (equal? (pad:play-cmd! c) "quit") "quit" "snap"))
              (in (pad:pi-bytes! line))
              (#t
               (let ((r1 (pad:pi-line! line)))
                 (cond
                   ((string=? r1 "quit") "quit")
                   ((string=? r1 "pending") "go")
                   (#t "snap")))))))
    (cond
      ((list? r)
       (set! *pi-fast* (+ *pi-fast* 1))
       (let* ((st2 *pl-st*)
              (fr (cond
                    ;; wire v2, one DIRTY row: inlined (see pad:play-snap)
                    ((and *w2-on* (not *w2-full*) (< *w2-plus* 0) (pair? r) (null? (cdr r)))
                     (set! *w2-gen* (+ *w2-gen* 1))
                     (string-append
                       "SNAP v2 pad\nGEN " (number->string *w2-gen*) " base=" (number->string (- *w2-gen* 1))
                       "\nTITLE " *pl-title* " keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                       " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                       "CURSOR line=" (number->string (cadr st2))
                       " col=" (number->string (caddr st2)) "\n"
                       "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                       "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                       "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*))
                       " body=" (number->string (string-length *lc-body*))
                       "\nR " (number->string (car r)) "\n"
                       (vector-ref *lc-rowv* (car r))
                       "END\n"))
                    (*w2-on* (pad:w2-frame (cadr st2) (caddr st2) r *lc-rowv* *lc-body*))
                    (#t
                      (string-append
                        "SNAP v1 pad\n"
                        "TITLE " *pl-title* " keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                        " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                        "CURSOR line=" (number->string (cadr st2))
                        " col=" (number->string (caddr st2)) "\n"
                        "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                        "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                        (cond
                          ((null? r) "")
                          ((null? (cdr r)) (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (number->string (car r)) "\n"))
                          (#t (string-append "DIRTY lines=" (string-join (map number->string r) ",") "\n")))
                        "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
                        *lc-body*
                        "END\n")))))
         (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons fr *pi-out*)) (display fr))
         "go"))
      ((string=? r "snap")
       (if fast (set! *pi-fast* (+ *pi-fast* 1)) 0)
       (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
       "go")
      (#t r))))

target.name: pad:play-step!
target.body:
(lambda (line) (let* ((n0 (string-length line))
         (in (and (> n0 3) (string=? (substring line 0 3) "IN ")))
         (idle (null? *pl-esc*))
         (b (and in idle (string->number (substring line 3 n0))))
         (c (cond
              ((not (and in idle)) #f)
              ((number? b) (if (and (>= b 0) (< b 256) (not (= b 15)))
                               (if *vi-on*
                                   (pad:vi-cmd b)
                                   (let ((t (member b *pi-kb*)))
                                     (if t (list-ref *pi-kc* (- *pi-kn* (length t))) (pad:pi-key-miss! b))))
                               #f))
              (#t (let ((t (member line *pi-seq-lines*)))
                    (if t (list-ref *pi-seq-cmds* (- *pi-seq-n* (length t))) #f)))))
         (fast (and c (not (equal? c "pending"))))
         (st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (sync (and fast (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (if sync (list-ref L l) (list)))
         (len (length ln))
         (mv (cond
               ((not sync) -1)
               ((number? c) -1)
               ((string=? c "left") (if (> col 0) (- col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "right") (if (< col len) (+ col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "home") 0)
               ((string=? c "end") len)
               (#t -1)))
         ;; the HL tape letter at the new column says whether a name is
         ;; there at all (S K Q M); only then walk the row's tokens (a
         ;; named-let entry costs ~0.1-0.25 ms on Soft tip c69e644)
         (tape (if (< mv 0) "" (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 3)))
         (tc (if (< mv (string-length tape)) (string-ref tape mv) 46))
         (name (cond
                 ((< mv 0) #f)
                 ((not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))) "")
                 (#t
                   (let pi-nm ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)) (cc mv))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (pi-nm (cdr ts) cc))))))))
         (cur (and name (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (ins (and sync (number? c) (>= c 32) (<= c 126) (< len *max-col*)))
         (del (and sync (not ins) (string? c) (string=? c "back") (> col 0)))
         (r (cond
              (cur
               (set! *pl-st* (list L l mv (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
               (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
               (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
               (set! *lc-cur* l)
               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
               (list l))
              ((or ins del)
               (let* ((n (length L))
                      (ln2 (if ins
                               (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                                       (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col))))
                               (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                                       (drop ln col))))
                      (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                                  (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                      (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                      (un (length U))
                      (col2 (if ins (+ col 1) (- col 1))))
                 (set! *pl-st*
                       (list L2 l col2 (list-ref st 3) (list)
                             (cond
                               ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                               ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                               (#t U))))
                 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
                 (let* ((old (vector-ref *lc-recv* l))
                        (oe (car old))
                        (p (if (> col2 0) (- col2 1) 0))
                        (xs (list-ref oe 8))
                        (t1 (if (pair? xs) (car xs) #f))
                        (x1 (and t1 (>= (caddr t1) p)))
                        (t2 (if (and x1 (pair? (cdr xs))) (cadr xs) #f))
                        (x2 (and t2 (>= (caddr t2) p)))
                        (t3 (if (and x2 (pair? (cddr xs))) (caddr xs) #f))
                        (x3 (and t3 (>= (caddr t3) p)))
                        (t4 (if (and x3 (pair? (cdddr xs))) (list-ref xs 3) #f))
                        (x4 (and t4 (>= (caddr t4) p))))
                   (if (or x4 (not (list-ref old 2)))
                       (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)
                       (let* ((fe (and (= col len) (not (list-ref oe 4)) (< len *lc-run-max*)
                                       ;; end-of-row edit (most typing): the
                                       ;; entry pad:lc-scan would return, built
                                       ;; from the cached one; #f = scan
                                       (let* ((s2 (list->string ln2))
                                              (tp0 (list-ref oe 3))
                                              (sy0 (list-ref oe 7))
                                              (k1 (if t1 (car t1) ""))
                                              (nm1 (and t1 (member k1 *pi-symk*)))
                                              (at-end (and t1 (= (caddr t1) len)))
                                              (n2 (if ins (+ len 1) (- len 1)))
                                              (k (if ins (vector-ref *lc-cls* c) 0))
                                              (pc (if (and ins (> len 0)) (string-ref s2 (- len 1)) 32))
                                              (pk (if (< pc 128) (vector-ref *lc-cls* pc) 0))
                                              ;; how the last token changes:
                                              ;; 1 grows/shrinks, 2 dropped,
                                              ;; 3 new token, 0 no token, -1 scan
                                              (how (cond
                                                     ((not ins)
                                                      (cond ((not at-end) 0)
                                                            ((string=? k1 "T") -1)
                                                            ((= (cadr t1) n2) 2)
                                                            (#t 1)))
                                                     ((and at-end (or (string=? k1 "C")
                                                                      (and (string=? k1 "N") (= k 2))
                                                                      (and nm1 (or (= k 2) (= k 3)))))
                                                      1)
                                                     ((or (= k 0) (= k 1)) 0)
                                                     ((or (= k 2) (= k 3) (= k 4)) 3)
                                                     (#t -1)))
                                              (a (cond ((= how 1) (cadr t1)) ((= how 3) len) (#t 0)))
                                              (txt (if (or (= how 1) (= how 3)) (substring s2 a n2) ""))
                                              (w (- n2 a))
                                              (kd (cond
                                                    ((= how 1) (if (or (string=? k1 "C") (string=? k1 "N")) k1 ""))
                                                    ((= how 3) (cond ((= k 4) "P")
                                                                     ((and (= k 2) (or (= len 0) (= pk 1) (= pk 4))) "N")
                                                                     (#t "")))
                                                    (#t "")))
                                              (kd2 (cond
                                                     ((not (string=? kd "")) kd)
                                                     ((not (or (= how 1) (= how 3))) "")
                                                     ((and (>= w 6) (string=? (substring txt 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
                                                     ((and (>= w 7) (string=? (substring txt 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
                                                     ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
                                                     (#t "S")))
                                              (nm2 (member kd2 *pi-symk*))
                                              (rt (cond
                                                    ((= how 0) xs)
                                                    ((= how 2) (cdr xs))
                                                    ((= how 1) (cons (list kd2 a n2 txt) (cdr xs)))
                                                    (#t (cons (list kd2 a n2 txt) xs))))
                                              (tape (cond
                                                      ((= how 0) (if ins (string-append tp0 ".") (substring tp0 0 n2)))
                                                      ((= how 2) (substring tp0 0 n2))
                                                      (#t (string-append
                                                            (substring tp0 0 a)
                                                            (substring (cond
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "S") *lc-run-S*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "K") *lc-run-K*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "N") *lc-run-N*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "P") *lc-run-P*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "C") *lc-run-C*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "Q") *lc-run-Q*)
                                                                         (#t *lc-run-M*))
                                                                       0 w)))))
                                              (sy (cond
                                                    ((= how 0) sy0)
                                                    ((= how 2) (if nm1 (cdr sy0) sy0))
                                                    ((= how 1) (if nm2 (cons txt (cdr sy0)) sy0))
                                                    (#t (if nm2 (cons txt sy0) sy0)))))
                                         (if (< how 0)
                                             #f
                                             (list ln2 s2 (reverse rt) tape #f
                                                   (if (pair? rt) (car rt) #f)
                                                   (if (and (pair? rt) (pair? (cdr rt))) (cadr rt) #f)
                                                   sy rt (list-ref oe 9))))))
                              (le (if fe
                                      (begin (set! *pi-fe* (+ *pi-fe* 1)) fe)
                                      (let* ((acc0 (cond (x3 (cdddr xs)) (x2 (cddr xs)) (x1 (cdr xs)) (#t xs)))
                                             (mr (+ (if (and x1 (member (car t1) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)
                                                    (if (and x2 (member (car t2) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)
                                                    (if (and x3 (member (car t3) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)))
                                             (r (if (pair? acc0) (caddr (car acc0)) 0)))
                                        (pad:lc-scan (list->string ln2) ln2 r acc0
                                                     (if (> r 0) (list (substring (list-ref oe 3) 0 r)) (list))
                                                     (drop (list-ref oe 7) mr)
                                                     (list-ref oe 9)))))
                              (h0 (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1)))
                              (a (list-ref le 5))
                              (b (list-ref le 6))
                              (p1 (list-ref old 3))
                              (p2 (list-ref old 4))
                              (q1 (if a a p1))
                              (q2 (cond ((not a) p2) ((not b) p1) (#t b)))
                              (rs (vector->list *lc-recv*))
                              (below (drop rs (+ l 1)))
                              (nx (if (pair? below) (car below) #f))
                              (keep (or (not nx)
                                        (and (eq? (list-ref le 4) (list-ref (car nx) 9))
                                             (list-ref nx 2)
                                             (= (cadr (list-ref nx 1))
                                                (if (and q1 (string=? (car q1) "K") (string=? (list-ref q1 3) "define")) 1 0))
                                             (= (caddr (list-ref nx 1))
                                                (if (and q1 (string=? (car q1) "P") q2 (string=? (car q2) "K")
                                                         (string=? (list-ref q2 3) "define"))
                                                    1 0))))))
                         (if (not keep)
                             (begin
                               (let ((ef (if (and *pi-defer*
                                       ;; same name under the cursor: a new one
                                       ;; re-marks other rows (settled frame only)
                                       (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                              (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46)))
                                         (if (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))
                                             (string=? *lc-name* (pad:lc-name-at le col2))
                                             (string=? *lc-name* ""))))
                                   ;; early frame: row l exact, rows below as
                                   ;; cached (their start state is stale for
                                   ;; ~2 ms); the exact frame follows at once
                                   (let* ((oname *lc-name*)
                                          (str (list-ref le 1))
                                          (k (string-length str))
                                          (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                         (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                                    (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                                    (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                          (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                          (n (length ws))
                                          (erows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref le 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")
                                                               (drop ws (+ l 1)))))
                                          (ebody (apply string-append erows))
                                          (fr (if *w2-on*
                                                  ;; v2: row l only; C still holds *lc-rowv*'s
                                                  ;; row l, so the next frame resends it
                                                  (let ((f (pad:w2-frame l col2 (list l) (list->vector erows) ebody)))
                                                    (set! *w2-plus* l)
                                                    f)
                                                  (string-append
                                                    "SNAP v1 pad\n"
                                                    "TITLE " *pl-title* " keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                                                    " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                                                    "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col2) "\n"
                                                    "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                                                    "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                                                    "DIRTY lines=" (number->string l) "\n"
                                                    "ROWS n=" (number->string n) "\n"
                                                    ebody
                                                    "END\n"))))
                                     (set! *pi-early* (+ *pi-early* 1))
                                     (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (string-append "EARLY\n" fr) *pi-out*)) (display fr))
                                     (list erows ebody))
                                   #f)))
                                 (if (and ef *pi-pending* (*pi-pending*))
                                     ;; a key is waiting: skip the settle
                                     (begin
                                       (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector (car ef)))
                                       (set! *lc-body* (cadr ef))
                                       (set! *pi-skips* (+ *pi-skips* 1))
                                       "go")
                                     (begin
                                       (set! *lc-pre* le)
                                       (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)))))
                             (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                    (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46))
                                    (name (if (not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77)))
                                              ""
                                              (let pi-nm2 ((ts (list-ref le 2)) (cc col2))
                                                (if (null? ts)
                                                    ""
                                                    (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                                                      (if (and (member kd *pi-symk*) (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                                                          (list-ref t 3)
                                                          (pi-nm2 (cdr ts) cc)))))))
                                    (oname *lc-name*)
                                    (str (list-ref le 1))
                                    (k (string-length str))
                                    (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                   (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                              (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                              (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                    (row (string-append "T " str "\nH " tp "\nM " mrow "\n"))
                                    (n (length rs))
                                    (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                    (nopen (+ *lc-nopen* (if (list-ref le 4) 1 0) (if (list-ref oe 4) -1 0)))
                                    (rows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l))) (cons row (drop ws (+ l 1))))))
                               (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector
                                                 (append (reverse (drop (reverse rs) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (list le (cons oname (cdr (list-ref old 1))) mrow p1 p2 #f)
                                                               below))))
                               (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
                               (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
                               (set! *lc-nopen* nopen)
                               (set! *lc-full* (if (> nopen 0) 1 0))
                               (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                               (set! *lc-L* L2)
                               (set! *lc-cur* l)
                               (set! *lc-framed* 1)
                               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                               (set! *pi-rows* (+ *pi-rows* 1))
                               (if (string=? name oname)
                                   (list l)
                                   (let ((dm (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
                                     (set! *lc-name* name)
                                     dm)))))))))
              ;; mode changes are not editor commands. Movement and inserts
              ;; fall through and use the same paths as the modeless map.
              ((and *vi-on* (string? c)
                    (or (string=? c "to-insert") (string=? c "to-normal")
                        (string=? c "append") (string=? c "normal-key")))
               (pad:vi-meta! c))
              (fast (if (equal? (pad:play-cmd! c) "quit") "quit" "snap"))
              (in (if *vi-on* (pad:vi-bytes! line) (pad:pi-bytes! line)))
              (#t

;; aura-pad -- one Soft entry per protocol line for play.aura.
;; Needs keys.aura, card.aura and who.aura (play.aura loads them first).
;;
;; c/pad_play forwards every read() of key bytes as ONE line,
;; "IN b1 b2 ... bn" (still raw bytes, never interpreted in C). An arrow
;; key is one line "IN 27 91 68" instead of three. Soft takes the line in
;; pad:play-step!, which does the dispatch, runs the command, and writes
;; the frame itself. A cursor move is one Soft call per key and a typed
;; char or backspace inside a row two (pad:play-step!, pad:lc-scan; three
;; when a string opens or closes: + pad:lc-line!), instead of the old
;; chain (play-line! wrapper -> keys.aura play-line! -> key-step ->
;; kv-get per keymap entry -> play-cmd! -> play-snap -> lc-line! ->
;; lc-scan, and three lines per arrow key).
;; Every closure call costs ~0.26 ms on Soft tip c69e644 with the pad
;; loaded (aura#4350), so the chain alone was ~1.5 ms per line and 2.5 ms
;; for backspace.
;;
;; The hot cases are table lookups made with builtins:
;; - one byte, idle escape state: the idle-state result of pad:key-step
;;   for that byte, memoized on first use in *pi-kb* / *pi-kc* (a table
;;   for all 256 bytes built at load cost ~1 s of pad startup);
;; - a whole escape sequence on one line ("IN 27 91 68"): *pi-seq-lines*.
;; Anything else (an escape split over lines, as the smoke streams send
;; it, several keys in one read, byte 15) goes through pad:pi-bytes!,
;; which feeds each byte through the same steps the old path used and
;; writes one frame per accepted command, as before. So every frame is
;; the frame the old path wrote (checked by gap_test.aura).
;; No named let captures an outer local here (aura#4353).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; Idle key-step memo: bytes seen (newest first) and their commands; a
;; hit is member + length + list-ref (builtins), a miss runs pad:key-step
;; once (what the old path ran for every byte) and remembers it.
(define *pi-kb* (list))
(define *pi-kc* (list))
(define *pi-kn* 0)
(define (pad:pi-key-miss! b)
  (let ((c (car (pad:key-step (list) b))))
    (set! *pi-kb* (cons b *pi-kb*))
    (set! *pi-kc* (cons c *pi-kc*))
    (set! *pi-kn* (+ *pi-kn* 1))
    c))

;; "IN 27 91 X" / "IN 27 79 X" for every arrow X -> its command word.
(define (pad:pi-seq-lines xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let ((x (number->string (car (car xs)))))
        (cons (string-append "IN 27 91 " x)
              (cons (string-append "IN 27 79 " x) (pad:pi-seq-lines (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:pi-seq-cmds xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (cons (cadr (car xs)) (cons (cadr (car xs)) (pad:pi-seq-cmds (cdr xs))))))
(define *pi-seq-lines* (pad:pi-seq-lines *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-cmds* (pad:pi-seq-cmds *arrows*))
(define *pi-seq-n* (length *pi-seq-lines*))

;; Tests collect frames instead of writing them.
(define *pi-collect* #f)
(define *pi-out* (list))
(define *pi-fast* 0)    ; lines taken by the table fast path
(define *pi-slow* 0)    ; lines taken byte by byte
;; vi.aura (PAD_VI=1, aura-pad's default) turns this on and replaces the
;; three stubs below. Off: this file's keymap path is unchanged.
(define *vi-on* #f)

;; M8: KEY goal:... and M10: IN 15 (ctrl-o) on top of keys.aura's
;; pad:play-line!. Same contract as keys.aura (returns "ok", "pending",
;; "quit" or a reason; the caller writes the frame). A new name, not a
;; redefinition: in a loaded file, "(define base f) (define (f ..))"
;; makes base run the NEW f on Soft tip c69e644 (inline it works), so the
;; old wrapper moved here looped forever on QUIT (aura#4354).
(define (pad:pi-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string=? line "IN 15") (null? *pl-esc*))
      (pad:who-key!)
      (if (and (string? line) (string-prefix? line "KEY ")
               (>= (string-length line) 9)
               (string=? (substring line 4 9) "goal:"))
          (let ((r (pad:card-goal! (substring line 4 (string-length line)))))
            (if (car r)
                (pad:play-ok! (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                (begin
                  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
                  (set! *pl-say* (car (cdr (cdr r))))
                  (car (cdr r)))))
          (pad:play-line! line))))

;; Byte list of "IN b1 b2 ..." or #f when a field is not a byte.
(define (pad:pi-parse line)
  (let pi-walk ((s line) (k (string-length line)) (i 3) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i k)
        (if (null? acc) #f (reverse acc))
        (let* ((sp (string-index s " " i))
               (j (if (< sp 0) k sp))
               (v (string->number (substring s i j))))
          (if (and (number? v) (>= v 0) (< v 256))
              (pi-walk s k (+ j 1) (cons v acc))
              #f)))))

;; Byte by byte, exactly what one "IN b" line per byte did before: ctrl-o
;; (15, idle) asks who wrote the row, every other byte goes through
;; pad:key-step and pad:play-cmd!. One frame per accepted or rejected
;; command; a pending escape byte writes nothing. Returns "quit" or "go".
(define (pad:pi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (let pi-each ((xs bs))
          (if (null? xs)
              "go"
              (let* ((b (car xs))
                     (r (if (and (= b 15) (null? *pl-esc*))
                            (pad:who-key!)
                            (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
                              (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
                              (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                                  "pending"
                                  (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
                (cond
                  ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
                  ((string=? r "pending") (pi-each (cdr xs)))
                  (#t
                   (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*)) (display (pad:play-snap)))
                   (pi-each (cdr xs))))))))))

;; Stubs. vi.aura redefines these when the editor is modal. Uncalled
;; while *vi-on* is false, which is every smoke that does not set PAD_VI.
(define (pad:vi-cmd b) "unknown")
(define (pad:vi-meta! c) "snap")
(define (pad:vi-bytes! line) (pad:pi-bytes! line))

;; A typed char or backspace changed row l only (L2 = new lines, ln2 = new
;; row codes, col2 = new column). This is pad:lc-line!'s common case
;; written out with builtins, so a key costs two Soft calls (play-step!
;; and pad:lc-scan): re-lex row l from the first token that can change
;; (font-lock-extend-region: tokens ending before col2 - 1 are kept, the
;; same cut lc-line! makes), then, when the row's end state (inside a
;; string?) and the def-carry it hands to row l+1 equal what row l+1's
;; cached record was built with, no other row can change
;; (jit-lock-context stops at once), so only row l is spliced in. Any
;; other case -- more than three tokens to drop, no cached mark row, the
;; end state or carry changed (a string opened or closed) -- goes to
;; pad:lc-line! with the entry already scanned (*lc-pre*), so the frame
;; is the one lc-line! builds either way. Written inline in
;; pad:play-step! (a Soft call costs ~0.23 ms). Yields the dirty rows.
;; An edit at the end of the row (most typing) does not call pad:lc-scan
;; at all: the last token grows, shrinks, is dropped or a new one-char
;; token is added, built from the cached entry with builtins (~0.5 ms
;; less per key). A quote, a comment start, a string token at the end or
;; an open row still scans. gap_test.aura (GAP3_EOL_ENTRY) checks every
;; such entry against a full scan of the row.
(define *pi-symk* (list "S" "K" "Q" "M"))
(define *pi-rows* 0)    ; keys spliced here (row l only)
(define *pi-fe* 0)      ; of those, entries built without pad:lc-scan
;; Early frame (PAD_DEFER=1, docs/perf-aura.md): when a key changes the
;; start state of the rows below (a string opened or closed), first write
;; a frame with row l exact and the rows below as cached (DIRTY = l), then
;; the exact frame, which is byte for byte the frame written without
;; deferral (its DIRTY = rows changed + cursor row, the same set relative
;; to the early frame). jit-lock-defer style: the key's own row shows at
;; once, the rows below follow ~2 ms later. Done on the main thread: a
;; fiber cannot run this while the loop waits in read-line (aura#4356).
(define *pi-defer* #f)
(define *pi-early* 0)   ; early frames written
;; Settle skip (Aura-native path, off until Aura has a stdin poll,
;; aura#4358): *pi-pending* is #f or a thunk that says a key is already
;; waiting. Then the early frame is the key's only frame: the cached rows
;; take the early frame's rows (what the screen shows), *lc-L* stays
;; behind, and the next key takes the play-cmd! + play-snap path, which
;; re-matches the rows and dirties every row that differs from the
;; screen. play.aura sets it when primitive:describe finds a poll
;; primitive (pad:pi-cap-poll), or from PAD_TEST_PENDING=k (every k-th
;; early frame, smoke only).
(define *pi-pending* #f)
(define *pi-skips* 0)   ; settles skipped because a key was waiting
(define *pi-tp-k* 0)
(define *pi-tp-n* 0)
(define (pad:pi-test-pending)
  (set! *pi-tp-n* (+ *pi-tp-n* 1))
  (= 0 (modulo *pi-tp-n* *pi-tp-k*)))
;; Name of a stdin poll primitive on this Aura, or "" (none on c69e644).
(define (pad:pi-cap-poll)
  (if (pair? (primitive:describe "char-ready?")) "char-ready?" ""))
;; One protocol line: dispatch, run, write the frame. Returns "quit" or
;; "go". One Soft entry per key on the hot paths: when the lc cache is in
;; step with the state (*lc-L* is the current lines object), a cursor
;; move on the row that keeps the name under the cursor (left, right,
;; home, end) and a typed char or a backspace inside a row are done here
;; inline -- the same state change as pad:play-cmd! and the same frame as
;; pad:play-snap (try_cursor_movement, or pad:lc-line! for the edited
;; row, which needs no try_window_id check because only row l changed).
;; Everything else calls pad:play-cmd! + pad:play-snap as before.
(define (pad:play-step! line)
  (let* ((n0 (string-length line))
         (in (and (> n0 3) (string=? (substring line 0 3) "IN ")))
         (idle (null? *pl-esc*))
         (b (and in idle (string->number (substring line 3 n0))))
         (c (cond
              ((not (and in idle)) #f)
              ((number? b) (if (and (>= b 0) (< b 256) (not (= b 15)))
                               (if *vi-on*
                                   (pad:vi-cmd b)
                                   (let ((t (member b *pi-kb*)))
                                     (if t (list-ref *pi-kc* (- *pi-kn* (length t))) (pad:pi-key-miss! b))))
                               #f))
              (#t (let ((t (member line *pi-seq-lines*)))
                    (if t (list-ref *pi-seq-cmds* (- *pi-seq-n* (length t))) #f)))))
         (fast (and c (not (equal? c "pending"))))
         (st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (sync (and fast (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (if sync (list-ref L l) (list)))
         (len (length ln))
         (mv (cond
               ((not sync) -1)
               ((number? c) -1)
               ((string=? c "left") (if (> col 0) (- col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "right") (if (< col len) (+ col 1) -1))
               ((string=? c "home") 0)
               ((string=? c "end") len)
               (#t -1)))
         ;; the HL tape letter at the new column says whether a name is
         ;; there at all (S K Q M); only then walk the row's tokens (a
         ;; named-let entry costs ~0.1-0.25 ms on Soft tip c69e644)
         (tape (if (< mv 0) "" (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 3)))
         (tc (if (< mv (string-length tape)) (string-ref tape mv) 46))
         (name (cond
                 ((< mv 0) #f)
                 ((not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))) "")
                 (#t
                   (let pi-nm ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)) (cc mv))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (pi-nm (cdr ts) cc))))))))
         (cur (and name (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (ins (and sync (number? c) (>= c 32) (<= c 126) (< len *max-col*)))
         (del (and sync (not ins) (string? c) (string=? c "back") (> col 0)))
         (r (cond
              (cur
               (set! *pl-st* (list L l mv (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
               (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
               (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
               (set! *lc-cur* l)
               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
               (list l))
              ((or ins del)
               (let* ((n (length L))
                      (ln2 (if ins
                               (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                                       (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col))))
                               (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                                       (drop ln col))))
                      (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                                  (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                      (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                      (un (length U))
                      (col2 (if ins (+ col 1) (- col 1))))
                 (set! *pl-st*
                       (list L2 l col2 (list-ref st 3) (list)
                             (cond
                               ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                               ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                               (#t U))))
                 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
                 (let* ((old (vector-ref *lc-recv* l))
                        (oe (car old))
                        (p (if (> col2 0) (- col2 1) 0))
                        (xs (list-ref oe 8))
                        (t1 (if (pair? xs) (car xs) #f))
                        (x1 (and t1 (>= (caddr t1) p)))
                        (t2 (if (and x1 (pair? (cdr xs))) (cadr xs) #f))
                        (x2 (and t2 (>= (caddr t2) p)))
                        (t3 (if (and x2 (pair? (cddr xs))) (caddr xs) #f))
                        (x3 (and t3 (>= (caddr t3) p)))
                        (t4 (if (and x3 (pair? (cdddr xs))) (list-ref xs 3) #f))
                        (x4 (and t4 (>= (caddr t4) p))))
                   (if (or x4 (not (list-ref old 2)))
                       (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)
                       (let* ((fe (and (= col len) (not (list-ref oe 4)) (< len *lc-run-max*)
                                       ;; end-of-row edit (most typing): the
                                       ;; entry pad:lc-scan would return, built
                                       ;; from the cached one; #f = scan
                                       (let* ((s2 (list->string ln2))
                                              (tp0 (list-ref oe 3))
                                              (sy0 (list-ref oe 7))
                                              (k1 (if t1 (car t1) ""))
                                              (nm1 (and t1 (member k1 *pi-symk*)))
                                              (at-end (and t1 (= (caddr t1) len)))
                                              (n2 (if ins (+ len 1) (- len 1)))
                                              (k (if ins (vector-ref *lc-cls* c) 0))
                                              (pc (if (and ins (> len 0)) (string-ref s2 (- len 1)) 32))
                                              (pk (if (< pc 128) (vector-ref *lc-cls* pc) 0))
                                              ;; how the last token changes:
                                              ;; 1 grows/shrinks, 2 dropped,
                                              ;; 3 new token, 0 no token, -1 scan
                                              (how (cond
                                                     ((not ins)
                                                      (cond ((not at-end) 0)
                                                            ((string=? k1 "T") -1)
                                                            ((= (cadr t1) n2) 2)
                                                            (#t 1)))
                                                     ((and at-end (or (string=? k1 "C")
                                                                      (and (string=? k1 "N") (= k 2))
                                                                      (and nm1 (or (= k 2) (= k 3)))))
                                                      1)
                                                     ((or (= k 0) (= k 1)) 0)
                                                     ((or (= k 2) (= k 3) (= k 4)) 3)
                                                     (#t -1)))
                                              (a (cond ((= how 1) (cadr t1)) ((= how 3) len) (#t 0)))
                                              (txt (if (or (= how 1) (= how 3)) (substring s2 a n2) ""))
                                              (w (- n2 a))
                                              (kd (cond
                                                    ((= how 1) (if (or (string=? k1 "C") (string=? k1 "N")) k1 ""))
                                                    ((= how 3) (cond ((= k 4) "P")
                                                                     ((and (= k 2) (or (= len 0) (= pk 1) (= pk 4))) "N")
                                                                     (#t "")))
                                                    (#t "")))
                                              (kd2 (cond
                                                     ((not (string=? kd "")) kd)
                                                     ((not (or (= how 1) (= how 3))) "")
                                                     ((and (>= w 6) (string=? (substring txt 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
                                                     ((and (>= w 7) (string=? (substring txt 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
                                                     ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
                                                     (#t "S")))
                                              (nm2 (member kd2 *pi-symk*))
                                              (rt (cond
                                                    ((= how 0) xs)
                                                    ((= how 2) (cdr xs))
                                                    ((= how 1) (cons (list kd2 a n2 txt) (cdr xs)))
                                                    (#t (cons (list kd2 a n2 txt) xs))))
                                              (tape (cond
                                                      ((= how 0) (if ins (string-append tp0 ".") (substring tp0 0 n2)))
                                                      ((= how 2) (substring tp0 0 n2))
                                                      (#t (string-append
                                                            (substring tp0 0 a)
                                                            (substring (cond
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "S") *lc-run-S*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "K") *lc-run-K*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "N") *lc-run-N*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "P") *lc-run-P*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "C") *lc-run-C*)
                                                                         ((string=? kd2 "Q") *lc-run-Q*)
                                                                         (#t *lc-run-M*))
                                                                       0 w)))))
                                              (sy (cond
                                                    ((= how 0) sy0)
                                                    ((= how 2) (if nm1 (cdr sy0) sy0))
                                                    ((= how 1) (if nm2 (cons txt (cdr sy0)) sy0))
                                                    (#t (if nm2 (cons txt sy0) sy0)))))
                                         (if (< how 0)
                                             #f
                                             (list ln2 s2 (reverse rt) tape #f
                                                   (if (pair? rt) (car rt) #f)
                                                   (if (and (pair? rt) (pair? (cdr rt))) (cadr rt) #f)
                                                   sy rt (list-ref oe 9))))))
                              (le (if fe
                                      (begin (set! *pi-fe* (+ *pi-fe* 1)) fe)
                                      (let* ((acc0 (cond (x3 (cdddr xs)) (x2 (cddr xs)) (x1 (cdr xs)) (#t xs)))
                                             (mr (+ (if (and x1 (member (car t1) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)
                                                    (if (and x2 (member (car t2) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)
                                                    (if (and x3 (member (car t3) *pi-symk*)) 1 0)))
                                             (r (if (pair? acc0) (caddr (car acc0)) 0)))
                                        (pad:lc-scan (list->string ln2) ln2 r acc0
                                                     (if (> r 0) (list (substring (list-ref oe 3) 0 r)) (list))
                                                     (drop (list-ref oe 7) mr)
                                                     (list-ref oe 9)))))
                              (h0 (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1)))
                              (a (list-ref le 5))
                              (b (list-ref le 6))
                              (p1 (list-ref old 3))
                              (p2 (list-ref old 4))
                              (q1 (if a a p1))
                              (q2 (cond ((not a) p2) ((not b) p1) (#t b)))
                              (rs (vector->list *lc-recv*))
                              (below (drop rs (+ l 1)))
                              (nx (if (pair? below) (car below) #f))
                              (keep (or (not nx)
                                        (and (eq? (list-ref le 4) (list-ref (car nx) 9))
                                             (list-ref nx 2)
                                             (= (cadr (list-ref nx 1))
                                                (if (and q1 (string=? (car q1) "K") (string=? (list-ref q1 3) "define")) 1 0))
                                             (= (caddr (list-ref nx 1))
                                                (if (and q1 (string=? (car q1) "P") q2 (string=? (car q2) "K")
                                                         (string=? (list-ref q2 3) "define"))
                                                    1 0))))))
                         (if (not keep)
                             (begin
                               (let ((ef (if (and *pi-defer*
                                       ;; same name under the cursor: a new one
                                       ;; re-marks other rows (settled frame only)
                                       (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                              (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46)))
                                         (if (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77))
                                             (string=? *lc-name* (pad:lc-name-at le col2))
                                             (string=? *lc-name* ""))))
                                   ;; early frame: row l exact, rows below as
                                   ;; cached (their start state is stale for
                                   ;; ~2 ms); the exact frame follows at once
                                   (let* ((oname *lc-name*)
                                          (str (list-ref le 1))
                                          (k (string-length str))
                                          (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                         (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                                    (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                                    (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                          (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                          (n (length ws))
                                          (erows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref le 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")
                                                               (drop ws (+ l 1)))))
                                          (ebody (apply string-append erows))
                                          (fr (if *w2-on*
                                                  ;; v2: row l only; C still holds *lc-rowv*'s
                                                  ;; row l, so the next frame resends it
                                                  (let ((f (pad:w2-frame l col2 (list l) (list->vector erows) ebody)))
                                                    (set! *w2-plus* l)
                                                    f)
                                                  (string-append
                                                    "SNAP v1 pad\n"
                                                    "TITLE " *pl-title* " keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
                                                    " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
                                                    "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col2) "\n"
                                                    "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
                                                    "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
                                                    "DIRTY lines=" (number->string l) "\n"
                                                    "ROWS n=" (number->string n) "\n"
                                                    ebody
                                                    "END\n"))))
                                     (set! *pi-early* (+ *pi-early* 1))
                                     (if *pi-collect* (set! *pi-out* (cons (string-append "EARLY\n" fr) *pi-out*)) (display fr))
                                     (list erows ebody))
                                   #f)))
                                 (if (and ef *pi-pending* (*pi-pending*))
                                     ;; a key is waiting: skip the settle
                                     (begin
                                       (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector (car ef)))
                                       (set! *lc-body* (cadr ef))
                                       (set! *pi-skips* (+ *pi-skips* 1))
                                       "go")
                                     (begin
                                       (set! *lc-pre* le)
                                       (pad:lc-line! L2 l col2)))))
                             (let* ((tp (list-ref le 3))
                                    (tc (if (< col2 (string-length tp)) (string-ref tp col2) 46))
                                    (name (if (not (or (= tc 83) (= tc 75) (= tc 81) (= tc 77)))
                                              ""
                                              (let pi-nm2 ((ts (list-ref le 2)) (cc col2))
                                                (if (null? ts)
                                                    ""
                                                    (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                                                      (if (and (member kd *pi-symk*) (>= cc (cadr t)) (< cc (caddr t)))
                                                          (list-ref t 3)
                                                          (pi-nm2 (cdr ts) cc)))))))
                                    (oname *lc-name*)
                                    (str (list-ref le 1))
                                    (k (string-length str))
                                    (mrow (if (and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                                                   (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                              (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                              (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                    (row (string-append "T " str "\nH " tp "\nM " mrow "\n"))
                                    (n (length rs))
                                    (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
                                    (nopen (+ *lc-nopen* (if (list-ref le 4) 1 0) (if (list-ref oe 4) -1 0)))
                                    (rows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) (- n l))) (cons row (drop ws (+ l 1))))))
                               (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector
                                                 (append (reverse (drop (reverse rs) (- n l)))
                                                         (cons (list le (cons oname (cdr (list-ref old 1))) mrow p1 p2 #f)
                                                               below))))
                               (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
                               (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
                               (set! *lc-nopen* nopen)
                               (set! *lc-full* (if (> nopen 0) 1 0))
                               (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                               (set! *lc-L* L2)
                               (set! *lc-cur* l)
                               (set! *lc-framed* 1)
                               (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                               (set! *pi-rows* (+ *pi-rows* 1))
                               (if (string=? name oname)
                                   (list l)
                                   (let ((dm (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
                                     (set! *lc-name* name)
                                     dm)))))))))
              ;; mode changes are not editor commands. Movement and inserts
              ;; fall through and use the same paths as the modeless map.
              ((and *vi-on* (string? c)
                    (or (string=? c "to-insert") (string=? c "to-normal")
                        (string=? c "append") (string=? c "normal-key")))
               (pad:vi-meta! c))
              (fast (if (equal? (pad:play-cmd! c) "quit") "quit" "snap"))
              (in (if *vi-on* (pad:vi-bytes! line) (pad:pi-bytes! line)))
              (#t
               (let ((r1 (pad:pi-line! line)))
                 (cond
                   ((string=? r1 "quit") "quit")
                   ((string=? r1 "pending") "go")
                   (#t "snap")))))))
    (cond
      ((list? r)
       (set! *pi-fast* (+ *pi-fast* 1))
       (let* ((st2 *pl-st*)
              (fr (cond
                    ;; wire v2, one DIRTY row: inlined (see pad:play-snap)
                    ((and *w2-on* (not *w2-full*) (< *w2-plus* 0) (pair? r) (null? (cdr r)))
