;; aura-pad -- show a window of the buffer, not a cut-off page.
;; The C viewport asks for a size (PAD_ROWS / PAD_COLS at start, then
;; "WIN rows cols" when the terminal changes). A frame that already
;; fits is returned unchanged, so a short page stays byte for byte.
;; A taller or wider buffer is sliced around the cursor. SNAP v2 is a
;; delta on the whole buffer, so it is never sliced. Wire v2 stays
;; full-buffer too. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;; No while+set! inside a define (aura#4372). No string-split.

(define *vw-rows* 200)
(define *vw-cols* 400)
(define *vw-top* 0)
(define *vw-left* 0)

(define (pad:vw-cap n hi lo)
  (cond ((> n hi) hi) ((< n lo) lo) (#t n)))

(define (pad:vw-num s)
  (if (and (string? s) (string->number s)) (string->number s) 0))

(define (pad:vw-boot!)
  (let ((r (pad:vw-num (getenv "PAD_ROWS")))
        (c (pad:vw-num (getenv "PAD_COLS"))))
    (if (> r 2) (set! *vw-rows* (pad:vw-cap r 240 1)) 0)
    (if (> c 8) (set! *vw-cols* (pad:vw-cap c 400 1)) 0)
    0))

(define (pad:vw-win! line)
  (let ((sp1 (string-index line " " 0)))
    (if (< sp1 0)
        "go"
        (let ((sp2 (string-index line " " (+ sp1 1))))
          (if (< sp2 0)
              "go"
              (let ((r (string->number (substring line (+ sp1 1) sp2)))
                    (c (string->number (substring line (+ sp2 1) (string-length line)))))
                (if (and (number? r) (> r 2)) (set! *vw-rows* (pad:vw-cap r 240 1)) 0)
                (if (and (number? c) (> c 8)) (set! *vw-cols* (pad:vw-cap c 400 1)) 0)
                (pad:play-emit!)
                "go"))))))

;; Width of the text on a cached "T ...\nH ...\nM ...\n" row.
(define (pad:vw-pay row)
  (let ((nl (string-index row "\n" 0)))
    (if (< nl 2) 0 (- nl 2))))

(define (pad:vw-row-wide i n cols)
  (if (>= i n)
      #f
      (if (> (pad:vw-pay (vector-ref *lc-rowv* i)) cols)
          #t
          (pad:vw-row-wide (+ i 1) n cols))))

(define (pad:vw-fits? n col rows cols)
  (and (<= n rows) (< col cols) (not (pad:vw-row-wide 0 n cols))))

;; Keep the window when the cursor is still inside it. Otherwise move
;; just enough that the cursor is on the last cell of the window.
(define (pad:vw-scroll cur top span)
  (cond
    ((< cur 0) 0)
    ((and (>= cur top) (< cur (+ top span))) top)
    ((< cur top) cur)
    (#t (+ (- cur span) 1))))

(define (pad:vw-clamp t span total)
  (let ((m (if (> total span) (- total span) 0)))
    (cond ((< t 0) 0) ((> t m) m) (#t t))))

(define (pad:vw-cut line left cols)
  (let ((n (string-length line)))
    (if (< n 2)
        line
        (let* ((pay (- n 2))
               (a (if (> left pay) pay left))
               (b0 (+ a cols))
               (b (if (> b0 pay) pay b0)))
          (string-append (substring line 0 2)
                         (substring line (+ 2 a) (+ 2 b)))))))

(define (pad:vw-slice-row row left cols)
  (let ((a (string-index row "\n" 0)))
    (if (< a 0)
        row
        (let ((b (string-index row "\n" (+ a 1))))
          (if (< b 0)
              row
              (let ((c (string-index row "\n" (+ b 1))))
                (if (< c 0)
                    row
                    (string-append
                      (pad:vw-cut (substring row 0 a) left cols) "\n"
                      (pad:vw-cut (substring row (+ a 1) b) left cols) "\n"
                      (pad:vw-cut (substring row (+ b 1) c) left cols) "\n"))))))))

(define (pad:vw-body i end left cols)
  (if (>= i end)
      ""
      (string-append (pad:vw-slice-row (vector-ref *lc-rowv* i) left cols)
                     (pad:vw-body (+ i 1) end left cols))))

(define (pad:vw-build n l col rows cols)
  (let ((top (pad:vw-clamp (pad:vw-scroll l *vw-top* rows) rows n))
        (left0 (pad:vw-scroll col *vw-left* cols)))
    (let ((left (if (or (< left0 0) (> left0 col)) (if (< col 0) 0 col) left0))
          (end0 (+ top rows)))
      (let ((end (if (> end0 n) n end0)))
        (set! *vw-top* top)
        (set! *vw-left* left)
        (string-append
          "SNAP v1 pad\n"
          "TITLE " *pl-title* " keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
          " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)
          " " (number->string (+ l 1)) "/" (number->string n) "\n"
          "CURSOR line=" (number->string (- l top))
          " col=" (number->string (- col left)) "\n"
          "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
          "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
          (if (or (> top 0) (> left 0))
              (string-append "ORIGIN line=" (number->string top)
                             " col=" (number->string left) "\n")
              "")
          "ROWS n=" (number->string (- end top)) "\n"
          (pad:vw-body top end left cols)
          "END\n")))))

(define (pad:vw-maybe s)
  (let* ((n (vector-length *lc-rowv*))
         (rows (pad:vw-rows-now))
         (cols (pad:vw-cols-now))
         (l (cadr *pl-st*))
         (col (caddr *pl-st*)))
    (if (or (<= n 0) (pad:vw-fits? n col rows cols))
        (begin (set! *vw-top* 0) (set! *vw-left* 0) s)
        (pad:vw-build n l col rows cols))))

(define (pad:vw-rows-now) (pad:vw-cap *vw-rows* 240 1))
(define (pad:vw-cols-now) (pad:vw-cap *vw-cols* 400 1))

;; Replaces the identity in keys.aura.
(define (pad:vw-frame s)
  (if (or *w2-on* (not (string? s)) (< (string-length s) 7)
          (not (string=? (substring s 0 7) "SNAP v1")))
      s
      (pad:vw-maybe s)))

          (not (string=? (substring s 0 7) "SNAP v1")))
      s

          (pad:wn-snap)
          (pad:vw-maybe s))))

              (string-append "ORIGIN line=" (number->string top)

              "")
          "ROWS n=" (number->string (- end top)) "\n"
          (pad:vw-body top end left cols)

(define (pad:vw-maybe s)
  (let* ((n (vector-length *lc-rowv*))
         (rows (pad:vw-rows-now))
         (cols (pad:vw-cols-now))
         (l (cadr *pl-st*))
         (col (caddr *pl-st*)))
    (if (or (<= n 0) (pad:vw-fits? n col rows cols))
        (begin (set! *vw-top* 0) (set! *vw-left* 0) s)
        (pad:vw-build n l col rows cols))))

(define (pad:vw-rows-now) (pad:vw-cap *vw-rows* 240 1))
(define (pad:vw-cols-now) (pad:vw-cap *vw-cols* 400 1))

;; win.aura replaces these. One window keeps the frame this file built.
(define (pad:wn-many?) #f)
(define (pad:wn-snap) "")

;; Replaces the identity in keys.aura.
(define (pad:vw-frame s)
  (if (or *w2-on* (not (string? s)) (< (string-length s) 7)
          (not (string=? (substring s 0 7) "SNAP v1")))
      s
      (if (pad:wn-many?)
          (pad:wn-snap)
          (pad:vw-maybe s))))

input.source:
;; M3.5 unit-ish Soft tests for the finer editor commands (edit.aura).
;; Every new command: a REJECT path (kid reason, state untouched) and a
;; success path. Then a plan table shared with scripts/edit_model.py
;; (fixtures/m35/expect.json), view/SCORE helpers, M3 compatibility.
;; Prints T lines and ends PAD_TEST_OK. No HTTP, no fibers, no hot slots.
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/buffer.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/rules.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/lines.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/helper.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/edit.aura")

(define *fail* 0)
(define *checks* 0)

(define (expect tag got want)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (display "T ")
  (display tag)
  (display "=")
  (display (pad:nstr got))
  (if (and (number? got) (= got want))
      (display " OK")
      (begin
        (display " WANT=")
        (display (pad:nstr want))
        (set! *fail* (+ *fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  got)

(define (expect-str tag got want)
  (set! *checks* (+ *checks* 1))
  (display "T ")
  (display tag)
  (display "=")
  (display got)
  (if (and (string? got) (string=? got want))
      (display " OK")
      (begin
        (display " WANT=")
        (display want)
        (set! *fail* (+ *fail* 1))))
  (newline)
  got)

;; State view, or the gate reason when the op was refused.
(define (sv r) (if (string? r) r (pad:es-view r)))

;; Run one op. A refused op must return the reason, and the plan player
;; must skip it: same state out, one reject counted, no key spent.
(define (op! tag c st want)
  (let ((r (pad:eop c st)))
    (if (string? r)
        (let ((p (pad:eplay-from st (list c))))
          (expect-str (string-append tag "_SAME") (pad:es-view (car p)) (pad:es-view st))
          (expect (string-append tag "_KEYS") (pad:nth p 1) 0)
          (expect (string-append tag "_REJ") (pad:nth p 2) 1)))
    (expect-str tag (sv r) want)
    r))

(define (codes s) (map char->integer (string->list s)))

(define *s0* (pad:estart))
;; "hi" / "  au", point at end of line 1.
(define *s2* (pad:es-at (list (codes "hi") (codes "  au")) 1 4))

(define (gate-tests!)
  ;; undo
  (op! "UNDO_EMPTY" "undo" *s0* "nothing-to-undo")
  (let ((a (pad:eop "indent" *s2*)))
    (expect-str "UNDO_PUSH" (sv a) "hi|....au@1,6 kill=none mark=none undo=1")
    (op! "UNDO_OK" "undo" a "hi|..au@1,4 kill=none mark=none undo=0"))
  ;; yank
  (op! "YANK_EMPTY" "yank" *s2* "nothing-to-yank")
  (let ((k (pad:es (pad:es-L *s2*) 0 1 (list (codes "aaaaaaaaaaa")) (list) (list))))
    (op! "YANK_FULL" "yank" k "need-space"))
  (let ((k (pad:es (pad:es-L *s2*) 1 4 (list (codes "i") (codes "  a")) (list) (list))))
    (op! "YANK_MULTI" "yank" k "hi|..aui|..a@2,3 kill=i|..a mark=none undo=1"))
  ;; indent / dedent
  (op! "INDENT" "indent" *s2* "hi|....au@1,6 kill=none mark=none undo=1")
  (op! "INDENT_FULL" "indent"
       (pad:es-at (list (codes "abcdefghijk")) 0 0) "need-space")
  (op! "DEDENT" "dedent" *s2* "hi|au@1,2 kill=none mark=none undo=1")
  (op! "DEDENT_COL0" "dedent" (pad:es-move *s2* 1 1) "hi|au@1,0 kill=none mark=none undo=1")
  (op! "DEDENT_NONE" "dedent" (pad:es-move *s2* 0 1) "no-indent")
  ;; bob / eob
  (op! "BOB" "bob" *s2* "hi|..au@0,0 kill=none mark=none undo=0")
  (op! "BOB_THERE" "bob" (pad:es-move *s2* 0 0) "already-there")
  (op! "EOB" "eob" (pad:es-move *s2* 0 1) "hi|..au@1,4 kill=none mark=none undo=0")
  (op! "EOB_THERE" "eob" *s2* "already-there")
  ;; mark + region
  (let ((m (pad:eop "set-mark" (pad:es-move *s2* 0 1))))
    (expect-str "MARK" (sv m) "hi|..au@0,1 kill=none mark=0,1 undo=0")
    (op! "MARK_THERE" "set-mark" m "already-there")
    (op! "KILL_REGION_EMPTY" "kill-region" m "empty-region")
    (op! "COPY_REGION_EMPTY" "copy-region" m "empty-region")
    (op! "KILL_REGION" "kill-region" (pad:es-move m 1 3)
         "hu@0,1 kill=i|..a mark=none undo=1")
    (op! "COPY_REGION" "copy-region" (pad:es-move m 1 3)
         "hi|..au@1,3 kill=i|..a mark=none undo=0")
    ;; point before mark: same region, point lands at the start
    (let ((m2 (pad:eop "set-mark" *s2*)))
      (op! "KILL_REGION_BACK" "kill-region" (pad:es-move m2 1 1)
           "hi|.@1,1 kill=.au mark=none undo=1"))
    ;; an edit clears the mark
    (expect-str "MARK_CLEARED" (sv (pad:eop "kill-region" (pad:eop 120 (pad:es-move m 1 4))))
                "no-mark"))
  (op! "KILL_REGION_NOMARK" "kill-region" *s2* "no-mark")
  (op! "COPY_REGION_NOMARK" "copy-region" *s2* "no-mark")
  ;; kill-line now fills the kill ring
  (op! "KILL_LINE_RING" "kill-line" (pad:es-move *s2* 1 1)
       "hi|.@1,1 kill=.au mark=none undo=1")
  (op! "KILL_LINE_NL" "kill-line" (pad:es-move *s2* 0 2)
       "hi..au@0,2 kill=| mark=none undo=1")
  ;; M3 commands still gate the M3 way
  (op! "M3_LEFT" "left" *s0* "too-far")
  (op! "M3_BAD" "jump" *s0* "not-a-key")
  (op! "M3_PRINT" 72 *s0* "not-print")
  (op! "M3_NEXT" "next-line" *s2* "no-line")
  0)

(define *plans*
  (list
        (list "undo_empty" (list "undo")

              "abcdefgnwn@0,10 kill=abcdefgnwn mark=none undo=8" 1)
        (list "indent" (list "indent")
              "..nwn@0,2 kill=none mark=none undo=1" 0)
        (list "indent_full" (list "type:abcdefghi" "indent" "indent")
              "abcdefghinwn@0,9 kill=none mark=none undo=8" 2)
        (list "dedent" (list "indent" "dedent")
              "nwn@0,0 kill=none mark=none undo=2" 0)

              "|||nwn@1,0 kill=| mark=none undo=5" 2)

              "nwn@0,0 kill=none mark=none undo=0" 1)

              "hinwn@0,2 kill=none mark=none undo=2" 1)))

(define (plan-tests!)
  (let loop ((xs *plans*) (n 0))
    (if (null? xs)
        (expect "PLAN_COUNT" n (length *plans*))
        (let* ((row (car xs))
               (name (pad:nth row 0))
               (r (pad:eplay-from *s0* (pad:nth row 1))))
          (expect-str (string-append "PLAN_" name) (pad:es-view (car r)) (pad:nth row 2))
          (expect (string-append "PLAN_" name "_REJ") (pad:nth r 2) (pad:nth row 3))
          (loop (cdr xs) (+ n 1))))))

(define *fx* "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/fixtures/m35/")

(define (fixture-plan name)
  (let* ((body (pd:clean (read-file (string-append *fx* name))))
         (sc (set-code (string-append "(define pd:m35-probe " body ")\n"))))
    (eval-current)
    (pd:m35-probe)))

(define (view-tests!)
  (expect-str "DOT_TEXT" (pad:dot-text (pad:es-L *s2*)) "hi|..au")
  (expect-str "CARET" (pad:caret-text (pad:es-L *s2*) 1 2) "hi|..^au")
  (expect-str "CARET_HOME" (pad:caret-text (pad:es-L *s2*) 0 0) "^hi|..au")
  (expect-str "SAY_UNDO" (pad:kid-say "nothing-to-undo") "nothing to take back yet")
  (expect-str "SAY_MARK" (pad:kid-say "no-mark") "set a mark first")
  (expect-str "SAY_UNKNOWN" (pad:kid-say "zzz") "the gate said no")
  (let loop ((rs (list "too-far" "no-line" "empty-buf" "need-space" "not-print"
                       "not-a-key" "nothing-to-undo" "nothing-to-yank"
                       "already-there" "no-mark" "empty-region" "no-indent"))
             (n 0))
    (if (null? rs)
        (expect "SAY_KNOWN" n 12)
        (loop (cdr rs)
              (if (string=? (pad:kid-say (car rs)) "the gate said no") n (+ n 1)))))
  (expect "SCORE_LINE" (pad:score-line! 60 15 0 0 45) 45)
  (pad:ereject! 1 "undo" "nothing-to-undo" "test")
  ;; goal3 fixture scores straight from esim (model: start dist 14; 28 11 43 43 45)
  (expect "GOAL3_START" (pad:dist-lines (pad:start-lines) *goal3*) 14)
  (expect "FX_MAIN" (pad:escore-plan (fixture-plan "main.lambda")) 28)
  (expect "FX_WORSE" (pad:escore-plan (fixture-plan "worse.lambda")) 11)
  (expect "FX_UNDO" (pad:escore-plan (fixture-plan "undo.lambda")) 43)
  (expect "FX_REGION" (pad:escore-plan (fixture-plan "region.lambda")) 43)
  (expect "FX_BEST" (pad:escore-plan (fixture-plan "best.lambda")) 45)
  (expect-str "FX_UGLY" (pad:plan-check (fixture-plan "ugly.lambda")) "bad-token")
  (expect "FX_NOT_PLAN" (pad:escore-plan "undo") -999)
  ;; M3 scoring unchanged (main 27, better 31)
  (expect "M3_MAIN" (pad:score-plan (list "kill-line" "type:hi" "open-line" "next-line" "type:au")) 27)
  (expect "M3_BETTER" (pad:score-plan (list "kill-line" "type:hi" "open-line" "next-line" "type:aura")) 31)
  ;; estamp writes the M3.5 world and prints TAPE + SCORE
  (expect "STAMP" (pad:estamp! (fixture-plan "best.lambda") "test") 45)

  0)

  (gate-tests!)
  (plan-tests!)
  (view-tests!)

  (display (number->string *checks*))
  (display " fail=")
  (display (number->string *fail*))

  (if (= *fail* 0)
      (display "PAD_TEST_OK\n")
      (display "PAD_TEST_FAIL\n")))

(main)

input.source:
;; aura-pad M0 -- Soft FlatAST text buffer (char-code list), point, Soft gate.
;; No C viewport. Goal fixture is the char codes for "hi aura".
;; Commands pass the gate before apply. Rejected commands never mutate.
;; Soft reserved: never bind the identifier quote; use qf / mid / tag.

(define *steps* 24)
(define *seed* 20261005)
(define *max-gentle* 8)
(define *max-bold* 20)

;; Goal: "hi aura"
(define *goal* (list 104 105 32 97 117 114 97))

;; Main-world buffer state. Only the stamp writes it.
(define *buf* (list))
(define *point* 0)
(define *edits* 0)
(define *rejects* 0)
(define *dist* 0)
(define *score* 0)
(define *slot-tag* "none")
(define *steps-done* 0)

(define (pad:dialect)
  "live-soft-editor-pad-m0")

(define (pad:nstr n)
  (if (< n 0)
      (string-append "-" (number->string (- 0 n)))
      (number->string n)))

(define (pad:abs n) (if (< n 0) (- 0 n) n))

(define (pad:seed-step seed)
  (modulo (+ (* seed 75) 74) 65537))

(define (pad:key-op k) (modulo k 6))
(define (pad:key-arg k) (quotient k 6))

;; List helpers (FlatAST-friendly char-code vectors as lists).
(define (pad:take n xs)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs))
      (list)
      (cons (car xs) (pad:take (- n 1) (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:drop n xs)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs))
      xs
      (pad:drop (- n 1) (cdr xs))))

(define (pad:insert buf point ch)
  (append (pad:take point buf) (cons ch (pad:drop point buf))))

(define (pad:delete-back buf point)
  (append (pad:take (- point 1) buf) (pad:drop point buf)))

;; Distance to goal: length gap + positional mismatches.
(define (pad:dist buf goal)
  (let loop ((a buf) (b goal) (d 0))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) d)
      ((null? a) (+ d (length b)))
      ((null? b) (+ d (length a)))
      ((= (car a) (car b)) (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) d))
      (#t (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ d 1))))))

(define (pad:score-of edits rejects dist)
  (- edits (+ (* 2 rejects) dist)))

;; Soft gate. Returns "ok" or a kid-friendly reason.
;; map 1 = gentle, map 2 = bold.
;; op: 0 left, 1 right, 2 insert-letter, 3 delete-back, 4 insert-space, 5 home/end.
(define (pad:gate map op arg buf point)
  (let ((len (length buf))
        (mx (if (= map 1) *max-gentle* *max-bold*)))
    (cond
      ((and (= op 0) (= point 0) (= map 1)) "too-far")
      ((and (= op 1) (>= point len) (= map 1)) "too-far")
      ((and (= op 3) (= point 0)) "empty-line")
      ((and (= op 2) (>= len mx)) "need-space")
      ((and (= op 4) (>= len mx)) "need-space")
      ((and (= op 2) (= map 1) (> (modulo arg 30) 25)) "not-print")
      (#t "ok"))))

(define (pad:reject! step mid reason tag)
  (display "REJECT mid=")
  (display (number->string mid))
  (display " reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  0)

(define (pad:tape! step buf point tag)
  (display "TAPE step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " len=")
  (display (number->string (length buf)))
  (display " point=")
  (display (number->string point))
  (display " dist=")
  (display (number->string (pad:dist buf *goal*)))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  0)

;; Apply one accepted command. Returns (buf point).
;; Bold clamps moves; gentle already gated too-far.
(define (pad:apply map op arg buf point)
  (let ((len (length buf)))
    (cond
      ((= op 0)
       (let ((step (if (= map 1) 1 3)))
         (let ((np (- point step)))
           (list buf (if (< np 0) 0 np)))))
      ((= op 1)
       (let ((step (if (= map 1) 1 3)))
         (let ((np (+ point step)))
           (list buf (if (> np len) len np)))))
      ((= op 2)
       (let ((ch (+ 97 (modulo arg 26))))
         (list (pad:insert buf point ch) (+ point 1))))
      ((= op 3)
       (list (pad:delete-back buf point) (- point 1)))
      ((= op 4)
       (list (pad:insert buf point 32) (+ point 1)))
      ((= op 5)
       ;; gentle: end; bold: home
       (if (= map 1)
           (list buf len)
           (list buf 0)))
      (#t (list buf point)))))

;; Pure play of one keymap against the seeded key sequence.
;; print=0 silent score, print=1 REJECT audit, print=2 TAPE stamp.
;; Returns (score edits rejects dist buf point).
(define (pad:sim map mid tag print)
  (let loop ((i 0)
             (r (pad:seed-step *seed*))
             (buf (list))
             (pt 0)
             (edits 0)
             (rejs 0))
    (if (>= i *steps*)
        (let ((d (pad:dist buf *goal*)))
          (list (pad:score-of edits rejs d) edits rejs d buf pt))
        (let* ((op (pad:key-op r))
               (arg (pad:key-arg r))
               (reason (pad:gate map op arg buf pt)))
          (if (string=? reason "ok")
              (let* ((st (pad:apply map op arg buf pt))
                     (buf1 (car st))
                     (pt1 (car (cdr st))))
                (if (and (= print 2) (= (modulo (+ i 1) 8) 0))
                    (pad:tape! (+ i 1) buf1 pt1 tag))
                (loop (+ i 1)
                      (pad:seed-step r)
                      buf1
                      pt1
                      (+ edits 1)
                      rejs))
              (begin
                (if (and (= print 1) (< rejs 3))
                    (pad:reject! (+ i 1) mid reason tag))
                (loop (+ i 1)
                      (pad:seed-step r)
                      buf
                      pt
                      edits
                      (+ rejs 1))))))))

(define (pad:r-score s) (car s))
(define (pad:r-edits s) (car (cdr s)))
(define (pad:r-rejects s) (car (cdr (cdr s))))
(define (pad:r-dist s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))
(define (pad:r-buf s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))
(define (pad:r-point s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))))

;; Score only. No set! of world slots -- fiber-safe.
(define (pad:score map mid)
  (pad:r-score (pad:sim map mid "race" 0)))

(define (pad:audit-run map mid tag)
  (pad:sim map mid tag 1))

(define (pad:stamp! map mid tag)
  (let ((s (pad:sim map mid tag 2)))
    (set! *slot-tag* tag)
    (set! *buf* (pad:r-buf s))
    (set! *point* (pad:r-point s))
    (set! *edits* (pad:r-edits s))
    (set! *rejects* (pad:r-rejects s))
    (set! *dist* (pad:r-dist s))
    (set! *score* (pad:r-score s))
    (set! *steps-done* *steps*)
    (pad:r-score s)))

    (cond
      ((<= n 0) (list))
      ((>= n k) xs)
      (#t (reverse (list-tail (reverse xs) (- k n)))))))

;; aura-pad M0 -- Soft FlatAST text buffer (char-code list), point, Soft gate.
;; No C viewport. Goal fixture is the char codes for "hi aura".
;; Commands pass the gate before apply. Rejected commands never mutate.
;; Soft reserved: never bind the identifier quote; use qf / mid / tag.

(define *steps* 24)
(define *seed* 20261005)
(define *max-gentle* 8)
(define *max-bold* 20)

;; Goal: "hi aura"
(define *goal* (list 104 105 32 97 117 114 97))

;; Main-world buffer state. Only the stamp writes it.
(define *buf* (list))
(define *point* 0)
(define *edits* 0)
(define *rejects* 0)
(define *dist* 0)
(define *score* 0)
(define *slot-tag* "none")
(define *steps-done* 0)

(define (pad:dialect)
  "live-soft-editor-pad-m0")

(define (pad:nstr n)
  (if (< n 0)
      (string-append "-" (number->string (- 0 n)))
      (number->string n)))

(define (pad:abs n) (if (< n 0) (- 0 n) n))

(define (pad:seed-step seed)
  (modulo (+ (* seed 75) 74) 65537))

(define (pad:key-op k) (modulo k 6))
(define (pad:key-arg k) (quotient k 6))

;; List helpers (FlatAST-friendly char-code vectors as lists).
(define (pad:take n xs)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs))
      (list)
      (cons (car xs) (pad:take (- n 1) (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:drop n xs)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs))
      xs
      (pad:drop (- n 1) (cdr xs))))

(define (pad:insert buf point ch)
  (append (pad:take point buf) (cons ch (pad:drop point buf))))

(define (pad:delete-back buf point)
  (append (pad:take (- point 1) buf) (pad:drop point buf)))

;; Distance to goal: length gap + positional mismatches.
(define (pad:dist buf goal)
  (let loop ((a buf) (b goal) (d 0))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) d)
      ((null? a) (+ d (length b)))
      ((null? b) (+ d (length a)))
      ((= (car a) (car b)) (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) d))
      (#t (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ d 1))))))

(define (pad:score-of edits rejects dist)
  (- edits (+ (* 2 rejects) dist)))

;; Soft gate. Returns "ok" or a kid-friendly reason.
;; map 1 = gentle, map 2 = bold.
;; op: 0 left, 1 right, 2 insert-letter, 3 delete-back, 4 insert-space, 5 home/end.
(define (pad:gate map op arg buf point)
  (let ((len (length buf))
        (mx (if (= map 1) *max-gentle* *max-bold*)))
    (cond
      ((and (= op 0) (= point 0) (= map 1)) "too-far")
      ((and (= op 1) (>= point len) (= map 1)) "too-far")
      ((and (= op 3) (= point 0)) "empty-line")
      ((and (= op 2) (>= len mx)) "need-space")
      ((and (= op 4) (>= len mx)) "need-space")
      ((and (= op 2) (= map 1) (> (modulo arg 30) 25)) "not-print")
      (#t "ok"))))

(define (pad:reject! step mid reason tag)
  (display "REJECT mid=")
  (display (number->string mid))
  (display " reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  0)

(define (pad:tape! step buf point tag)
  (display "TAPE step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " len=")
  (display (number->string (length buf)))
  (display " point=")
  (display (number->string point))
  (display " dist=")
  (display (number->string (pad:dist buf *goal*)))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  0)

;; Apply one accepted command. Returns (buf point).
;; Bold clamps moves; gentle already gated too-far.
(define (pad:apply map op arg buf point)
  (let ((len (length buf)))
    (cond
      ((= op 0)
       (let ((step (if (= map 1) 1 3)))
         (let ((np (- point step)))
           (list buf (if (< np 0) 0 np)))))
      ((= op 1)
       (let ((step (if (= map 1) 1 3)))
         (let ((np (+ point step)))
           (list buf (if (> np len) len np)))))
      ((= op 2)
       (let ((ch (+ 97 (modulo arg 26))))
         (list (pad:insert buf point ch) (+ point 1))))
      ((= op 3)
       (list (pad:delete-back buf point) (- point 1)))
      ((= op 4)
       (list (pad:insert buf point 32) (+ point 1)))
      ((= op 5)
       ;; gentle: end; bold: home
       (if (= map 1)
           (list buf len)
           (list buf 0)))
      (#t (list buf point)))))

;; Pure play of one keymap against the seeded key sequence.
;; print=0 silent score, print=1 REJECT audit, print=2 TAPE stamp.
;; Returns (score edits rejects dist buf point).
(define (pad:sim map mid tag print)
  (let loop ((i 0)
             (r (pad:seed-step *seed*))
             (buf (list))
             (pt 0)
             (edits 0)
             (rejs 0))
    (if (>= i *steps*)
        (let ((d (pad:dist buf *goal*)))
          (list (pad:score-of edits rejs d) edits rejs d buf pt))
        (let* ((op (pad:key-op r))
               (arg (pad:key-arg r))
               (reason (pad:gate map op arg buf pt)))
          (if (string=? reason "ok")
              (let* ((st (pad:apply map op arg buf pt))
                     (buf1 (car st))
                     (pt1 (car (cdr st))))
                (if (and (= print 2) (= (modulo (+ i 1) 8) 0))
                    (pad:tape! (+ i 1) buf1 pt1 tag))
                (loop (+ i 1)
                      (pad:seed-step r)
                      buf1
                      pt1
                      (+ edits 1)
                      rejs))
              (begin
                (if (and (= print 1) (< rejs 3))
                    (pad:reject! (+ i 1) mid reason tag))
                (loop (+ i 1)
                      (pad:seed-step r)
                      buf
                      pt
                      edits
                      (+ rejs 1))))))))

(define (pad:r-score s) (car s))
(define (pad:r-edits s) (car (cdr s)))
(define (pad:r-rejects s) (car (cdr (cdr s))))
(define (pad:r-dist s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))
(define (pad:r-buf s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))
(define (pad:r-point s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))))

;; Score only. No set! of world slots -- fiber-safe.
(define (pad:score map mid)
  (pad:r-score (pad:sim map mid "race" 0)))

(define (pad:audit-run map mid tag)
  (pad:sim map mid tag 1))

(define (pad:stamp! map mid tag)
  (let ((s (pad:sim map mid tag 2)))
    (set! *slot-tag* tag)
    (set! *buf* (pad:r-buf s))
    (set! *point* (pad:r-point s))
    (set! *edits* (pad:r-edits s))
    (set! *rejects* (pad:r-rejects s))
    (set! *dist* (pad:r-dist s))
    (set! *score* (pad:r-score s))
    (set! *steps-done* *steps*)
    (pad:r-score s)))

target.body:
(lambda (n xs) (let ((k (length xs)))
    (cond
      ((<= n 0) xs)
      ((>= n k) (list))
      (#t (list-tail xs n)))))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11f -- sandbox worlds for AI tries.
;; The helper brings up to *world-max* ideas for one goal. Each idea runs
;; in its own child workspace (workspace :create / :switch): the child
;; starts as a copy of the root program, the idea goes in as one typed
;; transaction (typed-mutate-atomic, like M11a), and the kid's goal
;; checks run there. The kid's page and the root program never change
;; while the helper tries. Only an idea that passes strictly more checks
;; than the page does now comes back, and it comes back as an M11a KEEP
;; in root (mutate:rebind of the winning defines, pad:robot-step!): one
;; ctrl-z, who stamps, a time-machine step. workspace :merge is never
;; used: it concatenates source and leaves duplicate defines.
;;
;; Checks against the engine:
;; - per idea, the defines that differ between the root code and the
;;   child's query:code (Soft split of both canonical programs, as in
;;   time.aura) must be exactly the idea's names, and
;;   workspace:conflicts-with must list every one of them (it also lists
;;   unchanged dependents, so it is a superset check);
;; - root query:code and the page object are unchanged after the tries;
;; - after the KEEP, root query:code equals the winner's child code and
;;   the goal score in root equals the winner's score.
;; A mismatch prints M11_WORLD_DISAGREE.
;;
;; A child's rebind changes the shared top-level bindings, and after a
;; child eval-current root's own eval-current does not put root's back
;; (aura#4368). So after every idea: workspace :switch 0, then
;; ast:restore of the root snapshot + one eval-current. Children are not
;; removed: workspace:discard only resets a child to root's state (its
;; documented meaning), and workspace:delete can leave root holding a
;; binding into the freed child (aura#4369: SIGSEGV / hang).
;; Goal: ((label thunk want) ...); a check passes when (thunk) is equal?
;; to want; a thunk that raises fails. Workspace ids start at 0 and 0 is
;; false in Soft, so ids are tested with number?.
;; Loaded after robot.aura and time.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *world-max* 3)
(define *world-last* #f)    ; (base tries winner verdict root-same)
(define *world-races* 0)
(define *world-kept* 0)
(define *world-disagree* 0)
(define *world-children* 0)

(define (pad:world-pass? chk)
  (let ((got (try ((cadr chk)) (catch (e) "world-raised"))))
    (equal? got (caddr chk))))
(define (pad:world-score goal)
  (cond
    ((null? goal) 0)
    ((pad:world-pass? (car goal)) (+ 1 (pad:world-score (cdr goal))))
    (#t (pad:world-score (cdr goal)))))

(define (pad:world-subset? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:world-subset? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; Back to root, root bindings back (aura#4368).
(define (pad:world-home! snap)
  (try (workspace :switch 0) (catch (e) #f))
  (pad:robot-heal! snap))

;; One idea in its own world. Returns
;; (k status score eng-names conflicts child-code why ops)
;; status: "tried" | "gate" (Soft gate said no) | "refused" | "no-world".
(define (pad:world-run1 k who why ops goal code0 snap)
  (let ((g (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? g "ok"))
        (list k "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
        (let ((c (try (workspace :create (string-append "try-" (number->string k))) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (number? c))
              (list k "no-world" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
              (begin
                (set! *world-children* (+ *world-children* 1))
                (try (workspace :switch c) (catch (e) #f))
                (pad:ew-set! who)
                (let* ((r (try (typed-mutate-atomic (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)) (catch (e) #f)))
                       (fp (pad:ew-set! "kid"))
                       (score (if (eq? r #t) (pad:world-score goal) -1))
                       (code (pad:q-code))
                       (eng (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code) (pad:time-defs code0)
                                                 (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code0) (pad:time-defs code) (list)))))
                  (pad:world-home! snap)
                  (let ((cf (try (workspace:conflicts-with c) (catch (e) (list)))))
                    (list k (if (eq? r #t) "tried" "refused") score eng (if (list? cf) cf (list))
                          code why ops)))))))))

(define (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap k)
  (if (or (null? tries) (> k *world-max*))
      (list)
      (cons (pad:world-run1 k who (car (car tries)) (cadr (car tries)) goal code0 snap)
            (pad:world-run-all who (cdr tries) goal code0 snap (+ k 1)))))

;; Engine check of one tried idea: (names-ok conflicts-ok).
(define (pad:world-idea-ok? t)
  (or (not (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried"))
      (let ((names (pad:robot-names (pad:nth t 7))))
        (and (pad:time-same-set? (pad:nth t 3) names)
             (pad:world-subset? names (pad:nth t 4))))))
(define (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts)
  (cond ((null? ts) #t) ((pad:world-idea-ok? (car ts)) (pad:world-ideas-ok? (cdr ts))) (#t #f)))

;; Best tried idea with a score strictly above base (first one on a tie).
(define (pad:world-best ts base best)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) best)
    ((and (string=? (pad:nth (car ts) 1) "tried")
          (> (pad:nth (car ts) 2) (if best (pad:nth best 2) base)))
     (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base (car ts)))
    (#t (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base best))))

(define (pad:world-n-of n m)
  (string-append (number->string n) " of " (number->string m)))

;; Race the helper's ideas. tries: ((why ops) ...). Returns (tag say verdict)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:world-race! who tries goal)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *world-races* (+ *world-races* 1))
  (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (code0 (pad:q-code))
         (snap (ast:snapshot "world"))
         (base (pad:world-score goal))
         (ts (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap 1))
         (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
         (ideas-ok (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts))
         (win (pad:world-best ts base #f))
         (n (length goal))
         (k (pad:world-keep! who win)))

;; aura-pad M11f -- sandbox worlds for AI tries.
;; The helper brings up to *world-max* ideas for one goal. Each idea runs
;; in its own child workspace (workspace :create / :switch): the child
;; starts as a copy of the root program, the idea goes in as one typed
;; transaction (typed-mutate-atomic, like M11a), and the kid's goal
;; checks run there. The kid's page and the root program never change
;; while the helper tries. Only an idea that passes strictly more checks
;; than the page does now comes back, and it comes back as an M11a KEEP
;; in root (mutate:rebind of the winning defines, pad:robot-step!): one
;; ctrl-z, who stamps, a time-machine step. workspace :merge is never
;; used: it concatenates source and leaves duplicate defines.
;;
;; Checks against the engine:
;; - per idea, the defines that differ between the root code and the
;;   child's query:code (Soft split of both canonical programs, as in
;;   time.aura) must be exactly the idea's names, and
;;   workspace:conflicts-with must list every one of them (it also lists
;;   unchanged dependents, so it is a superset check);
;; - root query:code and the page object are unchanged after the tries;
;; - after the KEEP, root query:code equals the winner's child code and
;;   the goal score in root equals the winner's score.
;; A mismatch prints M11_WORLD_DISAGREE.
;;
;; A child's rebind changes the shared top-level bindings, and after a
;; child eval-current root's own eval-current does not put root's back
;; (aura#4368). So after every idea: workspace :switch 0, then
;; ast:restore of the root snapshot + one eval-current. Children are not
;; removed: workspace:discard only resets a child to root's state (its
;; documented meaning), and workspace:delete can leave root holding a
;; binding into the freed child (aura#4369: SIGSEGV / hang).
;; Goal: ((label thunk want) ...); a check passes when (thunk) is equal?
;; to want; a thunk that raises fails. Workspace ids start at 0 and 0 is
;; false in Soft, so ids are tested with number?.
;; Loaded after robot.aura and time.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *world-max* 3)
(define *world-last* #f)    ; (base tries winner verdict root-same)
(define *world-races* 0)
(define *world-kept* 0)
(define *world-disagree* 0)
(define *world-children* 0)

(define (pad:world-pass? chk)
  (let ((got (try ((cadr chk)) (catch (e) "world-raised"))))
    (equal? got (caddr chk))))
(define (pad:world-score goal)
  (cond
    ((null? goal) 0)
    ((pad:world-pass? (car goal)) (+ 1 (pad:world-score (cdr goal))))
    (#t (pad:world-score (cdr goal)))))

(define (pad:world-subset? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:world-subset? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; Back to root, root bindings back (aura#4368).
(define (pad:world-home! snap)
  (try (workspace :switch 0) (catch (e) #f))
  (pad:robot-heal! snap))

;; One idea in its own world. Returns
;; (k status score eng-names conflicts child-code why ops)
;; status: "tried" | "gate" (Soft gate said no) | "refused" | "no-world".
(define (pad:world-run1 k who why ops goal code0 snap)
  (let ((g (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? g "ok"))
        (list k "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
        (let ((c (try (workspace :create (string-append "try-" (number->string k))) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (number? c))
              (list k "no-world" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
              (begin
                (set! *world-children* (+ *world-children* 1))
                (try (workspace :switch c) (catch (e) #f))
                (pad:ew-set! who)
                (let* ((r (try (typed-mutate-atomic (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)) (catch (e) #f)))
                       (fp (pad:ew-set! "kid"))
                       (score (if (eq? r #t) (pad:world-score goal) -1))
                       (code (pad:q-code))
                       (eng (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code) (pad:time-defs code0)
                                                 (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code0) (pad:time-defs code) (list)))))
                  (pad:world-home! snap)
                  (let ((cf (try (workspace:conflicts-with c) (catch (e) (list)))))
                    (list k (if (eq? r #t) "tried" "refused") score eng (if (list? cf) cf (list))
                          code why ops)))))))))

(define (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap k)
  (if (or (null? tries) (> k *world-max*))
      (list)
      (cons (pad:world-run1 k who (car (car tries)) (cadr (car tries)) goal code0 snap)
            (pad:world-run-all who (cdr tries) goal code0 snap (+ k 1)))))

;; Engine check of one tried idea: (names-ok conflicts-ok).
(define (pad:world-idea-ok? t)
  (or (not (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried"))
      (let ((names (pad:robot-names (pad:nth t 7))))
        (and (pad:time-same-set? (pad:nth t 3) names)
             (pad:world-subset? names (pad:nth t 4))))))
(define (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts)
  (cond ((null? ts) #t) ((pad:world-idea-ok? (car ts)) (pad:world-ideas-ok? (cdr ts))) (#t #f)))

;; Best tried idea with a score strictly above base (first one on a tie).
(define (pad:world-best ts base best)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) best)
    ((and (string=? (pad:nth (car ts) 1) "tried")
          (> (pad:nth (car ts) 2) (if best (pad:nth best 2) base)))
     (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base (car ts)))
    (#t (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base best))))

(define (pad:world-n-of n m)
  (string-append (number->string n) " of " (number->string m)))

;; Race the helper's ideas. tries: ((why ops) ...). Returns (tag say verdict)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:world-race! who tries goal)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *world-races* (+ *world-races* 1))
  (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (code0 (pad:q-code))
         (snap (ast:snapshot "world"))
         (base (pad:world-score goal))
         (ts (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap 1))
         (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
         (ideas-ok (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts))
         (win (pad:world-best ts base #f))
         (n (length goal))
         (k (pad:world-keep! who win)))
    (let* ((keep-ok (or (not win)
                        (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP")
                             (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth win 5))
                             (= (pad:world-score goal) (pad:nth win 2)))))
           (v (if (and same ideas-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
           (say (cond
                  ((not win)
                   (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                  " ideas in its own worlds, none did better than your page ("
                                  (pad:world-n-of base n) " checks), nothing changed"))
                  ((not (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (pad:nth k 2))
                  (#t (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                     " ideas in its own worlds: idea " (number->string (car win))
                                     " passes " (pad:world-n-of (pad:nth win 2) n)
                                     " checks (your page " (pad:world-n-of base n)
                                     "), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back")))))
      (set! *world-last* (list base ts win v same))
      (if (string=? v "disagree")
          (begin
            (set! *world-disagree* (+ *world-disagree* 1))
            (newline) (display "M11_WORLD_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:world-line *world-last*)) (newline))
          #f)
      (set! *pl-say* say)
      (list (if win "WIN" "NOWIN") say v))))

;; KEEP the winner in root through the M11a path.
(define (pad:world-keep! who win)
  (if (not win)
      (list "NONE" "" "")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-step! who (pad:nth win 7) (pad:nth win 6))))
        (if (string=? (car r) "KEEP") (set! *world-kept* (+ *world-kept* 1)) #f)
        r)))

;; WORLD base=1 ideas=1:tried:2:hello/hello.bye,2:refused:-1,3:gate:-1 win=1 same=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:world-idea-str t)
  (string-append (number->string (car t)) ":" (pad:nth t 1) ":" (number->string (pad:nth t 2))
                 (if (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried")
                     (string-append ":" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 3)) "/" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 4)))
                     "")))
(define (pad:world-ideas-str ts)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) "")
    ((null? (cdr ts)) (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)) "," (pad:world-ideas-str (cdr ts))))))
(define (pad:world-line x)
  (string-append "WORLD base=" (number->string (car x))
                 " ideas=" (pad:world-ideas-str (cadr x))
                 " win=" (if (caddr x) (number->string (car (caddr x))) "none")
                 " same=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth x 3)))

(define (pad:world-stats-str)
  (string-append "races=" (number->string *world-races*)
                 " kept=" (number->string *world-kept*)
                 " children=" (number->string *world-children*)
                 " wdisagree=" (number->string *world-disagree*)))

;; aura-pad M11f -- sandbox worlds for AI tries.
;; The helper brings up to *world-max* ideas for one goal. Each idea runs
;; in its own child workspace (workspace :create / :switch): the child
;; starts as a copy of the root program, the idea goes in as one typed
;; transaction (typed-mutate-atomic, like M11a), and the kid's goal
;; checks run there. The kid's page and the root program never change
;; while the helper tries. Only an idea that passes strictly more checks
;; than the page does now comes back, and it comes back as an M11a KEEP
;; in root (mutate:rebind of the winning defines, pad:robot-step!): one
;; ctrl-z, who stamps, a time-machine step. workspace :merge is never
;; used: it concatenates source and leaves duplicate defines.
;;
;; Checks against the engine:
;; - per idea, the defines that differ between the root code and the
;;   child's query:code (Soft split of both canonical programs, as in
;;   time.aura) must be exactly the idea's names, and
;;   workspace:conflicts-with must list every one of them (it also lists
;;   unchanged dependents, so it is a superset check);
;; - root query:code and the page object are unchanged after the tries;
;; - after the KEEP, root query:code equals the winner's child code and
;;   the goal score in root equals the winner's score.
;; A mismatch prints M11_WORLD_DISAGREE.
;;
;; A child's rebind changes the shared top-level bindings, and after a
;; child eval-current root's own eval-current does not put root's back
;; (aura#4368). So after every idea: workspace :switch 0, then
;; ast:restore of the root snapshot + one eval-current. Children are not
;; removed: workspace:discard only resets a child to root's state (its
;; documented meaning), and workspace:delete can leave root holding a
;; binding into the freed child (aura#4369: SIGSEGV / hang).
;; Goal: ((label thunk want) ...); a check passes when (thunk) is equal?
;; to want; a thunk that raises fails. Workspace ids start at 0 and 0 is
;; false in Soft, so ids are tested with number?.
;; Loaded after robot.aura and time.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *world-max* 3)
(define *world-last* #f)    ; (base tries winner verdict root-same)
(define *world-races* 0)
(define *world-kept* 0)
(define *world-disagree* 0)
(define *world-children* 0)

(define (pad:world-pass? chk)
  (let ((got (try ((cadr chk)) (catch (e) "world-raised"))))
    (equal? got (caddr chk))))
(define (pad:world-score goal)
  (cond
    ((null? goal) 0)
    ((pad:world-pass? (car goal)) (+ 1 (pad:world-score (cdr goal))))
    (#t (pad:world-score (cdr goal)))))

(define (pad:world-subset? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:world-subset? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; Back to root, root bindings back (aura#4368).
(define (pad:world-home! snap)
  (try (workspace :switch 0) (catch (e) #f))
  (pad:robot-heal! snap))

;; One idea in its own world. Returns
;; (k status score eng-names conflicts child-code why ops)
;; status: "tried" | "gate" (Soft gate said no) | "refused" | "no-world".
(define (pad:world-run1 k who why ops goal code0 snap)
  (let ((g (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? g "ok"))
        (list k "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
        (let ((c (try (workspace :create (string-append "try-" (number->string k))) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (number? c))
              (list k "no-world" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
              (begin
                (set! *world-children* (+ *world-children* 1))
                (try (workspace :switch c) (catch (e) #f))
                (pad:ew-set! who)
                (let* ((r (try (typed-mutate-atomic (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)) (catch (e) #f)))
                       (fp (pad:ew-set! "kid"))
                       (score (if (eq? r #t) (pad:world-score goal) -1))
                       (code (pad:q-code))
                       (eng (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code) (pad:time-defs code0)
                                                 (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code0) (pad:time-defs code) (list)))))
                  (pad:world-home! snap)
                  (let ((cf (try (workspace:conflicts-with c) (catch (e) (list)))))
                    (list k (if (eq? r #t) "tried" "refused") score eng (if (list? cf) cf (list))
                          code why ops)))))))))

(define (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap k)
  (if (or (null? tries) (> k *world-max*))
      (list)
      (cons (pad:world-run1 k who (car (car tries)) (cadr (car tries)) goal code0 snap)
            (pad:world-run-all who (cdr tries) goal code0 snap (+ k 1)))))

;; Engine check of one tried idea: (names-ok conflicts-ok).
(define (pad:world-idea-ok? t)
  (or (not (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried"))
      (let ((names (pad:robot-names (pad:nth t 7))))
        (and (pad:time-same-set? (pad:nth t 3) names)
             (pad:world-subset? names (pad:nth t 4))))))
(define (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts)
  (cond ((null? ts) #t) ((pad:world-idea-ok? (car ts)) (pad:world-ideas-ok? (cdr ts))) (#t #f)))

;; Best tried idea with a score strictly above base (first one on a tie).
(define (pad:world-best ts base best)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) best)
    ((and (string=? (pad:nth (car ts) 1) "tried")
          (> (pad:nth (car ts) 2) (if best (pad:nth best 2) base)))
     (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base (car ts)))
    (#t (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base best))))

(define (pad:world-n-of n m)
  (string-append (number->string n) " of " (number->string m)))

;; Race the helper's ideas. tries: ((why ops) ...). Returns (tag say verdict)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:world-race! who tries goal)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *world-races* (+ *world-races* 1))
  (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (code0 (pad:q-code))
         (snap (ast:snapshot "world"))
         (base (pad:world-score goal))
         (ts (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap 1))
         (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
         (ideas-ok (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts))
         (win (pad:world-best ts base #f))
         (n (length goal))
         (k (pad:world-keep! who win)))
    (let* ((keep-ok (or (not win)
                        (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP")
                             (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth win 5))
                             (= (pad:world-score goal) (pad:nth win 2)))))
           (v (if (and same ideas-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
           (say (cond
                  ((not win)
                   (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                  " ideas in its own worlds, none did better than your page ("
                                  (pad:world-n-of base n) " checks), nothing changed"))
                  ((not (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (pad:nth k 2))
                  (#t (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                     " ideas in its own worlds: idea " (number->string (car win))
                                     " passes " (pad:world-n-of (pad:nth win 2) n)
                                     " checks (your page " (pad:world-n-of base n)
                                     "), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back")))))
      (set! *world-last* (list base ts win v same))
      (if (string=? v "disagree")
          (begin
            (set! *world-disagree* (+ *world-disagree* 1))
            (newline) (display "M11_WORLD_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:world-line *world-last*)) (newline))
          #f)
      (set! *pl-say* say)
      (list (if win "WIN" "NOWIN") say v))))

;; KEEP the winner in root through the M11a path.
(define (pad:world-keep! who win)
  (if (not win)
      (list "NONE" "" "")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-step! who (pad:nth win 7) (pad:nth win 6))))
        (if (string=? (car r) "KEEP") (set! *world-kept* (+ *world-kept* 1)) #f)
        r)))

;; WORLD base=1 ideas=1:tried:2:hello/hello.bye,2:refused:-1,3:gate:-1 win=1 same=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:world-idea-str t)
  (string-append (number->string (car t)) ":" (pad:nth t 1) ":" (number->string (pad:nth t 2))
                 (if (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried")
                     (string-append ":" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 3)) "/" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 4)))
                     "")))
(define (pad:world-ideas-str ts)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) "")
    ((null? (cdr ts)) (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)) "," (pad:world-ideas-str (cdr ts))))))
(define (pad:world-line x)
  (string-append "WORLD base=" (number->string (car x))
                 " ideas=" (pad:world-ideas-str (cadr x))
                 " win=" (if (caddr x) (number->string (car (caddr x))) "none")
                 " same=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth x 3)))

(define (pad:world-stats-str)
  (string-append "races=" (number->string *world-races*)
                 " kept=" (number->string *world-kept*)
                 " children=" (number->string *world-children*)
                 " wdisagree=" (number->string *world-disagree*)))

  (cond ((null? ts) #t) ((pad:world-idea-ok? (car ts)) (pad:world-ideas-ok? (cdr ts))) (#t #f)))

;; Best tried idea with a score strictly above base (first one on a tie).
(define (pad:world-best ts base best)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) best)
    ((and (string=? (pad:nth (car ts) 1) "tried")
          (> (pad:nth (car ts) 2) (if best (pad:nth best 2) base)))
     (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base (car ts)))
    (#t (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base best))))

(define (pad:world-n-of n m)
  (string-append (number->string n) " of " (number->string m)))

;; Race the helper's ideas. tries: ((why ops) ...). Returns (tag say verdict)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:world-race! who tries goal)

  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *world-races* (+ *world-races* 1))
  (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (code0 (pad:q-code))
         (snap (ast:snapshot "world"))
         (base (pad:world-score goal))
         (ts (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap 1))
         (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
         (ideas-ok (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts))
         (win (pad:world-best ts base #f))
         (n (length goal))
         (k (pad:world-keep! who win)))
    (let* ((keep-ok (or (not win)
                        (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP")
                             (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth win 5))
                             (= (pad:world-score goal) (pad:nth win 2)))))
           (v (if (and same ideas-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
           (say (cond
                  ((not win)
                   (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                  " ideas in its own worlds, none did better than your page ("
                                  (pad:world-n-of base n) " checks), nothing changed"))
                  ((not (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (pad:nth k 2))
                  (#t (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                     " ideas in its own worlds: idea " (number->string (car win))
                                     " passes " (pad:world-n-of (pad:nth win 2) n)
                                     " checks (your page " (pad:world-n-of base n)
                                     "), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back")))))
      (set! *world-last* (list base ts win v same))
      (if (string=? v "disagree")
          (begin
            (set! *world-disagree* (+ *world-disagree* 1))
            (newline) (display "M11_WORLD_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:world-line *world-last*)) (newline))
          #f)
      (set! *pl-say* say)
      (list (if win "WIN" "NOWIN") say v))))

;; KEEP the winner in root through the M11a path.
(define (pad:world-keep! who win)
  (if (not win)
      (list "NONE" "" "")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-step! who (pad:nth win 7) (pad:nth win 6))))
        (if (string=? (car r) "KEEP") (set! *world-kept* (+ *world-kept* 1)) #f)
        r)))

;; WORLD base=1 ideas=1:tried:2:hello/hello.bye,2:refused:-1,3:gate:-1 win=1 same=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:world-idea-str t)
  (string-append (number->string (car t)) ":" (pad:nth t 1) ":" (number->string (pad:nth t 2))
                 (if (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried")
                     (string-append ":" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 3)) "/" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 4)))
                     "")))
(define (pad:world-ideas-str ts)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) "")
    ((null? (cdr ts)) (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)) "," (pad:world-ideas-str (cdr ts))))))
(define (pad:world-line x)
  (string-append "WORLD base=" (number->string (car x))
                 " ideas=" (pad:world-ideas-str (cadr x))
                 " win=" (if (caddr x) (number->string (car (caddr x))) "none")
                 " same=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth x 3)))

(define (pad:world-stats-str)
  (string-append "races=" (number->string *world-races*)
                 " kept=" (number->string *world-kept*)
                 " children=" (number->string *world-children*)
                 " wdisagree=" (number->string *world-disagree*)))

;; aura-pad M11f -- sandbox worlds for AI tries.
;; The helper brings up to *world-max* ideas for one goal. Each idea runs
;; in its own child workspace (workspace :create / :switch): the child
;; starts as a copy of the root program, the idea goes in as one typed
;; transaction (typed-mutate-atomic, like M11a), and the kid's goal
;; checks run there. The kid's page and the root program never change
;; while the helper tries. Only an idea that passes strictly more checks
;; than the page does now comes back, and it comes back as an M11a KEEP
;; in root (mutate:rebind of the winning defines, pad:robot-step!): one
;; ctrl-z, who stamps, a time-machine step. workspace :merge is never
;; used: it concatenates source and leaves duplicate defines.
;;
;; Checks against the engine:
;; - per idea, the defines that differ between the root code and the
;;   child's query:code (Soft split of both canonical programs, as in
;;   time.aura) must be exactly the idea's names, and
;;   workspace:conflicts-with must list every one of them (it also lists
;;   unchanged dependents, so it is a superset check);
;; - root query:code and the page object are unchanged after the tries;
;; - after the KEEP, root query:code equals the winner's child code and
;;   the goal score in root equals the winner's score.
;; A mismatch prints M11_WORLD_DISAGREE.
;;
;; A child's rebind changes the shared top-level bindings, and after a
;; child eval-current root's own eval-current does not put root's back
;; (aura#4368). So after every idea: workspace :switch 0, then
;; ast:restore of the root snapshot + one eval-current. Children are not
;; removed: workspace:discard only resets a child to root's state (its
;; documented meaning), and workspace:delete can leave root holding a
;; binding into the freed child (aura#4369: SIGSEGV / hang).
;; Goal: ((label thunk want) ...); a check passes when (thunk) is equal?
;; to want; a thunk that raises fails. Workspace ids start at 0 and 0 is
;; false in Soft, so ids are tested with number?.
;; Loaded after robot.aura and time.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *world-max* 3)
(define *world-last* #f)    ; (base tries winner verdict root-same)
(define *world-races* 0)
(define *world-kept* 0)
(define *world-disagree* 0)
(define *world-children* 0)

(define (pad:world-pass? chk)
  (let ((got (try ((cadr chk)) (catch (e) "world-raised"))))
    (equal? got (caddr chk))))
(define (pad:world-score goal)
  (cond
    ((null? goal) 0)
    ((pad:world-pass? (car goal)) (+ 1 (pad:world-score (cdr goal))))
    (#t (pad:world-score (cdr goal)))))

(define (pad:world-subset? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:world-subset? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; Back to root, root bindings back (aura#4368).
(define (pad:world-home! snap)
  (try (workspace :switch 0) (catch (e) #f))
  (pad:robot-heal! snap))

;; One idea in its own world. Returns
;; (k status score eng-names conflicts child-code why ops)
;; status: "tried" | "gate" (Soft gate said no) | "refused" | "no-world".
(define (pad:world-run1 k who why ops goal code0 snap)
  (let ((g (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? g "ok"))
        (list k "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
        (let ((c (try (workspace :create (string-append "try-" (number->string k))) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (number? c))
              (list k "no-world" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
              (begin
                (set! *world-children* (+ *world-children* 1))
                (try (workspace :switch c) (catch (e) #f))
                (pad:ew-set! who)
                (let* ((r (try (typed-mutate-atomic (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)) (catch (e) #f)))
                       (fp (pad:ew-set! "kid"))
                       (score (if (eq? r #t) (pad:world-score goal) -1))
                       (code (pad:q-code))
                       (eng (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code) (pad:time-defs code0)
                                                 (pad:time-changed-in (pad:time-defs code0) (pad:time-defs code) (list)))))
                  (pad:world-home! snap)
                  (let ((cf (try (workspace:conflicts-with c) (catch (e) (list)))))
                    (list k (if (eq? r #t) "tried" "refused") score eng (if (list? cf) cf (list))
                          code why ops)))))))))

(define (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap k)
  (if (or (null? tries) (> k *world-max*))
      (list)
      (cons (pad:world-run1 k who (car (car tries)) (cadr (car tries)) goal code0 snap)
            (pad:world-run-all who (cdr tries) goal code0 snap (+ k 1)))))

;; Engine check of one tried idea: (names-ok conflicts-ok).
(define (pad:world-idea-ok? t)
  (or (not (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried"))
      (let ((names (pad:robot-names (pad:nth t 7))))
        (and (pad:time-same-set? (pad:nth t 3) names)
             (pad:world-subset? names (pad:nth t 4))))))
(define (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts)
  (cond ((null? ts) #t) ((pad:world-idea-ok? (car ts)) (pad:world-ideas-ok? (cdr ts))) (#t #f)))

;; Best tried idea with a score strictly above base (first one on a tie).
(define (pad:world-best ts base best)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) best)
    ((and (string=? (pad:nth (car ts) 1) "tried")
          (> (pad:nth (car ts) 2) (if best (pad:nth best 2) base)))
     (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base (car ts)))
    (#t (pad:world-best (cdr ts) base best))))

(define (pad:world-n-of n m)
  (string-append (number->string n) " of " (number->string m)))

;; Race the helper's ideas. tries: ((why ops) ...). Returns (tag say verdict)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:world-race! who tries goal)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *world-races* (+ *world-races* 1))
  (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (code0 (pad:q-code))
         (snap (ast:snapshot "world"))
         (base (pad:world-score goal))
         (ts (pad:world-run-all who tries goal code0 snap 1))
         (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
         (ideas-ok (pad:world-ideas-ok? ts))
         (win (pad:world-best ts base #f))
         (n (length goal))
         (k (pad:world-keep! who win)))
    (let* ((keep-ok (or (not win)
                        (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP")
                             (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth win 5))
                             (= (pad:world-score goal) (pad:nth win 2)))))
           (v (if (and same ideas-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
           (say (cond
                  ((not win)
                   (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                  " ideas in its own worlds, none did better than your page ("
                                  (pad:world-n-of base n) " checks), nothing changed"))
                  ((not (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (pad:nth k 2))
                  (#t (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length ts))
                                     " ideas in its own worlds: idea " (number->string (car win))
                                     " passes " (pad:world-n-of (pad:nth win 2) n)
                                     " checks (your page " (pad:world-n-of base n)
                                     "), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back")))))
      (set! *world-last* (list base ts win v same))
      (if (string=? v "disagree")
          (begin
            (set! *world-disagree* (+ *world-disagree* 1))
            (newline) (display "M11_WORLD_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:world-line *world-last*)) (newline))
          #f)
      (set! *pl-say* say)
      (list (if win "WIN" "NOWIN") say v))))

;; KEEP the winner in root through the M11a path.
(define (pad:world-keep! who win)
  (if (not win)
      (list "NONE" "" "")
      (let ((r (pad:robot-step! who (pad:nth win 7) (pad:nth win 6))))
        (if (string=? (car r) "KEEP") (set! *world-kept* (+ *world-kept* 1)) #f)
        r)))

;; WORLD base=1 ideas=1:tried:2:hello/hello.bye,2:refused:-1,3:gate:-1 win=1 same=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:world-idea-str t)
  (string-append (number->string (car t)) ":" (pad:nth t 1) ":" (number->string (pad:nth t 2))
                 (if (string=? (pad:nth t 1) "tried")
                     (string-append ":" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 3)) "/" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth t 4)))
                     "")))
(define (pad:world-ideas-str ts)
  (cond
    ((null? ts) "")
    ((null? (cdr ts)) (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:world-idea-str (car ts)) "," (pad:world-ideas-str (cdr ts))))))
(define (pad:world-line x)
  (string-append "WORLD base=" (number->string (car x))
                 " ideas=" (pad:world-ideas-str (cadr x))
                 " win=" (if (caddr x) (number->string (car (caddr x))) "none")
                 " same=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth x 3)))

(define (pad:world-stats-str)
  (string-append "races=" (number->string *world-races*)
                 " kept=" (number->string *world-kept*)
                 " children=" (number->string *world-children*)
                 " wdisagree=" (number->string *world-disagree*)))

;; aura-pad -- vi normal / insert, evil-style, plus emacs movement.
;; Loaded by play.aura. Off unless PAD_VI=1 (aura-pad sets that; the
;; smokes do not, so the modeless keymap in keys.aura stays put).
;;
;; Normal (the start): h j k l move, i types, a appends, Esc stays.
;; Insert: letters type, Esc returns to normal.
;; Both modes: ctrl-b left, ctrl-f right, ctrl-p up, ctrl-n down,
;; and the arrow keys. ctrl-] jumps back (ctrl-b used to). ctrl-v
;; copies the region (ctrl-p used to). Other ctrl keys are unchanged
;; (ctrl-a / ctrl-e, ctrl-q, ctrl-x, ctrl-o, ...).
;;
;; Esc is byte 27, which is also the start of an arrow. C sends one
;; read() as one "IN b1 b2 ..." line, and a real Esc is a one-byte
;; read, so a lone 27 leaves insert. 27 91 / 27 79 in the SAME line
;; is still an arrow. A split "IN 27" then "IN 91" is Esc, then "[".
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *vi-mode* "normal")
(define *vi-base* "")

(define (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-title*
        (string-append *vi-base*
                       (if (string=? *vi-mode* "insert") " [insert]" " [normal]"))))

;; Call after the file title is set (play.aura). Returns #t when modal.
(define (pad:vi-boot!)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_VI")))
    (if (and (string? v) (string=? v "1"))
        (begin
          (set! *vi-on* #t)
          (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
          (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
          (pad:vi-title!))
        (set! *vi-on* #f))
    *vi-on*))

;; Controls that are not the emacs movement keys, looked up in the
;; modeless map. 2 and 16 are movement here, so they never reach this.
(define (pad:vi-ctrl b)
  (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
    (if w w "unknown")))

;; One idle byte -> a command word, a char code, or a mode word
;; (to-insert / to-normal / append / normal-key).
(define (pad:vi-cmd b)
  (cond
    ((= b 27) "to-normal")
    ((= b 2) "left")
    ((= b 6) "right")
    ((= b 14) "next-line")
    ((= b 16) "prev-line")
    ((= b 29) "jump-back")
    ((= b 22) "copy-region")
    ((string=? *vi-mode* "insert")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) b (pad:vi-ctrl b)))
    ((= b 104) "left")
    ((= b 106) "next-line")
    ((= b 107) "prev-line")
    ((= b 108) "right")
    ((= b 105) "to-insert")
    ((= b 97) "append")
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) "normal-key")
    (#t (pad:vi-ctrl b))))

(define (pad:vi-can-right?)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (len (length (list-ref L l))))
    (not (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)))))

;; Apply a mode word. Returns "snap" (the caller writes one frame).
(define (pad:vi-meta! c)
  (cond
    ((string=? c "to-insert")
     (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "insert - type, esc goes back")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-normal")
     (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "normal - press i to type")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "append")
     (let ((moved (pad:vi-can-right?)))
       (if moved (pad:play-cmd! "right") 0)
       (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
       (pad:vi-title!)
       (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
       (if moved 0 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1)))
       "snap"))
    (#t
     (pad:play-reject! "normal-key")
     "snap")))

(define (pad:vi-emit! r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? r "pending") "pending")
    (#t
     (if *pi-collect*
         (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
         (display (pad:play-snap)))
     "go")))

;; Rest of a multi-byte line. esc is the escape-sequence state, passed
;; in so the loop does not capture an outer local. A trailing lone 27
;; leaves insert; 27 followed by 91 or 79 in this same line is an arrow.
(define (pad:vi-each xs esc)
  (if (null? xs)
      (begin (set! *pl-esc* esc) "go")
      (let ((b (car xs)) (rest (cdr xs)))
        (cond
          ((pair? esc)
           (let* ((step (pad:key-step esc b))
                  (cmd (car step))
                  (esc2 (car (cdr step))))
             (if (and (string? cmd) (string=? cmd "pending"))
                 (pad:vi-each rest esc2)
                 (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:play-cmd! cmd))))
                   (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))
          ((and (= b 27) (pair? rest) (or (= (car rest) 91) (= (car rest) 79)))
           (pad:vi-each rest (list 27)))
          ((and (= b 15) (null? esc))
           (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:who-key!))))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))
          (#t
           (let* ((cmd (pad:vi-cmd b))
                  (r (if (and (string? cmd)
                              (or (string=? cmd "to-insert") (string=? cmd "to-normal")
                                  (string=? cmd "append") (string=? cmd "normal-key")))
                         (pad:vi-meta! cmd)
                         (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
                  (e (pad:vi-emit! r)))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))))

(define (pad:vi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect*
              (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
              (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (pad:vi-each bs *pl-esc*))))

;; aura-pad -- vi normal / insert, evil-style, plus emacs movement.
;; Loaded by play.aura. Off unless PAD_VI=1 (aura-pad sets that; the
;; smokes do not, so the modeless keymap in keys.aura stays put).
;;
;; Normal (the start): h j k l move, i types, a appends, Esc stays.
;; Insert: letters type, Esc returns to normal.
;; Both modes: ctrl-b left, ctrl-f right, ctrl-p up, ctrl-n down,
;; and the arrow keys. ctrl-] jumps back (ctrl-b used to). ctrl-v
;; copies the region (ctrl-p used to). Other ctrl keys are unchanged
;; (ctrl-a / ctrl-e, ctrl-q, ctrl-x, ctrl-o, ...).
;;
;; Esc is byte 27, which is also the start of an arrow. C sends one
;; read() as one "IN b1 b2 ..." line, and a real Esc is a one-byte
;; read, so a lone 27 leaves insert. 27 91 / 27 79 in the SAME line
;; is still an arrow. A split "IN 27" then "IN 91" is Esc, then "[".
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *vi-mode* "normal")
(define *vi-base* "")

(define (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-title*
        (string-append *vi-base*
                       (if (string=? *vi-mode* "insert") " [insert]" " [normal]"))))

;; Call after the file title is set (play.aura). Returns #t when modal.
(define (pad:vi-boot!)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_VI")))
    (if (and (string? v) (string=? v "1"))
        (begin
          (set! *vi-on* #t)
          (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
          (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
          (pad:vi-title!))
        (set! *vi-on* #f))
    *vi-on*))

;; Controls that are not the emacs movement keys, looked up in the
;; modeless map. 2 and 16 are movement here, so they never reach this.
(define (pad:vi-ctrl b)
  (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
    (if w w "unknown")))

;; One idle byte -> a command word, a char code, or a mode word
;; (to-insert / to-normal / append / normal-key).
(define (pad:vi-cmd b)
  (cond
    ((= b 27) "to-normal")
    ((= b 2) "left")
    ((= b 6) "right")
    ((= b 14) "next-line")
    ((= b 16) "prev-line")
    ((= b 29) "jump-back")
    ((= b 22) "copy-region")
    ((string=? *vi-mode* "insert")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) b (pad:vi-ctrl b)))
    ((= b 104) "left")
    ((= b 106) "next-line")
    ((= b 107) "prev-line")
    ((= b 108) "right")
    ((= b 105) "to-insert")
    ((= b 97) "append")
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) "normal-key")
    (#t (pad:vi-ctrl b))))

(define (pad:vi-can-right?)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (len (length (list-ref L l))))
    (not (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)))))

;; Apply a mode word. Returns "snap" (the caller writes one frame).
(define (pad:vi-meta! c)
  (cond
    ((string=? c "to-insert")
     (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "insert - type, esc goes back")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-normal")
     (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "normal - press i to type")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "append")
     (let ((moved (pad:vi-can-right?)))
       (if moved (pad:play-cmd! "right") 0)
       (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
       (pad:vi-title!)
       (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
       (if moved 0 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1)))
       "snap"))
    (#t
     (pad:play-reject! "normal-key")
     "snap")))

(define (pad:vi-emit! r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? r "pending") "pending")
    (#t
     (if *pi-collect*
         (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
         (display (pad:play-snap)))
     "go")))

;; Rest of a multi-byte line. esc is the escape-sequence state, passed
;; in so the loop does not capture an outer local. A trailing lone 27
;; leaves insert; 27 followed by 91 or 79 in this same line is an arrow.
(define (pad:vi-each xs esc)
  (if (null? xs)
      (begin (set! *pl-esc* esc) "go")
      (let ((b (car xs)) (rest (cdr xs)))
        (cond
          ((pair? esc)
           (let* ((step (pad:key-step esc b))
                  (cmd (car step))
                  (esc2 (car (cdr step))))
             (if (and (string? cmd) (string=? cmd "pending"))
                 (pad:vi-each rest esc2)
                 (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:play-cmd! cmd))))
                   (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))
          ((and (= b 27) (pair? rest) (or (= (car rest) 91) (= (car rest) 79)))
           (pad:vi-each rest (list 27)))
          ((and (= b 15) (null? esc))
           (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:who-key!))))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))
          (#t
           (let* ((cmd (pad:vi-cmd b))
                  (r (if (and (string? cmd)
                              (or (string=? cmd "to-insert") (string=? cmd "to-normal")
                                  (string=? cmd "append") (string=? cmd "normal-key")))
                         (pad:vi-meta! cmd)
                         (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
                  (e (pad:vi-emit! r)))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))))

(define (pad:vi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect*
              (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
              (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (pad:vi-each bs *pl-esc*))))
