;; aura-pad -- vi normal / insert, evil-style, plus emacs movement.
;; Loaded by play.aura. Off unless PAD_VI=1 (aura-pad sets that; the
;; smokes do not, so the modeless keymap in keys.aura stays put).
;;
;; Normal (the start):
;;   h j k l move, i types, a appends, Esc stays.
;;   x / X delete a letter, dd deletes the line, D deletes to the end
;;   of the line (it does not join), yy copies the line, p pastes.
;;   u takes the last edit back. 0 / $ go to the ends of the line,
;;   gg / G to the top and the bottom. w / b move by words.
;;   I / A / o / O open insert at the start, the end, below, above.
;;   r replaces the letter under the cursor.
;;   : opens a command line: e / eval / run runs the page, w saves,
;;   q quits, wq saves and quits. ZZ saves and quits, ZQ quits.
;; Insert: letters type, Esc returns to normal. : is a letter there.
;; Both modes: ctrl-b left, ctrl-f right, ctrl-p up, ctrl-n down,
;; and the arrow keys. ctrl-] jumps back (ctrl-b used to). ctrl-v
;; copies the region (ctrl-p used to).
;; ctrl-x ctrl-c quits (with a file, file.aura owns that chord and
;; warns once when the page is not saved). ctrl-x ctrl-e runs the page.
;; Alt-x is the bytes 27 120 in ONE read (a lone 27 is still Esc).
;; Enter on an empty Alt-x line runs the page.
;;
;; Running the page uses (eval ...), not set-code, so the editor stays
;; loaded. display and newline inside the page are caught so they do
;; not write into the SNAP stream. On this Aura a let that binds those
;; names sticks to the top level, so the real primitives are put back
;; before the next frame.
;;
;; Esc is byte 27, which is also the start of an arrow. C sends one
;; read() as one "IN b1 b2 ..." line, and a real Esc is a one-byte
;; read, so a lone 27 leaves insert. 27 91 / 27 79 in the SAME line
;; is still an arrow. A split "IN 27" then "IN 120" is Esc, then x,
;; not Alt-x.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No named let captures an outer local.

(define *vi-mode* "normal")
(define *vi-base* "")
(define *vi-op* "")
(define *vi-line* "")
(define *vi-prompt* ": ")
(define *vi-mx* #f)
(define *vi-cx* #f)
(define *vi-arg* 0)
(define *vi-out* (list ""))
(define *vi-ran* #f)
(define *vi-gap* (list->string (list 32 47 32)))
(define *vi-disp* display)
(define *vi-nl* newline)

(define (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-title*
        (string-append *vi-base*
                       (if (string=? *vi-mode* "insert") " [insert]" " [normal]"))))

(define (pad:vi-has-file?)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_FILE")))
    (and (string? v) (> (string-length v) 0))))

;; Call after the file title is set (play.aura). Returns #t when modal.
(define (pad:vi-boot!)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_VI")))
    (if (and (string? v) (string=? v "1"))
        (begin
          (set! *vi-on* #t)
          (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
          (set! *vi-op* "")
          (set! *vi-cx* #f)
          (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
          (pad:vi-title!)
          (if (pad:vi-has-file?)
              0
              (set! *pl-say* "normal - :eval runs this page, ctrl-x ctrl-c quits")))
        (set! *vi-on* #f))
    *vi-on*))

;; Controls that are not the emacs movement keys, looked up in the
;; modeless map. 2 and 16 are movement here, so they never reach this.
(define (pad:vi-ctrl b)
  (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
    (if w w "unknown")))

(define (pad:vi-can-right?)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (len (length (list-ref L l))))
    (not (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)))))

(define (pad:vi-mode-word? cmd)
  (or (string=? cmd "vi-do")
      (string=? cmd "to-insert")
      (string=? cmd "to-normal")
      (string=? cmd "append")
      (string=? cmd "normal-key")))

;; --- command line and running the page ---

;; A let/define of display inside eval sticks to the top level on this
;; Aura, and set! of the primitive before that stick is an error. Put
;; the primitives back when the names are variables, and ignore the
;; error when the page never ran.
(define (pad:vi-restore-io!)
  (try (set! display *vi-disp*) (catch (e) 0))
  (try (set! newline *vi-nl*) (catch (e) 0)))

(define (pad:vi-cut s)
  (if (> (string-length s) 160) (string-append (substring s 0 160) "...") s))

(define (pad:vi-ol s i n acc k)
  (if (or (>= i n) (>= k 160))
      acc
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (pad:vi-ol s (+ i 1) n
                   (string-append acc
                                  (if (or (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 9))
                                      " "
                                      (list->string (list c))))
                   (+ k 1)))))

(define (pad:vi-one-line s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:vi-ol s 0 (string-length s) "" 0) ""))

(define (pad:vi-plist v d n)
  (cond
    ((> n 6) "...")
    ((null? v) "")
    ((not (pair? v)) (string-append ". " (pad:vi-p v (+ d 1))))
    ((null? (cdr v)) (pad:vi-p (car v) (+ d 1)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:vi-p (car v) (+ d 1)) " "
                       (pad:vi-plist (cdr v) d (+ n 1))))))

(define (pad:vi-p v d)
  (cond
    ((> d 4) "...")
    ((string? v) (pad:vi-one-line v))
    ((number? v) (number->string v))
    ((null? v) "()")
    ((equal? v #t) "#t")
    ((equal? v #f) "#f")
    ((pair? v) (string-append "(" (pad:vi-plist v d 0) ")"))
    (#t "a value")))

(define (pad:vi-add-s! s)
  (let ((cur (car *vi-out*)))
    (if (>= (string-length cur) 160)
        0
        (set-car! *vi-out* (string-append cur (pad:vi-one-line s))))))

(define (pad:vi-add! v)
  (pad:vi-add-s! (pad:vi-p v 0)))

(define (pad:vi-wrap src)
  (string-append
    "(try (cons 1 (let () (define (display v) (pad:vi-add! v)) (define (newline) (pad:vi-add! *vi-gap*)) "
    src
    ")) (catch (e) (cons 0 e)))"))

(define (pad:vi-skip-sp s i n)
  (if (or (>= i n) (not (= (string-ref s i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-sp s (+ i 1) n)))

(define (pad:vi-word-end s i n)
  (if (or (>= i n) (= (string-ref s i) 32))
      i
      (pad:vi-word-end s (+ i 1) n)))

(define (pad:vi-word s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (substring s (pad:vi-skip-sp s 0 n) (pad:vi-word-end s (pad:vi-skip-sp s 0 n) n))))

(define (pad:vi-first-line s)
  (let ((i (if (string? s) (string-index s "\n" 0) -1)))
    (cond
      ((not (string? s)) "")
      ((< i 0) s)
      (#t (substring s 0 i)))))

(define (pad:vi-after s mark)
  (let ((i (string-index s mark 0)))
    (if (< i 0) "" (substring s (+ i (string-length mark)) (string-length s)))))

;; Kid words only. The raw interpreter line can contain "unbound
;; variable" / "error:", and the smokes treat those as a Soft crash.
(define (pad:vi-soften s)
  (let* ((line (pad:vi-first-line s))
         (name (pad:vi-word (pad:vi-after line "unbound variable: "))))
    (cond
      ((> (string-length name) 0) (string-append name " is not defined yet"))
      ((or (string-contains? line "error:") (string-contains? line "unbound"))
       "did not run - check the parens")
      ((string=? line "") "did not run - check the parens")
      (#t (pad:vi-cut line)))))

(define (pad:vi-blank-i s i n)
  (if (>= i n)
      #t
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (if (or (= c 32) (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 9))
            (pad:vi-blank-i s (+ i 1) n)
            #f))))

(define (pad:vi-blank? s)
  (pad:vi-blank-i s 0 (string-length s)))

(define (pad:vi-exec src)
  (set-car! *vi-out* "")
  (set! *vi-ran* (try (eval (pad:vi-wrap src)) (catch (e) (cons 0 e))))
  (pad:vi-restore-io!)
  *vi-ran*)

(define (pad:vi-report! r)
  (let ((out (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-one-line (car *vi-out*)))))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (cond
            ((not (pair? r)) "did not run - check the parens")
            ((and (number? (car r)) (= (car r) 0))
             (string-append "did not run: " (pad:vi-soften (cdr r))))
            ((and (number? (car r)) (= (car r) 1))
             (let ((v (cdr r)))
               (cond
                 ((and (null? v) (string=? out "")) "ran, and it returned nothing")
                 ((string=? out "") (string-append "ran: " (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-p v 0))))
                 ((null? v) (string-append "ran, printed: " out))
                 (#t (string-append "ran: " (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-p v 0)) " printed: " out)))))
            (#t "did not run - check the parens")))))

(define (pad:vi-eval!)
  (if (pad:vi-blank? (pad:play-src))
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "the page is empty")
        (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
        "vi-do")
      (begin
        (pad:vi-report! (pad:vi-exec (pad:play-src)))
        (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-quit! force)
  (cond
    ((not (pad:vi-has-file?)) "quit")
    (force "quit")
    (*pf-ro* "quit")
    ((string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*) "quit")
    (*pf-quit*
     (set! *pf-quit* #f)
     "quit")
    (#t
     (set! *pf-quit* #t)
     (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                                  " ctrl-x ctrl-c again quits"))
     "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-write! and-quit)
  (if (not (pad:vi-has-file?))
      (if and-quit
          "quit"
          (begin
            (set! *pl-say* "no file to save")
            "vi-do"))
      (let ((r (pad:pf-save!)))
        (if (and and-quit (string=? r "saved"))
            "quit"
            "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-colon!)
  (let ((w (pad:vi-word *vi-line*))
        (mx *vi-mx*))
    (set! *vi-op* "")
    (set! *vi-line* "")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (cond
      ((or (string=? w "e") (string=? w "eval") (string=? w "run")) (pad:vi-eval!))
      ((or (string=? w "q") (string=? w "quit")) (pad:vi-quit! #f))
      ((or (string=? w "q!") (string=? w "quit!")) (pad:vi-quit! #t))
      ((or (string=? w "w") (string=? w "write") (string=? w "save")) (pad:vi-write! #f))
      ((or (string=? w "wq") (string=? w "x")) (pad:vi-write! #t))
      ((string=? w "help")
       (set! *pl-say* "eval runs this page, w saves, q quits")
       "vi-do")
      ((string=? w "")
       (if mx
           (pad:vi-eval!)
           (begin
             (set! *pl-say* "eval runs this page, w saves, q quits")
             "vi-do")))
      (#t
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no command " w " - eval runs, w saves, q quits"))
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-colon-start! mx)
  (set! *vi-op* ":")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* mx)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* (if mx "M-x " ": "))
  (set! *pl-say*
        (if mx
            "M-x - enter runs this page, q quits, w saves"
            ": - eval runs this page, w saves, q quits"))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-type! b)
  (if (< (string-length *vi-line*) 48)
      (set! *vi-line* (string-append *vi-line* (list->string (list b))))
      0)
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-bs!)
  (let ((n (string-length *vi-line*)))
    (if (= n 0)
        (pad:vi-cancel!)
        (begin
          (set! *vi-line* (substring *vi-line* 0 (- n 1)))
          (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
          "vi-do"))))

;; --- line edits (normal mode) ---

(define (pad:vi-undo-push U)
  (let ((un (length U)))
    (cond
      ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
      ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
      (#t U))))

(define (pad:vi-drop-line!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l)))
    (if (and (= n 1) (null? ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing to delete")
          "vi-do")
        (let* ((only (= n 1))
               (last (and (not only) (= l (- n 1))))
               (L2 (if only
                       (list (list))
                       (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                               (drop L (+ l 1)))))
               (l2 (cond (only 0) (last (- l 1)) (#t l)))
               (ln2 (list-ref L2 l2))
               (len2 (length ln2))
               (col2 (cond (last len2) (only 0) ((> col len2) len2) (#t col)))
               (kill (if only (list ln) (if last (list (list) ln) (list ln (list)))))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l2 col2 kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted the line")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-x!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (>= col (length ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let ((ch (list-ref ln col)))
          (pad:play-cmd! "right")
          (pad:play-cmd! "back")
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                              (list (list ch)) (list) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-X!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (= col 0)
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing before the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let ((ch (list-ref ln (- col 1))))
          (pad:play-cmd! "back")
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                              (list (list ch)) (list) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-D!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (>= col (length ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (begin
          (pad:play-cmd! "kill-line")
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted to the end of the line")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-yy!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l)))
    (set! *pl-st* (list L l (caddr st) (list ln (list)) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
    (pad:play-ok! "copied the line")
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:vi-p!)
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "yank")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (set! *pl-say* "pasted") 0)
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:vi-replace! b)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (n (length L)))
    (if (>= col len)
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let* ((pre (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col)))))
               (post (drop ln (+ col 1)))
               (ln2 (append pre (cons b post)))
               (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                           (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col (list-ref st 3) (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "replaced")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-insert-here!)
  (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-open-below!)
  (pad:play-cmd! "end")
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "enter")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-open-above!)
  (pad:play-cmd! "home")
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "open-line")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-go-insert! cmd)
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

;; Words are runs of letters that are not spaces. w moves to the next
;; one, including the next line; b moves back to the start of a word.
(define (pad:vi-skip-word ln i len)
  (if (or (>= i len) (= (list-ref ln i) 32)) i (pad:vi-skip-word ln (+ i 1) len)))

(define (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln i len)
  (if (or (>= i len) (not (= (list-ref ln i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln (+ i 1) len)))

(define (pad:vi-w!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln (pad:vi-skip-word ln col len) len)))
    (cond
      ((< i len)
       (set! *pl-st* (list L l i (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
       "vi-do")
      ((< l (- n 1))
       (set! *pl-st* (list L (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
       "vi-do")
      (#t
       (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln i)
  (if (or (< i 0) (not (= (list-ref ln i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln (- i 1))))

(define (pad:vi-word-start ln i)
  (if (or (<= i 0) (= (list-ref ln (- i 1)) 32))
      i
      (pad:vi-word-start ln (- i 1))))

(define (pad:vi-b-pos L l col)
  (if (and (= l 0) (= col 0))
      #f
      (let* ((prev (= col 0))
             (l2 (if prev (- l 1) l))
             (ln (list-ref L l2))
             (start (if prev (length ln) col)))
        (if (= start 0)
            (pad:vi-b-pos L l2 0)
            (let ((i (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln (- start 1))))
              (if (< i 0)
                  (if (= l2 0) #f (pad:vi-b-pos L l2 0))
                  (list l2 (pad:vi-word-start ln i))))))))

(define (pad:vi-b!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:vi-b-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st))))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-cancel!)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *pl-say* "normal - press i to type")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-pend! op say)
  (set! *vi-op* op)
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-redo! b)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (pad:vi-cmd b))

(define (pad:vi-act! name)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (cond
    ((string=? name "dd") (pad:vi-drop-line!))
    ((string=? name "x") (pad:vi-x!))
    ((string=? name "X") (pad:vi-X!))
    ((string=? name "D") (pad:vi-D!))
    ((string=? name "yy") (pad:vi-yy!))
    ((string=? name "p") (pad:vi-p!))
    ((string=? name "r") (pad:vi-replace! *vi-arg*))
    ((string=? name "o") (pad:vi-open-below!))
    ((string=? name "O") (pad:vi-open-above!))
    ((string=? name "I") (pad:vi-go-insert! "home"))
    ((string=? name "A") (pad:vi-go-insert! "end"))
    ((string=? name "w") (pad:vi-w!))
    ((string=? name "b") (pad:vi-b!))
    ((string=? name "eval") (pad:vi-eval!))
    ((string=? name "ZZ") (pad:vi-write! #t))
    ((string=? name "ZQ") (pad:vi-quit! #t))
    ((string=? name "cx")
     (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-c quits, ctrl-e runs this page")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "cx-no")
     (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x and that key do not go together")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "c-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "to quit press ctrl-q (ctrl-x ctrl-c works too)")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "d-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "d deletes a line - press d again")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "y-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "y copies a line - press y again")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "r-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "r replaces one letter")
     "vi-do")
    (#t (pad:vi-cancel!))))

(define (pad:vi-op-byte b)
  (cond
    ((= b 27) (pad:vi-cancel!))
    ((string=? *vi-op* ":")
     (cond
       ((or (= b 10) (= b 13)) (pad:vi-colon!))
       ((or (= b 8) (= b 127)) (pad:vi-bs!))
       ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (pad:vi-type! b))
       (#t (pad:vi-type-keep!))))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "d")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 100) (pad:vi-act! "dd") (pad:vi-act! "d-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "y")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 121) (pad:vi-act! "yy") (pad:vi-act! "y-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "g")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 103) "bob" (pad:vi-redo! b)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "r")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126))
         (begin (set! *vi-arg* b) (pad:vi-act! "r"))
         (pad:vi-act! "r-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "Z")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (cond
       ((= b 90) (pad:vi-act! "ZZ"))
       ((= b 81) (pad:vi-act! "ZQ"))
       (#t (pad:vi-redo! b))))
    (#t (pad:vi-cancel!))))

(define (pad:vi-type-keep!)
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-cx-start!)
  (set! *vi-cx* #t)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (pad:vi-act! "cx"))

(define (pad:vi-cx-byte b)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (cond
    ((= b 3) "quit")
    ((= b 5) (pad:vi-act! "eval"))
    ((= b 17) "quit")
    (#t (pad:vi-act! "cx-no"))))

;; One idle byte -> a command word, a char code, or a mode word
;; (to-insert / to-normal / append / normal-key / vi-do).
(define (pad:vi-cmd b)
  (cond
    ((not (string=? *vi-op* "")) (pad:vi-op-byte b))
    (*vi-cx* (pad:vi-cx-byte b))
    ((= b 27) "to-normal")
    ((= b 24) (pad:vi-cx-start!))
    ((= b 3) (pad:vi-act! "c-hint"))
    ((= b 2) "left")
    ((= b 6) "right")
    ((= b 14) "next-line")
    ((= b 16) "prev-line")
    ((= b 29) "jump-back")
    ((= b 22) "copy-region")
    ((string=? *vi-mode* "insert")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) b (pad:vi-ctrl b)))
    ((= b 104) "left")
    ((= b 106) "next-line")
    ((= b 107) "prev-line")
    ((= b 108) "right")
    ((= b 105) "to-insert")
    ((= b 97) "append")
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-act! "x"))
    ((= b 88) (pad:vi-act! "X"))
    ((= b 100) (pad:vi-pend! "d" "d - press d again to delete the line"))
    ((= b 68) (pad:vi-act! "D"))
    ((= b 121) (pad:vi-pend! "y" "y - press y again to copy the line"))
    ((= b 112) (pad:vi-act! "p"))
    ((= b 117) "undo")
    ((= b 48) "home")
    ((= b 36) "end")
    ((= b 103) (pad:vi-pend! "g" "g - press g again to go to the top"))
    ((= b 71) "eob")
    ((= b 73) (pad:vi-act! "I"))
    ((= b 65) (pad:vi-act! "A"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:vi-act! "o"))
    ((= b 79) (pad:vi-act! "O"))
    ((= b 114) (pad:vi-pend! "r" "r - type a letter to replace"))
    ((= b 119) (pad:vi-act! "w"))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-act! "b"))
    ((= b 58) (pad:vi-colon-start! #f))
    ((= b 90) (pad:vi-pend! "Z" "Z - Z saves and quits, Q quits"))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) "normal-key")
    (#t (pad:vi-ctrl b))))

;; Apply a mode word. Returns "snap" (the caller writes one frame)
;; or "quit". "vi-do" was already carried out in pad:vi-cmd.
(define (pad:vi-meta! c)
  (cond
    ((string=? c "vi-do") "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-insert")
     (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (set! *vi-cx* #f)
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "insert - type, esc goes back")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-normal")
     (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "normal - press i to type")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "append")
     (let ((moved (pad:vi-can-right?)))
       (if moved (pad:play-cmd! "right") 0)
       (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-cx* #f)
       (pad:vi-title!)
       (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
       (if moved 0 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1)))
       "snap"))
    (#t
     (pad:play-reject! "normal-key")
     "snap")))

(define (pad:vi-emit! r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? r "pending") "pending")
    (#t
     (if *pi-collect*
         (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
         (display (pad:play-snap)))
     "go")))

(define (pad:vi-took! cmd rest)
  (let* ((r (if (pad:vi-mode-word? cmd) (pad:vi-meta! cmd) (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
         (e (pad:vi-emit! r)))
    (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))

;; Rest of a multi-byte line. esc is the escape-sequence state, passed
;; in so the loop does not capture an outer local. A trailing lone 27
;; leaves insert; 27 followed by 91 or 79 in this same line is an arrow.
;; 27 followed by 120 in this same line is Alt-x.
(define (pad:vi-each xs esc)
  (if (null? xs)
      (begin (set! *pl-esc* esc) "go")
      (let ((b (car xs)) (rest (cdr xs)))
        (cond
          ((and (null? esc) (string=? *vi-op* "")
                (= b 27) (pair? rest) (= (car rest) 120))
           (pad:vi-took! (pad:vi-colon-start! #t) (cdr rest)))
          ((pair? esc)
           (let* ((step (pad:key-step esc b))
                  (cmd (car step))
                  (esc2 (car (cdr step))))
             (if (and (string? cmd) (string=? cmd "pending"))
                 (pad:vi-each rest esc2)
                 (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:play-cmd! cmd))))
                   (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))
          ((and (= b 27) (pair? rest) (or (= (car rest) 91) (= (car rest) 79)))
           (pad:vi-each rest (list 27)))
          ((and (= b 15) (null? esc))
           (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:who-key!))))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))
          (#t (pad:vi-took! (pad:vi-cmd b) rest))))))

(define (pad:vi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- vi normal / insert, evil-style, plus emacs movement.
;; Loaded by play.aura. Off unless PAD_VI=1 (aura-pad sets that; the
;; smokes do not, so the modeless keymap in keys.aura stays put).
;;
;; Normal (the start):
;;   h j k l move, i types, a appends, Esc stays.
;;   x / X delete a letter, dd deletes the line, D deletes to the end
;;   of the line (it does not join), yy copies the line, p pastes.
;;   u takes the last edit back. 0 / $ go to the ends of the line,
;;   gg / G to the top and the bottom. w / b move by words.
;;   I / A / o / O open insert at the start, the end, below, above.
;;   r replaces the letter under the cursor.
;;   : opens a command line: e / eval / run runs the page, w saves,
;;   q quits, wq saves and quits. ZZ saves and quits, ZQ quits.
;; Insert: letters type, Esc returns to normal. : is a letter there.
;; Both modes: ctrl-b left, ctrl-f right, ctrl-p up, ctrl-n down,
;; and the arrow keys. ctrl-] jumps back (ctrl-b used to). ctrl-v
;; copies the region (ctrl-p used to).
;; ctrl-x ctrl-c quits (with a file, file.aura owns that chord and
;; warns once when the page is not saved). ctrl-x ctrl-e runs the page.
;; Alt-x is the bytes 27 120 in ONE read (a lone 27 is still Esc).
;; Enter on an empty Alt-x line runs the page.
;;
;; Running the page uses (eval ...), not set-code, so the editor stays
;; loaded. display and newline inside the page are caught so they do
;; not write into the SNAP stream. On this Aura a let that binds those
;; names sticks to the top level, so the real primitives are put back
;; before the next frame.
;;
;; Esc is byte 27, which is also the start of an arrow. C sends one
;; read() as one "IN b1 b2 ..." line, and a real Esc is a one-byte
;; read, so a lone 27 leaves insert. 27 91 / 27 79 in the SAME line
;; is still an arrow. A split "IN 27" then "IN 120" is Esc, then x,
;; not Alt-x.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No named let captures an outer local.

(define *vi-mode* "normal")
(define *vi-base* "")
(define *vi-op* "")
(define *vi-line* "")
(define *vi-prompt* ": ")
(define *vi-mx* #f)
(define *vi-cx* #f)
(define *vi-arg* 0)
(define *vi-out* (list ""))
(define *vi-ran* #f)
(define *vi-gap* (list->string (list 32 47 32)))
(define *vi-disp* display)
(define *vi-nl* newline)

(define (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-title*
        (string-append *vi-base*
                       (if (string=? *vi-mode* "insert") " [insert]" " [normal]"))))

(define (pad:vi-has-file?)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_FILE")))
    (and (string? v) (> (string-length v) 0))))

;; Call after the file title is set (play.aura). Returns #t when modal.
(define (pad:vi-boot!)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_VI")))
    (if (and (string? v) (string=? v "1"))
        (begin
          (set! *vi-on* #t)
          (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
          (set! *vi-op* "")
          (set! *vi-cx* #f)
          (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
          (pad:vi-title!)
          (if (pad:vi-has-file?)
              0
              (set! *pl-say* "normal - :eval runs this page, ctrl-x ctrl-c quits")))
        (set! *vi-on* #f))
    *vi-on*))

;; Controls that are not the emacs movement keys, looked up in the
;; modeless map. 2 and 16 are movement here, so they never reach this.
(define (pad:vi-ctrl b)
  (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
    (if w w "unknown")))

(define (pad:vi-can-right?)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (len (length (list-ref L l))))
    (not (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)))))

(define (pad:vi-mode-word? cmd)
  (or (string=? cmd "vi-do")
      (string=? cmd "to-insert")
      (string=? cmd "to-normal")
      (string=? cmd "append")
      (string=? cmd "normal-key")))

;; --- command line and running the page ---

;; A let/define of display inside eval sticks to the top level on this
;; Aura, and set! of the primitive before that stick is an error. Put
;; the primitives back when the names are variables, and ignore the
;; error when the page never ran.
(define (pad:vi-restore-io!)
  (try (set! display *vi-disp*) (catch (e) 0))
  (try (set! newline *vi-nl*) (catch (e) 0)))

(define (pad:vi-cut s)
  (if (> (string-length s) 160) (string-append (substring s 0 160) "...") s))

(define (pad:vi-ol s i n acc k)
  (if (or (>= i n) (>= k 160))
      acc
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (pad:vi-ol s (+ i 1) n
                   (string-append acc
                                  (if (or (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 9))
                                      " "
                                      (list->string (list c))))
                   (+ k 1)))))

(define (pad:vi-one-line s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:vi-ol s 0 (string-length s) "" 0) ""))

(define (pad:vi-plist v d n)
  (cond
    ((> n 6) "...")
    ((null? v) "")
    ((not (pair? v)) (string-append ". " (pad:vi-p v (+ d 1))))
    ((null? (cdr v)) (pad:vi-p (car v) (+ d 1)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:vi-p (car v) (+ d 1)) " "
                       (pad:vi-plist (cdr v) d (+ n 1))))))

(define (pad:vi-p v d)
  (cond
    ((> d 4) "...")
    ((string? v) (pad:vi-one-line v))
    ((number? v) (number->string v))
    ((null? v) "()")
    ((equal? v #t) "#t")
    ((equal? v #f) "#f")
    ((pair? v) (string-append "(" (pad:vi-plist v d 0) ")"))
    (#t "a value")))

(define (pad:vi-add-s! s)
  (let ((cur (car *vi-out*)))
    (if (>= (string-length cur) 160)
        0
        (set-car! *vi-out* (string-append cur (pad:vi-one-line s))))))

(define (pad:vi-add! v)
  (pad:vi-add-s! (pad:vi-p v 0)))

(define (pad:vi-wrap src)
  (string-append
    "(try (cons 1 (let () (define (display v) (pad:vi-add! v)) (define (newline) (pad:vi-add! *vi-gap*)) "
    src
    ")) (catch (e) (cons 0 e)))"))

(define (pad:vi-skip-sp s i n)
  (if (or (>= i n) (not (= (string-ref s i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-sp s (+ i 1) n)))

(define (pad:vi-word-end s i n)
  (if (or (>= i n) (= (string-ref s i) 32))
      i
      (pad:vi-word-end s (+ i 1) n)))

(define (pad:vi-word s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (substring s (pad:vi-skip-sp s 0 n) (pad:vi-word-end s (pad:vi-skip-sp s 0 n) n))))

(define (pad:vi-first-line s)
  (let ((i (if (string? s) (string-index s "\n" 0) -1)))
    (cond
      ((not (string? s)) "")
      ((< i 0) s)
      (#t (substring s 0 i)))))

(define (pad:vi-after s mark)
  (let ((i (string-index s mark 0)))
    (if (< i 0) "" (substring s (+ i (string-length mark)) (string-length s)))))

;; Kid words only. The raw interpreter line can contain "unbound
;; variable" / "error:", and the smokes treat those as a Soft crash.
(define (pad:vi-soften s)
  (let* ((line (pad:vi-first-line s))
         (name (pad:vi-word (pad:vi-after line "unbound variable: "))))
    (cond
      ((> (string-length name) 0) (string-append name " is not defined yet"))
      ((or (string-contains? line "error:") (string-contains? line "unbound"))
       "did not run - check the parens")
      ((string=? line "") "did not run - check the parens")
      (#t (pad:vi-cut line)))))

(define (pad:vi-blank-i s i n)
  (if (>= i n)
      #t
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (if (or (= c 32) (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 9))
            (pad:vi-blank-i s (+ i 1) n)
            #f))))

(define (pad:vi-blank? s)
  (pad:vi-blank-i s 0 (string-length s)))

(define (pad:vi-exec src)
  (set-car! *vi-out* "")
  (set! *vi-ran* (try (eval (pad:vi-wrap src)) (catch (e) (cons 0 e))))
  (pad:vi-restore-io!)
  *vi-ran*)

(define (pad:vi-report! r)
  (let ((out (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-one-line (car *vi-out*)))))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (cond
            ((not (pair? r)) "did not run - check the parens")
            ((and (number? (car r)) (= (car r) 0))
             (string-append "did not run: " (pad:vi-soften (cdr r))))
            ((and (number? (car r)) (= (car r) 1))
             (let ((v (cdr r)))
               (cond
                 ((and (null? v) (string=? out "")) "ran, and it returned nothing")
                 ((string=? out "") (string-append "ran: " (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-p v 0))))
                 ((null? v) (string-append "ran, printed: " out))
                 (#t (string-append "ran: " (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-p v 0)) " printed: " out)))))
            (#t "did not run - check the parens")))))

(define (pad:vi-eval!)
  (if (pad:vi-blank? (pad:play-src))
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "the page is empty")
        (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
        "vi-do")
      (begin
        (pad:vi-report! (pad:vi-exec (pad:play-src)))
        (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-quit! force)
  (cond
    ((not (pad:vi-has-file?)) "quit")
    (force "quit")
    (*pf-ro* "quit")
    ((string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*) "quit")
    (*pf-quit*
     (set! *pf-quit* #f)
     "quit")
    (#t
     (set! *pf-quit* #t)
     (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                                  " ctrl-x ctrl-c again quits"))
     "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-write! and-quit)
  (if (not (pad:vi-has-file?))
      (if and-quit
          "quit"
          (begin
            (set! *pl-say* "no file to save")
            "vi-do"))
      (let ((r (pad:pf-save!)))
        (if (and and-quit (string=? r "saved"))
            "quit"
            "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-colon!)
  (let ((w (pad:vi-word *vi-line*))
        (mx *vi-mx*))
    (set! *vi-op* "")
    (set! *vi-line* "")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (cond
      ((or (string=? w "e") (string=? w "eval") (string=? w "run")) (pad:vi-eval!))
      ((or (string=? w "q") (string=? w "quit")) (pad:vi-quit! #f))
      ((or (string=? w "q!") (string=? w "quit!")) (pad:vi-quit! #t))
      ((or (string=? w "w") (string=? w "write") (string=? w "save")) (pad:vi-write! #f))
      ((or (string=? w "wq") (string=? w "x")) (pad:vi-write! #t))
      ((string=? w "help")
       (set! *pl-say* "eval runs this page, w saves, q quits")
       "vi-do")
      ((string=? w "")
       (if mx
           (pad:vi-eval!)
           (begin
             (set! *pl-say* "eval runs this page, w saves, q quits")
             "vi-do")))
      (#t
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no command " w " - eval runs, w saves, q quits"))
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-colon-start! mx)
  (set! *vi-op* ":")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* mx)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* (if mx "M-x " ": "))
  (set! *pl-say*
        (if mx
            "M-x - enter runs this page, q quits, w saves"
            ": - eval runs this page, w saves, q quits"))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-type! b)
  (if (< (string-length *vi-line*) 48)
      (set! *vi-line* (string-append *vi-line* (list->string (list b))))
      0)
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-bs!)
  (let ((n (string-length *vi-line*)))
    (if (= n 0)
        (pad:vi-cancel!)
        (begin
          (set! *vi-line* (substring *vi-line* 0 (- n 1)))
          (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
          "vi-do"))))

;; --- line edits (normal mode) ---

(define (pad:vi-undo-push U)
  (let ((un (length U)))
    (cond
      ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
      ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
      (#t U))))

(define (pad:vi-drop-line!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l)))
    (if (and (= n 1) (null? ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing to delete")
          "vi-do")
        (let* ((only (= n 1))
               (last (and (not only) (= l (- n 1))))
               (L2 (if only
                       (list (list))
                       (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                               (drop L (+ l 1)))))
               (l2 (cond (only 0) (last (- l 1)) (#t l)))
               (ln2 (list-ref L2 l2))
               (len2 (length ln2))
               (col2 (cond (last len2) (only 0) ((> col len2) len2) (#t col)))
               (kill (if only (list ln) (if last (list (list) ln) (list ln (list)))))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l2 col2 kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted the line")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-x!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (>= col (length ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let ((ch (list-ref ln col)))
          (pad:play-cmd! "right")
          (pad:play-cmd! "back")
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                              (list (list ch)) (list) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-X!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (= col 0)
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing before the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let ((ch (list-ref ln (- col 1))))
          (pad:play-cmd! "back")
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                              (list (list ch)) (list) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-D!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (>= col (length ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (begin
          (pad:play-cmd! "kill-line")
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted to the end of the line")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-yy!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l)))
    (set! *pl-st* (list L l (caddr st) (list ln (list)) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
    (pad:play-ok! "copied the line")
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:vi-p!)
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "yank")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (set! *pl-say* "pasted") 0)
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:vi-replace! b)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (n (length L)))
    (if (>= col len)
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let* ((pre (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col)))))
               (post (drop ln (+ col 1)))
               (ln2 (append pre (cons b post)))
               (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                           (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col (list-ref st 3) (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "replaced")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-insert-here!)
  (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-open-below!)
  (pad:play-cmd! "end")
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "enter")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-open-above!)
  (pad:play-cmd! "home")
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "open-line")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-go-insert! cmd)
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

;; Words are runs of letters that are not spaces. w moves to the next
;; one, including the next line; b moves back to the start of a word.
(define (pad:vi-skip-word ln i len)
  (if (or (>= i len) (= (list-ref ln i) 32)) i (pad:vi-skip-word ln (+ i 1) len)))

(define (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln i len)
  (if (or (>= i len) (not (= (list-ref ln i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln (+ i 1) len)))

(define (pad:vi-w!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln (pad:vi-skip-word ln col len) len)))
    (cond
      ((< i len)
       (set! *pl-st* (list L l i (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
       "vi-do")
      ((< l (- n 1))
       (set! *pl-st* (list L (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
       "vi-do")
      (#t
       (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln i)
  (if (or (< i 0) (not (= (list-ref ln i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln (- i 1))))

(define (pad:vi-word-start ln i)
  (if (or (<= i 0) (= (list-ref ln (- i 1)) 32))
      i
      (pad:vi-word-start ln (- i 1))))

(define (pad:vi-b-pos L l col)
  (if (and (= l 0) (= col 0))
      #f
      (let* ((prev (= col 0))
             (l2 (if prev (- l 1) l))
             (ln (list-ref L l2))
             (start (if prev (length ln) col)))
        (if (= start 0)
            (pad:vi-b-pos L l2 0)
            (let ((i (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln (- start 1))))
              (if (< i 0)
                  (if (= l2 0) #f (pad:vi-b-pos L l2 0))
                  (list l2 (pad:vi-word-start ln i))))))))

(define (pad:vi-b!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:vi-b-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st))))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-cancel!)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *pl-say* "normal - press i to type")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-pend! op say)
  (set! *vi-op* op)
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-redo! b)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (pad:vi-cmd b))

(define (pad:vi-act! name)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (cond
    ((string=? name "dd") (pad:vi-drop-line!))
    ((string=? name "x") (pad:vi-x!))
    ((string=? name "X") (pad:vi-X!))
    ((string=? name "D") (pad:vi-D!))
    ((string=? name "yy") (pad:vi-yy!))
    ((string=? name "p") (pad:vi-p!))
    ((string=? name "r") (pad:vi-replace! *vi-arg*))
    ((string=? name "o") (pad:vi-open-below!))
    ((string=? name "O") (pad:vi-open-above!))
    ((string=? name "I") (pad:vi-go-insert! "home"))
    ((string=? name "A") (pad:vi-go-insert! "end"))
    ((string=? name "w") (pad:vi-w!))
    ((string=? name "b") (pad:vi-b!))
    ((string=? name "eval") (pad:vi-eval!))
    ((string=? name "ZZ") (pad:vi-write! #t))
    ((string=? name "ZQ") (pad:vi-quit! #t))
    ((string=? name "cx")
     (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-c quits, ctrl-e runs this page")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "cx-no")
     (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x and that key do not go together")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "c-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "to quit press ctrl-q (ctrl-x ctrl-c works too)")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "d-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "d deletes a line - press d again")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "y-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "y copies a line - press y again")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "r-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "r replaces one letter")
     "vi-do")
    (#t (pad:vi-cancel!))))

(define (pad:vi-op-byte b)
  (cond
    ((= b 27) (pad:vi-cancel!))
    ((string=? *vi-op* ":")
     (cond
       ((or (= b 10) (= b 13)) (pad:vi-colon!))
       ((or (= b 8) (= b 127)) (pad:vi-bs!))
       ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (pad:vi-type! b))
       (#t (pad:vi-type-keep!))))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "d")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 100) (pad:vi-act! "dd") (pad:vi-act! "d-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "y")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 121) (pad:vi-act! "yy") (pad:vi-act! "y-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "g")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 103) "bob" (pad:vi-redo! b)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "r")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126))
         (begin (set! *vi-arg* b) (pad:vi-act! "r"))
         (pad:vi-act! "r-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "Z")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (cond
       ((= b 90) (pad:vi-act! "ZZ"))
       ((= b 81) (pad:vi-act! "ZQ"))
       (#t (pad:vi-redo! b))))
    (#t (pad:vi-cancel!))))

(define (pad:vi-type-keep!)
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-cx-start!)
  (set! *vi-cx* #t)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (pad:vi-act! "cx"))

(define (pad:vi-cx-byte b)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (cond
    ((= b 3) "quit")
    ((= b 5) (pad:vi-act! "eval"))
    ((= b 17) "quit")
    (#t (pad:vi-act! "cx-no"))))

;; One idle byte -> a command word, a char code, or a mode word
;; (to-insert / to-normal / append / normal-key / vi-do).
(define (pad:vi-cmd b)
  (cond
    ((not (string=? *vi-op* "")) (pad:vi-op-byte b))
    (*vi-cx* (pad:vi-cx-byte b))
    ((= b 27) "to-normal")
    ((= b 24) (pad:vi-cx-start!))
    ((= b 3) (pad:vi-act! "c-hint"))
    ((= b 2) "left")
    ((= b 6) "right")
    ((= b 14) "next-line")
    ((= b 16) "prev-line")
    ((= b 29) "jump-back")
    ((= b 22) "copy-region")
    ((string=? *vi-mode* "insert")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) b (pad:vi-ctrl b)))
    ((= b 104) "left")
    ((= b 106) "next-line")
    ((= b 107) "prev-line")
    ((= b 108) "right")
    ((= b 105) "to-insert")
    ((= b 97) "append")
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-act! "x"))
    ((= b 88) (pad:vi-act! "X"))
    ((= b 100) (pad:vi-pend! "d" "d - press d again to delete the line"))
    ((= b 68) (pad:vi-act! "D"))
    ((= b 121) (pad:vi-pend! "y" "y - press y again to copy the line"))
    ((= b 112) (pad:vi-act! "p"))
    ((= b 117) "undo")
    ((= b 48) "home")
    ((= b 36) "end")
    ((= b 103) (pad:vi-pend! "g" "g - press g again to go to the top"))
    ((= b 71) "eob")
    ((= b 73) (pad:vi-act! "I"))
    ((= b 65) (pad:vi-act! "A"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:vi-act! "o"))
    ((= b 79) (pad:vi-act! "O"))
    ((= b 114) (pad:vi-pend! "r" "r - type a letter to replace"))
    ((= b 119) (pad:vi-act! "w"))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-act! "b"))
    ((= b 58) (pad:vi-colon-start! #f))
    ((= b 90) (pad:vi-pend! "Z" "Z - Z saves and quits, Q quits"))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) "normal-key")
    (#t (pad:vi-ctrl b))))

;; Apply a mode word. Returns "snap" (the caller writes one frame)
;; or "quit". "vi-do" was already carried out in pad:vi-cmd.
(define (pad:vi-meta! c)
  (cond
    ((string=? c "vi-do") "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-insert")
     (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (set! *vi-cx* #f)
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "insert - type, esc goes back")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-normal")
     (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "normal - press i to type")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "append")
     (let ((moved (pad:vi-can-right?)))
       (if moved (pad:play-cmd! "right") 0)
       (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-cx* #f)
       (pad:vi-title!)
       (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
       (if moved 0 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1)))
       "snap"))
    (#t
     (pad:play-reject! "normal-key")
     "snap")))

(define (pad:vi-emit! r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? r "pending") "pending")
    (#t
     (if *pi-collect*
         (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
         (display (pad:play-snap)))
     "go")))

(define (pad:vi-took! cmd rest)
  (let* ((r (if (pad:vi-mode-word? cmd) (pad:vi-meta! cmd) (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
         (e (pad:vi-emit! r)))
    (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))

;; Rest of a multi-byte line. esc is the escape-sequence state, passed
;; in so the loop does not capture an outer local. A trailing lone 27
;; leaves insert; 27 followed by 91 or 79 in this same line is an arrow.
;; 27 followed by 120 in this same line is Alt-x.
(define (pad:vi-each xs esc)
  (if (null? xs)
      (begin (set! *pl-esc* esc) "go")
      (let ((b (car xs)) (rest (cdr xs)))
        (cond
          ((and (null? esc) (string=? *vi-op* "")
                (= b 27) (pair? rest) (= (car rest) 120))
           (pad:vi-took! (pad:vi-colon-start! #t) (cdr rest)))
          ((pair? esc)
           (let* ((step (pad:key-step esc b))
                  (cmd (car step))
                  (esc2 (car (cdr step))))
             (if (and (string? cmd) (string=? cmd "pending"))
                 (pad:vi-each rest esc2)
                 (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:play-cmd! cmd))))
                   (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))
          ((and (= b 27) (pair? rest) (or (= (car rest) 91) (= (car rest) 79)))
           (pad:vi-each rest (list 27)))
          ((and (= b 15) (null? esc))
           (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:who-key!))))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))
          (#t (pad:vi-took! (pad:vi-cmd b) rest))))))

(define (pad:vi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect*
              (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
              (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (pad:vi-each bs *pl-esc*))))

input.source:
;; aura-pad -- vi normal / insert, evil-style, plus emacs movement.
;; Loaded by play.aura. Off unless PAD_VI=1 (aura-pad sets that; the
;; smokes do not, so the modeless keymap in keys.aura stays put).
;;
;; Normal (the start):
;;   h j k l move, i types, a appends, Esc stays.
;;   x / X delete a letter, dd deletes the line, D deletes to the end
;;   of the line (it does not join), yy copies the line, p pastes.
;;   u takes the last edit back. 0 / $ go to the ends of the line,
;;   gg / G to the top and the bottom. w / b move by words.
;;   I / A / o / O open insert at the start, the end, below, above.
;;   r replaces the letter under the cursor.
;;   : opens a command line: e / eval / run runs the page, w saves,
;;   q quits, wq saves and quits. ZZ saves and quits, ZQ quits.
;; Insert: letters type, Esc returns to normal. : is a letter there.
;; Both modes: ctrl-b left, ctrl-f right, ctrl-p up, ctrl-n down,
;; and the arrow keys. ctrl-] jumps back (ctrl-b used to). ctrl-v
;; copies the region (ctrl-p used to).
;; ctrl-x ctrl-c quits (with a file, file.aura owns that chord and
;; warns once when the page is not saved). ctrl-x ctrl-e runs the page.
;; Alt-x is the bytes 27 120 in ONE read (a lone 27 is still Esc).
;; Enter on an empty Alt-x line runs the page.
;;
;; Running the page uses (eval ...), not set-code, so the editor stays
;; loaded. display and newline inside the page are caught so they do
;; not write into the SNAP stream. On this Aura a let that binds those
;; names sticks to the top level, so the real primitives are put back
;; before the next frame.
;;
;; Esc is byte 27, which is also the start of an arrow. C sends one
;; read() as one "IN b1 b2 ..." line, and a real Esc is a one-byte
;; read, so a lone 27 leaves insert. 27 91 / 27 79 in the SAME line
;; is still an arrow. A split "IN 27" then "IN 120" is Esc, then x,
;; not Alt-x.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No named let captures an outer local.

(define *vi-mode* "normal")
(define *vi-base* "")
(define *vi-op* "")
(define *vi-line* "")
(define *vi-prompt* ": ")
(define *vi-mx* #f)
(define *vi-cx* #f)
(define *vi-arg* 0)
(define *vi-out* (list ""))
(define *vi-ran* #f)
(define *vi-gap* (list->string (list 32 47 32)))
(define *vi-disp* display)
(define *vi-nl* newline)

(define (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-title*
        (string-append *vi-base*
                       (if (string=? *vi-mode* "insert") " [insert]" " [normal]"))))

(define (pad:vi-has-file?)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_FILE")))
    (and (string? v) (> (string-length v) 0))))

;; Call after the file title is set (play.aura). Returns #t when modal.
(define (pad:vi-boot!)
  (let ((v (getenv "PAD_VI")))
    (if (and (string? v) (string=? v "1"))
        (begin
          (set! *vi-on* #t)
          (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
          (set! *vi-op* "")
          (set! *vi-cx* #f)
          (set! *vi-base* *pl-title*)
          (pad:vi-title!)
          (if (pad:vi-has-file?)
              0
              (set! *pl-say* "normal - :eval runs this page, ctrl-x ctrl-c quits")))
        (set! *vi-on* #f))
    *vi-on*))

;; Controls that are not the emacs movement keys, looked up in the
;; modeless map. 2 and 16 are movement here, so they never reach this.
(define (pad:vi-ctrl b)
  (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
    (if w w "unknown")))

(define (pad:vi-can-right?)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (len (length (list-ref L l))))
    (not (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)))))

(define (pad:vi-mode-word? cmd)
  (or (string=? cmd "vi-do")
      (string=? cmd "to-insert")
      (string=? cmd "to-normal")
      (string=? cmd "append")
      (string=? cmd "normal-key")))

;; --- command line and running the page ---

;; A let/define of display inside eval sticks to the top level on this
;; Aura, and set! of the primitive before that stick is an error. Put
;; the primitives back when the names are variables, and ignore the
;; error when the page never ran.
(define (pad:vi-restore-io!)
  (try (set! display *vi-disp*) (catch (e) 0))
  (try (set! newline *vi-nl*) (catch (e) 0)))

(define (pad:vi-cut s)
  (if (> (string-length s) 160) (string-append (substring s 0 160) "...") s))

(define (pad:vi-ol s i n acc k)
  (if (or (>= i n) (>= k 160))
      acc
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (pad:vi-ol s (+ i 1) n
                   (string-append acc
                                  (if (or (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 9))
                                      " "
                                      (list->string (list c))))
                   (+ k 1)))))

(define (pad:vi-one-line s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:vi-ol s 0 (string-length s) "" 0) ""))

(define (pad:vi-plist v d n)
  (cond
    ((> n 6) "...")
    ((null? v) "")
    ((not (pair? v)) (string-append ". " (pad:vi-p v (+ d 1))))
    ((null? (cdr v)) (pad:vi-p (car v) (+ d 1)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:vi-p (car v) (+ d 1)) " "
                       (pad:vi-plist (cdr v) d (+ n 1))))))

(define (pad:vi-p v d)
  (cond
    ((> d 4) "...")
    ((string? v) (pad:vi-one-line v))
    ((number? v) (number->string v))
    ((null? v) "()")
    ((equal? v #t) "#t")
    ((equal? v #f) "#f")
    ((pair? v) (string-append "(" (pad:vi-plist v d 0) ")"))
    (#t "a value")))

(define (pad:vi-add-s! s)
  (let ((cur (car *vi-out*)))
    (if (>= (string-length cur) 160)
        0
        (set-car! *vi-out* (string-append cur (pad:vi-one-line s))))))

(define (pad:vi-add! v)
  (pad:vi-add-s! (pad:vi-p v 0)))

(define (pad:vi-wrap src)
  (string-append
    "(try (cons 1 (let () (define (display v) (pad:vi-add! v)) (define (newline) (pad:vi-add! *vi-gap*)) "
    src
    ")) (catch (e) (cons 0 e)))"))

(define (pad:vi-skip-sp s i n)
  (if (or (>= i n) (not (= (string-ref s i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-sp s (+ i 1) n)))

(define (pad:vi-word-end s i n)
  (if (or (>= i n) (= (string-ref s i) 32))
      i
      (pad:vi-word-end s (+ i 1) n)))

(define (pad:vi-word s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (substring s (pad:vi-skip-sp s 0 n) (pad:vi-word-end s (pad:vi-skip-sp s 0 n) n))))

(define (pad:vi-first-line s)
  (let ((i (if (string? s) (string-index s "\n" 0) -1)))
    (cond
      ((not (string? s)) "")
      ((< i 0) s)
      (#t (substring s 0 i)))))

(define (pad:vi-after s mark)
  (let ((i (string-index s mark 0)))
    (if (< i 0) "" (substring s (+ i (string-length mark)) (string-length s)))))

;; Kid words only. The raw interpreter line can contain "unbound
;; variable" / "error:", and the smokes treat those as a Soft crash.
(define (pad:vi-soften s)
  (let* ((line (pad:vi-first-line s))
         (name (pad:vi-word (pad:vi-after line "unbound variable: "))))
    (cond
      ((> (string-length name) 0) (string-append name " is not defined yet"))
      ((or (string-contains? line "error:") (string-contains? line "unbound"))
       "did not run - check the parens")
      ((string=? line "") "did not run - check the parens")
      (#t (pad:vi-cut line)))))

(define (pad:vi-blank-i s i n)
  (if (>= i n)
      #t
      (let ((c (string-ref s i)))
        (if (or (= c 32) (= c 10) (= c 13) (= c 9))
            (pad:vi-blank-i s (+ i 1) n)
            #f))))

(define (pad:vi-blank? s)
  (pad:vi-blank-i s 0 (string-length s)))

(define (pad:vi-exec src)
  (set-car! *vi-out* "")
  (set! *vi-ran* (try (eval (pad:vi-wrap src)) (catch (e) (cons 0 e))))
  (pad:vi-restore-io!)
  *vi-ran*)

(define (pad:vi-report! r)
  (let ((out (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-one-line (car *vi-out*)))))
    (set! *pl-say*
          (cond
            ((not (pair? r)) "did not run - check the parens")
            ((and (number? (car r)) (= (car r) 0))
             (string-append "did not run: " (pad:vi-soften (cdr r))))
            ((and (number? (car r)) (= (car r) 1))
             (let ((v (cdr r)))
               (cond
                 ((and (null? v) (string=? out "")) "ran, and it returned nothing")
                 ((string=? out "") (string-append "ran: " (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-p v 0))))
                 ((null? v) (string-append "ran, printed: " out))
                 (#t (string-append "ran: " (pad:vi-cut (pad:vi-p v 0)) " printed: " out)))))
            (#t "did not run - check the parens")))))

(define (pad:vi-eval!)
  (if (pad:vi-blank? (pad:play-src))
      (begin
        (set! *pl-say* "the page is empty")
        (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
        "vi-do")
      (begin
        (pad:vi-report! (pad:vi-exec (pad:play-src)))
        (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
        "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-quit! force)
  (cond
    ((not (pad:vi-has-file?)) "quit")
    (force "quit")
    (*pf-ro* "quit")
    ((string=? (pad:play-src) *pf-saved*) "quit")
    (*pf-quit*
     (set! *pf-quit* #f)
     "quit")
    (#t
     (set! *pf-quit* #t)
     (set! *pl-say* (string-append *pf-name* " is not saved yet - ctrl-x ctrl-s saves,"
                                  " ctrl-x ctrl-c again quits"))
     "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-write! and-quit)
  (if (not (pad:vi-has-file?))
      (if and-quit
          "quit"
          (begin
            (set! *pl-say* "no file to save")
            "vi-do"))
      (let ((r (pad:pf-save!)))
        (if (and and-quit (string=? r "saved"))
            "quit"
            "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-colon!)
  (let ((w (pad:vi-word *vi-line*))
        (mx *vi-mx*))
    (set! *vi-op* "")
    (set! *vi-line* "")
    (set! *vi-mx* #f)
    (cond
      ((or (string=? w "e") (string=? w "eval") (string=? w "run")) (pad:vi-eval!))
      ((or (string=? w "q") (string=? w "quit")) (pad:vi-quit! #f))
      ((or (string=? w "q!") (string=? w "quit!")) (pad:vi-quit! #t))
      ((or (string=? w "w") (string=? w "write") (string=? w "save")) (pad:vi-write! #f))
      ((or (string=? w "wq") (string=? w "x")) (pad:vi-write! #t))
      ((string=? w "help")
       (set! *pl-say* "eval runs this page, w saves, q quits")
       "vi-do")
      ((string=? w "")
       (if mx
           (pad:vi-eval!)
           (begin
             (set! *pl-say* "eval runs this page, w saves, q quits")
             "vi-do")))
      (#t
       (set! *pl-say* (string-append "no command " w " - eval runs, w saves, q quits"))
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-colon-start! mx)
  (set! *vi-op* ":")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* mx)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *vi-prompt* (if mx "M-x " ": "))
  (set! *pl-say*
        (if mx
            "M-x - enter runs this page, q quits, w saves"
            ": - eval runs this page, w saves, q quits"))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-type! b)
  (if (< (string-length *vi-line*) 48)
      (set! *vi-line* (string-append *vi-line* (list->string (list b))))
      0)
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-bs!)
  (let ((n (string-length *vi-line*)))
    (if (= n 0)
        (pad:vi-cancel!)
        (begin
          (set! *vi-line* (substring *vi-line* 0 (- n 1)))
          (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
          "vi-do"))))

;; --- line edits (normal mode) ---

(define (pad:vi-undo-push U)
  (let ((un (length U)))
    (cond
      ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
      ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
      (#t U))))

(define (pad:vi-drop-line!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l)))
    (if (and (= n 1) (null? ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing to delete")
          "vi-do")
        (let* ((only (= n 1))
               (last (and (not only) (= l (- n 1))))
               (L2 (if only
                       (list (list))
                       (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                               (drop L (+ l 1)))))
               (l2 (cond (only 0) (last (- l 1)) (#t l)))
               (ln2 (list-ref L2 l2))
               (len2 (length ln2))
               (col2 (cond (last len2) (only 0) ((> col len2) len2) (#t col)))
               (kill (if only (list ln) (if last (list (list) ln) (list ln (list)))))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l2 col2 kill (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "deleted the line")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-x!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (>= col (length ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let ((ch (list-ref ln col)))
          (pad:play-cmd! "right")
          (pad:play-cmd! "back")
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                              (list (list ch)) (list) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-X!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (= col 0)
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing before the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let ((ch (list-ref ln (- col 1))))
          (pad:play-cmd! "back")
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car *pl-st*) (cadr *pl-st*) (caddr *pl-st*)
                              (list (list ch)) (list) (list-ref *pl-st* 5)))
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted a letter")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-D!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref (car st) (cadr st))))
    (if (>= col (length ln))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (begin
          (pad:play-cmd! "kill-line")
          (set! *pl-say* "deleted to the end of the line")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-yy!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l)))
    (set! *pl-st* (list L l (caddr st) (list ln (list)) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
    (pad:play-ok! "copied the line")
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:vi-p!)
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "yank")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (set! *pl-say* "pasted") 0)
    "vi-do"))

(define (pad:vi-replace! b)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (n (length L)))
    (if (>= col len)
        (begin
          (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
          (set! *pl-say* "nothing under the cursor")
          "vi-do")
        (let* ((pre (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col)))))
               (post (drop ln (+ col 1)))
               (ln2 (append pre (cons b post)))
               (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                           (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
               (U (pad:vi-undo-push (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))))
          (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col (list-ref st 3) (list) U))
          (pad:play-ok! "replaced")
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-insert-here!)
  (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (pad:vi-title!)
  (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-open-below!)
  (pad:play-cmd! "end")
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "enter")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-open-above!)
  (pad:play-cmd! "home")
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! "open-line")))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

(define (pad:vi-go-insert! cmd)
  (let ((r (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
    (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:vi-insert-here!) "vi-do")))

;; Words are runs of letters that are not spaces. w moves to the next
;; one, including the next line; b moves back to the start of a word.
(define (pad:vi-skip-word ln i len)
  (if (or (>= i len) (= (list-ref ln i) 32)) i (pad:vi-skip-word ln (+ i 1) len)))

(define (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln i len)
  (if (or (>= i len) (not (= (list-ref ln i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln (+ i 1) len)))

(define (pad:vi-w!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (n (length L))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (i (pad:vi-skip-spaces ln (pad:vi-skip-word ln col len) len)))
    (cond
      ((< i len)
       (set! *pl-st* (list L l i (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
       "vi-do")
      ((< l (- n 1))
       (set! *pl-st* (list L (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
       "vi-do")
      (#t
       (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
       "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln i)
  (if (or (< i 0) (not (= (list-ref ln i) 32)))
      i
      (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln (- i 1))))

(define (pad:vi-word-start ln i)
  (if (or (<= i 0) (= (list-ref ln (- i 1)) 32))
      i
      (pad:vi-word-start ln (- i 1))))

(define (pad:vi-b-pos L l col)
  (if (and (= l 0) (= col 0))
      #f
      (let* ((prev (= col 0))
             (l2 (if prev (- l 1) l))
             (ln (list-ref L l2))
             (start (if prev (length ln) col)))
        (if (= start 0)
            (pad:vi-b-pos L l2 0)
            (let ((i (pad:vi-skip-back-sp ln (- start 1))))
              (if (< i 0)
                  (if (= l2 0) #f (pad:vi-b-pos L l2 0))
                  (list l2 (pad:vi-word-start ln i))))))))

(define (pad:vi-b!)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (pos (pad:vi-b-pos (car st) (cadr st) (caddr st))))
    (if (not pos)
        (begin (pad:play-reject! "too-far") "vi-do")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (list (car st) (car pos) (cadr pos)
                              (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*)
          "vi-do"))))

(define (pad:vi-cancel!)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *pl-say* "normal - press i to type")
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-pend! op say)
  (set! *vi-op* op)
  (set! *vi-line* "")
  (set! *vi-mx* #f)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-redo! b)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (pad:vi-cmd b))

(define (pad:vi-act! name)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (cond
    ((string=? name "dd") (pad:vi-drop-line!))
    ((string=? name "x") (pad:vi-x!))
    ((string=? name "X") (pad:vi-X!))
    ((string=? name "D") (pad:vi-D!))
    ((string=? name "yy") (pad:vi-yy!))
    ((string=? name "p") (pad:vi-p!))
    ((string=? name "r") (pad:vi-replace! *vi-arg*))
    ((string=? name "o") (pad:vi-open-below!))
    ((string=? name "O") (pad:vi-open-above!))
    ((string=? name "I") (pad:vi-go-insert! "home"))
    ((string=? name "A") (pad:vi-go-insert! "end"))
    ((string=? name "w") (pad:vi-w!))
    ((string=? name "b") (pad:vi-b!))
    ((string=? name "eval") (pad:vi-eval!))
    ((string=? name "ZZ") (pad:vi-write! #t))
    ((string=? name "ZQ") (pad:vi-quit! #t))
    ((string=? name "cx")
     (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x - now ctrl-c quits, ctrl-e runs this page")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "cx-no")
     (set! *pl-say* "ctrl-x and that key do not go together")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "c-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "to quit press ctrl-q (ctrl-x ctrl-c works too)")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "d-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "d deletes a line - press d again")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "y-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "y copies a line - press y again")
     "vi-do")
    ((string=? name "r-hint")
     (set! *pl-say* "r replaces one letter")
     "vi-do")
    (#t (pad:vi-cancel!))))

(define (pad:vi-op-byte b)
  (cond
    ((= b 27) (pad:vi-cancel!))
    ((string=? *vi-op* ":")
     (cond
       ((or (= b 10) (= b 13)) (pad:vi-colon!))
       ((or (= b 8) (= b 127)) (pad:vi-bs!))
       ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (pad:vi-type! b))
       (#t (pad:vi-type-keep!))))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "d")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 100) (pad:vi-act! "dd") (pad:vi-act! "d-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "y")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 121) (pad:vi-act! "yy") (pad:vi-act! "y-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "g")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (= b 103) "bob" (pad:vi-redo! b)))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "r")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126))
         (begin (set! *vi-arg* b) (pad:vi-act! "r"))
         (pad:vi-act! "r-hint")))
    ((string=? *vi-op* "Z")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (cond
       ((= b 90) (pad:vi-act! "ZZ"))
       ((= b 81) (pad:vi-act! "ZQ"))
       (#t (pad:vi-redo! b))))
    (#t (pad:vi-cancel!))))

(define (pad:vi-type-keep!)
  (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
  "vi-do")

(define (pad:vi-cx-start!)
  (set! *vi-cx* #t)
  (set! *vi-op* "")
  (pad:vi-act! "cx"))

(define (pad:vi-cx-byte b)
  (set! *vi-cx* #f)
  (cond
    ((= b 3) "quit")
    ((= b 5) (pad:vi-act! "eval"))
    ((= b 17) "quit")
    (#t (pad:vi-act! "cx-no"))))

;; One idle byte -> a command word, a char code, or a mode word
;; (to-insert / to-normal / append / normal-key / vi-do).
(define (pad:vi-cmd b)
  (cond
    ((not (string=? *vi-op* "")) (pad:vi-op-byte b))
    (*vi-cx* (pad:vi-cx-byte b))
    ((= b 27) "to-normal")
    ((= b 24) (pad:vi-cx-start!))
    ((= b 3) (pad:vi-act! "c-hint"))
    ((= b 2) "left")
    ((= b 6) "right")
    ((= b 14) "next-line")
    ((= b 16) "prev-line")
    ((= b 29) "jump-back")
    ((= b 22) "copy-region")
    ((string=? *vi-mode* "insert")
     (if (and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) b (pad:vi-ctrl b)))
    ((= b 104) "left")
    ((= b 106) "next-line")
    ((= b 107) "prev-line")
    ((= b 108) "right")
    ((= b 105) "to-insert")
    ((= b 97) "append")
    ((= b 120) (pad:vi-act! "x"))
    ((= b 88) (pad:vi-act! "X"))
    ((= b 100) (pad:vi-pend! "d" "d - press d again to delete the line"))
    ((= b 68) (pad:vi-act! "D"))
    ((= b 121) (pad:vi-pend! "y" "y - press y again to copy the line"))
    ((= b 112) (pad:vi-act! "p"))
    ((= b 117) "undo")
    ((= b 48) "home")
    ((= b 36) "end")
    ((= b 103) (pad:vi-pend! "g" "g - press g again to go to the top"))
    ((= b 71) "eob")
    ((= b 73) (pad:vi-act! "I"))
    ((= b 65) (pad:vi-act! "A"))
    ((= b 111) (pad:vi-act! "o"))
    ((= b 79) (pad:vi-act! "O"))
    ((= b 114) (pad:vi-pend! "r" "r - type a letter to replace"))
    ((= b 119) (pad:vi-act! "w"))
    ((= b 98) (pad:vi-act! "b"))
    ((= b 58) (pad:vi-colon-start! #f))
    ((= b 90) (pad:vi-pend! "Z" "Z - Z saves and quits, Q quits"))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) "normal-key")
    (#t (pad:vi-ctrl b))))

;; Apply a mode word. Returns "snap" (the caller writes one frame)
;; or "quit". "vi-do" was already carried out in pad:vi-cmd.
(define (pad:vi-meta! c)
  (cond
    ((string=? c "vi-do") "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-insert")
     (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (set! *vi-cx* #f)
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "insert - type, esc goes back")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "to-normal")
     (set! *vi-mode* "normal")
     (set! *vi-op* "")
     (pad:vi-title!)
     (pad:play-ok! "normal - press i to type")
     "snap")
    ((string=? c "append")
     (let ((moved (pad:vi-can-right?)))
       (if moved (pad:play-cmd! "right") 0)
       (set! *vi-mode* "insert")
       (set! *vi-op* "")
       (set! *vi-cx* #f)
       (pad:vi-title!)
       (set! *pl-say* "insert - type, esc goes back")
       (if moved 0 (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1)))
       "snap"))
    (#t
     (pad:play-reject! "normal-key")
     "snap")))

(define (pad:vi-emit! r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? r "pending") "pending")
    (#t
     (if *pi-collect*
         (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
         (display (pad:play-snap)))
     "go")))

(define (pad:vi-took! cmd rest)
  (let* ((r (if (pad:vi-mode-word? cmd) (pad:vi-meta! cmd) (pad:play-cmd! cmd)))
         (e (pad:vi-emit! r)))
    (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))

;; Rest of a multi-byte line. esc is the escape-sequence state, passed
;; in so the loop does not capture an outer local. A trailing lone 27
;; leaves insert; 27 followed by 91 or 79 in this same line is an arrow.
;; 27 followed by 120 in this same line is Alt-x.
(define (pad:vi-each xs esc)
  (if (null? xs)
      (begin (set! *pl-esc* esc) "go")
      (let ((b (car xs)) (rest (cdr xs)))
        (cond
          ((and (null? esc) (string=? *vi-op* "")
                (= b 27) (pair? rest) (= (car rest) 120))
           (pad:vi-took! (pad:vi-colon-start! #t) (cdr rest)))
          ((pair? esc)
           (let* ((step (pad:key-step esc b))
                  (cmd (car step))
                  (esc2 (car (cdr step))))
             (if (and (string? cmd) (string=? cmd "pending"))
                 (pad:vi-each rest esc2)
                 (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:play-cmd! cmd))))
                   (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))))
          ((and (= b 27) (pair? rest) (or (= (car rest) 91) (= (car rest) 79)))
           (pad:vi-each rest (list 27)))
          ((and (= b 15) (null? esc))
           (let ((e (pad:vi-emit! (pad:who-key!))))
             (if (string=? e "quit") "quit" (pad:vi-each rest (list)))))
          (#t (pad:vi-took! (pad:vi-cmd b) rest))))))

(define (pad:vi-bytes! line)
  (set! *pi-slow* (+ *pi-slow* 1))
  (let ((bs (pad:pi-parse line)))
    (if (not bs)
        (begin
          (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
          (if *pi-collect*
              (set! *pi-out* (cons (pad:play-snap) *pi-out*))
              (display (pad:play-snap)))
          "go")
        (pad:vi-each bs *pl-esc*))))

target.name: pad:vi-bs!
target.body:
(lambda () (let ((n (string-length *vi-line*)))
    (if (= n 0)
        (pad:vi-cancel!)
        (begin
          (set! *vi-line* (substring *vi-line* 0 (- n 1)))
          (cond
            ((string=? *vi-op* "s") (pad:em-search-now!))
            ((or (string=? *vi-op* "find") (string=? *vi-op* "buf")) (pad:em-hint!))
            (#t
             (set! *pl-say* (string-append *vi-prompt* *vi-line*))
             "vi-do"))))))
