;; aura-pad M7 -- line-incremental Soft key path ("snappy pad").
;; Soft still owns every decision; this file only makes the per-key cost
;; scale with the edited LINE instead of the whole page.
;;
;; Per line Soft caches an entry (codes str toks tape open last1 last2
;; syms), a record (entry mkey mrow p1 p2) and the row string. A key
;; re-tokenizes only lines whose char codes changed (equal? on the code
;; list), reuses the HL tape of every other line, rebuilds a mark row
;; only when the name under the cursor or the def-carry into that line
;; changed, and marks DIRTY exactly the rows whose T/H/M text changed
;; (+ the cursor row).
;;
;; Exactness: whole-page tokenize and per-line tokenize agree whenever no
;; token crosses a newline. Only an unclosed string can; such a line sets
;; `open` and the frame falls back to the M6 full path (pad:hl-bundle +
;; pad:v-marks-in). Tests diff every frame against pad:snap-text.
;;
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; --- char classes (built from the M5 predicates, so equal by construction)
;; 0 other  1 space  2 digit  3 symbol  4 paren  5 semicolon  6 dquote
;; Built with cons + list->vector: on tip, vector-set! / set-car! cost
;; grows with workspace size (~15 ms each with the pad loaded), so this
;; file never mutates a vector or pair in place (see docs/perf.md).

(define (pad:lc-cls-of c)
  (cond
    ((or (= c 40) (= c 41)) 4)
    ((= c 59) 5)
    ((= c 34) 6)
    ((pad:hl-space? c) 1)
    ((pad:hl-digit? c) 2)
    ((pad:hl-sym? c) 3)
    (#t 0)))

;; Built by a named procedure, not a top-level named let: a top-level
;; named let that calls a user procedure, in a loaded file, broke later
;; prelude calls such as reverse (aura#4352).
(define (pad:lc-cls-list c acc)
  (if (< c 0) acc (pad:lc-cls-list (- c 1) (cons (pad:lc-cls-of c) acc))))

(define *lc-cls* (list->vector (pad:lc-cls-list 127 (list))))

(define (pad:lc-k s i)
  (let ((c (char->integer (string-ref s i))))
    (if (< c 128) (vector-ref *lc-cls* c) 0)))

(define (pad:lc-kind txt)
  (cond
    ((string-prefix? txt "query:") "Q")
    ((string-prefix? txt "mutate:") "M")
    ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
    (#t "S")))

;; Tokens of ONE line (no newline inside). Mirrors pad:hl-one exactly.
;; Returns (toks open): toks are ((kind a b text) ...) line-relative,
;; spaces skipped; open is #t when a string runs off the line unclosed.
(define (pad:lc-line-toks s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (>= i n)
          (list (reverse acc) #f)
          (let ((k (pad:lc-k s i)))
            (cond
              ((= k 4)
               (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list "P" i (+ i 1) (substring s i (+ i 1))) acc)))
              ((= k 5)
               (list (reverse (cons (list "C" i n (substring s i n)) acc)) #f))
              ((= k 6)
               (let str ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (cond
                   ((>= j n)
                    (list (reverse (cons (list "T" i n (substring s i n)) acc)) #t))
                   ((= (char->integer (string-ref s j)) 92)
                    (str (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
                   ((= (char->integer (string-ref s j)) 34)
                    (loop (+ j 1)
                          (cons (list "T" i (+ j 1) (substring s i (+ j 1))) acc)))
                   (#t (str (+ j 1))))))
              ((= k 1)
               (let sp ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (not (= (pad:lc-k s j) 1)))
                     (loop j acc)
                     (sp (+ j 1)))))
              ((and (= k 2)
                    (or (= i 0)
                        (let ((p (pad:lc-k s (- i 1)))) (or (= p 1) (= p 4)))))
               (let num ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (not (= (pad:lc-k s j) 2)))
                     (loop j (cons (list "N" i j (substring s i j)) acc))
                     (num (+ j 1)))))
              ((or (= k 2) (= k 3))
               (let sy ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let ((q (pad:lc-k s j))) (not (or (= q 2) (= q 3)))))
                     (let ((txt (substring s i j)))
                       (loop j (cons (list (pad:lc-kind txt) i j txt) acc)))
                     (sy (+ j 1)))))
              (#t (loop (+ i 1) acc))))))))

;; --- line entries ---
(define (pad:lc-ref-kind? k)
  (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K") (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M")))

(define (pad:lc-syms toks)
  (let loop ((ts toks) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) acc)
      ((pad:lc-ref-kind? (car (car ts)))
       (loop (cdr ts) (cons (list-ref (car ts) 3) acc)))
      (#t (loop (cdr ts) acc)))))

;; Runs of one letter, sliced per token (no per-char Soft loop).
(define *lc-dots* "................................................................")
(define *lc-run-max* 64)

(define (pad:lc-run-of ch)
  (list->string (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (>= i *lc-run-max*) acc (loop (+ i 1) (cons ch acc))))))

(define *lc-runs*
  (list (list "P" (pad:lc-run-of #\P)) (list "S" (pad:lc-run-of #\S))
        (list "K" (pad:lc-run-of #\K)) (list "N" (pad:lc-run-of #\N))
        (list "T" (pad:lc-run-of #\T)) (list "C" (pad:lc-run-of #\C))
        (list "Q" (pad:lc-run-of #\Q)) (list "M" (pad:lc-run-of #\M))
        (list "d" (pad:lc-run-of #\d)) (list "r" (pad:lc-run-of #\r))))

(define (pad:lc-run kind k)
  (let loop ((xs *lc-runs*))
    (if (string=? (car (car xs)) kind)
        (substring (cadr (car xs)) 0 k)
        (loop (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:lc-dots n)
  (if (<= n *lc-run-max*)
      (substring *lc-dots* 0 n)
      (string-append *lc-dots* (pad:lc-dots (- n *lc-run-max*)))))

;; HL tape of one line, one slice per token (== pad:hl-color-from-tokens).
(define (pad:lc-tape s toks)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (if (> n *lc-run-max*)
        (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
        (let loop ((i 0) (ts toks) (acc (list)))
          (if (null? ts)
              (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
              (let* ((t (car ts)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t)))
                (loop b (cdr ts)
                      (cons (pad:lc-run (car t) (- b a))
                            (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc)))))))))

;; Entry: (codes str toks tape open last1 last2 syms)
(define (pad:lc-entry codes)
  (let* ((str (list->string (map integer->char codes)))
         (r (pad:lc-line-toks str))
         (toks (car r))
         (rv (reverse toks)))
    (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1))
    (list codes str toks (pad:lc-tape str toks) (cadr r)
          (if (pair? rv) (car rv) #f)
          (if (and (pair? rv) (pair? (cdr rv))) (cadr rv) #f)
          (pad:lc-syms toks))))

(define (pad:lc-e-codes e) (car e))
(define (pad:lc-e-str e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (pad:lc-e-toks e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (pad:lc-e-tape e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (pad:lc-e-open e) (list-ref e 4))

;; --- marks (def/use of the name under the cursor) ---
(define (pad:lc-kdef? t)
  (and t (string=? (car t) "K") (string=? (list-ref t 3) "define")))

;; def-carry key into a line: the only facts about earlier tokens that
;; pad:find-defs-in can still use on this line's first two tokens.
(define (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)
  (list (if (pad:lc-kdef? p1) 1 0)
        (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "P") (pad:lc-kdef? p2)) 1 0)))

(define (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2)
  (let ((a (list-ref e 5)) (b (list-ref e 6)))
    (cond
      ((not a) (list p1 p2))
      ((not b) (list a p1))
      (#t (list a b)))))

;; Mark row for one line: same rule as pad:find-defs-in / pad:v-marks-in,
;; prev/prev2 carried in from earlier lines; one slice per token.
(define (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (pad:lc-e-str e))
         (n (string-length str)))
    (cond
      ((or (string=? name "") (not (member name (list-ref e 7))))
       (pad:lc-dots n))
      ((> n *lc-run-max*)
       (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2))
      (#t
       (let loop ((i 0) (ts (pad:lc-e-toks e)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? ts)
             (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
             (let* ((t (car ts)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                    (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                              (pad:lc-ref-kind? (car t))))
                    (def (and ref
                              (or (pad:lc-kdef? prev)
                                  (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                       (pad:lc-kdef? prev2))))))
               (loop b (cdr ts) t prev
                     (cons (if ref (pad:lc-run (if def "d" "r") (- b a))
                               (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- b a)))
                           (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc))))))))))

;; Long-line fallback (> 64 chars): per-char walk, same rule.
(define (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (pad:lc-e-str e)) (n (string-length str)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (ts (pad:lc-e-toks e)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
      (cond
        ((>= i n) (list->string (reverse acc)))
        ((and (pair? ts) (= (cadr (car ts)) i))
         (let* ((t (car ts))
                (b (caddr t))
                (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name) (pad:lc-ref-kind? (car t))))
                (def (and ref (or (pad:lc-kdef? prev)
                                  (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                       (pad:lc-kdef? prev2)))))
                (ch (if ref (if def #\d #\r) #\.)))
           (let fill ((j i) (xs acc))
             (if (>= j b) (loop b (cdr ts) t prev xs) (fill (+ j 1) (cons ch xs))))))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) ts prev prev2 (cons #\. acc)))))))

(define (pad:lc-row str tape mrow)
  (string-append "T " str "\nH " tape "\nM " mrow "\n"))

;; --- cache state (only pad:lc-* write it) ---
;; record = (entry mkey mrow p1 p2); mrow #f = rebuild on next fast frame.
(define *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))   ; records of the last frame
(define *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))  ; row strings of the last frame
(define *lc-L* (list))                 ; editor lines of the last frame
(define *lc-cur* -1)                   ; cursor row of the last frame
(define *lc-name* "")                  ; name under the cursor, last frame
(define *lc-full* 0)                   ; 1 when the last frame used the full path
(define *lc-framed* 0)
;; Observability counters (PERF / smoke lines, never on the wire).
(define *lc-retok* 0)                  ; line tokenizes since reset
(define *lc-frames* 0)
(define *lc-fulls* 0)                  ; frames that fell back to full tokenize
(define *lc-moves* 0)                  ; cursor-only frames
(define *lc-lines* 0)                  ; one-line-edit frames

(define (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))
  (set! *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))
  (set! *lc-L* (list))
  (set! *lc-cur* -1)
  (set! *lc-name* "")
  (set! *lc-full* 0)
  (set! *lc-framed* 0)
  (set! *lc-retok* 0)
  (set! *lc-frames* 0)
  (set! *lc-fulls* 0)
  (set! *lc-moves* 0)
  (set! *lc-lines* 0)
  0)

;; Old record at index j whose codes equal codes, or #f.
(define (pad:lc-old-at j codes)
  (if (and (>= j 0) (< j (vector-length *lc-recv*)))
      (let ((r (vector-ref *lc-recv* j)))
        (if (equal? (pad:lc-e-codes (car r)) codes) r #f))
      #f))

;; Match new line i against old rows: last shift d first, then i, i-1, i+1
;; (one enter / one join keeps every later row cached).
(define (pad:lc-match i d codes)
  (let ((a (pad:lc-old-at (+ i d) codes)))
    (if a
        (list a d)
        (let ((b (pad:lc-old-at i codes)))
          (if b
              (list b 0)
              (let ((c (pad:lc-old-at (- i 1) codes)))
                (if c
                    (list c -1)
                    (let ((x (pad:lc-old-at (+ i 1) codes)))
                      (if x (list x 1) #f)))))))))

;; Entries for L: reuse old entries (and their old record) when codes match.
;; Returns list of (entry old-record-or-#f).
(define (pad:lc-entries L)
  (let loop ((xs L) (i 0) (d 0) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let ((m (pad:lc-match i d (car xs))))
          (if m
              (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) (cadr m) (cons (list (car (car m)) (car m)) acc))
              (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) d (cons (list (pad:lc-entry (car xs)) #f) acc)))))))

(define (pad:lc-any-open? es)
  (cond
    ((null? es) #f)
    ((pad:lc-e-open (car (car es))) #t)
    (#t (pad:lc-any-open? (cdr es)))))

;; Fast rows from per-line entries: list of (record row-string).
(define (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)
  (let loop ((xs es) (i 0) (p1 #f) (p2 #f) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
               (old (cadr (car xs)))
               (mkey (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)))
               (keep (and old (list-ref old 2) (equal? (list-ref old 1) mkey)))
               (mrow (if keep (list-ref old 2) (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)))
               (co (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2)))
          (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) (car co) (cadr co)
                (cons (list (list e mkey mrow p1 p2)
                            (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow))
                      acc))))))

;; Full path (an unclosed string crosses a newline): the M6 whole-page
;; tokenize. Records keep the entry but no mark row.
(define (pad:lc-full-recs es L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (b (pad:hl-bundle src))
         (tape (car b))
         (marks (pad:v-marks-in src (pad:v-point L l col) (cadr b))))
    (let loop ((xs es) (off 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (null? xs)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
                 (str (pad:lc-e-str e))
                 (k (string-length str))
                 (ee (+ off k)))
            (loop (cdr xs) (+ ee 1)
                  (cons (list (list e #f #f #f #f)
                              (pad:lc-row str (substring tape off ee)
                                          (substring marks off ee)))
                        acc)))))))

;; Rows that differ from the last frame (by index) plus the cursor row.
(define (pad:lc-dirty old new l)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a old) (b new) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? b) (reverse acc))
      ((or (= i l) (null? a) (not (string=? (car a) (car b))))
       (loop (+ i 1) (if (null? a) a (cdr a)) (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc)))))

(define (pad:lc-name-at e col) (pad:sym-at-in (pad:lc-e-toks e) col))

(define (pad:lc-commit! L l name full)
  (set! *lc-L* L)
  (set! *lc-cur* l)
  (set! *lc-name* name)
  (set! *lc-full* full)
  (set! *lc-framed* 1)
  (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
  0)

;; Generic frame: match every row, rebuild what changed. Returns dirty.
(define (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
  (let* ((es (pad:lc-entries L))
         (full (pad:lc-any-open? es))
         (name (if full "" (pad:lc-name-at (car (list-ref es l)) col)))
         (rr (if full (pad:lc-full-recs es L l col) (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)))
         (rows (map cadr rr))
         (dirty (if (= *lc-framed* 0)
                    (list)
                    (pad:lc-dirty (vector->list *lc-rowv*) rows l))))
    (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (map car rr)))
    (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
    (if full (set! *lc-fulls* (+ *lc-fulls* 1)))
    (pad:lc-commit! L l name (if full 1 0))
    dirty))

;; xs ascending without l -> ascending with l.
(define (pad:lc-with l xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list l))
    ((= (car xs) l) xs)
    ((< l (car xs)) (cons l xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:lc-with l (cdr xs))))))

;; Name under the cursor changed, text did not: only rows that hold the
;; old or the new name can change their mark row. Each record keeps its
;; def-carry (p1 p2), so no other row is walked. Returns dirty rows.
(define (pad:lc-remark! name l)
  (let ((old-name *lc-name*))
    (let loop ((rs (vector->list *lc-recv*)) (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
               (i 0) (racc (list)) (wacc (list)) (dacc (list)))
      (if (null? rs)
          (begin
            (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (reverse racc)))
            (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector (reverse wacc)))
            (pad:lc-with l (reverse dacc)))
          (let* ((r (car rs))
                 (e (car r))
                 (sy (list-ref e 7)))
            (if (or (member name sy) (member old-name sy))
                (let* ((p1 (list-ref r 3))
                       (p2 (list-ref r 4))
                       (mrow (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2))
                       (row (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow)))
                  (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1)
                        (cons (list e (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)) mrow p1 p2) racc)
                        (cons row wacc)
                        (if (string=? row (car ws)) dacc (cons i dacc))))
                (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1) (cons r racc) (cons (car ws) wacc) dacc)))))))

;; Cursor-only frame (same lines object): rows change only if the name
;; under the cursor changed (marks); else only the cursor row is dirty.
(define (pad:lc-move! L l col)
  (let ((name (pad:lc-name-at (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) col)))
    (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
    (if (string=? name *lc-name*)
        (begin (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0) (list l))
        (let ((dirty (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
          (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0)
          dirty))))

;; Copy of vector v with slot i = x, builtins only (no vector-set!).
(define (pad:lc-vput v i x)
  (let* ((xs (vector->list v))
         (n (length xs)))
    (list->vector
      (append (reverse (list-tail (reverse xs) (- n i)))
              (cons x (list-tail xs (+ i 1)))))))

;; Do L and the last frame's lines differ only at row l (same row count)?
(define (pad:lc-one-line? L l)
  (let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
    (and (= n (length old))
         (< l n)
         (equal? (list-tail L (+ l 1)) (list-tail old (+ l 1)))
         (equal? (list-tail (reverse L) (- n l))
                 (list-tail (reverse old) (- n l))))))

;; One-line edit frame: re-tokenize row l only. If the name under the
;; cursor and the def-carry out of row l are unchanged, no other row can
;; change; else fall back to the generic frame (entries still reused).
(define (pad:lc-line! L l col)
  (let* ((e (pad:lc-entry (list-ref L l)))
         (old (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)))
    (if (or (pad:lc-e-open e) (not (list-ref old 2)))
        (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
        (let* ((name (pad:lc-name-at e col))
               (p1 (list-ref old 3))
               (p2 (list-ref old 4))
               (co-new (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2))
               (co-old (pad:lc-carry-out (car old) p1 p2)))
          (if (and (string=? name *lc-name*)
                   (equal? (pad:lc-carry-key (car co-new) (cadr co-new))
                           (pad:lc-carry-key (car co-old) (cadr co-old))))
              (let ((mrow (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)))
                (set! *lc-recv*
                      (pad:lc-vput *lc-recv* l
                                   (list e (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)) mrow p1 p2)))
                (set! *lc-rowv*
                      (pad:lc-vput *lc-rowv* l
                                   (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow)))
                (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0)
                (list l))
              (begin
                ;; let the generic frame reuse the fresh entry for row l
                (set! *lc-recv* (pad:lc-vput *lc-recv* l (list e #f #f p1 p2)))
                (pad:lc-generic! L l col)))))))

;; One frame. Returns dirty rows; () on the first frame (Soft omits
;; DIRTY; C full-blits).
(define (pad:lc-frame! L l col)
  (cond
    ((or (= *lc-framed* 0) (= *lc-full* 1)) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
    ((eq? L *lc-L*) (pad:lc-move! L l col))
    ((pad:lc-one-line? L l) (pad:lc-line! L l col))
    (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))

;; Whole SNAP block from the line cache. Same bytes as pad:snap-text plus
;; an optional DIRTY line (see view.aura / c/snap.c).
(define (pad:lc-snap title L l col say)
  (let* ((dirty (pad:lc-frame! L l col))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " say "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"

;; Whole-page tokens for jump / refs, from the cache when it holds L
;; (offsets shifted per line; equal to pad:hl-tokens when no line is
;; open), else a real full tokenize.
(define (pad:lc-toks L)
  (if (and (= *lc-full* 0) (= *lc-framed* 1) (equal? L *lc-L*))
      (let loop ((i 0) (off 0) (acc (list)))
        (if (>= i (vector-length *lc-recv*))
            (apply append (reverse acc))
            (let ((e (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* i))))
              (loop (+ i 1)
                    (+ off (string-length (pad:lc-e-str e)) 1)
                    (cons (map (lambda (t)
                                 (list (car t) (+ off (cadr t)) (+ off (caddr t))
                                       (list-ref t 3)))
                               (pad:lc-e-toks e))
                          acc)))))
      (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L))))

;; aura-pad M7 -- line-incremental Soft key path ("snappy pad").
;; Soft still owns every decision; this file only makes the per-key cost
;; scale with the edited LINE instead of the whole page.
;;
;; Per line Soft caches an entry (codes str toks tape open last1 last2
;; syms), a record (entry mkey mrow p1 p2) and the row string. A key
;; re-tokenizes only lines whose char codes changed (equal? on the code
;; list), reuses the HL tape of every other line, rebuilds a mark row
;; only when the name under the cursor or the def-carry into that line
;; changed, and marks DIRTY exactly the rows whose T/H/M text changed
;; (+ the cursor row).
;;
;; Exactness: whole-page tokenize and per-line tokenize agree whenever no
;; token crosses a newline. Only an unclosed string can; such a line sets
;; `open` and the frame falls back to the M6 full path (pad:hl-bundle +
;; pad:v-marks-in). Tests diff every frame against pad:snap-text.
;;
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; --- char classes (built from the M5 predicates, so equal by construction)
;; 0 other  1 space  2 digit  3 symbol  4 paren  5 semicolon  6 dquote
;; Built with cons + list->vector: on tip, vector-set! / set-car! cost
;; grows with workspace size (~15 ms each with the pad loaded), so this
;; file never mutates a vector or pair in place (see docs/perf.md).

(define (pad:lc-cls-of c)
  (cond
    ((or (= c 40) (= c 41)) 4)
    ((= c 59) 5)
    ((= c 34) 6)
    ((pad:hl-space? c) 1)
    ((pad:hl-digit? c) 2)
    ((pad:hl-sym? c) 3)
    (#t 0)))

;; Built by a named procedure, not a top-level named let: a top-level
;; named let that calls a user procedure, in a loaded file, broke later
;; prelude calls such as reverse (aura#4352).
(define (pad:lc-cls-list c acc)
  (if (< c 0) acc (pad:lc-cls-list (- c 1) (cons (pad:lc-cls-of c) acc))))

(define *lc-cls* (list->vector (pad:lc-cls-list 127 (list))))

(define (pad:lc-k s i)
  (let ((c (char->integer (string-ref s i))))
    (if (< c 128) (vector-ref *lc-cls* c) 0)))

(define (pad:lc-kind txt)
  (cond
    ((string-prefix? txt "query:") "Q")
    ((string-prefix? txt "mutate:") "M")
    ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
    (#t "S")))

;; Tokens of ONE line (no newline inside). Mirrors pad:hl-one exactly.
;; Returns (toks open): toks are ((kind a b text) ...) line-relative,
;; spaces skipped; open is #t when a string runs off the line unclosed.
(define (pad:lc-line-toks s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (>= i n)
          (list (reverse acc) #f)
          (let ((k (pad:lc-k s i)))
            (cond
              ((= k 4)
               (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list "P" i (+ i 1) (substring s i (+ i 1))) acc)))
              ((= k 5)
               (list (reverse (cons (list "C" i n (substring s i n)) acc)) #f))
              ((= k 6)
               (let str ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (cond
                   ((>= j n)
                    (list (reverse (cons (list "T" i n (substring s i n)) acc)) #t))
                   ((= (char->integer (string-ref s j)) 92)
                    (str (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
                   ((= (char->integer (string-ref s j)) 34)
                    (loop (+ j 1)
                          (cons (list "T" i (+ j 1) (substring s i (+ j 1))) acc)))
                   (#t (str (+ j 1))))))
              ((= k 1)
               (let sp ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (not (= (pad:lc-k s j) 1)))
                     (loop j acc)
                     (sp (+ j 1)))))
              ((and (= k 2)
                    (or (= i 0)
                        (let ((p (pad:lc-k s (- i 1)))) (or (= p 1) (= p 4)))))
               (let num ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (not (= (pad:lc-k s j) 2)))
                     (loop j (cons (list "N" i j (substring s i j)) acc))
                     (num (+ j 1)))))
              ((or (= k 2) (= k 3))
               (let sy ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let ((q (pad:lc-k s j))) (not (or (= q 2) (= q 3)))))
                     (let ((txt (substring s i j)))
                       (loop j (cons (list (pad:lc-kind txt) i j txt) acc)))
                     (sy (+ j 1)))))
              (#t (loop (+ i 1) acc))))))))

;; --- line entries ---
(define (pad:lc-ref-kind? k)
  (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K") (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M")))

(define (pad:lc-syms toks)
  (let loop ((ts toks) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) acc)
      ((pad:lc-ref-kind? (car (car ts)))
       (loop (cdr ts) (cons (list-ref (car ts) 3) acc)))
      (#t (loop (cdr ts) acc)))))

;; Runs of one letter, sliced per token (no per-char Soft loop).
(define *lc-dots* "................................................................")
(define *lc-run-max* 64)

(define (pad:lc-run-of ch)
  (list->string (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (>= i *lc-run-max*) acc (loop (+ i 1) (cons ch acc))))))

(define *lc-runs*
  (list (list "P" (pad:lc-run-of #\P)) (list "S" (pad:lc-run-of #\S))
        (list "K" (pad:lc-run-of #\K)) (list "N" (pad:lc-run-of #\N))
        (list "T" (pad:lc-run-of #\T)) (list "C" (pad:lc-run-of #\C))
        (list "Q" (pad:lc-run-of #\Q)) (list "M" (pad:lc-run-of #\M))
        (list "d" (pad:lc-run-of #\d)) (list "r" (pad:lc-run-of #\r))))

(define (pad:lc-run kind k)
  (let loop ((xs *lc-runs*))
    (if (string=? (car (car xs)) kind)
        (substring (cadr (car xs)) 0 k)
        (loop (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:lc-dots n)
  (if (<= n *lc-run-max*)
      (substring *lc-dots* 0 n)
      (string-append *lc-dots* (pad:lc-dots (- n *lc-run-max*)))))

;; HL tape of one line, one slice per token (== pad:hl-color-from-tokens).
(define (pad:lc-tape s toks)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (if (> n *lc-run-max*)
        (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
        (let loop ((i 0) (ts toks) (acc (list)))
          (if (null? ts)
              (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
              (let* ((t (car ts)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t)))
                (loop b (cdr ts)
                      (cons (pad:lc-run (car t) (- b a))
                            (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc)))))))))

;; Entry: (codes str toks tape open last1 last2 syms)
(define (pad:lc-entry codes)
  (let* ((str (list->string (map integer->char codes)))
         (r (pad:lc-line-toks str))
         (toks (car r))
         (rv (reverse toks)))
    (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1))
    (list codes str toks (pad:lc-tape str toks) (cadr r)
          (if (pair? rv) (car rv) #f)
          (if (and (pair? rv) (pair? (cdr rv))) (cadr rv) #f)
          (pad:lc-syms toks))))

(define (pad:lc-e-codes e) (car e))
(define (pad:lc-e-str e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (pad:lc-e-toks e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (pad:lc-e-tape e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (pad:lc-e-open e) (list-ref e 4))

;; --- marks (def/use of the name under the cursor) ---
(define (pad:lc-kdef? t)
  (and t (string=? (car t) "K") (string=? (list-ref t 3) "define")))

;; def-carry key into a line: the only facts about earlier tokens that
;; pad:find-defs-in can still use on this line's first two tokens.
(define (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)
  (list (if (pad:lc-kdef? p1) 1 0)
        (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "P") (pad:lc-kdef? p2)) 1 0)))

(define (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2)
  (let ((a (list-ref e 5)) (b (list-ref e 6)))
    (cond
      ((not a) (list p1 p2))
      ((not b) (list a p1))
      (#t (list a b)))))

;; Mark row for one line: same rule as pad:find-defs-in / pad:v-marks-in,
;; prev/prev2 carried in from earlier lines; one slice per token.
(define (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (pad:lc-e-str e))
         (n (string-length str)))
    (cond
      ((or (string=? name "") (not (member name (list-ref e 7))))
       (pad:lc-dots n))
      ((> n *lc-run-max*)
       (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2))
      (#t
       (let loop ((i 0) (ts (pad:lc-e-toks e)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? ts)
             (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
             (let* ((t (car ts)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                    (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                              (pad:lc-ref-kind? (car t))))
                    (def (and ref
                              (or (pad:lc-kdef? prev)
                                  (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                       (pad:lc-kdef? prev2))))))
               (loop b (cdr ts) t prev
                     (cons (if ref (pad:lc-run (if def "d" "r") (- b a))
                               (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- b a)))
                           (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc))))))))))

;; Long-line fallback (> 64 chars): per-char walk, same rule.
(define (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (pad:lc-e-str e)) (n (string-length str)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (ts (pad:lc-e-toks e)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
      (cond
        ((>= i n) (list->string (reverse acc)))
        ((and (pair? ts) (= (cadr (car ts)) i))
         (let* ((t (car ts))
                (b (caddr t))
                (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name) (pad:lc-ref-kind? (car t))))
                (def (and ref (or (pad:lc-kdef? prev)
                                  (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                       (pad:lc-kdef? prev2)))))
                (ch (if ref (if def #\d #\r) #\.)))
           (let fill ((j i) (xs acc))
             (if (>= j b) (loop b (cdr ts) t prev xs) (fill (+ j 1) (cons ch xs))))))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) ts prev prev2 (cons #\. acc)))))))

(define (pad:lc-row str tape mrow)
  (string-append "T " str "\nH " tape "\nM " mrow "\n"))

;; --- cache state (only pad:lc-* write it) ---
;; record = (entry mkey mrow p1 p2); mrow #f = rebuild on next fast frame.
(define *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))   ; records of the last frame
(define *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))  ; row strings of the last frame
(define *lc-L* (list))                 ; editor lines of the last frame
(define *lc-cur* -1)                   ; cursor row of the last frame
(define *lc-name* "")                  ; name under the cursor, last frame
(define *lc-full* 0)                   ; 1 when the last frame used the full path
(define *lc-framed* 0)
;; Observability counters (PERF / smoke lines, never on the wire).
(define *lc-retok* 0)                  ; line tokenizes since reset
(define *lc-frames* 0)
(define *lc-fulls* 0)                  ; frames that fell back to full tokenize
(define *lc-moves* 0)                  ; cursor-only frames
(define *lc-lines* 0)                  ; one-line-edit frames

(define (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))
  (set! *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))
  (set! *lc-L* (list))
  (set! *lc-cur* -1)
  (set! *lc-name* "")
  (set! *lc-full* 0)
  (set! *lc-framed* 0)
  (set! *lc-retok* 0)
  (set! *lc-frames* 0)
  (set! *lc-fulls* 0)
  (set! *lc-moves* 0)
  (set! *lc-lines* 0)
  0)

;; Old record at index j whose codes equal codes, or #f.
(define (pad:lc-old-at j codes)
  (if (and (>= j 0) (< j (vector-length *lc-recv*)))
      (let ((r (vector-ref *lc-recv* j)))
        (if (equal? (pad:lc-e-codes (car r)) codes) r #f))
      #f))

;; Match new line i against old rows: last shift d first, then i, i-1, i+1
;; (one enter / one join keeps every later row cached).
(define (pad:lc-match i d codes)
  (let ((a (pad:lc-old-at (+ i d) codes)))
    (if a
        (list a d)
        (let ((b (pad:lc-old-at i codes)))
          (if b
              (list b 0)
              (let ((c (pad:lc-old-at (- i 1) codes)))
                (if c
                    (list c -1)
                    (let ((x (pad:lc-old-at (+ i 1) codes)))
                      (if x (list x 1) #f)))))))))

;; Entries for L: reuse old entries (and their old record) when codes match.
;; Returns list of (entry old-record-or-#f).
(define (pad:lc-entries L)
  (let loop ((xs L) (i 0) (d 0) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let ((m (pad:lc-match i d (car xs))))
          (if m
              (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) (cadr m) (cons (list (car (car m)) (car m)) acc))
              (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) d (cons (list (pad:lc-entry (car xs)) #f) acc)))))))

(define (pad:lc-any-open? es)
  (cond
    ((null? es) #f)
    ((pad:lc-e-open (car (car es))) #t)
    (#t (pad:lc-any-open? (cdr es)))))

;; Fast rows from per-line entries: list of (record row-string).
(define (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)
  (let loop ((xs es) (i 0) (p1 #f) (p2 #f) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
               (old (cadr (car xs)))
               (mkey (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)))
               (keep (and old (list-ref old 2) (equal? (list-ref old 1) mkey)))
               (mrow (if keep (list-ref old 2) (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)))
               (co (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2)))
          (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) (car co) (cadr co)
                (cons (list (list e mkey mrow p1 p2)
                            (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow))
                      acc))))))

;; Full path (an unclosed string crosses a newline): the M6 whole-page
;; tokenize. Records keep the entry but no mark row.
(define (pad:lc-full-recs es L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (b (pad:hl-bundle src))
         (tape (car b))
         (marks (pad:v-marks-in src (pad:v-point L l col) (cadr b))))
    (let loop ((xs es) (off 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (null? xs)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
                 (str (pad:lc-e-str e))
                 (k (string-length str))
                 (ee (+ off k)))
            (loop (cdr xs) (+ ee 1)
                  (cons (list (list e #f #f #f #f)
                              (pad:lc-row str (substring tape off ee)
                                          (substring marks off ee)))
                        acc)))))))

;; Rows that differ from the last frame (by index) plus the cursor row.
(define (pad:lc-dirty old new l)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a old) (b new) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? b) (reverse acc))
      ((or (= i l) (null? a) (not (string=? (car a) (car b))))
       (loop (+ i 1) (if (null? a) a (cdr a)) (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc)))))

(define (pad:lc-name-at e col) (pad:sym-at-in (pad:lc-e-toks e) col))

(define (pad:lc-commit! L l name full)
  (set! *lc-L* L)
  (set! *lc-cur* l)
  (set! *lc-name* name)
  (set! *lc-full* full)
  (set! *lc-framed* 1)
  (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
  0)

;; Generic frame: match every row, rebuild what changed. Returns dirty.
(define (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
  (let* ((es (pad:lc-entries L))
         (full (pad:lc-any-open? es))
         (name (if full "" (pad:lc-name-at (car (list-ref es l)) col)))
         (rr (if full (pad:lc-full-recs es L l col) (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)))
         (rows (map cadr rr))
         (dirty (if (= *lc-framed* 0)
                    (list)
                    (pad:lc-dirty (vector->list *lc-rowv*) rows l))))
    (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (map car rr)))
    (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
    (if full (set! *lc-fulls* (+ *lc-fulls* 1)))
    (pad:lc-commit! L l name (if full 1 0))
    dirty))

;; xs ascending without l -> ascending with l.
(define (pad:lc-with l xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list l))
    ((= (car xs) l) xs)
    ((< l (car xs)) (cons l xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:lc-with l (cdr xs))))))

;; Name under the cursor changed, text did not: only rows that hold the
;; old or the new name can change their mark row. Each record keeps its
;; def-carry (p1 p2), so no other row is walked. Returns dirty rows.
(define (pad:lc-remark! name l)
  (let ((old-name *lc-name*))
    (let loop ((rs (vector->list *lc-recv*)) (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
               (i 0) (racc (list)) (wacc (list)) (dacc (list)))
      (if (null? rs)
          (begin
            (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (reverse racc)))
            (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector (reverse wacc)))
            (pad:lc-with l (reverse dacc)))
          (let* ((r (car rs))
                 (e (car r))
                 (sy (list-ref e 7)))
            (if (or (member name sy) (member old-name sy))
                (let* ((p1 (list-ref r 3))
                       (p2 (list-ref r 4))
                       (mrow (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2))
                       (row (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow)))
                  (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1)
                        (cons (list e (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)) mrow p1 p2) racc)
                        (cons row wacc)
                        (if (string=? row (car ws)) dacc (cons i dacc))))
                (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1) (cons r racc) (cons (car ws) wacc) dacc)))))))

;; Cursor-only frame (same lines object): rows change only if the name
;; under the cursor changed (marks); else only the cursor row is dirty.
(define (pad:lc-move! L l col)
  (let ((name (pad:lc-name-at (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) col)))
    (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
    (if (string=? name *lc-name*)
        (begin (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0) (list l))
        (let ((dirty (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
          (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0)
          dirty))))

;; Copy of vector v with slot i = x, builtins only (no vector-set!).
(define (pad:lc-vput v i x)
  (let* ((xs (vector->list v))
         (n (length xs)))
    (list->vector
      (append (reverse (list-tail (reverse xs) (- n i)))
              (cons x (list-tail xs (+ i 1)))))))

;; Do L and the last frame's lines differ only at row l (same row count)?
(define (pad:lc-one-line? L l)
  (let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
    (and (= n (length old))
         (< l n)
         (equal? (list-tail L (+ l 1)) (list-tail old (+ l 1)))
         (equal? (list-tail (reverse L) (- n l))
                 (list-tail (reverse old) (- n l))))))

;; One-line edit frame: re-tokenize row l only. If the name under the
;; cursor and the def-carry out of row l are unchanged, no other row can
;; change; else fall back to the generic frame (entries still reused).
(define (pad:lc-line! L l col)
  (let* ((e (pad:lc-entry (list-ref L l)))
         (old (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)))
    (if (or (pad:lc-e-open e) (not (list-ref old 2)))
        (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
        (let* ((name (pad:lc-name-at e col))
               (p1 (list-ref old 3))
               (p2 (list-ref old 4))
               (co-new (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2))
               (co-old (pad:lc-carry-out (car old) p1 p2)))
          (if (and (string=? name *lc-name*)
                   (equal? (pad:lc-carry-key (car co-new) (cadr co-new))
                           (pad:lc-carry-key (car co-old) (cadr co-old))))
              (let ((mrow (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)))
                (set! *lc-recv*
                      (pad:lc-vput *lc-recv* l
                                   (list e (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)) mrow p1 p2)))
                (set! *lc-rowv*
                      (pad:lc-vput *lc-rowv* l
                                   (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow)))
                (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0)
                (list l))
              (begin
                ;; let the generic frame reuse the fresh entry for row l
                (set! *lc-recv* (pad:lc-vput *lc-recv* l (list e #f #f p1 p2)))
                (pad:lc-generic! L l col)))))))

;; One frame. Returns dirty rows; () on the first frame (Soft omits
;; DIRTY; C full-blits).
(define (pad:lc-frame! L l col)
  (cond
    ((or (= *lc-framed* 0) (= *lc-full* 1)) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
    ((eq? L *lc-L*) (pad:lc-move! L l col))
    ((pad:lc-one-line? L l) (pad:lc-line! L l col))
    (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))

;; Whole SNAP block from the line cache. Same bytes as pad:snap-text plus
;; an optional DIRTY line (see view.aura / c/snap.c).
(define (pad:lc-snap title L l col say)
  (let* ((dirty (pad:lc-frame! L l col))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " say "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "") "" (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
      (apply string-append (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
      "END\n")))

;; Whole-page tokens for jump / refs, from the cache when it holds L
;; (offsets shifted per line; equal to pad:hl-tokens when no line is
;; open), else a real full tokenize.
(define (pad:lc-toks L)
  (if (and (= *lc-full* 0) (= *lc-framed* 1) (equal? L *lc-L*))
      (let loop ((i 0) (off 0) (acc (list)))
        (if (>= i (vector-length *lc-recv*))
            (apply append (reverse acc))
            (let ((e (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* i))))
              (loop (+ i 1)
                    (+ off (string-length (pad:lc-e-str e)) 1)
                    (cons (map (lambda (t)
                                 (list (car t) (+ off (cadr t)) (+ off (caddr t))
                                       (list-ref t 3)))
                               (pad:lc-e-toks e))
                          acc)))))
      (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L))))

(define (pad:lc-stats)
  (string-append "frames=" (number->string *lc-frames*)
                 " moves=" (number->string *lc-moves*)
                 " line_edits=" (number->string *lc-lines*)
                 " retok_lines=" (number->string *lc-retok*)
                 " full_frames=" (number->string *lc-fulls*)))

;; Twelve-line kid page (fits *play-max-lines* / *play-max-col*): the
;; perf and test fixture where whole-page tokenize per key hurts.
(define *lc-big-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(query:find hello)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

target.name: pad:lc-generic!
target.body:
(lambda (L l col) (let* ((es (pad:lc-entries L))
         (h0 (set! *lc-hint* #f))
         (full (let any ((xs es))                 ; any row ends inside a string?
                 (cond ((null? xs) #f)
                       ((list-ref (car (car xs)) 4) #t)
                       (#t (any (cdr xs))))))
         (name (pad:lc-name-at (car (list-ref es l)) col))
         (rr (pad:lc-fast-recs es name))
         (rows (map cadr rr))
         (dirty (if (= *lc-framed* 0)
                    (list)
                    (pad:lc-dirty (vector->list *lc-rowv*) rows l))))
    (if (not (eq? full (= *lc-full* 1)))
        (begin (set! *lc-altv* *lc-recv*) (set! *lc-altw* *lc-rowv*)))
    (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (map car rr)))
    (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
    (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
    (if full (set! *lc-fulls* (+ *lc-fulls* 1)))
    (set! *lc-L* L)
    (set! *lc-cur* l)
    (set! *lc-name* name)
    (set! *lc-full* (if full 1 0))
    (set! *lc-framed* 1)
    (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))

;; aura-pad M7 -- line-incremental Soft key path ("snappy pad").
;; Soft still owns every decision; this file only makes the per-key cost
;; scale with the edited LINE instead of the whole page.
;;
;; Per line Soft caches an entry (codes str toks tape open last1 last2
;; syms), a record (entry mkey mrow p1 p2) and the row string. A key
;; re-tokenizes only lines whose char codes changed (equal? on the code
;; list), reuses the HL tape of every other line, rebuilds a mark row
;; only when the name under the cursor or the def-carry into that line
;; changed, and marks DIRTY exactly the rows whose T/H/M text changed
;; (+ the cursor row).
;;
;; Exactness: whole-page tokenize and per-line tokenize agree whenever no
;; token crosses a newline. Only an unclosed string can; such a line sets
;; `open` and the frame falls back to the M6 full path (pad:hl-bundle +
;; pad:v-marks-in). Tests diff every frame against pad:snap-text.
;;
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; --- char classes (built from the M5 predicates, so equal by construction)
;; 0 other  1 space  2 digit  3 symbol  4 paren  5 semicolon  6 dquote
;; Built with cons + list->vector: on tip, vector-set! / set-car! cost
;; grows with workspace size (~15 ms each with the pad loaded), so this
;; file never mutates a vector or pair in place (see docs/perf.md).

(define (pad:lc-cls-of c)
  (cond
    ((or (= c 40) (= c 41)) 4)
    ((= c 59) 5)
    ((= c 34) 6)
    ((pad:hl-space? c) 1)
    ((pad:hl-digit? c) 2)
    ((pad:hl-sym? c) 3)
    (#t 0)))

;; Built by a named procedure, not a top-level named let: a top-level
;; named let that calls a user procedure, in a loaded file, broke later
;; prelude calls such as reverse (aura#4352).
(define (pad:lc-cls-list c acc)
  (if (< c 0) acc (pad:lc-cls-list (- c 1) (cons (pad:lc-cls-of c) acc))))

(define *lc-cls* (list->vector (pad:lc-cls-list 127 (list))))

(define (pad:lc-k s i)
  (let ((c (char->integer (string-ref s i))))
    (if (< c 128) (vector-ref *lc-cls* c) 0)))

(define (pad:lc-kind txt)
  (cond
    ((string-prefix? txt "query:") "Q")
    ((string-prefix? txt "mutate:") "M")
    ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
    (#t "S")))

;; Tokens of ONE line (no newline inside). Mirrors pad:hl-one exactly.
;; Returns (toks open): toks are ((kind a b text) ...) line-relative,
;; spaces skipped; open is #t when a string runs off the line unclosed.
(define (pad:lc-line-toks s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (>= i n)
          (list (reverse acc) #f)
          (let ((k (pad:lc-k s i)))
            (cond
              ((= k 4)
               (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list "P" i (+ i 1) (substring s i (+ i 1))) acc)))
              ((= k 5)
               (list (reverse (cons (list "C" i n (substring s i n)) acc)) #f))
              ((= k 6)
               (let str ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (cond
                   ((>= j n)
                    (list (reverse (cons (list "T" i n (substring s i n)) acc)) #t))
                   ((= (char->integer (string-ref s j)) 92)
                    (str (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
                   ((= (char->integer (string-ref s j)) 34)
                    (loop (+ j 1)
                          (cons (list "T" i (+ j 1) (substring s i (+ j 1))) acc)))
                   (#t (str (+ j 1))))))
              ((= k 1)
               (let sp ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (not (= (pad:lc-k s j) 1)))
                     (loop j acc)
                     (sp (+ j 1)))))
              ((and (= k 2)
                    (or (= i 0)
                        (let ((p (pad:lc-k s (- i 1)))) (or (= p 1) (= p 4)))))
               (let num ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (not (= (pad:lc-k s j) 2)))
                     (loop j (cons (list "N" i j (substring s i j)) acc))
                     (num (+ j 1)))))
              ((or (= k 2) (= k 3))
               (let sy ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let ((q (pad:lc-k s j))) (not (or (= q 2) (= q 3)))))
                     (let ((txt (substring s i j)))
                       (loop j (cons (list (pad:lc-kind txt) i j txt) acc)))
                     (sy (+ j 1)))))
              (#t (loop (+ i 1) acc))))))))

;; --- line entries ---
(define (pad:lc-ref-kind? k)
  (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K") (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M")))

(define (pad:lc-syms toks)
  (let loop ((ts toks) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) acc)
      ((pad:lc-ref-kind? (car (car ts)))
       (loop (cdr ts) (cons (list-ref (car ts) 3) acc)))
      (#t (loop (cdr ts) acc)))))

;; Runs of one letter, sliced per token (no per-char Soft loop).
(define *lc-dots* "................................................................")
(define *lc-run-max* 64)

(define (pad:lc-run-of ch)
  (list->string (let loop ((i 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (>= i *lc-run-max*) acc (loop (+ i 1) (cons ch acc))))))

(define *lc-runs*
  (list (list "P" (pad:lc-run-of #\P)) (list "S" (pad:lc-run-of #\S))
        (list "K" (pad:lc-run-of #\K)) (list "N" (pad:lc-run-of #\N))
        (list "T" (pad:lc-run-of #\T)) (list "C" (pad:lc-run-of #\C))
        (list "Q" (pad:lc-run-of #\Q)) (list "M" (pad:lc-run-of #\M))
        (list "d" (pad:lc-run-of #\d)) (list "r" (pad:lc-run-of #\r))))

(define (pad:lc-run kind k)
  (let loop ((xs *lc-runs*))
    (if (string=? (car (car xs)) kind)
        (substring (cadr (car xs)) 0 k)
        (loop (cdr xs)))))

(define (pad:lc-dots n)
  (if (<= n *lc-run-max*)
      (substring *lc-dots* 0 n)
      (string-append *lc-dots* (pad:lc-dots (- n *lc-run-max*)))))

;; HL tape of one line, one slice per token (== pad:hl-color-from-tokens).
(define (pad:lc-tape s toks)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (if (> n *lc-run-max*)
        (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
        (let loop ((i 0) (ts toks) (acc (list)))
          (if (null? ts)
              (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
              (let* ((t (car ts)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t)))
                (loop b (cdr ts)
                      (cons (pad:lc-run (car t) (- b a))
                            (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc)))))))))

;; Entry: (codes str toks tape open last1 last2 syms)
(define (pad:lc-entry codes)
  (let* ((str (list->string (map integer->char codes)))
         (r (pad:lc-line-toks str))
         (toks (car r))
         (rv (reverse toks)))
    (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1))
    (list codes str toks (pad:lc-tape str toks) (cadr r)
          (if (pair? rv) (car rv) #f)
          (if (and (pair? rv) (pair? (cdr rv))) (cadr rv) #f)
          (pad:lc-syms toks))))

(define (pad:lc-e-codes e) (car e))
(define (pad:lc-e-str e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (pad:lc-e-toks e) (list-ref e 2))
(define (pad:lc-e-tape e) (list-ref e 3))
(define (pad:lc-e-open e) (list-ref e 4))

;; --- marks (def/use of the name under the cursor) ---
(define (pad:lc-kdef? t)
  (and t (string=? (car t) "K") (string=? (list-ref t 3) "define")))

;; def-carry key into a line: the only facts about earlier tokens that
;; pad:find-defs-in can still use on this line's first two tokens.
(define (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)
  (list (if (pad:lc-kdef? p1) 1 0)
        (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "P") (pad:lc-kdef? p2)) 1 0)))

(define (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2)
  (let ((a (list-ref e 5)) (b (list-ref e 6)))
    (cond
      ((not a) (list p1 p2))
      ((not b) (list a p1))
      (#t (list a b)))))

;; Mark row for one line: same rule as pad:find-defs-in / pad:v-marks-in,
;; prev/prev2 carried in from earlier lines; one slice per token.
(define (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (pad:lc-e-str e))
         (n (string-length str)))
    (cond
      ((or (string=? name "") (not (member name (list-ref e 7))))
       (pad:lc-dots n))
      ((> n *lc-run-max*)
       (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2))
      (#t
       (let loop ((i 0) (ts (pad:lc-e-toks e)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? ts)
             (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
             (let* ((t (car ts)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                    (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                              (pad:lc-ref-kind? (car t))))
                    (def (and ref
                              (or (pad:lc-kdef? prev)
                                  (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                       (pad:lc-kdef? prev2))))))
               (loop b (cdr ts) t prev
                     (cons (if ref (pad:lc-run (if def "d" "r") (- b a))
                               (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- b a)))
                           (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc))))))))))

;; Long-line fallback (> 64 chars): per-char walk, same rule.
(define (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (pad:lc-e-str e)) (n (string-length str)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (ts (pad:lc-e-toks e)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
      (cond
        ((>= i n) (list->string (reverse acc)))
        ((and (pair? ts) (= (cadr (car ts)) i))
         (let* ((t (car ts))
                (b (caddr t))
                (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name) (pad:lc-ref-kind? (car t))))
                (def (and ref (or (pad:lc-kdef? prev)
                                  (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                       (pad:lc-kdef? prev2)))))
                (ch (if ref (if def #\d #\r) #\.)))
           (let fill ((j i) (xs acc))
             (if (>= j b) (loop b (cdr ts) t prev xs) (fill (+ j 1) (cons ch xs))))))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) ts prev prev2 (cons #\. acc)))))))

(define (pad:lc-row str tape mrow)
  (string-append "T " str "\nH " tape "\nM " mrow "\n"))

;; --- cache state (only pad:lc-* write it) ---
;; record = (entry mkey mrow p1 p2); mrow #f = rebuild on next fast frame.
(define *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))   ; records of the last frame
(define *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))  ; row strings of the last frame
(define *lc-L* (list))                 ; editor lines of the last frame
(define *lc-cur* -1)                   ; cursor row of the last frame
(define *lc-name* "")                  ; name under the cursor, last frame
(define *lc-full* 0)                   ; 1 when the last frame used the full path
(define *lc-framed* 0)
;; Observability counters (PERF / smoke lines, never on the wire).
(define *lc-retok* 0)                  ; line tokenizes since reset
(define *lc-frames* 0)
(define *lc-fulls* 0)                  ; frames that fell back to full tokenize
(define *lc-moves* 0)                  ; cursor-only frames
(define *lc-lines* 0)                  ; one-line-edit frames

(define (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))
  (set! *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))
  (set! *lc-L* (list))
  (set! *lc-cur* -1)
  (set! *lc-name* "")
  (set! *lc-full* 0)
  (set! *lc-framed* 0)
  (set! *lc-retok* 0)
  (set! *lc-frames* 0)
  (set! *lc-fulls* 0)
  (set! *lc-moves* 0)
  (set! *lc-lines* 0)
  0)

;; Old record at index j whose codes equal codes, or #f.
(define (pad:lc-old-at j codes)
  (if (and (>= j 0) (< j (vector-length *lc-recv*)))
      (let ((r (vector-ref *lc-recv* j)))
        (if (equal? (pad:lc-e-codes (car r)) codes) r #f))
      #f))

;; Match new line i against old rows: last shift d first, then i, i-1, i+1
;; (one enter / one join keeps every later row cached).
(define (pad:lc-match i d codes)
  (let ((a (pad:lc-old-at (+ i d) codes)))
    (if a
        (list a d)
        (let ((b (pad:lc-old-at i codes)))
          (if b
              (list b 0)
              (let ((c (pad:lc-old-at (- i 1) codes)))
                (if c
                    (list c -1)
                    (let ((x (pad:lc-old-at (+ i 1) codes)))
                      (if x (list x 1) #f)))))))))

;; Entries for L: reuse old entries (and their old record) when codes match.
;; Returns list of (entry old-record-or-#f).
(define (pad:lc-entries L)
  (let loop ((xs L) (i 0) (d 0) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let ((m (pad:lc-match i d (car xs))))
          (if m
              (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) (cadr m) (cons (list (car (car m)) (car m)) acc))
              (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) d (cons (list (pad:lc-entry (car xs)) #f) acc)))))))

(define (pad:lc-any-open? es)
  (cond
    ((null? es) #f)
    ((pad:lc-e-open (car (car es))) #t)
    (#t (pad:lc-any-open? (cdr es)))))

;; Fast rows from per-line entries: list of (record row-string).
(define (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)
  (let loop ((xs es) (i 0) (p1 #f) (p2 #f) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
               (old (cadr (car xs)))
               (mkey (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)))
               (keep (and old (list-ref old 2) (equal? (list-ref old 1) mkey)))
               (mrow (if keep (list-ref old 2) (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)))
               (co (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2)))
          (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) (car co) (cadr co)
                (cons (list (list e mkey mrow p1 p2)
                            (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow))
                      acc))))))

;; Full path (an unclosed string crosses a newline): the M6 whole-page
;; tokenize. Records keep the entry but no mark row.
(define (pad:lc-full-recs es L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (b (pad:hl-bundle src))
         (tape (car b))
         (marks (pad:v-marks-in src (pad:v-point L l col) (cadr b))))
    (let loop ((xs es) (off 0) (acc (list)))
      (if (null? xs)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
                 (str (pad:lc-e-str e))
                 (k (string-length str))
                 (ee (+ off k)))
            (loop (cdr xs) (+ ee 1)
                  (cons (list (list e #f #f #f #f)
                              (pad:lc-row str (substring tape off ee)
                                          (substring marks off ee)))
                        acc)))))))

;; Rows that differ from the last frame (by index) plus the cursor row.
(define (pad:lc-dirty old new l)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a old) (b new) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? b) (reverse acc))
      ((or (= i l) (null? a) (not (string=? (car a) (car b))))
       (loop (+ i 1) (if (null? a) a (cdr a)) (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc)))))

(define (pad:lc-name-at e col) (pad:sym-at-in (pad:lc-e-toks e) col))

(define (pad:lc-commit! L l name full)
  (set! *lc-L* L)
  (set! *lc-cur* l)
  (set! *lc-name* name)
  (set! *lc-full* full)
  (set! *lc-framed* 1)
  (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
  0)

;; Generic frame: match every row, rebuild what changed. Returns dirty.
(define (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
  (let* ((es (pad:lc-entries L))
         (full (pad:lc-any-open? es))
         (name (if full "" (pad:lc-name-at (car (list-ref es l)) col)))
         (rr (if full (pad:lc-full-recs es L l col) (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)))
         (rows (map cadr rr))
         (dirty (if (= *lc-framed* 0)
                    (list)
                    (pad:lc-dirty (vector->list *lc-rowv*) rows l))))
    (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (map car rr)))
    (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
    (if full (set! *lc-fulls* (+ *lc-fulls* 1)))
    (pad:lc-commit! L l name (if full 1 0))
    dirty))

;; xs ascending without l -> ascending with l.
(define (pad:lc-with l xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list l))
    ((= (car xs) l) xs)
    ((< l (car xs)) (cons l xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:lc-with l (cdr xs))))))

;; Name under the cursor changed, text did not: only rows that hold the
;; old or the new name can change their mark row. Each record keeps its
;; def-carry (p1 p2), so no other row is walked. Returns dirty rows.
(define (pad:lc-remark! name l)
  (let ((old-name *lc-name*))
    (let loop ((rs (vector->list *lc-recv*)) (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
               (i 0) (racc (list)) (wacc (list)) (dacc (list)))
      (if (null? rs)
          (begin
            (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (reverse racc)))
            (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector (reverse wacc)))
            (pad:lc-with l (reverse dacc)))
          (let* ((r (car rs))
                 (e (car r))
                 (sy (list-ref e 7)))
            (if (or (member name sy) (member old-name sy))
                (let* ((p1 (list-ref r 3))
                       (p2 (list-ref r 4))
                       (mrow (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2))
                       (row (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow)))
                  (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1)
                        (cons (list e (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)) mrow p1 p2) racc)
                        (cons row wacc)
                        (if (string=? row (car ws)) dacc (cons i dacc))))
                (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1) (cons r racc) (cons (car ws) wacc) dacc)))))))

;; Cursor-only frame (same lines object): rows change only if the name
;; under the cursor changed (marks); else only the cursor row is dirty.
(define (pad:lc-move! L l col)
  (let ((name (pad:lc-name-at (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) col)))
    (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
    (if (string=? name *lc-name*)
        (begin (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0) (list l))
        (let ((dirty (pad:lc-remark! name l)))
          (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0)
          dirty))))

;; Copy of vector v with slot i = x, builtins only (no vector-set!).
(define (pad:lc-vput v i x)
  (let* ((xs (vector->list v))
         (n (length xs)))
    (list->vector
      (append (reverse (list-tail (reverse xs) (- n i)))
              (cons x (list-tail xs (+ i 1)))))))

;; Do L and the last frame's lines differ only at row l (same row count)?
(define (pad:lc-one-line? L l)
  (let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
    (and (= n (length old))
         (< l n)
         (equal? (list-tail L (+ l 1)) (list-tail old (+ l 1)))
         (equal? (list-tail (reverse L) (- n l))
                 (list-tail (reverse old) (- n l))))))

;; One-line edit frame: re-tokenize row l only. If the name under the
;; cursor and the def-carry out of row l are unchanged, no other row can
;; change; else fall back to the generic frame (entries still reused).
(define (pad:lc-line! L l col)
  (let* ((e (pad:lc-entry (list-ref L l)))
         (old (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)))
    (if (or (pad:lc-e-open e) (not (list-ref old 2)))
        (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
        (let* ((name (pad:lc-name-at e col))
               (p1 (list-ref old 3))
               (p2 (list-ref old 4))
               (co-new (pad:lc-carry-out e p1 p2))
               (co-old (pad:lc-carry-out (car old) p1 p2)))
          (if (and (string=? name *lc-name*)
                   (equal? (pad:lc-carry-key (car co-new) (cadr co-new))
                           (pad:lc-carry-key (car co-old) (cadr co-old))))
              (let ((mrow (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)))
                (set! *lc-recv*
                      (pad:lc-vput *lc-recv* l
                                   (list e (cons name (pad:lc-carry-key p1 p2)) mrow p1 p2)))
                (set! *lc-rowv*
                      (pad:lc-vput *lc-rowv* l
                                   (pad:lc-row (pad:lc-e-str e) (pad:lc-e-tape e) mrow)))
                (set! *lc-lines* (+ *lc-lines* 1))
                (pad:lc-commit! L l name 0)
                (list l))
              (begin
                ;; let the generic frame reuse the fresh entry for row l
                (set! *lc-recv* (pad:lc-vput *lc-recv* l (list e #f #f p1 p2)))
                (pad:lc-generic! L l col)))))))

;; One frame. Returns dirty rows; () on the first frame (Soft omits
;; DIRTY; C full-blits).
(define (pad:lc-frame! L l col)
  (cond
    ((or (= *lc-framed* 0) (= *lc-full* 1)) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
    ((eq? L *lc-L*) (pad:lc-move! L l col))
    ((pad:lc-one-line? L l) (pad:lc-line! L l col))
    (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))

;; Whole SNAP block from the line cache. Same bytes as pad:snap-text plus
;; an optional DIRTY line (see view.aura / c/snap.c).
(define (pad:lc-snap title L l col say)
  (let* ((dirty (pad:lc-frame! L l col))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " say "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "") "" (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
      (apply string-append (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
      "END\n")))

;; Whole-page tokens for jump / refs, from the cache when it holds L
;; (offsets shifted per line; equal to pad:hl-tokens when no line is
;; open), else a real full tokenize.
(define (pad:lc-toks L)
  (if (and (= *lc-full* 0) (= *lc-framed* 1) (equal? L *lc-L*))
      (let loop ((i 0) (off 0) (acc (list)))
        (if (>= i (vector-length *lc-recv*))
            (apply append (reverse acc))
            (let ((e (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* i))))
              (loop (+ i 1)
                    (+ off (string-length (pad:lc-e-str e)) 1)
                    (cons (map (lambda (t)
                                 (list (car t) (+ off (cadr t)) (+ off (caddr t))
                                       (list-ref t 3)))
                               (pad:lc-e-toks e))
                          acc)))))
      (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L))))

(define (pad:lc-stats)
  (string-append "frames=" (number->string *lc-frames*)
                 " moves=" (number->string *lc-moves*)
                 " line_edits=" (number->string *lc-lines*)
                 " retok_lines=" (number->string *lc-retok*)
                 " full_frames=" (number->string *lc-fulls*)))

;; Twelve-line kid page (fits *play-max-lines* / *play-max-col*): the
;; perf and test fixture where whole-page tokenize per key hurts.
(define *lc-big-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(query:find hello)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))

target.body:
(lambda (name l) (let ((old-name *lc-name*))
    (let loop ((rs (vector->list *lc-recv*)) (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
               (i 0) (racc (list)) (wacc (list)) (dacc (list)))
      (if (null? rs)
          (let ((rows (reverse wacc)))
            (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (reverse racc)))
            (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
            (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
            (pad:lc-with l (reverse dacc)))
          (let* ((r (car rs))
                 (e (car r))
                 (sy (list-ref e 7)))
            (if (or (member name sy) (member old-name sy))
                (let* ((p1 (list-ref r 3))
                       (p2 (list-ref r 4))
                       (str (list-ref e 1))
                       (n (string-length str))
                       ;; pad:lc-mrow, inlined for the common short row
                       (mrow (cond
                               ((> n *lc-run-max*) (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2))
                               ((or (string=? name "") (not (member name sy)))
                                (substring *lc-dots* 0 n))
                               (#t
                                (let mk ((ts (list-ref e 2)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (j 0) (acc (list)))
                                  (if (null? ts)
                                      (apply string-append
                                             (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n j)) acc)))
                                      (let ((t (car ts)))
                                        (if (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                                                 (let ((kd (car t)))
                                                   (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                                       (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))))
                                            (let* ((a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                                                   (def (or (and prev (string=? (car prev) "K")
                                                                 (string=? (list-ref prev 3) "define"))
                                                            (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                                                 prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                                                 (string=? (list-ref prev2 3) "define")))))
                                              (mk (cdr ts) t prev b
                                                  (cons (substring (if def *lc-run-d* *lc-run-r*) 0 (- b a))
                                                        (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a j)) acc))))
                                            (mk (cdr ts) t prev j acc))))))))
                       (row (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref e 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")))
                  (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1)
                        (cons (list e (cons name (cdr (list-ref r 1))) mrow p1 p2) racc)
                        (cons row wacc)
                        (if (string=? row (car ws)) dacc (cons i dacc))))
                (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1) (cons r racc) (cons (car ws) wacc) dacc)))))))
