;; aura-pad M7 -- line-incremental Soft key path ("snappy pad").
;; Soft still owns every decision; this file only makes the per-key cost
;; scale with the edited LINE instead of the whole page.
;;
;; Per line Soft caches an entry (codes str toks tape open last1 last2
;; syms), a record (entry mkey mrow p1 p2) and the row string. A key
;; re-tokenizes only lines whose char codes changed (equal? on the code
;; list), reuses the HL tape of every other line, rebuilds a mark row
;; only when the name under the cursor or the def-carry into that line
;; changed, and marks DIRTY exactly the rows whose T/H/M text changed
;; (+ the cursor row).
;;
;; Exactness: whole-page tokenize and per-line tokenize agree whenever no
;; token crosses a newline. Only a string can; a line it runs off is
;; `open` and the next line starts inside the string (entry field `ins`,
;; the Emacs syntax-ppss idea: lex a line from its known start state).
;; The T piece on each line colors exactly like the whole-page T token
;; and is never a ref or a def key, so tapes and marks still equal the
;; M6 whole-page path; pad:lc-toks (jump) uses a real full tokenize while
;; a string is open (*lc-full*). Tests diff every frame against
;; pad:snap-text. Emacs mapping: docs/perf-emacs.md.
;;
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; --- char classes (built from the M5 predicates, so equal by construction)
;; 0 other  1 space  2 digit  3 symbol  4 paren  5 semicolon  6 dquote
;; Built with cons + list->vector: on tip, vector-set! / set-car! cost
;; grows with workspace size (~15 ms each with the pad loaded), so this
;; file never mutates a vector or pair in place (see docs/perf.md).
;;
;; Emacs port (docs/perf-emacs.md): on tip Soft every call of a user
;; procedure costs ~0.27 ms with the pad loaded, while a named-let step
;; or a builtin costs ~0.01-0.02 ms. So the per-key functions below are
;; written the way Emacs writes its redisplay fast paths in C: one
;; procedure per job, helpers inlined as builtin expressions, no Soft
;; call per character or per token.

(define (pad:lc-cls-of c)
  (cond
    ((or (= c 40) (= c 41)) 4)
    ((= c 59) 5)
    ((= c 34) 6)
    ((pad:hl-space? c) 1)
    ((pad:hl-digit? c) 2)
    ((pad:hl-sym? c) 3)
    (#t 0)))

;; Built by a named procedure, not a top-level named let: a top-level
;; named let that calls a user procedure, in a loaded file, broke later
;; prelude calls such as reverse (aura#4352).
(define (pad:lc-cls-list c acc)
  (if (< c 0) acc (pad:lc-cls-list (- c 1) (cons (pad:lc-cls-of c) acc))))

(define *lc-cls* (list->vector (pad:lc-cls-list 127 (list))))

;; Class of char i of s (kept for probes; the scanner inlines it).
(define (pad:lc-k s i)
  (let ((c (char->integer (string-ref s i))))
    (if (< c 128) (vector-ref *lc-cls* c) 0)))

;; Runs of one letter, sliced per token (no per-char Soft loop). 512
;; covers a whole kid page (12 x 40 + newlines), so even a whole-page
;; scan slices; longer text uses the per-char fallbacks.
(define *lc-run-max* 512)

(define (pad:lc-dbl s k) (if (= k 0) s (pad:lc-dbl (string-append s s) (- k 1))))
(define (pad:lc-run-of ch) (pad:lc-dbl (list->string (list ch ch ch ch ch ch ch ch)) 6))

(define *lc-dots* (pad:lc-run-of #\.))
(define *lc-run-P* (pad:lc-run-of #\P))
(define *lc-run-S* (pad:lc-run-of #\S))
(define *lc-run-K* (pad:lc-run-of #\K))
(define *lc-run-N* (pad:lc-run-of #\N))
(define *lc-run-T* (pad:lc-run-of #\T))
(define *lc-run-C* (pad:lc-run-of #\C))
(define *lc-run-Q* (pad:lc-run-of #\Q))
(define *lc-run-M* (pad:lc-run-of #\M))
(define *lc-run-d* (pad:lc-run-of #\d))
(define *lc-run-r* (pad:lc-run-of #\r))

;; One scan of s (jit-lock-fontify-now for one line: tokens, HL tape
;; and the symbol list in a single pass). Mirrors pad:hl-one: a
;; comment stops at a newline, a string may run past one, so the same
;; scan serves one line (no newline inside) and a whole page (tests).
;; Returns the entry (codes str toks tape open last1 last2 syms rtoks ins):
;;   toks   ((kind a b text) ...), spaces skipped
;;   tape   HL letters, one per char (slices joined; long lines use
;;          pad:hl-color-from-tokens)
;;   open   #t when a string runs off the end unclosed
;;   last1 last2  the last two tokens (def-carry into the next line)
;;   syms   texts of S/K/Q/M tokens (reverse order)
;;   rtoks  toks reversed (last token first)
;; codes is stored as given (#f for a probe / whole-page scan). The scan
;; may resume at r with the reversed tokens acc0, tape slices tp0 and
;; syms sy0 of an unchanged prefix (pad:lc-line!, jit-lock-after-change
;; style: only text from the change on is re-lexed); r = 0 with empty
;; lists scans from the start. string-ref yields a code (as in hl.aura).
(define (pad:lc-scan s codes r acc0 tp0 sy0 ins)
  (let* ((n (string-length s)) (cls *lc-cls*) (mx *lc-run-max*) (dots *lc-dots*)
         ;; syntax-ppss carry: a line that starts inside a string first
         ;; finishes that string (one T token from 0) before normal
         ;; lexing. qq = end of that token, -2 = no closing quote here
         ;; (the whole line is string and it stays open), -1 = not in one.
         (qq (if (and ins (= r 0))
                 (if (< (string-index s "\"" 0) 0)
                     -2                     ; no quote at all: stays open
                 (let str0 ((j 0))
                   (cond
                     ((>= j n) -2)
                     ((= (string-ref s j) 92) (if (>= (+ j 1) n) -2 (str0 (+ j 2))))
                     ((= (string-ref s j) 34) (+ j 1))
                     (#t (str0 (+ j 1))))))
                 -1))
         (open-all (= qq -2))
         (q (cond (open-all n) (#t qq)))
         (i0 (if (>= q 0) q r)))
    (let loop ((i i0)
               (acc (if (> q 0) (cons (list "T" 0 q (substring s 0 q)) acc0) acc0))
               (tp (if (> q 0) (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (if (> q mx) mx q)) tp0) tp0))
               (e i0)
               (sy sy0))
      (if (>= i n)
          (let ((toks (reverse acc)))
            (list codes s toks
                  (if (> n mx)
                      (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
                      (apply string-append
                             (reverse (cons (substring dots 0 (- n e)) tp))))
                  open-all
                  (if (pair? acc) (car acc) #f)
                  (if (and (pair? acc) (pair? (cdr acc))) (cadr acc) #f)
                  sy
                  acc
                  ins))
          (let* ((c (string-ref s i))
                 (k (if (< c 128) (vector-ref cls c) 0)))
            (cond
              ((= k 1)
               (let sp ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (>= j n)
                     (loop j acc tp e sy)
                     (let ((q (string-ref s j)))
                       (if (and (< q 128) (= (vector-ref cls q) 1))
                           (sp (+ j 1))
                           (loop j acc tp e sy))))))
              ((= k 4)
               (loop (+ i 1) (cons (list "P" i (+ i 1) (substring s i (+ i 1))) acc)
                     (cons "P" (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                     (+ i 1) sy))
              ((and (= k 2)
                    (or (= i 0)
                        (let* ((pc (string-ref s (- i 1)))
                               (p (if (< pc 128) (vector-ref cls pc) 0)))
                          (or (= p 1) (= p 4)))))
               (let num ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let ((q (string-ref s j)))
                           (not (and (< q 128) (= (vector-ref cls q) 2)))))
                     (loop j (cons (list "N" i j (substring s i j)) acc)
                           (cons (substring *lc-run-N* 0 (if (> (- j i) mx) mx (- j i)))
                                 (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                           j sy)
                     (num (+ j 1)))))
              ((or (= k 2) (= k 3))
               (let sym ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n)
                         (let* ((q (string-ref s j))
                                (qk (if (< q 128) (vector-ref cls q) 0)))
                           (not (or (= qk 3) (= qk 2)))))
                     (let* ((txt (substring s i j))
                            (w (- j i))
                            (kd (cond
                                  ((and (>= w 6) (string=? (substring txt 0 6) "query:")) "Q")
                                  ((and (>= w 7) (string=? (substring txt 0 7) "mutate:")) "M")
                                  ((member txt *hl-keywords*) "K")
                                  (#t "S"))))
                       (loop j (cons (list kd i j txt) acc)
                             (cons (substring (cond
                                                ((string=? kd "S") *lc-run-S*)
                                                ((string=? kd "K") *lc-run-K*)
                                                ((string=? kd "Q") *lc-run-Q*)
                                                (#t *lc-run-M*))
                                              0 (if (> w mx) mx w))
                                   (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                             j (cons txt sy)))
                     (sym (+ j 1)))))
              ((= k 5)
               (let cm ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (if (or (>= j n) (= (string-ref s j) 10))
                     (loop j (cons (list "C" i j (substring s i j)) acc)
                           (cons (substring *lc-run-C* 0 (if (> (- j i) mx) mx (- j i)))
                                 (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                           j sy)
                     (cm (+ j 1)))))
              ((= k 6)
               (let str ((j (+ i 1)))
                 (cond
                   ((>= j n)
                    (let* ((a2 (cons (list "T" i n (substring s i n)) acc))
                           (toks (reverse a2)))
                      (list codes s toks
                            (if (> n mx)
                                (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
                                (apply string-append
                                       (reverse (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (- n i))
                                                      (cons (substring dots 0 (- i e)) tp)))))
                            #t
                            (car a2)
                            (if (pair? (cdr a2)) (cadr a2) #f)
                            sy
                            a2
                            ins)))
                   ((= (string-ref s j) 92)
                    (str (if (>= (+ j 1) n) n (+ j 2))))
                   ((= (string-ref s j) 34)
                    (loop (+ j 1)
                          (cons (list "T" i (+ j 1) (substring s i (+ j 1))) acc)
                          (cons (substring *lc-run-T* 0 (if (> (- (+ j 1) i) mx) mx (- (+ j 1) i)))
                                (cons (substring dots 0 (if (> (- i e) mx) mx (- i e))) tp))
                          (+ j 1) sy))
                   (#t (str (+ j 1))))))
              (#t (loop (+ i 1) acc tp e sy))))))))

;; Tokens of ONE line (no newline inside). Mirrors pad:hl-one exactly.
;; Returns (toks open): toks are ((kind a b text) ...) line-relative,
;; spaces skipped; open is #t when a string runs off the line unclosed.
(define (pad:lc-line-toks s)
  (let ((e (pad:lc-scan s #f 0 (list) (list) (list) #f))) (list (list-ref e 2) (list-ref e 4))))

;; HL tape of one line from its toks (== pad:hl-color-from-tokens).
(define (pad:lc-tape s toks)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (if (> n *lc-run-max*)
        (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s toks)
        (let loop ((i 0) (ts toks) (acc (list)))
          (if (null? ts)
              (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
              (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)) (a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                     (run (cond
                            ((string=? kd "P") *lc-run-P*) ((string=? kd "S") *lc-run-S*)
                            ((string=? kd "K") *lc-run-K*) ((string=? kd "N") *lc-run-N*)
                            ((string=? kd "T") *lc-run-T*) ((string=? kd "C") *lc-run-C*)
                            ((string=? kd "Q") *lc-run-Q*) (#t *lc-run-M*))))
                (loop b (cdr ts)
                      (cons (substring run 0 (- b a))
                            (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc)))))))))

;; Entry: (codes str toks tape open last1 last2 syms rtoks ins) -- one
;; scan; ins = the line starts inside a string (previous line open).
(define (pad:lc-entry codes ins) (pad:lc-entry2 codes #f ins))

;; Same entry, with the line string already known (str0, or #f to build
;; it from codes). A line that starts inside a string and holds no quote
;; is one T token that stays open: built directly (string-index is a
;; builtin), no per-char scan. Equal to pad:lc-scan by construction
;; (emacs_test checks it).
(define (pad:lc-entry2 codes str0 ins)
  (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1))
  (let ((s (if str0 str0 (list->string (map integer->char codes)))))
    (if (and ins (< (string-index s "\"" 0) 0))
        (let ((n (string-length s)))
          (if (= n 0)
              (list codes s (list) "" #t #f #f (list) (list) #t)
              (let ((t (list "T" 0 n s)))
                (list codes s (list t)
                      (if (> n *lc-run-max*)
                          (pad:hl-color-from-tokens s (list t))
                          (substring *lc-run-T* 0 n))
                      #t t #f (list) (list t) #t))))
        (pad:lc-scan s codes 0 (list) (list) (list) ins))))

(define (pad:lc-e-str e) (list-ref e 1))
(define (pad:lc-e-toks e) (list-ref e 2))

;; --- marks (def/use of the name under the cursor) ---
;; def-carry key into a line: the only facts about earlier tokens that
;; pad:find-defs-in can still use on this line's first two tokens:
;; (prev is K define, prev is P and prev2 is K define) as 0/1.
(define (pad:lc-ckey p1 p2)
  (list (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "K") (string=? (list-ref p1 3) "define")) 1 0)
        (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "P")
                 p2 (string=? (car p2) "K") (string=? (list-ref p2 3) "define"))
            1 0)))

;; Mark row for one line: same rule as pad:find-defs-in / pad:v-marks-in,
;; prev/prev2 carried in from earlier lines; one slice per token.
(define (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (list-ref e 1))
         (n (string-length str)))
    (cond
      ((or (string=? name "") (not (member name (list-ref e 7))))
       (if (<= n *lc-run-max*) (substring *lc-dots* 0 n) (pad:lc-mrow-chars e "" p1 p2)))
      ((> n *lc-run-max*)
       (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2))
      (#t
       ;; slices only at the name's tokens; every other token is one
       ;; text compare (dots fill the gaps)
       (let loop ((ts (list-ref e 2)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (i 0) (acc (list)))
         (if (null? ts)
             (apply string-append (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n i)) acc)))
             (let ((t (car ts)))
               (if (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                        (let ((kd (car t)))
                          (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                              (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))))
                   (let* ((a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                          (def (or (and prev (string=? (car prev) "K")
                                        (string=? (list-ref prev 3) "define"))
                                   (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                        prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                        (string=? (list-ref prev2 3) "define")))))
                     (loop (cdr ts) t prev b
                           (cons (substring (if def *lc-run-d* *lc-run-r*) 0 (- b a))
                                 (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a i)) acc))))
                   (loop (cdr ts) t prev i acc)))))))))

;; Long-line fallback (> *lc-run-max* chars): per-char walk, same rule.
(define (pad:lc-mrow-chars e name p1 p2)
  (let* ((str (list-ref e 1)) (n (string-length str)))
    (let loop ((i 0) (ts (list-ref e 2)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (acc (list)))
      (cond
        ((>= i n) (list->string (reverse acc)))
        ((and (pair? ts) (= (cadr (car ts)) i))
         (let* ((t (car ts))
                (kd (car t))
                (b (caddr t))
                (ref (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                          (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                              (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))))
                (def (and ref
                          (or (and prev (string=? (car prev) "K")
                                   (string=? (list-ref prev 3) "define"))
                              (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                   prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                   (string=? (list-ref prev2 3) "define")))))
                (ch (if ref (if def #\d #\r) #\.)))
           (let fill ((j i) (xs acc))
             (if (>= j b) (loop b (cdr ts) t prev xs) (fill (+ j 1) (cons ch xs))))))
        (#t (loop (+ i 1) ts prev prev2 (cons #\. acc)))))))

;; --- cache state (only pad:lc-* write it) ---
;; record = (entry mkey mrow p1 p2 alt); mrow #f = rebuild on next fast
;; frame. alt = #f or (entry mkey mrow row) of the SAME text lexed from
;; the other start state (the syntax-ppss cache idea, kept per row):
;; closing a string you just opened gets every row below back without a
;; re-lex or a row rebuild.
(define *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))   ; records of the last frame
(define *lc-nopen* 0)                  ; rows whose entry ends open
;; Tail memo for pad:lc-line! (the rows below an edit, as they were before
;; the edit changed their start state): (l ins d1 d2 name Ltail recs rows).
;; Records are a pure function of (codes, start state, carry key, name),
;; so the memo is checked by content and reused whole: closing a string
;; just opened (or opening it again) brings every row below back at once.
(define *lc-tail* #f)
(define *lc-hint* #f)                  ; entry lc-line! just scanned, or #f
(define *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))  ; row strings of the last frame
(define *lc-body* "")                  ; the row strings joined (SNAP body)
(define *lc-L* (list))                 ; editor lines of the last frame
(define *lc-cur* -1)                   ; cursor row of the last frame
(define *lc-name* "")                  ; name under the cursor, last frame
(define *lc-full* 0)                   ; 1 when some row ends inside a string
(define *lc-framed* 0)
;; Observability counters (PERF / smoke lines, never on the wire).
(define *lc-retok* 0)                  ; line tokenizes since reset
(define *lc-frames* 0)
(define *lc-fulls* 0)                  ; generic frames with a string open
(define *lc-moves* 0)                  ; cursor-only frames
(define *lc-lines* 0)                  ; one-line-edit frames

(define (pad:lc-reset!)
  (set! *lc-recv* (make-vector 0 0))
  (set! *lc-nopen* 0)
  (set! *lc-tail* #f)
  (set! *lc-hint* #f)
  (set! *lc-rowv* (make-vector 0 ""))
  (set! *lc-body* "")
  (set! *lc-L* (list))
  (set! *lc-cur* -1)
  (set! *lc-name* "")
  (set! *lc-full* 0)
  (set! *lc-framed* 0)
  (set! *lc-retok* 0)
  (set! *lc-frames* 0)
  (set! *lc-fulls* 0)
  (set! *lc-moves* 0)
  (set! *lc-lines* 0)
  0)

;; Entries for L: reuse old entries (and their old record) when codes
;; AND the start state match. Like try_window_id's scan for unchanged
;; rows above and below the change: match each new row against the old
;; row at the last shift d first, then at i, i-1, i+1 (one enter / one
;; join keeps every later row cached). The start state is the syntax-ppss
;; fact "this line starts inside a string" (previous entry open); when it
;; flips, the row is re-lexed even if its text did not change
;; (jit-lock-contextually) -- unless the old record's alt already holds
;; that text lexed from the new state (per-row syntax-ppss memo), which
;; also brings its mark row and row string. Entries are a pure function
;; of (codes, start state), so any equal pair is safe to reuse. Returns
;; list of (entry old-or-#f old-row-string-or-"" alt); old has the
;; record layout for fields 0..2 (entry mkey mrow); a kept row reuses its
;; old row string (try_window_reusing_current_matrix).
(define (pad:lc-entries L)
  (let ((ov *lc-recv*) (ow *lc-rowv*) (on (vector-length *lc-recv*)))
    (let loop ((xs L) (i 0) (d 0) (ins #f) (acc (list)))
      (if (null? xs)
          (reverse acc)
          (let* ((codes (car xs))
                 (j0 (+ i d)) (j1 i) (j2 (- i 1)) (j3 (+ i 1))
                 (r0 (and (>= j0 0) (< j0 on) (vector-ref ov j0)))
                 (h0 (and r0 (eq? (list-ref (car r0) 9) ins) (equal? (car (car r0)) codes)))
                 (r1 (and (not h0) (>= j1 0) (< j1 on) (vector-ref ov j1)))
                 (h1 (and r1 (eq? (list-ref (car r1) 9) ins) (equal? (car (car r1)) codes)))
                 (r2 (and (not h0) (not h1) (>= j2 0) (< j2 on) (vector-ref ov j2)))
                 (h2 (and r2 (eq? (list-ref (car r2) 9) ins) (equal? (car (car r2)) codes)))
                 (r3 (and (not h0) (not h1) (not h2) (>= j3 0) (< j3 on) (vector-ref ov j3)))
                 (h3 (and r3 (eq? (list-ref (car r3) 9) ins) (equal? (car (car r3)) codes))))
            (cond
              (h0 (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) d (list-ref (car r0) 4) (cons (list (car r0) r0 (vector-ref ow j0) (list-ref r0 5)) acc)))
              (h1 (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) 0 (list-ref (car r1) 4) (cons (list (car r1) r1 (vector-ref ow j1) (list-ref r1 5)) acc)))
              (h2 (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) -1 (list-ref (car r2) 4) (cons (list (car r2) r2 (vector-ref ow j2) (list-ref r2 5)) acc)))
              (h3 (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) 1 (list-ref (car r3) 4) (cons (list (car r3) r3 (vector-ref ow j3) (list-ref r3 5)) acc)))
              (#t
               ;; same text, other start state: the memo, else a re-lex
               (let* ((jc (cond ((and r0 (equal? (car (car r0)) codes)) j0)
                                ((and r1 (equal? (car (car r1)) codes)) j1)
                                ((and r2 (equal? (car (car r2)) codes)) j2)
                                ((and r3 (equal? (car (car r3)) codes)) j3)
                                (#t -1)))
                      (rc (if (>= jc 0) (vector-ref ov jc) #f))
                      (alt (and rc (list-ref rc 5)))
                      (ae (and alt (eq? (list-ref (car alt) 9) ins) (car alt)))
                      (nalt (and rc (list (car rc) (list-ref rc 1) (list-ref rc 2) (vector-ref ow jc)))))
                 (if ae
                     (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) d (list-ref ae 4) (cons (list ae alt (list-ref alt 3) nalt) acc))
                     (let ((e (if (and *lc-hint* (eq? (car *lc-hint*) codes) (eq? (list-ref *lc-hint* 9) ins))
                                  *lc-hint*
                                  (pad:lc-entry2 codes (and rc (list-ref (car rc) 1)) ins))))
                       (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) d (list-ref e 4) (cons (list e #f "" nalt) acc))))))))))))

;; Fast rows from per-line entries: list of (record row-string). The
;; def-carry key (pad:lc-ckey) and the no-mark row are inlined.
(define (pad:lc-fast-recs es name)
  (let loop ((xs es) (i 0) (p1 #f) (p2 #f) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let* ((e (car (car xs)))
               (old (cadr (car xs)))
               (mkey (cons name
                           (list (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "K")
                                          (string=? (list-ref p1 3) "define")) 1 0)
                                 (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "P")
                                          p2 (string=? (car p2) "K")
                                          (string=? (list-ref p2 3) "define")) 1 0))))
               (keep (and old (list-ref old 2) (equal? (list-ref old 1) mkey)))
               (str (list-ref e 1))
               (k (string-length str))
               (mrow (cond
                       (keep (list-ref old 2))
                       ((and (<= k *lc-run-max*)
                             (or (string=? name "") (not (member name (list-ref e 7)))))
                        (substring *lc-dots* 0 k))
                       (#t (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2))))
               (a (list-ref e 5)) (b (list-ref e 6))
               (q1 (if a a p1))
               (q2 (cond ((not a) p2) ((not b) p1) (#t b))))
          (loop (cdr xs) (+ i 1) q1 q2
                (cons (list (list e mkey mrow p1 p2 (list-ref (car xs) 3))
                            (if keep
                                (list-ref (car xs) 2)
                                (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref e 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")))
                      acc))))))

;; Rows that differ from the last frame (by index) plus the cursor row.
(define (pad:lc-dirty old new l)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a old) (b new) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? b) (reverse acc))
      ((or (= i l) (null? a) (not (string=? (car a) (car b))))
       (loop (+ i 1) (if (null? a) a (cdr a)) (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc)))))

;; Name under the cursor from one line's toks (pad:sym-at-in, inlined:
;; first S/K/Q/M token with a <= col < b, else "").
(define (pad:lc-name-at e col)
  (let loop ((ts (list-ref e 2)))
    (if (null? ts)
        ""
        (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
          (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                       (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                   (>= col (cadr t)) (< col (caddr t)))
              (list-ref t 3)
              (loop (cdr ts)))))))

;; Generic frame: match every row, rebuild what changed. Returns dirty.
(define (pad:lc-generic! L l col)
  (let* ((es (pad:lc-entries L))
         (h0 (set! *lc-hint* #f))
         (nopen (let cnt ((xs es) (c 0))          ; rows ending inside a string
                  (if (null? xs) c (cnt (cdr xs) (if (list-ref (car (car xs)) 4) (+ c 1) c)))))
         (full (> nopen 0))
         (name (pad:lc-name-at (car (list-ref es l)) col))
         (rr (pad:lc-fast-recs es name))
         (rows (map cadr rr))
         (dirty (if (= *lc-framed* 0)
                    (list)
                    (pad:lc-dirty (vector->list *lc-rowv*) rows l))))
    (set! *lc-nopen* nopen)
    (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (map car rr)))
    (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
    (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
    (if full (set! *lc-fulls* (+ *lc-fulls* 1)))
    (set! *lc-L* L)
    (set! *lc-cur* l)
    (set! *lc-name* name)
    (set! *lc-full* (if full 1 0))
    (set! *lc-framed* 1)
    (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
    dirty))

;; xs ascending without l -> ascending with l.
(define (pad:lc-with l xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list l))
    ((= (car xs) l) xs)
    ((< l (car xs)) (cons l xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:lc-with l (cdr xs))))))

;; Name under the cursor changed, text did not: only rows that hold the
;; old or the new name can change their mark row. Each record keeps its
;; def-carry (p1 p2), so no other row is walked. Returns dirty rows.
(define (pad:lc-remark! name l)
  (let ((old-name *lc-name*))
    (let loop ((rs (vector->list *lc-recv*)) (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
               (i 0) (racc (list)) (wacc (list)) (dacc (list)))
      (if (null? rs)
          (let ((rows (reverse wacc)))
            (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector (reverse racc)))
            (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
            (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
            (pad:lc-with l (reverse dacc)))
          (let* ((r (car rs))
                 (e (car r))
                 (sy (list-ref e 7)))
            (if (or (member name sy) (member old-name sy))
                (let* ((p1 (list-ref r 3))
                       (p2 (list-ref r 4))
                       (str (list-ref e 1))
                       (n (string-length str))
                       ;; pad:lc-mrow, inlined for the common short row
                       (mrow (cond
                               ((> n *lc-run-max*) (pad:lc-mrow e name p1 p2))
                               ((or (string=? name "") (not (member name sy)))
                                (substring *lc-dots* 0 n))
                               (#t
                                (let mk ((ts (list-ref e 2)) (prev p1) (prev2 p2) (j 0) (acc (list)))
                                  (if (null? ts)
                                      (apply string-append
                                             (reverse (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- n j)) acc)))
                                      (let ((t (car ts)))
                                        (if (and (string=? (list-ref t 3) name)
                                                 (let ((kd (car t)))
                                                   (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                                       (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))))
                                            (let* ((a (cadr t)) (b (caddr t))
                                                   (def (or (and prev (string=? (car prev) "K")
                                                                 (string=? (list-ref prev 3) "define"))
                                                            (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                                                                 prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                                                 (string=? (list-ref prev2 3) "define")))))
                                              (mk (cdr ts) t prev b
                                                  (cons (substring (if def *lc-run-d* *lc-run-r*) 0 (- b a))
                                                        (cons (substring *lc-dots* 0 (- a j)) acc))))
                                            (mk (cdr ts) t prev j acc))))))))
                       (row (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref e 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")))
                  (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1)
                        (cons (list e (cons name (cdr (list-ref r 1))) mrow p1 p2 (list-ref r 5)) racc)
                        (cons row wacc)
                        (if (string=? row (car ws)) dacc (cons i dacc))))
                (loop (cdr rs) (cdr ws) (+ i 1) (cons r racc) (cons (car ws) wacc) dacc)))))))

;; Cursor-only frame (same lines object) = Emacs try_cursor_movement:
;; text unchanged, so the cached rows stand; rows change only if the
;; name under the cursor changed (marks); else only the cursor row is
;; dirty and the cached SNAP body is reused as is.
(define (pad:lc-move! L l col)
  (pad:lc-move-to! L l (pad:lc-name-at (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) col)))

;; pad:lc-move! with the name under the cursor already known
;; (pad:play-snap computes it for its inline try_cursor_movement).
(define (pad:lc-move-to! L l name)
  (let ((dirty (if (string=? name *lc-name*) (list l) (pad:lc-remark! name l))))
    (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
    (set! *lc-L* L)
    (set! *lc-cur* l)
    (set! *lc-name* name)
    (set! *lc-framed* 1)
    (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
    dirty))

;; Ascending row lists a, b -> ascending union.
(define (pad:lc-union a b)
  (let u ((a a) (b b) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? a) (append (reverse acc) b))
      ((null? b) (append (reverse acc) a))
      ((= (car a) (car b)) (u (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons (car a) acc)))
      ((< (car a) (car b)) (u (cdr a) b (cons (car a) acc)))
      (#t (u a (cdr b) (cons (car b) acc))))))

;; One-line edit frame = Emacs try_window_id for a change confined to
;; one row: re-lex row l only from the change on (jit-lock-after-change),
;; then walk the rows below the way jit-lock-context / syntax-ppss do:
;; a row is touched only while its start state (inside a string?) or the
;; def-carry into it differs from what its cached record was built with,
;; and the walk STOPS at the first row whose start state and carry match
;; (every later row is then unchanged and kept as is). A touched row with
;; the same text gets its entry from the record (same state), from the
;; record's alt (the other state, lexed before: closing a string just
;; opened), from the direct no-quote build, or from one scan. Mark rows
;; are built for the old name; if the name under the cursor changed,
;; pad:lc-remark! then fixes exactly the rows holding the old or new
;; name. The record/row vectors are rebuilt with builtins (no
;; vector-set!, see the header note).
(define (pad:lc-line! L l col)
  (let* ((codes (list-ref L l))
         (old (vector-ref *lc-recv* l))
         (oe (car old))
         (news (list->string (map integer->char codes)))
         (olds (list-ref oe 1))
         ;; unchanged prefix [0,p): guess p = col - 1 (typing, backspace,
         ;; kill-line all change text at or after it) and verify with
         ;; substring; any other edit (undo, yank, indent) gets p = 0
         (p0 (if (> col 0) (- col 1) 0))
         (p (if (and (<= p0 (string-length olds)) (<= p0 (string-length news))
                     (string=? (substring olds 0 p0) (substring news 0 p0)))
                p0
                0))
         ;; keep old tokens whose end AND lookahead char lie before p
         ;; (b < p); drop the rest from the reversed token / sym lists
         (cut (let walk ((xs (list-ref oe 8)) (m 0) (mr 0))
                (if (and (pair? xs) (>= (caddr (car xs)) p))
                    (let ((kd (car (car xs))))
                      (walk (cdr xs) (+ m 1)
                            (if (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                    (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                (+ mr 1) mr)))
                    (list xs mr))))
         (acc0 (car cut))
         (r (if (pair? acc0) (caddr (car acc0)) 0))
         (le (begin (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1))      ; pad:lc-entry, inlined
                   (pad:lc-scan news codes r acc0
                                (if (> r 0) (list (substring (list-ref oe 3) 0 r)) (list))
                                (drop (list-ref oe 7) (cadr cut))
                                (list-ref oe 9)))))
    (if (not (list-ref old 2))
        (begin (set! *lc-hint* le) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
        (let* ((name (let loop ((ts (list-ref le 2)))   ; pad:lc-name-at, inlined
                       (if (null? ts)
                           ""
                           (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                             (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                          (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                      (>= col (cadr t)) (< col (caddr t)))
                                 (list-ref t 3)
                                 (loop (cdr ts)))))))
               (oname *lc-name*)
               (mx *lc-run-max*)
               (mk00 (list *lc-name* 0 0))
               (rs (vector->list *lc-recv*))
               (ws (vector->list *lc-rowv*))
               (keep (- (length rs) l))
               ;; walk rows l, l+1, ... -> (records rows nopen dirty)
               (res
                (let rw ((rr (drop rs l)) (ww (drop ws l)) (i l) (ins (list-ref oe 9))
                         (p1 (list-ref old 3)) (p2 (list-ref old 4))
                         (racc (list)) (wacc (list)) (dacc (list)) (nopen *lc-nopen*))
                  (let* ((rc (if (pair? rr) (car rr) #f))
                         (d1 (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "K") (string=? (list-ref p1 3) "define")) 1 0))
                         (d2 (if (and p1 (string=? (car p1) "P") p2 (string=? (car p2) "K")
                                      (string=? (list-ref p2 3) "define"))
                                 1 0)))
                    (if (or (not rc)
                            (and (> i l)
                                 (eq? ins (list-ref (car rc) 9))
                                 (list-ref rc 2)
                                 (= (cadr (list-ref rc 1)) d1)
                                 (= (caddr (list-ref rc 1)) d2)))
                        ;; start state and carry match the cache: stop here
                        (list (append (reverse racc) rr) (append (reverse wacc) ww) nopen (reverse dacc))
                        (let* ((tm (and (= i (+ l 1)) *lc-tail*))
                               (hit (and tm (= (car tm) l) (eq? (cadr tm) ins)
                                         (= (caddr tm) d1) (= (list-ref tm 3) d2)
                                         (string=? (list-ref tm 4) oname)
                                         (equal? (list-ref tm 5) (drop L i))))
                               ;; the rows below are about to change: remember
                               ;; them as they are (the memo for the way back)
                               (sv (if (= i (+ l 1))
                                       (set! *lc-tail*
                                             (list l (list-ref (car rc) 9)
                                                   (cadr (list-ref rc 1)) (caddr (list-ref rc 1))
                                                   oname (drop *lc-L* i) rr ww))
                                       0)))
                          (cond
                            ((= i l)
                             ;; the edited row itself (fresh entry le, carry in
                             ;; unchanged); marks for the old name
                             (let* ((str (list-ref le 1))
                                    (k (string-length str))
                                    (mrow (if (and (<= k mx)
                                                   (or (string=? oname "")
                                                       (not (member oname (list-ref le 7)))))
                                              (substring *lc-dots* 0 k)
                                              (pad:lc-mrow le oname p1 p2)))
                                    (a (list-ref le 5))
                                    (b (list-ref le 6)))
                               (rw (cdr rr) (cdr ww) (+ i 1) (list-ref le 4)
                                   (if a a p1)
                                   (cond ((not a) p2) ((not b) p1) (#t b))
                                   (cons (list le (list oname d1 d2) mrow p1 p2 #f) racc)
                                   (cons (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref le 3) "\nM " mrow "\n") wacc)
                                   (cons i dacc)
                                   (+ nopen (if (list-ref le 4) 1 0) (if (list-ref oe 4) -1 0)))))
                            (hit
                             ;; memo rows back whole; one pass for dirty rows
                             ;; and the open-row count of the swapped tails
                             (let dl ((xs (list-ref tm 7)) (ys ww) (sr (list-ref tm 6)) (orr rr)
                                      (j i) (acc dacc) (no nopen))
                               (if (null? xs)
                                   (list (append (reverse racc) (list-ref tm 6))
                                         (append (reverse wacc) (list-ref tm 7))
                                         no (reverse acc))
                                   (dl (cdr xs) (cdr ys) (cdr sr) (cdr orr) (+ j 1)
                                       (if (string=? (car xs) (car ys)) acc (cons j acc))
                                       (+ no (if (list-ref (car (car sr)) 4) 1 0)
                                          (if (list-ref (car (car orr)) 4) -1 0))))))
                            ;; a quote-free row now starting inside a string,
                            ;; no usable memo: one open T token, no mark (the
                            ;; common case under a string just opened)
                            ((and ins (> i l) (= d1 0) (= d2 0)
                                  (not (list-ref (car rc) 9))
                                  (not (and (list-ref rc 5) (list-ref (car (list-ref rc 5)) 9)))
                                  (let* ((s (list-ref (car rc) 1)) (n (string-length s)))
                                    (and (> n 0) (<= n mx) (< (string-index s "\"" 0) 0))))
                             (let* ((oe-i (car rc))
                                    (s (list-ref oe-i 1))
                                    (n (string-length s))
                                    (t (list "T" 0 n s))
                                    (tape (substring *lc-run-T* 0 n))
                                    (mrow (substring *lc-dots* 0 n))
                                    (row (string-append "T " s "\nH " tape "\nM " mrow "\n")))
                               (set! *lc-retok* (+ *lc-retok* 1))
                               (rw (cdr rr) (cdr ww) (+ i 1) #t t p1
                                   (cons (list (list (car oe-i) s (list t) tape #t t #f (list) (list t) #t)
                                               mk00 mrow p1 p2
                                               (list oe-i (list-ref rc 1) (list-ref rc 2) (car ww)))
                                         racc)
                                   (cons row wacc)
                                   (if (string=? row (car ww)) dacc (cons i dacc))
                                   (+ nopen (if (list-ref oe-i 4) 0 1)))))
                            (#t
                             (let* ((oe-i (car rc))
                                    (oins (list-ref oe-i 9))
                                    (alt (list-ref rc 5))
                                    (same (and (> i l) (eq? ins oins)))
                                    (altok (and (> i l) (not same) alt (eq? (list-ref (car alt) 9) ins)))
                                    (ne (cond
                                          ((= i l) le)
                                          (same oe-i)
                                          (altok (car alt))
                                          (#t (pad:lc-entry2 (car oe-i) (list-ref oe-i 1) ins))))
                                    (nalt (cond
                                            ((= i l) #f)
                                            (same alt)
                                            (#t (list oe-i (list-ref rc 1) (list-ref rc 2) (car ww)))))
                                    (mkey (list oname d1 d2))
                                    ;; cached (mkey mrow row) already built for ne
                                    (src (cond
                                           (same (list (list-ref rc 1) (list-ref rc 2) (car ww)))
                                           (altok (cdr alt))
                                           (#t #f)))
                                    (kp (and src (cadr src) (equal? (car src) mkey)))
                                    (str (list-ref ne 1))
                                    (k (string-length str))
                                    (mrow (cond
                                            (kp (cadr src))
                                            ((and (<= k mx)
                                                  (or (string=? oname "") (not (member oname (list-ref ne 7)))))
                                             (substring *lc-dots* 0 k))
                                            (#t (pad:lc-mrow ne oname p1 p2))))
                                    (row (if kp
                                             (caddr src)
                                             (string-append "T " str "\nH " (list-ref ne 3) "\nM " mrow "\n")))
                                    (a (list-ref ne 5))
                                    (b (list-ref ne 6)))
                               (rw (cdr rr) (cdr ww) (+ i 1) (list-ref ne 4)
                                   (if a a p1)
                                   (cond ((not a) p2) ((not b) p1) (#t b))
                                   (cons (list ne mkey mrow p1 p2 nalt) racc)
                                   (cons row wacc)
                                   (if (or (= i l) (not (string=? row (car ww)))) (cons i dacc) dacc)
                                   (+ nopen (if (list-ref ne 4) 1 0) (if (list-ref oe-i 4) -1 0)))))))))))
               (recs (append (reverse (drop (reverse rs) keep)) (car res)))
               (rows (append (reverse (drop (reverse ws) keep)) (cadr res)))
               (nopen (caddr res)))
          (set! *lc-recv* (list->vector recs))
          (set! *lc-rowv* (list->vector rows))
          (set! *lc-body* (apply string-append rows))
          (set! *lc-nopen* nopen)
          (set! *lc-full* (if (> nopen 0) 1 0))

          (set! *lc-L* L)
          (set! *lc-cur* l)
          (set! *lc-framed* 1)
          (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))

;; One frame. Returns dirty rows; () on the first frame (Soft omits
;; DIRTY; C full-blits). Frame choice = Emacs redisplay_window's ladder:
;; try_cursor_movement (same text), try_window_id (rows differ only at
;; the cursor row, checked with builtin drop/reverse/equal?), else the
;; generic row-matching frame (try_window_reusing_current_matrix).
(define (pad:lc-frame! L l col)
  (cond
    ((= *lc-framed* 0) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
    ((eq? L *lc-L*) (pad:lc-move! L l col))
    ((let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
       (and (= n (length old))
            (< l n)
            (equal? (drop L (+ l 1)) (drop old (+ l 1)))
            (equal? (drop (reverse L) (- n l))
                    (drop (reverse old) (- n l)))))
     (pad:lc-line! L l col))
    (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))

;; Whole SNAP block from the line cache. Same bytes as pad:snap-text plus
;; an optional DIRTY line (see view.aura / c/snap.c). The ROWS body is
;; kept joined in *lc-body* by the frame (a cursor-only frame reuses it).
(define (pad:lc-snap title L l col say)
  (let* ((dirty (pad:lc-frame! L l col))
         (dcsv (cond
                 ((null? dirty) "")
                 ((null? (cdr dirty)) (number->string (car dirty)))
                 (#t (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " say "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "") "" (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
      *lc-body*
      "END\n")))

;; Whole-page tokens for jump / refs, from the cache when it holds L
;; (offsets shifted per line; equal to pad:hl-tokens when no line is
;; open), else a real full tokenize.
(define (pad:lc-toks L)
  (if (and (= *lc-full* 0) (= *lc-framed* 1) (equal? L *lc-L*))
      (let loop ((i 0) (off 0) (acc (list)))
        (if (>= i (vector-length *lc-recv*))
            (apply append (reverse acc))
            (let ((e (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* i))))
              (loop (+ i 1)
                    (+ off (string-length (pad:lc-e-str e)) 1)
                    (cons (map (lambda (t)
                                 (list (car t) (+ off (cadr t)) (+ off (caddr t))
                                       (list-ref t 3)))
                               (pad:lc-e-toks e))
                          acc)))))
      (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L))))

(define (pad:lc-stats)
  (string-append "frames=" (number->string *lc-frames*)
                 " moves=" (number->string *lc-moves*)
                 " line_edits=" (number->string *lc-lines*)
                 " retok_lines=" (number->string *lc-retok*)
                 " full_frames=" (number->string *lc-fulls*)))

;; Twelve-line kid page (fits *play-max-lines* / *play-max-col*): the
;; perf and test fixture where whole-page tokenize per key hurts.
(define *lc-big-page*
  (string-append
    "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n"
    "(define (bye y) (hello y))\n"
    "(define (add a b) (+ a b))\n"
    "; kids write stories here\n"
    "(define pet \"cat\")\n"
    "(define (greet n) (add n 1))\n"
    "(hello 3)\n"
    "(bye 4)\n"
    "(greet (add 1 2))\n"
    "(display pet)\n"
    "(query:find hello)\n"
    "(hello (bye 5))"))
