  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) (pad:blast-count-of (car (car now)) before))
     (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before)))
    (#t (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-names now)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) 0) (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now))))
    (#t (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now)))))
(define (pad:blast-subset? xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #t)
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-subset? (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t #f)))
;; same count, or (aura#4364) the engine added exactly the new sites
(define (pad:blast-count-ok? c)
  (let ((soft (cadr c)) (eng (caddr c)) (e0 (pad:nth c 3)) (new (pad:nth c 4)))
    (and (>= eng 0)
         (or (= soft eng)
             (and (>= e0 0) (= (- eng e0) new))))))
(define (pad:blast-counts-ok? cs)
  (cond
    ((null? cs) #t)
    ((pad:blast-count-ok? (car cs)) (pad:blast-counts-ok? (cdr cs)))
    (#t #f)))

;; kid name for row l of page L: the define it starts, the row when
;; short, else "line N"
(define (pad:blast-row-name L l)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src (list (list-ref L l))))
         (d (pad:why-row-def src)))
    (cond
      (d d)
      ((<= (string-length src) 18) src)
      (#t (string-append "line " (number->string (+ l 1)))))))
(define (pad:blast-row-names L rows)
  (if (null? rows) (list) (cons (pad:blast-row-name L (car rows)) (pad:blast-row-names L (cdr rows)))))

;; The card: (names use-rows use-names counts grown dirty-now verdict)
;; L1 = the page the KEEP would give; before = (dirty counts, engine
;; call counts) taken before the transaction (pad:blast-before).
(define (pad:blast-before names)
  (list (pad:blast-dirty-now) (pad:blast-eng-before names)))
(define (pad:blast-card ops L1 before)
  (set! *blast-cards* (+ *blast-cards* 1))
  (let* ((names (pad:robot-names ops))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L1)))
         (defs (pad:blast-def-rows L1 toks names))
         (uses (pad:blast-minus (pad:blast-sorted (pad:blast-rows L1 (pad:blast-all-points toks names)) (list))
                                defs))

         (grown (pad:blast-grown d1 d0))
         (dirty (pad:blast-dirty-names d1))

                  (pad:blast-subset? names dirty)))

                     (if ok "agree" "disagree"))))

    (if ok

        (begin
          (set! *blast-disagree* (+ *blast-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_BLAST_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:blast-line card)) (newline)))
    card))

(define (pad:blast-first xs n)
  (if (or (null? xs) (<= n 0)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-first (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))
(define (pad:blast-commas xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:blast-commas (cdr xs))))))

;; Kid words for a card.
(define (pad:blast-say card)
  (let* ((names (car card))

         (n (length shown))

    (string-append

        ((= n 1) (string-append " moves 1 place: " (car shown)))

                           (if (> more 0) (string-append " and " (number->string more) " more") ""))))
      ". enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")))

;; aura-pad M11d -- "blast radius" card before KEEP.
;; Needs ws.aura, who_pen.aura, why.aura (and what they load). Loaded
;; before robot.aura, whose card path (pad:robot-card!) calls it.
;;
;; The helper's proposal is applied as one typed transaction inside an
;; ast:snapshot (M11a) but NOT kept yet: the page does not change, and
;; the say line shows what the change would move:
;;   "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3).
;;    enter keeps, ctrl-z says no"
;; Enter keeps it (rows projected, ctrl-z undo entry, stamps); ctrl-z
;; drops it (ast:restore + eval-current, nothing moved).
;; Soft finds the places from the page the KEEP would give (call sites =
;; a name right after "(" that is not a define head). The engine checks
;; that answer:
;;   query:calls name        -> the engine's call sites of name; their
;;                              number must equal the Soft count. After a
;;                              rebind the engine keeps the replaced body's
;;                              sites too (aura#4364), so then the engine
;;                              must have added exactly the call sites the
;;                              new bodies hold (taken before and after)
;;   query:dirty-subtree     -> per page define (query:defines name): the
;;                              defines whose dirty count grew must be
;;                              changed names, and every changed name must
;;                              be dirty now (query:dirty-nodes marks only
;;                              the rebound define node and the root)
;; c69e644 has no node -> row query, so rows come from Soft and the engine
;; confirms the counts; a mismatch prints M11_BLAST_DISAGREE.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *blast-cards* 0)
(define *blast-disagree* 0)
(define *blast-last* #f)
(define *blast-max-shown* 3)

;; token start points of the call sites of name
(define (pad:blast-sites toks name prev prev2 acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks))
             (hit (and (string=? (pad:hl-nth t 3) name)
                       prev (string=? (car prev) "P") (string=? (pad:hl-nth prev 3) "(")
                       (not (and prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                 (string=? (pad:hl-nth prev2 3) "define"))))))
        (pad:blast-sites (cdr toks) name t prev (if hit (cons (cadr t) acc) acc)))))

(define (pad:blast-rows L points)
  (if (null? points)
      (list)
      (cons (car (pad:v-linecol L (car points))) (pad:blast-rows L (cdr points)))))

(define (pad:blast-insert x xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list x))
    ((= x (car xs)) xs)
    ((< x (car xs)) (cons x xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-insert x (cdr xs))))))
(define (pad:blast-sorted xs acc)
  (if (null? xs) acc (pad:blast-sorted (cdr xs) (pad:blast-insert (car xs) acc))))
(define (pad:blast-minus xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-minus (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-minus (cdr xs) ys)))))

;; rows where the changed defines start
(define (pad:blast-def-rows L toks names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (let ((ds (pad:find-defs-in toks (car names)))
            (rest (pad:blast-def-rows L toks (cdr names))))
        (if (null? ds) rest (cons (car (pad:v-linecol L (car ds))) rest)))))

;; ((name soft engine engine-before new-body-sites) ...)
;; e0s = engine counts before the transaction (pad:blast-eng-before)
(define (pad:blast-counts toks names e0s ops)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (cons (list (car names)
                  (length (pad:blast-sites toks (car names) #f #f (list)))
                  (pad:blast-eng-calls (car names))
                  (if (null? e0s) -1 (car e0s))
                  (pad:blast-new-sites ops (car names)))
            (pad:blast-counts toks (cdr names) (if (null? e0s) e0s (cdr e0s)) ops))))
;; call sites of name inside the proposal's new bodies
(define (pad:blast-new-sites ops name)
  (if (null? ops)
      0
      (+ (length (pad:blast-sites (pad:hl-tokens (cadr (car ops))) name #f #f (list)))
         (pad:blast-new-sites (cdr ops) name))))
(define (pad:blast-eng-before names)
  (if (null? names) (list) (cons (pad:blast-eng-calls (car names)) (pad:blast-eng-before (cdr names)))))
(define (pad:blast-eng-calls name)
  (try
    (let ((r (query:calls name)))
      (if (and (or (pair? r) (null? r)) (not (pad:eng-err? r))) (length r) -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))
(define (pad:blast-all-points toks names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (append (pad:blast-sites toks (car names) #f #f (list)) (pad:blast-all-points toks (cdr names)))))

;; --- engine dirty per page define ---
;; ((name . dirty-count) ...) for the defines the page writes
(define (pad:blast-dirty-of names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (cons (cons (car names) (pad:who-sum-subs (pad:q-defines-of (car names))))
            (pad:blast-dirty-of (cdr names)))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-now)
  (pad:blast-dirty-of (pad:ws-soft-defs (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*))))))
(define (pad:blast-count-of name xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) 0)
    ((string=? (car (car xs)) name) (cdr (car xs)))
    (#t (pad:blast-count-of name (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:blast-grown now before)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) (pad:blast-count-of (car (car now)) before))
     (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before)))
    (#t (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-names now)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) 0) (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now))))
    (#t (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now)))))
(define (pad:blast-subset? xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #t)
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-subset? (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t #f)))
;; same count, or (aura#4364) the engine added exactly the new sites
(define (pad:blast-count-ok? c)
  (let ((soft (cadr c)) (eng (caddr c)) (e0 (pad:nth c 3)) (new (pad:nth c 4)))
    (and (>= eng 0)
         (or (= soft eng)
             (and (>= e0 0) (= (- eng e0) new))))))
(define (pad:blast-counts-ok? cs)
  (cond
    ((null? cs) #t)
    ((pad:blast-count-ok? (car cs)) (pad:blast-counts-ok? (cdr cs)))
    (#t #f)))

;; kid name for row l of page L: the define it starts, the row when
;; short, else "line N"
(define (pad:blast-row-name L l)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src (list (list-ref L l))))
         (d (pad:why-row-def src)))
    (cond
      (d d)
      ((<= (string-length src) 18) src)
      (#t (string-append "line " (number->string (+ l 1)))))))
(define (pad:blast-row-names L rows)
  (if (null? rows) (list) (cons (pad:blast-row-name L (car rows)) (pad:blast-row-names L (cdr rows)))))

;; The card: (names use-rows use-names counts grown dirty-now verdict)
;; L1 = the page the KEEP would give; before = (dirty counts, engine
;; call counts) taken before the transaction (pad:blast-before).
(define (pad:blast-before names)
  (list (pad:blast-dirty-now) (pad:blast-eng-before names)))
(define (pad:blast-card ops L1 before)
  (set! *blast-cards* (+ *blast-cards* 1))
  (let* ((names (pad:robot-names ops))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L1)))
         (defs (pad:blast-def-rows L1 toks names))
         (uses (pad:blast-minus (pad:blast-sorted (pad:blast-rows L1 (pad:blast-all-points toks names)) (list))
                                defs))
         (d0 (car before))
         (counts (pad:blast-counts toks names (cadr before) ops))
         (d1 (pad:blast-dirty-now))
         (grown (pad:blast-grown d1 d0))
         (dirty (pad:blast-dirty-names d1))
         (ok (and (pad:blast-counts-ok? counts)
                  (pad:blast-subset? grown names)
                  (pad:blast-subset? names dirty)))
         (card (list names uses (pad:blast-row-names L1 uses) counts grown dirty
                     (if ok "agree" "disagree"))))
    (set! *blast-last* card)
    (if ok
        #f
        (begin
          (set! *blast-disagree* (+ *blast-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_BLAST_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:blast-line card)) (newline)))
    card))

(define (pad:blast-first xs n)
  (if (or (null? xs) (<= n 0)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-first (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))
(define (pad:blast-commas xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:blast-commas (cdr xs))))))

;; Kid words for a card.
(define (pad:blast-say card)
  (let* ((names (car card))
         (shown (caddr card))
         (n (length shown))
         (more (- n *blast-max-shown*)))
    (string-append
      "changing " (pad:robot-names-str names)
      (cond
        ((= n 0) " moves nothing else")
        ((= n 1) (string-append " moves 1 place: " (car shown)))
        (#t (string-append " moves " (number->string n) " places: "
                           (pad:blast-commas (pad:blast-first shown *blast-max-shown*))
                           (if (> more 0) (string-append " and " (number->string more) " more") ""))))
      ". enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")))

;; sites=name:soft/engine:+engine-added (engine total is stale after a
;; rebind, aura#4364)
;; BLAST names=hello.bye uses=6.7.11 sites=hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0 grown=hello.bye dirty=hello.bye verdict=agree
(define (pad:blast-counts-str cs)
  (if (null? cs)
      ""
      (string-append (car (car cs)) ":" (number->string (cadr (car cs))) "/"
                     (number->string (caddr (car cs)))
                     ":+" (number->string (- (caddr (car cs)) (pad:nth (car cs) 3)))
                     (if (null? (cdr cs)) "" ".")
                     (pad:blast-counts-str (cdr cs)))))
(define (pad:blast-line card)
  (string-append "BLAST names=" (pad:ws-names-str (car card))
                 " uses=" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr card))
                 " sites=" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth card 3))
                 " grown=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth card 4))
                 " dirty=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth card 5))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth card 6)))

target.body: (lambda (names) (list (pad:blast-dirty-now)))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11d -- "blast radius" card before KEEP.
;; Needs ws.aura, who_pen.aura, why.aura (and what they load). Loaded
;; before robot.aura, whose card path (pad:robot-card!) calls it.
;;
;; The helper's proposal is applied as one typed transaction inside an
;; ast:snapshot (M11a) but NOT kept yet: the page does not change, and
;; the say line shows what the change would move:
;;   "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3).
;;    enter keeps, ctrl-z says no"
;; Enter keeps it (rows projected, ctrl-z undo entry, stamps); ctrl-z
;; drops it (ast:restore + eval-current, nothing moved).
;; Soft finds the places from the page the KEEP would give (call sites =
;; a name right after "(" that is not a define head). The engine checks
;; that answer:
;;   query:calls name        -> the engine's call sites of name; their
;;                              number must equal the Soft count. After a
;;                              rebind the engine keeps the replaced body's
;;                              sites too (aura#4364), so then the engine
;;                              must have added exactly the call sites the
;;                              new bodies hold (taken before and after)
;;   query:dirty-subtree     -> per page define (query:defines name): the
;;                              defines whose dirty count grew must be
;;                              changed names, and every changed name must
;;                              be dirty now (query:dirty-nodes marks only
;;                              the rebound define node and the root)
;; c69e644 has no node -> row query, so rows come from Soft and the engine
;; confirms the counts; a mismatch prints M11_BLAST_DISAGREE.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *blast-cards* 0)
(define *blast-disagree* 0)
(define *blast-last* #f)
(define *blast-max-shown* 3)

;; token start points of the call sites of name
(define (pad:blast-sites toks name prev prev2 acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks))
             (hit (and (string=? (pad:hl-nth t 3) name)
                       prev (string=? (car prev) "P") (string=? (pad:hl-nth prev 3) "(")
                       (not (and prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                 (string=? (pad:hl-nth prev2 3) "define"))))))
        (pad:blast-sites (cdr toks) name t prev (if hit (cons (cadr t) acc) acc)))))

(define (pad:blast-rows L points)
  (if (null? points)
      (list)
      (cons (car (pad:v-linecol L (car points))) (pad:blast-rows L (cdr points)))))

(define (pad:blast-insert x xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list x))
    ((= x (car xs)) xs)
    ((< x (car xs)) (cons x xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-insert x (cdr xs))))))
(define (pad:blast-sorted xs acc)
  (if (null? xs) acc (pad:blast-sorted (cdr xs) (pad:blast-insert (car xs) acc))))
(define (pad:blast-minus xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-minus (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-minus (cdr xs) ys)))))

;; rows where the changed defines start
(define (pad:blast-def-rows L toks names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (let ((ds (pad:find-defs-in toks (car names)))
            (rest (pad:blast-def-rows L toks (cdr names))))
        (if (null? ds) rest (cons (car (pad:v-linecol L (car ds))) rest)))))

;; ((name soft engine engine-before new-body-sites) ...)
;; e0s = engine counts before the transaction (pad:blast-eng-before)
(define (pad:blast-counts toks names e0s ops)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (cons (list (car names)
                  (length (pad:blast-sites toks (car names) #f #f (list)))
                  (pad:blast-eng-calls (car names))
                  (if (null? e0s) -1 (car e0s))
                  (pad:blast-new-sites ops (car names)))
            (pad:blast-counts toks (cdr names) (if (null? e0s) e0s (cdr e0s)) ops))))
;; call sites of name inside the proposal's new bodies
(define (pad:blast-new-sites ops name)
  (if (null? ops)
      0
      (+ (length (pad:blast-sites (pad:hl-tokens (cadr (car ops))) name #f #f (list)))
         (pad:blast-new-sites (cdr ops) name))))
(define (pad:blast-eng-before names)
  (if (null? names) (list) (cons (pad:blast-eng-calls (car names)) (pad:blast-eng-before (cdr names)))))
(define (pad:blast-eng-calls name)
  (try
    (let ((r (query:calls name)))
      (if (and (or (pair? r) (null? r)) (not (pad:eng-err? r))) (length r) -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))
(define (pad:blast-all-points toks names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (append (pad:blast-sites toks (car names) #f #f (list)) (pad:blast-all-points toks (cdr names)))))

;; --- engine dirty per page define ---
;; ((name . dirty-count) ...) for the defines the page writes
(define (pad:blast-dirty-of names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (cons (cons (car names) (pad:who-sum-subs (pad:q-defines-of (car names))))
            (pad:blast-dirty-of (cdr names)))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-now)
  (pad:blast-dirty-of (pad:ws-soft-defs (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*))))))
(define (pad:blast-count-of name xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) 0)
    ((string=? (car (car xs)) name) (cdr (car xs)))
    (#t (pad:blast-count-of name (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:blast-grown now before)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) (pad:blast-count-of (car (car now)) before))
     (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before)))
    (#t (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-names now)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) 0) (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now))))
    (#t (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now)))))
(define (pad:blast-subset? xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #t)
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-subset? (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t #f)))
;; same count, or (aura#4364) the engine added exactly the new sites
(define (pad:blast-count-ok? c)
  (let ((soft (cadr c)) (eng (caddr c)) (e0 (pad:nth c 3)) (new (pad:nth c 4)))
    (and (>= eng 0)
         (or (= soft eng)
             (and (>= e0 0) (= (- eng e0) new))))))
(define (pad:blast-counts-ok? cs)
  (cond
    ((null? cs) #t)
    ((pad:blast-count-ok? (car cs)) (pad:blast-counts-ok? (cdr cs)))
    (#t #f)))

;; kid name for row l of page L: the define it starts, the row when
;; short, else "line N"
(define (pad:blast-row-name L l)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src (list (list-ref L l))))
         (d (pad:why-row-def src)))
    (cond
      (d d)
      ((<= (string-length src) 18) src)
      (#t (string-append "line " (number->string (+ l 1)))))))
(define (pad:blast-row-names L rows)
  (if (null? rows) (list) (cons (pad:blast-row-name L (car rows)) (pad:blast-row-names L (cdr rows)))))

;; The card: (names use-rows use-names counts grown dirty-now verdict)
;; L1 = the page the KEEP would give; before = (dirty counts, engine
;; call counts) taken before the transaction (pad:blast-before).
(define (pad:blast-before names)
  (list (pad:blast-dirty-now) (pad:blast-eng-before names)))
(define (pad:blast-card ops L1 before)
  (set! *blast-cards* (+ *blast-cards* 1))
  (let* ((names (pad:robot-names ops))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L1)))
         (defs (pad:blast-def-rows L1 toks names))
         (uses (pad:blast-minus (pad:blast-sorted (pad:blast-rows L1 (pad:blast-all-points toks names)) (list))
                                defs))
         (d0 (car before))
         (counts (pad:blast-counts toks names (cadr before) ops))
         (d1 (pad:blast-dirty-now))
         (grown (pad:blast-grown d1 d0))
         (dirty (pad:blast-dirty-names d1))
         (ok (and (pad:blast-counts-ok? counts)
                  (pad:blast-subset? grown names)
                  (pad:blast-subset? names dirty)))
         (card (list names uses (pad:blast-row-names L1 uses) counts grown dirty
                     (if ok "agree" "disagree"))))
    (set! *blast-last* card)
    (if ok
        #f
        (begin
          (set! *blast-disagree* (+ *blast-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_BLAST_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:blast-line card)) (newline)))
    card))

(define (pad:blast-first xs n)
  (if (or (null? xs) (<= n 0)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-first (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))
(define (pad:blast-commas xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:blast-commas (cdr xs))))))

;; Kid words for a card.
(define (pad:blast-say card)
  (let* ((names (car card))
         (shown (caddr card))
         (n (length shown))
         (more (- n *blast-max-shown*)))
    (string-append
      "changing " (pad:robot-names-str names)
      (cond
        ((= n 0) " moves nothing else")
        ((= n 1) (string-append " moves 1 place: " (car shown)))
        (#t (string-append " moves " (number->string n) " places: "
                           (pad:blast-commas (pad:blast-first shown *blast-max-shown*))
                           (if (> more 0) (string-append " and " (number->string more) " more") ""))))
      ". enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")))

;; sites=name:soft/engine:+engine-added (engine total is stale after a
;; rebind, aura#4364)
;; BLAST names=hello.bye uses=6.7.11 sites=hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0 grown=hello.bye dirty=hello.bye verdict=agree
(define (pad:blast-counts-str cs)
  (if (null? cs)
      ""
      (string-append (car (car cs)) ":" (number->string (cadr (car cs))) "/"
                     (number->string (caddr (car cs)))
                     ":+" (number->string (- (caddr (car cs)) (pad:nth (car cs) 3)))
                     (if (null? (cdr cs)) "" ".")
                     (pad:blast-counts-str (cdr cs)))))
(define (pad:blast-line card)
  (string-append "BLAST names=" (pad:ws-names-str (car card))
                 " uses=" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr card))
                 " sites=" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth card 3))
                 " grown=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth card 4))
                 " dirty=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth card 5))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth card 6)))

target.name: pad:blast-card
target.body:
(lambda (ops L1 before) (set! *blast-cards* (+ *blast-cards* 1))
  (let* ((names (pad:robot-names ops))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L1)))
         (defs (pad:blast-def-rows L1 toks names))
         (uses (pad:blast-minus (pad:blast-sorted (pad:blast-rows L1 (pad:blast-all-points toks names)) (list))
                                defs))
         (d0 (car before))
         (counts (pad:blast-counts toks names))
         (d1 (pad:blast-dirty-now))
         (grown (pad:blast-grown d1 d0))
         (dirty (pad:blast-dirty-names d1))
         (ok (and (pad:blast-counts-ok? counts)
                  (pad:blast-subset? grown names)
                  (pad:blast-subset? names dirty)))
         (card (list names uses (pad:blast-row-names L1 uses) counts grown dirty
                     (if ok "agree" "disagree"))))
    (set! *blast-last* card)
    (if ok
        #f
        (begin
          (set! *blast-disagree* (+ *blast-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_BLAST_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:blast-line card)) (newline)))
    card))

;; aura-pad M11d -- "blast radius" card before KEEP.
;; Needs ws.aura, who_pen.aura, why.aura (and what they load). Loaded
;; before robot.aura, whose card path (pad:robot-card!) calls it.
;;
;; The helper's proposal is applied as one typed transaction inside an
;; ast:snapshot (M11a) but NOT kept yet: the page does not change, and
;; the say line shows what the change would move:
;;   "changing add moves 3 places: greet, (greet (add 1 2)), (add 2 3).
;;    enter keeps, ctrl-z says no"
;; Enter keeps it (rows projected, ctrl-z undo entry, stamps); ctrl-z
;; drops it (ast:restore + eval-current, nothing moved).
;; Soft finds the places from the page the KEEP would give (call sites =
;; a name right after "(" that is not a define head). The engine checks
;; that answer:
;;   query:calls name        -> the engine's call sites of name; their
;;                              number must equal the Soft count. After a
;;                              rebind the engine keeps the replaced body's
;;                              sites too (aura#4364), so then the engine
;;                              must have added exactly the call sites the
;;                              new bodies hold (taken before and after)
;;   query:dirty-subtree     -> per page define (query:defines name): the
;;                              defines whose dirty count grew must be
;;                              changed names, and every changed name must
;;                              be dirty now (query:dirty-nodes marks only
;;                              the rebound define node and the root)
;; c69e644 has no node -> row query, so rows come from Soft and the engine
;; confirms the counts; a mismatch prints M11_BLAST_DISAGREE.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *blast-cards* 0)
(define *blast-disagree* 0)
(define *blast-last* #f)
(define *blast-max-shown* 3)

;; token start points of the call sites of name
(define (pad:blast-sites toks name prev prev2 acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks))
             (hit (and (string=? (pad:hl-nth t 3) name)
                       prev (string=? (car prev) "P") (string=? (pad:hl-nth prev 3) "(")
                       (not (and prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                                 (string=? (pad:hl-nth prev2 3) "define"))))))
        (pad:blast-sites (cdr toks) name t prev (if hit (cons (cadr t) acc) acc)))))

(define (pad:blast-rows L points)
  (if (null? points)
      (list)
      (cons (car (pad:v-linecol L (car points))) (pad:blast-rows L (cdr points)))))

(define (pad:blast-insert x xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list x))
    ((= x (car xs)) xs)
    ((< x (car xs)) (cons x xs))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-insert x (cdr xs))))))
(define (pad:blast-sorted xs acc)
  (if (null? xs) acc (pad:blast-sorted (cdr xs) (pad:blast-insert (car xs) acc))))
(define (pad:blast-minus xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-minus (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-minus (cdr xs) ys)))))

;; rows where the changed defines start
(define (pad:blast-def-rows L toks names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (let ((ds (pad:find-defs-in toks (car names)))
            (rest (pad:blast-def-rows L toks (cdr names))))
        (if (null? ds) rest (cons (car (pad:v-linecol L (car ds))) rest)))))

;; ((name soft engine engine-before new-body-sites) ...)
;; e0s = engine counts before the transaction (pad:blast-eng-before)
(define (pad:blast-counts toks names e0s ops)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (cons (list (car names)
                  (length (pad:blast-sites toks (car names) #f #f (list)))
                  (pad:blast-eng-calls (car names))
                  (if (null? e0s) -1 (car e0s))
                  (pad:blast-new-sites ops (car names)))
            (pad:blast-counts toks (cdr names) (if (null? e0s) e0s (cdr e0s)) ops))))
;; call sites of name inside the proposal's new bodies
(define (pad:blast-new-sites ops name)
  (if (null? ops)
      0
      (+ (length (pad:blast-sites (pad:hl-tokens (cadr (car ops))) name #f #f (list)))
         (pad:blast-new-sites (cdr ops) name))))
(define (pad:blast-eng-before names)
  (if (null? names) (list) (cons (pad:blast-eng-calls (car names)) (pad:blast-eng-before (cdr names)))))
(define (pad:blast-eng-calls name)
  (try
    (let ((r (query:calls name)))
      (if (and (or (pair? r) (null? r)) (not (pad:eng-err? r))) (length r) -1))
    (catch (e) -1)))
(define (pad:blast-all-points toks names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (append (pad:blast-sites toks (car names) #f #f (list)) (pad:blast-all-points toks (cdr names)))))

;; --- engine dirty per page define ---
;; ((name . dirty-count) ...) for the defines the page writes
(define (pad:blast-dirty-of names)
  (if (null? names)
      (list)
      (cons (cons (car names) (pad:who-sum-subs (pad:q-defines-of (car names))))
            (pad:blast-dirty-of (cdr names)))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-now)
  (pad:blast-dirty-of (pad:ws-soft-defs (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*))))))
(define (pad:blast-count-of name xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) 0)
    ((string=? (car (car xs)) name) (cdr (car xs)))
    (#t (pad:blast-count-of name (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:blast-grown now before)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) (pad:blast-count-of (car (car now)) before))
     (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before)))
    (#t (pad:blast-grown (cdr now) before))))
(define (pad:blast-dirty-names now)
  (cond
    ((null? now) (list))
    ((> (cdr (car now)) 0) (cons (car (car now)) (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now))))
    (#t (pad:blast-dirty-names (cdr now)))))
(define (pad:blast-subset? xs ys)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #t)
    ((member (car xs) ys) (pad:blast-subset? (cdr xs) ys))
    (#t #f)))
;; same count, or (aura#4364) the engine added exactly the new sites
(define (pad:blast-count-ok? c)
  (let ((soft (cadr c)) (eng (caddr c)) (e0 (pad:nth c 3)) (new (pad:nth c 4)))
    (and (>= eng 0)
         (or (= soft eng)
             (and (>= e0 0) (= (- eng e0) new))))))
(define (pad:blast-counts-ok? cs)
  (cond
    ((null? cs) #t)
    ((pad:blast-count-ok? (car cs)) (pad:blast-counts-ok? (cdr cs)))
    (#t #f)))

;; kid name for row l of page L: the define it starts, the row when
;; short, else "line N"
(define (pad:blast-row-name L l)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src (list (list-ref L l))))
         (d (pad:why-row-def src)))
    (cond
      (d d)
      ((<= (string-length src) 18) src)
      (#t (string-append "line " (number->string (+ l 1)))))))
(define (pad:blast-row-names L rows)
  (if (null? rows) (list) (cons (pad:blast-row-name L (car rows)) (pad:blast-row-names L (cdr rows)))))

;; The card: (names use-rows use-names counts grown dirty-now verdict)
;; L1 = the page the KEEP would give; before = (dirty counts, engine
;; call counts) taken before the transaction (pad:blast-before).
(define (pad:blast-before names)
  (list (pad:blast-dirty-now) (pad:blast-eng-before names)))
(define (pad:blast-card ops L1 before)
  (set! *blast-cards* (+ *blast-cards* 1))
  (let* ((names (pad:robot-names ops))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L1)))
         (defs (pad:blast-def-rows L1 toks names))
         (uses (pad:blast-minus (pad:blast-sorted (pad:blast-rows L1 (pad:blast-all-points toks names)) (list))
                                defs))
         (d0 (car before))
         (counts (pad:blast-counts toks names (cadr before) ops))
         (d1 (pad:blast-dirty-now))
         (grown (pad:blast-grown d1 d0))
         (dirty (pad:blast-dirty-names d1))
         (ok (and (pad:blast-counts-ok? counts)
                  (pad:blast-subset? grown names)
                  (pad:blast-subset? names dirty)))
         (card (list names uses (pad:blast-row-names L1 uses) counts grown dirty
                     (if ok "agree" "disagree"))))
    (set! *blast-last* card)
    (if ok
        #f
        (begin
          (set! *blast-disagree* (+ *blast-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_BLAST_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:blast-line card)) (newline)))
    card))

(define (pad:blast-first xs n)
  (if (or (null? xs) (<= n 0)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:blast-first (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))
(define (pad:blast-commas xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:blast-commas (cdr xs))))))

;; Kid words for a card.
(define (pad:blast-say card)
  (let* ((names (car card))
         (shown (caddr card))
         (n (length shown))
         (more (- n *blast-max-shown*)))
    (string-append
      "changing " (pad:robot-names-str names)
      (cond
        ((= n 0) " moves nothing else")
        ((= n 1) (string-append " moves 1 place: " (car shown)))
        (#t (string-append " moves " (number->string n) " places: "
                           (pad:blast-commas (pad:blast-first shown *blast-max-shown*))
                           (if (> more 0) (string-append " and " (number->string more) " more") ""))))
      ". enter keeps, ctrl-z says no")))

;; sites=name:soft/engine:+engine-added (engine total is stale after a
;; rebind, aura#4364)
;; BLAST names=hello.bye uses=6.7.11 sites=hello:3/4:+1.bye:2/2:+0 grown=hello.bye dirty=hello.bye verdict=agree
(define (pad:blast-counts-str cs)
  (if (null? cs)
      ""
      (string-append (car (car cs)) ":" (number->string (cadr (car cs))) "/"
                     (number->string (caddr (car cs)))
                     ":+" (number->string (- (caddr (car cs)) (pad:nth (car cs) 3)))
                     (if (null? (cdr cs)) "" ".")
                     (pad:blast-counts-str (cdr cs)))))
(define (pad:blast-line card)
  (string-append "BLAST names=" (pad:ws-names-str (car card))
                 " uses=" (pad:who-nums-str (cadr card))
                 " sites=" (pad:blast-counts-str (pad:nth card 3))
                 " grown=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth card 4))
                 " dirty=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth card 5))
                 " verdict=" (pad:nth card 6)))

                     (pad:blast-counts-str (cdr cs)))))

;; aura-pad M11e test cases (time machine + open-is-restore), loaded by
;; m11_test.aura after m11_cases.aura (m11:run-all calls these sections).
;; Prints T lines and M11E_ACC n OK. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *m11-ops-flip* (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (+ b a))")))
(define *m11-ops-swap* (list (list "add" "(lambda (a b) (- a b))")))
(define *m11-ops-big* (list (list "greet" "(lambda (n) (add n 2))")))
(define *m11-book* "/workspace/aura-pad/out/m11/book_e3")

(define (m11:time-out! r)
  (newline) (display (car r)) (display " time say=\"") (display (cadr r)) (display "\"") (newline)
  (if (string=? (car r) "TIME") (begin (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline)) #f)
  r)

;; start, helper closer (hello + bye), macro flip (add)
(define (m11:three-steps!)
  (m11:fresh!)
  (pad:time-start! "start")
  (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper")
  (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "macro" *m11-ops-flip* "flip") "macro")
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-e1)
  ;; 1. Each KEEP is a step on the strip; ctrl-t steps back, ctrl-n steps
  ;;    forward. Each move: ast:diff names == the names the skipped steps
  ;;    changed, engine code == the step's code, page + stamps come back.
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (let* ((L0 (begin (m11:fresh!) (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
         (code0 (pad:q-code)))
    (pad:time-start! "start")
    (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-good* "closer") "helper")
    (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "macro" *m11-ops-flip* "flip") "macro")
    (m11:expect-str "E1_STRIP3" (pad:time-strip) "start | helper: closer | [macro: flip]")
    (let ((code2 (pad:q-code)))
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 20"))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK1_SAY" *pl-say* "back to step 2 of 3: add like before the macro's flip")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK1" (pad:time-line *time-last*) "TIME from=3 to=2 eng=add soft=add code=yes verdict=agree")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK1_ROW2" (m11:row-src 2) "(define (add a b) (+ a b))")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK1_ROW0" (m11:row-src 0) "(define hello (lambda (x) (* x 2)))")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 20"))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK2_SAY" *pl-say* "back to step 1 of 3: hello and bye like before the helper's closer")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK2_VERDICT" (pad:nth *time-last* 5) "agree")
      (m11:expect-true "E1_BACK2_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
      (m11:expect-true "E1_BACK2_PAGE" (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_BACK2_WHO" (car (pad:who-ask!)) "no-who")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_STRIP1" (pad:time-strip) "[start] | helper: closer | macro: flip")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 20"))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_OLDEST" *pl-say* "this is the start, there is nothing older")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 14"))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_FWD1_SAY" *pl-say* "forward to step 2 of 3: the helper's closer is back (hello and bye)")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_FWD1_WHO" (caddr (pad:ew-ask!)) "agree")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 14"))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_FWD2_SAY" *pl-say* "forward to step 3 of 3: the macro's flip is back (add)")
      (m11:expect-true "E1_FWD2_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code2))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_FWD2_ROW2" (m11:row-src 2) "(define add (lambda (a b) (+ b a)))")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 14"))
      (m11:expect-str "E1_NEWEST" *pl-say* "this is the newest step")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_JUMP_SAY" (cadr (m11:time-out! (pad:time-go! 0))) "back to step 1 of 3: hello, bye and add like before the last 2 changes")
      (m11:expect-str "E1_JUMP" (pad:time-line *time-last*) "TIME from=3 to=1 eng=hello.bye.add soft=hello.bye.add code=yes verdict=agree")))
  (m11:acc-end! "M11E" 1)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-e2)
  ;; 2. A KEEP after stepping back cuts the future (a new branch); ctrl-z
  ;;    on the newest KEEP takes its step off the strip too; a time move
  ;;    clears robot undo (the strip is the history now).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:three-steps!)
  (pad:time-go! 0)
  (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-swap* "swap") "helper")
  (m11:expect-str "E2_BRANCH" (pad:time-strip) "start | [helper: swap]")
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (m11:expect-str "E2_UNDO_SAY" *pl-say* "the helper's whole change is gone")
  (m11:expect-str "E2_UNDO_STRIP" (pad:time-strip) "[start]")
  (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-swap* "swap") "helper")
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 20"))
  (m11:expect "E2_MOVE_CLEARS_UNDO" (length *robot-undo*) 0)
  (m11:keys! (list "IN 26"))
  (m11:expect-str "E2_NOTHING_TO_UNDO" *pl-say* "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
  (m11:expect-str "E2_DIFF_SAME" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:time-diff-names (car (list-ref *time-steps* 0)))) "none")
  (m11:expect-str "E2_DEFS" (pad:ws-names-str (map car (pad:time-defs "(begin (define a (lambda (x) (f (g x)))) (define b 2) (a b))"))) "a.b")
  (m11:expect "E2_NO_DISAGREE" *time-disagree* 0)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11E" 2)
  #t)

(define (m11:sec-e3)
  ;; 3. Save = serialize-workspace + sidecar; open = deserialize-workspace
  ;;    + sidecar, no set-code: same code, same page, the strip's story,
  ;;    and ctrl-o recovers who from the stamp whose why == the log reason
  ;;    (aura#4365: reopened records say author=0).
  (m11:acc-begin!)
  (m11:three-steps!)
  (let* ((d0 *ew-disagree*)
         (code-s (pad:q-code))
         (src-s (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
         (sv (pad:time-save! *m11-book*)))
    (m11:expect-str "E3_SAVE" (car sv) "SAVE")
    (m11:fresh!)
    (m11:expect-true "E3_CLOBBERED" (not (string=? (pad:q-code) code-s)))
    (let ((op (m11:time-out! (pad:time-open! *m11-book*))))
      (m11:expect-str "E3_OPEN" (car op) "OPEN")
      (m11:expect-str "E3_OPEN_SAY" *pl-say* "the book is open: 2 saved steps, aura has the whole story"))
    (m11:expect-true "E3_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code-s))
    (m11:expect-true "E3_PAGE" (string=? (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)) src-s))
    (m11:expect-str "E3_STRIP" (pad:time-strip) "helper: closer | macro: flip | [opened]")
    (m11:expect-str "E3_STAMP0" (pad:who-tag (pad:who-stamp-of 0)) (string-append "WHO who=helper why=closer gen=" (number->string (caddr (pad:who-stamp-of 0)))))
    (let ((recs (m11:muts)))
      (newline) (display "M11E_4365 records=") (display (number->string (length recs)))
      (display " author0=") (display (pad:who-bool (m11:all-author0? recs))) (newline))
    (let ((w (pad:time-who-ask!)))
      (newline) (display (car w)) (newline)
      (m11:expect-str "E3_WHO0_VERDICT" (caddr w) "agree")
      (m11:expect-true "E3_WHO0_REOPENED" (string-contains? (car w) "who=helper why=closer"))
      (m11:expect-true "E3_WHO0_SAY" (string-contains? (cadr w) ", from the saved book")))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:es-L *pl-st*) 2 0))
    (m11:keys! (list "IN 15"))
    (m11:expect-true "E3_WHO2_SAY" (string-prefix? *pl-say* "a macro wrote add: flip"))
    (m11:expect "E3_NO_WHO_DISAGREE" (- *ew-disagree* d0) 0)
    (let ((code-o (pad:q-code)))
      (pad:robot-line-out! (pad:robot-step! "helper" *m11-ops-big* "bigger") "helper")
      (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:es-L *pl-st*) 5 0))
      (let ((w (pad:time-who-ask!)))
        (newline) (display (car w)) (newline)
        (m11:expect-str "E3_NEW_VERDICT" (caddr w) "agree")
        (m11:expect-true "E3_NEW_LIVE" (not (string-contains? (car w) "reopened="))))
      (m11:expect-str "E3_STRIP2" (pad:time-strip) "helper: closer | macro: flip | opened | [helper: bigger]")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 20"))
      (m11:expect-true "E3_BACK_CODE" (string=? (pad:q-code) code-o))
      (m11:expect-str "E3_BACK_VERDICT" (pad:nth *time-last* 5) "agree")
      (m11:keys! (list "IN 20"))
      (m11:expect-str "E3_OPEN_EDGE" *pl-say* "this is where the book was opened, older steps are only in the story"))
    (m11:expect-str "E3_NO_BOOK" (car (pad:time-open! "/workspace/aura-pad/out/m11/no_such_book")) "NOOPEN")
    (m11:expect "E3_NO_DISAGREE" *time-disagree* 0))
  (set! *time-reopened* #f)
  (m11:acc-end! "M11E" 3)
  #t)

;; every author= token of the log is author=0 (aura#4365 still open)
(define (m11:all-author0? toks)
  (cond
    ((null? toks) #t)
    ((and (string-prefix? (car toks) "author=") (not (string=? (car toks) "author=0"))) #f)
    (#t (m11:all-author0? (cdr toks)))))

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft play loop for the thin C viewport (c/pad_play.c).
;; stdin : "IN <byte>" (raw key byte forwarded by C, uninterpreted),
;;         "KEY <word>" (scripted command word), "QUIT".
;; stdout: SNAP v1 pad blocks only (see view.aura).
;; Soft owns everything: the keymap (bytes -> commands), the gate, the
;; buffer, cursor, jump stack, HL tape, marks and kid words. C forwards
;; bytes and blits; it never learns what a key means.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/buffer.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/lines.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/edit.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/hl.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/jump.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/view.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/lc.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/keys.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/card.aura")


;; M8: wrap KEY goal:... without touching keys.aura play-cmd! (Soft tip
;; type-check is fragile around new cond arms in that file).
(define *pad-play-line-base* pad:play-line!)
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string-prefix? line "KEY ")
           (>= (string-length line) 9)
           (string=? (substring line 4 9) "goal:"))
      (let ((r (pad:card-goal! (substring line 4 (string-length line)))))
        (if (car r)
            (pad:play-ok! (car (cdr (cdr r))))
            (begin
              (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
              (set! *pl-say* (car (cdr (cdr r))))
              (car (cdr r)))))
      (*pad-play-line-base* line)))

;; PAD_PAGE=big starts on the twelve-row page (scripts/bench_editors.sh)
(pad:play-reset! (if (equal? (getenv "PAD_PAGE") "big") *lc-big-page* *play-start*))
(pad:play-emit!)
(let loop ()
  (let ((line (read-line)))
    (if (string? line)
        (let ((r (pad:play-line! line)))
          (cond
            ((string=? r "quit") 0)
            ((string=? r "pending") (loop))

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft play loop for the thin C viewport (c/pad_play.c).
;; stdin : "IN <b1> [<b2> ...]" (the raw key bytes of one read() in C,
;;         uninterpreted; one byte per line works too),
;;         "KEY <word>" (scripted command word), "QUIT".
;; stdout: SNAP v1 pad blocks only (see view.aura); SNAP v2 pad after
;;         C offers "WIRE 2" (soft/pad/wire2.aura, c/snap.c).
;; Soft owns everything: the keymap (bytes -> commands), the gate, the
;; buffer, cursor, jump stack, HL tape, marks and kid words. C forwards
;; bytes and blits; it never learns what a key means.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; aura-pad FILE (c/aura_pad.c) starts this file with AURA_PAD_HOME (the
;; dir that holds soft/pad, installed or source tree) and PAD_FILE (the
;; absolute path of FILE). file.aura opens and saves it; without
;; PAD_FILE the play page below is unchanged. The smokes run without
;; AURA_PAD_HOME (box layout, /workspace/aura-pad).
(define *pad-home*
  (let ((h (getenv "AURA_PAD_HOME")))
    (if (and (string? h) (> (string-length h) 0)) h "/workspace/aura-pad")))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/buffer.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lines.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/edit.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/hl.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/jump.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/view.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/lc.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/keys.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/card.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/who.aura"))


;; M8 (KEY goal:), M10 (IN 15 ctrl-o) and the one-call-per-line
;; key path live in play_in.aura (loadable, so gap_test.aura can check
;; its frames against the keys.aura path).
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/play_in.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/wire2.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/file.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/vi.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/screen.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/emacs.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/win.aura"))
(load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/ux.aura"))

;; PAD_PAGE=big starts on the twelve-row page (scripts/bench_editors.sh)
(pad:play-reset! (if (equal? (getenv "PAD_PAGE") "big") *lc-big-page* *play-start*))
(pad:who-reset!)
;; aura-pad FILE: open it (file.aura). getenv gives () when unset.
(define *play-file* (getenv "PAD_FILE"))
(if (and (string? *play-file*) (> (string-length *play-file*) 0))
    (pad:pf-open! *play-file*)
    0)
;; aura-pad sets PAD_VI=1 (evil normal / insert). Smokes leave it unset.
;; PAD_SENTENCE=1 is the sentence branch even when PAD_VI=1 is also set.
;; That branch does not call pad:vi-boot!. A file frame grows a "> " line.
(if (pad:ux-on?)
    (pad:ux-chrome!)
    (pad:vi-boot!))
;; PAD_DEFER=1: early frame before the rows below a string edit settle.
;; With the stdin poll (char-ready?, aura#4358 fixed in b8f008d) the
;; early frame is on by default (PAD_DEFER=0 turns it off) and a waiting
;; key skips the settle.
(define *play-poll* (pad:pi-cap-poll))
(set! *pi-defer* (or (equal? (getenv "PAD_DEFER") "1")
                     (and (not (string=? *play-poll* "")) (not (equal? (getenv "PAD_DEFER") "0")))))
;; char-ready? (Soft 18b48dc+) is looked up once and called directly;
;; it answers #t / #f. Older Soft has no poll: *pi-pending* stays #f.
;; PAD_POLL=0 leaves it off: a smoke that pipes a whole key stream sees
;; char-ready? #t at every key, so no settle would ever be written
;; (smoke_aura_perf drives the skip path with PAD_TEST_PENDING instead).
(if (and (string=? *play-poll* "char-ready?") (not (equal? (getenv "PAD_POLL") "0")))
    (set! *pi-pending* (eval "char-ready?"))
    0)
;; smoke only: pretend a key is waiting at every k-th early frame
(if (and (string? (getenv "PAD_TEST_PENDING")) (string->number (getenv "PAD_TEST_PENDING")))
    (begin (set! *pi-tp-k* (string->number (getenv "PAD_TEST_PENDING")))
           (set! *pi-pending* pad:pi-test-pending))
    0)
;; The read stack stays off arrow keys. The first "KEY check" loads it.
;; This file's load list does not include the notebook or the query pad.
(define *read-ready* #f)

(define (pad:play-check!)
  (if (not *read-ready*)
      (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/read.aura")))
  (if *read-ready*
      (pad:read-load!)
      0)
  "go")
(pad:vw-boot!)
(pad:play-emit!)
(let loop ()
  (let ((line (read-line)))
    (if (string? line)
        ;; "WIN rows cols" (87 73 78 32) is the terminal size, not a key.
        ;; "WIRE ..." (87 = W) is C's wire offer. File keys (ctrl-x /
        ;; ctrl-q / ctrl-s, file mode only) go to file.aura, unless a
        ;; prompt is open (search uses ctrl-s for the next match).
        (if (string=? (cond
                        ((and (> (string-length line) 3)
                              (= (string-ref line 0) 87)
                              (= (string-ref line 1) 73)
                              (= (string-ref line 2) 78)
                              (= (string-ref line 3) 32))
                         (pad:vw-win! line))
                        ((and (> (string-length line) 5) (= (string-ref line 0) 87))
                         (pad:w2-line! line))
                        ((and *pf-on* (string=? *vi-op* "")
                              (or *pf-cx* *pf-quit* (member line *pf-keys*)))
                         (pad:pf-line! line))
                        ((string=? line "KEY check")
                         (pad:play-check!))
                        (#t (pad:play-step! line)))
                      "quit")
            0
            (loop))
        0)))

;; aura-pad M11c -- "why did it break?" in kid words.
;; Needs ws.aura, eng_who.aura (and what they load). Loaded before
;; robot.aura, which calls pad:why-probe! when aura refuses a proposal.
;;
;; typed-mutate-atomic answers only #t / #f, so after a refusal the pad
;; replays the proposal one mutate:rebind at a time (still before the
;; heal, so the robot's single ast:restore + eval-current puts back
;; whatever the replay committed). The first edit aura refuses gives the
;; engine's own text:
;;   type error: argument 1: expected String, got Int / blamed: caller
;;   arity mismatch: call 'hello': expected 1 arguments, got 2
;;   unbound variable: frob
;;   (parse-error "1:21: unexpected ')'")
;; and a Soft table turns it into one short sentence for the say line:
;;   "the helper's greet used a number where words go"
;;   "the helper's bye gives hello 2 things, it wants 1"
;;   "the helper's bye uses frob, nothing is called that yet"
;;   "the helper's bye has a bracket in the wrong place"
;; When aura blames a line that uses the changed define (a caller), the
;; sentence names that line instead:
;;   "the helper's hello now wants 2 things, but bye gives it 1"
;;   "the helper's bye does not fit (bye 4)"
;; typecheck-incremental lines (after a KEEP) go through the same table.
;; "unbound variable: X" is dropped when X is a notebook define:
;; typecheck-incremental reports value defines as unbound (aura#4363).
;; The engine silently closes a missing ")" in a rebind body, so the
;; robot gate counts brackets itself (pad:why-brackets-ok?).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *why-probes* 0)
(define *why-last* (list #f "none" "" ""))   ; (name kind text sentence)

;; --- tiny string search (texts are short) ---
(define (pad:why-find s pat i)
  (cond
    ((> (+ i (string-length pat)) (string-length s)) -1)
    ((string=? (substring s i (+ i (string-length pat))) pat) i)
    (#t (pad:why-find s pat (+ i 1)))))
(define (pad:why-has? s pat) (>= (pad:why-find s pat 0) 0))
;; s from i up to the first char whose code is in stops
(define (pad:why-until s i j stops)
  (cond
    ((>= j (string-length s)) (substring s i j))
    ((member (char->integer (string-ref s j)) stops) (substring s i j))
    (#t (pad:why-until s i (+ j 1) stops))))
;; text after the first pat, up to a stop char; "" when pat is missing
(define (pad:why-after s pat stops)
  (let ((k (pad:why-find s pat 0)))
    (if (< k 0)
        ""
        (pad:why-until s (+ k (string-length pat)) (+ k (string-length pat)) stops))))
(define *why-stops* (list 10 59 44 39 32))   ; \n ; , ' space

(define (pad:why-type-word t)
  (cond
    ((string=? t "String") "words")
    ((member t (list "Int" "Integer" "Float" "Number" "Num" "Real")) "a number")
    ((member t (list "Bool" "Boolean")) "yes or no")
    ((string=? t "Char") "a letter")
    ((member t (list "List" "Pair")) "a list")
    ((string=? t "Symbol") "a name")
    ((string=? t "") "something")
    ((let ((c (char->integer (string-ref t 0)))) (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122))) "something else")
    (#t t)))

(define (pad:why-things n)
  (string-append n (if (string=? n "1") " thing" " things")))

(define (pad:why-owner who name)
  (string-append
    (cond
      ((string=? who "helper") "the helper's ")
      ((string=? who "macro") "the macro's ")
      ((string=? who "law") "the law's ")
      ((string=? who "kid") "your ")
      (#t "the "))
    name))

;; engine text -> kind: arity | type | unbound | brackets | other
(define (pad:why-kind text)
  (cond
    ((pad:why-has? text "arity mismatch") "arity")
    ((pad:why-has? text "type error") "type")
    ((pad:why-has? text "incompatible ground types") "type")
    ((pad:why-has? text "unbound variable: ") "unbound")
    ((or (pad:why-has? text "parse-error") (pad:why-has? text "unexpected ')'")
         (pad:why-has? text "unexpected end")) "brackets")
    (#t "other")))

;; Where aura points: the 1-based line after "(selective) failed: " (lines
;; of the notebook as checked), or -1. ("mutation-failed: " comes first.)
(define (pad:why-line text)
  (pad:ew-num (pad:why-after text ") failed: " (list 58 10 59 32))))
(define (pad:why-row-src l)
  (if (and (>= l 0) (< l (length (pad:es-L *pl-st*))))
      (pad:v-src (list (list-ref (pad:es-L *pl-st*) l)))
      ""))
(define (pad:why-row-def src)
  (let ((ds (if (string=? src "") (list) (pad:ws-soft-defs (pad:hl-tokens src)))))
    (if (pair? ds) (car ds) #f)))
;; The error sits in a line that USES name (not in name's new body):
;; a caller no longer fits the change.
(define (pad:why-caller? text name)
  (let* ((line (pad:why-line text))
         (src (pad:why-row-src (- line 1)))
         (d (pad:why-row-def src)))
    (and (> line 0)
         (string-contains? src (string-append "(" name))
         (not (and d (string=? d name))))))
;; Kid name for a line: the define it starts, the row itself when short,
;; else "line N".
(define (pad:why-where text)
  (let* ((line (pad:why-line text))
         (src (pad:why-row-src (- line 1)))
         (d (pad:why-row-def src)))
    (cond
      (d d)
      ((and (> (string-length src) 0) (<= (string-length src) 18)) src)
      (#t (string-append "line " (number->string line))))))

;; One kid sentence for engine text about define name, written by who.
(define (pad:why-kid text who name)
  (let ((k (pad:why-kind text))
        (o (pad:why-owner who name)))
    (cond
      ((and (string=? k "arity") (pad:why-caller? text name))
       (string-append o " now wants " (pad:why-things (pad:why-after text "expected " *why-stops*))
                      ", but " (pad:why-where text) " gives it "
                      (pad:why-after text "got " *why-stops*)))
      ((and (string=? k "type") (pad:why-caller? text name))
       (string-append o " does not fit " (pad:why-where text)))
      ((string=? k "arity")
       (string-append o " gives " (pad:why-after text "call '" *why-stops*) " "
                      (pad:why-things (pad:why-after text "got " *why-stops*))
                      ", it wants " (pad:why-after text "expected " *why-stops*)))
      ((string=? k "type")
       (string-append o " used " (pad:why-type-word (pad:why-after text "got " *why-stops*))
                      " where " (pad:why-type-word (pad:why-after text "expected " *why-stops*))
                      " go"))
      ((string=? k "unbound")
       (string-append o " uses " (pad:why-after text "unbound variable: " *why-stops*)
                      ", nothing is called that yet"))
      ((string=? k "brackets") (string-append o " has a bracket in the wrong place"))
      (#t "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved"))))

;; Text of a mutate result: "" for #t, the reason string for a refusal.
(define (pad:why-text r)
  (cond
    ((eq? r #t) "")
    ((and (pair? r) (string? (car r)) (pair? (cdr r)) (string? (cadr r)))
     (string-append (car r) ": " (cadr r)))
    ((string? r) r)
    (#t "refused")))

;; Replay ops one rebind at a time; first refusal -> (name kind text sentence).
;; Call it while the snapshot taken before the proposal is still to be
;; restored (the replay may commit the good edits).
(define (pad:why-replay who ops why)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list #f "other" "" "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
      (let* ((op (car ops))
             (r (try (mutate:rebind (car op) (cadr op) why) (catch (e) "raised")))
             (t (pad:why-text r)))
        (if (string=? t "")
            (pad:why-replay who (cdr ops) why)
            (list (car op) (pad:why-kind t) t (pad:why-kid t who (car op)))))))

(define (pad:why-probe! who ops why)
  (set! *why-probes* (+ *why-probes* 1))
  (let ((w (pad:why-replay who ops why)))
    (set! *why-last* w)
    w))

;; --- brackets (the engine closes a missing ")" by itself) ---
(define (pad:why-brackets-ok? lam)
  (= (pad:ws-paren-depth (pad:hl-tokens lam)) 0))

;; --- typecheck-incremental diagnostics ---
;; "  [3] 1:18: unbound variable: pet" -> "unbound variable: pet"
(define (pad:why-diag-msg line)
  (let ((k (pad:why-find line "] " 0)))
    (if (< k 0)
        ""
        (let* ((rest (substring line (+ k 2) (string-length line)))
               (c (pad:why-find rest ": " 0)))
          (if (and (>= c 0) (< c 8)) (substring rest (+ c 2) (string-length rest)) rest)))))
;; keep a message unless it is a false "unbound" for a notebook define
(define (pad:why-diag-real? msg)
  (if (string-prefix? msg "unbound variable: ")
      (not (pad:ew-nid (pad:why-after msg "unbound variable: " *why-stops*)))
      (> (string-length msg) 0)))
(define (pad:why-diag-msgs lines acc)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (reverse acc))
    ((and (string-prefix? (car lines) "  [") (pad:why-diag-real? (pad:why-diag-msg (car lines))))
     (pad:why-diag-msgs (cdr lines) (cons (pad:why-diag-msg (car lines)) acc)))
    (#t (pad:why-diag-msgs (cdr lines) acc))))
;; typecheck-incremental text -> real diagnostic messages
(define (pad:why-diags tc)
  (if (string? tc) (pad:why-diag-msgs (string-split tc "\n") (list)) (list)))
(define (pad:why-tc-now)
  (try (pad:why-diags (typecheck-incremental)) (catch (e) (list))))

;; Lazy read stack. play.aura loads this file on the first "KEY check".
;; An arrow never loads it. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; This order does not fix aura#4351. play.aura has already loaded the
;; editor, so std cannot be first among every pad file. A false baseline
;; or a false pad:q-sane? is a real leak: print GAPS read-leak, set the
;; status to insane, and do not set-code. Do not describe that failure
;; as aura#4351 being solved by this load order.
;;
;; pad:q-sane? does not exist until query.aura has loaded. Calling it
;; earlier is unbound and re-runs play.aura (R7), which is not a baseline.
;; query.aura also freezes *pad-q-gaps* and *pad-q-used* at load, and it
;; needs std/query first, so query.aura is not loaded to invent the name.

(define *read-based* #f)
(define *read-base* #f)
(define *read-join* #f)
(define *read-done* #f)
(define *read-q* #f)
(define *read-canary* "")

(define (pad:read-bool b)
  (if b "true" "false"))

(define (pad:read-show! s)
  (display s)
  (newline)
  0)

;; The three forms on query.aura line 171. Recorded once, before std.aura,
;; query.aura, and ws.aura load. This function does not call pad:q-sane?.
(define (pad:read-sane?)
  (if (not *read-based*)
      (begin
        (set! *read-join* string-join)
        (set! *read-base*
              (and (null? (list))
                   (not (pair? (null? (list 1))))
                   (not (null? (list 1)))))
        (set! *read-based* #t)))
  *read-base*)

(define (pad:read-leak!)
  (pad:read-show! "GAPS read-leak")
  (pad:read-show! "READ state=insane")
  (set! *pl-say* "insane")
  0)

;; The pad's own string-join (view.aura). Not a stand-in for either probe.
;; A rebound name is not called: std/string's copy hangs (aura#4372).
(define (pad:read-canary!)
  (set! *read-canary*
        (if (eq? string-join *read-join*)
            (string-join (list "a" "b") ",")
            "rebound"))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ canary=" *read-canary*))
  (pad:read-show!
    (string-append "READ set_code=" (number->string *ws-set-code-n*)))
  (pad:read-show! "READ state=sane")
  (set! *pl-say* "sane")
  0)

;; std, then query, then ws, and only then pad:q-sane?.
(define (pad:read-stack!)
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=std")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/std.aura"))
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=query")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/query.aura"))
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=ws")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/ws.aura"))
  (set! *read-q* (pad:q-sane?))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ q-sane=" (pad:read-bool *read-q*)))
  (if *read-q*
      (pad:read-canary!)
      (begin
        (pad:read-show!
          (string-append "READ set_code=" (number->string *ws-set-code-n*)))
        (pad:read-leak!))))

(define (pad:read-load!)
  (if *read-done*
      0
      (begin
        (pad:read-show!
          (string-append "READ baseline=" (pad:read-bool (pad:read-sane?))))
        (if *read-base*
            (pad:read-stack!)
            (begin
              (pad:read-show! "READ q-sane=unbound")
              (pad:read-show! "READ set_code=0")
              (pad:read-leak!)))
        (set! *read-done* #t)
        (pad:play-emit!))))

(pad:read-show! "READ loaded")
(set! *read-ready* #t)

;; pair (aura#4366). This is not the notebook rows define.
(define (pad:read-src L)

(define (pad:read-id? c)

;; Lazy read stack. play.aura loads this file on the first "KEY check".
;; An arrow never loads it. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; This order does not fix aura#4351. play.aura has already loaded the
;; editor, so std cannot be first among every pad file. A false baseline
;; or a false pad:q-sane? is a real leak: print GAPS read-leak, set the
;; status to insane, and do not set-code. Do not describe that failure
;; as aura#4351 being solved by this load order.
;;
;; pad:q-sane? does not exist until query.aura has loaded. Calling it
;; earlier is unbound and re-runs play.aura (R7), which is not a baseline.
;; query.aura also freezes *pad-q-gaps* and *pad-q-used* at load, and it
;; needs std/query first, so query.aura is not loaded to invent the name.

(define *read-based* #f)
(define *read-base* #f)
(define *read-join* #f)
(define *read-done* #f)
(define *read-q* #f)
(define *read-canary* "")
(define *read-frame* #f)
(define *read-cache* (list))
(define *read-status* "none")

(define (pad:read-bool b)
  (if b "true" "false"))

(define (pad:read-show! s)
  (display s)
  (newline)
  0)

;; The three forms on query.aura line 171. Recorded once, before std.aura,
;; query.aura, and ws.aura load. This function does not call pad:q-sane?.
(define (pad:read-sane?)
  (if (not *read-based*)
      (begin
        (set! *read-join* string-join)
        (set! *read-base*
              (and (null? (list))
                   (not (pair? (null? (list 1))))
                   (not (null? (list 1)))))
        (set! *read-based* #t)))
  *read-base*)

(define (pad:read-leak!)
  (pad:read-show! "GAPS read-leak")
  (pad:read-show! "READ state=insane")
  (set! *pl-say* "insane")
  0)

;; The pad's own string-join (view.aura). Not a stand-in for either probe.
;; A rebound name is not called: std/string's copy hangs (aura#4372).
(define (pad:read-canary!)
  (set! *read-canary*
        (if (eq? string-join *read-join*)
            (string-join (list "a" "b") ",")
            "rebound"))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ canary=" *read-canary*))
  (pad:read-show!
    (string-append "READ set_code=" (number->string *ws-set-code-n*)))
  (pad:read-show! "READ state=sane")
  (set! *pl-say* "sane")
  0)

;; std, then query, then ws, and only then pad:q-sane?.
(define (pad:read-stack!)
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=std")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/std.aura"))
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=query")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/query.aura"))
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=ws")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/ws.aura"))
  (set! *read-q* (pad:q-sane?))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ q-sane=" (pad:read-bool *read-q*)))
  (if *read-q*
      (pad:read-canary!)
      (begin
        (pad:read-show!
          (string-append "READ set_code=" (number->string *ws-set-code-n*)))
        (pad:read-leak!))))

(define (pad:read-load!)
  (if *read-done*
      0
      (begin
        (pad:read-show!
          (string-append "READ baseline=" (pad:read-bool (pad:read-sane?))))
        (if *read-base*
            (pad:read-stack!)
            (begin
              (pad:read-show! "READ q-sane=unbound")
              (pad:read-show! "READ set_code=0")
              (pad:read-leak!)))
        (set! *read-done* #t)
        (if *read-frame* (pad:play-emit!) 0))))

;; Page text plus a trailing #t so eval-current is not a procedure or a
;; pair (aura#4366). This is not the notebook rows define.
(define (pad:read-src L)
  (string-append (pad:v-src L) "\n#t\n"))

;; Workspace ids start at 0, and 0 is false. Accept every number, including 0.
(define (pad:read-id? c)
  (number? c))

(define (pad:read-row-name row)
  (if (and (pair? row) (pair? (cdr row)) (string? (cadr row)))
      (cadr row)
      ""))

(define (pad:read-has-name? rows name)
  (cond
    ((null? rows) #f)
    ((string=? (pad:read-row-name (car rows)) name) #t)
    (#t (pad:read-has-name? (cdr rows) name))))

(define (pad:read-plain v)
  (cond
    ((null? v) (list))
    ((or (number? v) (string? v) (eq? v #t) (eq? v #f)) v)
    ((pair? v) (cons (pad:read-plain (car v)) (pad:read-plain (cdr v))))
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:read-lookup name)
  (try
    (let ((r (define-lookup name)))
      (if (pad:eng-err? r) (list) (pad:read-plain r)))
    (catch (e)
      (if (pad:unbound-msg? e) "gap" (list)))))

(define (pad:read-refs look)
  (if (and (pair? look) (pair? (car look)) (number? (car (car look))))
      (pad:read-plain (pad:q-ref-counts (car (car look))))
      -1))

(define (pad:read-note! s)
  (pad:read-show! s)
  (set! *read-status* "fail")
  0)

;; set-code in the child replaces that workspace, so the counter set! inside
;; pad:ws-set-code! may not be the root binding we switch back to. After
;; the switch, record the call on the root when the child copy was dropped.
(define (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 did-eval)
  (try (workspace :switch 0) (catch (e) #f))
  (try (workspace:delete c) (catch (e) #f))
  (if (= *ws-set-code-n* n0)
      (set! *ws-set-code-n* (+ n0 1))
      0)
  (if (and did-eval (= *ws-eval-n* e0))
      (set! *ws-eval-n* (+ e0 1))
      0)
  0)

(define (pad:read-finish! code0 t0)
  (let ((rows (try (workspace :list) (catch (e) #f))))
    (if (not (or (null? rows) (pair? rows)))
        (pad:read-note! "READ list-fail")
        (if (pad:read-has-name? rows "read")
            (pad:read-note! "READ child-left")
            (if (not (and (string? code0) (> (string-length code0) 0)
                          (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
                (pad:read-note! "READ_DISAGREE")
                (let ((canary (string-join (list "a" "b") ",")))
                  (if (not (string=? canary "a,b"))
                      (pad:read-note! "GAPS read-leak")
                      (if (not (pad:q-sane?))
                          (pad:read-note! "GAPS read-leak")
                          (begin
                            (set! *ws-load-ms* (- (current-time-ms) t0))
                            (set! *read-status* "checked")
                            (pad:read-show!
                              (string-append "READ ms=" (number->string *ws-load-ms*)))
                            (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ " (pad:ws-stats-str)))
                            (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ canary=" canary))
                            (pad:read-show! "READ q-sane=true")
                            (pad:read-show! "READ root=same")
                            (pad:read-show! "READ state=checked")
                            0)))))))))

(define (pad:read-gather! c n0 e0 code0 t0)
  (let ((look (pad:read-lookup "hello")))
    (if (string? look)
        (begin
          (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
          (pad:read-note! "GAPS define-lookup"))
        (if (not (pair? look))
            (begin
              (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
              (pad:read-note! "READ miss hello"))
            (let ((cache (list look
                               (pad:read-plain (pad:q-defines))
                               (pad:read-plain (pad:q-defuse "hello"))
                               (pad:read-plain (pad:q-node-types))
                               (pad:read-refs look))))
              (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
              (set! *read-cache* cache)
              (pad:read-finish! code0 t0))))))

(define (pad:read-switched! c L n0 e0 code0 t0)
  (try (workspace :switch c) (catch (e) #f))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ child=" (number->string c)))
  (let ((r1 (pad:ws-set-code! (pad:read-src L))))
    (if (not (string=? r1 "ok"))
        (begin
          (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #f)
          (pad:read-note! "READ set-code-fail"))
        (let ((r2 (pad:ws-eval!)))
          (if (not (or (string=? r2 "ok") (string=? r2 "note")))
              (begin
                (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
                (pad:read-note! "READ eval-fail"))
              (pad:read-gather! c n0 e0 code0 t0))))))

(define (pad:read-check! L)
  (let ((code0 (pad:q-code))
        (t0 (current-time-ms))
        (n0 *ws-set-code-n*)
        (e0 *ws-eval-n*))
    (let ((c (try (workspace :create "read") (catch (e) #f))))
      (if (not (pad:read-id? c))
          (pad:read-note! "READ no-world")
          (pad:read-switched! c L n0 e0 code0 t0)))))

(pad:read-show! "READ loaded")
(set! *read-ready* #t)

;; query.aura, and ws.aura load. This function does not call pad:q-sane?.
(define (pad:read-sane?)
  (if (not *read-based*)
      (begin
        (set! *read-join* string-join)
        (set! *read-base*
              (and (null? (list))
                   (not (pair? (null? (list 1))))
                   (not (null? (list 1)))))
        (set! *read-based* #t)))
  *read-base*)

(define (pad:read-leak!)
  (pad:read-show! "GAPS read-leak")
  (pad:read-show! "READ state=insane")
  (set! *pl-say* "insane")
  0)

;; The pad's own string-join (view.aura). Not a stand-in for either probe.
;; A rebound name is not called: std/string's copy hangs (aura#4372).
(define (pad:read-canary!)
  (set! *read-canary*
        (if (eq? string-join *read-join*)
            (string-join (list "a" "b") ",")
            "rebound"))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ canary=" *read-canary*))
  (pad:read-show!
    (string-append "READ set_code=" (number->string *ws-set-code-n*)))
  (pad:read-show! "READ state=sane")
  (set! *pl-say* "sane")
  0)

;; std, then query, then ws, and only then pad:q-sane?.
(define (pad:read-stack!)
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=std")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/std.aura"))
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=query")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/query.aura"))
  (pad:read-show! "READ loads=ws")
  (load (string-append *pad-home* "/soft/pad/ws.aura"))
  (set! *read-q* (pad:q-sane?))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ q-sane=" (pad:read-bool *read-q*)))
  (if *read-q*
      (pad:read-canary!)
      (begin
        (pad:read-show!
          (string-append "READ set_code=" (number->string *ws-set-code-n*)))
        (pad:read-leak!))))

(define (pad:read-load!)
  (if *read-done*
      0
      (begin
        (pad:read-show!
          (string-append "READ baseline=" (pad:read-bool (pad:read-sane?))))
        (if *read-base*
            (pad:read-stack!)
            (begin
              (pad:read-show! "READ q-sane=unbound")
              (pad:read-show! "READ set_code=0")
              (pad:read-leak!)))
        (set! *read-done* #t)
        (if *read-frame* (pad:play-emit!) 0))))

;; Page text plus a trailing #t so eval-current is not a procedure or a
;; pair (aura#4366). This is not the notebook rows define.
(define (pad:read-src L)
  (string-append (pad:v-src L) "\n#t\n"))

;; Workspace ids start at 0, and 0 is false. Accept every number, including 0.
(define (pad:read-id? c)
  (number? c))

(define (pad:read-row-name row)
  (if (and (pair? row) (pair? (cdr row)) (string? (cadr row)))
      (cadr row)
      ""))

(define (pad:read-has-name? rows name)
  (cond
    ((null? rows) #f)
    ((string=? (pad:read-row-name (car rows)) name) #t)
    (#t (pad:read-has-name? (cdr rows) name))))

(define (pad:read-plain v)
  (cond
    ((null? v) (list))
    ((or (number? v) (string? v) (eq? v #t) (eq? v #f)) v)
    ((pair? v) (cons (pad:read-plain (car v)) (pad:read-plain (cdr v))))
    (#t 0)))

(define (pad:read-lookup name)
  (try
    (let ((r (define-lookup name)))
      (if (pad:eng-err? r) (list) (pad:read-plain r)))
    (catch (e)
      (if (pad:unbound-msg? e) "gap" (list)))))

(define (pad:read-refs look)
  (if (and (pair? look) (pair? (car look)) (number? (car (car look))))
      (pad:read-plain (pad:q-ref-counts (car (car look))))
      -1))

(define (pad:read-note! s)
  (pad:read-show! s)
  (set! *read-status* "fail")
  0)

;; set-code in the child replaces that workspace, so the counter set! inside
;; pad:ws-set-code! may not be the root binding we switch back to. After
;; the switch, record the call on the root when the child copy was dropped.
(define (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 did-eval)
  (try (workspace :switch 0) (catch (e) #f))
  (try (workspace:delete c) (catch (e) #f))
  (if (= *ws-set-code-n* n0)
      (set! *ws-set-code-n* (+ n0 1))
      0)
  (if (and did-eval (= *ws-eval-n* e0))
      (set! *ws-eval-n* (+ e0 1))
      0)
  0)

;; M9 shape: missing = Soft defines the engine did not birth,
;; extra = engine births the Soft define scan missed. Log only.
;; A non-empty diff stays "checked" and does not write SAY.
;; pad:hl-tokens is the editor highlighter (play loads hl before view).
(define (pad:read-diff L)
  (let* ((toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src L)))
         (soft (pad:ws-soft-defs toks))
         (eng (pad:ws-engine-defs toks)))
    (list (pad:ws-diff soft eng) (pad:ws-diff eng soft))))

(define (pad:read-log-diff! miss extra)
  (let ((ms (pad:ws-names-str miss))
        (ex (pad:ws-names-str extra)))
    (set! *read-missing* ms)
    (set! *read-extra* ex)
    (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ missing=" ms))
    (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ extra=" ex))
    0))

(define (pad:read-finish! code0 t0 miss extra)
  (let ((rows (try (workspace :list) (catch (e) #f))))
    (if (not (or (null? rows) (pair? rows)))
        (pad:read-note! "READ list-fail")
        (if (pad:read-has-name? rows "read")
            (pad:read-note! "READ child-left")
            (if (not (and (string? code0) (> (string-length code0) 0)
                          (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
                (pad:read-note! "READ_DISAGREE")
                (let ((canary (string-join (list "a" "b") ",")))
                  (if (not (string=? canary "a,b"))
                      (pad:read-note! "GAPS read-leak")
                      (if (not (pad:q-sane?))
                          (pad:read-note! "GAPS read-leak")
                          (begin
                            (set! *ws-load-ms* (- (current-time-ms) t0))
                            (set! *read-status* "checked")
                            (pad:read-show!
                              (string-append "READ ms=" (number->string *ws-load-ms*)))
                            (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ " (pad:ws-stats-str)))
                            (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ canary=" canary))
                            (pad:read-show! "READ q-sane=true")
                            (pad:read-show! "READ root=same")
                            (pad:read-show! "READ state=checked")
                            (pad:read-log-diff! miss extra)
                            0)))))))))

(define (pad:read-gather! c L n0 e0 code0 t0)
  (let ((look (pad:read-lookup "hello")))
    (if (string? look)
        (begin
          (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
          (pad:read-note! "GAPS define-lookup"))
        (if (not (pair? look))
            (begin
              (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
              (pad:read-note! "READ miss hello"))
            (let ((cache (list look
                               (pad:read-plain (pad:q-defines))
                               (pad:read-plain (pad:q-defuse "hello"))
                               (pad:read-plain (pad:q-node-types))
                               (pad:read-refs look)))
                  (diff (pad:read-diff L)))
              (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
              (set! *read-cache* cache)
              (pad:read-finish! code0 t0 (car diff) (cadr diff)))))))

(define (pad:read-switched! c L n0 e0 code0 t0)
  (try (workspace :switch c) (catch (e) #f))
  (pad:read-show! (string-append "READ child=" (number->string c)))
  (let ((r1 (pad:ws-set-code! (pad:read-src L))))
    (if (not (string=? r1 "ok"))
        (begin
          (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #f)
          (pad:read-note! "READ set-code-fail"))
        (let ((r2 (pad:ws-eval!)))
          (if (not (or (string=? r2 "ok") (string=? r2 "note")))
              (begin
                (pad:read-back! c n0 e0 #t)
                (pad:read-note! "READ eval-fail"))
              (pad:read-gather! c L n0 e0 code0 t0))))))

(define (pad:read-check! L)
  (let ((code0 (pad:q-code))
        (t0 (current-time-ms))
        (n0 *ws-set-code-n*)
        (e0 *ws-eval-n*))
    (let ((c (try (workspace :create "read") (catch (e) #f))))
      (if (not (pad:read-id? c))
          (pad:read-note! "READ no-world")
          (pad:read-switched! c L n0 e0 code0 t0)))))

(pad:read-show! "READ loaded")
(set! *read-ready* #t)

                (set! *read-cache* cache)
                (set! *read-mean* mean)
                (pad:read-finish! code0 t0 (car diff) (cadr diff))))))))
