;; aura-pad M5 -- Soft LSP-lite: goto-def, find-refs, jump-back.
;; Works on a Soft Aura source string + integer point (byte/char offset).
;; Jump state js = (src point stack) where stack is prior points.
;; Kid REJECT reasons: no-symbol, no-def, no-ref, nothing-to-back.
;; Uses hl.aura tokens so strings/comments are skipped for refs.
;; Hot path: find-defs / find-refs / sym-at walk a token list once
;; (no O(n^2) list-ref via pad:hl-nth + length). Soft reserved: never
;; bind quote. Needs buffer.aura + hl.aura.

(define (pad:js src point stack) (list src point stack))
(define (pad:js-src j) (car j))
(define (pad:js-point j) (cadr j))
(define (pad:js-stack j) (caddr j))

(define (pad:js-at src point) (pad:js src point (list)))

(define (pad:js-set-point j p)
  (pad:js (pad:js-src j) p (pad:js-stack j)))

(define (pad:js-push j p)
  (pad:js (pad:js-src j) p (cons (pad:js-point j) (pad:js-stack j))))

;; Symbol token covering point from toks, or #f. Single walk.
(define (pad:sym-tok-in toks point)
  (let loop ((ts toks))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) #f)
      (#t
       (let* ((t (car ts))
              (k (car t))
              (a (cadr t))
              (b (caddr t)))
         (if (and (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K")
                      (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M"))
                  (>= point a) (< point b))
             t
             (loop (cdr ts))))))))

(define (pad:sym-tok-at src point)
  (pad:sym-tok-in (pad:hl-tokens src) point))

(define (pad:sym-at-in toks point)
  (let ((t (pad:sym-tok-in toks point)))
    (if t (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t)))) "")))

(define (pad:sym-at src point)
  (pad:sym-at-in (pad:hl-tokens src) point))

;; Single-pass defs: track prev / prev2 while walking toks.
;; Patterns: (define NAME ...) or (define (NAME ...) ...)
(define (pad:find-defs-in toks name)
  (let loop ((xs toks) (prev #f) (prev2 #f) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let* ((t (car xs))
               (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t)))))
               (hit
                (and (string=? txt name)
                     (or (and prev
                              (string=? (car prev) "K")
                              (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev))))
                                        "define"))
                         (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                              prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                              (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev2))))
                                        "define"))))))
          (loop (cdr xs) t prev
                (if hit (cons (cadr t) acc) acc))))))

(define (pad:find-defs src name)
  (pad:find-defs-in (pad:hl-tokens src) name))

;; Kept for m5 tests that may probe the old helper shape via is-def.
(define (pad:tok-before tokens idx)
  (if (<= idx 0) #f (pad:hl-nth tokens (- idx 1))))

(define (pad:is-def-name? tokens idx name)
  (let* ((t (pad:hl-nth tokens idx))
         (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t))))))
    (if (not (string=? txt name))
        #f
        (let ((prev (pad:tok-before tokens idx)))
          (cond
            ((not prev) #f)
            ((and (string=? (car prev) "K")
                  (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev)))) "define"))
             #t)
            ((string=? (car prev) "P")
             (let ((prev2 (pad:tok-before tokens (- idx 1))))
               (and prev2
                    (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                    (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev2)))) "define"))))
            (#t #f))))))

;; All non-comment/string token starts matching name exactly.
(define (pad:find-refs-in toks name)
  (let loop ((ts toks) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
      (#t
       (let* ((t (car ts))
              (k (car t))
              (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t))))))
         (if (and (string=? txt name)
                  (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K")
                      (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M")))
             (loop (cdr ts) (cons (cadr t) acc))
             (loop (cdr ts) acc)))))))

(define (pad:find-refs src name)
  (pad:find-refs-in (pad:hl-tokens src) name))

;; Result shape: (reason point stack refs) where reason "ok" or kid tag.
(define (pad:goto-def j)
  (let* ((src (pad:js-src j))
         (pt (pad:js-point j))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens src))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt)))
    (cond
      ((string=? name "")
       (list "no-symbol" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list)))
      (#t
       (let ((defs (pad:find-defs-in toks name)))
         (if (null? defs)
             (list "no-def" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list))
             (let ((dest (car defs)))
               (if (= dest pt)
                   (if (null? (cdr defs))
                       (list "ok" dest (pad:js-stack j) defs)
                       (list "ok" (car (cdr defs))
                             (cons pt (pad:js-stack j)) defs))
                   (list "ok" dest (cons pt (pad:js-stack j)) defs)))))))))

(define (pad:find-refs-cmd j)
  (let* ((src (pad:js-src j))
         (pt (pad:js-point j))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens src))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt)))
    (cond
      ((string=? name "")
       (list "no-symbol" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list)))
      (#t
       (let ((refs (pad:find-refs-in toks name)))
         (if (null? refs)
             (list "no-ref" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list))
             (list "ok" pt (pad:js-stack j) refs)))))))

(define (pad:jump-back j)
  (let ((st (pad:js-stack j)))
    (if (null? st)
        (list "nothing-to-back" (pad:js-point j) st (list))

;; aura-pad M5 -- Soft LSP-lite: goto-def, find-refs, jump-back.
;; Works on a Soft Aura source string + integer point (byte/char offset).
;; Jump state js = (src point stack) where stack is prior points.
;; Kid REJECT reasons: no-symbol, no-def, no-ref, nothing-to-back.
;; Uses hl.aura tokens so strings/comments are skipped for refs.
;; Hot path: find-defs / find-refs / sym-at walk a token list once
;; (no O(n^2) list-ref via pad:hl-nth + length). Soft reserved: never
;; bind quote. Needs buffer.aura + hl.aura.

(define (pad:js-src j) (car j))
(define (pad:js-point j) (cadr j))
(define (pad:js-stack j) (caddr j))

(define (pad:js-at src point) (pad:js src point (list)))

(define (pad:js-set-point j p)
  (pad:js (pad:js-src j) p (pad:js-stack j)))

(define (pad:js-push j p)
  (pad:js (pad:js-src j) p (cons (pad:js-point j) (pad:js-stack j))))

;; Symbol token covering point from toks, or #f. Single walk.
(define (pad:sym-tok-in toks point)
  (let loop ((ts toks))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) #f)
      (#t
       (let* ((t (car ts))
              (k (car t))
              (a (cadr t))
              (b (caddr t)))
         (if (and (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K")
                      (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M"))
                  (>= point a) (< point b))
             t
             (loop (cdr ts))))))))

(define (pad:sym-tok-at src point)
  (pad:sym-tok-in (pad:hl-tokens src) point))

(define (pad:sym-at-in toks point)
  (let ((t (pad:sym-tok-in toks point)))
    (if t (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t)))) "")))

(define (pad:sym-at src point)
  (pad:sym-at-in (pad:hl-tokens src) point))

;; Single-pass defs: track prev / prev2 while walking toks.
;; Patterns: (define NAME ...) or (define (NAME ...) ...)
(define (pad:find-defs-in toks name)
  (let loop ((xs toks) (prev #f) (prev2 #f) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
        (reverse acc)
        (let* ((t (car xs))
               (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t)))))
               (hit
                (and (string=? txt name)
                     (or (and prev
                              (string=? (car prev) "K")
                              (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev))))
                                        "define"))
                         (and prev (string=? (car prev) "P")
                              prev2 (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                              (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev2))))
                                        "define"))))))
          (loop (cdr xs) t prev
                (if hit (cons (cadr t) acc) acc))))))

(define (pad:find-defs src name)
  (pad:find-defs-in (pad:hl-tokens src) name))

(define (pad:tok-before tokens idx)
  (if (<= idx 0) #f (pad:hl-nth tokens (- idx 1))))

(define (pad:is-def-name? tokens idx name)
  (let* ((t (pad:hl-nth tokens idx))
         (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t))))))
    (if (not (string=? txt name))
        #f
        (let ((prev (pad:tok-before tokens idx)))
          (cond
            ((not prev) #f)
            ((and (string=? (car prev) "K")
                  (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev)))) "define"))
             #t)
            ((string=? (car prev) "P")
             (let ((prev2 (pad:tok-before tokens (- idx 1))))
               (and prev2
                    (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                    (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev2)))) "define"))))
            (#t #f))))))

(define (pad:find-refs-in toks name)
  (let loop ((ts toks) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
      (#t
       (let* ((t (car ts))
              (k (car t))
              (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t))))))
         (if (and (string=? txt name)
                  (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K")
                      (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M")))
             (loop (cdr ts) (cons (cadr t) acc))
             (loop (cdr ts) acc)))))))

(define (pad:find-refs src name)
  (pad:find-refs-in (pad:hl-tokens src) name))

(define (pad:goto-def j)
  (let* ((src (pad:js-src j))
         (pt (pad:js-point j))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens src))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt)))

    ((string=? reason "no-ref") "that name is not used anywhere else")
    ((string=? reason "nothing-to-back") "nowhere to jump back to")
    (#t "the gate said no")))

(define (pad:jump-reject! mid reason cmd)
  (display "REJECT mid=")
  (display (number->string mid))
  (display " reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " cmd=")
  (display cmd)
  (display " say=\"")
  (display (pad:kid-say-jump reason))
  (display "\"")
  (newline)
  0)

(define (pad:jump-ok! cmd point nrefs)
  (display "JUMP cmd=")
  (display cmd)
  (display " point=")
  (display (number->string point))
  (display " refs=")
  (display (number->string nrefs))
  (newline)
  0)

;; Offsets list as dotted string "1.4.9"
(define (pad:offs-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "none")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (number->string (car xs)))
    (#t (string-append (number->string (car xs)) "."
                       (pad:offs-str (cdr xs))))))

               (and prev2
                    (string=? (car prev2) "K")
                    (string=? (car (cdr (cdr (cdr prev2)))) "define"))))
            (#t #f))))))

;; All non-comment/string token starts matching name exactly.
(define (pad:find-refs-in toks name)
  (let loop ((ts toks) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((null? ts) (reverse acc))
      (#t
       (let* ((t (car ts))
              (k (car t))
              (txt (car (cdr (cdr (cdr t))))))
         (if (and (string=? txt name)
                  (or (string=? k "S") (string=? k "K")
                      (string=? k "Q") (string=? k "M")))
             (loop (cdr ts) (cons (cadr t) acc))
             (loop (cdr ts) acc)))))))

(define (pad:find-refs src name)
  (pad:find-refs-in (pad:hl-tokens src) name))

;; Result shape: (reason point stack refs) where reason "ok" or kid tag.
;; The -in forms take whole-page toks (M7 line cache hands them over so a
;; jump key does not re-tokenize); the plain forms tokenize src.
(define (pad:goto-def-in j toks)
  (let* ((pt (pad:js-point j))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt)))
    (cond
      ((string=? name "")
       (list "no-symbol" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list)))
      (#t
       (let ((defs (pad:find-defs-in toks name)))
         (if (null? defs)
             (list "no-def" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list))
             (let ((dest (car defs)))
               (if (= dest pt)
                   (if (null? (cdr defs))
                       (list "ok" dest (pad:js-stack j) defs)
                       (list "ok" (car (cdr defs))
                             (cons pt (pad:js-stack j)) defs))
                   (list "ok" dest (cons pt (pad:js-stack j)) defs)))))))))

(define (pad:goto-def j)
  (pad:goto-def-in j (pad:hl-tokens (pad:js-src j))))

(define (pad:find-refs-cmd-in j toks)
  (let* ((pt (pad:js-point j))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt)))
    (cond
      ((string=? name "")
       (list "no-symbol" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list)))
      (#t
       (let ((refs (pad:find-refs-in toks name)))
         (if (null? refs)
             (list "no-ref" pt (pad:js-stack j) (list))
             (list "ok" pt (pad:js-stack j) refs)))))))

(define (pad:find-refs-cmd j)
  (pad:find-refs-cmd-in j (pad:hl-tokens (pad:js-src j))))

(define (pad:jump-back j)
  (let ((st (pad:js-stack j)))
    (if (null? st)
        (list "nothing-to-back" (pad:js-point j) st (list))
        (list "ok" (car st) (cdr st) (list)))))

(define (pad:jump-apply j r)
  (pad:js (pad:js-src j) (cadr r) (caddr r)))

(define (pad:kid-say-jump reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "no-symbol") "put the cursor on a name first")
    ((string=? reason "no-def") "could not find where that name is born")
    ((string=? reason "no-ref") "that name is not used anywhere else")
    ((string=? reason "nothing-to-back") "nowhere to jump back to")
    (#t "the gate said no")))

(define (pad:jump-reject! mid reason cmd)
  (display "REJECT mid=")
  (display (number->string mid))
  (display " reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " cmd=")
  (display cmd)
  (display " say=\"")
  (display (pad:kid-say-jump reason))
  (display "\"")
  (newline)
  0)

(define (pad:jump-ok! cmd point nrefs)
  (display "JUMP cmd=")
  (display cmd)
  (display " point=")
  (display (number->string point))
  (display " refs=")
  (display (number->string nrefs))
  (newline)
  0)

;; Offsets list as dotted string "1.4.9"
(define (pad:offs-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "none")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (number->string (car xs)))
    (#t (string-append (number->string (car xs)) "."
                       (pad:offs-str (cdr xs))))))

;; aura-pad Aura-native perf round tests (docs/perf-aura.md). Loads the
;; pad core and the gap cases (helpers only), makes one top-level call.
;;  AP_EARLY_FRAMES  PAD_DEFER path: the stream minus its early frames is
;;                   byte for byte the stream written without deferral
;;  AP_EARLY_ROWS    every early frame = the frame before it with only row
;;                   l replaced, and that row already equals row l of the
;;                   exact frame after it (so DIRTY lines=l is exact)
;;  AP_EARLY_TAKEN   early frames were written (strings opened / closed)
;; Prints T lines, APSTATS, then PAD_AURA_PERF_TEST_OK.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/buffer.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/lines.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/edit.aura")

;; frame text -> list of row strings ("T ..\nH ..\nM ..\n" each)
(define (ap:rows fr)
  (let* ((i (string-index fr "ROWS n=" 0))
         (j (string-index fr "\n" i))
         (body (substring fr (+ j 1) (- (string-length fr) 4)))
         (ls (pad:v-split body)))
    (ap:group ls (list))))
(define (ap:group ls acc)
  (if (or (null? ls) (null? (cdr ls)) (null? (cddr ls)))
      (reverse acc)
      (ap:group (cdddr ls)
                (cons (string-append (car ls) "\n" (cadr ls) "\n" (caddr ls) "\n") acc))))
(define (ap:early? fr) (string-prefix? fr "EARLY\n"))
(define (ap:strip fr) (substring fr 6 (string-length fr)))
(define (ap:cur-line fr)
  (let* ((i (string-index fr "CURSOR line=" 0))
         (j (string-index fr " " (+ i 12))))
    (string->number (substring fr (+ i 12) j))))
;; rows a, b equal except at index l
(define (ap:same-but a b l i)
  (cond
    ((and (null? a) (null? b)) #t)
    ((or (null? a) (null? b)) #f)
    ((or (= i l) (string=? (car a) (car b))) (ap:same-but (cdr a) (cdr b) l (+ i 1)))
    (#t #f)))
;; walk the deferred stream: (kept-frames bad-early-count)
(define (ap:walk fs prev kept bad)
  (cond
    ((null? fs) (list (reverse kept) bad))
    ((ap:early? (car fs))
     (let* ((e (ap:strip (car fs)))
            (nx (if (pair? (cdr fs)) (cadr fs) #f))
            (l (ap:cur-line e))
            (er (ap:rows e))
            (ok (and prev nx (not (ap:early? nx))
                     (ap:same-but (ap:rows prev) er l 0)
                     (string=? (list-ref er l) (list-ref (ap:rows nx) l)))))
       (ap:walk (cdr fs) e kept (if ok bad (+ bad 1)))))
    (#t (ap:walk (cdr fs) (car fs) (cons (car fs) kept) bad))))

(define (ap:run)
  (display "AURA_PERF early frame on Soft tip") (newline)
  (let* ((ks (gp:keylist2 260 (list)))
         (r0 (gp:start!))
         (r1 (set! *pi-collect* #t))
         (ref (gp:step-keys ks))
         (r2 (gp:start!))
         (r3 (set! *pi-defer* #t))
         (e0 *pi-early*)
         (got (gp:step-keys ks))
         (r4 (set! *pi-defer* #f))
         (r5 (set! *pi-collect* #f))
         (w (ap:walk got r2 (list) 0))
         (d (gp:first-diff ref (car w) 0))
         (ne (- *pi-early* e0)))
    (display "APSTATS keys=") (display (length ks)) (display " frames=") (display (length ref))
    (display " deferred_frames=") (display (length got)) (display " early=") (display ne) (newline)
    (gp:expect "AP_EARLY_FRAMES" (= d -1) (if (= d -1) "" (string-append "frame " (number->string d))))
    (gp:expect "AP_EARLY_ROWS" (= (cadr w) 0) (cadr w))
    (gp:expect "AP_EARLY_TAKEN" (and (> ne 5) (= (length got) (+ (length ref) ne))) ne))
  (display "TESTS checks=") (display gp-checks) (display " fail=") (display gp-fails) (newline)
  (if (= gp-fails 0) (begin (display "PAD_AURA_PERF_TEST_OK") (newline)) 0))
(ap:run)

;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura (and what they load).
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (if (string=? g "ok") (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)) g))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags).
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "REJECT" gate (pad:robot-say gate) (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f))))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
                     (t1 (pad:pen-total))
                     (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                     (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
                (set! *robot-undo*
                      (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                                  (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                            *robot-undo*))
                (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
                (set! *who-gen* g1)
                (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
                (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
                (list "KEEP" "row"
                      (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                                     ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
                      (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr)))
              (begin
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:robot-say "refused")
                      (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change; every
;; other line goes to pad:play-line!. Returns what pad:play-line! returns.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (if (and (string? line) (string=? line "IN 26") (null? *pl-esc*))
      (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!)))
      (pad:play-line! line)))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)

                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura (and what they load).
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)

;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura, eng_who.aura (and what
;; they load). The transaction runs under the writer's engine fingerprint
;; (pad:ew-set!, M11b); the fingerprint goes back to kid right after.
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (if (string=? g "ok") (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)) g))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags).
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "REJECT" gate (pad:robot-say gate) (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
                     (t1 (pad:pen-total))
                     (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                     (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
                (set! *robot-undo*
                      (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                                  (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                            *robot-undo*))
                (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
                (set! *who-gen* g1)
                (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
                (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
                (list "KEEP" "row"
                      (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                                     ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
                      (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr)))
              (begin
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:robot-say "refused")
                      (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

target.name: pad:robot-gate-each
target.body:
(lambda (who ops) (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (cond
          ((not (string=? g "ok")) g)
          ((not (pad:why-brackets-ok? (cadr (car ops)))) "brackets")
          (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)))))))

;; (pad:ew-set!, M11b); the fingerprint goes back to kid right after.
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (if (string=? g "ok") (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)) g))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags).
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "REJECT" gate (pad:robot-say gate) (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
                     (t1 (pad:pen-total))
                     (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                     (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
                (set! *robot-undo*
                      (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                                  (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                            *robot-undo*))
                (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
                (set! *who-gen* g1)
                (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
                (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
                (list "KEEP" "row"
                      (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                                     ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
                      (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr)))
              (begin
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:robot-say "refused")
                      (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura, eng_who.aura, why.aura
;; (and what they load). The transaction runs under the writer's engine
;; fingerprint (pad:ew-set!, M11b); the fingerprint goes back to kid right
;; after.
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched. Before that heal, why.aura (M11c) replays the edits one at a
;;   time to get aura's reason and says it in kid words.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))
(define *robot-diags* (list))   ; typecheck-incremental messages after the last KEEP
(define *robot-tc-raw* "")      ; and its raw text

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (cond
          ((not (string=? g "ok")) g)
          ((not (pad:why-brackets-ok? (cadr (car ops)))) "brackets")
          (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)))))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    ((string=? reason "brackets") "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-try! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))
(define (pad:robot-try! who ops why)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "REJECT" gate (pad:robot-say gate) (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
                     (t1 (pad:pen-total))
                     (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                     (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
                (set! *robot-undo*
                      (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                                  (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                            *robot-undo*))
                (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
                (set! *who-gen* g1)
                (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
                (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
                (set! *robot-tc-raw* (try (typecheck-incremental) (catch (e) "")))
                (set! *robot-diags* (pad:why-diags *robot-tc-raw*))
                (list "KEEP" "row"
                      (if (null? *robot-diags*)
                          (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                                         ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
                          (string-append "aura warns: " (pad:why-kid (car *robot-diags*) who
                                                                     (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops)))))
                      (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr)))
              (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:nth w 3)
                      (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

        (pad:robot-no a))))

;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura, eng_who.aura, why.aura
;; (and what they load). The transaction runs under the writer's engine
;; fingerprint (pad:ew-set!, M11b); the fingerprint goes back to kid right
;; after.
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched. Before that heal, why.aura (M11c) replays the edits one at a
;;   time to get aura's reason and says it in kid words.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))
(define *robot-diags* (list))   ; typecheck-incremental messages after the last KEEP
(define *robot-tc-raw* "")      ; and its raw text

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (cond
          ((not (string=? g "ok")) g)
          ((not (pad:why-brackets-ok? (cadr (car ops)))) "brackets")
          (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)))))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    ((string=? reason "brackets") "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-try! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))
(define (pad:robot-try! who ops why)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "REJECT" gate (pad:robot-say gate) (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
                     (t1 (pad:pen-total))
                     (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                     (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
                (set! *robot-undo*
                      (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                                  (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                            *robot-undo*))
                (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
                (set! *who-gen* g1)
                (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
                (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
                (set! *robot-tc-raw* (try (typecheck-incremental) (catch (e) "")))
                (set! *robot-diags* (pad:why-diags *robot-tc-raw*))
                (list "KEEP" "row"
                      (if (null? *robot-diags*)
                          (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                                         ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
                          (string-append "aura warns: " (pad:why-kid (car *robot-diags*) who
                                                                     (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops)))))
                      (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr)))
              (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:nth w 3)
                      (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((and *robot-pending* (or (string=? line "IN 13") (string=? line "IN 10")))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-keep!) 2)))
    ((and *robot-pending* (string=? line "IN 26"))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-drop!) 2)))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched. Before that heal, why.aura (M11c) replays the edits one at a
;;   time to get aura's reason and says it in kid words.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))
(define *robot-diags* (list))   ; typecheck-incremental messages after the last KEEP
(define *robot-tc-raw* "")      ; and its raw text

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (cond
          ((not (string=? g "ok")) g)
          ((not (pad:why-brackets-ok? (cadr (car ops)))) "brackets")
          (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)))))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    ((string=? reason "brackets") "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-try! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))

;; Gate, snapshot, one typed transaction. Returns
;; (status snap code0 g0 t0 detail):
;;   "gate"     detail = the gate tag (nothing was touched)
;;   "refused"  detail = the why.aura answer (already healed)
;;   "applied"  detail = engine dirty + call counts before (card path) or #f
(define (pad:robot-apply! who ops why want-card)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "gate" #f "" g0 t0 gate))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (d0 (if want-card (pad:blast-before (pad:robot-names ops)) #f))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (list "applied" snap code0 g0 t0 d0)
              (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "refused" #f code0 g0 t0 w)))))))

;; REJECT / DROP verdicts for a gate NO or an engine refusal.
(define (pad:robot-no a)
  (let ((g0 (pad:nth a 3)) (t0 (pad:nth a 4)))
    (if (string=? (car a) "gate")
        (list "REJECT" (pad:nth a 5) (pad:robot-say (pad:nth a 5))
              (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))
        (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:nth (pad:nth a 5) 3)
              (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))))

;; Keep an applied transaction: project rows, push the ctrl-z entry,
;; stamp the rows, check typecheck-incremental (M11c).
(define (pad:robot-commit! who ops why snap code0 g0 t0)
  (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t1 (pad:pen-total))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
    (set! *robot-undo*
          (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                      (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                *robot-undo*))
    (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
    (set! *who-gen* g1)
    (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
    (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
    (set! *robot-tc-raw* (try (typecheck-incremental) (catch (e) "")))
    (set! *robot-diags* (pad:why-diags *robot-tc-raw*))
    (list "KEEP" "row"
          (if (null? *robot-diags*)
              (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                             ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
              (string-append "aura warns: " (pad:why-kid (car *robot-diags*) who
                                                         (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops)))))
          (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr))))

(define (pad:robot-try! who ops why)
  (let ((a (pad:robot-apply! who ops why #f)))
    (if (string=? (car a) "applied")
        (pad:robot-commit! who ops why (pad:nth a 1) (pad:nth a 2) (pad:nth a 3) (pad:nth a 4))
        (pad:robot-no a))))

;; --- M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura) ---
;; The transaction is applied but waits: the page does not change until
;; enter (pad:robot-keep!); ctrl-z (pad:robot-drop!) restores the snapshot.
(define *robot-pending* #f)   ; (who ops why snap code0 g0 t0 card)
(define *robot-said-no* 0)

;; Returns (CARD blast say gen-delta total-delta tags) or REJECT / DROP;
;; shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-card! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-propose! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))
(define (pad:robot-propose! who ops why)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (let ((a (pad:robot-apply! who ops why #t)))
    (if (not (string=? (car a) "applied"))
        (pad:robot-no a)
        (let* ((g0 (pad:nth a 3))
               (t0 (pad:nth a 4))
               (L1 (car (pad:robot-project (pad:es-L *pl-st*) ops (list))))
               (card (pad:blast-card ops L1 (pad:nth a 5))))
          (set! *robot-pending* (list who ops why (pad:nth a 1) (pad:nth a 2) g0 t0 card))
          (list "CARD" "blast" (pad:blast-say card)
                (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))

(define (pad:robot-keep!)
  (if (not *robot-pending*)
      (list "NONE" "no-card" "there is no helper idea waiting" 0 0 (list))
      (let ((p *robot-pending*))
        (set! *robot-pending* #f)
        (pad:robot-commit! (car p) (cadr p) (caddr p) (pad:nth p 3) (pad:nth p 4)
                           (pad:nth p 5) (pad:nth p 6)))))

(define (pad:robot-drop!)
  (if (not *robot-pending*)
      (list "NONE" "no-card" "there is no helper idea waiting" 0 0 (list))
      (let ((p *robot-pending*))
        (set! *robot-pending* #f)
        (pad:robot-heal! (pad:nth p 3))
        (set! *robot-said-no* (+ *robot-said-no* 1))
        (list "DROP" "kid-no" "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed"
              (- (pad:pen-gen) (pad:nth p 5)) (- (pad:pen-total) (pad:nth p 6)) (list)))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; while a blast card waits (M11d), enter keeps it and ctrl-z drops it;
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((and *robot-pending* (or (string=? line "IN 13") (string=? line "IN 10")))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-keep!) 2)))
    ((and *robot-pending* (string=? line "IN 26"))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-drop!) 2)))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))
