input.source:
;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura, eng_who.aura, why.aura,
;; blast.aura (and what they load). The transaction runs under the
;; writer's engine fingerprint (pad:ew-set!, M11b); the fingerprint goes
;; back to kid right after.
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched. Before that heal, why.aura (M11c) replays the edits one at a
;;   time to get aura's reason and says it in kid words.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))
(define *robot-diags* (list))   ; typecheck-incremental messages after the last KEEP
(define *robot-tc-raw* "")      ; and its raw text

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (cond
          ((not (string=? g "ok")) g)
          ((not (pad:why-brackets-ok? (cadr (car ops)))) "brackets")
          (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)))))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    ((string=? reason "brackets") "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-try! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))

;; Gate, snapshot, one typed transaction. Returns
;; (status snap code0 g0 t0 detail):
;;   "gate"     detail = the gate tag (nothing was touched)
;;   "refused"  detail = the why.aura answer (already healed)
;;   "applied"  detail = engine dirty + call counts before (card path) or #f
(define (pad:robot-apply! who ops why want-card)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "gate" #f "" g0 t0 gate))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (d0 (if want-card (pad:blast-before (pad:robot-names ops)) #f))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (list "applied" snap code0 g0 t0 d0)
              (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "refused" #f code0 g0 t0 w)))))))

;; REJECT / DROP verdicts for a gate NO or an engine refusal.
(define (pad:robot-no a)
  (let ((g0 (pad:nth a 3)) (t0 (pad:nth a 4)))
    (if (string=? (car a) "gate")
        (list "REJECT" (pad:nth a 5) (pad:robot-say (pad:nth a 5))
              (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))
        (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:nth (pad:nth a 5) 3)
              (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))))

;; Keep an applied transaction: project rows, push the ctrl-z entry,
;; stamp the rows, check typecheck-incremental (M11c).
(define (pad:robot-commit! who ops why snap code0 g0 t0)
  (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t1 (pad:pen-total))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
    (set! *robot-undo*
          (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                      (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                *robot-undo*))
    (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
    (set! *who-gen* g1)
    (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
    (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
    (set! *robot-tc-raw* (try (typecheck-incremental) (catch (e) "")))
    (set! *robot-diags* (pad:why-diags *robot-tc-raw*))
    (list "KEEP" "row"
          (if (null? *robot-diags*)
              (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                             ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
              (string-append "aura warns: " (pad:why-kid (car *robot-diags*) who
                                                         (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops)))))
          (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr))))

(define (pad:robot-try! who ops why)
  (let ((a (pad:robot-apply! who ops why #f)))
    (if (string=? (car a) "applied")
        (pad:robot-commit! who ops why (pad:nth a 1) (pad:nth a 2) (pad:nth a 3) (pad:nth a 4))
        (pad:robot-no a))))

;; --- M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura) ---
;; The transaction is applied but waits: the page does not change until
;; enter (pad:robot-keep!); ctrl-z (pad:robot-drop!) restores the snapshot.
(define *robot-pending* #f)   ; (who ops why snap code0 g0 t0 card)
(define *robot-said-no* 0)

;; Returns (CARD blast say gen-delta total-delta tags) or REJECT / DROP;
;; shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-card! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-propose! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))
(define (pad:robot-propose! who ops why)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (let ((a (pad:robot-apply! who ops why #t)))
    (if (not (string=? (car a) "applied"))
        (pad:robot-no a)
        (let* ((g0 (pad:nth a 3))
               (t0 (pad:nth a 4))
               (L1 (car (pad:robot-project (pad:es-L *pl-st*) ops (list))))
               (card (pad:blast-card ops L1 (pad:nth a 5))))
          (set! *robot-pending* (list who ops why (pad:nth a 1) (pad:nth a 2) g0 t0 card))
          (list "CARD" "blast" (pad:blast-say card)
                (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))

(define (pad:robot-keep!)
  (if (not *robot-pending*)
      (list "NONE" "no-card" "there is no helper idea waiting" 0 0 (list))
      (let ((p *robot-pending*))
        (set! *robot-pending* #f)
        (pad:robot-commit! (car p) (cadr p) (caddr p) (pad:nth p 3) (pad:nth p 4)
                           (pad:nth p 5) (pad:nth p 6)))))

(define (pad:robot-drop!)
  (if (not *robot-pending*)
      (list "NONE" "no-card" "there is no helper idea waiting" 0 0 (list))
      (let ((p *robot-pending*))
        (set! *robot-pending* #f)
        (pad:robot-heal! (pad:nth p 3))
        (set! *robot-said-no* (+ *robot-said-no* 1))
        (list "DROP" "kid-no" "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed"
              (- (pad:pen-gen) (pad:nth p 5)) (- (pad:pen-total) (pad:nth p 6)) (list)))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; while a blast card waits (M11d), enter keeps it and ctrl-z drops it;
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((and *robot-pending* (or (string=? line "IN 13") (string=? line "IN 10")))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-keep!) 2)))
    ((and *robot-pending* (string=? line "IN 26"))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-drop!) 2)))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11a -- "undo the robot": one AI proposal = ONE typed engine
;; transaction, one key takes it all back.
;; Needs ws.aura, pen.aura, who.aura, who_pen.aura, eng_who.aura, why.aura,
;; blast.aura (and what they load). The transaction runs under the
;; writer's engine fingerprint (pad:ew-set!, M11b); the fingerprint goes
;; back to kid right after.
;;
;; A robot proposal is a list of (name lam) edits plus one reason. It is
;; applied with typed-mutate-atomic: every edit is a mutate:rebind sexpr,
;; the engine runs them under one MutationBoundary (one composite id in
;; query:mutations-since), types and arity are checked after the batch
;; (AURA_MUTATE_TYPE_GATE=hard rejects type errors; arity always), and a
;; refusal rolls back every edit (all or nothing). mutate:atomic-batch is
;; NOT used: it skips the type/arity gate (aura#4362).
;; - ast:snapshot is taken before the transaction; KEEP pushes it with
;;   the page, so ctrl-z (IN 26, pad:robot-line!) runs ast:restore + one
;;   eval-current and puts every row of the change back at once.
;; - A refused transaction still gets ast:restore + eval-current (a
;;   failed batch can leave stale node ids, aura#4361); the page is not
;;   touched. Before that heal, why.aura (M11c) replays the edits one at a
;;   time to get aura's reason and says it in kid words.
;; - The Soft pen gate (pad:pen-gate) checks every edit first; a gate NO
;;   never takes a snapshot and never calls the engine.
;; Lives in the notebook session (M9 stack), not in play.aura: the play
;; loop never loads the workspace stack, so key latency is unchanged.
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *robot-undo* (list))   ; entries: (snap L l col names gen0 code0)
(define *robot-keeps* 0)
(define *robot-refused* 0)
(define *robot-gated* 0)
(define *robot-undos* 0)
(define *robot-max-ops* 4)
(define *robot-last-sexprs* (list))
(define *robot-diags* (list))   ; typecheck-incremental messages after the last KEEP
(define *robot-tc-raw* "")      ; and its raw text

;; "s" -> "\"s\"" with " and \ escaped, built from char codes (a Soft
;; file literal loses a backslash, aura#4348).
(define (pad:robot-q s)
  (let rq ((t s) (i (- (string-length s) 1)) (acc (list 34)))
    (if (< i 0)
        (list->string (cons 34 acc))
        (let ((c (string-ref t i)))
          (rq t (- i 1) (if (or (= c 34) (= c 92)) (cons 92 (cons c acc)) (cons c acc)))))))

;; (name lam) -> "(mutate:rebind \"name\" \"lam\" \"why\")"
(define (pad:robot-sexpr op why)
  (string-append "(mutate:rebind " (pad:robot-q (car op)) " " (pad:robot-q (cadr op))
                 " " (pad:robot-q why) ")"))
(define (pad:robot-sexprs ops why)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (pad:robot-sexpr (car ops) why) (pad:robot-sexprs (cdr ops) why))))

(define (pad:robot-names ops)
  (if (null? ops) (list) (cons (car (car ops)) (pad:robot-names (cdr ops)))))

(define (pad:robot-dup? xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((member (car xs) (cdr xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:robot-dup? (cdr xs)))))

;; Soft gate for the whole proposal: "ok" or the first kid tag.
(define (pad:robot-gate who ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "nothing")
    ((> (length ops) *robot-max-ops*) "too-long")
    ((pad:robot-dup? (pad:robot-names ops)) "twice")
    (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who ops))))
(define (pad:robot-gate-each who ops)
  (if (null? ops)
      "ok"
      (let ((g (pad:pen-gate who (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (cond
          ((not (string=? g "ok")) g)
          ((not (pad:why-brackets-ok? (cadr (car ops)))) "brackets")
          (#t (pad:robot-gate-each who (cdr ops)))))))

(define (pad:robot-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "nothing") "the helper did not change anything")
    ((string=? reason "twice") "the helper tried to change one name twice")
    ((string=? reason "refused") "aura said no to the whole change, nothing moved")
    ((string=? reason "brackets") "the helper's brackets do not match")
    (#t (pad:pen-say reason))))

(define (pad:robot-names-str xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) "")
    ((null? (cdr xs)) (car xs))
    ((null? (cddr xs)) (string-append (car xs) " and " (cadr xs)))
    (#t (string-append (car xs) ", " (pad:robot-names-str (cdr xs))))))

;; Project every KEEP edit into the page; returns (L tags).
(define (pad:robot-project L ops tags)
  (if (null? ops)
      (list L (reverse tags))
      (let ((pr (pad:pen-project L (car (car ops)) (cadr (car ops)))))
        (pad:robot-project (car pr) (cdr ops) (cons (cadr pr) tags)))))

(define (pad:robot-heal! snap)
  (let ((ok (try (ast:restore snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *ws-heals* (+ *ws-heals* 1))
    (pad:ws-eval!)
    ok))

;; One robot step. Returns (verdict reason say gen-delta total-delta tags)
;; and shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-step! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-try! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))

;; Gate, snapshot, one typed transaction. Returns
;; (status snap code0 g0 t0 detail):
;;   "gate"     detail = the gate tag (nothing was touched)
;;   "refused"  detail = the why.aura answer (already healed)
;;   "applied"  detail = engine dirty + call counts before (card path) or #f
(define (pad:robot-apply! who ops why want-card)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (let* ((g0 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t0 (pad:pen-total))
         (gate (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
    (if (not (string=? gate "ok"))
        (begin
          (set! *robot-gated* (+ *robot-gated* 1))
          (list "gate" #f "" g0 t0 gate))
        (let* ((code0 (pad:q-code))
               (d0 (if want-card (pad:blast-before (pad:robot-names ops)) #f))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "robot"))
               (sx (pad:robot-sexprs ops why))
               (fp (pad:ew-set! who))
               (r (try (typed-mutate-atomic sx) (catch (e) #f)))
               (fp-back (pad:ew-set! "kid")))
          (set! *robot-last-sexprs* sx)
          (if (eq? r #t)
              (list "applied" snap code0 g0 t0 d0)
              (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
                (pad:robot-heal! snap)
                (set! *robot-refused* (+ *robot-refused* 1))
                (list "refused" #f code0 g0 t0 w)))))))

;; REJECT / DROP verdicts for a gate NO or an engine refusal.
(define (pad:robot-no a)
  (let ((g0 (pad:nth a 3)) (t0 (pad:nth a 4)))
    (if (string=? (car a) "gate")
        (list "REJECT" (pad:nth a 5) (pad:robot-say (pad:nth a 5))
              (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))
        (list "DROP" "refused" (pad:nth (pad:nth a 5) 3)
              (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list)))))

;; Keep an applied transaction: project rows, push the ctrl-z entry,
;; stamp the rows, check typecheck-incremental (M11c).
(define (pad:robot-commit! who ops why snap code0 g0 t0)
  (let* ((g1 (pad:pen-gen))
         (t1 (pad:pen-total))
         (L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (pr (pad:robot-project L0 ops (list))))
    (set! *robot-undo*
          (cons (list snap L0 (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                      (pad:robot-names ops) g0 code0)
                *robot-undo*))
    (pad:pen-set-page! (car pr))
    (set! *who-gen* g1)
    (pad:who-sync! who why g1)
    (set! *robot-keeps* (+ *robot-keeps* 1))
    (set! *robot-tc-raw* (try (typecheck-incremental) (catch (e) "")))
    (set! *robot-diags* (pad:why-diags *robot-tc-raw*))
    (list "KEEP" "row"
          (if (null? *robot-diags*)
              (string-append "the " who " changed " (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops))
                             ", ctrl-z takes it all back")
              (string-append "aura warns: " (pad:why-kid (car *robot-diags*) who
                                                         (pad:robot-names-str (pad:robot-names ops)))))
          (- g1 g0) (- t1 t0) (cadr pr))))

(define (pad:robot-try! who ops why)
  (let ((a (pad:robot-apply! who ops why #f)))
    (if (string=? (car a) "applied")
        (pad:robot-commit! who ops why (pad:nth a 1) (pad:nth a 2) (pad:nth a 3) (pad:nth a 4))
        (pad:robot-no a))))

;; --- M11d: blast radius card before KEEP (blast.aura) ---
;; The transaction is applied but waits: the page does not change until
;; enter (pad:robot-keep!); ctrl-z (pad:robot-drop!) restores the snapshot.
(define *robot-pending* #f)   ; (who ops why snap code0 g0 t0 card)
(define *robot-said-no* 0)

;; Returns (CARD blast say gen-delta total-delta tags) or REJECT / DROP;
;; shows say in the say line.
(define (pad:robot-card! who ops why)
  (let ((r (pad:robot-propose! who ops why)))
    (set! *pl-say* (pad:nth r 2))
    r))
(define (pad:robot-propose! who ops why)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (let ((a (pad:robot-apply! who ops why #t)))
    (if (not (string=? (car a) "applied"))
        (pad:robot-no a)
        (let* ((g0 (pad:nth a 3))
               (t0 (pad:nth a 4))
               (L1 (car (pad:robot-project (pad:es-L *pl-st*) ops (list))))
               (card (pad:blast-card ops L1 (pad:nth a 5))))
          (set! *robot-pending* (list who ops why (pad:nth a 1) (pad:nth a 2) g0 t0 card))
          (list "CARD" "blast" (pad:blast-say card)
                (- (pad:pen-gen) g0) (- (pad:pen-total) t0) (list))))))

(define (pad:robot-keep!)
  (if (not *robot-pending*)
      (list "NONE" "no-card" "there is no helper idea waiting" 0 0 (list))
      (let ((p *robot-pending*))
        (set! *robot-pending* #f)
        (pad:robot-commit! (car p) (cadr p) (caddr p) (pad:nth p 3) (pad:nth p 4)
                           (pad:nth p 5) (pad:nth p 6)))))

(define (pad:robot-drop!)
  (if (not *robot-pending*)
      (list "NONE" "no-card" "there is no helper idea waiting" 0 0 (list))
      (let ((p *robot-pending*))
        (set! *robot-pending* #f)
        (pad:robot-heal! (pad:nth p 3))
        (set! *robot-said-no* (+ *robot-said-no* 1))
        (list "DROP" "kid-no" "ok, the helper's idea is gone, nothing changed"
              (- (pad:pen-gen) (pad:nth p 5)) (- (pad:pen-total) (pad:nth p 6)) (list)))))

;; ctrl-z: undo the last robot KEEP as one unit. Returns
;; "nothing-to-undo", "agree" (engine code and page both back) or
;; "disagree" (fails loud with an M11_UNDO_DISAGREE line).
(define (pad:robot-undo!)
  (if (null? *robot-undo*)
      "nothing-to-undo"
      (let* ((u (car *robot-undo*))
             (L0 (pad:nth u 1))
             (code0 (pad:nth u 6)))
        (set! *robot-undo* (cdr *robot-undo*))
        (pad:robot-heal! (car u))
        (set! *pl-st* (pad:es L0 (pad:nth u 2) (pad:nth u 3)
                              (pad:es-kill *pl-st*) (pad:es-mark *pl-st*)
                              (pad:es-undo *pl-st*)))
        (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (set! *robot-undos* (+ *robot-undos* 1))
        (let ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) code0))
              (page-ok (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0)))
          (if (and code-ok page-ok)
              "agree"
              (begin
                (newline)
                (display "M11_UNDO_DISAGREE code=") (display (pad:who-bool code-ok))
                (display " page=") (display (pad:who-bool page-ok))
                (newline)
                "disagree"))))))

(define (pad:robot-undo-say r)
  (cond
    ((string=? r "agree") "the helper's whole change is gone")
    ((string=? r "nothing-to-undo") "the helper has not changed anything to undo")
    (#t "undo got mixed up, the page and aura disagree")))

;; Notebook key face: IN 26 (ctrl-z) undoes the last robot change, IN 15
;; (ctrl-o) answers "who wrote this" from the engine (eng_who.aura, M11b);
;; while a blast card waits (M11d), enter keeps it and ctrl-z drops it;
;; every other line goes to pad:play-line!.
(define (pad:robot-line! line)
  (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((and *robot-pending* (or (string=? line "IN 13") (string=? line "IN 10")))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-keep!) 2)))
    ((and *robot-pending* (string=? line "IN 26"))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-drop!) 2)))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (pad:ew-key!))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

(define (pad:robot-line-out! r who)
  (newline)
  (display (car r))
  (display " robot who=") (display who)
  (display " reason=") (display (cadr r))
  (display " gen+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 3)))
  (display " total+=") (display (number->string (pad:nth r 4)))
  (display " say=\"") (display (pad:nth r 2)) (display "\"")
  (newline)
  r)

(define (pad:robot-stats-str)
  (string-append "keeps=" (number->string *robot-keeps*)
                 " refused=" (number->string *robot-refused*)
                 " gated=" (number->string *robot-gated*)
                 " undos=" (number->string *robot-undos*)
                 " heals=" (number->string *ws-heals*)))

(lambda (line) (cond
    ((not (and (string? line) (null? *pl-esc*))) (pad:play-line! line))
    ((and *robot-pending* (or (string=? line "IN 13") (string=? line "IN 10")))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-keep!) 2)))
    ((and *robot-pending* (string=? line "IN 26"))
     (pad:play-ok! (pad:nth (pad:robot-drop!) 2)))
    ((string=? line "IN 26") (pad:play-ok! (pad:robot-undo-say (pad:robot-undo!))))
    ((string=? line "IN 15") (if *time-reopened* (pad:time-who-key!) (pad:ew-key!)))
    ((string=? line "IN 20") (pad:time-key! #t))
    ((string=? line "IN 14") (pad:time-key! #f))
    (#t (pad:play-line! line))))

;; aura-pad M11e -- time machine + open-is-restore.
;; Every robot KEEP (robot.aura pad:robot-commit!) adds one step to a
;; history strip: an ast:snapshot taken right after the KEEP, the page
;; object, its who stamps, and who / why / which names. ctrl-t (IN 20)
;; steps back, ctrl-n (IN 14) steps forward: ast:restore + one
;; eval-current (aura#4349), the step's own page and stamps come back.
;; Before each move ast:diff (target snapshot vs now) says which defines
;; differ; Soft knows which names the skipped steps changed. The two must
;; match, and the engine code after the move must equal the code the step
;; was taken with, or the move prints M11_TIME_DISAGREE.
;;
;; Save = serialize-workspace (code + mutation log) plus a small Soft
;; sidecar (page rows as char codes, who stamps, the strip's who / why).
;; Open = deserialize-workspace + the sidecar: no set-code, the log comes
;; back with its change reasons (sum=). aura#4365 / aura#4367: reopened
;; records say author=0 and point at old node ids, so ctrl-o after an open
;; recovers who from the pad stamp whose why equals a record's reason
;; (pad:time-eng-of). aura#4366: the notebook source ends in #t so the
;; reopened program's value is not a pair (ws.aura).
;;
;; Loaded after robot.aura (robot calls pad:time-note! / pad:time-undone!
;; at run time). Every loop is a top-level function with its data as
;; parameters (no named let captures an outer local, docs/m10.md).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *time-on* #f)
(define *time-steps* (list))   ; oldest first: (snap L S who why names code gen)
(define *time-at* 0)
(define *time-story* (list))   ; saved steps before an open: ((who why names) ...)
(define *time-reopened* #f)
(define *time-open-recs* (list)) ; the reopened log, captured at the open
(define *time-moves* 0)
(define *time-disagree* 0)
(define *time-last* #f)        ; (from to eng-names soft-names code-ok verdict)

(define (pad:time-step snap L S who why names)
  (list snap L S who why names (pad:q-code) (pad:pen-gen)))

;; Start the strip at the page as it is now (after a check or an open).
(define (pad:time-start! label)
  (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *time-steps* (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* label "" (list))))
    (set! *time-at* 0)
    (set! *time-on* (number? snap))   ; the first id is 0, and 0 is false in Soft
    (set! *time-reopened* #f)
    (set! *time-open-recs* (list))
    (set! *time-story* (list))
    *time-on*))

(define (pad:time-take xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:time-take (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))

;; After a robot KEEP: a step in the future is cut (a new branch).
(define (pad:time-note! who why names)
  (if (not *time-on*)
      #f
      (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
        (set! *time-steps*
              (append (pad:time-take *time-steps* (+ *time-at* 1))
                      (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* who why names))))
        (set! *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1))
        #t)))

;; After ctrl-z took the newest KEEP back: that step is gone too.
(define (pad:time-undone!)
  (if (and *time-on* (> *time-at* 0) (= *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1)))
      (begin
        (set! *time-steps* (pad:time-take *time-steps* *time-at*))
        (set! *time-at* (- *time-at* 1))
        #t)
      #f))

;; --- ast:diff in define names ---
;; Top-level defines of a canonical program "(begin (define n ...) ...)":
;; ((name . text) ...) in program order.
(define (pad:time-defs-in code toks depth name start acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks)) (k (car t)) (txt (pad:hl-nth t 3)) (p (cadr t)))
        (cond
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt "("))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (+ depth 1) (if (= depth 1) #f name)
                             (if (= depth 1) p start) acc))
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt ")"))
           (if (and (= depth 2) name)
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) 1 #f 0
                                 (cons (cons name (substring code start (+ p 1))) acc))
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (- depth 1) name start acc)))
          ((and (= depth 2) (not name) (string=? txt "define") (pair? (cdr toks)))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cddr toks) depth (pad:hl-nth (cadr toks) 3) start acc))
          (#t (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) depth name start acc))))))
(define (pad:time-defs code)
  (pad:time-defs-in code (pad:hl-tokens code) 0 #f 0 (list)))

(define (pad:time-text-of name ds)
  (cond
    ((null? ds) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car ds)) name) (cdr (car ds)))
    (#t (pad:time-text-of name (cdr ds)))))

;; Names whose define text differs between a and b (or is in one only).
(define (pad:time-changed-in xs other acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((let ((o (pad:time-text-of (car (car xs)) other)))
       (and o (string=? o (cdr (car xs)))))
     (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    ((member (car (car xs)) acc) (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    (#t (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other (append acc (list (car (car xs))))))))

;; ast:diff snap -> names that differ between that snapshot and now.
;; (:same . code) has one part; (:removed . old) (:added . new) has two.
(define (pad:time-diff-names snap)
  (let ((d (try (ast:diff snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (cond
      ((not (pair? d)) #f)
      ((null? (cdr d)) (list))
      (#t (let ((a (pad:time-defs (cdr (car d))))
                (b (pad:time-defs (cdr (cadr d)))))
            (pad:time-changed-in b a (pad:time-changed-in a b (list))))))))

;; Names the steps lo+1 .. hi changed (Soft side), unique.
(define (pad:time-names-add xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((member (car xs) acc) (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) (append acc (list (car xs)))))))
(define (pad:time-soft-names steps i lo hi acc)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) acc)
    ((and (> i lo) (<= i hi))
     (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi (pad:time-names-add (pad:nth (car steps) 5) acc)))
    (#t (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi acc))))

(define (pad:time-same-set? a b)
  (and (= (length a) (length b)) (pad:time-all-in? a b)))
(define (pad:time-all-in? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:time-all-in? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; --- moving ---
(define (pad:time-step-word i)
  (string-append "step " (number->string (+ i 1)) " of " (number->string (length *time-steps*))))

(define (pad:time-move-say from to names)
  (let* ((st (list-ref *time-steps* (if (< to from) from to)))
         (what (pad:why-owner (pad:nth st 3) (pad:nth st 4)))
         (ns (if (null? names) "nothing" (pad:robot-names-str names))))
    (cond
      ((and (< to from) (= (- from to) 1))
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before " what))
      ((< to from)
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before the last "
                      (number->string (- from to)) " changes"))
      ((= (- to from) 1)
       (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " what " is back (" ns ")"))
      (#t (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " come back")))))

;; Go to step i. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-go! i)
  (cond
    ((not *time-on*) (list "NONE" "the time machine is off" "none"))
    ((< i 0)
     (list "NONE" (if *time-reopened*
                      "this is where the book was opened, older steps are only in the story"
                      "this is the start, there is nothing older")
           "none"))
    ((>= i (length *time-steps*)) (list "NONE" "this is the newest step" "none"))
    ((= i *time-at*) (list "NONE" "you are already here" "none"))
    (#t
     (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
     (let* ((from *time-at*)
            (st (list-ref *time-steps* i))
            (eng (pad:time-diff-names (car st)))
            (soft (pad:time-soft-names *time-steps* 0 (min from i) (max from i) (list))))
       (pad:robot-heal! (car st))
       (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-L* (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-S* (pad:nth st 2))
       (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
       (set! *robot-undo* (list))
       (set! *time-at* i)
       (set! *time-moves* (+ *time-moves* 1))
       (let* ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth st 6)))
              (names-ok (and (list? eng) (pad:time-same-set? eng soft)))
              (v (if (and code-ok names-ok) "agree" "disagree")))
         (set! *time-last* (list from i (if (list? eng) eng (list)) soft code-ok v))
         (if (string=? v "disagree")
             (begin
               (set! *time-disagree* (+ *time-disagree* 1))
               (newline) (display "M11_TIME_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline))
             #f)
         (list "TIME" (pad:time-move-say from i (if (list? eng) eng soft)) v))))))

(define (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-go! (- *time-at* 1)))
(define (pad:time-forward!) (pad:time-go! (+ *time-at* 1)))

;; TIME from=2 to=1 eng=hello.bye soft=hello.bye code=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:time-line x)
  (string-append "TIME from=" (number->string (+ (car x) 1)) " to=" (number->string (+ (cadr x) 1))
                 " eng=" (pad:ws-names-str (caddr x)) " soft=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth x 3))
                 " code=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4)) " verdict=" (pad:nth x 5)))

(define (pad:time-key! back)
  (let ((r (if back (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-forward!))))
    (if (string=? (car r) "TIME") (begin (newline) (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline)) #f)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

;; --- the strip ---
(define (pad:time-label who why)
  (if (string=? why "") who (string-append who ": " why)))
(define (pad:time-story-strs xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
      (cons (pad:time-label (car (car xs)) (cadr (car xs))) (pad:time-story-strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-step-strs steps i)
  (if (null? steps) (list)
      (let ((s (pad:time-label (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))))
        (cons (if (= i *time-at*) (string-append "[" s "]") s)
              (pad:time-step-strs (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))))
;; "start | helper: closer | [macro: flip]"; saved steps first after an open.
(define (pad:time-strip)
  (string-join (append (pad:time-story-strs *time-story*) (pad:time-step-strs *time-steps* 0)) " | "))

;; --- save / open ---
(define (pad:time-row-line row)
  (if (null? row) "ROW" (string-append "ROW " (pad:ws-nums row))))
(define (pad:time-rows-text L)
  (if (null? L) "" (string-append (pad:time-row-line (car L)) "\n" (pad:time-rows-text (cdr L)))))
(define (pad:time-stamps-text S i)
  (cond
    ((null? S) "")
    ((car S)
     (string-append "STAMP " (number->string i) " " (car (car S)) " "
                    (number->string (caddr (car S))) " " (cadr (car S)) "\n"
                    (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1)))))
(define (pad:time-story-line who names why)
  (string-append "STEP " who " " (if (null? names) "-" (string-join names ".")) " " why "\n"))
(define (pad:time-story-text xs)
  (if (null? xs) ""
      (string-append (pad:time-story-line (car (car xs)) (caddr (car xs)) (cadr (car xs)))
                     (pad:time-story-text (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-steps-text steps i)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) "")
    ((and (> i 0) (<= i *time-at*))
     (string-append (pad:time-story-line (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 5) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))
                    (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1)))))

;; Save to base.aw (engine) + base.pad (Soft). Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-save! base)
  (if *robot-pending*
      (list "NOSAVE" "keep or drop the helper's idea first")
      (begin
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (let* ((side (string-append "PADBOOK 1\n"
                                    (pad:time-rows-text (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                                    (pad:time-stamps-text *who-S* 0)
                                    (pad:time-story-text *time-story*)
                                    (pad:time-steps-text *time-steps* 0)))
               (aw (try (serialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f)))
               (pd (try (write-file (string-append base ".pad") side) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (and (eq? aw #t) pd (not (pad:eng-err? pd)))
              (list "SAVE" "the book is saved, with its story")
              (list "NOSAVE" "the book could not be saved"))))))

(define (pad:time-nums xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list) (cons (string->number (car xs)) (pad:time-nums (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-rest xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) xs (pad:time-rest (cdr xs) (- n 1))))
(define (pad:time-read-rows lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "ROW")
     (cons (pad:time-nums (cdr (string-split (car lines) " "))) (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines)))))
(define (pad:time-put xs i v)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((= i 0) (cons v (cdr xs)))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:time-put (cdr xs) (- i 1) v)))))
(define (pad:time-read-stamps lines S)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) S)
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STAMP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines)
                             (pad:time-put S (string->number (cadr f))
                                           (list (caddr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 4) " ")
                                                 (string->number (pad:nth f 3)))))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines) S))))
(define (pad:time-read-story lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STEP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (cons (list (cadr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 3) " ")
                   (if (string=? (caddr f) "-") (list) (string-split (caddr f) ".")))
             (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))

;; Open base.aw + base.pad: the engine comes back with its log (no
;; set-code), the page and stamps from the sidecar. Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-open! base)
  (let* ((side (try (read-file (string-append base ".pad")) (catch (e) #f)))
         (lines (if (string? side) (string-split side "\n") (list))))
    (if (not (and (pair? lines) (string=? (car lines) "PADBOOK 1")))
        (list "NOOPEN" "that book has no pad story")
        (let ((d (try (deserialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (eq? d #t))
              (list "NOOPEN" "aura could not open that book")
              (let ((L (pad:time-read-rows lines)))
                (set! *robot-pending* #f)
                (set! *robot-undo* (list))
                (pad:play-reset! (pad:v-src L))
                (set! *who-L* (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                (set! *who-S* (pad:time-read-stamps lines (pad:who-falses (length *who-L*))))
                (set! *who-hist* (list))
                (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
                (pad:time-start! "opened")
                (set! *time-story* (pad:time-read-story lines))
                (set! *time-reopened* #t)
                (set! *time-open-recs* (pad:ew-records))
                (set! *pl-say* (string-append "the book is open: " (number->string (length *time-story*))
                                              " saved steps, aura has the whole story"))
                (list "OPEN" *pl-say*)))))))

;; --- who after an open (aura#4365, aura#4367) ---
;; The reopened log keeps every change reason (sum=) but says author=0
;; (aura#4365), and the reload renumbers the tree while log targets and
;; node provenance keep the old ids (aura#4367), so nothing joins the log
;; to a define by node id. A define last written before the open takes
;; who from the pad stamp of its row, and aura confirms it: the log must
;; hold a rebind whose reason is the stamp's why. A write after the open
;; has a real author (fingerprint != 0; reopened records say 0): plain
;; M11b. Its mutation id may repeat a reopened one (the id counter is not
;; restored), so ids never decide old vs new.
(define (pad:time-sum-last recs why best)
  (cond
    ((null? recs) best)
    ((and (string=? (caddr (car recs)) "rebind") (string=? (pad:nth (car recs) 3) why))
     (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why (car (car recs))))
    (#t (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why best))))

(define (pad:time-eng-of name st)
  (let ((e (pad:ew-prov name)))
    (cond
      ((and e (> (pad:nth e 3) 0) (not (= (pad:nth e 5) 0))) e)
      ((not st) (list name "nobody" "" 0 0 0))
      ((string=? (car st) "kid") (list name "kid" "" 0 0 0))
      (#t (let ((id (pad:time-sum-last *time-open-recs* (cadr st) 0)))
            (if (> id 0)
                (list name (car st) (cadr st) id 0 0)
                (list name "someone" "" 0 0 0)))))))

(define (pad:time-who-at l)
  (let* ((wl (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src wl)))
         (name (pad:ew-row-name wl toks (pad:ws-soft-defs toks) l))
         (st (pad:who-stamp-of l))
         (e (if name (pad:time-eng-of name st) #f)))
    (list st e (pad:ew-verdict st e))))

;; ctrl-o after an open. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-who-ask!)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *ew-asks* (+ *ew-asks* 1))
  (let* ((l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (x (pad:time-who-at l))
         (v (caddr x))
         (old (and (cadr x) (> (pad:nth (cadr x) 3) 0) (= (pad:nth (cadr x) 5) 0)))
         (tag (string-append (pad:ew-tag l x) (if old " reopened=yes author=0" ""))))
    (if (string=? v "disagree")
        (begin
          (set! *ew-disagree* (+ *ew-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_WHO_DISAGREE ") (display tag) (newline))
        #f)
    (list tag
          (string-append (pad:ew-say v (car x) (cadr x))
                         (if (and old (string=? v "agree")) ", from the saved book" ""))
          v)))

(define (pad:time-who-key!)
  (let ((r (pad:time-who-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (newline)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

(define (pad:time-stats-str)
  (string-append "steps=" (number->string (length *time-steps*))
                 " at=" (number->string (+ *time-at* 1))
                 " moves=" (number->string *time-moves*)
                 " story=" (number->string (length *time-story*))
                 " disagree=" (number->string *time-disagree*)))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11e -- time machine + open-is-restore.
;; Every robot KEEP (robot.aura pad:robot-commit!) adds one step to a
;; history strip: an ast:snapshot taken right after the KEEP, the page
;; object, its who stamps, and who / why / which names. ctrl-t (IN 20)
;; steps back, ctrl-n (IN 14) steps forward: ast:restore + one
;; eval-current (aura#4349), the step's own page and stamps come back.
;; Before each move ast:diff (target snapshot vs now) says which defines
;; differ; Soft knows which names the skipped steps changed. The two must
;; match, and the engine code after the move must equal the code the step
;; was taken with, or the move prints M11_TIME_DISAGREE.
;;
;; Save = serialize-workspace (code + mutation log) plus a small Soft
;; sidecar (page rows as char codes, who stamps, the strip's who / why).
;; Open = deserialize-workspace + the sidecar: no set-code, the log comes
;; back with its change reasons (sum=). aura#4365 / aura#4367: reopened
;; records say author=0 and point at old node ids, so ctrl-o after an open
;; recovers who from the pad stamp whose why equals a record's reason
;; (pad:time-eng-of). aura#4366: the notebook source ends in #t so the
;; reopened program's value is not a pair (ws.aura).
;;
;; Loaded after robot.aura (robot calls pad:time-note! / pad:time-undone!
;; at run time). Every loop is a top-level function with its data as
;; parameters (no named let captures an outer local, docs/m10.md).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *time-on* #f)
(define *time-steps* (list))   ; oldest first: (snap L S who why names code gen)
(define *time-at* 0)
(define *time-story* (list))   ; saved steps before an open: ((who why names) ...)
(define *time-reopened* #f)
(define *time-open-recs* (list)) ; the reopened log, captured at the open
(define *time-moves* 0)
(define *time-disagree* 0)
(define *time-last* #f)        ; (from to eng-names soft-names code-ok verdict)

(define (pad:time-step snap L S who why names)
  (list snap L S who why names (pad:q-code) (pad:pen-gen)))

;; Start the strip at the page as it is now (after a check or an open).
(define (pad:time-start! label)
  (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *time-steps* (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* label "" (list))))
    (set! *time-at* 0)
    (set! *time-on* (number? snap))   ; the first id is 0, and 0 is false in Soft
    (set! *time-reopened* #f)
    (set! *time-open-recs* (list))
    (set! *time-story* (list))
    *time-on*))

(define (pad:time-take xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:time-take (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))

;; After a robot KEEP: a step in the future is cut (a new branch).
(define (pad:time-note! who why names)
  (if (not *time-on*)
      #f
      (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
        (set! *time-steps*
              (append (pad:time-take *time-steps* (+ *time-at* 1))
                      (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* who why names))))
        (set! *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1))
        #t)))

;; After ctrl-z took the newest KEEP back: that step is gone too.
(define (pad:time-undone!)
  (if (and *time-on* (> *time-at* 0) (= *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1)))
      (begin
        (set! *time-steps* (pad:time-take *time-steps* *time-at*))
        (set! *time-at* (- *time-at* 1))
        #t)
      #f))

;; --- ast:diff in define names ---
;; Top-level defines of a canonical program "(begin (define n ...) ...)":
;; ((name . text) ...) in program order.
(define (pad:time-defs-in code toks depth name start acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks)) (k (car t)) (txt (pad:hl-nth t 3)) (p (cadr t)))
        (cond
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt "("))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (+ depth 1) (if (= depth 1) #f name)
                             (if (= depth 1) p start) acc))
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt ")"))
           (if (and (= depth 2) name)
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) 1 #f 0
                                 (cons (cons name (substring code start (+ p 1))) acc))
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (- depth 1) name start acc)))
          ((and (= depth 2) (not name) (string=? txt "define") (pair? (cdr toks)))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cddr toks) depth (pad:hl-nth (cadr toks) 3) start acc))
          (#t (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) depth name start acc))))))
(define (pad:time-defs code)
  (pad:time-defs-in code (pad:hl-tokens code) 0 #f 0 (list)))

(define (pad:time-text-of name ds)
  (cond
    ((null? ds) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car ds)) name) (cdr (car ds)))
    (#t (pad:time-text-of name (cdr ds)))))

;; Names whose define text differs between a and b (or is in one only).
(define (pad:time-changed-in xs other acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((let ((o (pad:time-text-of (car (car xs)) other)))
       (and o (string=? o (cdr (car xs)))))
     (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    ((member (car (car xs)) acc) (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    (#t (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other (append acc (list (car (car xs))))))))

;; ast:diff snap -> names that differ between that snapshot and now.
;; (:same . code) has one part; (:removed . old) (:added . new) has two.
(define (pad:time-diff-names snap)
  (let ((d (try (ast:diff snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (cond
      ((not (pair? d)) #f)
      ((null? (cdr d)) (list))
      (#t (let ((a (pad:time-defs (cdr (car d))))
                (b (pad:time-defs (cdr (cadr d)))))
            (pad:time-changed-in b a (pad:time-changed-in a b (list))))))))

;; Names the steps lo+1 .. hi changed (Soft side), unique.
(define (pad:time-names-add xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((member (car xs) acc) (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) (append acc (list (car xs)))))))
(define (pad:time-soft-names steps i lo hi acc)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) acc)
    ((and (> i lo) (<= i hi))
     (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi (pad:time-names-add (pad:nth (car steps) 5) acc)))
    (#t (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi acc))))

(define (pad:time-same-set? a b)
  (and (= (length a) (length b)) (pad:time-all-in? a b)))
(define (pad:time-all-in? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:time-all-in? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; --- moving ---
(define (pad:time-step-word i)
  (string-append "step " (number->string (+ i 1)) " of " (number->string (length *time-steps*))))

(define (pad:time-move-say from to names)
  (let* ((st (list-ref *time-steps* (if (< to from) from to)))
         (what (pad:why-owner (pad:nth st 3) (pad:nth st 4)))
         (ns (if (null? names) "nothing" (pad:robot-names-str names))))
    (cond
      ((and (< to from) (= (- from to) 1))
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before " what))
      ((< to from)
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before the last "
                      (number->string (- from to)) " changes"))
      ((= (- to from) 1)
       (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " what " is back (" ns ")"))
      (#t (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " come back")))))

;; Go to step i. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-go! i)
  (cond
    ((not *time-on*) (list "NONE" "the time machine is off" "none"))
    ((< i 0)
     (list "NONE" (if *time-reopened*
                      "this is where the book was opened, older steps are only in the story"
                      "this is the start, there is nothing older")
           "none"))
    ((>= i (length *time-steps*)) (list "NONE" "this is the newest step" "none"))
    ((= i *time-at*) (list "NONE" "you are already here" "none"))
    (#t
     (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
     (let* ((from *time-at*)
            (st (list-ref *time-steps* i))
            (eng (pad:time-diff-names (car st)))
            (soft (pad:time-soft-names *time-steps* 0 (min from i) (max from i) (list))))
       (pad:robot-heal! (car st))
       (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-L* (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-S* (pad:nth st 2))
       (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
       (set! *robot-undo* (list))
       (set! *time-at* i)
       (set! *time-moves* (+ *time-moves* 1))
       (let* ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth st 6)))
              (names-ok (and (list? eng) (pad:time-same-set? eng soft)))
              (v (if (and code-ok names-ok) "agree" "disagree")))
         (set! *time-last* (list from i (if (list? eng) eng (list)) soft code-ok v))
         (if (string=? v "disagree")
             (begin
               (set! *time-disagree* (+ *time-disagree* 1))
               (newline) (display "M11_TIME_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline))
             #f)
         (list "TIME" (pad:time-move-say from i (if (list? eng) eng soft)) v))))))

(define (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-go! (- *time-at* 1)))
(define (pad:time-forward!) (pad:time-go! (+ *time-at* 1)))

;; TIME from=2 to=1 eng=hello.bye soft=hello.bye code=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:time-line x)
  (string-append "TIME from=" (number->string (+ (car x) 1)) " to=" (number->string (+ (cadr x) 1))
                 " eng=" (pad:ws-names-str (caddr x)) " soft=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth x 3))
                 " code=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4)) " verdict=" (pad:nth x 5)))

(define (pad:time-key! back)
  (let ((r (if back (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-forward!))))
    (if (string=? (car r) "TIME") (begin (newline) (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline)) #f)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

;; --- the strip ---
(define (pad:time-label who why)
  (if (string=? why "") who (string-append who ": " why)))
(define (pad:time-story-strs xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
      (cons (pad:time-label (car (car xs)) (cadr (car xs))) (pad:time-story-strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-step-strs steps i)
  (if (null? steps) (list)
      (let ((s (pad:time-label (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))))
        (cons (if (= i *time-at*) (string-append "[" s "]") s)
              (pad:time-step-strs (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))))
;; "start | helper: closer | [macro: flip]"; saved steps first after an open.
(define (pad:time-strip)
  (string-join (append (pad:time-story-strs *time-story*) (pad:time-step-strs *time-steps* 0)) " | "))

;; --- save / open ---
(define (pad:time-row-line row)
  (if (null? row) "ROW" (string-append "ROW " (pad:ws-nums row))))
(define (pad:time-rows-text L)
  (if (null? L) "" (string-append (pad:time-row-line (car L)) "\n" (pad:time-rows-text (cdr L)))))
(define (pad:time-stamps-text S i)
  (cond
    ((null? S) "")
    ((car S)
     (string-append "STAMP " (number->string i) " " (car (car S)) " "
                    (number->string (caddr (car S))) " " (cadr (car S)) "\n"
                    (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1)))))
(define (pad:time-story-line who names why)
  (string-append "STEP " who " " (if (null? names) "-" (string-join names ".")) " " why "\n"))
(define (pad:time-story-text xs)
  (if (null? xs) ""
      (string-append (pad:time-story-line (car (car xs)) (caddr (car xs)) (cadr (car xs)))
                     (pad:time-story-text (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-steps-text steps i)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) "")
    ((and (> i 0) (<= i *time-at*))
     (string-append (pad:time-story-line (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 5) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))
                    (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1)))))

;; Save to base.aw (engine) + base.pad (Soft). Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-save! base)
  (if *robot-pending*
      (list "NOSAVE" "keep or drop the helper's idea first")
      (begin
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (let* ((side (string-append "PADBOOK 1\n"
                                    (pad:time-rows-text (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                                    (pad:time-stamps-text *who-S* 0)
                                    (pad:time-story-text *time-story*)
                                    (pad:time-steps-text *time-steps* 0)))
               (aw (try (serialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f)))
               (pd (try (write-file (string-append base ".pad") side) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (and (eq? aw #t) pd (not (pad:eng-err? pd)))
              (list "SAVE" "the book is saved, with its story")
              (list "NOSAVE" "the book could not be saved"))))))

(define (pad:time-nums xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list) (cons (string->number (car xs)) (pad:time-nums (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-rest xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) xs (pad:time-rest (cdr xs) (- n 1))))
(define (pad:time-read-rows lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "ROW")
     (cons (pad:time-nums (cdr (string-split (car lines) " "))) (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines)))))
(define (pad:time-put xs i v)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((= i 0) (cons v (cdr xs)))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:time-put (cdr xs) (- i 1) v)))))
(define (pad:time-read-stamps lines S)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) S)
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STAMP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines)
                             (pad:time-put S (string->number (cadr f))
                                           (list (caddr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 4) " ")
                                                 (string->number (pad:nth f 3)))))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines) S))))
(define (pad:time-read-story lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STEP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (cons (list (cadr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 3) " ")
                   (if (string=? (caddr f) "-") (list) (string-split (caddr f) ".")))
             (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))

;; Open base.aw + base.pad: the engine comes back with its log (no
;; set-code), the page and stamps from the sidecar. Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-open! base)
  (let* ((side (try (read-file (string-append base ".pad")) (catch (e) #f)))
         (lines (if (string? side) (string-split side "\n") (list))))
    (if (not (and (pair? lines) (string=? (car lines) "PADBOOK 1")))
        (list "NOOPEN" "that book has no pad story")
        (let ((d (try (deserialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (eq? d #t))
              (list "NOOPEN" "aura could not open that book")
              (let ((L (pad:time-read-rows lines)))
                (set! *robot-pending* #f)
                (set! *robot-undo* (list))
                (pad:play-reset! (pad:v-src L))
                (set! *who-L* (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                (set! *who-S* (pad:time-read-stamps lines (pad:who-falses (length *who-L*))))
                (set! *who-hist* (list))
                (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
                (pad:time-start! "opened")
                (set! *time-story* (pad:time-read-story lines))
                (set! *time-reopened* #t)
                (set! *time-open-recs* (pad:ew-records))
                (set! *pl-say* (string-append "the book is open: " (number->string (length *time-story*))
                                              " saved steps, aura has the whole story"))
                (list "OPEN" *pl-say*)))))))

;; --- who after an open (aura#4365, aura#4367) ---
;; The reopened log keeps every change reason (sum=) but says author=0
;; (aura#4365), and the reload renumbers the tree while log targets and
;; node provenance keep the old ids (aura#4367), so nothing joins the log
;; to a define by node id. A define last written before the open takes
;; who from the pad stamp of its row, and aura confirms it: the log must
;; hold a rebind whose reason is the stamp's why. A write after the open
;; has a real author (fingerprint != 0; reopened records say 0): plain
;; M11b. Its mutation id may repeat a reopened one (the id counter is not
;; restored), so ids never decide old vs new.
(define (pad:time-sum-last recs why best)
  (cond
    ((null? recs) best)
    ((and (string=? (caddr (car recs)) "rebind") (string=? (pad:nth (car recs) 3) why))
     (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why (car (car recs))))
    (#t (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why best))))

(define (pad:time-eng-of name st)
  (let ((e (pad:ew-prov name)))
    (cond
      ((and e (> (pad:nth e 3) 0) (not (= (pad:nth e 5) 0))) e)
      ((not st) (list name "nobody" "" 0 0 0))
      ((string=? (car st) "kid") (list name "kid" "" 0 0 0))
      (#t (let ((id (pad:time-sum-last *time-open-recs* (cadr st) 0)))
            (if (> id 0)
                (list name (car st) (cadr st) id 0 0)
                (list name "someone" "" 0 0 0)))))))

(define (pad:time-who-at l)
  (let* ((wl (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src wl)))
         (name (pad:ew-row-name wl toks (pad:ws-soft-defs toks) l))
         (st (pad:who-stamp-of l))
         (e (if name (pad:time-eng-of name st) #f)))
    (list st e (pad:ew-verdict st e))))

;; ctrl-o after an open. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-who-ask!)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *ew-asks* (+ *ew-asks* 1))
  (let* ((l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (x (pad:time-who-at l))
         (v (caddr x))
         (old (and (cadr x) (> (pad:nth (cadr x) 3) 0) (= (pad:nth (cadr x) 5) 0)))
         (tag (string-append (pad:ew-tag l x) (if old " reopened=yes author=0" ""))))
    (if (string=? v "disagree")
        (begin
          (set! *ew-disagree* (+ *ew-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_WHO_DISAGREE ") (display tag) (newline))
        #f)
    (list tag
          (string-append (pad:ew-say v (car x) (cadr x))
                         (if (and old (string=? v "agree")) ", from the saved book" ""))
          v)))

(define (pad:time-who-key!)
  (let ((r (pad:time-who-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (newline)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

(define (pad:time-stats-str)
  (string-append "steps=" (number->string (length *time-steps*))
                 " at=" (number->string (+ *time-at* 1))
                 " moves=" (number->string *time-moves*)
                 " story=" (number->string (length *time-story*))
                 " disagree=" (number->string *time-disagree*)))

target.name: pad:time-note!
target.body:
(lambda (who why names) (if (not *time-on*)
      #f
      (let ((snap (pad:time-snap)))
        (set! *time-steps*
              (append (pad:time-take *time-steps* (+ *time-at* 1))
                      (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* who why names))))
        (set! *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1))
        #t)))
