;; aura-pad M11e -- time machine + open-is-restore.
;; Every robot KEEP (robot.aura pad:robot-commit!) adds one step to a
;; history strip: an ast:snapshot taken right after the KEEP, the page
;; object, its who stamps, and who / why / which names. ctrl-t (IN 20)
;; steps back, ctrl-n (IN 14) steps forward: ast:restore + one
;; eval-current (aura#4349), the step's own page and stamps come back.
;; Before each move ast:diff (target snapshot vs now) says which defines
;; differ; Soft knows which names the skipped steps changed. The two must
;; match, and the engine code after the move must equal the code the step
;; was taken with, or the move prints M11_TIME_DISAGREE.
;;
;; Save = serialize-workspace (code + mutation log) plus a small Soft
;; sidecar (page rows as char codes, who stamps, the strip's who / why).
;; Open = deserialize-workspace + the sidecar: no set-code, the log comes
;; back with its change reasons (sum=). aura#4365 / aura#4367: reopened
;; records say author=0 and point at old node ids, so ctrl-o after an open
;; recovers who from the pad stamp whose why equals a record's reason
;; (pad:time-eng-of). aura#4366: the notebook source ends in #t so the
;; reopened program's value is not a pair (ws.aura).
;;
;; Loaded after robot.aura (robot calls pad:time-note! / pad:time-undone!
;; at run time). Every loop is a top-level function with its data as
;; parameters (no named let captures an outer local, docs/m10.md).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *time-on* #f)
(define *time-steps* (list))   ; oldest first: (snap L S who why names code gen)
(define *time-at* 0)
(define *time-story* (list))   ; saved steps before an open: ((who why names) ...)
(define *time-reopened* #f)
(define *time-open-recs* (list)) ; the reopened log, captured at the open
(define *time-moves* 0)
(define *time-disagree* 0)
(define *time-last* #f)        ; (from to eng-names soft-names code-ok verdict)

(define (pad:time-step snap L S who why names)
  (list snap L S who why names (pad:q-code) (pad:pen-gen)))

;; Start the strip at the page as it is now (after a check or an open).
(define (pad:time-start! label)
  (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *time-steps* (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* label "" (list))))
    (set! *time-at* 0)
    (set! *time-on* (number? snap))   ; the first id is 0, and 0 is false in Soft
    (set! *time-reopened* #f)
    (set! *time-open-recs* (list))
    (set! *time-story* (list))
    *time-on*))

(define (pad:time-take xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:time-take (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))

;; After a robot KEEP: a step in the future is cut (a new branch).
(define (pad:time-note! who why names)
  (if (not *time-on*)
      #f
      (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
        (set! *time-steps*
              (append (pad:time-take *time-steps* (+ *time-at* 1))
                      (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* who why names))))
        (set! *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1))
        #t)))

;; After ctrl-z took the newest KEEP back: that step is gone too.
(define (pad:time-undone!)
  (if (and *time-on* (> *time-at* 0) (= *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1)))
      (begin
        (set! *time-steps* (pad:time-take *time-steps* *time-at*))
        (set! *time-at* (- *time-at* 1))
        #t)
      #f))

;; --- ast:diff in define names ---
;; Top-level defines of a canonical program "(begin (define n ...) ...)":
;; ((name . text) ...) in program order.
(define (pad:time-defs-in code toks depth name start acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks)) (k (car t)) (txt (pad:hl-nth t 3)) (p (cadr t)))
        (cond
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt "("))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (+ depth 1) (if (= depth 1) #f name)
                             (if (= depth 1) p start) acc))
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt ")"))
           (if (and (= depth 2) name)
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) 1 #f 0
                                 (cons (cons name (substring code start (+ p 1))) acc))
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (- depth 1) name start acc)))
          ((and (= depth 2) (not name) (string=? txt "define") (pair? (cdr toks)))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cddr toks) depth (pad:hl-nth (cadr toks) 3) start acc))
          (#t (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) depth name start acc))))))
(define (pad:time-defs code)
  (pad:time-defs-in code (pad:hl-tokens code) 0 #f 0 (list)))

(define (pad:time-text-of name ds)
  (cond
    ((null? ds) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car ds)) name) (cdr (car ds)))
    (#t (pad:time-text-of name (cdr ds)))))

;; Names whose define text differs between a and b (or is in one only).
(define (pad:time-changed-in xs other acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((let ((o (pad:time-text-of (car (car xs)) other)))
       (and o (string=? o (cdr (car xs)))))
     (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    ((member (car (car xs)) acc) (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    (#t (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other (append acc (list (car (car xs))))))))

;; ast:diff snap -> names that differ between that snapshot and now.
;; (:same . code) has one part; (:removed . old) (:added . new) has two.
(define (pad:time-diff-names snap)
  (let ((d (try (ast:diff snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (cond
      ((not (pair? d)) #f)
      ((null? (cdr d)) (list))
      (#t (let ((a (pad:time-defs (cdr (car d))))
                (b (pad:time-defs (cdr (cadr d)))))
            (pad:time-changed-in b a (pad:time-changed-in a b (list))))))))

;; Names the steps lo+1 .. hi changed (Soft side), unique.
(define (pad:time-names-add xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((member (car xs) acc) (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) (append acc (list (car xs)))))))
(define (pad:time-soft-names steps i lo hi acc)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) acc)
    ((and (> i lo) (<= i hi))
     (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi (pad:time-names-add (pad:nth (car steps) 5) acc)))
    (#t (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi acc))))

(define (pad:time-same-set? a b)
  (and (= (length a) (length b)) (pad:time-all-in? a b)))
(define (pad:time-all-in? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:time-all-in? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; --- moving ---
(define (pad:time-step-word i)
  (string-append "step " (number->string (+ i 1)) " of " (number->string (length *time-steps*))))

(define (pad:time-move-say from to names)
  (let* ((st (list-ref *time-steps* (if (< to from) from to)))
         (what (pad:why-owner (pad:nth st 3) (pad:nth st 4)))
         (ns (if (null? names) "nothing" (pad:robot-names-str names))))
    (cond
      ((and (< to from) (= (- from to) 1))
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before " what))
      ((< to from)
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before the last "
                      (number->string (- from to)) " changes"))
      ((= (- to from) 1)
       (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " what " is back (" ns ")"))
      (#t (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " come back")))))

;; Go to step i. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-go! i)
  (cond
    ((not *time-on*) (list "NONE" "the time machine is off" "none"))
    ((< i 0)
     (list "NONE" (if *time-reopened*
                      "this is where the book was opened, older steps are only in the story"
                      "this is the start, there is nothing older")
           "none"))
    ((>= i (length *time-steps*)) (list "NONE" "this is the newest step" "none"))
    ((= i *time-at*) (list "NONE" "you are already here" "none"))
    (#t
     (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
     (let* ((from *time-at*)
            (st (list-ref *time-steps* i))
            (eng (pad:time-diff-names (car st)))
            (soft (pad:time-soft-names *time-steps* 0 (min from i) (max from i) (list))))
       (pad:robot-heal! (car st))
       (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-L* (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-S* (pad:nth st 2))
       (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
       (set! *robot-undo* (list))
       (set! *time-at* i)
       (set! *time-moves* (+ *time-moves* 1))
       (let* ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth st 6)))
              (names-ok (and (list? eng) (pad:time-same-set? eng soft)))
              (v (if (and code-ok names-ok) "agree" "disagree")))
         (set! *time-last* (list from i (if (list? eng) eng (list)) soft code-ok v))
         (if (string=? v "disagree")
             (begin
               (set! *time-disagree* (+ *time-disagree* 1))
               (newline) (display "M11_TIME_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline))
             #f)
         (list "TIME" (pad:time-move-say from i (if (list? eng) eng soft)) v))))))

(define (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-go! (- *time-at* 1)))
(define (pad:time-forward!) (pad:time-go! (+ *time-at* 1)))

;; TIME from=2 to=1 eng=hello.bye soft=hello.bye code=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:time-line x)
  (string-append "TIME from=" (number->string (+ (car x) 1)) " to=" (number->string (+ (cadr x) 1))
                 " eng=" (pad:ws-names-str (caddr x)) " soft=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth x 3))
                 " code=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4)) " verdict=" (pad:nth x 5)))

(define (pad:time-key! back)
  (let ((r (if back (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-forward!))))
    (if (string=? (car r) "TIME") (begin (newline) (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline)) #f)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

;; --- the strip ---
(define (pad:time-label who why)
  (if (string=? why "") who (string-append who ": " why)))
(define (pad:time-story-strs xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
      (cons (pad:time-label (car (car xs)) (cadr (car xs))) (pad:time-story-strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-step-strs steps i)
  (if (null? steps) (list)
      (let ((s (pad:time-label (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))))
        (cons (if (= i *time-at*) (string-append "[" s "]") s)
              (pad:time-step-strs (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))))
;; "start | helper: closer | [macro: flip]"; saved steps first after an open.
(define (pad:time-strip)
  (string-join (append (pad:time-story-strs *time-story*) (pad:time-step-strs *time-steps* 0)) " | "))

;; --- save / open ---
(define (pad:time-row-line row)
  (if (null? row) "ROW" (string-append "ROW " (pad:ws-nums row))))
(define (pad:time-rows-text L)
  (if (null? L) "" (string-append (pad:time-row-line (car L)) "\n" (pad:time-rows-text (cdr L)))))
(define (pad:time-stamps-text S i)
  (cond
    ((null? S) "")
    ((car S)
     (string-append "STAMP " (number->string i) " " (car (car S)) " "
                    (number->string (caddr (car S))) " " (cadr (car S)) "\n"
                    (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1)))))
(define (pad:time-story-line who names why)
  (string-append "STEP " who " " (if (null? names) "-" (string-join names ".")) " " why "\n"))
(define (pad:time-story-text xs)
  (if (null? xs) ""
      (string-append (pad:time-story-line (car (car xs)) (caddr (car xs)) (cadr (car xs)))
                     (pad:time-story-text (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-steps-text steps i)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) "")
    ((and (> i 0) (<= i *time-at*))
     (string-append (pad:time-story-line (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 5) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))
                    (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1)))))

;; Save to base.aw (engine) + base.pad (Soft). Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-save! base)
  (if *robot-pending*
      (list "NOSAVE" "keep or drop the helper's idea first")
      (begin
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (let* ((side (string-append "PADBOOK 1\n"
                                    (pad:time-rows-text (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                                    (pad:time-stamps-text *who-S* 0)
                                    (pad:time-story-text *time-story*)
                                    (pad:time-steps-text *time-steps* 0)))
               (aw (try (serialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f)))
               (pd (try (write-file (string-append base ".pad") side) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (and (eq? aw #t) pd (not (pad:eng-err? pd)))
              (list "SAVE" "the book is saved, with its story")
              (list "NOSAVE" "the book could not be saved"))))))

(define (pad:time-nums xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list) (cons (string->number (car xs)) (pad:time-nums (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-rest xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) xs (pad:time-rest (cdr xs) (- n 1))))
(define (pad:time-read-rows lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "ROW")
     (cons (pad:time-nums (cdr (string-split (car lines) " "))) (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines)))))
(define (pad:time-put xs i v)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((= i 0) (cons v (cdr xs)))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:time-put (cdr xs) (- i 1) v)))))
(define (pad:time-read-stamps lines S)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) S)
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STAMP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines)
                             (pad:time-put S (string->number (cadr f))
                                           (list (caddr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 4) " ")
                                                 (string->number (pad:nth f 3)))))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines) S))))
(define (pad:time-read-story lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STEP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (cons (list (cadr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 3) " ")
                   (if (string=? (caddr f) "-") (list) (string-split (caddr f) ".")))
             (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))

;; Open base.aw + base.pad: the engine comes back with its log (no
;; set-code), the page and stamps from the sidecar. Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-open! base)
  (let* ((side (try (read-file (string-append base ".pad")) (catch (e) #f)))
         (lines (if (string? side) (string-split side "\n") (list))))
    (if (not (and (pair? lines) (string=? (car lines) "PADBOOK 1")))
        (list "NOOPEN" "that book has no pad story")
        (let ((d (try (deserialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (eq? d #t))
              (list "NOOPEN" "aura could not open that book")
              (let ((L (pad:time-read-rows lines)))
                (set! *robot-pending* #f)
                (set! *robot-undo* (list))
                (pad:play-reset! (pad:v-src L))
                (set! *who-L* (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                (set! *who-S* (pad:time-read-stamps lines (pad:who-falses (length *who-L*))))
                (set! *who-hist* (list))
                (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
                (pad:time-start! "opened")
                (set! *time-story* (pad:time-read-story lines))
                (set! *time-reopened* #t)
                (set! *time-open-recs* (pad:ew-records))
                (set! *pl-say* (string-append "the book is open: " (number->string (length *time-story*))
                                              " saved steps, aura has the whole story"))
                (list "OPEN" *pl-say*)))))))

;; --- who after an open (aura#4365, aura#4367) ---
;; The reopened log keeps every change reason (sum=) but says author=0
;; (aura#4365), and the reload renumbers the tree while log targets and
;; node provenance keep the old ids (aura#4367), so nothing joins the log
;; to a define by node id. A define last written before the open takes
;; who from the pad stamp of its row, and aura confirms it: the log must
;; hold a rebind whose reason is the stamp's why. A write after the open
;; has a real author (fingerprint != 0; reopened records say 0): plain
;; M11b. Its mutation id may repeat a reopened one (the id counter is not
;; restored), so ids never decide old vs new.
(define (pad:time-sum-last recs why best)
  (cond
    ((null? recs) best)
    ((and (string=? (caddr (car recs)) "rebind") (string=? (pad:nth (car recs) 3) why))
     (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why (car (car recs))))
    (#t (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why best))))

(define (pad:time-eng-of name st)
  (let ((e (pad:ew-prov name)))
    (cond
      ((and e (> (pad:nth e 3) 0) (not (= (pad:nth e 5) 0))) e)
      ((not st) (list name "nobody" "" 0 0 0))
      ((string=? (car st) "kid") (list name "kid" "" 0 0 0))
      (#t (let ((id (pad:time-sum-last *time-open-recs* (cadr st) 0)))
            (if (> id 0)
                (list name (car st) (cadr st) id 0 0)
                (list name "someone" "" 0 0 0)))))))

(define (pad:time-who-at l)
  (let* ((wl (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src wl)))
         (name (pad:ew-row-name wl toks (pad:ws-soft-defs toks) l))
         (st (pad:who-stamp-of l))
         (e (if name (pad:time-eng-of name st) #f)))
    (list st e (pad:ew-verdict st e))))

;; ctrl-o after an open. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-who-ask!)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *ew-asks* (+ *ew-asks* 1))
  (let* ((l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (x (pad:time-who-at l))
         (v (caddr x))
         (old (and (cadr x) (> (pad:nth (cadr x) 3) 0) (= (pad:nth (cadr x) 5) 0)))
         (tag (string-append (pad:ew-tag l x) (if old " reopened=yes author=0" ""))))
    (if (string=? v "disagree")
        (begin
          (set! *ew-disagree* (+ *ew-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_WHO_DISAGREE ") (display tag) (newline))
        #f)
    (list tag
          (string-append (pad:ew-say v (car x) (cadr x))
                         (if (and old (string=? v "agree")) ", from the saved book" ""))
          v)))

(define (pad:time-who-key!)
  (let ((r (pad:time-who-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (newline)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

(define (pad:time-stats-str)
  (string-append "steps=" (number->string (length *time-steps*))
                 " at=" (number->string (+ *time-at* 1))
                 " moves=" (number->string *time-moves*)
                 " story=" (number->string (length *time-story*))
                 " disagree=" (number->string *time-disagree*)))

    (cond
      ((and e (> (pad:nth e 3) 0)) e)
      ((and st (string=? (car st) "kid")) (list name "kid" "" 0 0 0))
      (e e)
      (#t (list name "nobody" "" 0 0 0)))))

;; aura-pad M11e -- time machine + open-is-restore.
;; Every robot KEEP (robot.aura pad:robot-commit!) adds one step to a
;; history strip: an ast:snapshot taken right after the KEEP, the page
;; object, its who stamps, and who / why / which names. ctrl-t (IN 20)
;; steps back, ctrl-n (IN 14) steps forward: ast:restore + one
;; eval-current (aura#4349), the step's own page and stamps come back.
;; Before each move ast:diff (target snapshot vs now) says which defines
;; differ; Soft knows which names the skipped steps changed. The two must
;; match, and the engine code after the move must equal the code the step
;; was taken with, or the move prints M11_TIME_DISAGREE.
;;
;; Save = serialize-workspace (code + mutation log) plus a small Soft
;; sidecar (page rows as char codes, who stamps, the strip's who / why).
;; Open = deserialize-workspace + the sidecar: no set-code, the log comes
;; back with its change reasons (sum=). aura#4365 / aura#4367: reopened
;; records say author=0 and point at old node ids, so ctrl-o after an open
;; recovers who from the pad stamp whose why equals a record's reason
;; (pad:time-eng-of). aura#4366: the notebook source ends in #t so the
;; reopened program's value is not a pair (ws.aura).
;;
;; Loaded after robot.aura (robot calls pad:time-note! / pad:time-undone!
;; at run time). Every loop is a top-level function with its data as
;; parameters (no named let captures an outer local, docs/m10.md).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *time-on* #f)
(define *time-steps* (list))   ; oldest first: (snap L S who why names code gen)
(define *time-at* 0)
(define *time-story* (list))   ; saved steps before an open: ((who why names) ...)
(define *time-reopened* #f)
(define *time-open-recs* (list)) ; the reopened log, captured at the open
(define *time-moves* 0)
(define *time-disagree* 0)
(define *time-last* #f)        ; (from to eng-names soft-names code-ok verdict)

(define (pad:time-step snap L S who why names)
  (list snap L S who why names (pad:q-code) (pad:pen-gen)))

;; Start the strip at the page as it is now (after a check or an open).
(define (pad:time-start! label)
  (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
    (set! *time-steps* (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* label "" (list))))
    (set! *time-at* 0)
    (set! *time-on* (number? snap))   ; the first id is 0, and 0 is false in Soft
    (set! *time-reopened* #f)
    (set! *time-open-recs* (list))
    (set! *time-story* (list))
    *time-on*))

(define (pad:time-take xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) (list) (cons (car xs) (pad:time-take (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))

;; After a robot KEEP: a step in the future is cut (a new branch).
(define (pad:time-note! who why names)
  (if (not *time-on*)
      #f
      (let ((snap (try (ast:snapshot "time") (catch (e) #f))))
        (set! *time-steps*
              (append (pad:time-take *time-steps* (+ *time-at* 1))
                      (list (pad:time-step snap (pad:es-L *pl-st*) *who-S* who why names))))
        (set! *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1))
        #t)))

;; After ctrl-z took the newest KEEP back: that step is gone too.
(define (pad:time-undone!)
  (if (and *time-on* (> *time-at* 0) (= *time-at* (- (length *time-steps*) 1)))
      (begin
        (set! *time-steps* (pad:time-take *time-steps* *time-at*))
        (set! *time-at* (- *time-at* 1))
        #t)
      #f))

;; --- ast:diff in define names ---
;; Top-level defines of a canonical program "(begin (define n ...) ...)":
;; ((name . text) ...) in program order.
(define (pad:time-defs-in code toks depth name start acc)
  (if (null? toks)
      (reverse acc)
      (let* ((t (car toks)) (k (car t)) (txt (pad:hl-nth t 3)) (p (cadr t)))
        (cond
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt "("))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (+ depth 1) (if (= depth 1) #f name)
                             (if (= depth 1) p start) acc))
          ((and (string=? k "P") (string=? txt ")"))
           (if (and (= depth 2) name)
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) 1 #f 0
                                 (cons (cons name (substring code start (+ p 1))) acc))
               (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) (- depth 1) name start acc)))
          ((and (= depth 2) (not name) (string=? txt "define") (pair? (cdr toks)))
           (pad:time-defs-in code (cddr toks) depth (pad:hl-nth (cadr toks) 3) start acc))
          (#t (pad:time-defs-in code (cdr toks) depth name start acc))))))
(define (pad:time-defs code)
  (pad:time-defs-in code (pad:hl-tokens code) 0 #f 0 (list)))

(define (pad:time-text-of name ds)
  (cond
    ((null? ds) #f)
    ((string=? (car (car ds)) name) (cdr (car ds)))
    (#t (pad:time-text-of name (cdr ds)))))

;; Names whose define text differs between a and b (or is in one only).
(define (pad:time-changed-in xs other acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((let ((o (pad:time-text-of (car (car xs)) other)))
       (and o (string=? o (cdr (car xs)))))
     (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    ((member (car (car xs)) acc) (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other acc))
    (#t (pad:time-changed-in (cdr xs) other (append acc (list (car (car xs))))))))

;; ast:diff snap -> names that differ between that snapshot and now.
;; (:same . code) has one part; (:removed . old) (:added . new) has two.
(define (pad:time-diff-names snap)
  (let ((d (try (ast:diff snap) (catch (e) #f))))
    (cond
      ((not (pair? d)) #f)
      ((null? (cdr d)) (list))
      (#t (let ((a (pad:time-defs (cdr (car d))))
                (b (pad:time-defs (cdr (cadr d)))))
            (pad:time-changed-in b a (pad:time-changed-in a b (list))))))))

;; Names the steps lo+1 .. hi changed (Soft side), unique.
(define (pad:time-names-add xs acc)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) acc)
    ((member (car xs) acc) (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) acc))
    (#t (pad:time-names-add (cdr xs) (append acc (list (car xs)))))))
(define (pad:time-soft-names steps i lo hi acc)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) acc)
    ((and (> i lo) (<= i hi))
     (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi (pad:time-names-add (pad:nth (car steps) 5) acc)))
    (#t (pad:time-soft-names (cdr steps) (+ i 1) lo hi acc))))

(define (pad:time-same-set? a b)
  (and (= (length a) (length b)) (pad:time-all-in? a b)))
(define (pad:time-all-in? a b)
  (cond ((null? a) #t) ((member (car a) b) (pad:time-all-in? (cdr a) b)) (#t #f)))

;; --- moving ---
(define (pad:time-step-word i)
  (string-append "step " (number->string (+ i 1)) " of " (number->string (length *time-steps*))))

(define (pad:time-move-say from to names)
  (let* ((st (list-ref *time-steps* (if (< to from) from to)))
         (what (pad:why-owner (pad:nth st 3) (pad:nth st 4)))
         (ns (if (null? names) "nothing" (pad:robot-names-str names))))
    (cond
      ((and (< to from) (= (- from to) 1))
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before " what))
      ((< to from)
       (string-append "back to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " like before the last "
                      (number->string (- from to)) " changes"))
      ((= (- to from) 1)
       (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " what " is back (" ns ")"))
      (#t (string-append "forward to " (pad:time-step-word to) ": " ns " come back")))))

;; Go to step i. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-go! i)
  (cond
    ((not *time-on*) (list "NONE" "the time machine is off" "none"))
    ((< i 0)
     (list "NONE" (if *time-reopened*
                      "this is where the book was opened, older steps are only in the story"
                      "this is the start, there is nothing older")
           "none"))
    ((>= i (length *time-steps*)) (list "NONE" "this is the newest step" "none"))
    ((= i *time-at*) (list "NONE" "you are already here" "none"))
    (#t
     (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
     (let* ((from *time-at*)
            (st (list-ref *time-steps* i))
            (eng (pad:time-diff-names (car st)))
            (soft (pad:time-soft-names *time-steps* 0 (min from i) (max from i) (list))))
       (pad:robot-heal! (car st))
       (pad:pen-set-page! (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-L* (pad:nth st 1))
       (set! *who-S* (pad:nth st 2))
       (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
       (set! *robot-undo* (list))
       (set! *time-at* i)
       (set! *time-moves* (+ *time-moves* 1))
       (let* ((code-ok (string=? (pad:q-code) (pad:nth st 6)))
              (names-ok (and (list? eng) (pad:time-same-set? eng soft)))
              (v (if (and code-ok names-ok) "agree" "disagree")))
         (set! *time-last* (list from i (if (list? eng) eng (list)) soft code-ok v))
         (if (string=? v "disagree")
             (begin
               (set! *time-disagree* (+ *time-disagree* 1))
               (newline) (display "M11_TIME_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline))
             #f)
         (list "TIME" (pad:time-move-say from i (if (list? eng) eng soft)) v))))))

(define (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-go! (- *time-at* 1)))
(define (pad:time-forward!) (pad:time-go! (+ *time-at* 1)))

;; TIME from=2 to=1 eng=hello.bye soft=hello.bye code=yes verdict=agree
(define (pad:time-line x)
  (string-append "TIME from=" (number->string (+ (car x) 1)) " to=" (number->string (+ (cadr x) 1))
                 " eng=" (pad:ws-names-str (caddr x)) " soft=" (pad:ws-names-str (pad:nth x 3))
                 " code=" (pad:who-bool (pad:nth x 4)) " verdict=" (pad:nth x 5)))

(define (pad:time-key! back)
  (let ((r (if back (pad:time-back!) (pad:time-forward!))))
    (if (string=? (car r) "TIME") (begin (newline) (display (pad:time-line *time-last*)) (newline)) #f)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

;; --- the strip ---
(define (pad:time-label who why)
  (if (string=? why "") who (string-append who ": " why)))
(define (pad:time-story-strs xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
      (cons (pad:time-label (car (car xs)) (cadr (car xs))) (pad:time-story-strs (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-step-strs steps i)
  (if (null? steps) (list)
      (let ((s (pad:time-label (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))))
        (cons (if (= i *time-at*) (string-append "[" s "]") s)
              (pad:time-step-strs (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))))
;; "start | helper: closer | [macro: flip]"; saved steps first after an open.
(define (pad:time-strip)
  (string-join (append (pad:time-story-strs *time-story*) (pad:time-step-strs *time-steps* 0)) " | "))

;; --- save / open ---
(define (pad:time-row-line row)
  (if (null? row) "ROW" (string-append "ROW " (pad:ws-nums row))))
(define (pad:time-rows-text L)
  (if (null? L) "" (string-append (pad:time-row-line (car L)) "\n" (pad:time-rows-text (cdr L)))))
(define (pad:time-stamps-text S i)
  (cond
    ((null? S) "")
    ((car S)
     (string-append "STAMP " (number->string i) " " (car (car S)) " "
                    (number->string (caddr (car S))) " " (cadr (car S)) "\n"
                    (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-stamps-text (cdr S) (+ i 1)))))
(define (pad:time-story-line who names why)
  (string-append "STEP " who " " (if (null? names) "-" (string-join names ".")) " " why "\n"))
(define (pad:time-story-text xs)
  (if (null? xs) ""
      (string-append (pad:time-story-line (car (car xs)) (caddr (car xs)) (cadr (car xs)))
                     (pad:time-story-text (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-steps-text steps i)
  (cond
    ((null? steps) "")
    ((and (> i 0) (<= i *time-at*))
     (string-append (pad:time-story-line (pad:nth (car steps) 3) (pad:nth (car steps) 5) (pad:nth (car steps) 4))
                    (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1))))
    (#t (pad:time-steps-text (cdr steps) (+ i 1)))))

;; Save to base.aw (engine) + base.pad (Soft). Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-save! base)
  (if *robot-pending*
      (list "NOSAVE" "keep or drop the helper's idea first")
      (begin
        (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
        (let* ((side (string-append "PADBOOK 1\n"
                                    (pad:time-rows-text (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                                    (pad:time-stamps-text *who-S* 0)
                                    (pad:time-story-text *time-story*)
                                    (pad:time-steps-text *time-steps* 0)))
               (aw (try (serialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f)))
               (pd (try (write-file (string-append base ".pad") side) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (and (eq? aw #t) pd (not (pad:eng-err? pd)))
              (list "SAVE" "the book is saved, with its story")
              (list "NOSAVE" "the book could not be saved"))))))

(define (pad:time-nums xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list) (cons (string->number (car xs)) (pad:time-nums (cdr xs)))))
(define (pad:time-rest xs n)
  (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs)) xs (pad:time-rest (cdr xs) (- n 1))))
(define (pad:time-read-rows lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "ROW")
     (cons (pad:time-nums (cdr (string-split (car lines) " "))) (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-rows (cdr lines)))))
(define (pad:time-put xs i v)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((= i 0) (cons v (cdr xs)))
    (#t (cons (car xs) (pad:time-put (cdr xs) (- i 1) v)))))
(define (pad:time-read-stamps lines S)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) S)
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STAMP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines)
                             (pad:time-put S (string->number (cadr f))
                                           (list (caddr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 4) " ")
                                                 (string->number (pad:nth f 3)))))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-stamps (cdr lines) S))))
(define (pad:time-read-story lines)
  (cond
    ((null? lines) (list))
    ((string-prefix? (car lines) "STEP ")
     (let ((f (string-split (car lines) " ")))
       (cons (list (cadr f) (string-join (pad:time-rest f 3) " ")
                   (if (string=? (caddr f) "-") (list) (string-split (caddr f) ".")))
             (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))
    (#t (pad:time-read-story (cdr lines)))))

;; Open base.aw + base.pad: the engine comes back with its log (no
;; set-code), the page and stamps from the sidecar. Returns (tag say).
(define (pad:time-open! base)
  (let* ((side (try (read-file (string-append base ".pad")) (catch (e) #f)))
         (lines (if (string? side) (string-split side "\n") (list))))
    (if (not (and (pair? lines) (string=? (car lines) "PADBOOK 1")))
        (list "NOOPEN" "that book has no pad story")
        (let ((d (try (deserialize-workspace (string-append base ".aw")) (catch (e) #f))))
          (if (not (eq? d #t))
              (list "NOOPEN" "aura could not open that book")
              (let ((L (pad:time-read-rows lines)))
                (set! *robot-pending* #f)
                (set! *robot-undo* (list))
                (pad:play-reset! (pad:v-src L))
                (set! *who-L* (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
                (set! *who-S* (pad:time-read-stamps lines (pad:who-falses (length *who-L*))))
                (set! *who-hist* (list))
                (set! *who-gen* (pad:pen-gen))
                (pad:time-start! "opened")
                (set! *time-story* (pad:time-read-story lines))
                (set! *time-reopened* #t)
                (set! *time-open-recs* (pad:ew-records))
                (set! *pl-say* (string-append "the book is open: " (number->string (length *time-story*))
                                              " saved steps, aura has the whole story"))
                (list "OPEN" *pl-say*)))))))

;; --- who after an open (aura#4365, aura#4367) ---
;; The reopened log keeps every change reason (sum=) but says author=0
;; (aura#4365), and the reload renumbers the tree while log targets and
;; node provenance keep the old ids (aura#4367), so nothing joins the log
;; to a define by node id. A define last written before the open takes
;; who from the pad stamp of its row, and aura confirms it: the log must
;; hold a rebind whose reason is the stamp's why. A write after the open
;; has a real author (fingerprint != 0; reopened records say 0): plain
;; M11b. Its mutation id may repeat a reopened one (the id counter is not
;; restored), so ids never decide old vs new.
(define (pad:time-sum-last recs why best)
  (cond
    ((null? recs) best)
    ((and (string=? (caddr (car recs)) "rebind") (string=? (pad:nth (car recs) 3) why))
     (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why (car (car recs))))
    (#t (pad:time-sum-last (cdr recs) why best))))

(define (pad:time-eng-of name st)
  (let ((e (pad:ew-prov name)))
    (cond
      ((and e (> (pad:nth e 3) 0) (not (= (pad:nth e 5) 0))) e)
      ((not st) (list name "nobody" "" 0 0 0))
      ((string=? (car st) "kid") (list name "kid" "" 0 0 0))
      (#t (let ((id (pad:time-sum-last *time-open-recs* (cadr st) 0)))
            (if (> id 0)
                (list name (car st) (cadr st) id 0 0)
                (list name "someone" "" 0 0 0)))))))

(define (pad:time-who-at l)
  (let* ((wl (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (toks (pad:hl-tokens (pad:v-src wl)))
         (name (pad:ew-row-name wl toks (pad:ws-soft-defs toks) l))
         (st (pad:who-stamp-of l))
         (e (if name (pad:time-eng-of name st) #f)))
    (list st e (pad:ew-verdict st e))))

;; ctrl-o after an open. Returns (tag say verdict).
(define (pad:time-who-ask!)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *ew-asks* (+ *ew-asks* 1))
  (let* ((l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (x (pad:time-who-at l))
         (v (caddr x))
         (old (and (cadr x) (> (pad:nth (cadr x) 3) 0) (= (pad:nth (cadr x) 5) 0)))
         (tag (string-append (pad:ew-tag l x) (if old " reopened=yes author=0" ""))))
    (if (string=? v "disagree")
        (begin
          (set! *ew-disagree* (+ *ew-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_WHO_DISAGREE ") (display tag) (newline))
        #f)
    (list tag
          (string-append (pad:ew-say v (car x) (cadr x))
                         (if (and old (string=? v "agree")) ", from the saved book" ""))
          v)))

(define (pad:time-who-key!)
  (let ((r (pad:time-who-ask!)))
    (newline) (display (car r)) (newline)
    (pad:play-ok! (cadr r))))

(define (pad:time-stats-str)
  (string-append "steps=" (number->string (length *time-steps*))
                 " at=" (number->string (+ *time-at* 1))
                 " moves=" (number->string *time-moves*)
                 " story=" (number->string (length *time-story*))
                 " disagree=" (number->string *time-disagree*)))

target.name: pad:time-who-ask!
target.body:
(lambda () (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *ew-asks* (+ *ew-asks* 1))
  (let* ((l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (x (pad:time-who-at l))
         (v (caddr x))
         (e (cadr x))
         (old (and *time-reopened* e (> (pad:nth e 3) 0)
                   (> (pad:time-sum-last *time-open-recs* (pad:nth e 2) 0) 0)))
         (tag (string-append (pad:ew-tag l x) (if old " reopened=yes" ""))))
    (if (string=? v "disagree")
        (begin
          (set! *ew-disagree* (+ *ew-disagree* 1))
          (newline) (display "M11_WHO_DISAGREE ") (display tag) (newline))
        #f)
    (list tag
          (string-append (pad:ew-say v (car x) (cadr x))
                         (if (and old (string=? v "agree")) ", from the saved book" ""))
          v)))

;; aura-pad key-path perf: scripted pad_play-style stream (edit + snap).
;; Prints PERF lines and PAD_PERF_OK when insert/cursor medians beat the
;; Soft threshold (kid pad should feel snappier than a sleepy Emacs).
;; Soft reserved: never bind quote. No HTTP.
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/buffer.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/lines.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/edit.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/hl.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/jump.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/view.aura")
(load "/workspace/aura-pad/soft/pad/keys.aura")

(define (now) (current-time-ms))

;; Threshold: clearly under ~50ms median for the small play buffer.
;; Ideal interactive path is <<16ms (60fps); Soft tip still pays a
;; per-call define-lookup cost (Aura #4343) so we guard 50ms here.
(define *pad-perf-ok-ms* 50)
(define *n* 20)

(pad:play-reset! *play-start*)
;; Warm the Soft pipeline once (not timed).
(pad:play-cmd! 120)
(string-length (pad:play-snap))

(define (run-insert n)
  (let ((t0 (now)))
    (let loop ((i 0))
      (if (< i n)
          (begin
            (pad:play-cmd! (+ 97 (modulo i 26)))
            (string-length (pad:play-snap))
            (loop (+ i 1)))))
    (- (now) t0)))

(define (run-cursor n)
  (let ((t0 (now)))
    (let loop ((i 0))
      (if (< i n)
          (begin
            (pad:play-cmd! (if (= (modulo i 2) 0) "left" "right"))
            (string-length (pad:play-snap))
            (loop (+ i 1)))))
    (- (now) t0)))

(define ms-ins (run-insert *n*))
(define ms-cur (run-cursor *n*))
(define per-ins (/ ms-ins *n*))
(define per-cur (/ ms-cur *n*))
(define src-len (string-length (pad:play-src)))

(display "PERF n=") (display (number->string *n*))
(display " src_len=") (display (number->string src-len))
(display " insert_ms_key=") (display (number->string per-ins))
(display " cursor_ms_key=") (display (number->string per-cur))
(display " threshold_ms=") (display (number->string *pad-perf-ok-ms*))
(newline)

(display "PERF_BASELINE_NOTE before=insert~161ms cursor~288ms (full re-HL+marks each key)")
(newline)

(if (and (< per-ins *pad-perf-ok-ms*) (< per-cur *pad-perf-ok-ms*))
    (begin (display "PAD_PERF_OK") (newline))
    (begin
      (display "PAD_PERF_FAIL insert=") (display (number->string per-ins))
      (display " cursor=") (display (number->string per-cur))
      (newline)))

            (loop (+ i 1)))))
    (- (now) t0)))

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "hi! type, arrows move, ctrl-g finds where a name is born, ctrl-q says bye")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))

  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*)) (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (name (pad:sym-at src pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def j))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd j)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (pad:hl-nth r 2))
          (pad:play-move-to! (pad:hl-nth r 1))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")

                                (number->string (length (pad:hl-nth r 3)))
                                " times"))))))))

(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")

             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))

                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

(define (pad:play-snap)
  (pad:snap-text (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                                (number->string *pl-keys*)
                                " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*))
                 (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                 *pl-say*))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "hi! type, arrows move, ctrl-g finds where a name is born, ctrl-q says bye")

(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)

  (pad:snap-text (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                                (number->string *pl-keys*)
                                " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*))
                 (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                 *pl-say*))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "hi! type, arrows move, ctrl-g finds where a name is born, ctrl-q says bye")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*)) (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (name (pad:sym-at src pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def j))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd j)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (pad:hl-nth r 2))
          (pad:play-move-to! (pad:hl-nth r 1))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (pad:hl-nth r 3)))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

(define (pad:play-snap)
  (pad:snap-text (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                                (number->string *pl-keys*)
                                " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*))
                 (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)
                 *pl-say*))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

             (#t (string-append name " is used "

                                " times"))))))))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; Hot path cache: *pl-src* / *pl-tape* / *pl-toks* / *pl-marks* /
;; *pl-mname* survive across keys. Text edits invalidate the tape;
;; cursor-only moves reuse the HL tape and only rebuild marks when the
;; name under point changes. Soft marks DIRTY rows so C can paint less.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "hi! type, arrows move, ctrl-g finds where a name is born, ctrl-q says bye")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

;; HL / marks cache for the interactive key path (kid-friendly speed).
(define *pl-src* "")
(define *pl-tape* "")
(define *pl-toks* (list))
(define *pl-marks* "")
(define *pl-mname* "")
(define *pl-prev-L* (list))
(define *pl-framed* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (if (string=? src *pl-src*) *pl-toks* (pad:hl-tokens src)))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def j))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd j)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-snap)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)

  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  0)

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; Hot path cache: *pl-src* / *pl-tape* / *pl-toks* / *pl-marks* /
;; *pl-mname* survive across keys. Text edits invalidate the tape;
;; cursor-only moves reuse the HL tape and only rebuild marks when the
;; name under point changes. Soft marks DIRTY rows so C can paint less.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "hi! type, arrows move, ctrl-g finds where a name is born, ctrl-q says bye")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

;; HL / marks cache for the interactive key path (kid-friendly speed).
(define *pl-src* "")
(define *pl-tape* "")
(define *pl-toks* (list))
(define *pl-marks* "")
(define *pl-mname* "")
(define *pl-prev-L* (list))
(define *pl-framed* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (if (string=? src *pl-src*) *pl-toks* (pad:hl-tokens src)))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def j))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd j)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-snap)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)
