;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; Hot path cache: *pl-src* / *pl-tape* / *pl-toks* / *pl-marks* /
;; *pl-mname* survive across keys. Text edits invalidate the tape;
;; cursor-only moves reuse the HL tape and only rebuild marks when the
;; name under point changes. Soft marks DIRTY rows so C can paint less.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "hi! type, arrows move, ctrl-g finds where a name is born, ctrl-q says bye")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

;; HL / marks cache for the interactive key path (kid-friendly speed).
(define *pl-src* "")
(define *pl-tape* "")
(define *pl-toks* (list))
(define *pl-marks* "")
(define *pl-mname* "")
(define *pl-prev-L* (list))
(define *pl-framed* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (if (string=? src *pl-src*) *pl-toks* (pad:hl-tokens src)))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def j))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd j)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-snap)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (pad:lc-toks L))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def-in j toks))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd-in j toks)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-title)
  (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                 (number->string *pl-keys*)
                 " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))

;; M7 key path: line-incremental Soft key path (lc.aura). Only the edited line is
;; re-tokenized; DIRTY lists exactly the rows whose T/H/M changed.
(define (pad:play-snap)
  (pad:lc-snap (pad:play-title) (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*)
               (pad:es-col *pl-st*) *pl-say*))

;; M6 key path (whole-page tokenize per text change), kept as the perf
;; "before" reference. Do not mix with pad:play-snap in one session.
(define (pad:play-snap-m6)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

target.body:
(lambda (c) (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (n (length L)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) (pad:play-reject! "not-print"))
         ((>= len *max-col*) (pad:play-reject! "need-space"))
         (#t
          (let* ((ln2 (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                              (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col)))))
                 (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                             (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                 (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                 (un (length U)))
            (set! *pl-st*
                  (list L2 l (+ col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                        (cond
                          ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                          ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                          (#t U))))
            (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
            "ok"))))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (and (= l 0) (= col 0))
           (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
           (begin
             (set! *pl-st*
                   (if (> col 0)
                       (list L l (- col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))
                       (list L (- l 1) (length (list-ref L (- l 1)))
                             (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len))
           (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
           (begin
             (set! *pl-st*
                   (if (< col len)
                       (list L l (+ col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))
                       (list L (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((or (string=? c "home") (string=? c "end"))
       (set! *pl-st* (list L l (if (string=? c "home") 0 len)
                           (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
       "ok")
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (if (>= l (- n 1))
           (pad:play-reject! "no-line")
           (let ((nl (length (list-ref L (+ l 1)))))
             (set! *pl-st* (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col)
                                 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (if (= l 0)
           (pad:play-reject! "no-line")
           (let ((pl (length (list-ref L (- l 1)))))
             (set! *pl-st* (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col)
                                 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((or (string=? c "open-line") (string=? c "enter"))
       ;; split the line at point (Emacs C-o); "enter" = open-line then
       ;; right, two accepted steps (keys += 2) as in pad:play-cmd-ref!
       (if (>= n *max-lines*)
           (pad:play-reject! "need-space")
           (let* ((pre (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col)))))
                  (post (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col)))
                  (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                              (cons pre (cons post (drop L (+ l 1))))))
                  (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                  (un (length U))
                  (U2 (cond
                        ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                        ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                        (#t U))))
             (if (string=? c "enter")
                 (begin
                   (set! *pl-st* (list L2 (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list) U2))
                   (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 2)))
                 (begin
                   (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col (list-ref st 3) (list) U2))
                   (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))))
             "ok")))
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= col 0) (> l 0))
       ;; backspace at line start joins onto the previous line
       (let* ((pv (list-ref L (- l 1)))
              (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n (- l 1))))
                          (cons (append pv ln) (drop L (+ l 1)))))
              (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
              (un (length U)))
         (set! *pl-st*
               (list L2 (- l 1) (length pv) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                     (cond
                       ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                       ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                       (#t U))))
         (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
         "ok"))
      ((and (string=? c "back") (> col 0))
       ;; backspace inside a line (delete_and_extract_region of one char);
       ;; col > 0 so neither empty-buf nor too-far can fire
       (let* ((ln2 (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                           (drop ln col)))
              (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                          (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
              (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
              (un (length U)))
         (set! *pl-st*
               (list L2 l (- col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                     (cond
                       ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                       ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                       (#t U))))
         (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
         "ok"))
      (#t (pad:play-cmd-ref! c)))))

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view/lc. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; Key path (M7): pad:play-snap goes through the per-line cache in
;; lc.aura (load it before this file). The M6 whole-page cache
;; (*pl-src* / *pl-tape* / *pl-toks* / *pl-marks*) stays only for
;; pad:play-snap-m6, the perf "before" reference.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "welcome to aura pad - type goal:hi aura to try")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

;; HL / marks cache for the interactive key path (kid-friendly speed).
(define *pl-src* "")
(define *pl-tape* "")
(define *pl-toks* (list))
(define *pl-marks* "")
(define *pl-mname* "")
(define *pl-prev-L* (list))
(define *pl-framed* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (pad:lc-toks L))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def-in j toks))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd-in j toks)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-title)
  (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                 (number->string *pl-keys*)
                 " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))

;; M7 key path: line-incremental Soft key path (lc.aura). Only the edited line is
;; re-tokenized; DIRTY lists exactly the rows whose T/H/M changed.
(define (pad:play-snap)
  (pad:lc-snap (pad:play-title) (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*)
               (pad:es-col *pl-st*) *pl-say*))

;; M6 key path (whole-page tokenize per text change), kept as the perf
;; "before" reference. Do not mix with pad:play-snap in one session.
(define (pad:play-snap-m6)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

target.name: pad:play-snap
target.body:
(lambda () (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         ;; try_cursor_movement, inlined: same lines object, cache live,
         ;; and the name under the cursor unchanged -> rows and SNAP body
         ;; stand, only the cursor row is dirty. Else the lc frame ladder.
         (move (and (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (name (if move
                   (let loop ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= col (cadr t)) (< col (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (loop (cdr ts))))))
                   ""))
         (same (and move (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (dirty (cond
                  (same
                   (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
                   (set! *lc-cur* l)
                   (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                   (list l))
                  ;; pad:lc-frame!'s ladder, inlined (one Soft call less)
                  ((= *lc-framed* 0) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
                  (move (pad:lc-move-to! L l name))
                  ((let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
                     (and (= n (length old))
                          (< l n)
                          (equal? (drop L (+ l 1)) (drop old (+ l 1)))
                          (equal? (drop (reverse L) (- n l))
                                  (drop (reverse old) (- n l)))))
                   (pad:lc-line! L l col))
                  (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))
         (dcsv (cond
                 ((null? dirty) "")
                 ((null? (cdr dirty)) (number->string (car dirty)))
                 (#t (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE aura pad (Soft) keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
      " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "") "" (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
      *lc-body*
      "END\n")))

;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view/lc. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; Key path (M7): pad:play-snap goes through the per-line cache in
;; lc.aura (load it before this file). The M6 whole-page cache
;; (*pl-src* / *pl-tape* / *pl-toks* / *pl-marks*) stays only for
;; pad:play-snap-m6, the perf "before" reference.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "welcome to aura pad - type goal:hi aura to try")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

;; HL / marks cache for the interactive key path (kid-friendly speed).
(define *pl-src* "")
(define *pl-tape* "")
(define *pl-toks* (list))
(define *pl-marks* "")
(define *pl-mname* "")
(define *pl-prev-L* (list))
(define *pl-framed* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word): the reference
;; path, gate (pad:play-gate) then apply (pad:eapply).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (pad:lc-toks L))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def-in j toks))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd-in j toks)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command, the reference dispatch (M6). Returns "ok", "quit",
;; or a reject reason. pad:play-cmd! (below) takes the hot words itself.
(define (pad:play-cmd-ref! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; Emacs port: command_loop_1 (Emacs 22 keyboard.c) ran forward-char,
;; backward-char and self-insert-command "directly" -- the primitive on
;; the buffer, no call-interactively -- and everything else the generic
;; way. Same here: a typed char and the cursor/backspace words are gated
;; and applied in this one procedure with builtins (no Soft call per
;; accessor, put-nth step or take/drop), giving the exact state and
;; reason pad:play-cmd-ref! gives (checked by emacs_test.aura).
;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
;; State is (L line col kill mark undo); a text edit pushes (L line col)
;; onto undo (at most *undo-max*) and clears the mark; a move keeps both.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (n (length L)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) (pad:play-reject! "not-print"))
         ((>= len *max-col*) (pad:play-reject! "need-space"))
         (#t
          (let* ((ln2 (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                              (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col)))))
                 (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                             (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                 (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                 (un (length U)))
            (set! *pl-st*
                  (list L2 l (+ col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                        (cond
                          ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                          ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                          (#t U))))
            (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
            "ok"))))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (and (= l 0) (= col 0))
           (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
           (begin
             (set! *pl-st*
                   (if (> col 0)
                       (list L l (- col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))
                       (list L (- l 1) (length (list-ref L (- l 1)))
                             (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len))
           (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
           (begin
             (set! *pl-st*
                   (if (< col len)
                       (list L l (+ col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))
                       (list L (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((or (string=? c "home") (string=? c "end"))
       (set! *pl-st* (list L l (if (string=? c "home") 0 len)
                           (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
       "ok")
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (if (>= l (- n 1))
           (pad:play-reject! "no-line")
           (let ((nl (length (list-ref L (+ l 1)))))
             (set! *pl-st* (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col)
                                 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (if (= l 0)
           (pad:play-reject! "no-line")
           (let ((pl (length (list-ref L (- l 1)))))
             (set! *pl-st* (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col)
                                 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((or (string=? c "open-line") (string=? c "enter"))
       ;; split the line at point (Emacs C-o); "enter" = open-line then
       ;; right, two accepted steps (keys += 2) as in pad:play-cmd-ref!
       (if (>= n *max-lines*)
           (pad:play-reject! "need-space")
           (let* ((pre (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col)))))
                  (post (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col)))
                  (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                              (cons pre (cons post (drop L (+ l 1))))))
                  (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                  (un (length U))
                  (U2 (cond
                        ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                        ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                        (#t U))))
             (if (string=? c "enter")
                 (begin
                   (set! *pl-st* (list L2 (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list) U2))
                   (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 2)))
                 (begin
                   (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col (list-ref st 3) (list) U2))
                   (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))))
             "ok")))
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= col 0) (> l 0))
       ;; backspace at line start joins onto the previous line
       (let* ((pv (list-ref L (- l 1)))
              (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n (- l 1))))
                          (cons (append pv ln) (drop L (+ l 1)))))
              (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
              (un (length U)))
         (set! *pl-st*
               (list L2 (- l 1) (length pv) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                     (cond
                       ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                       ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                       (#t U))))
         (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
         "ok"))
      ((and (string=? c "back") (> col 0))
       ;; backspace inside a line (delete_and_extract_region of one char);
       ;; col > 0 so neither empty-buf nor too-far can fire
       (let* ((ln2 (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                           (drop ln col)))
              (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                          (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
              (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
              (un (length U)))
         (set! *pl-st*
               (list L2 l (- col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                     (cond
                       ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                       ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                       (#t U))))
         (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
         "ok"))
      (#t (pad:play-cmd-ref! c)))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-title)
  (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                 (number->string *pl-keys*)
                 " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))

;; M7 key path: line-incremental Soft key path (lc.aura). Only the edited line is
;; re-tokenized; DIRTY lists exactly the rows whose T/H/M changed.
(define (pad:play-snap)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         ;; try_cursor_movement, inlined: same lines object, cache live,
         ;; and the name under the cursor unchanged -> rows and SNAP body
         ;; stand, only the cursor row is dirty. Else the lc frame ladder.
         (move (and (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (name (if move
                   (let loop ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= col (cadr t)) (< col (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (loop (cdr ts))))))
                   ""))
         (same (and move (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (dirty (cond
                  (same
                   (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
                   (set! *lc-cur* l)
                   (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                   (list l))
                  ;; pad:lc-frame!'s ladder, inlined (one Soft call less)
                  ((= *lc-framed* 0) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
                  (move (pad:lc-move-to! L l name))
                  ((let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
                     (and (= n (length old))
                          (< l n)
                          (equal? (drop L (+ l 1)) (drop old (+ l 1)))
                          (equal? (drop (reverse L) (- n l))
                                  (drop (reverse old) (- n l)))))
                   (pad:lc-line! L l col))
                  (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))
         (dcsv (cond
                 ((null? dirty) "")
                 ((null? (cdr dirty)) (number->string (car dirty)))
                 (#t (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE aura pad (Soft) keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
      " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "") "" (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
      *lc-body*
      "END\n")))

;; M6 key path (whole-page tokenize per text change), kept as the perf
;; "before" reference. Do not mix with pad:play-snap in one session.
(define (pad:play-snap-m6)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)

input.source:
;; aura-pad M6 -- Soft keymap + play state for the thin C viewport.
;; Raw key bytes in, editor commands out. The C side never maps keys.
;; Needs buffer/lines/edit/hl/jump/view/lc. Soft reserved: never bind quote.
;;
;; Key path (M7): pad:play-snap goes through the per-line cache in
;; lc.aura (load it before this file). The M6 whole-page cache
;; (*pl-src* / *pl-tape* / *pl-toks* / *pl-marks*) stays only for
;; pad:play-snap-m6, the perf "before" reference.

;; The viewport pad is roomier than the M3 kid race pad. Soft decides.
(define *play-max-col* 40)
(define *play-max-lines* 12)

(define *play-start* "(define (hello x) (+ x 1))\n(hello 3)")
(define *play-hello*
  "welcome to aura pad - type goal:hi aura to try")

;; Play state (only pad:play-* write it).
(define *pl-st* (pad:es-at (list (list)) 0 0))
(define *pl-stack* (list))
(define *pl-esc* (list))
(define *pl-say* "")
;; wire v2 (soft/pad/wire2.aura, play.aura only): frames carry only the
;; DIRTY rows. Off until C offers it ("WIRE 2" from pad_play --wire2).
(define *w2-on* #f)
(define *pl-keys* 0)
(define *pl-rej* 0)

;; HL / marks cache for the interactive key path (kid-friendly speed).
(define *pl-src* "")
(define *pl-tape* "")
(define *pl-toks* (list))
(define *pl-marks* "")
(define *pl-mname* "")
(define *pl-prev-L* (list))
(define *pl-framed* 0)

(define (pad:play-reset! src)
  (set! *max-col* *play-max-col*)
  (set! *max-lines* *play-max-lines*)
  (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-at (pad:v-lines src) 0 0))
  (set! *pl-stack* (list))
  (set! *pl-esc* (list))
  (set! *pl-say* *play-hello*)
  (set! *pl-keys* 0)
  (set! *pl-rej* 0)
  (set! *pl-src* "")
  (set! *pl-tape* "")
  (set! *pl-toks* (list))
  (set! *pl-marks* "")
  (set! *pl-mname* "")
  (set! *pl-prev-L* (list))
  (set! *pl-framed* 0)
  (pad:lc-reset!)
  0)

;; --- keymap: byte -> command word, char code, "pending" or "unknown" ---
(define *keymap*
  (list (list 1 "home") (list 5 "end") (list 11 "kill-line")
        (list 25 "yank") (list 31 "undo") (list 21 "undo")
        (list 127 "back") (list 8 "back")
        (list 13 "enter") (list 10 "enter")
        (list 0 "set-mark") (list 23 "kill-region") (list 16 "copy-region")
        (list 7 "goto-def") (list 2 "jump-back") (list 18 "find-refs")
        (list 17 "quit")))

(define *arrows*
  (list (list 65 "prev-line") (list 66 "next-line")
        (list 67 "right") (list 68 "left")
        (list 72 "home") (list 70 "end")))

(define (pad:kv-get xs k)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((= (car (car xs)) k) (car (cdr (car xs))))
    (#t (pad:kv-get (cdr xs) k))))

;; Feed one byte through the escape-sequence state. Pure on (esc byte):
;; returns (cmd new-esc).
(define (pad:key-step esc b)
  (cond
    ((and (null? esc) (= b 27)) (list "pending" (list 27)))
    ((and (equal? esc (list 27)) (or (= b 91) (= b 79)))
     (list "pending" (list 27 91)))
    ((equal? esc (list 27 91))
     (let ((w (pad:kv-get *arrows* b)))
       (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))
    ((pair? esc) (list "unknown" (list)))
    ((and (>= b 32) (<= b 126)) (list b (list)))
    (#t (let ((w (pad:kv-get *keymap* b)))
          (list (if w w "unknown") (list))))))

;; --- kid words for play-only outcomes ---
(define (pad:play-say reason)
  (cond
    ((string=? reason "unknown") "that key does nothing yet")
    ((string=? reason "not-print") "that letter is not on the pad yet")
    ((string=? reason "need-space") "this line is full")
    (#t (let ((j (pad:kid-say-jump reason)))
          (if (string=? j "the gate said no") (pad:kid-say reason) j)))))

;; Play gate: the viewport pad types any printable char; words use egate.
(define (pad:play-gate c st)
  (if (number? c)
      (cond
        ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) "not-print")
        ((>= (length (pad:nth (pad:es-L st) (pad:es-l st))) *max-col*)
         "need-space")
        (#t "ok"))
      (pad:egate c st)))

(define (pad:play-src) (pad:v-src (pad:es-L *pl-st*)))
(define (pad:play-point)
  (pad:v-point (pad:es-L *pl-st*) (pad:es-l *pl-st*) (pad:es-col *pl-st*)))

(define (pad:play-move-to! point)
  (let ((lc (pad:v-linecol (pad:es-L *pl-st*) point)))
    (set! *pl-st* (pad:es-move *pl-st* (car lc) (car (cdr lc))))))

(define (pad:play-reject! reason)
  (set! *pl-rej* (+ *pl-rej* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* (pad:play-say reason))
  reason)

(define (pad:play-ok! say)
  (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
  (set! *pl-say* say)
  "ok")

;; One gated editor step (char code or command word): the reference
;; path, gate (pad:play-gate) then apply (pad:eapply).
(define (pad:play-edit! c)
  (let ((reason (pad:play-gate c *pl-st*)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok")
        (begin
          (set! *pl-st* (pad:eapply c *pl-st*))
          (pad:play-ok! *pl-say*))
        (pad:play-reject! reason))))

(define (pad:play-jump! cmd)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (src (pad:play-src))
         (pt (pad:play-point))
         (toks (pad:lc-toks L))
         (name (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
         (j (pad:js src pt *pl-stack*))
         (r (cond ((string=? cmd "goto-def") (pad:goto-def-in j toks))
                  ((string=? cmd "jump-back") (pad:jump-back j))
                  (#t (pad:find-refs-cmd-in j toks)))))
    (if (not (string=? (car r) "ok"))
        (pad:play-reject! (car r))
        (begin
          (set! *pl-stack* (caddr r))
          (pad:play-move-to! (cadr r))
          (pad:play-ok!
           (cond
             ((string=? cmd "goto-def")
              (string-append "jumped to where " name " is born"))
             ((string=? cmd "jump-back") "jumped back")
             (#t (string-append name " is used "
                                (number->string (length (car (cdr (cdr (cdr r))))))
                                " times"))))))))

;; Run one command, the reference dispatch (M6). Returns "ok", "quit",
;; or a reject reason. pad:play-cmd! (below) takes the hot words itself.
(define (pad:play-cmd-ref! c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (pad:play-edit! c))
    ((string=? c "quit") "quit")
    ((string=? c "unknown") (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))
    ((or (string=? c "goto-def") (string=? c "jump-back")
         (string=? c "find-refs"))
     (pad:play-jump! c))
    ((string=? c "enter")
     (let ((r (pad:play-edit! "open-line")))
       (if (string=? r "ok") (pad:play-edit! "right") r)))
    (#t (pad:play-edit! c))))

;; Emacs port: command_loop_1 (Emacs 22 keyboard.c) ran forward-char,
;; backward-char and self-insert-command "directly" -- the primitive on
;; the buffer, no call-interactively -- and everything else the generic
;; way. Same here: a typed char and the cursor/backspace words are gated
;; and applied in this one procedure with builtins (no Soft call per
;; accessor, put-nth step or take/drop), giving the exact state and
;; reason pad:play-cmd-ref! gives (checked by emacs_test.aura).
;; Run one command. Returns "ok", "quit", or a reject reason.
;; State is (L line col kill mark undo); a text edit pushes (L line col)
;; onto undo (at most *undo-max*) and clears the mark; a move keeps both.
(define (pad:play-cmd! c)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         (ln (list-ref L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (n (length L)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (and (>= c 32) (<= c 126))) (pad:play-reject! "not-print"))
         ((>= len *max-col*) (pad:play-reject! "need-space"))
         (#t
          (let* ((ln2 (append (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col))))
                              (cons c (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col)))))
                 (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                             (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
                 (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                 (un (length U)))
            (set! *pl-st*
                  (list L2 l (+ col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                        (cond
                          ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                          ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                          (#t U))))
            (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
            "ok"))))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (and (= l 0) (= col 0))
           (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
           (begin
             (set! *pl-st*
                   (if (> col 0)
                       (list L l (- col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))
                       (list L (- l 1) (length (list-ref L (- l 1)))
                             (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (and (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len))
           (pad:play-reject! "too-far")
           (begin
             (set! *pl-st*
                   (if (< col len)
                       (list L l (+ col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))
                       (list L (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5))))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((or (string=? c "home") (string=? c "end"))
       (set! *pl-st* (list L l (if (string=? c "home") 0 len)
                           (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
       (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
       "ok")
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (if (>= l (- n 1))
           (pad:play-reject! "no-line")
           (let ((nl (length (list-ref L (+ l 1)))))
             (set! *pl-st* (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col)
                                 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (if (= l 0)
           (pad:play-reject! "no-line")
           (let ((pl (length (list-ref L (- l 1)))))
             (set! *pl-st* (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col)
                                 (list-ref st 3) (list-ref st 4) (list-ref st 5)))
             (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
             "ok")))
      ((or (string=? c "open-line") (string=? c "enter"))
       ;; split the line at point (Emacs C-o); "enter" = open-line then
       ;; right, two accepted steps (keys += 2) as in pad:play-cmd-ref!
       (if (>= n *max-lines*)
           (pad:play-reject! "need-space")
           (let* ((pre (if (<= col 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len col)))))
                  (post (if (<= col 0) ln (drop ln col)))
                  (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                              (cons pre (cons post (drop L (+ l 1))))))
                  (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
                  (un (length U))
                  (U2 (cond

                        ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                        (#t U))))
             (if (string=? c "enter")
                 (begin
                   (set! *pl-st* (list L2 (+ l 1) 0 (list-ref st 3) (list) U2))
                   (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 2)))
                 (begin
                   (set! *pl-st* (list L2 l col (list-ref st 3) (list) U2))
                   (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))))
             "ok")))
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= col 0) (> l 0))
       ;; backspace at line start joins onto the previous line
       (let* ((pv (list-ref L (- l 1)))
              (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n (- l 1))))
                          (cons (append pv ln) (drop L (+ l 1)))))
              (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
              (un (length U)))
         (set! *pl-st*
               (list L2 (- l 1) (length pv) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                     (cond
                       ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                       ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                       (#t U))))
         (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
         "ok"))
      ((and (string=? c "back") (> col 0))
       ;; backspace inside a line (delete_and_extract_region of one char);
       ;; col > 0 so neither empty-buf nor too-far can fire
       (let* ((ln2 (append (if (<= (- col 1) 0) (list) (reverse (drop (reverse ln) (- len (- col 1)))))
                           (drop ln col)))
              (L2 (append (reverse (drop (reverse L) (- n l)))
                          (cons ln2 (drop L (+ l 1)))))
              (U (cons (list L l col) (list-ref st 5)))
              (un (length U)))
         (set! *pl-st*
               (list L2 l (- col 1) (list-ref st 3) (list)
                     (cond
                       ((<= *undo-max* 0) (list))
                       ((> un *undo-max*) (reverse (drop (reverse U) (- un *undo-max*))))
                       (#t U))))
         (set! *pl-keys* (+ *pl-keys* 1))
         "ok"))
      (#t (pad:play-cmd-ref! c)))))

;; One protocol line. Returns "pending", "quit", "ok" or a reason.
(define (pad:play-line! line)
  (cond
    ((string=? line "QUIT") "quit")
    ((string-prefix? line "IN ")
     (let ((b (string->number (substring line 3 (string-length line)))))
       (if (not (number? b))
           (pad:play-reject! "unknown")
           (let ((step (pad:key-step *pl-esc* b)))
             (set! *pl-esc* (car (cdr step)))
             (if (and (string? (car step)) (string=? (car step) "pending"))
                 "pending"
                 (pad:play-cmd! (car step)))))))
    ((string-prefix? line "KEY ")
     (pad:play-cmd! (substring line 4 (string-length line))))
    (#t (pad:play-reject! "unknown"))))

;; Which rows differ between two editor line-lists (char-code lists).
(define (pad:play-dirty-rows oldL newL)
  (let loop ((i 0) (a oldL) (b newL) (acc (list)))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) (reverse acc))
      ((null? a)
       (loop (+ i 1) a (cdr b) (cons i acc)))
      ((null? b)
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) b (cons i acc)))
      ((equal? (car a) (car b))
       (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) acc))
      (#t (loop (+ i 1) (cdr a) (cdr b) (cons i acc))))))

;; Refresh HL/marks cache; return dirty row list for SNAP.
;; First frame returns () so Soft omits DIRTY (C does a full blit).
(define (pad:play-cache! L l col)
  (let* ((src (pad:v-src L))
         (pt (pad:v-point L l col))
         (same-text (string=? src *pl-src*))
         (first (= *pl-framed* 0))
         (dirty (if first (list) (pad:play-dirty-rows *pl-prev-L* L))))
    (if same-text
        (let ((name (pad:sym-at-in *pl-toks* pt)))
          (if (string=? name *pl-mname*)
              0
              (begin
                (set! *pl-mname* name)
                (set! *pl-marks*
                      (pad:v-marks-in src pt *pl-toks*)))))
        (let* ((b (pad:hl-bundle src))
               (tape (car b))
               (toks (cadr b)))
          (set! *pl-src* src)
          (set! *pl-tape* tape)
          (set! *pl-toks* toks)
          (set! *pl-mname* (pad:sym-at-in toks pt))
          (set! *pl-marks* (pad:v-marks-in src pt toks))))
    (set! *pl-prev-L* L)
    (set! *pl-framed* 1)
    (if first
        (list)
        (if (pad:v-in? l dirty) dirty (cons l dirty)))))

(define (pad:play-title)
  (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                 (number->string *pl-keys*)
                 " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))

;; M7 key path: line-incremental Soft key path (lc.aura). Only the edited line is
;; re-tokenized; DIRTY lists exactly the rows whose T/H/M changed.
(define (pad:play-snap)
  (let* ((st *pl-st*)
         (L (car st))
         (l (cadr st))
         (col (caddr st))
         ;; try_cursor_movement, inlined: same lines object, cache live,
         ;; and the name under the cursor unchanged -> rows and SNAP body
         ;; stand, only the cursor row is dirty. Else the lc frame ladder.
         (move (and (= *lc-framed* 1) (eq? L *lc-L*)))
         (name (if move
                   (let loop ((ts (list-ref (car (vector-ref *lc-recv* l)) 2)))
                     (if (null? ts)
                         ""
                         (let* ((t (car ts)) (kd (car t)))
                           (if (and (or (string=? kd "S") (string=? kd "K")
                                        (string=? kd "Q") (string=? kd "M"))
                                    (>= col (cadr t)) (< col (caddr t)))
                               (list-ref t 3)
                               (loop (cdr ts))))))
                   ""))
         (same (and move (string=? name *lc-name*)))
         (dirty (cond
                  (same
                   (set! *lc-moves* (+ *lc-moves* 1))
                   (set! *lc-cur* l)
                   (set! *lc-frames* (+ *lc-frames* 1))
                   (list l))
                  ;; pad:lc-frame!'s ladder, inlined (one Soft call less)
                  ((= *lc-framed* 0) (pad:lc-generic! L l col))
                  (move (pad:lc-move-to! L l name))
                  ((let ((n (length L)) (old *lc-L*))
                     (and (= n (length old))
                          (< l n)
                          (equal? (drop L (+ l 1)) (drop old (+ l 1)))
                          (equal? (drop (reverse L) (- n l))
                                  (drop (reverse old) (- n l)))))
                   (pad:lc-line! L l col))
                  (#t (pad:lc-generic! L l col))))
         (dcsv (cond
                 ((null? dirty) "")
                 ((null? (cdr dirty)) (number->string (car dirty)))
                 (#t (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))))
    (cond
      ;; wire v2, one DIRTY row (cursor moves, most edits): inlined; one
      ;; more Soft call (~0.13 ms, aura#4350) costs about what v2 saves
      ((and *w2-on* (not *w2-full*) (< *w2-plus* 0) (pair? dirty) (null? (cdr dirty)))
       (set! *w2-gen* (+ *w2-gen* 1))
       (string-append
         "SNAP v2 pad\nGEN " (number->string *w2-gen*) " base=" (number->string (- *w2-gen* 1))
         "\nTITLE aura pad (Soft) keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
         " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
         "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
         "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
         "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
         "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*))
         " body=" (number->string (string-length *lc-body*))
         "\nR " (number->string (car dirty)) "\n"
         (vector-ref *lc-rowv* (car dirty))
         "END\n"))
      (*w2-on* (pad:w2-frame l col dirty *lc-rowv* *lc-body*))
      (#t
        (string-append
          "SNAP v1 pad\n"
          "TITLE aura pad (Soft) keys=" (number->string *pl-keys*)
          " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*) "\n"
          "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
          "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
          "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
          (if (string=? dcsv "") "" (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
          "ROWS n=" (number->string (vector-length *lc-rowv*)) "\n"
          *lc-body*
          "END\n")))))

;; M6 key path (whole-page tokenize per text change), kept as the perf
;; "before" reference. Do not mix with pad:play-snap in one session.
(define (pad:play-snap-m6)
  (let* ((L (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
         (l (pad:es-l *pl-st*))
         (col (pad:es-col *pl-st*))
         (dirty (pad:play-cache! L l col))
         (title (string-append "aura pad (Soft) keys="
                               (number->string *pl-keys*)
                               " no=" (number->string *pl-rej*)))
         (lines (pad:v-split *pl-src*))
         (dcsv (pad:v-dirty-csv dirty)))
    (string-append
      "SNAP v1 pad\n"
      "TITLE " title "\n"
      "CURSOR line=" (number->string l) " col=" (number->string col) "\n"
      "SAY " *pl-say* "\n"
      "LEGEND " *view-legend* "\n"
      (if (string=? dcsv "")
          ""
          (string-append "DIRTY lines=" dcsv "\n"))
      "ROWS n=" (number->string (length lines)) "\n"
      (pad:v-rows lines *pl-tape* *pl-marks*)
      "END\n")))

(define (pad:play-emit!) (display (pad:play-snap)) 0)
