input.source:
;; aura-pad M11h -- the helper repairs its own idea with intend.
;; The kid has a goal (checks like "hello 3 is 6", M11f). The helper
;; brings one idea and a fixer. Aura's own loop manager runs it:
;;   (intend goal gen verify fix max)
;; gen    -> the helper's first idea, as a string (one "name=(lambda ...)"
;;           per line)
;; verify -> "#t" when the idea passes every check, else a kid sentence
;;           ("passes 1 of 3 checks", or aura's / the gate's reason).
;;           The verifier never evals generated code (aura#4359): the
;;           idea goes into a child world by one typed-mutate-atomic
;;           (pad:world-run1, world.aura), the checks run there, root is
;;           healed after (aura#4368). A refused idea gets why.aura's
;;           sentence (replayed in root, then healed).
;; fix    -> the helper's next idea, given the last idea and that sentence.
;; intend passes its strings in reused slots (aura#4370), so the pad
;; copies them before anything keeps them.
;; intend-history is aura's own timeline ("attempt_1:passes 1 of 3
;; checks", "attempt_2:success"); the pad shows it as "try 1: passes 1 of
;; 3 checks | try 2: ok" and checks it against Soft's own log of the
;; verifier calls (M11_FIX_DISAGREE on a mismatch). A passing idea comes
;; back as one robot KEEP (robot.aura: ctrl-z, who stamps, time step).
;; Notebook face only, at human speed; nothing on play.aura's key path.
;; Loaded after world.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *fx-max* 3)
(define *fx-runs* 0)
(define *fx-kept* 0)
(define *fx-disagree* 0)
(define *fx-log* (list))    ; Soft log of verifier calls, newest first: (ops text score)
(define *fx-last* #f)       ; (tag tries-strip intend-status verdict base best)
(define *fx-ctx* #f)        ; (who goal code0 snap why) while a run is going

;; --- proposal <-> string (intend passes strings) ---
(define (pad:fx-enc ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "")
    ((null? (cdr ops)) (string-append (car (car ops)) "=" (cadr (car ops))))
    (#t (string-append (car (car ops)) "=" (cadr (car ops)) "\n" (pad:fx-enc (cdr ops))))))
(define (pad:fx-dec-line s)
  (let ((k (pad:why-find s "=" 0)))
    (if (<= k 0) #f (list (substring s 0 k) (substring s (+ k 1) (string-length s))))))
(define (pad:fx-dec-all xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string=? (car xs) "") (pad:fx-dec-all (cdr xs)))
    (#t (let ((op (pad:fx-dec-line (car xs))))
          (if op (cons op (pad:fx-dec-all (cdr xs))) (pad:fx-dec-all (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:fx-dec s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:fx-dec-all (string-split s "\n")) (list)))

;; --- the verifier: child world, checks, kid sentence ---
(define (pad:fx-verify code)
  (let* ((who (car *fx-ctx*))
         (goal (cadr *fx-ctx*))
         (code0 (caddr *fx-ctx*))
         (snap (pad:nth *fx-ctx* 3))
         (why (pad:nth *fx-ctx* 4))
         (ops (pad:fx-dec (string-append code "")))
         (n (length goal))
         (t (if (null? ops)
                (list 0 "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
                (pad:world-run1 (+ (length *fx-log*) 1) who why ops goal code0 snap)))
         (st (pad:nth t 1))
         (score (pad:nth t 2))
         (text (cond
                 ((null? ops) "the helper gave no change")
                 ((string=? st "gate") (pad:robot-say (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
                 ((string=? st "refused") (pad:fx-refused-why who ops why snap))
                 ((string=? st "no-world") "aura had no room for a try")
                 ((= score n) "#t")
                 (#t (string-append "passes " (pad:world-n-of score n) " checks")))))
    (set! *fx-log* (cons (list ops text score) *fx-log*))
    text))
;; The fixer's next idea as a string. No idea -> "" (intend logs
;; "empty from fixer" and does not call the verifier; Soft logs it too).
;; intend hands code / err in reused string slots (aura#4370): copy first.
(define (pad:fx-fix fixer code err)
  (let ((ops (fixer (pad:fx-dec (string-append code "")) (string-append err ""))))
    (if (and (pair? ops) (pair? (pad:fx-dec (pad:fx-enc ops))))
        (pad:fx-enc ops)
        (begin
          (set! *fx-log* (cons (list (list) "empty from fixer" -1) *fx-log*))
          ""))))
;; why.aura's sentence for an idea aura refused (replayed in root, healed).
(define (pad:fx-refused-why who ops why snap)
  (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
    (pad:robot-heal! snap)
    (if (and (pair? w) (string? (pad:nth w 3))) (pad:nth w 3) "aura said no")))

;; --- intend-history -> ((i text) ...) for the attempt lines ---
(define (pad:fx-hist-lines s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:fx-hist-parse (string-split s "\n")) (list)))
(define (pad:fx-hist-parse xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let* ((x (car xs))
             (k (pad:why-find x ":attempt_" 0)))
        (if (< k 0)
            (pad:fx-hist-parse (cdr xs))
            (let* ((rest (substring x (+ k 9) (string-length x)))
                   (c (pad:why-find rest ":" 0)))
              (if (< c 0)
                  (pad:fx-hist-parse (cdr xs))
                  (cons (list (string->number (substring rest 0 c))
                              (substring rest (+ c 1) (string-length rest)))
                        (pad:fx-hist-parse (cdr xs)))))))))
;; aura's "success" is the verifier's "#t"
(define (pad:fx-same-log? hs ls)
  (cond
    ((and (null? hs) (null? ls)) #t)
    ((or (null? hs) (null? ls)) #f)
    ((string=? (cadr (car hs)) (if (string=? (cadr (car ls)) "#t") "success" (cadr (car ls))))
     (pad:fx-same-log? (cdr hs) (cdr ls)))
    (#t #f)))
(define (pad:fx-try-word h)
  (string-append "try " (number->string (car h)) ": "
                 (cond
                   ((string=? (cadr h) "success") "ok")
                   ((string-prefix? (cadr h) "empty from ") "the helper had no new idea")
                   (#t (cadr h)))))
(define (pad:fx-strip hs)
  (cond
    ((null? hs) "")
    ((null? (cdr hs)) (pad:fx-try-word (car hs)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:fx-try-word (car hs)) " | " (pad:fx-strip (cdr hs))))))

;; "#(status:\"ok\" ...)" -> "ok" | "failed" | "?"
(define (pad:fx-status r)
  (cond
    ((not (string? r)) "?")
    ((string-contains? r "status:\"ok\"") "ok")
    ((string-contains? r "status:\"failed\"") "failed")
    (#t "?")))

(define (pad:fx-best ls best)
  (cond
    ((null? ls) best)
    ((> (caddr (car ls)) best) (pad:fx-best (cdr ls) (caddr (car ls))))
    (#t (pad:fx-best (cdr ls) best))))

;; One repair run. gen-ops: the helper's first idea (ops); fixer:
;; (lambda (ops kid-sentence) -> next ops, or (list) for none).
;; Returns (tag say verdict) and shows say in the say line.
;; tag: FIXED | GAVEUP | ALREADY.
(define (pad:fx-run! who goal-name goal gen-ops fixer why)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *fx-runs* (+ *fx-runs* 1))
  (let* ((n (length goal))
         (base (pad:world-score goal)))
    (if (= base n)
        (let ((say (string-append "your page already passes all " (number->string n) " checks")))
          (set! *fx-last* (list "ALREADY" "" "none" "agree" base base))
          (set! *pl-say* say)
          (list "ALREADY" say "agree"))
        (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
               (code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "fix")))
          (set! *fx-ctx* (list who goal code0 snap why))
          (set! *fx-log* (list))
          (let* ((r (try (intend goal-name
                                 (lambda (g) (pad:fx-enc gen-ops))
                                 (lambda (code) (pad:fx-verify code))
                                 (lambda (code err g) (pad:fx-fix fixer code err))
                                 *fx-max*)
                         (catch (e) #f)))
                 (status (pad:fx-status r))
                 (hs (pad:fx-hist-lines (try (intend-history) (catch (e) ""))))
                 (log (reverse *fx-log*))
                 (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
                 (log-ok (pad:fx-same-log? hs log))
                 (win (if (and (pair? *fx-log*) (string=? (cadr (car *fx-log*)) "#t")) (car *fx-log*) #f))
                 (status-ok (string=? status (if win "ok" "failed")))
                 (k (if win (pad:robot-step! who (car win) (string-append why " (try "
                                                                         (number->string (length log)) ")"))
                        (list "NONE" "" "")))
                 (keep-ok (or (not win)
                              (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP") (= (pad:world-score goal) n))))
                 (v (if (and same log-ok status-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
                 (best (pad:fx-best log 0))
                 (strip (pad:fx-strip hs))
                 (say (cond
                        ((and win (not (string=? (car k) "KEEP"))) (pad:nth k 2))
                        (win (string-append "the " who " fixed it on try " (number->string (length log))
                                            " (" strip "), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back"))
                        (#t (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length log))
                                           " times and never passed all " (number->string n)
                                           " checks (best " (pad:world-n-of best n)
                                           "), nothing changed")))))
            (set! *fx-ctx* #f)
            (if (and win (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (set! *fx-kept* (+ *fx-kept* 1)) #f)
            (set! *fx-last* (list (if win "FIXED" "GAVEUP") strip status v base best))
            (if (string=? v "disagree")
                (begin
                  (set! *fx-disagree* (+ *fx-disagree* 1))
                  (newline) (display "M11_FIX_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:fx-line *fx-last*))
                  (display " same=") (display (pad:who-bool same))
                  (display " log=") (display (pad:who-bool log-ok))
                  (display " status=") (display (pad:who-bool status-ok))
                  (display " keep=") (display (pad:who-bool keep-ok)) (newline))
                #f)
            (set! *pl-say* say)
            (list (car *fx-last*) say v))))))

;; FIX tag=FIXED status=ok base=1 best=3 verdict=agree tries=try 1: ... | try 2: ok
(define (pad:fx-line x)
  (if (not x)
      "FIX none"
      (string-append "FIX tag=" (car x) " status=" (caddr x)
                     " base=" (number->string (pad:nth x 4)) " best=" (number->string (pad:nth x 5))
                     " verdict=" (pad:nth x 3) " tries=" (cadr x))))

(define (pad:fx-stats-str)
  (string-append "fix_runs=" (number->string *fx-runs*)
                 " fix_kept=" (number->string *fx-kept*)
                 " fix_disagree=" (number->string *fx-disagree*)))

         (why (pad:nth *fx-ctx* 4))
         (ops (pad:fx-dec code))

         (t (if (null? ops)
                (list 0 "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)

                 ((string=? st "no-world") "aura had no room for a try")
                 ((= score n) "#t")
                 (#t (string-append "passes " (pad:world-n-of score n) " checks")))))
    (set! *fx-log* (cons (list ops text score) *fx-log*))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M11h -- the helper repairs its own idea with intend.
;; The kid has a goal (checks like "hello 3 is 6", M11f). The helper
;; brings one idea and a fixer. Aura's own loop manager runs it:
;;   (intend goal gen verify fix max)
;; gen    -> the helper's first idea, as a string (one "name=(lambda ...)"
;;           per line)
;; verify -> "#t" when the idea passes every check, else a kid sentence
;;           ("passes 1 of 3 checks", or aura's / the gate's reason).
;;           The verifier never evals generated code (aura#4359): the
;;           idea goes into a child world by one typed-mutate-atomic
;;           (pad:world-run1, world.aura), the checks run there, root is
;;           healed after (aura#4368). A refused idea gets why.aura's
;;           sentence (replayed in root, then healed).
;; fix    -> the helper's next idea, given the last idea and that sentence.
;; intend passes its strings in reused slots (aura#4370), so the pad
;; copies them before anything keeps them.
;; intend-history is aura's own timeline ("attempt_1:passes 1 of 3
;; checks", "attempt_2:success"); the pad shows it as "try 1: passes 1 of
;; 3 checks | try 2: ok" and checks it against Soft's own log of the
;; verifier calls (M11_FIX_DISAGREE on a mismatch). A passing idea comes
;; back as one robot KEEP (robot.aura: ctrl-z, who stamps, time step).
;; Notebook face only, at human speed; nothing on play.aura's key path.
;; Loaded after world.aura. Soft reserved: never bind quote.

(define *fx-max* 3)
(define *fx-runs* 0)
(define *fx-kept* 0)
(define *fx-disagree* 0)
(define *fx-log* (list))    ; Soft log of verifier calls, newest first: (ops text score)
(define *fx-last* #f)       ; (tag tries-strip intend-status verdict base best)
(define *fx-ctx* #f)        ; (who goal code0 snap why) while a run is going

;; --- proposal <-> string (intend passes strings) ---
(define (pad:fx-enc ops)
  (cond
    ((null? ops) "")
    ((null? (cdr ops)) (string-append (car (car ops)) "=" (cadr (car ops))))
    (#t (string-append (car (car ops)) "=" (cadr (car ops)) "\n" (pad:fx-enc (cdr ops))))))
(define (pad:fx-dec-line s)
  (let ((k (pad:why-find s "=" 0)))
    (if (<= k 0) #f (list (substring s 0 k) (substring s (+ k 1) (string-length s))))))
(define (pad:fx-dec-all xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) (list))
    ((string=? (car xs) "") (pad:fx-dec-all (cdr xs)))
    (#t (let ((op (pad:fx-dec-line (car xs))))
          (if op (cons op (pad:fx-dec-all (cdr xs))) (pad:fx-dec-all (cdr xs)))))))
(define (pad:fx-dec s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:fx-dec-all (string-split s "\n")) (list)))

;; --- the verifier: child world, checks, kid sentence ---
(define (pad:fx-verify code)
  (let* ((who (car *fx-ctx*))
         (goal (cadr *fx-ctx*))
         (code0 (caddr *fx-ctx*))
         (snap (pad:nth *fx-ctx* 3))
         (why (pad:nth *fx-ctx* 4))
         (ops (pad:fx-dec (string-append code "")))
         (n (length goal))
         (t (if (null? ops)
                (list 0 "gate" -1 (list) (list) "" why ops)
                (pad:world-run1 (+ (length *fx-log*) 1) who why ops goal code0 snap)))
         (st (pad:nth t 1))
         (score (pad:nth t 2))
         (text (cond
                 ((null? ops) "the helper gave no change")
                 ((string=? st "gate") (pad:robot-say (pad:robot-gate who ops)))
                 ((string=? st "refused") (pad:fx-refused-why who ops why snap))
                 ((string=? st "no-world") "aura had no room for a try")
                 ((= score n) "#t")
                 (#t (string-append "passes " (pad:world-n-of score n) " checks")))))
    (set! *fx-log* (cons (list ops text score) *fx-log*))
    text))
;; The fixer's next idea as a string. No idea -> "" (intend logs
;; "empty from fixer" and does not call the verifier; Soft logs it too).
;; intend hands code / err in reused string slots (aura#4370): copy first.
(define (pad:fx-fix fixer code err)
  (let ((ops (fixer (pad:fx-dec (string-append code "")) (string-append err ""))))
    (if (and (pair? ops) (pair? (pad:fx-dec (pad:fx-enc ops))))
        (pad:fx-enc ops)
        (begin
          (set! *fx-log* (cons (list (list) "empty from fixer" -1) *fx-log*))
          ""))))
;; why.aura's sentence for an idea aura refused (replayed in root, healed).
(define (pad:fx-refused-why who ops why snap)
  (let ((w (pad:why-probe! who ops why)))
    (pad:robot-heal! snap)
    (if (and (pair? w) (string? (pad:nth w 3))) (pad:nth w 3) "aura said no")))

;; --- intend-history -> ((i text) ...) for the attempt lines ---
(define (pad:fx-hist-lines s)
  (if (string? s) (pad:fx-hist-parse (string-split s "\n")) (list)))
(define (pad:fx-hist-parse xs)
  (if (null? xs)
      (list)
      (let* ((x (car xs))
             (k (pad:why-find x ":attempt_" 0)))
        (if (< k 0)
            (pad:fx-hist-parse (cdr xs))
            (let* ((rest (substring x (+ k 9) (string-length x)))
                   (c (pad:why-find rest ":" 0)))
              (if (< c 0)
                  (pad:fx-hist-parse (cdr xs))
                  (cons (list (string->number (substring rest 0 c))
                              (substring rest (+ c 1) (string-length rest)))
                        (pad:fx-hist-parse (cdr xs)))))))))
;; aura's "success" is the verifier's "#t"
(define (pad:fx-same-log? hs ls)
  (cond
    ((and (null? hs) (null? ls)) #t)
    ((or (null? hs) (null? ls)) #f)
    ((string=? (cadr (car hs)) (if (string=? (cadr (car ls)) "#t") "success" (cadr (car ls))))
     (pad:fx-same-log? (cdr hs) (cdr ls)))
    (#t #f)))
(define (pad:fx-try-word h)
  (string-append "try " (number->string (car h)) ": "
                 (cond
                   ((string=? (cadr h) "success") "ok")
                   ((string-prefix? (cadr h) "empty from ") "the helper had no new idea")
                   (#t (cadr h)))))
(define (pad:fx-strip hs)
  (cond
    ((null? hs) "")
    ((null? (cdr hs)) (pad:fx-try-word (car hs)))
    (#t (string-append (pad:fx-try-word (car hs)) " | " (pad:fx-strip (cdr hs))))))

;; "#(status:\"ok\" ...)" -> "ok" | "failed" | "?"
(define (pad:fx-status r)
  (cond
    ((not (string? r)) "?")
    ((string-contains? r "status:\"ok\"") "ok")
    ((string-contains? r "status:\"failed\"") "failed")
    (#t "?")))

(define (pad:fx-best ls best)
  (cond
    ((null? ls) best)
    ((> (caddr (car ls)) best) (pad:fx-best (cdr ls) (caddr (car ls))))
    (#t (pad:fx-best (cdr ls) best))))

;; One repair run. gen-ops: the helper's first idea (ops); fixer:
;; (lambda (ops kid-sentence) -> next ops, or (list) for none).
;; Returns (tag say verdict) and shows say in the say line.
;; tag: FIXED | GAVEUP | ALREADY.
(define (pad:fx-run! who goal-name goal gen-ops fixer why)
  (if *robot-pending* (pad:robot-drop!) #f)
  (pad:who-sync! "kid" "typed" *who-gen*)
  (set! *fx-runs* (+ *fx-runs* 1))
  (let* ((n (length goal))
         (base (pad:world-score goal)))
    (if (= base n)
        (let ((say (string-append "your page already passes all " (number->string n) " checks")))
          (set! *fx-last* (list "ALREADY" "" "none" "agree" base base))
          (set! *pl-say* say)
          (list "ALREADY" say "agree"))
        (let* ((L0 (pad:es-L *pl-st*))
               (code0 (pad:q-code))
               (snap (ast:snapshot "fix")))
          (set! *fx-ctx* (list who goal code0 snap why))
          (set! *fx-log* (list))
          (let* ((r (try (intend goal-name
                                 (lambda (g) (pad:fx-enc gen-ops))
                                 (lambda (code) (pad:fx-verify code))
                                 (lambda (code err g) (pad:fx-fix fixer code err))
                                 *fx-max*)
                         (catch (e) #f)))
                 (status (pad:fx-status r))
                 (hs (pad:fx-hist-lines (try (intend-history) (catch (e) ""))))
                 (log (reverse *fx-log*))
                 (same (and (eq? (pad:es-L *pl-st*) L0) (string=? (pad:q-code) code0)))
                 (log-ok (pad:fx-same-log? hs log))
                 (win (if (and (pair? *fx-log*) (string=? (cadr (car *fx-log*)) "#t")) (car *fx-log*) #f))
                 (status-ok (string=? status (if win "ok" "failed")))
                 (k (if win (pad:robot-step! who (car win) (string-append why " (try "
                                                                         (number->string (length log)) ")"))
                        (list "NONE" "" "")))
                 (keep-ok (or (not win)
                              (and (string=? (car k) "KEEP") (= (pad:world-score goal) n))))
                 (v (if (and same log-ok status-ok keep-ok) "agree" "disagree"))
                 (best (pad:fx-best log 0))
                 (strip (pad:fx-strip hs))
                 (say (cond
                        ((and win (not (string=? (car k) "KEEP"))) (pad:nth k 2))
                        (win (string-append "the " who " fixed it on try " (number->string (length log))
                                            " (" strip "), kept it. ctrl-z takes it back"))
                        (#t (string-append "the " who " tried " (number->string (length log))
                                           " times and never passed all " (number->string n)
                                           " checks (best " (pad:world-n-of best n)
                                           "), nothing changed")))))
            (set! *fx-ctx* #f)
            (if (and win (string=? (car k) "KEEP")) (set! *fx-kept* (+ *fx-kept* 1)) #f)
            (set! *fx-last* (list (if win "FIXED" "GAVEUP") strip status v base best))
            (if (string=? v "disagree")
                (begin
                  (set! *fx-disagree* (+ *fx-disagree* 1))
                  (newline) (display "M11_FIX_DISAGREE ") (display (pad:fx-line *fx-last*))
                  (display " same=") (display (pad:who-bool same))
                  (display " log=") (display (pad:who-bool log-ok))
                  (display " status=") (display (pad:who-bool status-ok))
                  (display " keep=") (display (pad:who-bool keep-ok)) (newline))
                #f)
            (set! *pl-say* say)
            (list (car *fx-last*) say v))))))

;; FIX tag=FIXED status=ok base=1 best=3 verdict=agree tries=try 1: ... | try 2: ok
(define (pad:fx-line x)
  (if (not x)
      "FIX none"
      (string-append "FIX tag=" (car x) " status=" (caddr x)
                     " base=" (number->string (pad:nth x 4)) " best=" (number->string (pad:nth x 5))
                     " verdict=" (pad:nth x 3) " tries=" (cadr x))))

(define (pad:fx-stats-str)
  (string-append "fix_runs=" (number->string *fx-runs*)
                 " fix_kept=" (number->string *fx-kept*)
                 " fix_disagree=" (number->string *fx-disagree*)))

input.source:
;; aura-pad M3 -- multi-line buffer. Soft owns the lines.
;; *lines* is a list of lines; each line is a list of char codes (the M0
;; FlatAST-friendly shape, one per line). Point is (*line* *col*).
;; Builds on buffer.aura (pad:take / pad:drop / pad:insert / pad:dist /
;; pad:seed-step). M0-M2 do not load this file.
;; Soft reserved: never bind the identifier quote.

(require "std/string" all:)

;; Goal fixture: two lines "hi" / "aura".
(define *goal-lines* (list (list 104 105) (list 97 117 114 97)))
(define *max-lines* 4)
(define *max-col* 12)
(define *noise-len* 3)
;; Plan score = base - keys - 2*rejects - 3*dist.
(define *plan-base* 40)
(define *plan-max* 32)
(define *keys-max* 48)

;; Main-world multi-line state. Only pad:stamp-lines! writes it.
(define *lines* (list (list)))
(define *line* 0)
(define *col* 0)
(define *ln-keys* 0)
(define *ln-rej* 0)
(define *ln-dist* 0)
(define *ln-score* 0)
(define *ln-tag* "none")

(define *line-cmds*
  (list "left" "right" "home" "end" "back"
        "open-line" "kill-line" "next-line" "prev-line"))

;; --- pure list helpers ---
(define (pad:nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0) (car xs) (pad:nth (cdr xs) (- i 1))))

(define (pad:put-nth xs i v)
  (if (= i 0)
      (cons v (cdr xs))
      (cons (car xs) (pad:put-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1) v))))

(define (pad:del-nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0)
      (cdr xs)
      (cons (car xs) (pad:del-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:ins-nth xs i v)
  (append (pad:take i xs) (cons v (pad:drop i xs))))

(define (pad:str-in? s xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((string=? s (car xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:str-in? s (cdr xs)))))

;; Seeded start: one line of noise letters (deterministic, seed 20261005).
(define (pad:start-lines)
  (let loop ((i 0) (r (pad:seed-step *seed*)) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i *noise-len*)
        (list acc)
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (pad:seed-step r)
              (append acc (list (+ 97 (modulo r 26))))))))

;; Line text for TAPE: "hi|aura".
(define (pad:line-text ln)
  (list->string (map integer->char ln)))

(define (pad:lines-text L)
  (string-join (map pad:line-text L) "|"))

;; Distance: per-line M0 distance; a missing or extra line costs len+1.
(define (pad:dist-lines L G)
  (let loop ((a L) (b G) (d 0))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) d)
      ((null? a) (loop a (cdr b) (+ d (+ (length (car b)) 1))))
      ((null? b) (loop (cdr a) b (+ d (+ (length (car a)) 1))))
      (#t (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ d (pad:dist (car a) (car b))))))))

;; --- Soft gate for one command on lines. "ok" or a kid reason. ---
;; A command is a char code (insert) or a command word.
(define (pad:lgate c L l col)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (empty (and (= n 1) (= len 0))))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (or (= c 32) (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122)))) "not-print")
         ((>= len *max-col*) "need-space")
         (#t "ok")))
      ((not (string? c)) "not-a-key")
      ((not (pad:str-in? c *line-cmds*)) "not-a-key")
      ((and (string=? c "left") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "right") (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "next-line") (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "prev-line") (= l 0)) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "back") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") (>= col len) (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "open-line") (>= n *max-lines*)) "need-space")
      (#t "ok"))))

;; --- apply one accepted command. Returns (L line col). ---
;; open-line: split at point, point stays (Emacs C-o).
;; kill-line: kill to end of line; at end of line, pull the next line up.
(define (pad:lapply c L l col)
  (let* ((ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:insert ln col c)) l (+ col 1)))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list L l (- col 1))
           (list L (- l 1) (length (pad:nth L (- l 1))))))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (< col len)
           (list L l (+ col 1))
           (list L (+ l 1) 0)))
      ((string=? c "home") (list L l 0))
      ((string=? c "end") (list L l len))
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (let ((nl (length (pad:nth L (+ l 1)))))
         (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col))))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (let ((pl (length (pad:nth L (- l 1)))))
         (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col))))
      ((string=? c "back")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:delete-back ln col)) l (- col 1))
           (let* ((pv (pad:nth L (- l 1)))
                  (pl (length pv)))
             (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L (- l 1) (append pv ln)) l)
                   (- l 1)
                   pl))))
      ((string=? c "kill-line")
       (if (< col len)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln)) l col)
           (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L l (append ln (pad:nth L (+ l 1))))
                              (+ l 1))
                 l
                 col)))
      ((string=? c "open-line")
       (list (pad:ins-nth (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln))
                          (+ l 1)
                          (pad:drop col ln))
             l
             col))
      (#t (list L l col)))))

;; Named line ops (gate first; a rejected op returns the reason string).
(define (pad:line-op c L l col)
  (let ((reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok") (pad:lapply c L l col) reason)))
(define (pad:open-line L l col) (pad:line-op "open-line" L l col))
(define (pad:kill-line L l col) (pad:line-op "kill-line" L l col))
(define (pad:next-line L l col) (pad:line-op "next-line" L l col))
(define (pad:prev-line L l col) (pad:line-op "prev-line" L l col))

;; --- command plans ---
;; A plan is a list of tokens: a char code, a command word, or "type:<text>"
;; which expands to one insert per char.
(define (pad:type-codes s)
  (map char->integer (string->list s)))

(define (pad:expand plan)
  (cond
    ((null? plan) (list))
    ((and (string? (car plan)) (string-prefix? (car plan) "type:"))
     (append (pad:type-codes (substring (car plan) 5 (string-length (car plan))))
             (pad:expand (cdr plan))))
    (#t (cons (car plan) (pad:expand (cdr plan))))))

;; Plan shape check: "ok", "not-a-plan", "bad-token", "too-long".
(define (pad:plan-check p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
      "not-a-plan"
      (let loop ((xs p) (n 0))
        (cond
          ((null? xs)
           (if (> (length (pad:expand p)) *keys-max*) "too-long" "ok"))
          ((not (pair? xs)) "not-a-plan")
          ((> n *plan-max*) "too-long")
          ((not (or (number? (car xs)) (string? (car xs)))) "bad-token")
          (#t (loop (cdr xs) (+ n 1)))))))

(define (pad:plan-ok? p) (string=? (pad:plan-check p) "ok"))

(define (pad:cmd-str c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (string-append "char-" (number->string c)))
    ((string? c) c)
    (#t "?")))

(define (pad:lreject! step c reason tag)
  (display "REJECT mid=3 reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " cmd=")
  (display (pad:cmd-str c))
  (display " step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  0)

;; Pure play of a plan from the seeded start. Writes no world slot -- fiber-safe.
;; print=1 shows up to 4 REJECT lines (host audit only).
;; Returns (score keys rejects dist lines line col).
(define (pad:lsim plan tag print)
  (let loop ((cs (pad:expand plan))
             (i 0)
             (L (pad:start-lines))
             (l 0)
             (col 0)
             (keys 0)
             (rej 0))
    (if (null? cs)
        (let ((d (pad:dist-lines L *goal-lines*)))
          (list (- *plan-base* (+ keys (* 2 rej) (* 3 d)))
                keys rej d L l col))
        (let* ((c (car cs))
               (reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
          (if (string=? reason "ok")
              (let ((st (pad:lapply c L l col)))
                (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1)
                      (car st) (car (cdr st)) (car (cdr (cdr st)))
                      (+ keys 1) rej))
              (begin
                (if (and (= print 1) (< rej 4))
                    (pad:lreject! (+ i 1) c reason tag))
                (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1) L l col keys (+ rej 1))))))))

(define (pad:l-score s) (car s))
(define (pad:l-keys s) (car (cdr s)))
(define (pad:l-rej s) (car (cdr (cdr s))))
(define (pad:l-dist s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))
(define (pad:l-lines s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))
(define (pad:l-line s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))))
(define (pad:l-col s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))))

(define (pad:score-plan plan)
  (if (pad:plan-ok? plan)
      (pad:l-score (pad:lsim plan "race" 0))
      -999))

(define (pad:ltape! tag)
  (display "TAPE lines=")
  (display (number->string (length *lines*)))
  (display " line=")
  (display (number->string *line*))
  (display " col=")
  (display (number->string *col*))
  (display " text=")
  (display (pad:lines-text *lines*))
  (display " keys=")
  (display (number->string *ln-keys*))
  (display " rejects=")
  (display (number->string *ln-rej*))
  (display " dist=")
  (display (number->string *ln-dist*))
  (display " score=")
  (display (pad:nstr *ln-score*))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  *ln-score*)

;; Stamp a plan into the main multi-line world. The only writer of *lines*.
(define (pad:stamp-lines! plan tag)
  (let ((s (pad:lsim plan tag 0)))
    (set! *ln-tag* tag)
    (set! *lines* (pad:l-lines s))
    (set! *line* (pad:l-line s))
    (set! *col* (pad:l-col s))
    (set! *ln-keys* (pad:l-keys s))
    (set! *ln-rej* (pad:l-rej s))
    (set! *ln-dist* (pad:l-dist s))
    (set! *ln-score* (pad:l-score s))
    (pad:ltape! tag)))

target.name: pad:lreject!
target.body:
(lambda (step c reason tag) (display "REJECT mid=3 reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " cmd=")
  (display (pad:cmd-str c))
  (display " step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (display " say=\"")
  (display (pad:kid-say reason))
  (display "\"")
  (newline)
  0)

input.source:
;; aura-pad M3 -- multi-line buffer. Soft owns the lines.
;; *lines* is a list of lines; each line is a list of char codes (the M0
;; FlatAST-friendly shape, one per line). Point is (*line* *col*).
;; Builds on buffer.aura (pad:take / pad:drop / pad:insert / pad:dist /
;; pad:seed-step). M0-M2 do not load this file.
;; Soft reserved: never bind the identifier quote.

(require "std/string" all:)

;; Goal fixture: two lines "hi" / "aura".
(define *goal-lines* (list (list 104 105) (list 97 117 114 97)))
(define *max-lines* 4)
(define *max-col* 12)
(define *noise-len* 3)
;; Plan score = base - keys - 2*rejects - 3*dist.
(define *plan-base* 40)
(define *plan-max* 32)
(define *keys-max* 48)

;; Main-world multi-line state. Only pad:stamp-lines! writes it.
(define *lines* (list (list)))
(define *line* 0)
(define *col* 0)
(define *ln-keys* 0)
(define *ln-rej* 0)
(define *ln-dist* 0)
(define *ln-score* 0)
(define *ln-tag* "none")

(define *line-cmds*
  (list "left" "right" "home" "end" "back"
        "open-line" "kill-line" "next-line" "prev-line"))

;; --- pure list helpers ---
(define (pad:nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0) (car xs) (pad:nth (cdr xs) (- i 1))))

(define (pad:put-nth xs i v)
  (if (= i 0)
      (cons v (cdr xs))
      (cons (car xs) (pad:put-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1) v))))

(define (pad:del-nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0)
      (cdr xs)
      (cons (car xs) (pad:del-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:ins-nth xs i v)
  (append (pad:take i xs) (cons v (pad:drop i xs))))

(define (pad:str-in? s xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((string=? s (car xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:str-in? s (cdr xs)))))

;; Seeded start: one line of noise letters (deterministic, seed 20261005).
(define (pad:start-lines)
  (let loop ((i 0) (r (pad:seed-step *seed*)) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i *noise-len*)
        (list acc)
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (pad:seed-step r)
              (append acc (list (+ 97 (modulo r 26))))))))

;; Line text for TAPE: "hi|aura".
(define (pad:line-text ln)
  (list->string (map integer->char ln)))

(define (pad:lines-text L)
  (string-join (map pad:line-text L) "|"))

;; Distance: per-line M0 distance; a missing or extra line costs len+1.
(define (pad:dist-lines L G)
  (let loop ((a L) (b G) (d 0))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) d)
      ((null? a) (loop a (cdr b) (+ d (+ (length (car b)) 1))))
      ((null? b) (loop (cdr a) b (+ d (+ (length (car a)) 1))))
      (#t (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ d (pad:dist (car a) (car b))))))))

;; --- Soft gate for one command on lines. "ok" or a kid reason. ---
;; A command is a char code (insert) or a command word.
(define (pad:lgate c L l col)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (empty (and (= n 1) (= len 0))))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (or (= c 32) (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122)))) "not-print")
         ((>= len *max-col*) "need-space")
         (#t "ok")))
      ((not (string? c)) "not-a-key")
      ((not (pad:str-in? c *line-cmds*)) "not-a-key")
      ((and (string=? c "left") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "right") (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "next-line") (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "prev-line") (= l 0)) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "back") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") (>= col len) (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "open-line") (>= n *max-lines*)) "need-space")
      (#t "ok"))))

;; --- apply one accepted command. Returns (L line col). ---
;; open-line: split at point, point stays (Emacs C-o).
;; kill-line: kill to end of line; at end of line, pull the next line up.
(define (pad:lapply c L l col)
  (let* ((ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:insert ln col c)) l (+ col 1)))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list L l (- col 1))
           (list L (- l 1) (length (pad:nth L (- l 1))))))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (< col len)
           (list L l (+ col 1))
           (list L (+ l 1) 0)))
      ((string=? c "home") (list L l 0))
      ((string=? c "end") (list L l len))
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (let ((nl (length (pad:nth L (+ l 1)))))
         (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col))))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (let ((pl (length (pad:nth L (- l 1)))))
         (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col))))
      ((string=? c "back")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:delete-back ln col)) l (- col 1))
           (let* ((pv (pad:nth L (- l 1)))
                  (pl (length pv)))
             (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L (- l 1) (append pv ln)) l)
                   (- l 1)
                   pl))))
      ((string=? c "kill-line")
       (if (< col len)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln)) l col)
           (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L l (append ln (pad:nth L (+ l 1))))
                              (+ l 1))
                 l
                 col)))
      ((string=? c "open-line")
       (list (pad:ins-nth (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln))
                          (+ l 1)
                          (pad:drop col ln))
             l
             col))
      (#t (list L l col)))))

;; Named line ops (gate first; a rejected op returns the reason string).
(define (pad:line-op c L l col)
  (let ((reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok") (pad:lapply c L l col) reason)))
(define (pad:open-line L l col) (pad:line-op "open-line" L l col))
(define (pad:kill-line L l col) (pad:line-op "kill-line" L l col))
(define (pad:next-line L l col) (pad:line-op "next-line" L l col))
(define (pad:prev-line L l col) (pad:line-op "prev-line" L l col))

;; --- command plans ---
;; A plan is a list of tokens: a char code, a command word, or "type:<text>"
;; which expands to one insert per char.
(define (pad:type-codes s)
  (map char->integer (string->list s)))

(define (pad:expand plan)
  (cond
    ((null? plan) (list))
    ((and (string? (car plan)) (string-prefix? (car plan) "type:"))
     (append (pad:type-codes (substring (car plan) 5 (string-length (car plan))))
             (pad:expand (cdr plan))))
    (#t (cons (car plan) (pad:expand (cdr plan))))))

;; Plan shape check: "ok", "not-a-plan", "bad-token", "too-long".
(define (pad:plan-check p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
      "not-a-plan"
      (let loop ((xs p) (n 0))
        (cond
          ((null? xs)
           (if (> (length (pad:expand p)) *keys-max*) "too-long" "ok"))
          ((not (pair? xs)) "not-a-plan")
          ((> n *plan-max*) "too-long")
          ((not (or (number? (car xs)) (string? (car xs)))) "bad-token")
          (#t (loop (cdr xs) (+ n 1)))))))

(define (pad:plan-ok? p) (string=? (pad:plan-check p) "ok"))

(define (pad:cmd-str c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (string-append "char-" (number->string c)))
    ((string? c) c)
    (#t "?")))

(define (pad:lreject! step c reason tag)
  (display "REJECT mid=3 reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " cmd=")
  (display (pad:cmd-str c))
  (display " step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  0)

;; Pure play of a plan from the seeded start. Writes no world slot -- fiber-safe.
;; print=1 shows up to 4 REJECT lines (host audit only).
;; Returns (score keys rejects dist lines line col).
(define (pad:lsim plan tag print)
  (let loop ((cs (pad:expand plan))
             (i 0)
             (L (pad:start-lines))
             (l 0)
             (col 0)
             (keys 0)
             (rej 0))
    (if (null? cs)
        (let ((d (pad:dist-lines L *goal-lines*)))
          (list (- *plan-base* (+ keys (* 2 rej) (* 3 d)))
                keys rej d L l col))
        (let* ((c (car cs))
               (reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
          (if (string=? reason "ok")
              (let ((st (pad:lapply c L l col)))
                (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1)
                      (car st) (car (cdr st)) (car (cdr (cdr st)))
                      (+ keys 1) rej))
              (begin
                (if (and (= print 1) (< rej 4))
                    (pad:lreject! (+ i 1) c reason tag))
                (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1) L l col keys (+ rej 1))))))))

(define (pad:l-score s) (car s))
(define (pad:l-keys s) (car (cdr s)))
(define (pad:l-rej s) (car (cdr (cdr s))))
(define (pad:l-dist s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))
(define (pad:l-lines s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))
(define (pad:l-line s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))))
(define (pad:l-col s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))))

(define (pad:score-plan plan)
  (if (pad:plan-ok? plan)
      (pad:l-score (pad:lsim plan "race" 0))
      -999))

(define (pad:ltape! tag)
  (display "TAPE lines=")
  (display (number->string (length *lines*)))
  (display " line=")
  (display (number->string *line*))
  (display " col=")
  (display (number->string *col*))
  (display " text=")
  (display (pad:lines-text *lines*))
  (display " keys=")
  (display (number->string *ln-keys*))
  (display " rejects=")
  (display (number->string *ln-rej*))
  (display " dist=")
  (display (number->string *ln-dist*))
  (display " score=")
  (display (pad:nstr *ln-score*))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  *ln-score*)

;; Stamp a plan into the main multi-line world. The only writer of *lines*.
(define (pad:stamp-lines! plan tag)
  (let ((s (pad:lsim plan tag 0)))
    (set! *ln-tag* tag)
    (set! *lines* (pad:l-lines s))
    (set! *line* (pad:l-line s))
    (set! *col* (pad:l-col s))
    (set! *ln-keys* (pad:l-keys s))
    (set! *ln-rej* (pad:l-rej s))
    (set! *ln-dist* (pad:l-dist s))
    (set! *ln-score* (pad:l-score s))
    (pad:ltape! tag)))

target.name: pad:ltape!
target.body:
(lambda (tag) (display "TAPE lines=")
  (display (number->string (length *lines*)))
  (display " line=")
  (display (number->string *line*))
  (display " col=")
  (display (number->string *col*))
  (display " text=")
  (display (pad:lines-text *lines*))
  (display " keys=")
  (display (number->string *ln-keys*))
  (display " rejects=")
  (display (number->string *ln-rej*))
  (display " dist=")
  (display (number->string *ln-dist*))
  (display " score=")
  (display (pad:nstr *ln-score*))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  (pad:score-line! *plan-base* *ln-keys* *ln-rej* *ln-dist* *ln-score*)
  *ln-score*)

input.source:
;; aura-pad M3 -- multi-line buffer. Soft owns the lines.
;; *lines* is a list of lines; each line is a list of char codes (the M0
;; FlatAST-friendly shape, one per line). Point is (*line* *col*).
;; Builds on buffer.aura (pad:take / pad:drop / pad:insert / pad:dist /
;; pad:seed-step). M0-M2 do not load this file.
;; Soft reserved: never bind the identifier quote.

(require "std/string" all:)

;; Goal fixture: two lines "hi" / "aura".
(define *goal-lines* (list (list 104 105) (list 97 117 114 97)))
(define *max-lines* 4)
(define *max-col* 12)
(define *noise-len* 3)
;; Plan score = base - keys - 2*rejects - 3*dist.
(define *plan-base* 40)
(define *plan-max* 32)
(define *keys-max* 48)

;; Main-world multi-line state. Only pad:stamp-lines! writes it.
(define *lines* (list (list)))
(define *line* 0)
(define *col* 0)
(define *ln-keys* 0)
(define *ln-rej* 0)
(define *ln-dist* 0)
(define *ln-score* 0)
(define *ln-tag* "none")

(define *line-cmds*
  (list "left" "right" "home" "end" "back"
        "open-line" "kill-line" "next-line" "prev-line"))

;; --- pure list helpers ---
(define (pad:nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0) (car xs) (pad:nth (cdr xs) (- i 1))))

(define (pad:put-nth xs i v)
  (if (= i 0)
      (cons v (cdr xs))
      (cons (car xs) (pad:put-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1) v))))

(define (pad:del-nth xs i)
  (if (= i 0)
      (cdr xs)
      (cons (car xs) (pad:del-nth (cdr xs) (- i 1)))))

(define (pad:ins-nth xs i v)
  (append (pad:take i xs) (cons v (pad:drop i xs))))

(define (pad:str-in? s xs)
  (cond
    ((null? xs) #f)
    ((string=? s (car xs)) #t)
    (#t (pad:str-in? s (cdr xs)))))

;; Seeded start: one line of noise letters (deterministic, seed 20261005).
(define (pad:start-lines)
  (let loop ((i 0) (r (pad:seed-step *seed*)) (acc (list)))
    (if (>= i *noise-len*)
        (list acc)
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (pad:seed-step r)
              (append acc (list (+ 97 (modulo r 26))))))))

;; Line text for TAPE: "hi|aura".
(define (pad:line-text ln)
  (list->string (map integer->char ln)))

(define (pad:lines-text L)
  (string-join (map pad:line-text L) "|"))

;; Distance: per-line M0 distance; a missing or extra line costs len+1.
(define (pad:dist-lines L G)
  (let loop ((a L) (b G) (d 0))
    (cond
      ((and (null? a) (null? b)) d)
      ((null? a) (loop a (cdr b) (+ d (+ (length (car b)) 1))))
      ((null? b) (loop (cdr a) b (+ d (+ (length (car a)) 1))))
      (#t (loop (cdr a) (cdr b) (+ d (pad:dist (car a) (car b))))))))

;; --- Soft gate for one command on lines. "ok" or a kid reason. ---
;; A command is a char code (insert) or a command word.
(define (pad:lgate c L l col)
  (let* ((n (length L))
         (ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln))
         (empty (and (= n 1) (= len 0))))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (cond
         ((not (or (= c 32) (and (>= c 97) (<= c 122)))) "not-print")
         ((>= len *max-col*) "need-space")
         (#t "ok")))
      ((not (string? c)) "not-a-key")
      ((not (pad:str-in? c *line-cmds*)) "not-a-key")
      ((and (string=? c "left") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "right") (= l (- n 1)) (>= col len)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "next-line") (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "prev-line") (= l 0)) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "back") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "back") (= l 0) (= col 0)) "too-far")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") empty) "empty-buf")
      ((and (string=? c "kill-line") (>= col len) (>= l (- n 1))) "no-line")
      ((and (string=? c "open-line") (>= n *max-lines*)) "need-space")
      (#t "ok"))))

;; --- apply one accepted command. Returns (L line col). ---
;; open-line: split at point, point stays (Emacs C-o).
;; kill-line: kill to end of line; at end of line, pull the next line up.
(define (pad:lapply c L l col)
  (let* ((ln (pad:nth L l))
         (len (length ln)))
    (cond
      ((number? c)
       (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:insert ln col c)) l (+ col 1)))
      ((string=? c "left")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list L l (- col 1))
           (list L (- l 1) (length (pad:nth L (- l 1))))))
      ((string=? c "right")
       (if (< col len)
           (list L l (+ col 1))
           (list L (+ l 1) 0)))
      ((string=? c "home") (list L l 0))
      ((string=? c "end") (list L l len))
      ((string=? c "next-line")
       (let ((nl (length (pad:nth L (+ l 1)))))
         (list L (+ l 1) (if (> col nl) nl col))))
      ((string=? c "prev-line")
       (let ((pl (length (pad:nth L (- l 1)))))
         (list L (- l 1) (if (> col pl) pl col))))
      ((string=? c "back")
       (if (> col 0)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:delete-back ln col)) l (- col 1))
           (let* ((pv (pad:nth L (- l 1)))
                  (pl (length pv)))
             (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L (- l 1) (append pv ln)) l)
                   (- l 1)
                   pl))))
      ((string=? c "kill-line")
       (if (< col len)
           (list (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln)) l col)
           (list (pad:del-nth (pad:put-nth L l (append ln (pad:nth L (+ l 1))))
                              (+ l 1))
                 l
                 col)))
      ((string=? c "open-line")
       (list (pad:ins-nth (pad:put-nth L l (pad:take col ln))
                          (+ l 1)
                          (pad:drop col ln))
             l
             col))
      (#t (list L l col)))))

;; Named line ops (gate first; a rejected op returns the reason string).
(define (pad:line-op c L l col)
  (let ((reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
    (if (string=? reason "ok") (pad:lapply c L l col) reason)))
(define (pad:open-line L l col) (pad:line-op "open-line" L l col))
(define (pad:kill-line L l col) (pad:line-op "kill-line" L l col))
(define (pad:next-line L l col) (pad:line-op "next-line" L l col))
(define (pad:prev-line L l col) (pad:line-op "prev-line" L l col))

;; --- command plans ---
;; A plan is a list of tokens: a char code, a command word, or "type:<text>"
;; which expands to one insert per char.
(define (pad:type-codes s)
  (map char->integer (string->list s)))

(define (pad:expand plan)
  (cond
    ((null? plan) (list))
    ((and (string? (car plan)) (string-prefix? (car plan) "type:"))
     (append (pad:type-codes (substring (car plan) 5 (string-length (car plan))))
             (pad:expand (cdr plan))))
    (#t (cons (car plan) (pad:expand (cdr plan))))))

;; Plan shape check: "ok", "not-a-plan", "bad-token", "too-long".
(define (pad:plan-check p)
  (if (not (pair? p))
      "not-a-plan"
      (let loop ((xs p) (n 0))
        (cond
          ((null? xs)
           (if (> (length (pad:expand p)) *keys-max*) "too-long" "ok"))
          ((not (pair? xs)) "not-a-plan")
          ((> n *plan-max*) "too-long")
          ((not (or (number? (car xs)) (string? (car xs)))) "bad-token")
          (#t (loop (cdr xs) (+ n 1)))))))

(define (pad:plan-ok? p) (string=? (pad:plan-check p) "ok"))

(define (pad:cmd-str c)
  (cond
    ((number? c) (string-append "char-" (number->string c)))
    ((string? c) c)
    (#t "?")))

;; Kid words for every gate reason (M3 + M3.5). Shown as say="..".
(define *kid-says*
  (list (list "too-far" "cannot move past the edge")
        (list "no-line" "there is no line there")
        (list "empty-buf" "the page is empty")
        (list "need-space" "no more room")
        (list "not-print" "that key is not a letter")
        (list "not-a-key" "that is not a command")
        (list "nothing-to-undo" "nothing to take back yet")
        (list "nothing-to-yank" "nothing cut yet to paste")
        (list "already-there" "you are already there")
        (list "no-mark" "set a mark first")
        (list "empty-region" "mark and cursor are on the same spot")
        (list "no-indent" "no spaces to remove")))

(define (pad:kid-say reason)
  (let loop ((xs *kid-says*))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) "the gate said no")
      ((string=? reason (car (car xs))) (car (cdr (car xs))))
      (#t (loop (cdr xs))))))

;; SCORE line: where the points went, in kid words.
(define (pad:score-line! base keys rej dist score)
  (display "SCORE total=")
  (display (pad:nstr score))
  (display " start=")
  (display (number->string base))
  (display " keys=-")
  (display (number->string keys))
  (display " rejects=-")
  (display (number->string (* 2 rej)))
  (display " dist=-")
  (display (number->string (* 3 dist)))
  (display " say=\"")
  (display (number->string keys))
  (display " keys, ")
  (display (number->string rej))
  (display " oops, ")
  (display (number->string dist))
  (display " letters off\"")
  (newline)
  score)

(define (pad:lreject! step c reason tag)
  (display "REJECT mid=3 reason=")
  (display reason)
  (display " cmd=")
  (display (pad:cmd-str c))
  (display " step=")
  (display (number->string step))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (display " say=\"")
  (display (pad:kid-say reason))
  (display "\"")
  (newline)
  0)

;; Pure play of a plan from the seeded start. Writes no world slot -- fiber-safe.
;; print=1 shows up to 4 REJECT lines (host audit only).
;; Returns (score keys rejects dist lines line col).
(define (pad:lsim plan tag print)
  (let loop ((cs (pad:expand plan))
             (i 0)
             (L (pad:start-lines))
             (l 0)
             (col 0)
             (keys 0)
             (rej 0))
    (if (null? cs)
        (let ((d (pad:dist-lines L *goal-lines*)))
          (list (- *plan-base* (+ keys (* 2 rej) (* 3 d)))
                keys rej d L l col))
        (let* ((c (car cs))
               (reason (pad:lgate c L l col)))
          (if (string=? reason "ok")
              (let ((st (pad:lapply c L l col)))
                (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1)
                      (car st) (car (cdr st)) (car (cdr (cdr st)))
                      (+ keys 1) rej))
              (begin
                (if (and (= print 1) (< rej 4))
                    (pad:lreject! (+ i 1) c reason tag))
                (loop (cdr cs) (+ i 1) L l col keys (+ rej 1))))))))

(define (pad:l-score s) (car s))
(define (pad:l-keys s) (car (cdr s)))
(define (pad:l-rej s) (car (cdr (cdr s))))
(define (pad:l-dist s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))
(define (pad:l-lines s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))
(define (pad:l-line s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s)))))))
(define (pad:l-col s) (car (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr (cdr s))))))))

(define (pad:score-plan plan)
  (if (pad:plan-ok? plan)
      (pad:l-score (pad:lsim plan "race" 0))
      -999))

(define (pad:ltape! tag)
  (display "TAPE lines=")
  (display (number->string (length *lines*)))
  (display " line=")
  (display (number->string *line*))
  (display " col=")
  (display (number->string *col*))
  (display " text=")
  (display (pad:lines-text *lines*))
  (display " keys=")
  (display (number->string *ln-keys*))
  (display " rejects=")
  (display (number->string *ln-rej*))
  (display " dist=")
  (display (number->string *ln-dist*))
  (display " score=")
  (display (pad:nstr *ln-score*))
  (display " slot=")
  (display tag)
  (newline)
  (pad:score-line! *plan-base* *ln-keys* *ln-rej* *ln-dist* *ln-score*)
  *ln-score*)

;; Stamp a plan into the main multi-line world. The only writer of *lines*.
(define (pad:stamp-lines! plan tag)
  (let ((s (pad:lsim plan tag 0)))
    (set! *ln-tag* tag)
    (set! *lines* (pad:l-lines s))
    (set! *line* (pad:l-line s))
    (set! *col* (pad:l-col s))
    (set! *ln-keys* (pad:l-keys s))
    (set! *ln-rej* (pad:l-rej s))
    (set! *ln-dist* (pad:l-dist s))
    (set! *ln-score* (pad:l-score s))
    (pad:ltape! tag)))

; aura-typeplay — scene evolve (Soft product brain)
; Typing signals primary; Soft query:* gate modulates energy / calm bias.
; MiniMax propose stays host-side (optional); Soft/host select — no gold fixes.
; AURA_BIN=/workspace/aura-grok/build/aura
(export
  typeplay-pick-scene
  typeplay-write-scene
  run-typeplay-evolve)

(require "typeplay_session" all:)
(require "typeplay_observe" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)

(define (typeplay-scene-meta id)
  (cond
    ((equal? id "party")
     (hash "id" "party" "title" "Streak Party!" "hue" "yellow" "energy" 0.95))
    ((equal? id "focus")
     (hash "id" "focus" "title" "Focus Cave" "hue" "white" "energy" 0.2))
    ((equal? id "ocean")
     (hash "id" "ocean" "title" "Calm Ocean" "hue" "blue" "energy" 0.35))
    ((equal? id "space")
     (hash "id" "space" "title" "Star Garden" "hue" "magenta" "energy" 0.7))
    ((equal? id "meadow")
     (hash "id" "meadow" "title" "Sunny Meadow" "hue" "green" "energy" 0.4))
    (#t (hash "id" "forest" "title" "Quiet Forest" "hue" "green" "energy" 0.3))))

(define (typeplay-pick-scene bundle)
  (let* ((sig (hash-ref bundle "signals" (hash)))
         (gate-h (hash-ref bundle "gate" (hash)))
         (gate (hash-ref gate-h "gate" "green"))
         (storm (hash-ref gate-h "storm_red" #f))
         (acc (hash-ref sig "accuracy" 1.0))
         (wpm (hash-ref sig "wpm" 0.0))
         (streak (hash-ref sig "streak" 0))
         (rhythm (hash-ref sig "rhythm_cv" 0.0))
         ; Soft storm → calm bias (Soft observe ≠ Hard). Typing still primary.
         (id (cond
               (storm "focus")
               ((>= streak 20) "party")
               ((< acc 0.7) "focus")
               ((and (> rhythm 0.8) (>= acc 0.85)) "ocean")
               ((and (>= wpm 25) (>= acc 0.9)) "space")
               ((and (>= acc 0.95) (>= streak 10)) "meadow")
               ((equal? gate "amber") "ocean")
               (#t "forest")))
         (meta (typeplay-scene-meta id))
         (base-e (hash-ref meta "energy" 0.5))
         (energy (cond
                   ((equal? gate "red") (* base-e 0.5))
                   ((equal? gate "amber") (* base-e 0.8))
                   (#t base-e))))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref meta "id")
          "title" (hash-ref meta "title")
          "hue" (hash-ref meta "hue")
          "energy" energy
          "source" "soft"
          "gate" gate
          "storm_red" storm
          "reasons" (hash-ref gate-h "reasons" (list))
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "accuracy" acc
          "wpm" wpm
          "streak" streak
          "rhythm_cv" rhythm
          "kernel" "aura")))

(define (typeplay-write-scene scene)
  (let ((p (typeplay-scene-path)))
    (write-file p (json-encode scene))
    scene))

(define (run-typeplay-evolve)
  (let* ((bundle (typeplay-observe-bundle))
         (scene (typeplay-pick-scene bundle))
         (_ (typeplay-write-scene scene)))
    (display "TYPEPLAY_EVOLVE ok=true id=")
    (display (hash-ref scene "id"))
    (display " gate=")
    (display (hash-ref scene "gate"))
    (display " soft_observe_ne_hard=true")
    (newline)
    scene))
