; aura-build kernel — scout → mutate → eval → select-best
; Primary product path. Simulated = pure Aura fitness; aura = in-process mutate:rebind.
; Slice 3: fiber_live ⇒ worldline_backend=fiber_graph (fiber:spawn fan-out); else file.
(export run-episode run-harness-canary select-best run-backend-episode)

(require "util" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "worldline" all:)
(require "harness" all:)
(require "prove" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "l2" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define (select-best worldlines)
  (if (null? worldlines)
    (error "no worldlines to select")
    (let loop ((xs (cdr worldlines)) (best (car worldlines)))
      (if (null? xs) best
        (let* ((w (car xs))
               (wf (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness"))
               (bf (hash-ref (hash-ref best "eval") "fitness"))
               (wid (hash-ref w "id"))
               (bid (hash-ref best "id")))
          (if (or (> wf bf) (and (= wf bf) (string>? wid bid)))
            (loop (cdr xs) w)
            (loop (cdr xs) best)))))))

(define (sim-mutate prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n) (reverse out)
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (cons (hash "id" (string-append "wl-" (number->string i))
                        "parent_id" #f
                        "mutations" (list
                          (hash "op" "simulated_edit"
                                "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                                "summary" (string-append "candidate " (number->string i)
                                                         " for: " (substring prompt 0 (min 80 (string-length prompt)))))))
                  out)))))

(define (sim-eval wl prompt seed index)
  (let* ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed index))
         (passed (>= fitness 0.3)))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref wl "id")
          "parent_id" (hash-ref wl "parent_id" #f)
          "mutations" (hash-ref wl "mutations")
          "stable_ref" (hash-ref wl "stable_ref" #f)
          "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                       "passed" passed
                       "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                       "tests_total" 1
                                       "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* index 3))
                                       "audit_ok" #t
                                       "incr_proven" #f)
                       "notes" "aura-kernel simulated eval"))))

(define (aura-eval wl prompt seed index)
  (let* ((mutations (hash-ref wl "mutations" (list)))
         (bump (if (null? mutations) (+ index 1)
                 (hash-ref (car mutations) "bump" (+ index 1)))))
    (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
    (eval-current)
    (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
    (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
    (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
    (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                   (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                   (string-append "orch-wl-" (number->string index)))
    (eval-current)
    (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
    (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
    (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
    (define val (m1-cand 40))
    (define expected (+ 40 bump))
    (define ok (= val expected))
    (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0)))
    (define fitness (if (and ok (= val expected))
                      (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo index 4))))
                      (if ok 0.45 0.1)))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref wl "id")
          "parent_id" (hash-ref wl "parent_id" #f)
          "mutations" mutations
          "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                       "passed" ok
                       "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                       "tests_total" 1
                                       "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                       "audit_ok" ok
                                       "aura_value" val
                                       "incr_valid" incr
                                       "incr_proven" #f)
                       "notes" (if incr "aura-kernel mutate+eval; AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID"
                                     "aura-kernel mutate+eval-current")))))

(define (aura-mutate prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n) (reverse out)
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cons (hash "id" (string-append "wl-" (number->string i))
                          "parent_id" #f
                          "mutations" (list
                            (hash "op" "aura_mutate_rebind"
                                  "target_id" (string-append "m1-cand:" (number->string i))
                                  "summary" (string-append "mutate:rebind bump=" (number->string bump))
                                  "bump" bump)))
                    out))))))

(define (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected reason runtime-extra harness-block discarded attach-root attach?)
  (let* ((ts0 (iso-now))
         (runtime (hash "mode" mode
                        "requested_mode" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_REQUESTED_MODE" mode)
                        "aura_ref" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_AURA_REF" #f)
                        "seed" seed
                        "incr_proven" #f
                        "kernel" "aura"))
         (_ (if (hash? runtime-extra)
              (hash-for-each runtime-extra (lambda (k v) (hash-set! runtime k v)))
              #t))
         (fields (if attach? (attach-prove-metadata attach-root) #f))
         (_2 (if fields (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields) #t))
         (wls (map (lambda (w)
                     (let ((e (hash "id" (hash-ref w "id")
                                    "parent_id" (hash-ref w "parent_id" #f)
                                    "mutations" (hash-ref w "mutations")
                                    "eval" (hash-ref w "eval"))))
                       (if (hash-ref w "stable_ref" #f)
                         (begin (hash-set! e "stable_ref" (hash-ref w "stable_ref")) e)
                         e)))
                   evaluated)))
    (hash "schema_version" "trajectory.v0"
          "episode_id" (make-id)
          "ts_start" ts0
          "ts_end" (iso-now)
          "prompt" prompt
          "runtime" runtime
          "harness" harness-block
          "worldlines" wls
          "selected_id" (hash-ref selected "id")
          "selection_reason" reason
          "discarded" (if discarded discarded (list))
          "privacy" (hash "redacted" #f "retention_class" "dogfood"))))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (car xs)
      (cons (car xs) (filter-truth (cdr xs)))
      (filter-truth (cdr xs)))))

(define (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id attach?)
  (let* ((decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
         (use-fiber (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER))
         (audit (join-path harness-root (string-append "wl-fiber-" (make-id))))
         (fan (if use-fiber
                (if (equal? mode "aura")
                  (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit)
                  (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit))
                #f))
         (evaluated
           (if use-fiber
             (hash-ref fan "worldlines")
             (let* ((raw (if (equal? mode "aura")
                           (aura-mutate prompt seed n)
                           (sim-mutate prompt seed n))))
               (let loop ((i 0) (xs raw) (out (list)))
                 (if (null? xs) (reverse out)
                   (let ((got (if (equal? mode "aura")
                                (aura-eval (car xs) prompt seed i)
                                (sim-eval (car xs) prompt seed i))))
                     (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons got out))))))))
         (selected (select-best evaluated))
         (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                    (for-each (lambda (w)
                                (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                           (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                              evaluated)
                    h))
         (ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated))
         (discarded
           (if use-fiber
             (let ((d (fiber-discard-losers (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map ids)))
               (if (and audit (not (equal? audit "")))
                 (fiber-audit-write audit n BACKEND_FIBER
                                    (hash-ref decision "session_model")
                                    #t ids d)
                 #t)
               d)
             (list)))
         (rt-extra
           (if use-fiber
             (fiber-runtime-fields audit n #t
                                   (hash-ref decision "session_model") ids)
             (hash "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                   "fiber_live" #f
                   "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)))
         (_ (hash-set! rt-extra "worldline_backend_reason"
                       (hash-ref decision "reason" "")))
         (harness-block (hash "l1_strategy_id" l1
                              "l2_weights_id" l2-id
                              "l3_online" #f))
         (l2ref (if (and l2-id (not (equal? l2-id "")))
                  (l2-resolve harness-root l2-id)
                  #f))
         (_2 (if (and l2ref (hash-ref l2ref "artifact_present" #f))
               (hash-set! harness-block "l2_ref" l2ref)
               #t))
         (ep (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected "max_fitness"
                            rt-extra harness-block discarded harness-root attach?))
         (rt (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    ; Episode truth: backend actually used + live probe (prove attach cannot invent fiber_graph)
    (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend" backend)
    (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (hash-set! rt "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (hash-set! rt "session_model" (hash-ref decision "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
    (hash "episode" ep "selected" selected
          "worldline_backend" backend)))

(define (run-aura-repo-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id workspace attach?)
  (let* ((decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
         (use-fiber (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER))
         (ws-root (if (or (null? workspace) (equal? workspace ""))
                    (join-path harness-root (string-append "ws-" (make-id)))
                    workspace))
         (pack
           (if use-fiber
             (let* ((fan (if (equal? mode "aura")
                           (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n ws-root)
                           (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n ws-root)))
                    (evaluated (hash-ref fan "worldlines"))
                    (selected (select-best evaluated))
                    (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                               (for-each (lambda (w)
                                           (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                                      (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                                         evaluated)
                               h))
                    (ids (hash-ref fan "ids"))
                    (discarded (fiber-discard-losers (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map ids))
                    (_ (fiber-audit-write ws-root n BACKEND_FIBER
                                          (hash-ref decision "session_model")
                                          #t ids discarded))
                    (rt (fiber-runtime-fields ws-root n #t
                                              (hash-ref decision "session_model") ids)))
               (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
               (hash "evaluated" evaluated "selected" selected
                     "discarded" discarded "rt" rt))
             (let* ((ws (workspace-create ws-root n))
                    (cids (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates")))
                    (evaluated
                      (let loop ((i 0) (xs cids) (out (list)))
                        (if (null? xs) (reverse out)
                          (let* ((cid (car xs))
                                 (mut (workspace-fork-note ws cid
                                        (string-append "aura-repo candidate " (number->string i)
                                                       " for: " (substring prompt 0 (min 80 (string-length prompt))))))
                                 (got (sim-eval (hash "id" cid
                                                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                                                      "mutations" (list mut)
                                                      "stable_ref" cid)
                                                prompt seed i)))
                            (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons got out))))))
                    (selected (select-best evaluated))
                    (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                               (for-each (lambda (w)
                                           (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                                      (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                                         evaluated)
                               h))
                    (discarded (filter-truth (workspace-discard-losers ws (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map)))
                    (rt (workspace-runtime-fields ws)))
               (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
               (hash "evaluated" evaluated "selected" selected
                     "discarded" discarded "rt" rt))))
         (evaluated (hash-ref pack "evaluated"))
         (selected (hash-ref pack "selected"))
         (discarded (hash-ref pack "discarded"))
         (rt (hash-ref pack "rt"))
         (harness-block (hash "l1_strategy_id" l1
                              "l2_weights_id" l2-id
                              "l3_online" #f))
         (ep (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected "max_fitness"
                            rt harness-block discarded harness-root attach?))
         (rtrun (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    (hash-set! rtrun "worldline_backend" backend)
    (hash-set! rtrun "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (hash-set! rtrun "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (hash-set! rtrun "session_model" (hash-ref decision "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
    (hash-set! rtrun "profile"
               (hash "id" "aura-repo"
                     "fitness_source" (if (equal? mode "aura") "aura" "simulated")
                     "incr_claimed" #t
                     "incr_proven" #f
                     "worldline_backend" backend))
    (hash "episode" ep "selected" selected
          "worldline_backend" backend)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (run-episode)
  (let* ((prompt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "aura-kernel demo"))
         (mode-req (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MODE" "simulated"))
         (mode (if (equal? mode-req "auto") "simulated" mode-req))
         ; auto→simulated when we can't probe another binary; in-kernel aura mode uses this process
         (mode (if (equal? mode-req "aura") "aura"
                 (if (equal? mode-req "auto")
                   (if (equal? (env-get "AURA_BIN" "") "") "simulated" "aura")
                   mode-req)))
         (seed-opt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SEED" ""))
         (seed (seed-from-prompt prompt
                 (if (equal? seed-opt "") #f (string->number seed-opt))))
         (n (env-int "AURA_BUILD_WORLDLINES" 3))
         (harness-root (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (out (env-get "AURA_BUILD_OUT" "trajectories/episodes.jsonl"))
         (profile (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROFILE" ""))
         (workspace (env-get "AURA_BUILD_WORKSPACE" ""))
         (l1 (env-get "AURA_BUILD_L1" "m3.harness.select_best"))
         (l2-id (env-get "AURA_BUILD_L2" ""))
         (attach? (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_ATTACH_PROVE" #t))
         (mem-profile (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MEMORY_PROFILE" ""))
         (result (if (equal? profile "aura-repo")
                   (run-aura-repo-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id workspace attach?)
                   (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1
                     (if (equal? l2-id "") #f l2-id) attach?)))
         (ep (hash-ref result "episode"))
         (sel (hash-ref result "selected")))
    (if (not (equal? mem-profile ""))
      (begin
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_selected_id" (hash-ref sel "id"))
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_prompt" (substring prompt 0 (min 200 (string-length prompt))))
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_fitness" (hash-ref (hash-ref sel "eval") "fitness"))
        (hash-set! ep "memory" (hash "profile_id" mem-profile
                                     "updated_keys" (list "last_selected_id" "last_prompt" "last_fitness"))))
      #t)
    (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
      (hash-set! ep "_wrote" path)
      (hash "ok" #t "episode" ep "path" path "selected" sel))))

(define (run-harness-canary)
  ; L1: prefer std/hot-strategy (register/swap/heal + last-good). harness.json = durable mirror.
  ; AUTOPROMOTE still default OFF. Honesty: never invent fiber_live / incr_proven.
  (let* ((prompt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "harness canary"))
         (harness-root (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (out (env-get "AURA_BUILD_OUT" "trajectories/episodes.jsonl"))
         (seed-opt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SEED" ""))
         (seed (seed-from-prompt prompt
                 (if (equal? seed-opt "") #f (string->number seed-opt))))
         (patches-json (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_PATCHES" "{}"))
         (fw-json (env-get "AURA_BUILD_FITNESS_PATCHES" "{}"))
         (patches (json-parse patches-json))
         (fw (json-parse fw-json))
         (auto-flag (env-get "AURA_BUILD_AUTOPROMOTE_FLAG" ""))
         (auto (if (equal? auto-flag "1") #t (if (equal? auto-flag "0") #f 'unset)))
         (base (load-harness harness-root))
         (proposal (propose-mutate base patches fw))
         (pre (validate-harness (hash-ref proposal "proposed")))
         (backend (l1-backend-prefer))
         (use-hot (equal? backend "hot-strategy")))
    ; Seed last-good from durable harness.json when using hot-strategy.
    (if use-hot (l1-seed! base) #f)
    (if (not (null? pre))
      (let* ((decision (decide-canary proposal #f auto harness-root))
             (_ (if use-hot (l1-heal!) #f))
             (_ (write-l1-backend-marker harness-root backend
                    (hash-ref proposal "mid") (hash-ref decision "outcome")))
             (ep (harness-change-episode prompt proposal #f decision seed harness-root
                                         #f 0.0 backend)))
        (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
          (hash "ok" #t "accepted" #f "episode" ep "path" path
                "outcome" (hash-ref decision "outcome")
                "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                "l1_backend" backend)))
      (let* ((n (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "worldline_count"))
             (mode (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "routing" "simulated"))
             (mode (if (equal? mode "aura") "aura" "simulated"))
             (base-n (hash-ref base "worldline_count"))
             (base-mode (hash-ref base "routing" "simulated"))
             (base-mode (if (equal? base-mode "aura") "aura" "simulated"))
             ; Live L1 swap of proposed strategy body (canary), when hot-strategy.
             (_swap (if use-hot
                       (l1-swap! (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1-canary")
                       #f))
             (baseline (run-backend-episode prompt seed base-n base-mode harness-root
                          (hash-ref base "l1_strategy_id")
                          (hash-ref base "l2_weights_id" #f) #t))
             (canary (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root
                          (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1_strategy_id")
                          (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l2_weights_id" #f) #t))
             (bf (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref baseline "selected") "eval") "fitness"))
             (cf (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref canary "selected") "eval") "fitness"))
             (passed (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref canary "selected") "eval") "passed"))
             (accepted (and passed (>= cf (* bf 0.5))))
             (decision (decide-canary proposal accepted auto harness-root))
             (outcome (hash-ref decision "outcome"))
             ; heal! on canary fail OR discard (AUTOPROMOTE off). Keep swap only on commit.
             (_heal (if (and use-hot (not (equal? outcome "commit")))
                       (l1-heal!)
                       #f))
             (_mark (write-l1-backend-marker harness-root backend
                       (hash-ref proposal "mid") outcome))
             (ep (harness-change-episode prompt proposal accepted decision seed harness-root
                                         (hash-ref canary "episode") cf backend)))
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_harness_mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid"))
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_harness_outcome" outcome)
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_l1_backend" backend)
        (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
          (hash "ok" #t "accepted" accepted "episode" ep "path" path
                "outcome" outcome
                "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                "l1_backend" backend))))))

(define (harness-change-episode prompt proposal accepted decision seed root nested cf l1-backend)
  (let* ((ts (iso-now))
         (use-nested (and nested (hash? nested) (hash-ref nested "worldlines" #f)))
         (worldlines (if use-nested (hash-ref nested "worldlines")
                       (list (hash "id" "wl-harness-0"
                                   "parent_id" #f
                                   "mutations" (list
                                     (hash "op" "harness_mutate"
                                           "target_id" "harness:default"
                                           "summary" (string-append "canary mid=" (hash-ref proposal "mid"))
                                           "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")))
                                   "eval" (hash "fitness" cf
                                                "passed" accepted
                                                "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if accepted 1 0)
                                                                "tests_total" 1
                                                                "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                                "compile_ms" 0
                                                                "audit_ok" #t
                                                                "incr_claimed" #f
                                                                "incr_proven" #f)
                                                "notes" (string-append "harness canary " (hash-ref decision "outcome")))))))
         (selected-id (if use-nested (hash-ref nested "selected_id") "wl-harness-0"))
         (runtime (hash "mode" (if use-nested (hash-ref (hash-ref nested "runtime") "mode") "simulated")
                        "requested_mode" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "routing")
                        "aura_ref" #f
                        "seed" seed
                        "incr_proven" #f
                        "shadow" #t
                        "harness_canary" #t
                        "kernel" "aura"))
         (_ (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime (attach-prove-metadata root))))
    (hash "schema_version" "trajectory.v0"
          "episode_id" (make-id)
          "ts_start" ts
          "ts_end" (iso-now)
          "prompt" prompt
          "runtime" runtime
          "harness" (hash "l1_strategy_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1_strategy_id")
                          "l2_weights_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l2_weights_id" #f)
                          "l3_online" #f
                          "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                          "harness_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "harness_id")
                          "version_base" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "base") "version")
                          "version_proposed" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "version")
                          "config_proposed" (hash-ref proposal "proposed")
                          "config_base" (hash-ref proposal "base")
                          "actions" (hash-ref decision "actions")
                          "outcome" (hash-ref decision "outcome")
                          "autopropote" (hash-ref decision "autopropote")
                          "committed" (hash-ref decision "committed")
                          "shadow_profile" (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                          "l1_backend" (if (string? l1-backend) l1-backend "file"))
          "worldlines" worldlines
          "selected_id" selected-id
          "selection_reason" (string-append "harness_" (hash-ref decision "outcome"))
          "discarded" (list)
          "privacy" (hash "redacted" #f "retention_class" "dogfood"))))

input.source:
; aura-build kernel — scout → mutate → eval → select-best
; Primary product path. Simulated = pure Aura fitness; aura = in-process mutate:rebind.
; Slice 3: fiber_live ⇒ worldline_backend=fiber_graph (fiber:spawn fan-out); else file.
(export run-episode run-harness-canary select-best run-backend-episode)

(require "util" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "worldline" all:)
(require "harness" all:)
(require "prove" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "l2" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define (select-best worldlines)
  (if (null? worldlines)
    (error "no worldlines to select")
    (let loop ((xs (cdr worldlines)) (best (car worldlines)))
      (if (null? xs) best
        (let* ((w (car xs))
               (wf (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness"))
               (bf (hash-ref (hash-ref best "eval") "fitness"))
               (wid (hash-ref w "id"))
               (bid (hash-ref best "id")))
          (if (or (> wf bf) (and (= wf bf) (string>? wid bid)))
            (loop (cdr xs) w)
            (loop (cdr xs) best)))))))

(define (sim-mutate prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n) (reverse out)
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (cons (hash "id" (string-append "wl-" (number->string i))
                        "parent_id" #f
                        "mutations" (list
                          (hash "op" "simulated_edit"
                                "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                                "summary" (string-append "candidate " (string-pad (number->string i) 3)
                                                         " for: " (substring prompt 0 (min 80 (string-length prompt)))))))
                  out)))))

(define (sim-eval wl prompt seed index)
  (let* ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed index))
         (passed (>= fitness 0.3)))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref wl "id")
          "parent_id" (hash-ref wl "parent_id" #f)
          "mutations" (hash-ref wl "mutations")
          "stable_ref" (hash-ref wl "stable_ref" #f)
          "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                       "passed" passed
                       "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                       "tests_total" 1
                                       "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* index 3))
                                       "audit_ok" #t
                                       "incr_proven" #f)
                       "notes" "aura-kernel simulated eval"))))

(define (aura-eval wl prompt seed index)
  (let* ((mutations (hash-ref wl "mutations" (list)))
         (bump (if (null? mutations) (+ index 1)
                 (hash-ref (car mutations) "bump" (+ index 1)))))
    (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
    (eval-current)
    (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
    (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
    (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
    (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                   (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                   (string-append "orch-wl-" (number->string index)))
    (eval-current)
    (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
    (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
    (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
    (define val (m1-cand 40))
    (define expected (+ 40 bump))
    (define ok (= val expected))
    (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0)))
    (define fitness (if (and ok (= val expected))
                      (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo index 4))))
                      (if ok 0.45 0.1)))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref wl "id")
          "parent_id" (hash-ref wl "parent_id" #f)
          "mutations" mutations
          "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                       "passed" ok
                       "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                       "tests_total" 1
                                       "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                       "audit_ok" ok
                                       "aura_value" val
                                       "incr_valid" incr
                                       "incr_proven" #f)
                       "notes" (if incr "aura-kernel mutate+eval; AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID"
                                     "aura-kernel mutate+eval-current")))))

(define (aura-mutate prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n) (reverse out)
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cons (hash "id" (string-append "wl-" (number->string i))
                          "parent_id" #f
                          "mutations" (list
                            (hash "op" "aura_mutate_rebind"
                                  "target_id" (string-append "m1-cand:" (number->string i))
                                  "summary" (string-append "mutate:rebind bump=" (number->string bump))
                                  "bump" bump)))
                    out))))))

(define (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected reason runtime-extra harness-block discarded attach-root attach?)
  (let* ((ts0 (iso-now))
         (runtime (hash "mode" mode
                        "requested_mode" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_REQUESTED_MODE" mode)
                        "aura_ref" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_AURA_REF" #f)
                        "seed" seed
                        "incr_proven" #f
                        "kernel" "aura"))
         (_ (if (hash? runtime-extra)
              (hash-for-each runtime-extra (lambda (k v) (hash-set! runtime k v)))
              #t))
         (fields (if attach? (attach-prove-metadata attach-root) #f))
         (_2 (if fields (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields) #t))
         (wls (map (lambda (w)
                     (let ((e (hash "id" (hash-ref w "id")
                                    "parent_id" (hash-ref w "parent_id" #f)
                                    "mutations" (hash-ref w "mutations")
                                    "eval" (hash-ref w "eval"))))
                       (if (hash-ref w "stable_ref" #f)
                         (begin (hash-set! e "stable_ref" (hash-ref w "stable_ref")) e)
                         e)))
                   evaluated)))
    (hash "schema_version" "trajectory.v0"
          "episode_id" (make-id)
          "ts_start" ts0
          "ts_end" (iso-now)
          "prompt" prompt
          "runtime" runtime
          "harness" harness-block
          "worldlines" wls
          "selected_id" (hash-ref selected "id")
          "selection_reason" reason
          "discarded" (if discarded discarded (list))
          "privacy" (hash "redacted" #f "retention_class" "dogfood"))))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (car xs)
      (cons (car xs) (filter-truth (cdr xs)))
      (filter-truth (cdr xs)))))

(define (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id attach?)
  (let* ((decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
         (use-fiber (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER))
         (audit (join-path harness-root (string-append "wl-fiber-" (make-id))))
         (fan (if use-fiber
                (if (equal? mode "aura")
                  (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit)
                  (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit))
                #f))
         (evaluated
           (if use-fiber
             (hash-ref fan "worldlines")
             (let* ((raw (if (equal? mode "aura")
                           (aura-mutate prompt seed n)
                           (sim-mutate prompt seed n))))
               (let loop ((i 0) (xs raw) (out (list)))
                 (if (null? xs) (reverse out)
                   (let ((got (if (equal? mode "aura")
                                (aura-eval (car xs) prompt seed i)
                                (sim-eval (car xs) prompt seed i))))
                     (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons got out))))))))
         (selected (select-best evaluated))
         (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                    (for-each (lambda (w)
                                (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                           (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                              evaluated)
                    h))
         (ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated))
         (discarded
           (if use-fiber
             (let ((d (fiber-discard-losers (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map ids)))
               (if (and audit (not (equal? audit "")))
                 (fiber-audit-write audit n BACKEND_FIBER
                                    (hash-ref decision "session_model")
                                    #t ids d)
                 #t)
               d)
             (list)))
         (rt-extra
           (if use-fiber
             (fiber-runtime-fields audit n #t
                                   (hash-ref decision "session_model") ids)
             (hash "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                   "fiber_live" #f
                   "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)))
         (_ (hash-set! rt-extra "worldline_backend_reason"
                       (hash-ref decision "reason" "")))
         (harness-block (hash "l1_strategy_id" l1
                              "l2_weights_id" l2-id
                              "l3_online" #f))
         (l2ref (if (and l2-id (not (equal? l2-id "")))
                  (l2-resolve harness-root l2-id)
                  #f))
         (_2 (if (and l2ref (hash-ref l2ref "artifact_present" #f))
               (hash-set! harness-block "l2_ref" l2ref)
               #t))
         (ep (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected "max_fitness"
                            rt-extra harness-block discarded harness-root attach?))
         (rt (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    ; Episode truth: backend actually used + live probe (prove attach cannot invent fiber_graph)
    (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend" backend)
    (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (hash-set! rt "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (hash-set! rt "session_model" (hash-ref decision "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
    (hash "episode" ep "selected" selected
          "worldline_backend" backend)))

(define (run-aura-repo-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id workspace attach?)
  (let* ((decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
         (use-fiber (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER))
         (ws-root (if (or (null? workspace) (equal? workspace ""))
                    (join-path harness-root (string-append "ws-" (make-id)))
                    workspace))
         (pack
           (if use-fiber
             (let* ((fan (if (equal? mode "aura")
                           (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n ws-root)
                           (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n ws-root)))
                    (evaluated (hash-ref fan "worldlines"))
                    (selected (select-best evaluated))
                    (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                               (for-each (lambda (w)
                                           (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                                      (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                                         evaluated)
                               h))
                    (ids (hash-ref fan "ids"))
                    (discarded (fiber-discard-losers (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map ids))
                    (_ (fiber-audit-write ws-root n BACKEND_FIBER
                                          (hash-ref decision "session_model")
                                          #t ids discarded))
                    (rt (fiber-runtime-fields ws-root n #t
                                              (hash-ref decision "session_model") ids)))
               (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
               (hash "evaluated" evaluated "selected" selected
                     "discarded" discarded "rt" rt))
             (let* ((ws (workspace-create ws-root n))
                    (cids (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates")))
                    (evaluated
                      (let loop ((i 0) (xs cids) (out (list)))
                        (if (null? xs) (reverse out)
                          (let* ((cid (car xs))
                                 (mut (workspace-fork-note ws cid
                                        (string-append "aura-repo candidate " (number->string i)
                                                       " for: " (substring prompt 0 (min 80 (string-length prompt))))))
                                 (got (sim-eval (hash "id" cid
                                                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                                                      "mutations" (list mut)
                                                      "stable_ref" cid)
                                                prompt seed i)))
                            (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons got out))))))
                    (selected (select-best evaluated))
                    (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                               (for-each (lambda (w)
                                           (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                                      (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                                         evaluated)
                               h))
                    (discarded (filter-truth (workspace-discard-losers ws (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map)))
                    (rt (workspace-runtime-fields ws)))
               (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
               (hash "evaluated" evaluated "selected" selected
                     "discarded" discarded "rt" rt))))
         (evaluated (hash-ref pack "evaluated"))
         (selected (hash-ref pack "selected"))
         (discarded (hash-ref pack "discarded"))
         (rt (hash-ref pack "rt"))
         (harness-block (hash "l1_strategy_id" l1
                              "l2_weights_id" l2-id
                              "l3_online" #f))
         (ep (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected "max_fitness"
                            rt harness-block discarded harness-root attach?))
         (rtrun (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    (hash-set! rtrun "worldline_backend" backend)
    (hash-set! rtrun "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (hash-set! rtrun "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (hash-set! rtrun "session_model" (hash-ref decision "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
    (hash-set! rtrun "profile"
               (hash "id" "aura-repo"
                     "fitness_source" (if (equal? mode "aura") "aura" "simulated")
                     "incr_claimed" #t
                     "incr_proven" #f
                     "worldline_backend" backend))
    (hash "episode" ep "selected" selected
          "worldline_backend" backend)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (run-episode)
  (let* ((prompt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "aura-kernel demo"))
         (mode-req (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MODE" "simulated"))
         (mode (if (equal? mode-req "auto") "simulated" mode-req))
         ; auto→simulated when we can't probe another binary; in-kernel aura mode uses this process
         (mode (if (equal? mode-req "aura") "aura"
                 (if (equal? mode-req "auto")
                   (if (equal? (env-get "AURA_BIN" "") "") "simulated" "aura")
                   mode-req)))
         (seed-opt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SEED" ""))
         (seed (seed-from-prompt prompt
                 (if (equal? seed-opt "") #f (string->number seed-opt))))
         (n (env-int "AURA_BUILD_WORLDLINES" 3))
         (harness-root (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (out (env-get "AURA_BUILD_OUT" "trajectories/episodes.jsonl"))
         (profile (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROFILE" ""))
         (workspace (env-get "AURA_BUILD_WORKSPACE" ""))
         (l1 (env-get "AURA_BUILD_L1" "m3.harness.select_best"))
         (l2-id (env-get "AURA_BUILD_L2" ""))
         (attach? (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_ATTACH_PROVE" #t))
         (mem-profile (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MEMORY_PROFILE" ""))
         (result (if (equal? profile "aura-repo")
                   (run-aura-repo-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id workspace attach?)
                   (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1
                     (if (equal? l2-id "") #f l2-id) attach?)))
         (ep (hash-ref result "episode"))
         (sel (hash-ref result "selected")))
    (if (not (equal? mem-profile ""))
      (begin
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_selected_id" (hash-ref sel "id"))
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_prompt" (substring prompt 0 (min 200 (string-length prompt))))
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_fitness" (hash-ref (hash-ref sel "eval") "fitness"))
        (hash-set! ep "memory" (hash "profile_id" mem-profile
                                     "updated_keys" (list "last_selected_id" "last_prompt" "last_fitness"))))
      #t)
    (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
      (hash-set! ep "_wrote" path)
      (hash "ok" #t "episode" ep "path" path "selected" sel))))

(define (run-harness-canary)
  ; L1: prefer std/hot-strategy (register/swap/heal + last-good). harness.json = durable mirror.
  ; AUTOPROMOTE still default OFF. Honesty: never invent fiber_live / incr_proven.
  (let* ((prompt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "harness canary"))
         (harness-root (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (out (env-get "AURA_BUILD_OUT" "trajectories/episodes.jsonl"))
         (seed-opt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SEED" ""))
         (seed (seed-from-prompt prompt
                 (if (equal? seed-opt "") #f (string->number seed-opt))))
         (patches-json (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_PATCHES" "{}"))
         (fw-json (env-get "AURA_BUILD_FITNESS_PATCHES" "{}"))
         (patches (json-parse patches-json))
         (fw (json-parse fw-json))
         (auto-flag (env-get "AURA_BUILD_AUTOPROMOTE_FLAG" ""))
         (auto (if (equal? auto-flag "1") #t (if (equal? auto-flag "0") #f 'unset)))
         (base (load-harness harness-root))
         (proposal (propose-mutate base patches fw))
         (pre (validate-harness (hash-ref proposal "proposed")))
         (backend (l1-backend-prefer))
         (use-hot (equal? backend "hot-strategy")))
    ; Seed last-good from durable harness.json when using hot-strategy.
    (if use-hot (l1-seed! base) #f)
    (if (not (null? pre))
      (let* ((decision (decide-canary proposal #f auto harness-root))
             (_ (if use-hot (l1-heal!) #f))
             (_ (write-l1-backend-marker harness-root backend
                    (hash-ref proposal "mid") (hash-ref decision "outcome")))
             (ep (harness-change-episode prompt proposal #f decision seed harness-root
                                         #f 0.0 backend)))
        (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
          (hash "ok" #t "accepted" #f "episode" ep "path" path
                "outcome" (hash-ref decision "outcome")
                "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                "l1_backend" backend)))
      (let* ((n (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "worldline_count"))
             (mode (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "routing" "simulated"))
             (mode (if (equal? mode "aura") "aura" "simulated"))
             (base-n (hash-ref base "worldline_count"))
             (base-mode (hash-ref base "routing" "simulated"))
             (base-mode (if (equal? base-mode "aura") "aura" "simulated"))
             ; Live L1 swap of proposed strategy body (canary), when hot-strategy.
             (_swap (if use-hot
                       (l1-swap! (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1-canary")
                       #f))
             (baseline (run-backend-episode prompt seed base-n base-mode harness-root
                          (hash-ref base "l1_strategy_id")
                          (hash-ref base "l2_weights_id" #f) #t))
             (canary (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root
                          (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1_strategy_id")
                          (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l2_weights_id" #f) #t))
             (bf (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref baseline "selected") "eval") "fitness"))
             (cf (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref canary "selected") "eval") "fitness"))
             (passed (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref canary "selected") "eval") "passed"))
             (accepted (and passed (>= cf (* bf 0.5))))
             (decision (decide-canary proposal accepted auto harness-root))
             (outcome (hash-ref decision "outcome"))
             ; heal! on canary fail OR discard (AUTOPROMOTE off). Keep swap only on commit.
             (_heal (if (and use-hot (not (equal? outcome "commit")))
                       (l1-heal!)
                       #f))
             (_mark (write-l1-backend-marker harness-root backend
                       (hash-ref proposal "mid") outcome))
             (ep (harness-change-episode prompt proposal accepted decision seed harness-root
                                         (hash-ref canary "episode") cf backend)))
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_harness_mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid"))
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_harness_outcome" outcome)
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_l1_backend" backend)
        (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
          (hash "ok" #t "accepted" accepted "episode" ep "path" path
                "outcome" outcome
                "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                "l1_backend" backend))))))

(define (harness-change-episode prompt proposal accepted decision seed root nested cf l1-backend)
  (let* ((ts (iso-now))
         (use-nested (and nested (hash? nested) (hash-ref nested "worldlines" #f)))
         (worldlines (if use-nested (hash-ref nested "worldlines")
                       (list (hash "id" "wl-harness-0"
                                   "parent_id" #f
                                   "mutations" (list
                                     (hash "op" "harness_mutate"
                                           "target_id" "harness:default"
                                           "summary" (string-append "canary mid=" (hash-ref proposal "mid"))
                                           "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")))
                                   "eval" (hash "fitness" cf
                                                "passed" accepted
                                                "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if accepted 1 0)
                                                                "tests_total" 1
                                                                "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                                "compile_ms" 0
                                                                "audit_ok" #t
                                                                "incr_claimed" #f
                                                                "incr_proven" #f)
                                                "notes" (string-append "harness canary " (hash-ref decision "outcome")))))))
         (selected-id (if use-nested (hash-ref nested "selected_id") "wl-harness-0"))
         (runtime (hash "mode" (if use-nested (hash-ref (hash-ref nested "runtime") "mode") "simulated")
                        "requested_mode" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "routing")
                        "aura_ref" #f
                        "seed" seed
                        "incr_proven" #f
                        "shadow" #t
                        "harness_canary" #t
                        "kernel" "aura"))
         (_ (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime (attach-prove-metadata root))))
    (hash "schema_version" "trajectory.v0"
          "episode_id" (make-id)
          "ts_start" ts
          "ts_end" (iso-now)
          "prompt" prompt
          "runtime" runtime
          "harness" (hash "l1_strategy_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1_strategy_id")
                          "l2_weights_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l2_weights_id" #f)
                          "l3_online" #f
                          "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                          "harness_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "harness_id")
                          "version_base" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "base") "version")
                          "version_proposed" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "version")
                          "config_proposed" (hash-ref proposal "proposed")
                          "config_base" (hash-ref proposal "base")
                          "actions" (hash-ref decision "actions")
                          "outcome" (hash-ref decision "outcome")
                          "autopropote" (hash-ref decision "autopropote")
                          "committed" (hash-ref decision "committed")
                          "shadow_profile" (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                          "l1_backend" (if (string? l1-backend) l1-backend "file"))
          "worldlines" worldlines
          "selected_id" selected-id
          "selection_reason" (string-append "harness_" (hash-ref decision "outcome"))
          "discarded" (list)
          "privacy" (hash "redacted" #f "retention_class" "dogfood"))))

input.source:
; aura-build kernel — scout → mutate → eval → select-best
; Primary product path. Simulated = pure Aura fitness; aura = in-process mutate:rebind.
; Slice 3: fiber_live ⇒ worldline_backend=fiber_graph (fiber:spawn fan-out); else file.
(export run-episode run-harness-canary select-best run-backend-episode)

(require "util" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "worldline" all:)
(require "harness" all:)
(require "prove" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "l2" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define (select-best worldlines)
  (if (null? worldlines)
    (error "no worldlines to select")
    (let loop ((xs (cdr worldlines)) (best (car worldlines)))
      (if (null? xs) best
        (let* ((w (car xs))
               (wf (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness"))
               (bf (hash-ref (hash-ref best "eval") "fitness"))
               (wid (hash-ref w "id"))
               (bid (hash-ref best "id")))
          (if (or (> wf bf) (and (= wf bf) (string>? wid bid)))
            (loop (cdr xs) w)
            (loop (cdr xs) best)))))))

(define (sim-mutate prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n) (reverse out)
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (cons (hash "id" (string-append "wl-" (number->string i))
                        "parent_id" #f
                        "mutations" (list
                          (hash "op" "simulated_edit"
                                "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                                "summary" (string-append "candidate " (string-pad (number->string i) 3)
                                                         " for: " (substring prompt 0 (min 80 (string-length prompt)))))))
                  out)))))

(define (sim-eval wl prompt seed index)
  (let* ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed index))
         (passed (>= fitness 0.3)))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref wl "id")
          "parent_id" (hash-ref wl "parent_id" #f)
          "mutations" (hash-ref wl "mutations")
          "stable_ref" (hash-ref wl "stable_ref" #f)
          "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                       "passed" passed
                       "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                       "tests_total" 1
                                       "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* index 3))
                                       "audit_ok" #t
                                       "incr_proven" #f)
                       "notes" "aura-kernel simulated eval"))))

(define (aura-eval wl prompt seed index)
  (let* ((mutations (hash-ref wl "mutations" (list)))
         (bump (if (null? mutations) (+ index 1)
                 (hash-ref (car mutations) "bump" (+ index 1)))))
    (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
    (eval-current)
    (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
    (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
    (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
    (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                   (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                   (string-append "orch-wl-" (number->string index)))
    (eval-current)
    (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
    (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
    (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
    (define val (m1-cand 40))
    (define expected (+ 40 bump))
    (define ok (= val expected))
    (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0)))
    (define fitness (if (and ok (= val expected))
                      (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo index 4))))
                      (if ok 0.45 0.1)))
    (hash "id" (hash-ref wl "id")
          "parent_id" (hash-ref wl "parent_id" #f)
          "mutations" mutations
          "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                       "passed" ok
                       "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                       "tests_total" 1
                                       "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                       "audit_ok" ok
                                       "aura_value" val
                                       "incr_valid" incr
                                       "incr_proven" #f)
                       "notes" (if incr "aura-kernel mutate+eval; AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID"
                                     "aura-kernel mutate+eval-current")))))

(define (aura-mutate prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n) (reverse out)
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cons (hash "id" (string-append "wl-" (number->string i))
                          "parent_id" #f
                          "mutations" (list
                            (hash "op" "aura_mutate_rebind"
                                  "target_id" (string-append "m1-cand:" (number->string i))
                                  "summary" (string-append "mutate:rebind bump=" (number->string bump))
                                  "bump" bump)))
                    out))))))

(define (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected reason runtime-extra harness-block discarded attach-root attach?)
  (let* ((ts0 (iso-now))
         (runtime (hash "mode" mode
                        "requested_mode" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_REQUESTED_MODE" mode)
                        "aura_ref" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_AURA_REF" #f)
                        "seed" seed
                        "incr_proven" #f
                        "kernel" "aura"))
         (_ (if (hash? runtime-extra)
              (hash-for-each runtime-extra (lambda (k v) (hash-set! runtime k v)))
              #t))
         (fields (if attach? (attach-prove-metadata attach-root) #f))
         (_2 (if fields (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields) #t))
         (wls (map (lambda (w)
                     (let ((e (hash "id" (hash-ref w "id")
                                    "parent_id" (hash-ref w "parent_id" #f)
                                    "mutations" (hash-ref w "mutations")
                                    "eval" (hash-ref w "eval"))))
                       (if (hash-ref w "stable_ref" #f)
                         (begin (hash-set! e "stable_ref" (hash-ref w "stable_ref")) e)
                         e)))
                   evaluated)))
    (hash "schema_version" "trajectory.v0"
          "episode_id" (make-id)
          "ts_start" ts0
          "ts_end" (iso-now)
          "prompt" prompt
          "runtime" runtime
          "harness" harness-block
          "worldlines" wls
          "selected_id" (hash-ref selected "id")
          "selection_reason" reason
          "discarded" (if discarded discarded (list))
          "privacy" (hash "redacted" #f "retention_class" "dogfood"))))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (car xs)
      (cons (car xs) (filter-truth (cdr xs)))
      (filter-truth (cdr xs)))))

(define (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id attach?)
  (let* ((decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
         (use-fiber (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER))
         (audit (join-path harness-root (string-append "wl-fiber-" (make-id))))
         (fan (if use-fiber
                (if (equal? mode "aura")
                  (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit)
                  (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit))
                #f))
         (evaluated
           (if use-fiber
             (hash-ref fan "worldlines")
             (let* ((raw (if (equal? mode "aura")
                           (aura-mutate prompt seed n)
                           (sim-mutate prompt seed n))))
               (let loop ((i 0) (xs raw) (out (list)))
                 (if (null? xs) (reverse out)
                   (let ((got (if (equal? mode "aura")
                                (aura-eval (car xs) prompt seed i)
                                (sim-eval (car xs) prompt seed i))))
                     (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons got out))))))))
         (selected (select-best evaluated))
         (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                    (for-each (lambda (w)
                                (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                           (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                              evaluated)
                    h))
         (ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated))
         (discarded
           (if use-fiber
             (let ((d (fiber-discard-losers (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map ids)))
               (if (and audit (not (equal? audit "")))
                 (fiber-audit-write audit n BACKEND_FIBER
                                    (hash-ref decision "session_model")
                                    #t ids d)
                 #t)
               d)
             (list)))
         (rt-extra
           (if use-fiber
             (fiber-runtime-fields audit n #t
                                   (hash-ref decision "session_model") ids)
             (hash "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                   "fiber_live" #f
                   "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)))
         (_ (hash-set! rt-extra "worldline_backend_reason"
                       (hash-ref decision "reason" "")))
         (harness-block (hash "l1_strategy_id" l1
                              "l2_weights_id" l2-id
                              "l3_online" #f))
         (l2ref (if (and l2-id (not (equal? l2-id "")))
                  (l2-resolve harness-root l2-id)
                  #f))
         (_2 (if (and l2ref (hash-ref l2ref "artifact_present" #f))
               (hash-set! harness-block "l2_ref" l2ref)
               #t))
         (ep (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected "max_fitness"
                            rt-extra harness-block discarded harness-root attach?))
         (rt (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    ; Episode truth: backend actually used + live probe (prove attach cannot invent fiber_graph)
    (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend" backend)
    (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (hash-set! rt "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (hash-set! rt "session_model" (hash-ref decision "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
    (hash "episode" ep "selected" selected
          "worldline_backend" backend)))

(define (run-aura-repo-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id workspace attach?)
  (let* ((decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
         (use-fiber (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER))
         (ws-root (if (or (null? workspace) (equal? workspace ""))
                    (join-path harness-root (string-append "ws-" (make-id)))
                    workspace))
         (pack
           (if use-fiber
             (let* ((fan (if (equal? mode "aura")
                           (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n ws-root)
                           (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n ws-root)))
                    (evaluated (hash-ref fan "worldlines"))
                    (selected (select-best evaluated))
                    (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                               (for-each (lambda (w)
                                           (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                                      (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                                         evaluated)
                               h))
                    (ids (hash-ref fan "ids"))
                    (discarded (fiber-discard-losers (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map ids))
                    (_ (fiber-audit-write ws-root n BACKEND_FIBER
                                          (hash-ref decision "session_model")
                                          #t ids discarded))
                    (rt (fiber-runtime-fields ws-root n #t
                                              (hash-ref decision "session_model") ids)))
               (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
               (hash "evaluated" evaluated "selected" selected
                     "discarded" discarded "rt" rt))
             (let* ((ws (workspace-create ws-root n))
                    (cids (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates")))
                    (evaluated
                      (let loop ((i 0) (xs cids) (out (list)))
                        (if (null? xs) (reverse out)
                          (let* ((cid (car xs))
                                 (mut (workspace-fork-note ws cid
                                        (string-append "aura-repo candidate " (number->string i)
                                                       " for: " (substring prompt 0 (min 80 (string-length prompt))))))
                                 (got (sim-eval (hash "id" cid
                                                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                                                      "mutations" (list mut)
                                                      "stable_ref" cid)
                                                prompt seed i)))
                            (loop (+ i 1) (cdr xs) (cons got out))))))
                    (selected (select-best evaluated))
                    (fit-map (let ((h (hash)))
                               (for-each (lambda (w)
                                           (hash-set! h (hash-ref w "id")
                                                      (hash-ref (hash-ref w "eval") "fitness")))
                                         evaluated)
                               h))
                    (discarded (filter-truth (workspace-discard-losers ws (hash-ref selected "id") fit-map)))
                    (rt (workspace-runtime-fields ws)))
               (hash-set! rt "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
               (hash "evaluated" evaluated "selected" selected
                     "discarded" discarded "rt" rt))))
         (evaluated (hash-ref pack "evaluated"))
         (selected (hash-ref pack "selected"))
         (discarded (hash-ref pack "discarded"))
         (rt (hash-ref pack "rt"))
         (harness-block (hash "l1_strategy_id" l1
                              "l2_weights_id" l2-id
                              "l3_online" #f))
         (ep (build-episode prompt seed mode evaluated selected "max_fitness"
                            rt harness-block discarded harness-root attach?))
         (rtrun (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    (hash-set! rtrun "worldline_backend" backend)
    (hash-set! rtrun "worldline_backend_reason" (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (hash-set! rtrun "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (hash-set! rtrun "session_model" (hash-ref decision "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
    (hash-set! rtrun "profile"
               (hash "id" "aura-repo"
                     "fitness_source" (if (equal? mode "aura") "aura" "simulated")
                     "incr_claimed" #t
                     "incr_proven" #f
                     "worldline_backend" backend))
    (hash "episode" ep "selected" selected
          "worldline_backend" backend)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (run-episode)
  (let* ((prompt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "aura-kernel demo"))
         (mode-req (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MODE" "simulated"))
         (mode (if (equal? mode-req "auto") "simulated" mode-req))
         ; auto→simulated when we can't probe another binary; in-kernel aura mode uses this process
         (mode (if (equal? mode-req "aura") "aura"
                 (if (equal? mode-req "auto")
                   (if (equal? (env-get "AURA_BIN" "") "") "simulated" "aura")
                   mode-req)))
         (seed-opt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SEED" ""))
         (seed (seed-from-prompt prompt
                 (if (equal? seed-opt "") #f (string->number seed-opt))))
         (n (env-int "AURA_BUILD_WORLDLINES" 3))
         (harness-root (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (out (env-get "AURA_BUILD_OUT" "trajectories/episodes.jsonl"))
         (profile (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROFILE" ""))
         (workspace (env-get "AURA_BUILD_WORKSPACE" ""))
         (l1 (env-get "AURA_BUILD_L1" "m3.harness.select_best"))
         (l2-id (env-get "AURA_BUILD_L2" ""))
         (attach? (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_ATTACH_PROVE" #t))
         (mem-profile (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MEMORY_PROFILE" ""))
         (result (if (equal? profile "aura-repo")
                   (run-aura-repo-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1 l2-id workspace attach?)
                   (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root l1
                     (if (equal? l2-id "") #f l2-id) attach?)))
         (ep (hash-ref result "episode"))
         (sel (hash-ref result "selected")))
    (if (not (equal? mem-profile ""))
      (begin
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_selected_id" (hash-ref sel "id"))
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_prompt" (substring prompt 0 (min 200 (string-length prompt))))
        (memory-set harness-root mem-profile "last_fitness" (hash-ref (hash-ref sel "eval") "fitness"))
        (hash-set! ep "memory" (hash "profile_id" mem-profile
                                     "updated_keys" (list "last_selected_id" "last_prompt" "last_fitness"))))
      #t)
    (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
      (hash-set! ep "_wrote" path)
      (hash "ok" #t "episode" ep "path" path "selected" sel))))

(define (run-harness-canary)
  ; L1: prefer std/hot-strategy (register/swap/heal + last-good). harness.json = durable mirror.
  ; AUTOPROMOTE still default OFF. Honesty: never invent fiber_live / incr_proven.
  (let* ((prompt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "harness canary"))
         (harness-root (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (out (env-get "AURA_BUILD_OUT" "trajectories/episodes.jsonl"))
         (seed-opt (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SEED" ""))
         (seed (seed-from-prompt prompt
                 (if (equal? seed-opt "") #f (string->number seed-opt))))
         (patches-json (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_PATCHES" "{}"))
         (fw-json (env-get "AURA_BUILD_FITNESS_PATCHES" "{}"))
         (patches (json-parse patches-json))
         (fw (json-parse fw-json))
         (auto-flag (env-get "AURA_BUILD_AUTOPROMOTE_FLAG" ""))
         (auto (if (equal? auto-flag "1") #t (if (equal? auto-flag "0") #f 'unset)))
         (base (load-harness harness-root))
         (proposal (propose-mutate base patches fw))
         (pre (validate-harness (hash-ref proposal "proposed")))
         (backend (l1-backend-prefer))
         (use-hot (equal? backend "hot-strategy")))
    ; Seed last-good from durable harness.json when using hot-strategy.
    (if use-hot (l1-seed! base) #f)
    (if (not (null? pre))
      (let* ((decision (decide-canary proposal #f auto harness-root))
             (_ (if use-hot (l1-heal!) #f))
             (_ (write-l1-backend-marker harness-root backend
                    (hash-ref proposal "mid") (hash-ref decision "outcome")))
             (ep (harness-change-episode prompt proposal #f decision seed harness-root
                                         #f 0.0 backend)))
        (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
          (hash "ok" #t "accepted" #f "episode" ep "path" path
                "outcome" (hash-ref decision "outcome")
                "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                "l1_backend" backend)))
      (let* ((n (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "worldline_count"))
             (mode (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "routing" "simulated"))
             (mode (if (equal? mode "aura") "aura" "simulated"))
             (base-n (hash-ref base "worldline_count"))
             (base-mode (hash-ref base "routing" "simulated"))
             (base-mode (if (equal? base-mode "aura") "aura" "simulated"))
             ; Live L1 swap of proposed strategy body (canary), when hot-strategy.
             (_swap (if use-hot
                       (l1-swap! (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1-canary")
                       #f))
             (baseline (run-backend-episode prompt seed base-n base-mode harness-root
                          (hash-ref base "l1_strategy_id")
                          (hash-ref base "l2_weights_id" #f) #t))
             (canary (run-backend-episode prompt seed n mode harness-root
                          (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1_strategy_id")
                          (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l2_weights_id" #f) #t))
             (bf (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref baseline "selected") "eval") "fitness"))
             (cf (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref canary "selected") "eval") "fitness"))
             (passed (hash-ref (hash-ref (hash-ref canary "selected") "eval") "passed"))
             (accepted (and passed (>= cf (* bf 0.5))))
             (decision (decide-canary proposal accepted auto harness-root))
             (outcome (hash-ref decision "outcome"))
             ; heal! on canary fail OR discard (AUTOPROMOTE off). Keep swap only on commit.
             (_heal (if (and use-hot (not (equal? outcome "commit")))
                       (l1-heal!)
                       #f))
             (_mark (write-l1-backend-marker harness-root backend
                       (hash-ref proposal "mid") outcome))
             (ep (harness-change-episode prompt proposal accepted decision seed harness-root
                                         (hash-ref canary "episode") cf backend)))
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_harness_mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid"))
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_harness_outcome" outcome)
        (memory-set harness-root (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                    "last_l1_backend" backend)
        (let ((path (write-episode ep out)))
          (hash "ok" #t "accepted" accepted "episode" ep "path" path
                "outcome" outcome
                "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                "l1_backend" backend))))))

(define (harness-change-episode prompt proposal accepted decision seed root nested cf l1-backend)
  (let* ((ts (iso-now))
         (use-nested (and nested (hash? nested) (hash-ref nested "worldlines" #f)))
         (worldlines (if use-nested (hash-ref nested "worldlines")
                       (list (hash "id" "wl-harness-0"
                                   "parent_id" #f
                                   "mutations" (list
                                     (hash "op" "harness_mutate"
                                           "target_id" "harness:default"
                                           "summary" (string-append "canary mid=" (hash-ref proposal "mid"))
                                           "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")))
                                   "eval" (hash "fitness" cf
                                                "passed" accepted
                                                "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if accepted 1 0)
                                                                "tests_total" 1
                                                                "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                                "compile_ms" 0
                                                                "audit_ok" #t
                                                                "incr_claimed" #f
                                                                "incr_proven" #f)
                                                "notes" (string-append "harness canary " (hash-ref decision "outcome")))))))
         (selected-id (if use-nested (hash-ref nested "selected_id") "wl-harness-0"))
         (runtime (hash "mode" (if use-nested (hash-ref (hash-ref nested "runtime") "mode") "simulated")
                        "requested_mode" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "routing")
                        "aura_ref" #f
                        "seed" seed
                        "incr_proven" #f
                        "shadow" #t
                        "harness_canary" #t
                        "kernel" "aura"))
         (_ (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime (attach-prove-metadata root))))
    (hash "schema_version" "trajectory.v0"
          "episode_id" (make-id)
          "ts_start" ts
          "ts_end" (iso-now)
          "prompt" prompt
          "runtime" runtime
          "harness" (hash "l1_strategy_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l1_strategy_id")
                          "l2_weights_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "l2_weights_id" #f)
                          "l3_online" #f
                          "mid" (hash-ref proposal "mid")
                          "harness_id" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "harness_id")
                          "version_base" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "base") "version")
                          "version_proposed" (hash-ref (hash-ref proposal "proposed") "version")
                          "config_proposed" (hash-ref proposal "proposed")
                          "config_base" (hash-ref proposal "base")
                          "actions" (hash-ref decision "actions")
                          "outcome" (hash-ref decision "outcome")
                          "autopropote" (hash-ref decision "autopropote")
                          "committed" (hash-ref decision "committed")
                          "shadow_profile" (hash-ref proposal "shadow_profile")
                          "l1_backend" (if (string? l1-backend) l1-backend "file"))
          "worldlines" worldlines
          "selected_id" selected-id
          "selection_reason" (string-append "harness_" (hash-ref decision "outcome"))
          "discarded" (list)
          "privacy" (hash "redacted" #f "retention_class" "dogfood"))))

                                  "bump" bump)))
                    out))))))
