; Actions come from stderr, not from a fixed menu.
; unbound variable: NAME -> try a few definitions of NAME.
; Keep the definition only when CASE matches rise. Otherwise discard it.
(require "std/string" all:)
(require "std/process" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)

(define aura-bin "/home/dev/code/grok-dev/aura-grok/build_soft4079/aura")
(define root "/home/dev/code/grok-dev/aura-build")
(define learned "scratch/leetcode_rl/learned.aura")

(define (as-str x)
  (if (string? x) x (number->string x)))

(define (starts-with? s pre)
  (let ((n (string-length pre)) (m (string-length s)))
    (and (>= m n) (equal? (substring s 0 n) pre))))

(define (find-at s key i)
  (let ((n (string-length key)) (m (string-length s)))
    (if (> (+ i n) m)
        -1
        (if (equal? (substring s i (+ i n)) key)
            i
            (find-at s key (+ i 1))))))

(define (skip-name? name)
  (or (< (string-length name) 2)
      (equal? name "else")
      (equal? name "loop")
      (equal? name "solve")
      (equal? name "let")))

(define (unbound-name text)
  (let ((at (find-at text "unbound variable: " 0)))
    (if (< at 0)
        ""
        (let* ((start (+ at (string-length "unbound variable: ")))
               (rest (substring text start (string-length text)))
               (cut (let loop ((i 0))
                      (if (or (>= i (string-length rest))
                              (<= (string-ref rest i) 32))
                          i
                          (loop (+ i 1))))))
          (substring rest 0 cut)))))

(define (case-value lines i)
  (let ((key (string-append "CASE" (number->string i) "=")))
    (let loop ((xs lines))
      (if (null? xs)
          #f
          (if (starts-with? (car xs) key)
              (substring (car xs) (string-length key) (string-length (car xs)))
              (loop (cdr xs)))))))

(define (count-hits lines tests)
  (if (null? tests)
      0
      (let* ((t (car tests))
             (got (case-value lines (hash-ref t "id")))
             (exp (as-str (hash-ref t "expected"))))
        (+ (if (and got (equal? got exp)) 1 0)
           (count-hits lines (cdr tests))))))

(define (run-with prelude solution tests)
  (let ((out "scratch/leetcode_rl/learn.out"))
    (shell (string-append
             "cd " root " && AURA_SANDBOX=off AURA_PIPELINE_STRICT=0 "
             "AURA_PATH='" root "/../aura-grok/lib:" root "/aura' "
             "timeout 2 " aura-bin " "
             prelude " " root "/aura/compat.aura " solution
             " > " out " 2>" out ".err"))
    (let ((text (read-file out)))
      (cons (count-hits (string-split (if (string? text) text "") "\n") tests)
            (unbound-name (let ((err (read-file (string-append out ".err"))))
                            (if (string? err) err "")))))))

(define (prelude-text name arity which)
  (string-append
    "(define (" name
    (if (= arity 1) " x" (if (= arity 2) " x y" " x y z"))
    ") "
    (if (= which 0) "0" (if (= which 1) "x" "y"))
    ")\n"))

(define (try-def slug solution tests name arity which base)
  (let ((pre "scratch/leetcode_rl/try.aura"))
    (write-file pre (prelude-text name arity which))
    (let* ((got (run-with pre solution tests))
           (hits (car got))
           (reward (- hits base)))
      (if (> reward 0)
          (cons reward (prelude-text name arity which))
          (cons reward "")))))

(define (best-def slug solution tests name base)
  (let* ((a (try-def slug solution tests name 1 0 base))
         (b (try-def slug solution tests name 1 1 base))
         (c (try-def slug solution tests name 2 1 base))
         (d (try-def slug solution tests name 2 2 base))
         (pick (lambda (p q) (if (> (car p) (car q)) p q))))
    (pick a (pick b (pick c d)))))

(define (learn-slug slug)
  (let* ((dir (string-append "corpus/leetcode/" slug))
         (sol (if (file-exists? (string-append dir "/solution_rl.aura"))
                  (string-append dir "/solution_rl.aura")
                  (if (file-exists? (string-append dir "/solution.aura"))
                      (string-append dir "/solution.aura")
                      (string-append dir "/solution_2.aura"))))
         (tests (json-parse (read-file (string-append dir "/tests.json"))))
         (base-run (run-with "scratch/leetcode_rl/empty.aura" sol tests))
         (base (car base-run))
         (name (cdr base-run)))
    (if (or (equal? name "") (skip-name? name) (>= base (length tests)))
        (cons 0 "")
        (let ((found (best-def slug sol tests name base)))
          (if (> (car found) 0)
              (begin
                (shell (string-append "cat scratch/leetcode_rl/try.aura >> " learned))
                (write-file (string-append dir "/solution_rl.aura")
                            (string-append "(require \"compat\" all:)\n"
                                           (cdr found)
                                           (read-file sol)))
                found)
              (cons (car found) ""))))))

(define (learn-lines lines left gained kept rejected)
  (if (or (null? lines) (= left 0))
      (cons gained (cons kept rejected))
      (let ((slug (car lines)))
        (if (equal? slug "")
            (learn-lines (cdr lines) left gained kept rejected)
            (let ((r (learn-slug slug)))
              (shell (string-append "printf '%s learn=%s\\n' " slug " " (number->string (car r))
                                    " >> scratch/leetcode_rl/learn.log"))
              (if (> (car r) 0)
                  (learn-lines (cdr lines) (- left 1) (+ gained (car r)) (+ kept 1) rejected)
                  (if (< (car r) 0)
                      (learn-lines (cdr lines) (- left 1) gained kept (+ rejected 1))
                      (learn-lines (cdr lines) (- left 1) gained kept rejected))))))))

(define (zero-slugs)
  (let ((raw (if (file-exists? "scratch/leetcode_rl/learn_queue.txt")
                 (read-file "scratch/leetcode_rl/learn_queue.txt")
                 "")))
    (string-split raw "\n")))

(let* ((mk (shell (string-append "mkdir -p " root "/scratch/leetcode_rl")))
       (_e (if (file-exists? learned) #f (write-file learned ";; learned definitions\n")))
       (_z (write-file "scratch/leetcode_rl/empty.aura" ";; no prelude\n"))
       (left (if (file-exists? "scratch/leetcode_rl/learn_limit")
                 (string->number (string-trim (read-file "scratch/leetcode_rl/learn_limit")))
                 8))
       (result (learn-lines (zero-slugs) left 0 0 0)))
  (display "LEARN_OK gained=")
  (display (car result))
  (display " kept=")
  (display (car (cdr result)))
  (display " rejected=")
  (display (cdr (cdr result)))
  (newline)
  mk)

; aura-build kernel — storm-still-incr prove-or-refuse + doctor honesty
; Never invent incr_proven/fiber_live; env alone cannot elevate.
(export
  prove-or-refuse write-prove-report load-prove-report
  attach-prove-metadata merge-prove-into-runtime doctor-snapshot
  default-prove-path ENV_INCR ENV_FIBER)

(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)

(define ENV_INCR "AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID")
(define ENV_FIBER "AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK")
(define REPORT_SCHEMA "prove_incr.v0")
(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")

(define (default-prove-path root)
  (join-path root "prove-incr-latest.json"))

(define (empty-report reason)
  (hash "schema_version" REPORT_SCHEMA
        "ts" (iso-now)
        "incr_proven" #f
        "reason" reason
        "measured" #f
        "aura_healthy" #f
        "aura_bin" (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")
        "probe_error" ""
        "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
        "fiber_live" #f
        "fiber_probe" (hash)
        "cycles_requested" 0
        "cycles_completed" 0
        "cycles_ok" 0
        "cycles_incr_valid" 0
        "worldline_pressure" 0
        "storm" (list)
        "honesty" (hash "never_claim_without_measure" #t
                        "fail_closed_on_unhealthy" #t
                        "incr_valid_requires_explicit_signal" #t)))

; One in-process mutate:rebind + epoch/invalidate delta check
(define (storm-cycle index bump)
  (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut0 (or (hash-ref h0 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                 (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                 (string-append "prove-cycle-" (number->string index)))
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut1 (or (hash-ref h1 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (define val (m1-cand 40))
  (define ok (= val (+ 40 bump)))
  (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0) (> mut1 mut0)))
  (hash "index" index
        "ok" ok
        "elapsed_ms" 0
        "incr_valid" (if (and ok incr) #t #f)
        "notes" (string-append "epoch " (number->string epoch0) "->"
                               (number->string epoch1))
        "aura_value" val))

(define (pressure-cycles cycle-index pressure)
  ; Returns (list storm-rev ok-all incr-all)
  (let loop ((j 0) (storm (list)) (ok-all #t) (incr-all #t))
    (if (>= j pressure)
      (list storm ok-all incr-all)
      (let ((c (storm-cycle cycle-index (+ j 1))))
        (loop (+ j 1)
              (cons c storm)
              (if (hash-ref c "ok") ok-all #f)
              (if (hash-ref c "incr_valid") incr-all #f))))))

(define (prove-or-refuse cycles pressure)
  (let ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (if (equal? bin "")
      (let ((r (empty-report "aura_binary_missing")))
        (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
        (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
        r)
      (let loop ((i 0) (storm (list)) (ok-n 0) (incr-n 0))
        (if (>= i cycles)
          (let* ((proven (and (= ok-n cycles) (= incr-n cycles) (> cycles 0)))
                 (reason (if proven "storm_incr_valid_measured"
                           (if (= ok-n cycles) "incr_valid_incomplete" "storm_cycles_failed")))
                 (r (empty-report reason)))
            (hash-set! r "measured" #t)
            (hash-set! r "aura_healthy" #t)
            (hash-set! r "incr_proven" proven)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_completed" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_ok" ok-n)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_incr_valid" incr-n)
            (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
            (hash-set! r "storm" (reverse storm))
            (hash-set! r "fiber_live" #f)
            (hash-set! r "fiber_probe"
              (hash "available" #f
                    "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                    "notes" "kernel in-process; not fiber-live multi-worldline"
                    "probed" #t))
            r)
          (let* ((pr (pressure-cycles i pressure))
                 (storm2 (append (car pr) storm))
                 (ok-n2 (if (car (cdr pr)) (+ ok-n 1) ok-n))
                 (incr-n2 (if (and (car (cdr pr)) (car (cdr (cdr pr)))) (+ incr-n 1) incr-n)))
            (loop (+ i 1) storm2 ok-n2 incr-n2)))))))

(define (write-prove-report report root)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (write-file p (json-encode report))
    p))

(define (load-prove-report root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (if (file-exists? p)
      (json-parse (read-file p))
      #f)))

; Attach honesty into traj runtime — never invent true from env alone.
(define (attach-prove-metadata root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (env-incr (env-bool ENV_INCR #f))
         (env-fiber (env-bool ENV_FIBER #f))
         (notes (if env-fiber
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven" "env_fiber_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "env_fiber_ignored_unproven"))
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "none")))))
    (if (not rep)
      (hash "attached" #t
            "incr_proven" #f
            "measured" #f
            "fiber_live" #f
            "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
            "reason" "no_prove_report"
            "env_notes" notes)
      (let* ((proven (hash-ref rep "incr_proven" #f))
             (measured (hash-ref rep "measured" #f))
             (incr (if (and proven measured) #t #f))
             (fiber (hash-ref rep "fiber_live" #f)))
        (hash "attached" #t
              "incr_proven" incr
              "measured" measured
              "fiber_live" (if fiber #t #f)
              "session_model" (hash-ref rep "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
              "reason" (hash-ref rep "reason" "")

; aura-build kernel — storm-still-incr prove-or-refuse + doctor honesty
; Never invent incr_proven/fiber_live; env alone cannot elevate.
(export
  prove-or-refuse write-prove-report load-prove-report
  attach-prove-metadata merge-prove-into-runtime doctor-snapshot
  default-prove-path ENV_INCR ENV_FIBER)

(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "harness" all:)

(define ENV_INCR "AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID")
(define ENV_FIBER "AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK")
(define REPORT_SCHEMA "prove_incr.v0")
(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")

(define (default-prove-path root)
  (join-path root "prove-incr-latest.json"))

(define (empty-report reason)
  (hash "schema_version" REPORT_SCHEMA
        "ts" (iso-now)
        "incr_proven" #f
        "reason" reason
        "measured" #f
        "aura_healthy" #f
        "aura_bin" (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")
        "probe_error" ""
        "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
        "fiber_live" #f
        "fiber_probe" (hash)
        "cycles_requested" 0
        "cycles_completed" 0
        "cycles_ok" 0
        "cycles_incr_valid" 0
        "worldline_pressure" 0
        "storm" (list)
        "honesty" (hash "never_claim_without_measure" #t
                        "fail_closed_on_unhealthy" #t
                        "incr_valid_requires_explicit_signal" #t)))

; One in-process mutate:rebind + epoch/invalidate delta check
(define (storm-cycle index bump)
  (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut0 (or (hash-ref h0 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                 (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                 (string-append "prove-cycle-" (number->string index)))
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut1 (or (hash-ref h1 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (define val (m1-cand 40))
  (define ok (= val (+ 40 bump)))
  (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0) (> mut1 mut0)))
  (hash "index" index
        "ok" ok
        "elapsed_ms" 0
        "incr_valid" (if (and ok incr) #t #f)
        "notes" (string-append "epoch " (number->string epoch0) "->"
                               (number->string epoch1))
        "aura_value" val))

(define (pressure-cycles cycle-index pressure)
  ; Returns (list storm-rev ok-all incr-all)
  (let loop ((j 0) (storm (list)) (ok-all #t) (incr-all #t))
    (if (>= j pressure)
      (list storm ok-all incr-all)
      (let ((c (storm-cycle cycle-index (+ j 1))))
        (loop (+ j 1)
              (cons c storm)
              (if (hash-ref c "ok") ok-all #f)
              (if (hash-ref c "incr_valid") incr-all #f))))))

(define (prove-or-refuse cycles pressure)
  (let ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (if (equal? bin "")
      (let ((r (empty-report "aura_binary_missing")))
        (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
        (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
        r)
      (let loop ((i 0) (storm (list)) (ok-n 0) (incr-n 0))
        (if (>= i cycles)
          (let* ((proven (and (= ok-n cycles) (= incr-n cycles) (> cycles 0)))
                 (reason (if proven "storm_incr_valid_measured"
                           (if (= ok-n cycles) "incr_valid_incomplete" "storm_cycles_failed")))
                 (r (empty-report reason)))
            (hash-set! r "measured" #t)
            (hash-set! r "aura_healthy" #t)
            (hash-set! r "incr_proven" proven)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_completed" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_ok" ok-n)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_incr_valid" incr-n)
            (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
            (hash-set! r "storm" (reverse storm))
            (hash-set! r "fiber_live" #f)
            (hash-set! r "fiber_probe"
              (hash "available" #f
                    "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                    "notes" "kernel in-process; not fiber-live multi-worldline"
                    "probed" #t))
            r)
          (let* ((pr (pressure-cycles i pressure))
                 (storm2 (append (car pr) storm))
                 (ok-n2 (if (car (cdr pr)) (+ ok-n 1) ok-n))
                 (incr-n2 (if (and (car (cdr pr)) (car (cdr (cdr pr)))) (+ incr-n 1) incr-n)))
            (loop (+ i 1) storm2 ok-n2 incr-n2)))))))

(define (write-prove-report report root)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (write-file p (json-encode report))
    p))

(define (load-prove-report root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (if (file-exists? p)
      (json-parse (read-file p))
      #f)))

; Attach honesty into traj runtime — never invent true from env alone.
(define (attach-prove-metadata root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (env-incr (env-bool ENV_INCR #f))
         (env-fiber (env-bool ENV_FIBER #f))
         (notes (if env-fiber
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven" "env_fiber_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "env_fiber_ignored_unproven"))
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "none")))))
    (if (not rep)
      (hash "attached" #t
            "incr_proven" #f
            "measured" #f
            "fiber_live" #f
            "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
            "reason" "no_prove_report"
            "env_notes" notes)
      (let* ((proven (hash-ref rep "incr_proven" #f))
             (measured (hash-ref rep "measured" #f))
             (incr (if (and proven measured) #t #f))
             (fiber (hash-ref rep "fiber_live" #f)))
        (hash "attached" #t
              "incr_proven" incr
              "measured" measured
              "fiber_live" (if fiber #t #f)
              "session_model" (hash-ref rep "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
              "reason" (hash-ref rep "reason" "")
              "env_notes" notes
              "report_ts" (hash-ref rep "ts" ""))))))

(define (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields)
  (hash-set! runtime "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "measured" (hash-ref fields "measured" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "fiber_live" (hash-ref fields "fiber_live" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "prove_incr" fields)
  runtime)

(define (doctor-snapshot root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" ""))
         (fields (attach-prove-metadata root))
         (l1 (l1-doctor-info root))
         (last (hash-ref l1 "last" #f))
         (l1-backend (if last (hash-ref last "l1_backend" (hash-ref l1 "preferred"))
                       (hash-ref l1 "preferred"))))
    (hash "aura_bin" bin
          "aura_probe_ok" (not (equal? bin ""))
          "aura_probe_error" (if (equal? bin "") "aura_binary_missing" "")
          "prove_incr_report_path" (default-prove-path root)
          "prove_incr_latest" (if rep rep #f)
          "l1" l1
          "honesty" (hash "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven")
                          "fiber_live" (hash-ref fields "fiber_live")
                          "session_model" (hash-ref fields "session_model")
                          "l3_online" #f
                          "l1_backend" l1-backend)
          "fiber" (hash "fiber_live" #f
                        "oneshot_fiber_ok" #f
                        "serve_session_ok" #f
                        "serve_cross_session_shared_ast" #f
                        "missing_surface" "host worldline shared-AST not wired")
          "tips" (list "kernel=Aura"
                       "run aura-build prove-incr with healthy AURA_BIN"
                       "L1 live path = std/hot-strategy; harness.json is durable mirror"
                       "fiber_live/incr_proven never invented"))))

; aura-build kernel — storm-still-incr prove-or-refuse + doctor honesty
; Never invent incr_proven/fiber_live; env alone cannot elevate.
(export
  prove-or-refuse write-prove-report load-prove-report
  attach-prove-metadata merge-prove-into-runtime doctor-snapshot
  default-prove-path ENV_INCR ENV_FIBER)

(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "harness" all:)

(define ENV_INCR "AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID")
(define ENV_FIBER "AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK")
(define REPORT_SCHEMA "prove_incr.v0")
(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")

(define (default-prove-path root)
  (join-path root "prove-incr-latest.json"))

(define (empty-report reason)
  (hash "schema_version" REPORT_SCHEMA
        "ts" (iso-now)
        "incr_proven" #f
        "reason" reason
        "measured" #f
        "aura_healthy" #f
        "aura_bin" (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")
        "probe_error" ""
        "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
        "fiber_live" #f
        "fiber_probe" (hash)
        "cycles_requested" 0
        "cycles_completed" 0
        "cycles_ok" 0
        "cycles_incr_valid" 0
        "worldline_pressure" 0
        "storm" (list)
        "honesty" (hash "never_claim_without_measure" #t
                        "fail_closed_on_unhealthy" #t
                        "incr_valid_requires_explicit_signal" #t)))

; One in-process mutate:rebind + epoch/invalidate delta check
(define (storm-cycle index bump)
  (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut0 (or (hash-ref h0 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                 (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                 (string-append "prove-cycle-" (number->string index)))
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut1 (or (hash-ref h1 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (define val (m1-cand 40))
  (define ok (= val (+ 40 bump)))
  (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0) (> mut1 mut0)))
  (hash "index" index
        "ok" ok
        "elapsed_ms" 0
        "incr_valid" (if (and ok incr) #t #f)
        "notes" (string-append "epoch " (number->string epoch0) "->"
                               (number->string epoch1))
        "aura_value" val))

(define (pressure-cycles cycle-index pressure)
  ; Returns (list storm-rev ok-all incr-all)
  (let loop ((j 0) (storm (list)) (ok-all #t) (incr-all #t))
    (if (>= j pressure)
      (list storm ok-all incr-all)
      (let ((c (storm-cycle cycle-index (+ j 1))))
        (loop (+ j 1)
              (cons c storm)
              (if (hash-ref c "ok") ok-all #f)
              (if (hash-ref c "incr_valid") incr-all #f))))))

(define (prove-or-refuse cycles pressure)
  (let ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (if (equal? bin "")
      (let ((r (empty-report "aura_binary_missing")))
        (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
        (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
        r)
      (let loop ((i 0) (storm (list)) (ok-n 0) (incr-n 0))
        (if (>= i cycles)
          (let* ((proven (and (= ok-n cycles) (= incr-n cycles) (> cycles 0)))
                 (reason (if proven "storm_incr_valid_measured"
                           (if (= ok-n cycles) "incr_valid_incomplete" "storm_cycles_failed")))
                 (r (empty-report reason)))
            (hash-set! r "measured" #t)
            (hash-set! r "aura_healthy" #t)
            (hash-set! r "incr_proven" proven)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_completed" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_ok" ok-n)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_incr_valid" incr-n)
            (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
            (hash-set! r "storm" (reverse storm))
            (hash-set! r "fiber_live" #f)
            (hash-set! r "fiber_probe"
              (hash "available" #f
                    "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                    "notes" "kernel in-process; not fiber-live multi-worldline"
                    "probed" #t))
            r)
          (let* ((pr (pressure-cycles i pressure))
                 (storm2 (append (car pr) storm))
                 (ok-n2 (if (car (cdr pr)) (+ ok-n 1) ok-n))
                 (incr-n2 (if (and (car (cdr pr)) (car (cdr (cdr pr)))) (+ incr-n 1) incr-n)))
            (loop (+ i 1) storm2 ok-n2 incr-n2)))))))

(define (write-prove-report report root)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (write-file p (json-encode report))
    p))

(define (load-prove-report root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (if (file-exists? p)
      (json-parse (read-file p))
      #f)))

; Attach honesty into traj runtime — never invent true from env alone.
(define (attach-prove-metadata root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (env-incr (env-bool ENV_INCR #f))
         (env-fiber (env-bool ENV_FIBER #f))
         (notes (if env-fiber
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven" "env_fiber_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "env_fiber_ignored_unproven"))
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "none")))))
    (if (not rep)
      (hash "attached" #t
            "incr_proven" #f
            "measured" #f
            "fiber_live" #f
            "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
            "reason" "no_prove_report"
            "env_notes" notes)
      (let* ((proven (hash-ref rep "incr_proven" #f))
             (measured (hash-ref rep "measured" #f))
             (incr (if (and proven measured) #t #f))
             (fiber (hash-ref rep "fiber_live" #f)))
        (hash "attached" #t
              "incr_proven" incr
              "measured" measured
              "fiber_live" (if fiber #t #f)
              "session_model" (hash-ref rep "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
              "reason" (hash-ref rep "reason" "")
              "env_notes" notes
              "report_ts" (hash-ref rep "ts" ""))))))

(define (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields)
  (hash-set! runtime "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "measured" (hash-ref fields "measured" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "fiber_live" (hash-ref fields "fiber_live" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "prove_incr" fields)
  runtime)

(define (doctor-snapshot root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" ""))
         (fields (attach-prove-metadata root))
         (l1 (l1-doctor-info root))
         (last (hash-ref l1 "last" #f))
         (l1-backend (if last (hash-ref last "l1_backend" (hash-ref l1 "preferred"))
                       (hash-ref l1 "preferred"))))
    (hash "aura_bin" bin
          "aura_probe_ok" (not (equal? bin ""))
          "aura_probe_error" (if (equal? bin "") "aura_binary_missing" "")
          "prove_incr_report_path" (default-prove-path root)
          "prove_incr_latest" (if rep rep #f)
          "l1" l1
          "honesty" (hash "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven")
                          "fiber_live" (hash-ref fields "fiber_live")
                          "session_model" (hash-ref fields "session_model")
                          "l3_online" #f
                          "l1_backend" l1-backend)
          "fiber" (hash "fiber_live" #f
                        "oneshot_fiber_ok" #f
                        "serve_session_ok" #f
                        "serve_cross_session_shared_ast" #f
                        "missing_surface" "host worldline shared-AST not wired")
          "tips" (list "kernel=Aura"
                       "run aura-build prove-incr with healthy AURA_BIN"
                       "L1 live path = std/hot-strategy; harness.json is durable mirror"
                       "fiber_live/incr_proven never invented"))))

              "reason" (hash-ref rep "reason" "")

              "fiber_probe" probe

(define ENV_INCR "AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID")
(define ENV_FIBER "AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK")
(define REPORT_SCHEMA "prove_incr.v0")
(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")

(define (default-prove-path root)
  (join-path root "prove-incr-latest.json"))

(define (empty-report reason)
  (hash "schema_version" REPORT_SCHEMA
        "ts" (iso-now)
        "incr_proven" #f
        "reason" reason
        "measured" #f
        "aura_healthy" #f
        "aura_bin" (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")
        "probe_error" ""
        "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
        "fiber_live" #f
        "fiber_probe" (hash)
        "cycles_requested" 0
        "cycles_completed" 0
        "cycles_ok" 0
        "cycles_incr_valid" 0
        "worldline_pressure" 0
        "storm" (list)
        "honesty" (hash "never_claim_without_measure" #t
                        "fail_closed_on_unhealthy" #t
                        "incr_valid_requires_explicit_signal" #t)))

; One in-process mutate:rebind + epoch/invalidate delta check
(define (storm-cycle index bump)
  (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut0 (or (hash-ref h0 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                 (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                 (string-append "prove-cycle-" (number->string index)))
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut1 (or (hash-ref h1 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (define val (m1-cand 40))
  (define ok (= val (+ 40 bump)))
  (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0) (> mut1 mut0)))
  (hash "index" index
        "ok" ok
        "elapsed_ms" 0
        "incr_valid" (if (and ok incr) #t #f)
        "notes" (string-append "epoch " (number->string epoch0) "->"
                               (number->string epoch1))
        "aura_value" val))

(define (pressure-cycles cycle-index pressure)
  ; Returns (list storm-rev ok-all incr-all)
  (let loop ((j 0) (storm (list)) (ok-all #t) (incr-all #t))
    (if (>= j pressure)
      (list storm ok-all incr-all)
      (let ((c (storm-cycle cycle-index (+ j 1))))
        (loop (+ j 1)
              (cons c storm)
              (if (hash-ref c "ok") ok-all #f)
              (if (hash-ref c "incr_valid") incr-all #f))))))

(define (prove-or-refuse cycles pressure)
  (let ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (if (equal? bin "")
      (let ((r (empty-report "aura_binary_missing")))
        (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
        (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
        r)
      (let loop ((i 0) (storm (list)) (ok-n 0) (incr-n 0))
        (if (>= i cycles)
          (let* ((proven (and (= ok-n cycles) (= incr-n cycles) (> cycles 0)))
                 (reason (if proven "storm_incr_valid_measured"
                           (if (= ok-n cycles) "incr_valid_incomplete" "storm_cycles_failed")))
                 (r (empty-report reason)))
            (hash-set! r "measured" #t)
            (hash-set! r "aura_healthy" #t)
            (hash-set! r "incr_proven" proven)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_completed" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_ok" ok-n)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_incr_valid" incr-n)
            (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
            (hash-set! r "storm" (reverse storm))
            (hash-set! r "fiber_live" #f)
            (hash-set! r "fiber_probe"
              (hash "available" #f
                    "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                    "notes" "kernel in-process; not fiber-live multi-worldline"
                    "probed" #t))
            r)
          (let* ((pr (pressure-cycles i pressure))
                 (storm2 (append (car pr) storm))
                 (ok-n2 (if (car (cdr pr)) (+ ok-n 1) ok-n))
                 (incr-n2 (if (and (car (cdr pr)) (car (cdr (cdr pr)))) (+ incr-n 1) incr-n)))
            (loop (+ i 1) storm2 ok-n2 incr-n2)))))))

    p))

(define (load-prove-report root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (if (file-exists? p)

      #f)))

(define (attach-prove-metadata root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (env-incr (env-bool ENV_INCR #f))
         (env-fiber (env-bool ENV_FIBER #f))
         (notes (if env-fiber
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven" "env_fiber_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "env_fiber_ignored_unproven"))
                  (if env-incr
                    (list "env_ignored_unproven")
                    (list "none")))))
    (if (not rep)
      (hash "attached" #t
            "incr_proven" #f
            "measured" #f
            "fiber_live" #f
            "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
            "reason" "no_prove_report"
            "env_notes" notes)
      (let* ((proven (hash-ref rep "incr_proven" #f))
             (measured (hash-ref rep "measured" #f))
             (incr (if (and proven measured) #t #f))
             (fiber (hash-ref rep "fiber_live" #f)))
        (hash "attached" #t
              "incr_proven" incr
              "measured" measured
              "fiber_live" (if fiber #t #f)
              "session_model" (hash-ref rep "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
              "reason" (hash-ref rep "reason" "")
              "env_notes" notes
              "report_ts" (hash-ref rep "ts" ""))))))

(define (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields)
  (hash-set! runtime "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "measured" (hash-ref fields "measured" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "fiber_live" (hash-ref fields "fiber_live" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "prove_incr" fields)
  runtime)

(define (doctor-snapshot root)

input.source:
;; aura-build kernel — storm-still-incr prove-or-refuse + doctor honesty
; Never invent incr_proven/fiber_live; env alone cannot elevate.
(export
  prove-or-refuse write-prove-report load-prove-report
  attach-prove-metadata merge-prove-into-runtime doctor-snapshot
  probe-fiber-session default-prove-path ENV_INCR ENV_FIBER)

(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "harness" all:)

(define ENV_INCR "AURA_BUILD_INCR_VALID")
(define ENV_FIBER "AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK")
(define ENV_NO_FIBER_PROBE "AURA_BUILD_NO_FIBER_PROBE")
(define REPORT_SCHEMA "prove_incr.v0")
(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")
(define SESSION_FIBER "fiber_denseness_in_process")

(define (default-prove-path root)
  (join-path root "prove-incr-latest.json"))

(define (empty-report reason)
  (hash "schema_version" REPORT_SCHEMA
        "ts" (iso-now)
        "incr_proven" #f
        "reason" reason
        "measured" #f
        "aura_healthy" #f
        "aura_bin" (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")
        "probe_error" ""
        "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
        "fiber_live" #f
        "fiber_probe" (hash)
        "cycles_requested" 0
        "cycles_completed" 0
        "cycles_ok" 0
        "cycles_incr_valid" 0
        "worldline_pressure" 0
        "storm" (list)
        "honesty" (hash "never_claim_without_measure" #t
                        "fail_closed_on_unhealthy" #t
                        "incr_valid_requires_explicit_signal" #t)))

; One in-process mutate:rebind + epoch/invalidate delta check
(define (storm-cycle index bump)
  (set-code "(define (m1-cand n) (+ n 0))")
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch0 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h0 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv0 (or (hash-ref h0 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut0 (or (hash-ref h0 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (mutate:rebind "m1-cand"
                 (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
                 (string-append "prove-cycle-" (number->string index)))
  (eval-current)
  (define epoch1 (or (stats:get "compile:epoch") 0))
  (define h1 (stats:get "query:jit-stats-hash"))
  (define inv1 (or (hash-ref h1 "hotswap-invalidate-total") 0))
  (define mut1 (or (hash-ref h1 "mutation-epoch") 0))
  (define val (m1-cand 40))
  (define ok (= val (+ 40 bump)))
  (define incr (or (> epoch1 epoch0) (> inv1 inv0) (> mut1 mut0)))
  (hash "index" index
        "ok" ok
        "elapsed_ms" 0
        "incr_valid" (if (and ok incr) #t #f)
        "notes" (string-append "epoch " (number->string epoch0) "->"
                               (number->string epoch1))
        "aura_value" val))

(define (pressure-cycles cycle-index pressure)
  ; Returns (list storm-rev ok-all incr-all)
  (let loop ((j 0) (storm (list)) (ok-all #t) (incr-all #t))
    (if (>= j pressure)
      (list storm ok-all incr-all)
      (let ((c (storm-cycle cycle-index (+ j 1))))
        (loop (+ j 1)
              (cons c storm)
              (if (hash-ref c "ok") ok-all #f)
              (if (hash-ref c "incr_valid") incr-all #f))))))

; --- Slice 2: honest fiber-live probe ---------------------------------
; Docs (aura-grok): docs/stdlib/fiber-spawn.md
; Multi-candidate same-FlatAST needs fiber:spawn+join denseness on one
; workspace (thread backend=2, or scheduler backend=1 under --serve-async).
; AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK alone must NEVER force fiber_live.

(define (fiber-oneshot-ok?)
  (try
    (let* ((fid (fiber:spawn (lambda () (+ 1 2))))
           (j (fiber:join fid)))
      (and (number? fid) (> fid 0) (= j 3)))
    (catch (e) #f)))

(define (fiber-same-flatast-multi-ok?)
  (try
    (begin
      (set-code "(define (c-a n) (+ n 0)) (define (c-b n) (+ n 0))")
      (eval-current)
      (let* ((fa (fiber:spawn (lambda ()
                    (and (mutate:rebind "c-a" "(lambda (n) (+ n 10))" "fiber-probe-a")
                         (begin (eval-current) #t)))))
             (fb (fiber:spawn (lambda ()
                    (and (mutate:rebind "c-b" "(lambda (n) (+ n 20))" "fiber-probe-b")
                         (begin (eval-current) #t)))))
             (ra (fiber:join fa))
             (rb (fiber:join fb))
             (va (c-a 1))
             (vb (c-b 1)))
        (and ra rb (= va 11) (= vb 21)
             (number? fa) (> fa 0) (number? fb) (> fb 0) (not (= fa fb)))))
    (catch (e) #f)))

(define (fiber-serve-session-ok?)
  ; Documented scheduler path: child --serve-async-bench (often fails Soft/Ready).
  (try
    (begin
      (require "std/process" all:)
      (let* ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" ""))
             (script "/tmp/aura-build-fiber-serve-probe.aura")
             (err "/tmp/aura-build-fiber-serve-probe.err")
             (rcfile "/tmp/aura-build-fiber-serve-probe.rc"))
        (if (equal? bin "")
          #f
          (begin
            (write-file script
              "(display (fiber:join (fiber:spawn (lambda () 7))))(newline)")
            (sh (string-append
                  bin " --serve-async-bench " script
                  " >/tmp/aura-build-fiber-serve-probe.out 2>" err
                  "; echo $? > " rcfile))
            (equal? (string-trim (read-file rcfile)) "0")))))
    (catch (e) #f)))

(define (fiber-probe-skipped reason)
  (hash "probed" #f
        "skipped" #t
        "reason" reason
        "oneshot_fiber_ok" #f
        "same_flatast_multi_ok" #f
        "serve_session_ok" #f
        "serve_cross_session_shared_ast" #f
        "fiber_live" #f
        "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
        "spawn_backend" 0
        "available" #f
        "notes" "fiber probe skipped; env cannot force fiber_live"
        "missing_surface" reason))

(define (probe-fiber-session)
  (if (env-bool ENV_NO_FIBER_PROBE #f)
    (fiber-probe-skipped "no_fiber_probe_flag")
    (if (equal? (env-get "AURA_BIN" "") "")
      (fiber-probe-skipped "aura_binary_missing")
      (let* ((oneshot (fiber-oneshot-ok?))
             (multi (if oneshot (fiber-same-flatast-multi-ok?) #f))
             (backend (try (fiber:spawn-backend) (catch (e) 0)))
             (serve (fiber-serve-session-ok?))
             (live (and oneshot multi))
             (session (if live SESSION_FIBER SESSION_SHARED))
             (reason (if live
                       (if serve "fiber_denseness_and_serve_ok"
                         "fiber_denseness_in_process_ok")
                       (if oneshot "same_flatast_multi_failed"
                         "oneshot_fiber_spawn_join_failed")))
             (missing (if live
                        "orch/worldline may use fiber_graph when fiber_live (slice 3)"
                        (if oneshot
                          "same-FlatAST multi-candidate denseness failed"
                          "fiber:spawn+join unavailable in this session"))))
        (hash "probed" #t
              "skipped" #f
              "reason" reason
              "oneshot_fiber_ok" oneshot
              "same_flatast_multi_ok" multi
              "serve_session_ok" serve
              "serve_cross_session_shared_ast" #f
              "fiber_live" live
              "session_model" session
              "spawn_backend" backend
              "available" live
              "notes" "fiber:spawn denseness (fiber-spawn.md); backend 1=scheduler 2=thread; AURA_BUILD_FIBER_SESSION_OK cannot force fiber_live"
              "missing_surface" missing)))))

(define (apply-fiber-probe report probe)
  (hash-set! report "fiber_live" (hash-ref probe "fiber_live" #f))
  (hash-set! report "session_model" (hash-ref probe "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
  (hash-set! report "fiber_probe" probe)
  report)

(define (env-notes-for incr-ok fiber-ok)
  (let* ((env-incr (env-bool ENV_INCR #f))
         (env-fiber (env-bool ENV_FIBER #f))
         (ignore-incr (and env-incr (not incr-ok)))
         (ignore-fiber (and env-fiber (not fiber-ok))))
    (if ignore-fiber
      (if ignore-incr
        (list "env_ignored_unproven" "env_fiber_ignored_unproven")
        (list "env_fiber_ignored_unproven"))
      (if ignore-incr
        (list "env_ignored_unproven")
        (list "none")))))

(define (prove-or-refuse cycles pressure)
  (let ((bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (if (equal? bin "")
      (let ((r (empty-report "aura_binary_missing")))
        (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
        (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
        (apply-fiber-probe r (fiber-probe-skipped "aura_binary_missing"))
        r)
      (let loop ((i 0) (storm (list)) (ok-n 0) (incr-n 0))
        (if (>= i cycles)
          (let* ((proven (and (= ok-n cycles) (= incr-n cycles) (> cycles 0)))
                 (reason (if proven "storm_incr_valid_measured"
                           (if (= ok-n cycles) "incr_valid_incomplete" "storm_cycles_failed")))
                 (r (empty-report reason)))
            (hash-set! r "measured" #t)
            (hash-set! r "aura_healthy" #t)
            (hash-set! r "incr_proven" proven)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_requested" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_completed" cycles)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_ok" ok-n)
            (hash-set! r "cycles_incr_valid" incr-n)
            (hash-set! r "worldline_pressure" pressure)
            (hash-set! r "storm" (reverse storm))
            (apply-fiber-probe r (probe-fiber-session))
            r)
          (let* ((pr (pressure-cycles i pressure))
                 (storm2 (append (car pr) storm))
                 (ok-n2 (if (car (cdr pr)) (+ ok-n 1) ok-n))
                 (incr-n2 (if (and (car (cdr pr)) (car (cdr (cdr pr)))) (+ incr-n 1) incr-n)))
            (loop (+ i 1) storm2 ok-n2 incr-n2)))))))

(define (write-prove-report report root)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (write-file p (json-encode report))
    p))

(define (load-prove-report root)
  (let ((p (default-prove-path root)))
    (if (file-exists? p)
      (json-parse (read-file p))
      #f)))

; Attach honesty into traj runtime — never invent true from env alone.
(define (attach-prove-metadata root)
  (let ((rep (load-prove-report root)))
    (if (not rep)
      (hash "attached" #t
            "incr_proven" #f
            "measured" #f
            "fiber_live" #f
            "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
            "reason" "no_prove_report"
            "env_notes" (env-notes-for #f #f)
            "fiber_probe" (hash))
      (let* ((proven (hash-ref rep "incr_proven" #f))
             (measured (hash-ref rep "measured" #f))
             (incr (if (and proven measured) #t #f))
             (fiber (hash-ref rep "fiber_live" #f))
             (probe (hash-ref rep "fiber_probe" (hash))))
        (hash "attached" #t
              "incr_proven" incr
              "measured" measured
              "fiber_live" (if fiber #t #f)
              "session_model" (hash-ref rep "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
              "reason" (hash-ref rep "reason" "")
              "env_notes" (env-notes-for incr fiber)
              "fiber_probe" probe
              "report_ts" (hash-ref rep "ts" ""))))))

(define (merge-prove-into-runtime runtime fields)
  (hash-set! runtime "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "measured" (hash-ref fields "measured" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "fiber_live" (hash-ref fields "fiber_live" #f))
  (hash-set! runtime "session_model"
             (hash-ref fields "session_model" SESSION_SHARED))
  (hash-set! runtime "prove_incr" fields)
  runtime)

(define (doctor-snapshot root)
  (let* ((rep (load-prove-report root))
         (bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" ""))
         (fields (attach-prove-metadata root))
         (probe (probe-fiber-session))
         (l1 (l1-doctor-info root))
         (last (hash-ref l1 "last" #f))
         (l1-backend (if last (hash-ref last "l1_backend" (hash-ref l1 "preferred"))
                       (hash-ref l1 "preferred")))
         (fiber-live (hash-ref probe "fiber_live" #f))
         (session (hash-ref probe "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)))
    (hash "aura_bin" bin
          "aura_probe_ok" (not (equal? bin ""))
          "aura_probe_error" (if (equal? bin "") "aura_binary_missing" "")
          "prove_incr_report_path" (default-prove-path root)
          "prove_incr_latest" (if rep rep #f)
          "l1" l1
          "honesty" (hash "incr_proven" (hash-ref fields "incr_proven")
                          "fiber_live" fiber-live
                          "session_model" session
                          "l3_online" #f
                          "l1_backend" l1-backend)
          "fiber" (hash "fiber_live" fiber-live
                        "oneshot_fiber_ok" (hash-ref probe "oneshot_fiber_ok" #f)
                        "same_flatast_multi_ok" (hash-ref probe "same_flatast_multi_ok" #f)
                        "serve_session_ok" (hash-ref probe "serve_session_ok" #f)
                        "serve_cross_session_shared_ast" (hash-ref probe "serve_cross_session_shared_ast" #f)
                        "spawn_backend" (hash-ref probe "spawn_backend" 0)
                        "reason" (hash-ref probe "reason" "")
                        "probed" (hash-ref probe "probed" #f)
                        "missing_surface" (hash-ref probe "missing_surface" "")
                        "fiber_probe" probe)
          "tips" (list "kernel=Aura"
                       "run aura-build prove-incr with healthy AURA_BIN"

input.source:
; aura-build KERNEL — Soft observe-steer from existing Aura query:* faces
;
; Prefer landed observability keys (no new mid-struct counters, no rename):
;   query:incremental-relower-stats
;     relower_skipped_entirely_count
;     partial_forced_full_by_impact_total
;     incremental_relower_cold_miss_total
;   query:dirty-cascade-stats
;   query:soa-dirty-stats
;   query:type-linear-commit-health / query:mutation-hold-* / steal residual
;     when Soft can invoke them (measured present below).
;
; Soft observe ≠ Hard proof: counter rise on Soft is guidance only.
; Steering: accuracy first; press fanout only when correctness gates green;
; if gates red (force-full / cold-miss / cascade-parity / soa-desync storm) →
; shrink worldlines / MiniMax / explorer — do not burn harder.
(export
  observe-query-keys
  observe-sample-stats
  observe-gate
  observe-steer
  observe-apply-to-swarm
  run-observe-steer-round)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define OBSERVE_PROFILE "leet_observe")
(define SWARM_PROFILE "leet_swarm")

; Exact faces Soft can invoke today (rg + Soft -e probe; do not invent).
(define (observe-query-keys)
  (list "query:incremental-relower-stats"
        "query:dirty-cascade-stats"
        "query:soa-dirty-stats"
        "query:type-linear-commit-health"
        "query:mutation-hold-estimate"
        "query:mutation-hold-live"
        "query:work-steal-stats"
        "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))

(define (observe-num h key)
  ; Soft hash-ref on these query faces returns numbers when present.
  (let ((v (hash-ref h key -1)))
    (if (number? v) v -1)))

(define (observe-sample-one facade)
  (let* ((h (engine:metrics facade))
         (ok (and (hash? h) (> (length (hash-keys h)) 0)))
         (nkeys (if (hash? h) (length (hash-keys h)) 0)))
    (cond
      ((equal? facade "query:incremental-relower-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "relower_skipped_entirely_count"
             (observe-num h "relower_skipped_entirely_count")
             "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"
             (observe-num h "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total")
             "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"
             (observe-num h "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total")
             "cold-miss-total" (observe-num h "cold-miss-total")
             "full-fallbacks" (observe-num h "full-fallbacks")
             "partial-relowers" (observe-num h "partial-relowers")))
      ((equal? facade "query:dirty-cascade-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "cascade-nodes-marked-total"
             (observe-num h "cascade-nodes-marked-total")
             "cascade-bfs-hits" (observe-num h "cascade-bfs-hits")
             "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"
             (observe-num h "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total")
             "hybrid-deferred-cascade-total"
             (observe-num h "hybrid-deferred-cascade-total")
             "cascade-skip-subtree-total"
             (observe-num h "cascade-skip-subtree-total")))
      ((equal? facade "query:soa-dirty-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "soa-dirty-desync-detected-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-desync-detected-total")
             "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total")
             "soa_dirty_desync_detected_total"
             (observe-num h "soa_dirty_desync_detected_total")
             "soa-dirty-finish-cascade-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-finish-cascade-total")
             "schema-4168" (observe-num h "schema-4168")))
      ((equal? facade "query:type-linear-commit-health")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "readiness-bp" (observe-num h "readiness-bp")
             "occurrence-stale" (observe-num h "occurrence-stale")
             "coercion-evidence-loss-bp"
             (observe-num h "coercion-evidence-loss-bp")
             "pending-full-solve-residual-escalate-total"
             (observe-num h "pending-full-solve-residual-escalate-total")
             "schema-2613" (observe-num h "schema-2613")))
      ((equal? facade "query:mutation-hold-estimate")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "hold-us-p50" (observe-num h "hold-us-p50")
             "hold-us-p99" (observe-num h "hold-us-p99")
             "recommend-split" (observe-num h "recommend-split")
             "budget-us" (observe-num h "budget-us")
             "schema-2405" (observe-num h "schema-2405")))
      ((equal? facade "query:mutation-hold-live")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "over-budget" (observe-num h "over-budget")
             "live-over-budget-observe-total"
             (observe-num h "live-over-budget-observe-total")
             "held" (observe-num h "held")
             "schema-2517" (observe-num h "schema-2517")))
      ((equal? facade "query:work-steal-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "steal-attempts" (observe-num h "steal-attempts")
             "steal-successes" (observe-num h "steal-successes")
             "steal-violations" (observe-num h "steal-violations")
             "steal-deferred-mutation"
             (observe-num h "steal-deferred-mutation")))
      ((equal? facade "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total"
             (observe-num h "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total")
             "post-steal-linear-hard-fail-total"
             (observe-num h "post-steal-linear-hard-fail-total")
             "linear-provenance-ok"
             (observe-num h "linear-provenance-ok")))
      (#t (hash "facade" facade "ok" ok "nkeys" nkeys)))))

(define (observe-sample-stats)
  (let loop ((ks (observe-query-keys)) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? ks)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "samples" (reverse acc)
            "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
            "note" "Soft observe guidance only; not Hard proof"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (loop (cdr ks) (cons (observe-sample-one (car ks)) acc)))))

(define (observe-find-sample samples facade)
  (let loop ((xs samples))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) (hash))
      ((equal? (hash-ref (car xs) "facade" "") facade) (car xs))
      (#t (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (observe-pos n)
  ; Treat missing (-1) as 0 for gate math; present zeros stay 0.
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 0)) n 0))

(define (observe-delta cur prev key)
  (- (observe-pos (hash-ref cur key -1))
     (observe-pos (hash-ref prev key -1))))

(define (observe-gate sample-bundle prev-bundle accuracy-ok)
  ; correctness gates from Aura query faces; accuracy-ok from host/Soft feedback.
  (let* ((samples (hash-ref sample-bundle "samples" (list)))
         (prev-samples (if (hash? prev-bundle)
                         (hash-ref prev-bundle "samples" (list))
                         (list)))
         (rel (observe-find-sample samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (prev-rel (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (cas (observe-find-sample samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (prev-cas (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (soa (observe-find-sample samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (prev-soa (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (tl (observe-find-sample samples "query:type-linear-commit-health"))
         (mh (observe-find-sample samples "query:mutation-hold-live"))
         (ps (observe-find-sample samples "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))
         (d-force (observe-delta rel prev-rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"))
         (d-cold (observe-delta rel prev-rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"))
         (d-parity (observe-delta cas prev-cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"))
         (d-soa-ff (observe-delta soa prev-soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"))
         (force-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" 0)))
         (cold-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" 0)))
         (parity-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" 0)))
         (soa-ff-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" 0)))
         (ready-bp (hash-ref tl "readiness-bp" -1))
         (ready-red (and (number? ready-bp) (>= ready-bp 0) (< ready-bp 5000)))
         (hold-red (or (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "over-budget" 0)) 0)
                       (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "live-over-budget-observe-total" 0)) 0)))
         (steal-red (> (observe-pos (hash-ref ps "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total" 0)) 0))
         ; Rising force-full / cold-miss / parity / soa force-full ⇒ red.
         ; Absolute parity/soa-ff/steal hard-fail also red (correctness).
         (storm-red (or (> d-force 0) (> d-cold 0) (> d-parity 0) (> d-soa-ff 0)
                        (> parity-abs 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0) ready-red hold-red steal-red))
         (acc-ok (if (boolean? accuracy-ok) accuracy-ok #t))
         (gate (cond
                 ((not acc-ok) "red")
                 (storm-red "red")
                 ; amber: lifetime force-full present but not rising this sample
                 ((or (> force-abs 0) (> cold-abs 0)) "amber")
                 (#t "green")))
         (reasons (list)))
    (if (not acc-ok)
      (set! reasons (cons "accuracy_red" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-force 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-cold 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "cold_miss_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-parity 0) (> parity-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "cascade_parity_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-soa-ff 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "soa_desync_force_full" reasons))
      #t)
    (if ready-red
      (set! reasons (cons "type_linear_readiness_low" reasons))
      #t)
    (if hold-red
      (set! reasons (cons "mutation_hold_over_budget" reasons))
      #t)
    (if steal-red
      (set! reasons (cons "post_steal_linear_hard_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (and (equal? gate "amber") (null? reasons))
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_or_cold_lifetime" reasons))
      #t)
    (hash "gate" gate
          "accuracy_ok" acc-ok
          "storm_red" storm-red
          "reasons" (reverse reasons)
          "deltas" (hash "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" d-force
                         "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" d-cold
                         "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" d-parity
                         "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" d-soa-ff)
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" "Soft observe ≠ Hard; guidance only")))

(define (observe-steer gate-h)
  ; accuracy first; green → can raise / keep diverge; red → shrink fanout.
  (let* ((gate (hash-ref gate-h "gate" "amber"))
         (sticky (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_DIVERGE_STICKY" #t))
         (wl (cond
               ((equal? gate "green") (if sticky 256 256))
               ((equal? gate "amber") 128)
               (#t 64)))
         (explorer (cond
                     ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                     ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                     (#t 16)))
         (minimax (cond
                    ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                    ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                    (#t 16)))
         (n-mut (cond
                  ((equal? gate "green") 48)
                  ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                  (#t 16)))
         ; red: lean mutate+rule (less MiniMax burn); green: full mix
         (mix (cond
                ((equal? gate "red") (list "rule" "mutate"))
                (#t (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))))
         (press (equal? gate "green")))
    (hash "gate" gate
          "worldlines_prefer" wl
          "explorer_cap_prefer" explorer
          "minimax_cap_prefer" minimax
          "n_mut" n-mut
          "mix" mix
          "press_fanout" press
          "diverge_sticky" (and sticky press)
          "path" "observe_steer"
          "kernel" "aura"
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" (if press
                   "gates_green→can_raise_fanout"
                   "gates_red_or_amber→shrink_or_rebalance_no_harder_burn"))))

(define (observe-apply-to-swarm harness-root steer)
  ; Persist Soft knobs for thin host; also mirror into leet_swarm prefer fields.
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "steer" steer)
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "gate" (hash-ref steer "gate" "amber"))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "worldlines_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 64))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "explorer_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "minimax_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "minimax_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "n_mut" (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "mix" (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "press_fanout"
              (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t)
  ; Mirror into leet_swarm so swarm_mutate_candidates / diverge knobs see Soft brain.
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "worldlines_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 64))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "explorer_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "n_mut" (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "mix" (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "diverge_sticky"
              (hash-ref steer "diverge_sticky" #f))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "observe_gate" (hash-ref steer "gate" "amber"))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "observe_press_fanout"
              (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
  steer)

(define (run-observe-steer-round)
  (let* ((harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (acc-s (env-get "AURA_BUILD_ACC_OK" "true"))
         (acc-ok (equal? acc-s "true"))
         (prev (memory-list harness OBSERVE_PROFILE))
         (prev-sample (hash-ref prev "last_sample" (hash)))
         (sample (observe-sample-stats))
         (gate (observe-gate sample prev-sample acc-ok))
         (steer (observe-steer gate))
         (_ (memory-set harness OBSERVE_PROFILE "last_sample" sample))
         (_2 (memory-set harness OBSERVE_PROFILE "last_gate" gate))
         (_3 (memory-set harness OBSERVE_PROFILE "last_slug" slug))
         (_4 (observe-apply-to-swarm harness steer)))
    (display "observe_steer ok=true kernel=aura gate=")
    (display (hash-ref gate "gate" ""))
    (display " press=")(display (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
    (display " wl=")(display (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 0))
    (display " explorer=")(display (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 0))
    (display " minimax=")(display (hash-ref steer "minimax_cap_prefer" 0))
    (display " n_mut=")(display (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 0))
    (display " mix=")(display (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
    (display " soft_observe_ne_hard=true")
    (display " slug=")(display slug)
    (display " reasons=")(display (hash-ref gate "reasons" (list)))
    (newline)
    (hash "ok" #t
          "kernel" "aura"
          "slug" slug
          "sample" sample
          "gate" gate
          "steer" steer
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "query_keys" (observe-query-keys))))

(lambda (sample-bundle prev-bundle accuracy-ok) ; Storm from Aura query faces only. accuracy_ok is transform feedback —
  ; accuracy_red ≠ Soft storm (do not drive red shrink). Soft observe ≠ Hard.
  (let* ((samples (hash-ref sample-bundle "samples" (list)))
         (prev-samples (if (hash? prev-bundle)
                         (hash-ref prev-bundle "samples" (list))
                         (list)))
         (rel (observe-find-sample samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (prev-rel (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (cas (observe-find-sample samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (prev-cas (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (soa (observe-find-sample samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (prev-soa (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (tl (observe-find-sample samples "query:type-linear-commit-health"))
         (mh (observe-find-sample samples "query:mutation-hold-live"))
         (ps (observe-find-sample samples "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))
         (d-force (observe-delta rel prev-rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"))
         (d-cold (observe-delta rel prev-rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"))
         (d-parity (observe-delta cas prev-cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"))
         (d-soa-ff (observe-delta soa prev-soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"))
         (force-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" 0)))
         (cold-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" 0)))
         (parity-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" 0)))
         (soa-ff-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" 0)))
         (ready-bp (hash-ref tl "readiness-bp" -1))
         (ready-red (and (number? ready-bp) (>= ready-bp 0) (< ready-bp 5000)))
         (hold-red (or (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "over-budget" 0)) 0)
                       (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "live-over-budget-observe-total" 0)) 0)))
         (steal-red (> (observe-pos (hash-ref ps "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total" 0)) 0))
         ; Rising force-full / cold-miss / parity / soa force-full ⇒ Soft storm red.
         ; Absolute parity/soa-ff/steal hard-fail also storm-red (observability).
         (storm-red (or (> d-force 0) (> d-cold 0) (> d-parity 0) (> d-soa-ff 0)
                        (> parity-abs 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0) ready-red hold-red steal-red))
         (acc-ok (if (boolean? accuracy-ok) accuracy-ok #t))
         (accuracy-signal (not acc-ok))
         ; Gate color from Soft storm / lifetime amber ONLY — not accuracy_red.
         ; accuracy_red alone: keep green press (or amber if lifetime force/cold).
         (gate (cond
                 (storm-red "red")
                 ; amber: lifetime force-full/cold present but not rising this sample
                 ((or (> force-abs 0) (> cold-abs 0)) "amber")
                 (#t "green")))
         (reasons (list)))
    ; accuracy_red is a reason/note only — does NOT force gate=red shrink.
    (if accuracy-signal
      (set! reasons (cons "accuracy_red" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-force 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-cold 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "cold_miss_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-parity 0) (> parity-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "cascade_parity_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-soa-ff 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "soa_desync_force_full" reasons))
      #t)
    (if ready-red
      (set! reasons (cons "type_linear_readiness_low" reasons))
      #t)
    (if hold-red
      (set! reasons (cons "mutation_hold_over_budget" reasons))
      #t)
    (if steal-red
      (set! reasons (cons "post_steal_linear_hard_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (and (equal? gate "amber")
             (not (member "force_full_rising" reasons))
             (not (member "cold_miss_rising" reasons))
             (or (> force-abs 0) (> cold-abs 0)))
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_or_cold_lifetime" reasons))
      #t)
    (hash "gate" gate
          "accuracy_ok" acc-ok
          "accuracy_signal" accuracy-signal
          "storm_red" storm-red
          "reasons" (reverse reasons)
          "deltas" (hash "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" d-force
                         "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" d-cold
                         "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" d-parity
                         "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" d-soa-ff)
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" (if accuracy-signal
                   "accuracy_red≠Soft_storm; Soft observe ≠ Hard; guidance only"
                   "Soft observe ≠ Hard; guidance only"))))
