; Prefer landed observability keys (no new mid-struct counters, no rename):
;   query:incremental-relower-stats
;     relower_skipped_entirely_count
;     partial_forced_full_by_impact_total
;     incremental_relower_cold_miss_total
;   query:dirty-cascade-stats
;   query:soa-dirty-stats
;   query:type-linear-commit-health / query:mutation-hold-* / steal residual
;     when Soft can invoke them (measured present below).
;
; Soft observe ≠ Hard proof: counter rise on Soft is guidance only.
; Steering: accuracy first; press fanout only when correctness gates green;
; if gates red (force-full / cold-miss / cascade-parity / soa-desync storm) →
; shrink worldlines / MiniMax / explorer — do not burn harder.
(export
  observe-query-keys
  observe-sample-stats
  observe-gate
  observe-steer
  observe-apply-to-swarm
  run-observe-steer-round)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define OBSERVE_PROFILE "leet_observe")
(define SWARM_PROFILE "leet_swarm")

; Exact faces Soft can invoke today (rg + Soft -e probe; do not invent).
(define (observe-query-keys)
  (list "query:incremental-relower-stats"
        "query:dirty-cascade-stats"
        "query:soa-dirty-stats"
        "query:type-linear-commit-health"
        "query:mutation-hold-estimate"
        "query:mutation-hold-live"
        "query:work-steal-stats"
        "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))

(define (observe-num h key)
  ; Soft hash-ref on these query faces returns numbers when present.
  (let ((v (hash-ref h key -1)))
    (if (number? v) v -1)))

(define (observe-sample-one facade)
  (let* ((h (engine:metrics facade))
         (ok (and (hash? h) (> (length (hash-keys h)) 0)))
         (nkeys (if (hash? h) (length (hash-keys h)) 0)))
    (cond
      ((equal? facade "query:incremental-relower-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "relower_skipped_entirely_count"
             (observe-num h "relower_skipped_entirely_count")
             "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"
             (observe-num h "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total")
             "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"
             (observe-num h "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total")
             "cold-miss-total" (observe-num h "cold-miss-total")
             "full-fallbacks" (observe-num h "full-fallbacks")
             "partial-relowers" (observe-num h "partial-relowers")))
      ((equal? facade "query:dirty-cascade-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "cascade-nodes-marked-total"
             (observe-num h "cascade-nodes-marked-total")
             "cascade-bfs-hits" (observe-num h "cascade-bfs-hits")
             "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"
             (observe-num h "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total")
             "hybrid-deferred-cascade-total"
             (observe-num h "hybrid-deferred-cascade-total")
             "cascade-skip-subtree-total"
             (observe-num h "cascade-skip-subtree-total")))
      ((equal? facade "query:soa-dirty-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "soa-dirty-desync-detected-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-desync-detected-total")
             "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total")
             "soa_dirty_desync_detected_total"
             (observe-num h "soa_dirty_desync_detected_total")
             "soa-dirty-finish-cascade-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-finish-cascade-total")
             "schema-4168" (observe-num h "schema-4168")))
      ((equal? facade "query:type-linear-commit-health")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "readiness-bp" (observe-num h "readiness-bp")
             "occurrence-stale" (observe-num h "occurrence-stale")
             "coercion-evidence-loss-bp"
             (observe-num h "coercion-evidence-loss-bp")
             "pending-full-solve-residual-escalate-total"
             (observe-num h "pending-full-solve-residual-escalate-total")
             "schema-2613" (observe-num h "schema-2613")))
      ((equal? facade "query:mutation-hold-estimate")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "hold-us-p50" (observe-num h "hold-us-p50")
             "hold-us-p99" (observe-num h "hold-us-p99")
             "recommend-split" (observe-num h "recommend-split")
             "budget-us" (observe-num h "budget-us")
             "schema-2405" (observe-num h "schema-2405")))
      ((equal? facade "query:mutation-hold-live")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "over-budget" (observe-num h "over-budget")
             "live-over-budget-observe-total"
             (observe-num h "live-over-budget-observe-total")
             "held" (observe-num h "held")
             "schema-2517" (observe-num h "schema-2517")))
      ((equal? facade "query:work-steal-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "steal-attempts" (observe-num h "steal-attempts")
             "steal-successes" (observe-num h "steal-successes")
             "steal-violations" (observe-num h "steal-violations")
             "steal-deferred-mutation"
             (observe-num h "steal-deferred-mutation")))
      ((equal? facade "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total"
             (observe-num h "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total")
             "post-steal-linear-hard-fail-total"
             (observe-num h "post-steal-linear-hard-fail-total")
             "linear-provenance-ok"
             (observe-num h "linear-provenance-ok")))
      (#t (hash "facade" facade "ok" ok "nkeys" nkeys)))))

(define (observe-sample-stats)
  (let loop ((ks (observe-query-keys)) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? ks)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "samples" (reverse acc)
            "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
            "note" "Soft observe guidance only; not Hard proof"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (loop (cdr ks) (cons (observe-sample-one (car ks)) acc)))))

(define (observe-find-sample samples facade)
  (let loop ((xs samples))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) (hash))
      ((equal? (hash-ref (car xs) "facade" "") facade) (car xs))
      (#t (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (observe-pos n)
  ; Treat missing (-1) as 0 for gate math; present zeros stay 0.
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 0)) n 0))

(define (observe-delta cur prev key)
  (- (observe-pos (hash-ref cur key -1))
     (observe-pos (hash-ref prev key -1))))

(define (observe-gate sample-bundle prev-bundle accuracy-ok)
  ; correctness gates from Aura query faces; accuracy-ok from host/Soft feedback.
  (let* ((samples (hash-ref sample-bundle "samples" (list)))
         (prev-samples (if (hash? prev-bundle)
                         (hash-ref prev-bundle "samples" (list))
                         (list)))
         (rel (observe-find-sample samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (prev-rel (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (cas (observe-find-sample samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (prev-cas (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (soa (observe-find-sample samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (prev-soa (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (tl (observe-find-sample samples "query:type-linear-commit-health"))
         (mh (observe-find-sample samples "query:mutation-hold-live"))
         (ps (observe-find-sample samples "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))
         (d-force (observe-delta rel prev-rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"))
         (d-cold (observe-delta rel prev-rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"))
         (d-parity (observe-delta cas prev-cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"))
         (d-soa-ff (observe-delta soa prev-soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"))
         (force-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" 0)))
         (cold-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" 0)))
         (parity-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" 0)))
         (soa-ff-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" 0)))
         (ready-bp (hash-ref tl "readiness-bp" -1))
         (ready-red (and (number? ready-bp) (>= ready-bp 0) (< ready-bp 5000)))
         (hold-red (or (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "over-budget" 0)) 0)
                       (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "live-over-budget-observe-total" 0)) 0)))
         (steal-red (> (observe-pos (hash-ref ps "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total" 0)) 0))
         ; Rising force-full / cold-miss / parity / soa force-full ⇒ red.
         ; Absolute parity/soa-ff/steal hard-fail also red (correctness).
         (storm-red (or (> d-force 0) (> d-cold 0) (> d-parity 0) (> d-soa-ff 0)
                        (> parity-abs 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0) ready-red hold-red steal-red))
         (acc-ok (if (boolean? accuracy-ok) accuracy-ok #t))
         (gate (cond
                 ((not acc-ok) "red")
                 (storm-red "red")
                 ; amber: lifetime force-full present but not rising this sample
                 ((or (> force-abs 0) (> cold-abs 0)) "amber")
                 (#t "green")))
         (reasons (list)))
    (if (not acc-ok)
      (set! reasons (cons "accuracy_red" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-force 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-cold 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "cold_miss_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-parity 0) (> parity-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "cascade_parity_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-soa-ff 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "soa_desync_force_full" reasons))
      #t)
    (if ready-red
      (set! reasons (cons "type_linear_readiness_low" reasons))
      #t)
    (if hold-red
      (set! reasons (cons "mutation_hold_over_budget" reasons))
      #t)
    (if steal-red
      (set! reasons (cons "post_steal_linear_hard_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (and (equal? gate "amber") (null? reasons))
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_or_cold_lifetime" reasons))
      #t)
    (hash "gate" gate
          "accuracy_ok" acc-ok
          "storm_red" storm-red
          "reasons" (reverse reasons)
          "deltas" (hash "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" d-force
                         "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" d-cold
                         "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" d-parity
                         "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" d-soa-ff)
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" "Soft observe ≠ Hard; guidance only")))

(define (observe-steer gate-h)
  ; accuracy first; green → can raise / keep diverge; red → shrink fanout.
  (let* ((gate (hash-ref gate-h "gate" "amber"))
         (sticky (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_DIVERGE_STICKY" #t))
         (wl (cond
               ((equal? gate "green") (if sticky 256 256))
               ((equal? gate "amber") 128)
               (#t 64)))
         (explorer (cond
                     ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                     ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                     (#t 16)))
         (minimax (cond
                    ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                    ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                    (#t 16)))
         (n-mut (cond
                  ((equal? gate "green") 48)
                  ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                  (#t 16)))
         ; red: lean mutate+rule (less MiniMax burn); green: full mix
         (mix (cond
                ((equal? gate "red") (list "rule" "mutate"))
                (#t (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))))
         (press (equal? gate "green")))
    (hash "gate" gate
          "worldlines_prefer" wl
          "explorer_cap_prefer" explorer
          "minimax_cap_prefer" minimax
          "n_mut" n-mut
          "mix" mix
          "press_fanout" press
          "diverge_sticky" (and sticky press)
          "path" "observe_steer"
          "kernel" "aura"
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" (if press
                   "gates_green→can_raise_fanout"
                   "gates_red_or_amber→shrink_or_rebalance_no_harder_burn"))))

(define (observe-apply-to-swarm harness-root steer)
  ; Persist Soft knobs for thin host; also mirror into leet_swarm prefer fields.
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "steer" steer)
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "gate" (hash-ref steer "gate" "amber"))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "worldlines_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 64))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "explorer_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "minimax_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "minimax_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "n_mut" (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "mix" (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "press_fanout"
              (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t)
  ; Mirror into leet_swarm so swarm_mutate_candidates / diverge knobs see Soft brain.
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "worldlines_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 64))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "explorer_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "n_mut" (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "mix" (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "diverge_sticky"
              (hash-ref steer "diverge_sticky" #f))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "observe_gate" (hash-ref steer "gate" "amber"))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "observe_press_fanout"
              (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
  steer)

(define (run-observe-steer-round)
  (let* ((harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (acc-s (env-get "AURA_BUILD_ACC_OK" "true"))
         (acc-ok (equal? acc-s "true"))
         (prev (memory-list harness OBSERVE_PROFILE))
         (prev-sample (hash-ref prev "last_sample" (hash)))
         (sample (observe-sample-stats))
         (gate (observe-gate sample prev-sample acc-ok))
         (steer (observe-steer gate))
         (_ (memory-set harness OBSERVE_PROFILE "last_sample" sample))
         (_2 (memory-set harness OBSERVE_PROFILE "last_gate" gate))
         (_3 (memory-set harness OBSERVE_PROFILE "last_slug" slug))
         (_4 (observe-apply-to-swarm harness steer)))
    (display "observe_steer ok=true kernel=aura gate=")
    (display (hash-ref gate "gate" ""))
    (display " press=")(display (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
    (display " wl=")(display (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 0))
    (display " explorer=")(display (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 0))
    (display " minimax=")(display (hash-ref steer "minimax_cap_prefer" 0))
    (display " n_mut=")(display (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 0))
    (display " mix=")(display (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
    (display " soft_observe_ne_hard=true")
    (display " slug=")(display slug)
    (display " reasons=")(display (hash-ref gate "reasons" (list)))
    (newline)
    (hash "ok" #t
          "kernel" "aura"
          "slug" slug
          "sample" sample
          "gate" gate
          "steer" steer
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "query_keys" (observe-query-keys))))

(lambda (gate-h) ; Soft storm_red → shrink fanout. accuracy_signal alone does NOT drop llm
  ; or crush explorer — gate color already excludes accuracy_red→red.
  (let* ((gate (hash-ref gate-h "gate" "amber"))
         (storm (hash-ref gate-h "storm_red" #f))
         (acc-sig (hash-ref gate-h "accuracy_signal" #f))
         (sticky (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_DIVERGE_STICKY" #t))
         (wl (cond
               ((equal? gate "green") (if sticky 256 256))
               ((equal? gate "amber") 128)
               (#t 64)))
         (explorer (cond
                     ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                     ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                     (#t 16)))
         (minimax (cond
                    ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                    ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                    (#t 16)))
         (n-mut (cond
                  ((equal? gate "green") 48)
                  ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                  (#t 16)))
         ; red (Soft storm only): lean mutate+rule; green/amber keep llm
         (mix (cond
                ((equal? gate "red") (list "rule" "mutate"))
                (#t (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))))
         (press (equal? gate "green")))
    (hash "gate" gate
          "storm_red" storm
          "accuracy_signal" acc-sig
          "worldlines_prefer" wl
          "explorer_cap_prefer" explorer
          "minimax_cap_prefer" minimax
          "n_mut" n-mut
          "mix" mix
          "press_fanout" press
          "diverge_sticky" (and sticky press)
          "path" "observe_steer"
          "kernel" "aura"
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" (cond
                   (press (if acc-sig
                            "query_faces_green+accuracy_red→keep_press_fanout"
                            "gates_green→can_raise_fanout"))
                   ((equal? gate "red")
                    "soft_storm_red→shrink_fanout_no_harder_burn")
                   (#t "gates_amber→rebalance_keep_llm")))))

input.source:
; aura-build KERNEL — Soft observe-steer from existing Aura query:* faces
;
; Prefer landed observability keys (no new mid-struct counters, no rename):
;   query:incremental-relower-stats
;     relower_skipped_entirely_count
;     partial_forced_full_by_impact_total
;     incremental_relower_cold_miss_total
;   query:dirty-cascade-stats
;   query:soa-dirty-stats
;   query:type-linear-commit-health / query:mutation-hold-* / steal residual
;     when Soft can invoke them (measured present below).
;
; Soft observe ≠ Hard proof: counter rise on Soft is guidance only.
; Steering: accuracy first; press fanout only when correctness gates green;
; if gates red (force-full / cold-miss / cascade-parity / soa-desync storm) →
; shrink worldlines / MiniMax / explorer — do not burn harder.
(export
  observe-query-keys
  observe-sample-stats
  observe-gate
  observe-steer
  observe-apply-to-swarm
  run-observe-steer-round)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define OBSERVE_PROFILE "leet_observe")
(define SWARM_PROFILE "leet_swarm")

; Exact faces Soft can invoke today (rg + Soft -e probe; do not invent).
(define (observe-query-keys)
  (list "query:incremental-relower-stats"
        "query:dirty-cascade-stats"
        "query:soa-dirty-stats"
        "query:type-linear-commit-health"
        "query:mutation-hold-estimate"
        "query:mutation-hold-live"
        "query:work-steal-stats"
        "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))

(define (observe-num h key)
  ; Soft hash-ref on these query faces returns numbers when present.
  (let ((v (hash-ref h key -1)))
    (if (number? v) v -1)))

(define (observe-sample-one facade)
  (let* ((h (engine:metrics facade))
         (ok (and (hash? h) (> (length (hash-keys h)) 0)))
         (nkeys (if (hash? h) (length (hash-keys h)) 0)))
    (cond
      ((equal? facade "query:incremental-relower-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "relower_skipped_entirely_count"
             (observe-num h "relower_skipped_entirely_count")
             "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"
             (observe-num h "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total")
             "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"
             (observe-num h "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total")
             "cold-miss-total" (observe-num h "cold-miss-total")
             "full-fallbacks" (observe-num h "full-fallbacks")
             "partial-relowers" (observe-num h "partial-relowers")))
      ((equal? facade "query:dirty-cascade-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "cascade-nodes-marked-total"
             (observe-num h "cascade-nodes-marked-total")
             "cascade-bfs-hits" (observe-num h "cascade-bfs-hits")
             "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"
             (observe-num h "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total")
             "hybrid-deferred-cascade-total"
             (observe-num h "hybrid-deferred-cascade-total")
             "cascade-skip-subtree-total"
             (observe-num h "cascade-skip-subtree-total")))
      ((equal? facade "query:soa-dirty-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "soa-dirty-desync-detected-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-desync-detected-total")
             "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total")
             "soa_dirty_desync_detected_total"
             (observe-num h "soa_dirty_desync_detected_total")
             "soa-dirty-finish-cascade-total"
             (observe-num h "soa-dirty-finish-cascade-total")
             "schema-4168" (observe-num h "schema-4168")))
      ((equal? facade "query:type-linear-commit-health")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "readiness-bp" (observe-num h "readiness-bp")
             "occurrence-stale" (observe-num h "occurrence-stale")
             "coercion-evidence-loss-bp"
             (observe-num h "coercion-evidence-loss-bp")
             "pending-full-solve-residual-escalate-total"
             (observe-num h "pending-full-solve-residual-escalate-total")
             "schema-2613" (observe-num h "schema-2613")))
      ((equal? facade "query:mutation-hold-estimate")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "hold-us-p50" (observe-num h "hold-us-p50")
             "hold-us-p99" (observe-num h "hold-us-p99")
             "recommend-split" (observe-num h "recommend-split")
             "budget-us" (observe-num h "budget-us")
             "schema-2405" (observe-num h "schema-2405")))
      ((equal? facade "query:mutation-hold-live")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "over-budget" (observe-num h "over-budget")
             "live-over-budget-observe-total"
             (observe-num h "live-over-budget-observe-total")
             "held" (observe-num h "held")
             "schema-2517" (observe-num h "schema-2517")))
      ((equal? facade "query:work-steal-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "steal-attempts" (observe-num h "steal-attempts")
             "steal-successes" (observe-num h "steal-successes")
             "steal-violations" (observe-num h "steal-violations")
             "steal-deferred-mutation"
             (observe-num h "steal-deferred-mutation")))
      ((equal? facade "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats")
       (hash "facade" facade
             "ok" ok
             "nkeys" nkeys
             "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total"
             (observe-num h "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total")
             "post-steal-linear-hard-fail-total"
             (observe-num h "post-steal-linear-hard-fail-total")
             "linear-provenance-ok"
             (observe-num h "linear-provenance-ok")))
      (#t (hash "facade" facade "ok" ok "nkeys" nkeys)))))

(define (observe-sample-stats)
  (let loop ((ks (observe-query-keys)) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? ks)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "samples" (reverse acc)
            "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
            "note" "Soft observe guidance only; not Hard proof"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (loop (cdr ks) (cons (observe-sample-one (car ks)) acc)))))

(define (observe-find-sample samples facade)
  (let loop ((xs samples))
    (cond
      ((null? xs) (hash))
      ((equal? (hash-ref (car xs) "facade" "") facade) (car xs))
      (#t (loop (cdr xs))))))

(define (observe-pos n)
  ; Treat missing (-1) as 0 for gate math; present zeros stay 0.
  (if (and (number? n) (>= n 0)) n 0))

(define (observe-delta cur prev key)
  (- (observe-pos (hash-ref cur key -1))
     (observe-pos (hash-ref prev key -1))))

(define (observe-gate sample-bundle prev-bundle accuracy-ok)
  ; correctness gates from Aura query faces; accuracy-ok from host/Soft feedback.
  (let* ((samples (hash-ref sample-bundle "samples" (list)))
         (prev-samples (if (hash? prev-bundle)
                         (hash-ref prev-bundle "samples" (list))
                         (list)))
         (rel (observe-find-sample samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (prev-rel (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:incremental-relower-stats"))
         (cas (observe-find-sample samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (prev-cas (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:dirty-cascade-stats"))
         (soa (observe-find-sample samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (prev-soa (observe-find-sample prev-samples "query:soa-dirty-stats"))
         (tl (observe-find-sample samples "query:type-linear-commit-health"))
         (mh (observe-find-sample samples "query:mutation-hold-live"))
         (ps (observe-find-sample samples "query:post-steal-closed-loop-stats"))
         (d-force (observe-delta rel prev-rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total"))
         (d-cold (observe-delta rel prev-rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total"))
         (d-parity (observe-delta cas prev-cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total"))
         (d-soa-ff (observe-delta soa prev-soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total"))
         (force-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" 0)))
         (cold-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref rel "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" 0)))
         (parity-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref cas "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" 0)))
         (soa-ff-abs (observe-pos (hash-ref soa "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" 0)))
         (ready-bp (hash-ref tl "readiness-bp" -1))
         (ready-red (and (number? ready-bp) (>= ready-bp 0) (< ready-bp 5000)))
         (hold-red (or (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "over-budget" 0)) 0)
                       (> (observe-pos (hash-ref mh "live-over-budget-observe-total" 0)) 0)))
         (steal-red (> (observe-pos (hash-ref ps "post_steal_linear_hard_fail_total" 0)) 0))
         ; Rising force-full / cold-miss / parity / soa force-full ⇒ red.
         ; Absolute parity/soa-ff/steal hard-fail also red (correctness).
         (storm-red (or (> d-force 0) (> d-cold 0) (> d-parity 0) (> d-soa-ff 0)
                        (> parity-abs 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0) ready-red hold-red steal-red))
         (acc-ok (if (boolean? accuracy-ok) accuracy-ok #t))
         (gate (cond
                 ((not acc-ok) "red")
                 (storm-red "red")
                 ; amber: lifetime force-full present but not rising this sample
                 ((or (> force-abs 0) (> cold-abs 0)) "amber")
                 (#t "green")))
         (reasons (list)))
    (if (not acc-ok)
      (set! reasons (cons "accuracy_red" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-force 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (> d-cold 0)
      (set! reasons (cons "cold_miss_rising" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-parity 0) (> parity-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "cascade_parity_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (or (> d-soa-ff 0) (> soa-ff-abs 0))
      (set! reasons (cons "soa_desync_force_full" reasons))
      #t)
    (if ready-red
      (set! reasons (cons "type_linear_readiness_low" reasons))
      #t)
    (if hold-red
      (set! reasons (cons "mutation_hold_over_budget" reasons))
      #t)
    (if steal-red
      (set! reasons (cons "post_steal_linear_hard_fail" reasons))
      #t)
    (if (and (equal? gate "amber") (null? reasons))
      (set! reasons (cons "force_full_or_cold_lifetime" reasons))
      #t)
    (hash "gate" gate
          "accuracy_ok" acc-ok
          "storm_red" storm-red
          "reasons" (reverse reasons)
          "deltas" (hash "partial_forced_full_by_impact_total" d-force
                         "incremental_relower_cold_miss_total" d-cold
                         "dual-dep-graph-parity-fail-total" d-parity
                         "soa-dirty-desync-force-full-total" d-soa-ff)
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" "Soft observe ≠ Hard; guidance only")))

(define (observe-steer gate-h)
  ; accuracy first; green → can raise / keep diverge; red → shrink fanout.
  (let* ((gate (hash-ref gate-h "gate" "amber"))
         (sticky (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_DIVERGE_STICKY" #t))
         (wl (cond
               ((equal? gate "green") (if sticky 256 256))
               ((equal? gate "amber") 128)
               (#t 64)))
         (explorer (cond
                     ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                     ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                     (#t 16)))
         (minimax (cond
                    ((equal? gate "green") 64)
                    ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                    (#t 16)))
         (n-mut (cond
                  ((equal? gate "green") 48)
                  ((equal? gate "amber") 32)
                  (#t 16)))
         ; red: lean mutate+rule (less MiniMax burn); green: full mix
         (mix (cond
                ((equal? gate "red") (list "rule" "mutate"))
                (#t (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))))
         (press (equal? gate "green")))
    (hash "gate" gate
          "worldlines_prefer" wl
          "explorer_cap_prefer" explorer
          "minimax_cap_prefer" minimax
          "n_mut" n-mut
          "mix" mix
          "press_fanout" press
          "diverge_sticky" (and sticky press)
          "path" "observe_steer"
          "kernel" "aura"
          "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t
          "note" (if press
                   "gates_green→can_raise_fanout"
                   "gates_red_or_amber→shrink_or_rebalance_no_harder_burn"))))

(define (observe-apply-to-swarm harness-root steer)
  ; Persist Soft knobs for thin host; also mirror into leet_swarm prefer fields.
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "steer" steer)
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "gate" (hash-ref steer "gate" "amber"))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "worldlines_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 64))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "explorer_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "minimax_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "minimax_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "n_mut" (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "mix" (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "press_fanout"
              (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
  (memory-set harness-root OBSERVE_PROFILE "soft_observe_ne_hard" #t)
  ; Mirror into leet_swarm so swarm_mutate_candidates / diverge knobs see Soft brain.
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "worldlines_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "worldlines_prefer" 64))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "explorer_cap_prefer"
              (hash-ref steer "explorer_cap_prefer" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "n_mut" (hash-ref steer "n_mut" 16))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "mix" (hash-ref steer "mix" (list)))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "diverge_sticky"
              (hash-ref steer "diverge_sticky" #f))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "observe_gate" (hash-ref steer "gate" "amber"))
  (memory-set harness-root SWARM_PROFILE "observe_press_fanout"
              (hash-ref steer "press_fanout" #f))
  steer)

(define (run-observe-steer-round)
  (let* ((harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (acc-s (env-get "AURA_BUILD_ACC_OK" "true"))
         (acc-ok (equal? acc-s "true"))
         (prev (memory-list harness OBSERVE_PROFILE))

; aura-build kernel — shared workspace stable refs (layout matches Python worldline.py)
; NOT fiber-live FlatAST.
(export
  SESSION_SHARED
  workspace-create workspace-fork-note workspace-discard-losers
  workspace-discard-one workspace-runtime-fields)

(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "traj" all:)

(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")

(define (workspace-create root n)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "parent"))
  (write-file (join-path root "parent" "SNAPSHOT") "parent_id=wl-parent\n")
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "candidates"))
  (let loop ((i 0) (cands (hash)) (cand-meta (hash)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (let* ((ws (hash "root" root
                       "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                       "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                       "candidates" cands
                       "n" n))
             (meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                         "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                         "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                        "parent_ref" #f
                                        "workspace_relpath" "parent"
                                        "kind" "parent")
                         "candidates" cand-meta
                         "discarded" (list)
                         "incr_proven" #f
                         "fiber_live" #f
                         "honesty" "shared workspace + stable refs; not fiber-live")))
        (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                    (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
        ws)
      (let* ((cid (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))
             (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
             (cdir (join-path root rel)))
        (ensure-dir cdir)
        (write-file (join-path cdir "REF")
                    (string-append "ref_id=" cid "\nparent_ref=wl-parent\n"))
        (hash-set! cands cid cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
                   (hash "ref_id" cid
                         "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                         "workspace_relpath" rel
                         "kind" "candidate"))
        (loop (+ i 1) cands cand-meta)))))

(define (workspace-fork-note ws cid summary)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (payload (hash "op" "worldline_fork"
                        "target_id" (string-append "stable:" cid)
                        "summary" summary
                        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                        "stable_ref" cid
                        "workspace_relpath" rel)))
    (write-file (join-path cdir "mutation.json") (json-encode payload))
    payload))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (car xs)
      (cons (car xs) (filter-truth (cdr xs)))
      (filter-truth (cdr xs)))))

(define (workspace-discard-losers ws selected-id fitness-by-id)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (cands (hash-ref ws "candidates"))
         (keys (hash-keys cands))
         (recs (map (lambda (cid)
                      (if (equal? cid selected-id)
                        #f
                        (let* ((fit (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0))
                               (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
                               (rec (hash "id" cid
                                          "reason" "lower_fitness"
                                          "fitness" fit
                                          "stable_ref" cid)))
                          (write-file (join-path root rel "DISCARDED")
                                      (json-encode rec))
                          rec)))
                    keys))
         (kept (filter-truth recs)))
    (let ((meta-path (join-path root "meta.json")))
      (if (file-exists? meta-path)
        (let ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path))))
          (hash-set! meta "discarded" kept)
          (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
        #t))
    kept))


(define (filter pred xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (pred (car xs))
      (cons (car xs) (filter pred (cdr xs)))
      (filter pred (cdr xs)))))


(define (workspace-discard-one root ref-id reason fitness)
  ; Mark a single candidate discarded (ACP hook). Audit-only; not fiber-live.
  (let* ((rel (string-append "candidates/" ref-id))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (meta-path (join-path root "meta.json"))
         (why (if (or (null? reason) (equal? reason "")) "acp_discard" reason))
         (rec (hash "id" ref-id
                    "reason" why
                    "fitness" fitness
                    "stable_ref" ref-id)))
    (if (not (file-exists? cdir))
      #f
      (begin
        (write-file (join-path cdir "DISCARDED") (json-encode rec))
        (if (file-exists? meta-path)
          (let* ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path)))
                 (prev (hash-ref meta "discarded" (list)))
                 (kept (filter (lambda (d) (not (equal? (hash-ref d "id" "") ref-id))) prev)))
            (hash-set! meta "discarded" (append kept (list rec)))
            (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
          #t)
        rec))))


(define (workspace-runtime-fields ws)
  (hash "workspace" (hash-ref ws "root")
        "session_model" (hash-ref ws "session_model")
        "parent_ref" (hash-ref ws "parent_ref")
        "stable_refs" (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates"))
        "fiber_live" #f))

(define (workspace-discard-one root ref-id reason fitness)
  ; Mark a single candidate discarded (ACP hook). Audit-only; not fiber-live.
  (let* ((rel (string-append "candidates/" ref-id))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (meta-path (join-path root "meta.json"))
         (why (if (or (null? reason) (equal? reason "")) "acp_discard" reason))
         (rec (hash "id" ref-id
                    "reason" why
                    "fitness" fitness
                    "stable_ref" ref-id)))
    (if (not (file-exists? cdir))
      #f
      (begin
        (write-file (join-path cdir "DISCARDED") (json-encode rec))
        (if (file-exists? meta-path)
          (let* ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path)))
                 (prev (hash-ref meta "discarded" (list)))
                 (kept (filter (lambda (d) (not (equal? (hash-ref d "id" "") ref-id))) prev)))
            (hash-set! meta "discarded" (append kept (list rec)))
            (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
          #t)
        rec))))

(define (workspace-runtime-fields ws)
  (hash "workspace" (hash-ref ws "root")
        "session_model" (hash-ref ws "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
        "parent_ref" (hash-ref ws "parent_ref" "wl-parent")
        "stable_refs" (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates" (hash)))
        "fiber_live" (hash-ref ws "fiber_live" #f)
        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE)))

; --- decide backend (honest; env alone cannot elevate) -----------------
; probe-live? is a thunk returning fiber denseness hash (from prove).
; Never claim fiber_graph unless probe says fiber_live.

(define (decide-worldline-backend probe-live?)
  ; fiber_live = denseness probe (never from env alone).
  ; worldline_backend = fiber_graph only when probe live AND not forced file.
  (let* ((req (string-downcase (env-get ENV_WL_BACKEND "auto")))
         (force-file (or (equal? req "file") (equal? req "files")))
         (force-fiber (or (equal? req "fiber_graph") (equal? req "fiber")))
         (probe (if (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_NO_FIBER_PROBE" #f)
                  (hash "fiber_live" #f "reason" "no_fiber_probe_flag" "probed" #f)
                  (probe-live?)))
         (live (and (hash? probe) (hash-ref probe "fiber_live" #f)))
         ; Env force-fiber cannot elevate without live probe.
         (use-fiber (and live (not force-file)))
         (session (if live SESSION_FIBER SESSION_SHARED))
         (reason (if use-fiber
                   (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_denseness_ok")
                   (if force-file
                     (if live "forced_file_backend_while_fiber_live" "forced_file_backend")
                     (if force-fiber
                       (if live "fiber_graph" "fiber_graph_requested_but_probe_failed")
                       (if (hash? probe)
                         (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_probe_failed")
                         "fiber_probe_unavailable"))))))
    (hash "worldline_backend" (if use-fiber BACKEND_FIBER BACKEND_FILE)
          "fiber_live" (if live #t #f)
          "session_model" session
          "probe" (if (hash? probe) probe (hash))
          "requested" req
          "reason" reason)))

; --- fiber graph fan-out (same FlatAST) --------------------------------

(define (wl-name i)
  (string-append "wl" (number->string i)))

(define (wl-id i)
  (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))

(define (build-fiber-prelude n)
  ; Install wl0..wl{n-1} stubs + call-wl dispatcher on one FlatAST.
  (let loop ((i 0) (defs "") (arms ""))
    (if (>= i n)
      (string-append defs
                     "(define (call-wl i arg) (cond " arms " (else #f)))")
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (string-append defs "(define (" (wl-name i) " n) (+ n 0))")
            (string-append arms "((= i " (number->string i) ") (" (wl-name i) " arg))")))))

(define (fiber-audit-write root n backend session live ids discarded)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((cand-meta (hash)))
    (for-each
      (lambda (cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
          (hash "ref_id" cid
                "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                "kind" "fiber_candidate"
                "workspace_relpath" #f)))
      ids)
    (let ((meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                      "session_model" session
                      "worldline_backend" backend
                      "fiber_live" live
                      "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                     "kind" "parent"
                                     "parent_ref" #f)
                      "candidates" cand-meta
                      "discarded" discarded
                      "incr_proven" #f
                      "honesty" "same-FlatAST fiber:spawn fan-out; not file candidates/")))
      (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                  (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
      meta)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (fiber-discard-losers selected-id fitness-by-id ids)
  (filter-truth
    (map (lambda (cid)
           (if (equal? cid selected-id)
             #f
             (hash "id" cid
                   "reason" "lower_fitness"
                   "fitness" (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0)
                   "stable_ref" cid
                   "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
         ids)))

(define (fiber-runtime-fields root n live session ids)
  (hash "workspace" root
        "session_model" session
        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
        "stable_refs" ids
        "fiber_live" live
        "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
        "fiber_candidate_count" n))

(define (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)
  (let ((name (wl-name i))
        (tag (string-append "fiber-wl-" (number->string i))))
    (fiber:spawn
      (lambda ()
        (try
          (begin
            (mutate:rebind name
              (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
              tag)
            (eval-current)
            bump)
          (catch (e) #f))))))

(define (join-all fids)
  (map (lambda (fid)
         (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))
           (try (fiber:join fid) (catch (e) #f))
           #f))
       fids))

(define (spawn-aura-fibers n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)) (meta (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (list (reverse fids) (reverse meta))
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (let ((fid (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)))
          (let ((ok-fid (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))))
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if ok-fid fid #f) fids)
                  (cons (hash "id" (wl-id i)
                              "index" i
                              "bump" bump
                              "fiber_id" (if ok-fid fid #f)
                              "spawn_ok" ok-fid)
                        meta))))))))

(define (make-aura-wl m i j)
  (let ((bump (hash-ref m "bump"))
        (cid (hash-ref m "id"))
        (spawn-ok (hash-ref m "spawn_ok")))
    (let ((join-ok (and spawn-ok (number? j) (= j bump))))
      (let ((val (if join-ok (try (call-wl i 40) (catch (e) #f)) #f)))
        (let ((expected (+ 40 bump)))
          (let ((ok (and join-ok (number? val) (= val expected))))
            (let ((fitness (if ok
                             (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo i 4))))
                             (if join-ok 0.45 0.1))))
              (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_mutate_rebind"
                               "target_id" (string-append (wl-name i) ":" (number->string i))
                               "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn mutate:rebind bump="
                                                        (number->string bump))
                               "bump" bump
                               "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
                (hash "id" cid
                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                      "stable_ref" cid
                      "mutations" (list mut)
                      "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                                   "passed" ok
                                   "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                                   "tests_total" 1
                                                   "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                   "audit_ok" ok
                                                   "aura_value" val
                                                   "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                                                   "incr_proven" #f)
                                   "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph mutate+eval"))))))))))

(define (eval-aura-joins meta joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs meta) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((m (car xs))
            (j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cdr xs)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-aura-wl m i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit-root)
  (begin
    (set-code (build-fiber-prelude n))
    (eval-current)
    (let ((spawned (spawn-aura-fibers n)))
      (let ((fids (car spawned))
            (meta (car (list-drop spawned 1))))
        (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
          (let ((evaluated (eval-aura-joins meta joins)))
            (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
              (begin
                (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
                  (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
                  #t)
                (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                      "ids" ids
                      "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                      "fiber_live" #t
                      "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                      "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                      "workspace" audit-root)))))))))

(define (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse fids)
      (let ((idx i))
        (let ((fid (fiber:spawn
                     (lambda ()
                       (let ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed idx)))
                         (hash "fitness" fitness
                               "passed" (>= fitness 0.3)
                               "index" idx))))))
          (begin
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0)) fid #f) fids))))))))

(define (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j)
  (let ((cid (wl-id i))
        (ok-join (hash? j)))
    (let ((fitness (if ok-join (hash-ref j "fitness") (default-fitness prompt seed i))))
      (let ((passed (if ok-join (hash-ref j "passed") (>= fitness 0.3))))
        (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_simulated_edit"
                         "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                         "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn sim candidate "
                                                  (number->string i)
                                                  " for: "
                                                  (string-take prompt 80))
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
          (hash "id" cid
                "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                "stable_ref" cid
                "mutations" (list mut)
                "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                             "passed" passed
                             "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                             "tests_total" 1
                                             "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* i 3))
                                             "audit_ok" #t
                                             "incr_proven" #f)
                             "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph simulated eval")))))))

(define (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit-root)
  (let ((fids (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)))
    (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
      (let ((evaluated (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)))
        (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
          (begin
            (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
              (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
              #t)
            (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                  "ids" ids
                  "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                  "fiber_live" #t
                  "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                  "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                  "workspace" audit-root)))))))

input.source:
; aura-build kernel — worldline fan-out (file layout OR same-FlatAST fiber graph)
; Slice 3: when fiber denseness is live, prefer fiber:spawn / mutate:rebind fan-out.
; When probe fails: file parent/candidates/wl-N + mutate:rebind; never fake fiber_live.
(export
  SESSION_SHARED SESSION_FIBER
  BACKEND_FILE BACKEND_FIBER
  workspace-create workspace-fork-note workspace-discard-losers
  workspace-discard-one workspace-runtime-fields
  decide-worldline-backend
  fiber-fanout-aura fiber-fanout-sim fiber-discard-losers
  fiber-runtime-fields fiber-audit-write)

; Soft gap fill: util string-take/list-take/list-drop/list-tail/make-list (+ soft_* denseness).
(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "traj" all:)

(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")
(define SESSION_FIBER "fiber_denseness_in_process")
(define BACKEND_FILE "file")
(define BACKEND_FIBER "fiber_graph")
(define ENV_WL_BACKEND "AURA_BUILD_WORLDLINE_BACKEND")

; --- file layout (M2; kept when fiber probe fails) ---------------------

(define (workspace-create root n)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "parent"))
  (write-file (join-path root "parent" "SNAPSHOT") "parent_id=wl-parent\n")
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "candidates"))
  (let loop ((i 0) (cands (hash)) (cand-meta (hash)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (let* ((ws (hash "root" root
                       "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                       "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                       "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                       "fiber_live" #f
                       "candidates" cands
                       "n" n))
             (meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                         "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                         "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                        "parent_ref" #f
                                        "workspace_relpath" "parent"
                                        "kind" "parent")
                         "candidates" cand-meta
                         "discarded" (list)
                         "incr_proven" #f
                         "fiber_live" #f
                         "honesty" "shared workspace + stable refs; not fiber-live")))
        (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                    (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
        ws)
      (let* ((cid (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))
             (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
             (cdir (join-path root rel)))
        (ensure-dir cdir)
        (write-file (join-path cdir "REF")
                    (string-append "ref_id=" cid "\nparent_ref=wl-parent\n"))
        (hash-set! cands cid cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
                   (hash "ref_id" cid
                         "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                         "workspace_relpath" rel
                         "kind" "candidate"))
        (loop (+ i 1) cands cand-meta)))))

(define (workspace-fork-note ws cid summary)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (payload (hash "op" "worldline_fork"
                        "target_id" (string-append "stable:" cid)
                        "summary" summary
                        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                        "stable_ref" cid
                        "workspace_relpath" rel
                        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE))))
    (write-file (join-path cdir "mutation.json") (json-encode payload))
    payload))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (car xs)
      (cons (car xs) (filter-truth (cdr xs)))
      (filter-truth (cdr xs)))))

(define (workspace-discard-losers ws selected-id fitness-by-id)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (cands (hash-ref ws "candidates"))
         (keys (hash-keys cands))
         (recs (map (lambda (cid)
                      (if (equal? cid selected-id)
                        #f
                        (let* ((fit (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0))
                               (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
                               (rec (hash "id" cid
                                          "reason" "lower_fitness"
                                          "fitness" fit
                                          "stable_ref" cid)))
                          (write-file (join-path root rel "DISCARDED")
                                      (json-encode rec))
                          rec)))
                    keys))
         (kept (filter-truth recs)))
    (let ((meta-path (join-path root "meta.json")))
      (if (file-exists? meta-path)
        (let ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path))))
          (hash-set! meta "discarded" kept)
          (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
        #t))
    kept))

(define (filter pred xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (pred (car xs))
      (cons (car xs) (filter pred (cdr xs)))
      (filter pred (cdr xs)))))

(define (workspace-discard-one root ref-id reason fitness)
  ; Mark a single candidate discarded (ACP hook). Audit-only; not fiber-live.
  (let* ((rel (string-append "candidates/" ref-id))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (meta-path (join-path root "meta.json"))
         (why (if (or (null? reason) (equal? reason "")) "acp_discard" reason))
         (rec (hash "id" ref-id
                    "reason" why
                    "fitness" fitness
                    "stable_ref" ref-id)))
    (if (not (file-exists? cdir))
      #f
      (begin
        (write-file (join-path cdir "DISCARDED") (json-encode rec))
        (if (file-exists? meta-path)
          (let* ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path)))
                 (prev (hash-ref meta "discarded" (list)))
                 (kept (filter (lambda (d) (not (equal? (hash-ref d "id" "") ref-id))) prev)))
            (hash-set! meta "discarded" (append kept (list rec)))
            (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
          #t)
        rec))))

(define (workspace-runtime-fields ws)
  (hash "workspace" (hash-ref ws "root")
        "session_model" (hash-ref ws "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
        "parent_ref" (hash-ref ws "parent_ref" "wl-parent")
        "stable_refs" (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates" (hash)))
        "fiber_live" (hash-ref ws "fiber_live" #f)
        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE)))

; --- decide backend (honest; env alone cannot elevate) -----------------
; probe-live? is a thunk returning fiber denseness hash (from prove).
; Never claim fiber_graph unless probe says fiber_live.

(define (decide-worldline-backend probe-live?)
  ; fiber_live = denseness probe (never from env alone).
  ; worldline_backend = fiber_graph only when probe live AND not forced file.
  (let* ((req (string-downcase (env-get ENV_WL_BACKEND "auto")))
         (force-file (or (equal? req "file") (equal? req "files")))
         (force-fiber (or (equal? req "fiber_graph") (equal? req "fiber")))
         (probe (if (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_NO_FIBER_PROBE" #f)
                  (hash "fiber_live" #f "reason" "no_fiber_probe_flag" "probed" #f)
                  (probe-live?)))
         (live (and (hash? probe) (hash-ref probe "fiber_live" #f)))
         ; Env force-fiber cannot elevate without live probe.
         (use-fiber (and live (not force-file)))
         (session (if live SESSION_FIBER SESSION_SHARED))
         (reason (if use-fiber
                   (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_denseness_ok")
                   (if force-file
                     (if live "forced_file_backend_while_fiber_live" "forced_file_backend")
                     (if force-fiber
                       (if live "fiber_graph" "fiber_graph_requested_but_probe_failed")
                       (if (hash? probe)
                         (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_probe_failed")
                         "fiber_probe_unavailable"))))))
    (hash "worldline_backend" (if use-fiber BACKEND_FIBER BACKEND_FILE)
          "fiber_live" (if live #t #f)
          "session_model" session
          "probe" (if (hash? probe) probe (hash))
          "requested" req
          "reason" reason)))

; --- fiber graph fan-out (same FlatAST) --------------------------------

(define (wl-name i)
  (string-append "wl" (number->string i)))

(define (wl-id i)
  (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))

(define (build-fiber-prelude n)
  ; Install wl0..wl{n-1} stubs + call-wl dispatcher on one FlatAST.
  (let loop ((i 0) (defs "") (arms ""))
    (if (>= i n)
      (string-append defs
                     "(define (call-wl i arg) (cond " arms " (else #f)))")
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (string-append defs "(define (" (wl-name i) " n) (+ n 0))")
            (string-append arms "((= i " (number->string i) ") (" (wl-name i) " arg))")))))

(define (fiber-audit-write root n backend session live ids discarded)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((cand-meta (hash)))
    (for-each
      (lambda (cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
          (hash "ref_id" cid
                "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                "kind" "fiber_candidate"
                "workspace_relpath" #f)))
      ids)
    (let ((meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                      "session_model" session
                      "worldline_backend" backend
                      "fiber_live" live
                      "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                     "kind" "parent"
                                     "parent_ref" #f)
                      "candidates" cand-meta
                      "discarded" discarded
                      "incr_proven" #f
                      "honesty" "same-FlatAST fiber:spawn fan-out; not file candidates/")))
      (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                  (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
      meta)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (fiber-discard-losers selected-id fitness-by-id ids)
  (filter-truth
    (map (lambda (cid)
           (if (equal? cid selected-id)
             #f
             (hash "id" cid
                   "reason" "lower_fitness"
                   "fitness" (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0)
                   "stable_ref" cid
                   "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
         ids)))

(define (fiber-runtime-fields root n live session ids)
  (hash "workspace" root
        "session_model" session
        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
        "stable_refs" ids
        "fiber_live" live
        "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
        "fiber_candidate_count" n))

(define (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)
  (let ((name (wl-name i))
        (tag (string-append "fiber-wl-" (number->string i))))
    (fiber:spawn
      (lambda ()
        (try
          (begin
            (mutate:rebind name
              (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
              tag)
            (eval-current)
            bump)
          (catch (e) #f))))))

(define (join-all fids)
  (map (lambda (fid)
         (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))
           (try (fiber:join fid) (catch (e) #f))
           #f))
       fids))

(define (spawn-aura-fibers n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)) (meta (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (list (reverse fids) (reverse meta))
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (let ((fid (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)))
          (let ((ok-fid (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))))
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if ok-fid fid #f) fids)
                  (cons (hash "id" (wl-id i)
                              "index" i
                              "bump" bump
                              "fiber_id" (if ok-fid fid #f)
                              "spawn_ok" ok-fid)
                        meta))))))))

(define (make-aura-wl m i j)
  (let ((bump (hash-ref m "bump"))
        (cid (hash-ref m "id"))
        (spawn-ok (hash-ref m "spawn_ok")))
    (let ((join-ok (and spawn-ok (number? j) (= j bump))))
      (let ((val (if join-ok (try (call-wl i 40) (catch (e) #f)) #f)))
        (let ((expected (+ 40 bump)))
          (let ((ok (and join-ok (number? val) (= val expected))))
            (let ((fitness (if ok
                             (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo i 4))))
                             (if join-ok 0.45 0.1))))
              (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_mutate_rebind"
                               "target_id" (string-append (wl-name i) ":" (number->string i))
                               "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn mutate:rebind bump="
                                                        (number->string bump))
                               "bump" bump
                               "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
                (hash "id" cid
                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                      "stable_ref" cid
                      "mutations" (list mut)
                      "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                                   "passed" ok
                                   "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                                   "tests_total" 1
                                                   "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                   "audit_ok" ok
                                                   "aura_value" val
                                                   "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                                                   "incr_proven" #f)
                                   "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph mutate+eval"))))))))))

(define (eval-aura-joins meta joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs meta) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((m (car xs))
            (j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cdr xs)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-aura-wl m i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit-root)
  (begin
    (set-code (build-fiber-prelude n))
    (eval-current)
    (let ((spawned (spawn-aura-fibers n)))
      (let ((fids (car spawned))
            (meta (car (list-drop spawned 1))))
        (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
          (let ((evaluated (eval-aura-joins meta joins)))
            (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
              (begin
                (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
                  (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
                  #t)
                (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                      "ids" ids
                      "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                      "fiber_live" #t
                      "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                      "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                      "workspace" audit-root)))))))))

(define (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse fids)
      (let ((idx i))
        (let ((fid (fiber:spawn
                     (lambda ()
                       (let ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed idx)))
                         (hash "fitness" fitness
                               "passed" (>= fitness 0.3)
                               "index" idx))))))
          (begin
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0)) fid #f) fids))))))))

(define (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j)
  (let ((cid (wl-id i))
        (ok-join (hash? j)))
    (let ((fitness (if ok-join (hash-ref j "fitness") (default-fitness prompt seed i))))
      (let ((passed (if ok-join (hash-ref j "passed") (>= fitness 0.3))))
        (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_simulated_edit"
                         "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                         "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn sim candidate "
                                                  (number->string i)
                                                  " for: "
                                                  (string-take prompt 80))
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
          (hash "id" cid
                "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                "stable_ref" cid
                "mutations" (list mut)
                "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                             "passed" passed
                             "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                             "tests_total" 1
                                             "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* i 3))
                                             "audit_ok" #t
                                             "incr_proven" #f)
                             "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph simulated eval")))))))

(define (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit-root)
  (let ((fids (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)))
    (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
      (let ((evaluated (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)))
        (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
          (begin
            (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
              (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
              #t)
            (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                  "ids" ids
                  "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                  "fiber_live" #t
                  "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                  "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                  "workspace" audit-root)))))))

(lambda (selected-id fitness-by-id ids) ; Prefer Soft-native delete (tip 25c8ae0 / #4226 CLOSED) then map losers.
  (map (lambda (cid)
         (hash "id" cid
               "reason" "lower_fitness"
               "fitness" (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0)
               "stable_ref" cid
               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER))
       (delete selected-id ids)))
