input.source:
; aura-build kernel — worldline fan-out (file layout OR same-FlatAST fiber graph)
; Slice 3: when fiber denseness is live, prefer fiber:spawn / mutate:rebind fan-out.
; When probe fails: file parent/candidates/wl-N + mutate:rebind; never fake fiber_live.
(export
  SESSION_SHARED SESSION_FIBER
  BACKEND_FILE BACKEND_FIBER
  workspace-create workspace-fork-note workspace-discard-losers
  workspace-discard-one workspace-runtime-fields
  decide-worldline-backend
  fiber-fanout-aura fiber-fanout-sim fiber-discard-losers
  fiber-runtime-fields fiber-audit-write fiber-indices fiber-fitness-extent)

; Soft gap fill: util …/find/count/remove/delete/range/take/drop/any/all (+ soft_* denseness). Soft tip 069bafa (#4154 Soft-zero-extra; #4153 Soft-zero-cost) gold find/count/remove/delete/range/extent/last/filter/any/all + R7RS take/drop — prefer Soft-native. #4228: direct (filter even? …) empty — local define denseness + lambda/let OK.
(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "traj" all:)

(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")
(define SESSION_FIBER "fiber_denseness_in_process")
(define BACKEND_FILE "file")
(define BACKEND_FIBER "fiber_graph")
(define ENV_WL_BACKEND "AURA_BUILD_WORLDLINE_BACKEND")

; --- file layout (M2; kept when fiber probe fails) ---------------------

(define (workspace-create root n)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "parent"))
  (write-file (join-path root "parent" "SNAPSHOT") "parent_id=wl-parent\n")
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "candidates"))
  (let loop ((i 0) (cands (hash)) (cand-meta (hash)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (let* ((ws (hash "root" root
                       "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                       "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                       "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                       "fiber_live" #f
                       "candidates" cands
                       "n" n))
             (meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                         "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                         "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                        "parent_ref" #f
                                        "workspace_relpath" "parent"
                                        "kind" "parent")
                         "candidates" cand-meta
                         "discarded" (list)
                         "incr_proven" #f
                         "fiber_live" #f
                         "honesty" "shared workspace + stable refs; not fiber-live")))
        (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                    (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
        ws)
      (let* ((cid (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))
             (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
             (cdir (join-path root rel)))
        (ensure-dir cdir)
        (write-file (join-path cdir "REF")
                    (string-append "ref_id=" cid "\nparent_ref=wl-parent\n"))
        (hash-set! cands cid cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
                   (hash "ref_id" cid
                         "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                         "workspace_relpath" rel
                         "kind" "candidate"))
        (loop (+ i 1) cands cand-meta)))))

(define (workspace-fork-note ws cid summary)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (payload (hash "op" "worldline_fork"
                        "target_id" (string-append "stable:" cid)
                        "summary" summary
                        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                        "stable_ref" cid
                        "workspace_relpath" rel
                        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE))))
    (write-file (join-path cdir "mutation.json") (json-encode payload))
    payload))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  ; Prefer Soft-native remove (tip 25c8ae0 / #4224 CLOSED) — drop falsey.
  (remove (lambda (x) (not x)) xs))

(define (workspace-discard-losers ws selected-id fitness-by-id)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (cands (hash-ref ws "candidates"))
         (keys (hash-keys cands))
         (recs (map (lambda (cid)
                      (if (equal? cid selected-id)
                        #f
                        (let* ((fit (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0))
                               (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
                               (rec (hash "id" cid
                                          "reason" "lower_fitness"
                                          "fitness" fit
                                          "stable_ref" cid)))
                          (write-file (join-path root rel "DISCARDED")
                                      (json-encode rec))
                          rec)))
                    keys))
         (kept (filter-truth recs)))
    (let ((meta-path (join-path root "meta.json")))
      (if (file-exists? meta-path)
        (let ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path))))
          (hash-set! meta "discarded" kept)
          (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
        #t))
    kept))

; Prefer Soft-native filter (tip 069bafa gold-binds filter; SRFI-1). Local define =
; denseness defense-in-depth (#4228: Soft oneshot direct (filter even?/odd?/positive?/zero? lst)
; returns empty; let/apply/lambda OK — keep local denseness). Soft shape: (filter pred lst).
(define (filter pred xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (pred (car xs))
      (cons (car xs) (filter pred (cdr xs)))
      (filter pred (cdr xs)))))

(define (workspace-discard-one root ref-id reason fitness)
  ; Mark a single candidate discarded (ACP hook). Audit-only; not fiber-live.
  (let* ((rel (string-append "candidates/" ref-id))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (meta-path (join-path root "meta.json"))
         (why (if (or (null? reason) (equal? reason "")) "acp_discard" reason))
         (rec (hash "id" ref-id
                    "reason" why
                    "fitness" fitness
                    "stable_ref" ref-id)))
    (if (not (file-exists? cdir))
      #f
      (begin
        (write-file (join-path cdir "DISCARDED") (json-encode rec))
        (if (file-exists? meta-path)
          (let* ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path)))
                 (prev (hash-ref meta "discarded" (list)))
                 (kept (filter (lambda (d) (not (equal? (hash-ref d "id" "") ref-id))) prev)))
            (hash-set! meta "discarded" (append kept (list rec)))
            (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))

(define (workspace-runtime-fields ws)
  (hash "workspace" (hash-ref ws "root")
        "session_model" (hash-ref ws "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
        "parent_ref" (hash-ref ws "parent_ref" "wl-parent")
        "stable_refs" (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates" (hash)))
        "fiber_live" (hash-ref ws "fiber_live" #f)
        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE)))

; --- decide backend (honest; env alone cannot elevate) -----------------
; probe-live? is a thunk returning fiber denseness hash (from prove).
; Never claim fiber_graph unless probe says fiber_live.

(define (decide-worldline-backend probe-live?)
  ; fiber_live = denseness probe (never from env alone).
  ; worldline_backend = fiber_graph only when probe live AND not forced file.
  (let* ((req (string-downcase (env-get ENV_WL_BACKEND "auto")))
         (force-file (or (equal? req "file") (equal? req "files")))
         (force-fiber (or (equal? req "fiber_graph") (equal? req "fiber")))
         (probe (if (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_NO_FIBER_PROBE" #f)
                  (hash "fiber_live" #f "reason" "no_fiber_probe_flag" "probed" #f)
                  (probe-live?)))
         (live (and (hash? probe) (hash-ref probe "fiber_live" #f)))
         ; Env force-fiber cannot elevate without live probe.
         (use-fiber (and live (not force-file)))
         (session (if live SESSION_FIBER SESSION_SHARED))
         (reason (if use-fiber
                   (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_denseness_ok")
                   (if force-file
                     (if live "forced_file_backend_while_fiber_live" "forced_file_backend")
                     (if force-fiber
                       (if live "fiber_graph" "fiber_graph_requested_but_probe_failed")
                       (if (hash? probe)
                         (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_probe_failed")
                         "fiber_probe_unavailable"))))))
    (hash "worldline_backend" (if use-fiber BACKEND_FIBER BACKEND_FILE)
          "fiber_live" (if live #t #f)
          "session_model" session
          "probe" (if (hash? probe) probe (hash))
          "requested" req
          "reason" reason)))

; --- fiber graph fan-out (same FlatAST) --------------------------------

(define (wl-name i)
  (string-append "wl" (number->string i)))

(define (wl-id i)
  (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))

(define (build-fiber-prelude n)
  ; Install wl0..wl{n-1} stubs + call-wl dispatcher on one FlatAST.
  (let loop ((i 0) (defs "") (arms ""))
    (if (>= i n)
      (string-append defs
                     "(define (call-wl i arg) (cond " arms " (else #f)))")
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (string-append defs "(define (" (wl-name i) " n) (+ n 0))")
            (string-append arms "((= i " (number->string i) ") (" (wl-name i) " arg))")))))

(define (fiber-audit-write root n backend session live ids discarded)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((cand-meta (hash)))
    (for-each
      (lambda (cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
          (hash "ref_id" cid
                "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                "kind" "fiber_candidate"
                "workspace_relpath" #f)))
      ids)
    (let ((meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                      "session_model" session
                      "worldline_backend" backend
                      "fiber_live" live
                      "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                     "kind" "parent"
                                     "parent_ref" #f)
                      "candidates" cand-meta
                      "discarded" discarded
                      "incr_proven" #f
                      "honesty" "same-FlatAST fiber:spawn fan-out; not file candidates/")))
      (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                  (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
      meta)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (fiber-discard-losers selected-id fitness-by-id ids)
  ; Prefer Soft-native delete (tip 25c8ae0 / #4226 CLOSED) then map losers.
  (map (lambda (cid)
         (hash "id" cid
               "reason" "lower_fitness"
               "fitness" (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0)
               "stable_ref" cid
               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER))
       (delete selected-id ids)))

(define (fiber-runtime-fields root n live session ids)
  (hash "workspace" root
        "session_model" session
        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
        "stable_refs" ids
        "fiber_live" live
        "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
        "fiber_candidate_count" n))

(define (fiber-indices n)
  ; Prefer Soft-native range (tip 069bafa / #4225 CLOSED); util/range defense-in-depth.
  (range 0 n))

(define (fiber-fitness-extent fits)
  ; Prefer Soft-native extent (tip 069bafa / #4225 CLOSED); util/extent defense-in-depth.
  ; fits = list of numeric fitness values from fiber fan-out.
  (extent fits))

(define (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)
  (let ((name (wl-name i))
        (tag (string-append "fiber-wl-" (number->string i))))
    (fiber:spawn
      (lambda ()
        (try
          (begin
            (mutate:rebind name
              (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
              tag)
            (eval-current)
            bump)
          (catch (e) #f))))))

(define (join-all fids)
  (map (lambda (fid)
         (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))
           (try (fiber:join fid) (catch (e) #f))
           #f))
       fids))

(define (spawn-aura-fibers n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)) (meta (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (list (reverse fids) (reverse meta))
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (let ((fid (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)))
          (let ((ok-fid (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))))
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if ok-fid fid #f) fids)
                  (cons (hash "id" (wl-id i)
                              "index" i
                              "bump" bump
                              "fiber_id" (if ok-fid fid #f)
                              "spawn_ok" ok-fid)
                        meta))))))))

(define (make-aura-wl m i j)
  (let ((bump (hash-ref m "bump"))
        (cid (hash-ref m "id"))
        (spawn-ok (hash-ref m "spawn_ok")))
    (let ((join-ok (and spawn-ok (number? j) (= j bump))))
      (let ((val (if join-ok (try (call-wl i 40) (catch (e) #f)) #f)))
        (let ((expected (+ 40 bump)))
          (let ((ok (and join-ok (number? val) (= val expected))))
            (let ((fitness (if ok
                             (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo i 4))))
                             (if join-ok 0.45 0.1))))
              (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_mutate_rebind"
                               "target_id" (string-append (wl-name i) ":" (number->string i))
                               "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn mutate:rebind bump="
                                                        (number->string bump))
                               "bump" bump
                               "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
                (hash "id" cid
                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                      "stable_ref" cid
                      "mutations" (list mut)
                      "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                                   "passed" ok
                                   "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                                   "tests_total" 1
                                                   "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                   "audit_ok" ok
                                                   "aura_value" val
                                                   "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                                                   "incr_proven" #f)
                                   "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph mutate+eval"))))))))))

(define (eval-aura-joins meta joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs meta) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((m (car xs))
            (j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cdr xs)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-aura-wl m i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit-root)
  (begin
    (set-code (build-fiber-prelude n))
    (eval-current)
    (let ((spawned (spawn-aura-fibers n)))
      (let ((fids (car spawned))
            ; Prefer Soft-native drop (tip 069bafa / #4221 CLOSED); util/list-drop fallback.
            (meta (car (drop spawned 1))))
        (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
          (let ((evaluated (eval-aura-joins meta joins)))
            (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
              (begin
                (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
                  (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
                  #t)
                (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                      "ids" ids
                      "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                      "fiber_live" #t
                      "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                      "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                      "workspace" audit-root)))))))))

(define (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse fids)
      (let ((idx i))
        (let ((fid (fiber:spawn
                     (lambda ()
                       (let ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed idx)))
                         (hash "fitness" fitness
                               "passed" (>= fitness 0.3)
                               "index" idx))))))
          (begin
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0)) fid #f) fids))))))))

(define (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j)
  (let ((cid (wl-id i))
        (ok-join (hash? j)))
    (let ((fitness (if ok-join (hash-ref j "fitness") (default-fitness prompt seed i))))
      (let ((passed (if ok-join (hash-ref j "passed") (>= fitness 0.3))))
        (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_simulated_edit"
                         "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                         "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn sim candidate "
                                                  (number->string i)
                                                  " for: "
                                                  (string-take prompt 80))
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
          (hash "id" cid
                "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                "stable_ref" cid
                "mutations" (list mut)
                "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                             "passed" passed
                             "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                             "tests_total" 1
                                             "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* i 3))
                                             "audit_ok" #t
                                             "incr_proven" #f)
                             "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph simulated eval")))))))

(define (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit-root)
  (let ((fids (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)))
    (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
      (let ((evaluated (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)))
        (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
          (begin
            (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
              (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
              #t)
            (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                  "ids" ids
                  "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                  "fiber_live" #t
                  "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                  "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                  "workspace" audit-root)))))))

input.source:
; aura-build kernel — worldline fan-out (file layout OR same-FlatAST fiber graph)
; Slice 3: when fiber denseness is live, prefer fiber:spawn / mutate:rebind fan-out.
; When probe fails: file parent/candidates/wl-N + mutate:rebind; never fake fiber_live.
(export
  SESSION_SHARED SESSION_FIBER
  BACKEND_FILE BACKEND_FIBER
  workspace-create workspace-fork-note workspace-discard-losers
  workspace-discard-one workspace-runtime-fields
  decide-worldline-backend
  fiber-fanout-aura fiber-fanout-sim fiber-discard-losers
  fiber-runtime-fields fiber-audit-write fiber-indices fiber-fitness-extent)

; Soft gap fill: util …/find/count/remove/delete/range/take/drop/any/all (+ soft_* denseness). Soft tip 069bafa (#4154 Soft-zero-extra; #4153 Soft-zero-cost) gold find/count/remove/delete/range/extent/last/filter/any/all + R7RS take/drop — prefer Soft-native. #4228: direct (filter even? …) empty — local define denseness + lambda/let OK.
(require "util" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "traj" all:)

(define SESSION_SHARED "shared_workspace_subprocess")
(define SESSION_FIBER "fiber_denseness_in_process")
(define BACKEND_FILE "file")
(define BACKEND_FIBER "fiber_graph")
(define ENV_WL_BACKEND "AURA_BUILD_WORLDLINE_BACKEND")

; --- file layout (M2; kept when fiber probe fails) ---------------------

(define (workspace-create root n)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "parent"))
  (write-file (join-path root "parent" "SNAPSHOT") "parent_id=wl-parent\n")
  (ensure-dir (join-path root "candidates"))
  (let loop ((i 0) (cands (hash)) (cand-meta (hash)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (let* ((ws (hash "root" root
                       "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                       "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                       "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                       "fiber_live" #f
                       "candidates" cands
                       "n" n))
             (meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                         "session_model" SESSION_SHARED
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE
                         "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                        "parent_ref" #f
                                        "workspace_relpath" "parent"
                                        "kind" "parent")
                         "candidates" cand-meta
                         "discarded" (list)
                         "incr_proven" #f
                         "fiber_live" #f
                         "honesty" "shared workspace + stable refs; not fiber-live")))
        (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                    (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
        ws)
      (let* ((cid (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))
             (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
             (cdir (join-path root rel)))
        (ensure-dir cdir)
        (write-file (join-path cdir "REF")
                    (string-append "ref_id=" cid "\nparent_ref=wl-parent\n"))
        (hash-set! cands cid cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
                   (hash "ref_id" cid
                         "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                         "workspace_relpath" rel
                         "kind" "candidate"))
        (loop (+ i 1) cands cand-meta)))))

(define (workspace-fork-note ws cid summary)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (payload (hash "op" "worldline_fork"
                        "target_id" (string-append "stable:" cid)
                        "summary" summary
                        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                        "stable_ref" cid
                        "workspace_relpath" rel
                        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE))))
    (write-file (join-path cdir "mutation.json") (json-encode payload))
    payload))

(define (filter-truth xs)
  ; Prefer Soft-native remove (tip 25c8ae0 / #4224 CLOSED) — drop falsey.
  (remove (lambda (x) (not x)) xs))

(define (workspace-discard-losers ws selected-id fitness-by-id)
  (let* ((root (hash-ref ws "root"))
         (cands (hash-ref ws "candidates"))
         (keys (hash-keys cands))
         (recs (map (lambda (cid)
                      (if (equal? cid selected-id)
                        #f
                        (let* ((fit (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0))
                               (rel (string-append "candidates/" cid))
                               (rec (hash "id" cid
                                          "reason" "lower_fitness"
                                          "fitness" fit
                                          "stable_ref" cid)))
                          (write-file (join-path root rel "DISCARDED")
                                      (json-encode rec))
                          rec)))
                    keys))
         (kept (filter-truth recs)))
    (let ((meta-path (join-path root "meta.json")))
      (if (file-exists? meta-path)
        (let ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path))))
          (hash-set! meta "discarded" kept)
          (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
        #t))
    kept))

; Prefer Soft-native filter (tip 069bafa gold-binds filter; SRFI-1). Local define =
; denseness defense-in-depth (#4228: Soft oneshot direct (filter even?/odd?/positive?/zero? lst)
; returns empty; let/apply/lambda OK — keep local denseness). Soft shape: (filter pred lst).
(define (filter pred xs)
  (if (null? xs) (list)
    (if (pred (car xs))
      (cons (car xs) (filter pred (cdr xs)))
      (filter pred (cdr xs)))))

(define (workspace-discard-one root ref-id reason fitness)
  ; Mark a single candidate discarded (ACP hook). Audit-only; not fiber-live.
  (let* ((rel (string-append "candidates/" ref-id))
         (cdir (join-path root rel))
         (meta-path (join-path root "meta.json"))
         (why (if (or (null? reason) (equal? reason "")) "acp_discard" reason))
         (rec (hash "id" ref-id
                    "reason" why
                    "fitness" fitness
                    "stable_ref" ref-id)))
    (if (not (file-exists? cdir))
      #f
      (begin
        (write-file (join-path cdir "DISCARDED") (json-encode rec))
        (if (file-exists? meta-path)
          (let* ((meta (json-parse (read-file meta-path)))
                 (prev (hash-ref meta "discarded" (list)))
                 (kept (filter (lambda (d) (not (equal? (hash-ref d "id" "") ref-id))) prev)))
            (hash-set! meta "discarded" (append kept (list rec)))
            (write-file meta-path (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta))))
          #t)
        rec))))

(define (workspace-runtime-fields ws)
  (hash "workspace" (hash-ref ws "root")
        "session_model" (hash-ref ws "session_model" SESSION_SHARED)
        "parent_ref" (hash-ref ws "parent_ref" "wl-parent")
        "stable_refs" (hash-keys (hash-ref ws "candidates" (hash)))
        "fiber_live" (hash-ref ws "fiber_live" #f)
        "worldline_backend" (hash-ref ws "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE)))

; --- decide backend (honest; env alone cannot elevate) -----------------
; probe-live? is a thunk returning fiber denseness hash (from prove).
; Never claim fiber_graph unless probe says fiber_live.

(define (decide-worldline-backend probe-live?)
  ; fiber_live = denseness probe (never from env alone).
  ; worldline_backend = fiber_graph only when probe live AND not forced file.
  (let* ((req (string-downcase (env-get ENV_WL_BACKEND "auto")))
         (force-file (or (equal? req "file") (equal? req "files")))
         (force-fiber (or (equal? req "fiber_graph") (equal? req "fiber")))
         (probe (if (env-bool "AURA_BUILD_NO_FIBER_PROBE" #f)
                  (hash "fiber_live" #f "reason" "no_fiber_probe_flag" "probed" #f)
                  (probe-live?)))
         (live (and (hash? probe) (hash-ref probe "fiber_live" #f)))
         ; Env force-fiber cannot elevate without live probe.
         (use-fiber (and live (not force-file)))
         (session (if live SESSION_FIBER SESSION_SHARED))
         (reason (if use-fiber
                   (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_denseness_ok")
                   (if force-file
                     (if live "forced_file_backend_while_fiber_live" "forced_file_backend")
                     (if force-fiber
                       (if live "fiber_graph" "fiber_graph_requested_but_probe_failed")
                       (if (hash? probe)
                         (hash-ref probe "reason" "fiber_probe_failed")
                         "fiber_probe_unavailable"))))))
    (hash "worldline_backend" (if use-fiber BACKEND_FIBER BACKEND_FILE)
          "fiber_live" (if live #t #f)
          "session_model" session
          "probe" (if (hash? probe) probe (hash))
          "requested" req
          "reason" reason)))

; --- fiber graph fan-out (same FlatAST) --------------------------------

(define (wl-name i)
  (string-append "wl" (number->string i)))

(define (wl-id i)
  (string-append "wl-" (number->string i)))

(define (build-fiber-prelude n)
  ; Install wl0..wl{n-1} stubs + call-wl dispatcher on one FlatAST.
  (let loop ((i 0) (defs "") (arms ""))
    (if (>= i n)
      (string-append defs
                     "(define (call-wl i arg) (cond " arms " (else #f)))")
      (loop (+ i 1)
            (string-append defs "(define (" (wl-name i) " n) (+ n 0))")
            (string-append arms "((= i " (number->string i) ") (" (wl-name i) " arg))")))))

(define (fiber-audit-write root n backend session live ids discarded)
  (ensure-dir root)
  (let ((cand-meta (hash)))
    (for-each
      (lambda (cid)
        (hash-set! cand-meta cid
          (hash "ref_id" cid
                "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                "kind" "fiber_candidate"
                "workspace_relpath" #f)))
      ids)
    (let ((meta (hash "episode_token" (make-id)
                      "session_model" session
                      "worldline_backend" backend
                      "fiber_live" live
                      "parent" (hash "ref_id" "wl-parent"
                                     "kind" "parent"
                                     "parent_ref" #f)
                      "candidates" cand-meta
                      "discarded" discarded
                      "incr_proven" #f
                      "honesty" "same-FlatAST fiber:spawn fan-out; not file candidates/")))
      (write-file (join-path root "meta.json")
                  (normalize-json-empties (json-encode meta)))
      meta)))

(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs) #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

(define (fiber-discard-losers selected-id fitness-by-id ids)
  ; Prefer Soft-native delete (tip 25c8ae0 / #4226 CLOSED) then map losers.
  (map (lambda (cid)
         (hash "id" cid
               "reason" "lower_fitness"
               "fitness" (hash-ref fitness-by-id cid 0.0)
               "stable_ref" cid
               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER))
       (delete selected-id ids)))

(define (fiber-runtime-fields root n live session ids)
  (hash "workspace" root
        "session_model" session
        "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
        "stable_refs" ids
        "fiber_live" live
        "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
        "fiber_candidate_count" n))

(define (fiber-indices n)
  ; Prefer Soft-native range (tip 069bafa / #4225 CLOSED); util/range defense-in-depth.
  (range 0 n))

(define (fiber-fitness-extent fits)
  ; Prefer Soft-native extent (tip 069bafa / #4225 CLOSED); util/extent defense-in-depth.
  ; fits = list of numeric fitness values from fiber fan-out.
  (extent fits))

(define (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)
  (let ((name (wl-name i))
        (tag (string-append "fiber-wl-" (number->string i))))
    (fiber:spawn
      (lambda ()
        (try
          (begin
            (mutate:rebind name
              (string-append "(lambda (n) (+ n " (number->string bump) "))")
              tag)
            (eval-current)
            bump)
          (catch (e) #f))))))

(define (join-all fids)
  (map (lambda (fid)
         (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))
           (try (fiber:join fid) (catch (e) #f))
           #f))
       fids))

(define (spawn-aura-fibers n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)) (meta (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (list (reverse fids) (reverse meta))
      (let ((bump (+ i 1)))
        (let ((fid (fiber-spawn-mutate i bump)))
          (let ((ok-fid (and (number? fid) (> fid 0))))
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if ok-fid fid #f) fids)
                  (cons (hash "id" (wl-id i)
                              "index" i
                              "bump" bump
                              "fiber_id" (if ok-fid fid #f)
                              "spawn_ok" ok-fid)
                        meta))))))))

(define (make-aura-wl m i j)
  (let ((bump (hash-ref m "bump"))
        (cid (hash-ref m "id"))
        (spawn-ok (hash-ref m "spawn_ok")))
    (let ((join-ok (and spawn-ok (number? j) (= j bump))))
      (let ((val (if join-ok (try (call-wl i 40) (catch (e) #f)) #f)))
        (let ((expected (+ 40 bump)))
          (let ((ok (and join-ok (number? val) (= val expected))))
            (let ((fitness (if ok
                             (round4 (+ 0.75 (* 0.05 (modulo i 4))))
                             (if join-ok 0.45 0.1))))
              (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_mutate_rebind"
                               "target_id" (string-append (wl-name i) ":" (number->string i))
                               "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn mutate:rebind bump="
                                                        (number->string bump))
                               "bump" bump
                               "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                               "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
                (hash "id" cid
                      "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                      "stable_ref" cid
                      "mutations" (list mut)
                      "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                                   "passed" ok
                                   "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if ok 1 0)
                                                   "tests_total" 1
                                                   "incr_compile_ms" 0
                                                   "audit_ok" ok
                                                   "aura_value" val
                                                   "fiber_id" (hash-ref m "fiber_id")
                                                   "incr_proven" #f)
                                   "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph mutate+eval"))))))))))

(define (eval-aura-joins meta joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (xs meta) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((m (car xs))
            (j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (cdr xs)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-aura-wl m i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-aura prompt seed n audit-root)
  (begin
    (set-code (build-fiber-prelude n))
    (eval-current)
    (let ((spawned (spawn-aura-fibers n)))
      (let ((fids (car spawned))
            ; Prefer Soft-native drop (tip 069bafa / #4221 CLOSED); util/list-drop fallback.
            (meta (car (drop spawned 1))))
        (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
          (let ((evaluated (eval-aura-joins meta joins)))
            (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
              (begin
                (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
                  (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
                  #t)
                (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                      "ids" ids
                      "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                      "fiber_live" #t
                      "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                      "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                      "workspace" audit-root)))))))))

(define (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (fids (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse fids)
      (let ((idx i))
        (let ((fid (fiber:spawn
                     (lambda ()
                       (let ((fitness (default-fitness prompt seed idx)))
                         (hash "fitness" fitness
                               "passed" (>= fitness 0.3)
                               "index" idx))))))
          (begin
            (loop (+ i 1)
                  (cons (if (and (number? fid) (> fid 0)) fid #f) fids))))))))

(define (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j)
  (let ((cid (wl-id i))
        (ok-join (hash? j)))
    (let ((fitness (if ok-join (hash-ref j "fitness") (default-fitness prompt seed i))))
      (let ((passed (if ok-join (hash-ref j "passed") (>= fitness 0.3))))
        (let ((mut (hash "op" "fiber_simulated_edit"
                         "target_id" (string-append "node:demo:" (number->string i))
                         "summary" (string-append "fiber:spawn sim candidate "
                                                  (number->string i)
                                                  " for: "
                                                  (string-take prompt 80))
                         "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER)))
          (hash "id" cid
                "parent_id" "wl-parent"
                "stable_ref" cid
                "mutations" (list mut)
                "eval" (hash "fitness" fitness
                             "passed" passed
                             "metrics" (hash "tests_passed" (if passed 1 0)
                                             "tests_total" 1
                                             "incr_compile_ms" (+ 5 (* i 3))
                                             "audit_ok" #t
                                             "incr_proven" #f)
                             "notes" "aura-kernel fiber_graph simulated eval")))))))

(define (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)
  (let loop ((i 0) (js joins) (out (list)))
    (if (>= i n)
      (reverse out)
      (let ((j (if (null? js) #f (car js))))
        (loop (+ i 1)
              (if (null? js) js (cdr js))
              (cons (make-sim-wl prompt seed i j) out))))))

(define (fiber-fanout-sim prompt seed n audit-root)
  (let ((fids (spawn-sim-fibers prompt seed n)))
    (let ((joins (join-all fids)))
      (let ((evaluated (eval-sim-joins prompt seed n joins)))
        (let ((ids (map (lambda (w) (hash-ref w "id")) evaluated)))
          (begin
            (if (and audit-root (not (equal? audit-root "")))
              (fiber-audit-write audit-root n BACKEND_FIBER SESSION_FIBER #t ids (list))
              #t)
            (hash "worldlines" evaluated
                  "ids" ids
                  "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FIBER
                  "fiber_live" #t
                  "session_model" SESSION_FIBER
                  "parent_ref" "wl-parent"
                  "workspace" audit-root)))))))

target.name: fiber-fitness-extent
target.body:
(lambda (fits) ; Prefer Soft-native extent (tip fecdf63 / #4225 CLOSED); util/extent defense-in-depth.
  ; fits = list of numeric fitness values from fiber fan-out.
  (extent fits))

; aura-build kernel — shared helpers (env, fs, time, id, fitness)
(export
  env-get env-int env-bool
  ensure-dir append-file dirname-path
  iso-now make-id
  default-fitness seed-from-prompt
  join-path abs-path string-trim string-downcase string-pad string-take string-drop
  list-take list-drop list-tail make-list for-each hash-for-each hash-fold foldr hash-empty? hash->list any all last find count remove delete range
  round4)

(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/process" all:)
(require "std/datetime" all:)
(require "std/uuid" all:)
(require "std/string" all:)

(define (env-get key default)
  (let ((v (getenv key)))
    (if (or (null? v) (equal? v ""))
      default
      v)))

(define (env-int key default)
  (let ((v (env-get key "")))
    (if (equal? v "")
      default
      (let ((n (string->number v)))
        (if (number? n) (floor n) default)))))

(define (string-downcase s)
  (list->string
    (map (lambda (c)
           (if (and (>= c 65) (<= c 90)) (+ c 32) c))
         (string->list s))))

(define (env-bool key default)
  (let ((v (string-downcase (env-get key ""))))
    (if (equal? v "")
      default
      (or (equal? v "1") (equal? v "true") (equal? v "yes") (equal? v "on")))))

(define (string-trim s)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (let l ((i 0))
      (if (or (>= i n) (> (string-ref s i) 32))
        (let r ((j (- n 1)))
          (if (or (< j i) (> (string-ref s j) 32))
            (substring s i (+ j 1))
            (r (- j 1))))
        (l (+ i 1))))))

; Left-pad with spaces to width (Soft oneshot lacks string-pad/make-string;
; Soft denseness path: aura/soft_pad.aura). Used by orch/pursue/harness aligns.
(define (string-pad s width)
  (let ((n (string-length s)))
    (if (>= n width)
      s
      (letrec ((loop (lambda (k acc)
                       (if (<= k 0)
                         (list->string acc)
                         (loop (- k 1) (cons 32 acc))))))
        (string-append (loop (- width n) (list)) s)))))

; First n chars (Soft oneshot lacks string-take; denseness path: aura/soft_take.aura).
; Used by orch/pursue prompt trunc instead of substring+min boilerplate.
(define (string-take s n)
  (let ((len (string-length s)))
    (if (<= n 0)
      ""
      (if (>= n len)
        s
        (substring s 0 n)))))


; Drop first n chars (Soft oneshot lacks string-drop; denseness path: aura/soft_drop.aura).
; Complement of string-take — used by pursue fitness_ge: parse + orch prefix strip.
(define (string-drop s n)
  (let ((len (string-length s)))
    (if (<= n 0)
      s
      (if (>= n len)
        ""
        (substring s n len)))))


; First n list elements (Soft oneshot native `take` returns opaque unprintable;
; denseness path: aura/soft_list_take.aura). Used by orch/worldline to cap
; evaluated/candidate lists (align host FIBER_EXPLORER_CAP honesty).
(define (list-take xs n)
  (letrec ((go (lambda (xs n)
                 (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs))
                   (list)
                   (cons (car xs) (go (cdr xs) (- n 1)))))))
    (go xs n)))


; Drop first n list elements (Soft oneshot native `drop` returns opaque unprintable;
; denseness path: aura/soft_list_drop.aura). Complement of list-take — orch overflow
; honesty after list-take cap; select-best starts with list-drop rest.
(define (list-drop xs n)
  (letrec ((go (lambda (xs n)
                 (if (or (<= n 0) (null? xs))
                   xs
                   (go (cdr xs) (- n 1))))))
    (go xs n)))

; R7RS list-tail ≡ list-drop (Soft oneshot unbound list-tail; denseness: soft_list_drop).
(define (list-tail xs n)
  (list-drop xs n))

; R7RS make-list (Soft oneshot unbound; denseness path: aura/soft_make_list.aura).
; Soft self_evolve_select + leetcode_observe already Soft-gap this primitive.
(define (make-list n fill)
  (if (<= n 0)
    (list)
    (cons fill (make-list (- n 1) fill))))

; R7RS for-each (Soft oneshot unbound; denseness path: aura/soft_for_each.aura).
; orch/worldline/acp/export previously redefined locally — prefer util export.
(define (for-each f xs)
  (if (null? xs)
    #t
    (begin (f (car xs)) (for-each f (cdr xs)))))

; Soft oneshot unbound hash-for-each (orch/harness/export use it; Soft std/hash.aura
; defines it but Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/hash). Denseness path:
; aura/soft_hash_for_each.aura (selected=named-let-keys). Arg order matches Soft
; std/hash and product: (hash-for-each h f) with f := (lambda (k v) ...).
(define (hash-for-each h f)
  (let loop ((ks (hash-keys h)))
    (if (null? ks)
      #t
      (begin (f (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks))) (loop (cdr ks))))))

; Soft oneshot unbound hash-fold (Soft std/hash.aura defines via foldr; Soft oneshot
; lacks foldr + does not auto-load std/hash). Denseness path: aura/soft_hash_fold.aura.
; Soft std shape: (hash-fold h f init) with f := (lambda (k v acc) ...).
(define (hash-fold h f init)
  (let loop ((ks (hash-keys h)) (acc init))
    (if (null? ks)
      acc
      (loop (cdr ks) (f (car ks) (hash-ref h (car ks)) acc)))))


; Soft oneshot has foldl but unbound foldr (Soft std/list.aura defines via reverse+foldl
; #1549; Soft std/hash hash-fold depends on foldr; Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/list).
; Denseness path: aura/soft_foldr.aura (selected=reverse-foldl). Soft std shape:
; (foldr f init lst) with f := (lambda (x acc) ...).
(define (foldr f init lst)
  (foldl (lambda (acc x) (f x acc)) init (reverse lst)))


; Soft oneshot unbound hash-empty? (Soft std/hash.aura defines via hash-length;
; Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/hash). Denseness path: aura/soft_hash_empty.aura
; (selected=hash-length-eq). Soft std shape: (hash-empty? h).
(define (hash-empty? h)
  (= (hash-length h) 0))

; Soft oneshot unbound hash->list (Soft std/hash.aura defines via map+hash-keys+hash-ref;
; Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/hash). Denseness path: aura/soft_hash_to_list.aura
; (selected=map-keys). Soft std shape: (hash->list h) → ((k v) ...).
(define (hash->list h)
  (map (lambda (k) (list k (hash-ref h k))) (hash-keys h)))

; Soft oneshot unbound any (Soft std/list.aura defines iterative any/all #928;
; Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/list). Denseness path: aura/soft_any.aura
; (selected=named-let). Soft std shape: (any pred lst).
(define (any pred lst)
  (let loop ((xs lst))
    (if (null? xs) #f
      (if (pred (car xs)) #t (loop (cdr xs))))))


; Soft oneshot unbound all (Soft std/list.aura defines iterative any/all #928;
; Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/list). Denseness path: aura/soft_all.aura
; (selected=named-let). Soft std shape: (all pred lst).
(define (all pred lst)
  (let loop ((xs lst))
    (if (null? xs) #t
      (if (pred (car xs)) (loop (cdr xs)) #f))))


; Soft oneshot unbound last (Soft std/list.aura defines iterative last;
; Soft oneshot does not auto-load std/list). Denseness path: aura/soft_last.aura
; (selected=named-let). Soft std shape: (last lst); empty → ().
(define (last lst)
  (if (null? lst) (quote ())
    (let loop ((xs lst))
      (if (null? (cdr xs)) (car xs)
        (loop (cdr xs))))))



; Soft tip 7c0952a (#4151) gold-binds find/count/remove/delete/range (+5954717 take). util/soft_find
; remain defense-in-depth. Soft shape: (find pred lst) → first or ().
(define (find pred lst)
  (let loop ((xs lst))
    (if (null? xs) (quote ())
      (if (pred (car xs)) (car xs)
        (loop (cdr xs))))))



; Soft tip 7c0952a gold-binds count on oneshot (std/list). util/soft_count remain
; defense-in-depth. Soft shape: (count pred lst) → integer; empty → 0.
(define (count pred lst)
  (let loop ((xs lst) (n 0))
    (if (null? xs) n
      (loop (cdr xs) (if (pred (car xs)) (+ n 1) n)))))

; Soft tip 7c0952a gold-binds remove on oneshot (std/list; #4224 CLOSED). util/soft_remove
; remain defense-in-depth. Soft shape: (remove pred lst) → elements where pred is false.
(define (remove pred lst)
  (let loop ((xs lst) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs) (reverse acc)
      (loop (cdr xs) (if (pred (car xs)) acc (cons (car xs) acc))))))

; Soft tip 7c0952a gold-binds delete on oneshot (std/list; #4226 CLOSED). util/soft_delete
; remain defense-in-depth. Soft shape: (delete x lst) → equal?-based drop of x.
(define (delete x lst)
  (let loop ((xs lst) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (null? xs) (reverse acc)
      (loop (cdr xs) (if (equal? (car xs) x) acc (cons (car xs) acc))))))

; Soft tip 7c0952a gold-binds range on oneshot (std/list; #4225 CLOSED). Soft shape:
; (range start end) → list [start, end). Prefer Soft-native; no soft_range invent this round
; (combat empty → skip invent). util define = defense-in-depth.
(define (range start end)
  (let loop ((i start) (acc (quote ())))
    (if (>= i end) (reverse acc)
      (loop (+ i 1) (cons i acc)))))

(define (ensure-dir path)
  (sh (string-append "mkdir -p '" path "'"))
  path)

(define (dirname-path path)
  (let ((tmp "/tmp/_aura_build_dirname"))
    (sh (string-append "dirname '" path "' > " tmp " 2>/dev/null"))
    (let ((d (string-trim (read-file tmp))))
      (sh (string-append "rm -f " tmp))
      (if (equal? d "") "." d))))

(define (append-file path line)
  (ensure-dir (dirname-path path))
  (if (file-exists? path)
    (write-file path (string-append (read-file path) line "\n"))
    (write-file path (string-append line "\n")))
  path)

(define (iso-now) (now))

(define *_id_seq* 0)
(define (make-id)
  (set! *_id_seq* (+ *_id_seq* 1))
  (string-append "ep-" (number->string (timestamp-ms)) "-" (number->string *_id_seq*)))

(define (join-path a b)
  (if (or (equal? a "") (equal? a "."))
    b
    (let ((n (string-length a)))
      (if (equal? (substring a (- n 1) n) "/")
        (string-append a b)
        (string-append a "/" b)))))

(define (abs-path p)
  (let ((tmp "/tmp/_aura_build_abspath"))
    (sh (string-append "readlink -f '" p "' > " tmp " 2>/dev/null || echo '" p "' > " tmp))
    (let ((d (string-trim (read-file tmp))))
      (sh (string-append "rm -f " tmp))
      (if (equal? d "") p d))))

(define (round4 x)
  (/ (floor (+ (* x 10000.0) 0.5)) 10000.0))

(define (hex-digit c)
  (if (and (>= c 48) (<= c 57)) (- c 48)
    (if (and (>= c 97) (<= c 102)) (- c 87)
      (if (and (>= c 65) (<= c 70)) (- c 55) 0))))

(define (hex-n->int s n)
  (let loop ((i 0) (acc 0))

; aura-build KERNEL — Soft swarm multi-mutate (product brain; NOT host Python)
;
; Soft std/ant pheromone:rank mutation-operator types; std/pso|abc probe honesty.
; Local multi-mutate via mutate:rebind + worldline/fiber explorers on the Soft
; FlatAST — Soft Ready never invented. Host Python is thin harness only.
;
; Pipeline (LeetCode / combat / pursue):
;   1. (swarm-rank-ops) → Soft-ranked mutate op schedule
;   2. (swarm-mutate-fanout score-fn n) → mutate:rebind candidates scored in Soft
;   3. (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta) → pheromone:update on helpful ops
;   4. Host may seed MiniMax from kernel-written schedule under harness memory
;
; denseness soft_*.aura = temporary; prefer Soft-native. Three-layer split.
(export
  swarm-default-ops
  swarm-rank-ops
  swarm-probe
  swarm-mutate-rebind
  swarm-mutate-fanout
  swarm-observe-gain
  swarm-schedule-write
  run-swarm-mutate-round
  mix-explorers-swarm)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)
(require "std/ant" all:)

; Mutation-type names aligned with Soft std/ant defaults (Issue #2876).
(define (swarm-default-ops)
  (list "edsl-lit-tweak"
        "edsl-op-swap"
        "edsl-body-wrap"
        "full-disp-bool"
        "full-disp-ref"
        "edsl-disp-ref"
        "full-hash-wrap"))

(define (swarm-rank-ops)
  ; Soft ACO rank — host fallback only if Soft fails (caller checks via).
  (pheromone:init)
  (let* ((ops (swarm-default-ops))
         (ranked (pheromone:rank ops)))
    (hash "ok" #t
          "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"
          "ranked_ops" ranked
          "path" "kernel_swarm_rank"
          "kernel" "aura")))

(define (swarm-probe kind)
  ; Honesty probe for Soft std swarm backends. Never invents Soft Ready.
  (cond
    ((equal? kind "ant")
     (let ((r (swarm-rank-ops)))
       (hash "ok" (hash-ref r "ok" #f) "via" (hash-ref r "via" "") "kind" "ant")))
    ((equal? kind "pso")
     (begin
       (require "std/pso" all:)
       (pso:init 1 8 (list (list 0.0 1.0)))
       (pso:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (pso:best)))
         (hash "ok" (number? (if (pair? b) (car b) b))
               "via" "soft_pso"
               "kind" "pso"
               "best" b))))
    ((equal? kind "abc")
     (begin
       (require "std/abc" all:)
       (abc:init 1 8 (list (list -2.0 2.0)))
       (abc:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (abc:best)))
         (hash "ok" #t "via" "soft_abc" "kind" "abc" "best" b))))
    (#t (hash "ok" #f "via" "unknown_kind" "kind" kind))))

; Apply one Soft mutate:rebind of solve → score-fn → restore optional.
; body-src is a string lambda form for mutate:rebind.
(define (swarm-mutate-rebind body-src score-fn)
  (mutate:rebind "solve" body-src "solve-swarm-cand")
  (eval-current)
  (score-fn))

; Fan-out: try several body candidates (list of strings); return best hits + list.
; bodies = ((name . body-src) ...) ; score-fn → number (higher better)
(define (swarm-mutate-fanout bodies score-fn)
  (let loop ((xs bodies) (best-name "") (best-score -1) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "best_name" best-name
            "best_score" best-score
            "n" (length acc)
            "explorers" (reverse acc)
            "path" "kernel_swarm_mutate_rebind"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (let* ((pair (car xs))
             (name (car pair))
             (body (cdr pair))
             (sc (swarm-mutate-rebind body score-fn))
             (nsc (if (number? sc) sc 0))
             (row (hash "name" name "hits" nsc "via" "mutate_rebind")))
        (loop (cdr xs)
              (if (> nsc best-score) name best-name)
              (if (> nsc best-score) nsc best-score)
              (cons row acc))))))

(define (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta)
  ; Reinforce Soft pheromone trails for ops that produced gain.
  (pheromone:init)
  (let loop ((xs op-list))
    (if (null? xs) #t
      (begin
        (pheromone:update (car xs) (if (number? delta) delta 1.0))
        (loop (cdr xs)))))
  (hash "ok" #t "updated" op-list "delta" delta "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"))

(define (swarm-schedule-write harness-root slug ranked probes)
  ; Persist Soft-ranked schedule for thin host MiniMax seed (not Python brain).
  (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "last_slug" slug)
  (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "ranked_ops" ranked)
  (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "probes" probes)
  (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "mix" (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))
  (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm")
  (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "kernel" "aura")
  (hash "ok" #t "profile" "leet_swarm" "slug" slug "kernel" "aura"))

(define (mix-explorers-swarm)
  ; Strategy mix expressed in kernel (not Python self_evolve_strategy alone).
  (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))

(define (run-swarm-mutate-round)
  ; Entry for thin host: AURA_BUILD_CMD=swarm-mutate / env slug+harness.
  (let* ((slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (rank (swarm-rank-ops))
         (pso (swarm-probe "pso"))
         (abc (swarm-probe "abc"))
         (probes (hash "ant" rank "pso" pso "abc" abc))
         (ranked (hash-ref rank "ranked_ops" (swarm-default-ops)))
         (_ (swarm-schedule-write harness slug ranked probes)))
    (display "swarm_mutate ok=true kernel=aura via=")
    (display (hash-ref rank "via" ""))
    (display " slug=")(display slug)
    (display " ranked_n=")(display (length ranked))
    (display " mix=")(display (mix-explorers-swarm))
    (newline)
    (hash "ok" #t
          "kernel" "aura"
          "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
          "slug" slug
          "rank" rank
          "probes" probes
          "mix_explorers" (mix-explorers-swarm)
          "fiber_live" #f
          "note" "fiber_live not claimed; measure via denseness probe")))

; aura-build KERNEL — Soft swarm multi-mutate (product brain; NOT host Python)
;
; Soft std/ant pheromone:rank mutation-operator types; std/pso|abc probe honesty.
; Local multi-mutate via mutate:rebind + worldline/fiber explorers on the Soft
; FlatAST — Soft Ready never invented. Host Python is thin harness only.
;
; Pipeline (LeetCode / combat / pursue):
;   1. (swarm-rank-ops) → Soft-ranked mutate op schedule
;   2. (swarm-mutate-fanout score-fn n) → mutate:rebind candidates scored in Soft
;   3. (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta) → pheromone:update on helpful ops
;   4. Host may seed MiniMax from kernel-written schedule under harness memory
;
; denseness soft_*.aura = temporary; prefer Soft-native. Three-layer split.
(export
  swarm-default-ops
  swarm-rank-ops
  swarm-probe
  swarm-mutate-rebind
  swarm-mutate-fanout
  swarm-observe-gain
  swarm-schedule-write
  swarm-diverge-knobs
  run-swarm-mutate-round
  mix-explorers-swarm)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)
(require "std/ant" all:)

; Mutation-type names aligned with Soft std/ant defaults (Issue #2876).
(define (swarm-default-ops)
  ; Diversified Soft mutate-op mix for high-diverge MiniMax seeding (ant pheromone:rank).
  (list "edsl-lit-tweak"
        "edsl-op-swap"
        "edsl-body-wrap"
        "full-disp-bool"
        "full-disp-ref"
        "edsl-disp-ref"
        "full-hash-wrap"
        "edsl-cond-swap"
        "edsl-let-wrap"
        "full-tail-recur"))

(define (swarm-rank-ops)
  ; Soft ACO rank — host fallback only if Soft fails (caller checks via).
  (pheromone:init)
  (let* ((ops (swarm-default-ops))
         (ranked (pheromone:rank ops)))
    (hash "ok" #t
          "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"
          "ranked_ops" ranked
          "path" "kernel_swarm_rank"
          "kernel" "aura")))

(define (swarm-probe kind)
  ; Honesty probe for Soft std swarm backends. Never invents Soft Ready.
  (cond
    ((equal? kind "ant")
     (let ((r (swarm-rank-ops)))
       (hash "ok" (hash-ref r "ok" #f) "via" (hash-ref r "via" "") "kind" "ant")))
    ((equal? kind "pso")
     (begin
       (require "std/pso" all:)
       (pso:init 1 8 (list (list 0.0 1.0)))
       (pso:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (pso:best)))
         (hash "ok" (number? (if (pair? b) (car b) b))
               "via" "soft_pso"
               "kind" "pso"
               "best" b))))
    ((equal? kind "abc")
     (begin
       (require "std/abc" all:)
       (abc:init 1 8 (list (list -2.0 2.0)))
       (abc:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (abc:best)))
         (hash "ok" #t "via" "soft_abc" "kind" "abc" "best" b))))
    (#t (hash "ok" #f "via" "unknown_kind" "kind" kind))))

(define (swarm-mutate-rebind body-src score-fn)

  (eval-current)
  (score-fn))

; Fan-out: try several body candidates (list of strings); return best hits + list.

(define (swarm-mutate-fanout bodies score-fn)
  (let loop ((xs bodies) (best-name "") (best-score -1) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "best_name" best-name
            "best_score" best-score
            "n" (length acc)

            "path" "kernel_swarm_mutate_rebind"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (let* ((pair (car xs))

             (sc (swarm-mutate-rebind body score-fn))
             (nsc (if (number? sc) sc 0))
             (row (hash "name" name "hits" nsc "via" "mutate_rebind")))
        (loop (cdr xs)
              (if (> nsc best-score) name best-name)
              (if (> nsc best-score) nsc best-score)

(define (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta)
  ; Reinforce Soft pheromone trails for ops that produced gain.
  (pheromone:init)
  (let loop ((xs op-list))
    (if (null? xs) #t
      (begin
        (pheromone:update (car xs) (if (number? delta) delta 1.0))
        (loop (cdr xs)))))
  (hash "ok" #t "updated" op-list "delta" delta "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"))

(define (swarm-diverge-knobs)
  ; High-diverge Soft intent (user: 多发散). Sticky prefer — host reads Soft memory.
  (hash "n_mut" 48
        "n_mut_ceil" 64
        "worldlines_prefer" 256
        "explorer_cap_prefer" 32
        "seed_policy" "minimax_seed_only_no_soft_score_banner"
        "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
        "mix" (list "rule" "mutate" "llm")
        "diverge_sticky" #t
        "kernel" "aura"))

(define (swarm-schedule-write harness-root slug ranked probes)
  ; Persist Soft-ranked schedule for thin host MiniMax seed (not Python brain).
  (let ((knobs (swarm-diverge-knobs)))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "last_slug" slug)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "ranked_ops" ranked)

    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm")
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "kernel" "aura")

    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "seed_policy" "minimax_seed_only_no_soft_score_banner")
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "n_mut" (hash-ref knobs "n_mut" 48))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "n_mut_ceil" (hash-ref knobs "n_mut_ceil" 64))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "worldlines_prefer" 256)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "explorer_cap_prefer" 32)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "diverge_sticky" #t)
    (hash "ok" #t "profile" "leet_swarm" "slug" slug "kernel" "aura" "n_mut" 48)))

(define (mix-explorers-swarm)
  ; Strategy mix expressed in kernel (not Python self_evolve_strategy alone).
  (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))

(define (run-swarm-mutate-round)
  ; Entry for thin host: AURA_BUILD_CMD=swarm-mutate / env slug+harness.
  (let* ((slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (rank (swarm-rank-ops))
         (pso (swarm-probe "pso"))
         (abc (swarm-probe "abc"))
         (probes (hash "ant" rank "pso" pso "abc" abc))
         (ranked (hash-ref rank "ranked_ops" (swarm-default-ops)))
         (_ (swarm-schedule-write harness slug ranked probes)))
    (display "swarm_mutate ok=true kernel=aura via=")
    (display (hash-ref rank "via" ""))
    (display " slug=")(display slug)
    (display " ranked_n=")(display (length ranked))
    (display " n_mut=")(display 48)
    (display " wl_prefer=")(display 256)
    (display " mix=")(display (mix-explorers-swarm))
    (newline)
    (hash "ok" #t
          "kernel" "aura"
          "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
          "slug" slug
          "rank" rank
          "probes" probes
          "mix_explorers" (mix-explorers-swarm)
          "fiber_live" #f
          "note" "fiber_live not claimed; measure via denseness probe")))

; aura-build KERNEL — Soft swarm multi-mutate (product brain; NOT host Python)
;
; Soft std/ant pheromone:rank mutation-operator types; std/pso|abc probe honesty.
; Local multi-mutate via mutate:rebind + worldline/fiber explorers on the Soft
; FlatAST — Soft Ready never invented. Host Python is thin harness only.
;
; Pipeline (LeetCode / combat / pursue):
;   1. (swarm-rank-ops) → Soft-ranked mutate op schedule
;   2. (swarm-mutate-fanout score-fn n) → mutate:rebind candidates scored in Soft
;   3. (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta) → pheromone:update on helpful ops
;   4. Host may seed MiniMax from kernel-written schedule under harness memory
;
; denseness soft_*.aura = temporary; prefer Soft-native. Three-layer split.
(export
  swarm-default-ops
  swarm-rank-ops
  swarm-probe
  swarm-mutate-rebind
  swarm-mutate-fanout
  swarm-observe-gain
  swarm-schedule-write
  swarm-diverge-knobs
  run-swarm-mutate-round
  mix-explorers-swarm)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)
(require "std/ant" all:)

; Mutation-type names aligned with Soft std/ant defaults (Issue #2876).
(define (swarm-default-ops)
  ; Diversified Soft mutate-op mix for high-diverge MiniMax seeding (ant pheromone:rank).
  (list "edsl-lit-tweak"
        "edsl-op-swap"
        "edsl-body-wrap"
        "full-disp-bool"
        "full-disp-ref"
        "edsl-disp-ref"
        "full-hash-wrap"
        "edsl-cond-swap"
        "edsl-let-wrap"
        "full-tail-recur"))

(define (swarm-rank-ops)
  ; Soft ACO rank — host fallback only if Soft fails (caller checks via).
  (pheromone:init)
  (let* ((ops (swarm-default-ops))
         (ranked (pheromone:rank ops)))
    (hash "ok" #t
          "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"
          "ranked_ops" ranked
          "path" "kernel_swarm_rank"
          "kernel" "aura")))

(define (swarm-probe kind)
  ; Honesty probe for Soft std swarm backends. Never invents Soft Ready.
  (cond
    ((equal? kind "ant")
     (let ((r (swarm-rank-ops)))
       (hash "ok" (hash-ref r "ok" #f) "via" (hash-ref r "via" "") "kind" "ant")))
    ((equal? kind "pso")
     (begin
       (require "std/pso" all:)
       (pso:init 1 8 (list (list 0.0 1.0)))
       (pso:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (pso:best)))
         (hash "ok" (number? (if (pair? b) (car b) b))
               "via" "soft_pso"
               "kind" "pso"
               "best" b))))
    ((equal? kind "abc")
     (begin
       (require "std/abc" all:)
       (abc:init 1 8 (list (list -2.0 2.0)))
       (abc:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (abc:best)))
         (hash "ok" #t "via" "soft_abc" "kind" "abc" "best" b))))
    (#t (hash "ok" #f "via" "unknown_kind" "kind" kind))))

; Apply one Soft mutate:rebind of solve → score-fn → restore optional.
; body-src is a string lambda form for mutate:rebind.
(define (swarm-mutate-rebind body-src score-fn)
  (mutate:rebind "solve" body-src "solve-swarm-cand")
  (eval-current)
  (score-fn))

; Fan-out: try several body candidates (list of strings); return best hits + list.
; bodies = ((name . body-src) ...) ; score-fn → number (higher better)
(define (swarm-mutate-fanout bodies score-fn)
  (let loop ((xs bodies) (best-name "") (best-score -1) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "best_name" best-name
            "best_score" best-score
            "n" (length acc)
            "explorers" (reverse acc)
            "path" "kernel_swarm_mutate_rebind"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (let* ((pair (car xs))
             (name (car pair))
             (body (cdr pair))
             (sc (swarm-mutate-rebind body score-fn))
             (nsc (if (number? sc) sc 0))
             (row (hash "name" name "hits" nsc "via" "mutate_rebind")))
        (loop (cdr xs)
              (if (> nsc best-score) name best-name)
              (if (> nsc best-score) nsc best-score)
              (cons row acc))))))

(define (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta)
  ; Reinforce Soft pheromone trails for ops that produced gain.
  (pheromone:init)
  (let loop ((xs op-list))
    (if (null? xs) #t
      (begin
        (pheromone:update (car xs) (if (number? delta) delta 1.0))
        (loop (cdr xs)))))
  (hash "ok" #t "updated" op-list "delta" delta "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"))

(define (swarm-diverge-knobs)
  ; High-diverge Soft intent (user: 多发散). Sticky prefer — host reads Soft memory.
  (hash "n_mut" 48
        "n_mut_ceil" 64
        "worldlines_prefer" 256
        "explorer_cap_prefer" 32
        "seed_policy" "minimax_seed_only_no_soft_score_banner"
        "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
        "mix" (list "rule" "mutate" "llm")
        "diverge_sticky" #t
        "kernel" "aura"))

(define (swarm-schedule-write harness-root slug ranked probes)
  ; Persist Soft-ranked schedule for thin host MiniMax seed (not Python brain).
  (let ((knobs (swarm-diverge-knobs)))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "last_slug" slug)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "ranked_ops" ranked)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "probes" probes)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "mix" (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm")
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "kernel" "aura")
    ; Host MiniMax seed-only for banner ops; Soft-score only mutate:rebind body diffs.
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "seed_policy" "minimax_seed_only_no_soft_score_banner")
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "n_mut" (hash-ref knobs "n_mut" 48))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "n_mut_ceil" (hash-ref knobs "n_mut_ceil" 64))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "worldlines_prefer" 256)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "explorer_cap_prefer" 32)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "diverge_sticky" #t)
    (hash "ok" #t "profile" "leet_swarm" "slug" slug "kernel" "aura" "n_mut" 48)))

(define (mix-explorers-swarm)
  ; Strategy mix expressed in kernel (not Python self_evolve_strategy alone).
  (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))

(define (run-swarm-mutate-round)
  ; Entry for thin host: AURA_BUILD_CMD=swarm-mutate / env slug+harness.
  (let* ((slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (rank (swarm-rank-ops))
         (pso (swarm-probe "pso"))
         (abc (swarm-probe "abc"))
         (probes (hash "ant" rank "pso" pso "abc" abc))
         (ranked (hash-ref rank "ranked_ops" (swarm-default-ops)))
         (_ (swarm-schedule-write harness slug ranked probes)))
    (display "swarm_mutate ok=true kernel=aura via=")
    (display (hash-ref rank "via" ""))
    (display " slug=")(display slug)
    (display " ranked_n=")(display (length ranked))
    (display " n_mut=")(display 48)
    (display " wl_prefer=")(display 256)
    (display " mix=")(display (mix-explorers-swarm))
    (newline)
    (hash "ok" #t
          "kernel" "aura"
          "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
          "slug" slug
          "rank" rank
          "probes" probes
          "mix_explorers" (mix-explorers-swarm)
          "fiber_live" #f
          "note" "fiber_live not claimed; measure via denseness probe")))

input.source:
; aura-build KERNEL — Soft swarm multi-mutate (product brain; NOT host Python)
;
; Soft std/ant pheromone:rank mutation-operator types; std/pso|abc probe honesty.
; Local multi-mutate via mutate:rebind + worldline/fiber explorers on the Soft
; FlatAST — Soft Ready never invented. Host Python is thin harness only.
;
; Pipeline (LeetCode / combat / pursue):
;   1. (swarm-rank-ops) → Soft-ranked mutate op schedule
;   2. (swarm-mutate-fanout score-fn n) → mutate:rebind candidates scored in Soft
;   3. (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta) → pheromone:update on helpful ops
;   4. Host may seed MiniMax from kernel-written schedule under harness memory
;
; denseness soft_*.aura = temporary; prefer Soft-native. Three-layer split.
(export
  swarm-default-ops
  swarm-rank-ops
  swarm-probe
  swarm-mutate-rebind
  swarm-mutate-fanout
  swarm-observe-gain
  swarm-schedule-write
  swarm-diverge-knobs
  run-swarm-mutate-round
  mix-explorers-swarm)

(require "util" all:)
(require "memory" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)
(require "std/ant" all:)

; Mutation-type names aligned with Soft std/ant defaults (Issue #2876).
(define (swarm-default-ops)
  ; Diversified Soft mutate-op mix for high-diverge MiniMax seeding (ant pheromone:rank).
  (list "edsl-lit-tweak"
        "edsl-op-swap"
        "edsl-body-wrap"
        "full-disp-bool"
        "full-disp-ref"
        "edsl-disp-ref"
        "full-hash-wrap"
        "edsl-cond-swap"
        "edsl-let-wrap"
        "full-tail-recur"))

(define (swarm-rank-ops)
  ; Soft ACO rank — host fallback only if Soft fails (caller checks via).
  (pheromone:init)
  (let* ((ops (swarm-default-ops))
         (ranked (pheromone:rank ops)))
    (hash "ok" #t
          "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"
          "ranked_ops" ranked
          "path" "kernel_swarm_rank"
          "kernel" "aura")))

(define (swarm-probe kind)
  ; Honesty probe for Soft std swarm backends. Never invents Soft Ready.
  (cond
    ((equal? kind "ant")
     (let ((r (swarm-rank-ops)))
       (hash "ok" (hash-ref r "ok" #f) "via" (hash-ref r "via" "") "kind" "ant")))
    ((equal? kind "pso")
     (begin
       (require "std/pso" all:)
       (pso:init 1 8 (list (list 0.0 1.0)))
       (pso:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (pso:best)))
         (hash "ok" (number? (if (pair? b) (car b) b))
               "via" "soft_pso"
               "kind" "pso"
               "best" b))))
    ((equal? kind "abc")
     (begin
       (require "std/abc" all:)
       (abc:init 1 8 (list (list -2.0 2.0)))
       (abc:step! (lambda (x) (- 0.0 (* (car x) (car x)))))
       (let ((b (abc:best)))
         (hash "ok" #t "via" "soft_abc" "kind" "abc" "best" b))))
    (#t (hash "ok" #f "via" "unknown_kind" "kind" kind))))

; Apply one Soft mutate:rebind of solve → score-fn → restore optional.
; body-src is a string lambda form for mutate:rebind.
(define (swarm-mutate-rebind body-src score-fn)
  (mutate:rebind "solve" body-src "solve-swarm-cand")
  (eval-current)
  (score-fn))

; Fan-out: try several body candidates (list of strings); return best hits + list.
; bodies = ((name . body-src) ...) ; score-fn → number (higher better)
(define (swarm-mutate-fanout bodies score-fn)
  (let loop ((xs bodies) (best-name "") (best-score -1) (acc (list)))
    (if (null? xs)
      (hash "ok" #t
            "best_name" best-name
            "best_score" best-score
            "n" (length acc)
            "explorers" (reverse acc)
            "path" "kernel_swarm_mutate_rebind"
            "kernel" "aura")
      (let* ((pair (car xs))
             (name (car pair))
             (body (cdr pair))
             (sc (swarm-mutate-rebind body score-fn))
             (nsc (if (number? sc) sc 0))
             (row (hash "name" name "hits" nsc "via" "mutate_rebind")))
        (loop (cdr xs)
              (if (> nsc best-score) name best-name)
              (if (> nsc best-score) nsc best-score)
              (cons row acc))))))

(define (swarm-observe-gain op-list delta)
  ; Reinforce Soft pheromone trails for ops that produced gain.
  (pheromone:init)
  (let loop ((xs op-list))
    (if (null? xs) #t
      (begin
        (pheromone:update (car xs) (if (number? delta) delta 1.0))
        (loop (cdr xs)))))
  (hash "ok" #t "updated" op-list "delta" delta "via" "soft_ant_pheromone"))

(define (swarm-diverge-knobs)
  ; High-diverge Soft intent (user: 多发散). Sticky prefer — host reads Soft memory.
  (hash "n_mut" 48
        "n_mut_ceil" 64
        "worldlines_prefer" 256
        "explorer_cap_prefer" 64
        "seed_policy" "minimax_seed_only_no_soft_score_banner"
        "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
        "mix" (list "rule" "mutate" "llm")
        "diverge_sticky" #t
        "kernel" "aura"))

(define (swarm-schedule-write harness-root slug ranked probes)
  ; Persist Soft-ranked schedule for thin host MiniMax seed (not Python brain).
  (let ((knobs (swarm-diverge-knobs)))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "last_slug" slug)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "ranked_ops" ranked)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "probes" probes)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "mix" (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm")
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "kernel" "aura")
    ; Host MiniMax seed-only for banner ops; Soft-score only mutate:rebind body diffs.
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "seed_policy" "minimax_seed_only_no_soft_score_banner")
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "n_mut" (hash-ref knobs "n_mut" 48))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "n_mut_ceil" (hash-ref knobs "n_mut_ceil" 64))
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "worldlines_prefer" 256)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "explorer_cap_prefer" 64)
    (memory-set harness-root "leet_swarm" "diverge_sticky" #t)
    (hash "ok" #t "profile" "leet_swarm" "slug" slug "kernel" "aura" "n_mut" 48)))

(define (mix-explorers-swarm)
  ; Strategy mix expressed in kernel (not Python self_evolve_strategy alone).
  (list "rule" "mutate" "llm"))

(define (run-swarm-mutate-round)
  ; Entry for thin host: AURA_BUILD_CMD=swarm-mutate / env slug+harness.
  (let* ((slug (env-get "AURA_BUILD_SLUG" "unknown"))
         (harness (env-get "AURA_BUILD_HARNESS_ROOT" ".aura-build"))
         (rank (swarm-rank-ops))
         (pso (swarm-probe "pso"))
         (abc (swarm-probe "abc"))
         (probes (hash "ant" rank "pso" pso "abc" abc))
         (ranked (hash-ref rank "ranked_ops" (swarm-default-ops)))
         (_ (swarm-schedule-write harness slug ranked probes)))
    (display "swarm_mutate ok=true kernel=aura via=")
    (display (hash-ref rank "via" ""))
    (display " slug=")(display slug)
    (display " ranked_n=")(display (length ranked))
    (display " n_mut=")(display 48)
    (display " wl_prefer=")(display 256)
    (display " mix=")(display (mix-explorers-swarm))
    (newline)
    (hash "ok" #t
          "kernel" "aura"
          "path" "swarm_mutate_then_llm"
          "slug" slug
          "rank" rank
          "probes" probes
          "mix_explorers" (mix-explorers-swarm)
          "fiber_live" #f
          "note" "fiber_live not claimed; measure via denseness probe")))

(define FEEDBACK_PROFILE "leet_feedback")

(define (feedback-load harness-root)
  (memory-list harness-root FEEDBACK_PROFILE))

(define (feedback-classify selected baseline transient-n zero-n n soft-via)
  (cond
    ((>= transient-n (if (> (quotient n 3) 2) (quotient n 3) 2))
     "sock_transient")
    ((and (> baseline 0) (= selected 0) (>= zero-n (quotient (* n 2) 3)))
     "sock_score_collapse")
    ((and (equal? soft-via "host_fallback") #t)
     "sock_select_transient")
    ((and (= selected baseline) (> selected 0))
     "quality_plateau")
    ((<= selected baseline)
     "quality_no_improvement")
    ((> selected baseline)
     "gain")
    (#t "quality_unknown")))

(define (feedback-family-hints slug)
  ; Algorithm-family tips live in KERNEL (not Python product).
  (cond
    ((or (equal? slug "daily-temperatures")
         (string-contains? slug "next-greater")
         (string-contains? slug "asteroid"))
     (list "Use a monotonic stack (indices) for next-greater / warmer patterns."
           "Iterate left→right; pop colder tops; fill distance array."))
    ((or (equal? slug "climbing-stairs")
         (string-contains? slug "fibonacci")
         (string-contains? slug "house-robber"))
     (list "O(n) iterative DP; rolling two vars; avoid deep Soft recursion."
           "Circular robber: solve exclude-first and exclude-last; take max."))
    ((string-contains? slug "parenthes")
     (list "Backtrack open/close counts; prune close>open; length 2n."))
    ((equal? slug "gas-station")
     (list "One-pass circuit: reset start when tank<0; total<0 → -1."))
    ((string-contains? slug "decode")
     (list "Stack of (prev, k); digit→k; '[' push; ']' pop+repeat."))
    ((or (string-contains? slug "island")
         (string-contains? slug "flood")
         (string-contains? slug "route")
         (string-contains? slug "course-schedule"))
     (list "Prefer BFS/queue Soft-friendly loops; mark visited."))

  (if (or (not (string? text)) (not (string? substr))) #f
    (let ((n (string-length text)) (m (string-length substr)))

;;; aura-build kernel — continuous goal-driven pursue loop
; Owns scout→mutate→eval→select-best rounds until goal / max-rounds / honesty fail-closed.
; MiniMax is never the controller (optional host hint only). AUTOPROMOTE stays OFF.
; Honesty: never invent incr_proven / fiber_live / worldline_backend via env alone.
; Soft gap fill: util string-pad/string-take (+ soft_pad/soft_take denseness) for align/trunc.
(export run-pursue)

(require "util" all:)
(require "traj" all:)
(require "orch" all:)
(require "worldline" all:)
(require "harness" all:)
(require "prove" all:)
(require "std/io" all:)
(require "std/hash" all:)

(define (pursue-parse-min-fitness)
  ; Prefer AURA_BUILD_MIN_FITNESS; else parse predicate fitness_ge:N
  (let* ((raw-min (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MIN_FITNESS" ""))
         (pred (string-downcase (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PREDICATE" "")))
         (from-min (if (equal? raw-min "") #f (string->number raw-min))))
    (if (number? from-min)
      from-min
      (if (and (>= (string-length pred) 11)
               (equal? (substring pred 0 11) "fitness_ge:"))
        (let ((n (string->number (substring pred 11 (string-length pred)))))
          (if (number? n) n 0.8))
        0.8))))

(define (pursue-make-prompt goal hint)
  (if (or (not (string? hint)) (equal? hint ""))
    goal
    (string-append goal "\n\n; llm_hint (non-controller):\n" hint)))

(define (pursue-print-round i max-r sel fit rt stop)
  (display "pursue round=")(display i)(display "/")(display max-r)
  (display " selected=")(display sel)
  (display " fitness=")(display fit)
  (display " worldline_backend=")(display (hash-ref rt "worldline_backend" "file"))
  (display " fiber_live=")(display (hash-ref rt "fiber_live" #f))
  (display " incr_proven=")(display (hash-ref rt "incr_proven" #f))
  (display " l1_backend=")(display (hash-ref rt "l1_backend" "file"))
  (display " stop_reason=")(display stop)
  (display " kernel=aura")
