(define (pursue-enrich-episode ep goal round-i max-r min-fit stop l1-backend llm-assist harness-mut?)
  (let ((rt (hash-ref ep "runtime")))
    (hash-set! rt "pursue" (hash "goal" goal
                                 "round_i" round-i
                                 "max_rounds" max-r
                                 "min_fitness" min-fit
                                 "stop_reason" stop
                                 "llm_assist" llm-assist
                                 "harness_mutate" harness-mut?))
    (hash-set! rt "l1_backend" l1-backend)
    (hash-set! rt "goal" goal)
    (hash-set! rt "round_i" round-i)
    (hash-set! rt "stop_reason" stop)
    (hash-set! ep "prompt" goal)
    (hash "episode" ep "runtime" rt)))

(define (pursue-honesty-ok? decision)
  ; Fail closed only on incoherent claims (env cannot elevate). Missing prove is OK.
  (let* ((fiber (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
         (backend (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend" BACKEND_FILE)))
    ; fiber_graph requires live denseness; file backend always coherent
    (if (equal? backend BACKEND_FIBER)
      (if fiber #t #f)
      #t)))

(define (run-pursue)
  (let* ((goal (env-get "AURA_BUILD_GOAL" (env-get "AURA_BUILD_PROMPT" "")))
         (hint (env-get "AURA_BUILD_LLM_HINT" ""))

         (mode-req (env-get "AURA_BUILD_MODE" "aura"))

         (prompt (pursue-make-prompt goal hint))
         (l1-backend (l1-backend-prefer))
         (honesty (attach-prove-metadata harness-root))
         (decision (decide-worldline-backend probe-fiber-session))
         (bin (env-get "AURA_BIN" "")))
    (display "pursue goal=")(display goal)(newline)
    (display "pursue min_fitness=")(display min-fit)
    (display " max_rounds=")(display max-r)
    (display " worldlines=")(display n)
    (display " mode=")(display mode)
    (display " llm_assist=")(display llm-assist)
    (display " harness_mutate=")(display want-harness)
    (display " kernel=aura")(newline)
    (display "pursue honesty worldline_backend=")(display (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend"))
    (display " fiber_live=")(display (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f))
    (display " incr_proven=")(display (hash-ref honesty "incr_proven" #f))
    (display " l1_backend=")(display l1-backend)
    (display " reason=")(display (hash-ref decision "reason" ""))
    (newline)
    (cond
      ((equal? goal "")
       (display "pursue ok=false stop_reason=missing_goal kernel=aura")(newline)
       (hash "ok" #f "goal_met" #f "stop_reason" "missing_goal"
             "error" "missing_goal" "kernel" "aura" "rounds" (list)))
      ((equal? bin "")
       (display "pursue ok=false stop_reason=aura_binary_missing kernel=aura")(newline)
       (hash "ok" #f "goal_met" #f "stop_reason" "aura_binary_missing"
             "error" "aura_binary_missing" "kernel" "aura" "rounds" (list)))
      ((not (pursue-honesty-ok? decision))
       (display "pursue ok=false stop_reason=honesty_fail kernel=aura")(newline)
       (hash "ok" #f "goal_met" #f "stop_reason" "honesty_fail"
             "error" "honesty_fail"
             "worldline_backend" (hash-ref decision "worldline_backend")
             "fiber_live" (hash-ref decision "fiber_live" #f)
             "incr_proven" (hash-ref honesty "incr_proven" #f)
             "l1_backend" l1-backend

      (else
        (let ((harness-note
                (if want-harness
                  (let ((hr (run-harness-canary)))
                    (display "pursue harness_mutate outcome=")
                    (display (hash-ref hr "outcome" ""))
                    (display " l1_backend=")
                    (display (hash-ref hr "l1_backend" l1-backend))
                    (display " accepted=")
                    (display (hash-ref hr "accepted" #f))
                    (newline)
                    hr)
                  #f)))
          (let loop ((i 1)
                     (rounds (list))
                     (best-fit -1.0)
                     (best-sel "")
                     (last-rt (hash))

            (if (> i max-r)
              (let ((stop "max_rounds")

;; Dungeon Game solution in Aura

(define (length xs)
  (if (null? xs) 0 (+ 1 (length (cdr xs)))))

(define (list-ref xs i)
  (if (= i 0) (car xs) (list-ref (cdr xs) i)))

(define (min a b) (if (< a b) a b))
(define (max a b) (if (> a b) a b))

(define (row-ref g i) (list-ref g i))
(define (cell g i j)
  (list-ref (list-ref g i) j))

(define (nrows g) (length g))
(define (ncols g) (length (list-ref g 0)))

;; DP from bottom-right:
;; dp[i][j] = min health needed BEFORE entering cell (i,j).
;; Recurrence: need = min(dp[i][j+1], dp[i+1][j]) - grid[i][j]
;; If need < 1, then 1.
;; Base: dp[m-1][n-1] = max(1, 1 - grid[m-1][n-1])
(define (solve grid)
  (let* ((m (nrows grid))
         (n (ncols grid)))
    (let ((dp (make-list m '())))
      (letrec (
        ;; Fill row i from right to left; row-below is (list-ref dp (+ i 1)) or #f
        (fill-row (lambda (i)
          (letrec ((row-below (if (< i (- m 1)) (list-ref dp (+ i 1)) #f))
                   (loop (lambda (j)
                     (if (< j 0) '()
                         (let* ((val (cell grid i j))
                                (right (if (< j (- n 1))
                                           (car (list-ref (list-ref dp i) 1))
                                           #f))
                                (down (if row-below
                                          (list-ref row-below j)
                                          #f))
                                (next (cond
                                         ((and (number? right) (number? down))
                                          (min right down))
                                         ((number? right) right)
                                         ((number? down) down)
                                         (else 1)))
                                (need (- next val))
                                (final (if (< need 1) 1 need)))
                           (cons final (loop (- j 1))))))))
            (set! (list-ref dp i) (loop (- n 1)))))))

        ;; Fill rows from bottom to top
        (fill-all (lambda (i)
          (if (< i 0) '()
              (begin
                (fill-row i)
                (fill-all (- i 1)))))))

        (fill-all (- m 1))
        (car (list-ref dp 0))))))

;; Test cases
(define grid0 '((-2 -3 3) (-5 -10 1) (10 30 -5)))
(define grid1 '((0)))
(define grid2 '((-3)))
(define grid3 '((1 2 3) (0 0 0)))
(define grid4 '((-1 -1 -1) (-1 -1 -1) (-1 -1 -1)))
(define grid5 '((100)))
(define grid6 '((0 0) (0 0)))
(define grid7 '((-2 1) (-3 1)))

(display "CASE0=") (display (solve grid0)) (newline)
(display "CASE1=") (display (solve grid1)) (newline)
(display "CASE2=") (display (solve grid2)) (newline)
(display "CASE3=") (display (solve grid3)) (newline)
(display "CASE4=") (display (solve grid4)) (newline)
(display "CASE5=") (display (solve grid5)) (newline)
(display "CASE6=") (display (solve grid6)) (newline)
(display "CASE7=") (display (solve grid7)) (newline)

                 (if (< j (- n 1))

;; Solution for BST Iterator problem
;; Implements an iterator using controlled in-order traversal with O(h) stack space

;; Build tree from level-order list where 'null represents missing nodes
(define (build-tree lst)
  (if (null? lst)
      '()
      (let ((root (cons (car lst) (cons '() '()))))
        (let ((queue (list root))
              (rest (cdr lst)))
          (define (build-helper q r)
            (if (or (null? q) (null? r))
                root
                (let ((node (car q))
                      (nq (cdr q)))
                  (let ((new-r (build-children node r nq)))
                    (build-helper new-r (cdr new-r))))))
          (define (build-children node r q)
            (let ((new-q (append q (list (cons 'null '()) (cons 'null '())))))
              (if (or (null? r) (equal? (car r) 'null))
                  (begin
                    (set-cdr! node (cons '() '()))
                    (cons '() (append r '())))
                  (let ((left-val (car r)))
                    (if (equal? left-val 'null)
                        (set-car! (cdr node) '())
                        (let ((left-node (cons left-val (cons '() '()))))
                          (set-car! (cdr node) left-node)
                          ...)))))))
        root)))

;; Simpler approach: build tree iteratively with mutable refs
(define (make-node val)
  (cons val (cons '() '())))

(define (set-left! node child)
  (set-car! (cdr node) child))

(define (set-right! node child)
  (set-cdr! (cdr node) child))

(define (build-tree2 vals)
  (if (or (null? vals) (equal? (car vals) 'null))
      '()
      (let ((root (make-node (car vals))))
        (let ((queue (list root))
              (idx 1))
          (define (loop)
            (if (or (null? queue) (>= idx (length vals)))
                'done
                (let ((node (car queue)))
                  (set! queue (cdr queue))
                  ;; left child
                  (if (and (< idx (length vals))
                           (not (equal? (list-ref vals idx) 'null)))
                      (let ((left (make-node (list-ref vals idx))))
                        (set-left! node left)
                        (set! queue (append queue (list left))))
                      (set-left! node '()))
                  (set! idx (+ idx 1))
                  ;; right child
                  (if (and (< idx (length vals))
                           (not (equal? (list-ref vals idx) 'null)))
                      (let ((right (make-node (list-ref vals idx))))
                        (set-right! node right)
                        (set! queue (append queue (list right))))
                      (set-right! node '()))
                  (set! idx (+ idx 1))
                  (loop))))
          (loop)
          root))))

  (if (= n 0)
      (car lst)

(define (make-stack) '())

(define (stack-push! stk val)
  (set! stk (cons val stk)))

;; Iterator state: a stack of nodes for controlled in-order traversal
;; Each state: (stack . root) where stack is a list of nodes

(define (iterator-init root)
  (let ((stack (make-stack)))

    (let ((node root))

        (if (or (null? n) (null? n))
            'done

              (set! stack (cons n stack))
              (push-lefts (car (cdr n))))))
      (push-lefts node))
    (cons stack root)))

(define (iterator-next it)
